Many important historical documents were destroyed when the library was bombed.  图书馆遭轰炸时，很多重要的历史文献都毁于一旦。
She specializes in historical novels set in eighteenth-century England.  她专门创作以18世纪英格兰为背景的历史小说。

words.meaning: n.内服药,医药;医术;医学,内科学
words.example:
She is a doctor, but is unable to practise medicine (= work as a doctor) in her own country.  她是位医生，却不能在自己的国家行医。noun
Take two spoonfuls of medicine at mealtimes.  进餐时服药两调羹。
She knows quite a lot about herbal medicines.  她的草药知识丰富。noun

words.meaning: n.旅游,旅行;巡回演出/比赛 v.旅游
words.example:
We went on a guided tour of / UK alsoround the cathedral/museum/factory.  我们在导游的带领下参观了大教堂／博物馆／工厂。
They've just come back from a tour of / UK alsoround Devon and Cornwall.  他们刚从德文郡和康沃尔郡旅行回来。
Tour operators (= companies which arrange holidays for people) have reported a drop in bookings.  旅行社称预订旅游的人数减少了。

words.meaning: v.(on)取决于,依靠,信赖,相信
words.example:
Whether or not we go to Spain for our holiday depends on the cost.  我们去不去西班牙渡假取决于需要花上多少钱。
You can always depend on Michael in a crisis.  遇到危机的时候你总是可以相信麦克。
humorous You can depend on Jane to be late (= she is always late).  简总是迟到。

words.meaning: n.(photograph)照片
words.example: She took a lot of photos of the kids.  她拍了很多孩子的照片。

words.meaning: n.发现,发现物;(常pl.)调查/研究结果
words.example: The report's finding on the decrease in violent crime supports the police chief's claims.  这份报告关于暴力罪行减少这一现象的结论证实了警察局长的说法。noun

words.meaning: v./n.(at)抓(住);夺(得)
words.example:
He grabbed (hold of) his child's arm to stop her from running into the road.  他抓住孩子的手臂防止她跑到路中间去。verb (-bb-)
If you don't grab this opportunity, you might not get another one.  如果你不抓住这次机会，可能就没有第二次了。
We'd better get there early, or someone else will grab the best seats.  我们最好早些赶到那里，否则好座位就给别人占了。

words.meaning: a./ad.径直的(地) v.管理,指导;(at,to)指向
words.example:
Is there a direct train to Edinburgh?  有到爱丁堡的直达列车吗？
She decided to take direct control of the project.  她决定直接管理这个企划案。
He denied that he had any direct involvement in the deal.  他否认自己与这笔交易有任何直接关系。

words.meaning: n.教室,课堂
words.example:
Students learning computer studies spend two days each week in a computer lab and four days in the classroom.  学习电脑的学生每周有两天在电脑室上课，四天在教室上课。
There are also no promotions within the school, so that teachers remain in the classroom throughout their careers.  学校里也没有晋升制度，所以老师在整个教学生涯中都要授课。

words.meaning: v./n.(使)接触,联系,交往
words.example:
I'm still in contact with her - we write a couple of times a year.  我和她仍有联系——我们一年写几封信。
There isn't enough contact between teachers and parents.  老师和家长间联系不够。
I've been busy at home and have hardly had any contact with the outside world.  我一直都在家里忙，和外面的世界几乎没有甚么联系。

words.meaning: n.公正,公平;审判,司法
words.example:
There's no justice in the world when people can be made to suffer like that.  如果人们被迫遭受这样的痛苦，那么世上就没有公平正义可言了。
The winner has been disqualified for cheating, so justice has been done (= a fair situation has been achieved).  获胜者因舞弊而被取消了资格，正义得以伸张。    Opposite injusticenoun
the justice system in this country consists of a series of law courts at different levels.  这个国家的司法体系由各级法庭组成。

words.meaning: v.(in)参与,参加;分享,分担;含有,带有
words.example: She never participates in any of our discussions, does she?  她从不参加我们的任何讨论，不是吗？UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.每日的 ad.每日,天天 n.日报
words.example:
Take the tablets twice daily.  药片日服两次。
Exercise has become part of my daily routine.  锻炼已经成为我日常生活的一部分。
We back up our computer files at work on a daily basis.  我们每天工作时都要把电脑文件进行备份。

words.meaning: a.公平的,合理的;相当的 n.集市,交易会
words.example:
Why should I have to do all the cleaning? It's not fair!  为甚么我要做所有的打扫工作？这不公平！
It's not fair on Joe (= It is not right) to make him do all the work!  所有的工作都由乔做，这对他不公平！
It's not fair that she's allowed to go and I'm not!  允许她去，却不许我去，这不公平！

words.meaning: n.一对,一双;一副;夫妇 v.配对,成对
words.example:
He packed two pairs of trousers and four shirts.  他把两条裤子和四件衬衫放进包里。
I'd like you to do this exercise in pairs (= in groups of two).  我希望你们两人一组来做这个练习。
They seem a very happy pair.  他们像是很幸福的一对。

words.meaning: a.著名的
words.example: Marie Curie is famous for her contribution to science.  玛丽‧居里以其对科学的贡献而享有盛名。

words.meaning: n.练习,习题;训练,锻练 v.训练,锻练;行使
words.example:
Swimming is my favourite form of exercise.  我最喜欢的运动是游泳。
You really should take more exercise.  你真的应该多做运动。
Ships from eight navies will be taking part in an exercise in the Pacific to improve their efficiency in combat.  来自8个国家的海军军舰将参加在太平洋举行的军事演习，以提高其作战效率。

words.meaning: n.膝,膝盖
words.example:
The baby was crawling around on its hands and knees.  婴儿用手和膝盖着地爬来爬去。
He got/went down on his knees (= got into a position where his knees were on the ground) in front of the altar.  他在圣坛前跪下。
She took the child and sat it on her knee (= on the part of the leg above the knee when sitting down).  她抱起孩子放在自己的膝盖上。

words.meaning: n.花;精华,精粹,精英;盛时 vi.开花
words.example:
The flower of the nation's youth were killed in the war.  该国的青年精英都死于这场战争。UK noun countable
Our roses are usually in flower from April to November.  我们的玫瑰通常在4月到11月开花。UK noun countable
He died in the very flower of his youth.  他去世时风华正茂。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.带(子);录音带,磁带 v.录音;系,捆
words.example:
I've got that film on tape (= recorded) if you want to borrow it.  我已经把那部电影录了下来，你可以借去看。
If you give me a blank tape (= one with nothing on it) I'll record it for you.  如果你给我一张空白带，我就帮你录。noun countable or uncountable
She taped a note to the door.  她把一张字条贴在门上。verb transitive

words.meaning: n./v.雇用,租借
words.example:
How much would it cost to hire a car for a fortnight?  租一辆车两个礼拜要多少钱？
You could always hire a dress for the ball if you can't afford to buy one.  如果你买不起舞会礼服，起码可以租一套。
How much do you charge for hiring out a bicycle for a week?  租一辆脚踏车一个星期需要多少钱？

words.meaning: a.熟悉的;通晓的;亲近的 n.熟客;密友
words.example:
There were one or two familiar faces (= people I knew).  那里有一两张熟悉的面孔。
The house looked strangely familiar, though she knew she'd never been there before.  尽管她知道自己以前从未到过那里，那座房子看上去却有一种奇怪的熟悉感。
The street was familiar to me.  这条街我很熟悉。

words.meaning: a.适当的,恰当的,特有的 vt.拨给,挪用,盗用
words.example:
Is this film appropriate for small children?  这部电影适合幼童观看吗？
Is this an appropriate occasion to discuss finance?  这个场合适合讨论财政问题吗？
Please complete the appropriate parts of this form (= the parts that are right or necessary for your particular situation) and return it as soon as possible.  请正确填写表中相应部分并尽快交回。    Opposite inappropriateverb transitive UK US     formal

words.meaning: v.(with,to)供给,供应,补足 n.供应,供应量
words.example:
Electrical power is supplied by underground cables.  电力是由地下电缆输送的。
Three people have been arrested for supplying arms to the terrorists.  有三个人因为向恐怖分子提供武器而被捕。
The company has supplied the royal family (= provided them with something they need) for years.  该公司多年来一直为皇室供货。

words.meaning: n.男演员;演员,行动者
words.example: "Who's your favourite actor?" "Robert de Niro."  “你最喜欢的演员是谁？”“劳勃‧狄尼洛。”

words.meaning: n.出生,诞生;出身,血统;起源;出现
words.example:
It was a difficult birth.  那是一次难产。
He weighed eight pounds at birth.  他出生时体重八磅。
More men are present at the births of their children these days.  现在更多父亲在孩子出生时也在场。

words.meaning: v./n.(for)搜索,寻找,探查
words.example:
The police searched the woods for the missing boy.  员警在树林中搜寻失踪的孩子。
She searched his face for some sign of forgiveness, but it remained expressionless.  她仔细端详他的脸，想看出些许表示原谅的神情，但他脸上仍然毫无表情。
He searched (in/through) his pockets for some change.  他翻遍口袋想找些零钱。

words.meaning: n.领带;联系,关系,纽带;束缚 v.扎,系,捆
words.example:
Could you tie this piece of string for me?  你能帮我把这个绳子打个结吗？
This skirt ties at the waist.  这条连衣裙是在腰间系带的。
She tied the ribbon tightly in a bow/knot.  她把丝带打成一个紧紧的蝴蝶结。

words.meaning: n.民主,民主制,民主国家
words.example:
The government has promised to uphold the principles of democracy.  政府承诺将坚守民主原则。
The early 1990s saw the spread of democracy in Eastern Europe.  20世纪90年代初，民主思想在东欧迅速传播。
Few of the Western democracies still have a royal family.  西方民主国家鲜有仍然保留皇室者。

words.meaning: a.东方的,东部的
words.example:
The eastern part of the country is very mountainous.  这个国家的东部地区多山。
Until about 1991, the Eastern bloc was the Soviet Union and the communist countries of Eastern Europe.  直到1991年左右，东方集团是指苏联和东欧的共产主义国家。
Buddhism and other Eastern (= Asian) religions fascinate me.  佛教和其他东方宗教让我着迷。

words.meaning: a.最初的,初级的;首要的,主要的,基本的
words.example:
The Red Cross's primary concern is to preserve and protect human life.  红十字会最关心的是维护人的生命安全。
The primary responsibility lies with those who break the law.  主要的责任在于那些违法者。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.&ad.昨天;前不久
words.example:
He rang yesterday while you were out.  昨天你外出时他打电话来了。
Nobody's interested in yesterday's pop-stars.  没人对过气明星感兴趣。
These songs are a part of all our yesterdays.  这些歌曲是我们所有往事的一部分。

words.meaning: n.圆,圆周;集团;周期,循环 v.环绕,旋转
words.example:
Coloured paper was cut into circles, squares and triangles.  彩纸被剪成了圆形、正方形和三角形。
We sat in a circle.  我们围坐成一圈。UK noun
The subject was never discussed outside the family circle.  这个话题只在家庭成员间讨论。

words.meaning: n.装置,设备,仪表;方法,设计
words.example: Rescuers used a special device for finding people trapped in collapsed buildings.  救援者使用特殊器械来寻找被困在倒塌建筑物下面的人。noun countable

words.meaning: v./n.进步,进展;前进
words.example:
Technological progress has been so rapid over the last few years.  在最近几年中，科技进步如此迅猛。
I'm not making much progress with my Spanish.  我的西班牙语没多大进步。
The doctor said that she was making good progress (= getting better after a medical operation or illness).  医生说她的情况正在好转。

words.meaning: n.底(部);基础,根基;海底,湖底,河床
words.example:
The government claims that the recession is bottoming out.  政府宣称经济衰退即将走出低谷。noun UK LOWEST PART  底部
He stood at the bottom of the stairs and called up to me.  他站在楼梯的最下面抬头叫我。
Extra information will be found at the bottom of the page.  补充资料见这一页的最底部。

words.meaning: n.岛,岛屿;(道路上的)交通安全岛
words.example: They live on the large Japanese island of Hokkaido.  他们住在日本的主要岛屿北海道。

words.meaning: v./n.(for)交换,兑换;交流,交易;交换台
words.example:
They were given food and shelter in exchange for work.  他们帮人工作以换取食宿。
She proposes an exchange of contracts at two o'clock.  她提议两点钟办理房屋产权过户手续。
Several people were killed during the exchange of gunfire.  交火中有几个人丧生。

words.meaning: a.清洁的,干净的v.除去..污垢,把...弄干净
words.example:
Make sure your hands are clean before you have your dinner.  饭前一定要把手洗干净。
Hospitals need to be kept spotlessly (= extremely) clean.  医院必须保持一尘不染，干干净净。adjective
The judge took the defendant's clean record (= the absence of previous involvement in crime) into account when passing sentence.  法官在宣判时考虑到被告没有前科。

words.meaning: n.画室;播音室;(电影)制片厂
words.example: The band recorded in a small studio.  乐队在小录音棚里录了音。

words.meaning: n.列车;行列,系列,一串 v.训练,培养
words.example:
Did you come by train?  你是乘火车来的吗？
She caught/took the train to Edinburgh.  她赶上了去爱丁堡的火车／她乘火车去爱丁堡。
Hurry up, or we'll miss (= arrive too late for) the train.  快点，不然我们就赶不上火车了。noun

words.meaning: n.女士,夫人
words.example:
There's a young lady here to see you.  这里有位年轻的女士要见你。
Mind your language - there are ladies present!  你说话注意点——有女士在场！
Say "thank you" to the lady, children.  孩子们，对这位女士说“谢谢。”

words.meaning: n.同事,同僚
words.example: We're entertaining some colleagues of Ben's tonight.  今晚我们要招待本的几位同事。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.申请,请求,申请书;应用,实施,实用性
words.example:
Free information will be sent out on application to (= if you ask) the central office.  请来函至总部索取免费资料。
I've sent off applications for four different jobs.  我投寄申请四份不同工作的求职信。
Have you filled in the application form for your passport yet?  你填写护照申请表了吗？

words.meaning: n.颈脖
words.example:
He had the thickest neck I'd ever seen.  我从没见过他那么粗的脖子。
She wore a gold chain around her neck.  她脖子上戴着一条金链子。
This sweater's too tight at the neck.  这件毛衣的领口太紧了。

words.meaning: v.倾斜,屈身;倚,靠,依赖 a.瘦的,无脂肪的
words.example:
She leaned forward and whispered something in my ear.  她俯身过来和我耳语了几句。
Lean your head back a bit.  头向后仰一点。
That fence is leaning to the right.  那个栅栏向右倾斜。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep] (leaned or UK ALSO leant, leaned or UK ALSO leant)

words.meaning: v./n.损害,毁坏 n.(pl.)损害赔偿费
words.example:
Many buildings were badly damaged during the war.  许多建筑物在战争中严重受损。
It was a scandal which damaged a lot of reputations.  这是一宗使人名誉扫地的丑闻。noun
Strong winds had caused serious damage to the roof.  强风使屋顶严重受损。

words.meaning: n.(常pl.)塑料,塑料制品 a.可塑的,塑性的
words.example:
He put a sheet of plastic over the broken window.  他在打破的窗户上盖了一块塑胶片。
Those flowers aren't real - they're made of plastic.  那些花不是真的——是塑胶做成的。
The company has moved into plastics.  公司已转而投身塑胶制造业。

words.meaning: a.(身材)高的,高大的;夸大的,离谱的
words.example:
He's six feet tall.  他身高六英尺。
She's much taller than me.  她比我高得多。UK adjective
Getting the essay done on time will be a tall order.  按时完成论文是件很难的事。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.金属板,片;盘子,盆子;板,钢板v.镀,电镀
words.example:
There's still lots of food on your plate.  你的盘子里还有很多食物。
Stephen ate three plates of spaghetti.  史蒂芬吃了三盘义大利面条。noun
Thick bony plates protected the dinosaur against attack.  厚厚的骨质鳞甲帮助恐龙抵御攻击。

words.meaning: v.恨,憎恨;不愿,不喜欢 n.恨,憎恶
words.example:
Kelly hates her teacher.  凯莉厌恶她的老师。
She hated the cold dark days of winter.  她不喜欢冬天寒冷阴暗的日子。
I'd hate (= would not like) you to think I didn't appreciate what you'd done.  我不愿让你认为我不欣赏你做的事。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: ad.另样,用别的方法;在其他方面conj.要不然
words.example:
I'd better write it down, otherwise I'll forget it.  我最好把它写下来，否则我会忘掉。
Phone home, otherwise your parents will start to worry.  给家里打个电话，不然你父母会开始担心的。UK adverb
The police believe he is the thief, but all the evidence suggests otherwise (= that he is not).  警方认为他就是小偷，但所有的证据都显示他不是。

words.meaning: n.写,写作;著作,作品
words.example:
Do you recognise the writing on the envelope?  你能认出信封上是谁的笔迹吗？
She is studying women's writing at the turn of the century.  她正在研究世纪之交的女作家的作品。
All bookings must be confirmed in writing.  所有预约都要以书面形式确定。

words.meaning: n./a.男性(的),雄性(的)
words.example:
What percentage of the adult male population is unemployed?  成年男性中的失业比例是多少？
The male parts of the flower are the stamens and the anthers.  花的雄性部分是雄蕊和花药。
The male of the species is less aggressive.  这个物种的雄性攻击性较弱。

words.meaning: a.活着的;存在的;活跃的;(to)敏感的
words.example:
He must be ninety if he's still alive.  如果他还在世的话，他肯定有90岁了。
Doctors kept him alive on a life-support machine.  医生使用维生系统来维持他的生命。
She's alive and well and living in New Zealand.  她生活得很好，目前住在纽西兰。

words.meaning: n.表达;表情;声调;腔调;榨出;措词;式;符号
words.example:
He wrote her a poem as an expression of his love.  他写了一首诗给她以表达爱慕之情。
We've received a lot of expressions of support for our campaign.  我们收到很多来信表示支持我们的运动。
Freedom of expression is a basic human right.  言论自由是基本的人权。

words.meaning: n.足球
words.example:
He's playing football.  他在踢足球。
Are you coming to the football match ?  你来看足球比赛吗？
I'm not a big football fan.  我算不上一个狂热的足球迷。

words.meaning: vt.想要,打算,企图
words.example:
Somehow I offended him, which wasn't what I'd intended.  我不知怎的得罪了他，但这不是我的初衷。
The course is intended for intermediate-level students.  这门课是为中等程度的学生开设的。
It was intended as a compliment, honestly!  真的，这本来是一句恭维话！

words.meaning: n.鸡肉;鸡,小鸡,小鸟
words.example:
We're having roast/fried chicken for dinner.  晚饭我们吃烤鸡／炸鸡。noun
Jump, you chicken!  跳呀，你这胆小鬼！noun
Why won't you jump? Are you chicken?  你干吗不跳？害怕了？verb

words.meaning: n.军队,陆军,军;大群,大批
words.example:
When did you join the army?  你甚么时候从军的？
He has decided on a career in the British Army.  他已经决定投身英国军队。
The army was/were called out to enforce the curfew.  出动了军队以实行宵禁。

words.meaning: vt.滥用;虐待,辱骂;诋毁 n.滥用;恶习;弊端
words.example:
She is continually abusing her position/authority by getting other people to do things for her.  她不断滥用职权／权力让别人替她做事。
Several of the children had been sexually/physically/emotionally abused.  几个儿童受到了性虐待／肉体折磨／精神上的伤害。verb transitive /əˈbjuːz/
The crowd started abusing him after he failed to save a goal.  他没有守住球门，丢了一分，观众开始对他破口大骂。noun]əˈbjuːs/

words.meaning: n.(theatre)戏院;戏剧;阶梯教室
words.example: We watched a play at the theater.  我们在剧院看了场戏。

words.meaning: v.关,关闭
words.example:
Please shut the gate.  请关上大门。
I've got a surprise for you! Shut your eyes tightly and hold out your hand.  我要给你一个惊喜！紧紧闭上眼睛，伸出你的手。
Mary shut her book and put it down on the table.  玛丽阖上书，把它放在桌子上。

words.meaning: n.地图,图 vt.在地图上标示出,绘制地图
words.example:
We need a large-scale map showing all the footpaths that we can walk along.  我们需要一张大比例尺地图，上面要标出所有能走的小路。
I'm hopeless at map reading (= understanding maps).  我一点也看不懂地图。
He bought a map showing the population distribution of Scotland.  他买了一张苏格兰人口分布图。

words.meaning: a.额外的,附加的 n.附加物,额外的东西
words.example:
If you need any extra help, just call me.  如果还需要其他的帮助，尽管打电话给我。
Recently he's been working an extra two hours a day.  最近他每日都加班两小时。
The price includes travel and accommodation but meals are extra (= there is an additional charge for meals).  这个价格包括旅费和住宿费，但是餐费要另计。adjective

words.meaning: n.(一届)会议,一段时间
words.example:
The parliamentary session is due to end on May 27th.  议会会议将于5月27日结束。
The UN Security Council met in emergency session to discuss the crisis.  联合国安理会举行了紧急会议讨论该危机。noun
The 21-year-old runner twisted his ankle in a training session last Friday.  这位21岁的跑者上周五在训练时扭伤了脚踝。

words.meaning: n.危险;威胁;危险事物
words.example:
Danger! Keep out!  危险！别进来！
He drove so fast that I really felt my life was in danger.  他的车开得太快了，当时我真的觉得自己会有生命危险。
The doctors say he is now out of danger (= is not expected to die although he has been extremely ill).  医生们说他已经渡过危险期。

words.meaning: int.欢迎 a.受欢迎的 vt./n.欢迎;迎接
words.example:
The new appointment has been widely welcomed.  这个新任命受到广泛欢迎。verb transitive
The visitors to the College were warmly welcomed by the Warden.  该大学的访问者受到学校理事的热烈欢迎。
Browning stood at the door, welcoming newcomers with a large smile and a pat on the arm.  布朗宁站在门口，面带灿烂笑容迎接新来的人，还会拍拍他们的胳膊。

words.meaning: a.家里的;本国的;驯养的
words.example: Domestic opinion had turned against the war.  国内舆论已转而反对战争。adjective

words.meaning: n.文学,文学作品,文献,图书资料,印刷品
words.example:
'Wuthering Heights' is a classic of English literature.  《咆哮山庄》是一部经典的英国文学作品。UK noun uncountable
It's important to keep up-to-date with the literature in your field.  跟踪阅读最新的专业文献非常重要。
There is very little literature on the disease.  关于这种疾病的文献资料很少。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.雨;雨天;下雨 vi.下雨 vt.使大量落下
words.example:
Rain is forecast for tomorrow.  预报明天会下雨。
Come inside out of the rain.  进屋来，别在雨里淋着。
We had heavy/light rain all day.  我们这里倾盆大雨／毛毛细雨整整下了一天。

words.meaning: v./n.愿望,欲望,要求
words.example:
There is a strong desire for peace among the people.  人民极盼和平。
He needed to satisfy his desire for revenge.  他需要满足自己复仇的愿望。
Several people have expressed a desire to see the report.  有几个人表示想要看看这份报告。UK noun

words.meaning: n.伤害,损害
words.example:
Several train passengers received/sustained serious injuries in the crash.  在这次撞车事故中火车上几名乘客受重伤。
Injuries to the spine are common amongst these workers.  脊椎受伤在这些工人中是很普遍的。
They were lucky to escape (without) injury.  他们很幸运，没有受伤。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n./v.尊敬,尊重 n.敬意,问候,关系,方面
words.example:
She is a formidable figure who commands a great deal of respect (= who is greatly admired by others).  她是个令人敬畏的人，赢得了大家的无限敬重。
New teachers have to earn/gain the respect of their students.  新教师必须要赢得学生的尊重。
You really should treat your parents with more respect.  你待你父母真应该多几分尊重。

words.meaning: a.北方的,北部的
words.example: northern Europe  北欧

words.meaning: v.点(头),点头招呼 n.点头招呼;打盹,瞌睡
words.example:
Many people in the audience nodded in agreement.  许多听众点头表示赞同。
When I suggested a walk, Elena nodded enthusiastically.  当我提议去散步时，埃琳娜使劲地点头。
She looked up and nodded for me to come in.  她抬起头，点头示意要我进来。    Compare shakeUK US  (-dd-)

words.meaning: n.油漆,颜料 v.油漆;涂,涂漆;画;描绘,描述
words.example:
This wall needs another coat of paint.  这面墙需要再刷一层漆。
Caution! Wet paint.  小心，油漆未干！
There were so many paints (= types of paint) to choose from that I couldn't decide which to buy.  有这么多种油漆可供选择，我很难决定买哪一种。

words.meaning: n.燃料 vt.给…加燃料
words.example:
Wood, coal, oil, petrol and gas are all different kinds of fuel.  木材、煤炭、石油、汽油和煤气是不同种类的燃料。
Plutonium is a fuel used to produce nuclear energy.  钸是一种用来产生核能量的燃料。
The new exhaust system, it is claimed, will lower fuel consumption.  据称新的排气装置会降低燃料的消耗。

words.meaning: n.叶子;(书刊的)一页,一张;金属薄片
words.example:
He was sweeping up leaves in his garden.  他在自己的花园里扫树叶。
The trees are in leaf early this year.  今年树木的叶子长得早。
The bushes are just coming into leaf.  灌木刚刚长出叶子。noun countable (plural leaves)

words.meaning: a.干(旱)的;干渴的;枯燥 vt.使干燥,晒干
words.example:
These plants grow well in dry soil/a dry climate.  这些植物适宜在干旱的土壤里／气候条件下生长。
This cake's a bit dry - I think I overcooked it.  这个蛋糕有点干——估计是给我烤过头了。
By this time all the wells had run dry.  到这个时候所有的井都已经干枯了。

words.meaning: n.教授;指导;(pl.)用法说明(书),操作指南
words.example:
The police who broke into the house were only acting on/under instructions.  员警破门而入只是奉命行事。
The cooking instructions say bake it for half an hour.  烹调说明书上说烘烤半个小时。
You obviously didn't read the instructions properly.  你显然没有好好看说明书。

words.meaning: n.水池,游泳池;合资经营v.合伙经营,联营
words.example:
We looked for crabs in the rock pools along the seashore.  我们在海边岩石的水坑里找螃蟹。
Patrick crashed a Ford that he'd borrowed from the car pool at work.  派翠克把他从公司车队借的一辆福特汽车撞坏了。
As unemployment rises, the pool of cheap labour increases.  随着失业率的上升，廉价劳力的数量也在增加。noun

words.meaning: v./n.攀登,爬
words.example:
The plane climbed quickly to a height of 30 000 feet.  飞机迅速爬升到三万英尺的高度。
As it leaves the village, the road climbs steeply up the mountain.  出了村庄，这条路沿着山坡陡然向上。
The sun climbed higher in the sky.  太阳升得更高了。

words.meaning: a.甜的;可爱的,美好的 n.(常pl.)糖果;甜食
words.example:
The pineapple was sweet and juicy.  这个凤梨甜而多汁。
Do you want your pancakes sweet or savoury?  您的煎饼是要甜的还是咸的?adjective
She was enjoying the sweet smell of success.  她沉浸在成功的喜悦中。

words.meaning: n.发动机,引擎;火车头
words.example: My car's been having engine trouble recently.  我的汽车引擎最近老出问题。

words.meaning: n.盐,盐,类 v.腌,盐渍
words.example:
Can you pass the salt please?  请把盐递过来好吗？
Add a pinch of (= small amount of) salt to the sauce.  往酱汁里加点盐。UK noun
Potassium nitrate and potassium chloride are potassium salts.  硝酸钾、氯化钾都是钾盐。UK noun

words.meaning: v.(使)膨胀,(使)扩张;张开,展开
words.example:
The air in the balloon expands when heated.  气球里的空气受热后膨胀。
They expanded their retail operations during the 1980s.  20世纪80年代他们扩大了零售业务。verb intransitive or transitive
She mentioned a few ideas, but she didn't expand on them.  她提到了几个想法，但并没有进行详细说明。

words.meaning: n.重要,重要性
words.example:
The health report stresses the importance of fresh food in a diet.  健康报告强调了饮食中新鲜食物的重要性。
She attaches a lot of importance to personal possessions.  她非常重视个人财产。

words.meaning: n.金属,金属制品
words.example:
Metal, paper and glass can be recycled.  金属、纸张和玻璃都可以再利用。
Silver, gold and platinum are precious metals.  银、金和铂都是贵重金属。
The wooden beam is reinforced with a metal plate.  木梁用金属板加固了。

words.meaning: a.多脂肪的,肥胖的;丰厚的n.脂肪,肥肉
words.example:
Like most women, she thinks she's fat.  与大多数女性一样，她觉得自己很胖。
He eats all the time but he never gets fat.  他总是在吃，但从来不长胖。
He lifted a fat volume down from the shelf.  他从架子上取下一册厚厚的书。

words.meaning: n.票,入场券;票签;(交通违章)罚款传票
words.example: She's standing on an education ticket.  她支持一条有关教育的竞选主张。

words.meaning: n.软件
words.example: He's written a piece of software which calculates your tax returns for you.  他编写了一个能计算你退税额度的软体。    Compare hardwareUK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.不见,消失
words.example:
The search was called off for the sailors who disappeared in the storm.  搜寻在风暴中失踪水手的行动被取消了。
This is a way of life that is fast disappearing.  这种生活方式正在迅速消失。
The sun disappeared behind a cloud.  太阳躲到了云彩的后面。

words.meaning: a.奇怪的,奇异的;陌生的,生疏的;外地的
words.example:
He's got some very strange ideas about women!  他对女性有一些非常古怪的看法！
You say the strangest things sometimes.  有时候你说的话非常奇怪。
It 's strange that tourists almost never visit this village.  不可思议的是，游客几乎从来不到这个村子来。

words.meaning: n.嘴唇
words.example:
She kissed me on the lips.  她吻了我的嘴唇。
He licked his lips.  他舔了舔嘴唇。noun
That's enough of your lip, young lady!  请尊重些，小姐！noun

words.meaning: n.读书,读物,(仪表等的)读数,阅读
words.example:
Reading and tennis are my favourite pastimes.  我最喜欢的业余爱好就是读书和打网球。
The diaries make good (bedtime) reading (= are good to read (in bed at night)).  （睡前在床上）读一读这些日记是很好的消遣。
These books are compulsory/required reading for students of architecture.  这些是主修建筑学的学生的必读书目。

words.meaning: a.精神的,思想的,心理的,智力的,脑力的
words.example:
His physical and mental health had got worse.  他的身心健康进一步恶化。
Many people suffer from some form of mental illness during their lives.  许多人一生中都会患上某种精神疾病。
She had a mental picture (= a picture in her mind) of how the house would look when they finished decorating it.  她脑海中已经有房子装修好以后的样子。    Compare physical    UK slang

words.meaning: ad.不断增加地,日益
words.example: Increasingly, there is pressure on the council to reverse its decision.  要求市政会推翻其决定的压力越来越大。

words.meaning: n.午餐,(美)便餐
words.example:
What's for lunch?  午饭吃甚么？
I'm sorry, Joanna isn't here at the moment, she's (gone) out to/gone to lunch.  对不起，乔安娜现在不在，她吃午饭去了。
We must do lunch sometime (= have lunch together).  我们找天一定要一起吃个午饭。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: ad.某地,在某处;在附近,前后,大约
words.example:
He was last heard of living somewhere on the south coast.  最后一次听到关于他的消息时，说他住在南海岸的某地。
You must have put their letter somewhere!  你一定把他们的信放在甚么地方了！
Can we go somewhere else to talk - it's very noisy here.  我们能否另外找个地方谈——这里太吵了。

words.meaning: n.农民,农场主
words.example: a dairy/sheep farmer  乳牛场／牧羊场场主

words.meaning: n.糖,食糖 vt.加糖于
words.example:
How many sugars (= spoonfuls or lumps of sugar) do you take in your tea?  你的茶要加几匙糖？
Glucose and lactose are sugars.  葡萄糖和乳糖都是糖类。
Hi, sugar, did you have a good day at school?  嗨，宝贝，你今天在学校过得好吗？UK noun

words.meaning: n.行星
words.example:
Might there be intelligent life on other planets?  其他星球上有可能存在智慧生物吗？noun countable
Some days that girl seems as if she's on another planet.  那个女孩有时候看来很怪异。

words.meaning: n.(favourite)最喜欢的人或物 a.喜爱的
words.example: Blue is my favorite color.  蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色。

words.meaning: v.勘探,探测;探究,探索
words.example:
The best way to explore the countryside is on foot.  在农村考察，步行是最好的方法了。
The children have gone exploring in the woods.  孩子们去树林里观察大自然了。
Let's explore this issue/idea more fully.  让我们进一步探讨一下这个问题／计划。

words.meaning: v.获得,得到
words.example:
First editions of these books are now almost impossible to obtain.  这些书的第一版现在已几乎弄不到了。
In the second experiment they obtained a very clear result.  第二次试验他们获得了明确的结果。
Sugar is obtained by crushing and processing sugar cane.  蔗糖是透过对甘蔗进行压榨和加工获得的。 formal

words.meaning: n.敌人,仇敌,反对者;敌人,敌军,敌国
words.example:
He's made a few enemies in this company.  他在公司中和几个人结了怨。
Max stole Lee's girlfriend and they've been enemies ever since.  马克斯抢走了李的女朋友，从那以后他们就成了死对头。
The enemy had succeeded in stopping our supplies from getting through.  敌人成功切断了我军的补给线。

words.meaning: a.复杂的;合成的,综合的 n.联合体
words.example:
The company has a complex organizational structure.  公司组织结构非常复杂。
It's a very complex issue to which there is no straightforward answer.  这个问题错综复杂，没有简单直接的答案。
The film's plot was so complex that I couldn't follow it.  这部电影的情节太复杂，我看不懂。noun countable UK BUILDING  建筑物

words.meaning: vt.包围,环绕 n.环绕物
words.example:
Snow-capped mountains surround the city.  白头积雪的群山环绕着这座城市。
Gwen sat at her desk, surrounded by books and papers.  格温坐在桌前，周围堆满了书和报纸。
Mystery still surrounds the exact circumstances of Stalin's death.  史达林去世的确切情况仍是迷雾重重。

words.meaning: n.运动员,体育家,身强力壮的人
words.example:
He became a professional athlete at the age of 16.  16岁时他成了一名职业运动员。
She has the build of an athlete.  她有一副运动员的体格。

words.meaning: vt.邀请,招待
words.example:
We're invited to Lola's party.  我们受邀参加洛拉的晚会。
Candidates who are successful in the written test will be invited for an interview.  通过笔试的候选人将获邀参加面试。
Offers in the region of £1 000 000 are invited for the property.  这块地产征求100万英镑左右的出价。

words.meaning: v.重复,重说,重做 n.重复
words.example:
Would you mind repeating what you just said?  您能重复一遍刚才您讲的话吗？
Please don't repeat what I've just told you to anyone else.  请不要把我刚才对你所说的话告诉任何人。
The test must be repeated several times.  这个试验一定要重复做数次。

words.meaning: n.灵魂,心灵;精神,精力;人
words.example:
She suffered greatly while she was alive, so let us hope her soul is now at peace.  她生前受过很多苦，所以我们希望现在她的灵魂能得到安息。UK noun
If you can't enjoy this music you've got no soul.  如果你不能欣赏这种音乐，说明你缺乏真挚的情感。
For me her paintings somehow lack soul.  在我看来，她的绘画作品有些缺乏真情实感。UK noun

words.meaning: a.科学上的
words.example:
The project has attracted considerable criticism from the scientific community (= from scientists).  这个企划案招致科学界广泛的批评。
We will have to adopt a more scientific approach in the future.  我们将来得采用更审慎而有系统的方法。

words.meaning: a.不可能的;难以忍受的,很难对付的
words.example:
It was impossible to sleep because of the noise.  噪音太大，无法入睡。
It seems impossible that I could have walked by without noticing her.  我似乎不太可能走过而没有注意到她。
He made it impossible for me to say no.  他使我无法说不。

words.meaning: n.面,板;控制板,仪表盘;专门小组
words.example:
The competition will be judged by a panel of experts.  这次竞赛将由一个专家小组评审。noun
White silk panels were inset into the sides of the dress.  衣边镶有白绸布。
At the bottom of each page is a panel with grammatical information.  每页底部都有文法知识栏。noun

words.meaning: n.意思,意义,含义;重要性,价值
words.example:
The word 'flight' has two different meanings: a plane journey, and the act of running away.  flight 一词有两个不同的意思：航程和逃跑。
The meaning of his gesture was clear.  他手势的含义很清楚。
His novels often have (a) hidden meaning.  他的小说常有隐含意义。noun

words.meaning: a.已婚的,夫妇的;(to)与…结婚的
words.example:
We've been happily married for five years.  我们已结婚五年，生活幸福。
Please state whether you are single, cohabiting, married, separated, divorced or widowed.  请说明你是单身、同居、已婚、分居、离异还是丧偶。
So how are you enjoying married life ?  那你的婚后生活怎么样？

words.meaning: n.工具,仪器,器械;乐器
words.example:
Which instrument do you play ?  你演奏哪一种乐器？noun countable
The man's injuries had obviously been caused by a blunt instrument.  这人的伤口显然是由钝器所致。
The lightning had damaged the plane's instruments, and they weren't giving any readings.  闪电击毁了飞机的仪表，上面甚么资料都显示不出来。

words.meaning: v.预言,预测,预告
words.example: It's still not possible to accurately predict the occurrence of earthquakes.  现在仍无法准确预报地震的发生。

words.meaning: n.天气,气象
words.example:
The weather in the hills can change very quickly, so take suitable clothing.  山里的天气瞬息万变，所以要带上合适的衣服。
We're going to have a picnic, weather permitting (= if the weather is good enough).  如果天气好的话，我们打算去野餐。UK noun uncountable
I'm feeling a bit under the weather - I think I've caught a cold.  我觉得有点不舒服——可能是感冒了。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.极度的,最重要的;至高的,最高的
words.example:
The present constitution gives supreme authority to the presidency.  现行宪法赋予总统至高无上的权力。
From 1960 to 1970, Ayatollah Mohsen al-Hakim reigned supreme among the Shi'ites of Iraq, Iran and elsewhere.  自1960年至1970年，阿亚图拉‧穆赫辛‧哈基姆是伊拉克、伊朗及其他地方什叶派的最高领袖。adjective
She was awarded a medal for showing supreme bravery.  她因为表现非常英勇而获得一枚奖章。

words.meaning: n.熊 v.忍受,容忍;负担;结果实,生子女
words.example:
The strain must have been enormous but she bore it well.  当时压力一定很大，但她承受得了。
Tell me now! I can't bear the suspense !  现在告诉我吧！ 我等不及了！
It's your decision - you must bear the responsibility if things go wrong.  是你作出的决定——如果出了差错，你必须承担责任。

words.meaning: n.衣袋 a.袖珍的,小型的 v.把…装入袋内
words.example:
She thrust her hands deep in/into her pockets.  她把双手深深插进口袋里。
He took some coins from/out of his pocket.  他从口袋里掏出几枚硬币。
Sarah put her maps in the outside pocket of her rucksack.  莎拉把地图放在帆布背包外面的口袋里。

words.meaning: a.薄的,细的;稀薄的,淡的;瘦的 v.变薄;变稀
words.example:
Did you notice how thin her wrists were?  你注意到她的手腕有多细吗？
Thin, hungry dogs roamed the streets.  瘦瘦的饿狗们在街上遛来遛去。    Opposite fat.
He eats like a horse and yet he's as thin as a rake.  他像猪一样吃得多，却骨瘦如柴。 (thinner, thinnest)

words.meaning: n.温度,体温;热度,发烧
words.example:
Preheat the oven to a temperature of 200 degrees Celsius.  把炉子预热到摄氏200度。
There has been a sudden rise in temperature over the past few days (= The weather has become warmer).  最近几天气温突然上升了。
The doctor examined him and took his temperature (= measured it).  医生给他做检查，并量了他的体温。

words.meaning: v.使诧异,使惊异;奇袭 n.诧异,惊异;奇袭
words.example:
Don't tell Anne we've arranged a party for her - I want it to be a surprise.  不要告诉安妮我们为她安排了一个派对——我想给她一个惊喜。
It was a lovely/nasty, etc. surprise to get home and find the letter.  回到家就意外看到这封信，真是太好了／糟糕透了等等。
Last night's heavy snow came as a complete surprise.  昨晚的那场大雪下得太突然了。

words.meaning: n.民意测验;(pl.)政治选举 v.获得…选票
words.example:
We're carrying out/conducting a poll to find out what people think about abortion.  我们正在进行一项民意调查，了解人们对堕胎的看法。
The latest opinion poll puts the Democrats in the lead.  最新的一项民意调查显示民主党领先。
The TV stations agreed not to announce the projected winner until after the polls closed.  电视台同意等到所有的投票点都关闭后再宣布预测的获胜者。

words.meaning: n.提议,建议;求婚
words.example:
Congress has rejected the latest economic proposal put forward by the president.  议会否决了总统最近提出的经济计划。
Have you read Steve's proposals for the new project?  你看了史蒂夫对新专案的建议了吗？

words.meaning: n.结果,后果,影响;重要性
words.example:
Not making a will can have serious consequences for the people you might wish to benefit.  不立遗嘱可能会给你所希望受益的人带来严重后果。
Scientists think it unlikely that any species will actually become extinct as a consequence of the oil spill.  科学家们认为实际上不太可能会有甚么物种因为石油泄漏而灭绝。
Well, if you insist on eating so much, you'll have to suffer/take (= accept and deal with) the consequences!  好吧，要是你坚持吃这么多，你会自食其果的！

words.meaning: n.呼吸,气息
words.example:
Her breath smelled of garlic.  她的嘴里有大蒜味。
She was dizzy and short of breath (= unable to breathe in enough air).  她头昏眼花，上气不接下气。
He burst into the room, red-faced and out of breath (= unable to breathe comfortably because of tiredness or excitement).  他冲进房间，满脸通红，气喘吁吁。

words.meaning: n.视力;望见,瞥见;视域;眼界;情景,奇观
words.example:
If your sight is poor, you should not drive a car.  视力不佳就不应该开车。
The old woman has lost her sight (= has become blind).  那位老妇人失明了。
The flowers at the annual flower show were a beautiful sight.  年度花卉展上的鲜花是一道美丽的风景。

words.meaning: v.称,(使)平衡 n.天平;平衡,均衡;差额,余款
words.example:
The toddler wobbled and lost his balance (= started to fall sideways).  那个刚学走路的小孩摇摇晃晃的，走了几步就失去平衡。
She had to hold onto the railings to keep her balance (= to stop herself from falling).  她必须扶着围栏才能保持平衡。
New tax measures are designed to redress the balance (= make the situation more equal) between rich and poor.  新的税收措施旨在透过重新分配，使贫富差距趋于合理。

words.meaning: vt.采用,采取(态度等);选定;收养
words.example:
They've adopted a baby girl.  他们领养了一个女婴。
She had the child adopted (= She gave her baby to someone else to look after).  她把自己的孩子送给别人抚养。
They have no children of their own, but they're hoping to adopt.  他们没有亲生子女，但是他们希望能领养。    Compare fosterUK verb

words.meaning: n.少数,少数派,少数民族
words.example:
It's only a tiny minority of people who are causing the problem.  惹麻烦的只是极少数的人。
Children with single parents at my school were very much in the minority (= there were very few).  在我的学校里单亲孩子只占极少数。
This section of the bookstore caters for minority interests (= subjects that interest only a few people).  书店的这个专柜主要满足少数读者的兴趣。    Opposite majorityUK noun

words.meaning: a.直的;整齐的,端正的 ad.直接;正直,直率
words.example:
She's got straight blonde hair.  她有一头金色直发。
Skirts this summer are long and straight.  今夏的裙装流行长长的直筒裙。
Can't you see it? - it's straight ahead (of you)!  难道你看不见吗？——就在（你）正前面！

words.meaning: vt.连接;与…联系,接通(电话) vi.连接
words.example:
Can I connect my printer to your computer?  我能把我的印表机连接到你的电脑上吗？
Where does the cooker connect (up) to the electricity?  这电锅在哪里连接电源？
Has the telephone/electricity/gas been connected (= switched on or joined to the main supply) in your new place yet?  你们的新居接通了电话／电／煤气了吗？verb

words.meaning: v.(to)属于,附属,隶属;应归入(类别,范畴等)
words.example:
This table belongs in the sitting-room.  这张桌子应该放在客厅里。
Where do these spoons belong?  这些匙应放在哪里？
These papers belong with the others.  这些报纸应该和其他的放在一起。

words.meaning: n.援助,救护;助手,辅助物 vi.援助,救援
words.example:
He gets about with the aid of a walking stick.  他拄着拐杖到处走动。
She went to the aid of a man trapped in his car.  她去帮助一个困在车中的男子。
The Vatican has agreed to donate $80 000 in humanitarian/emergency aid to countries affected by the war.  罗马教廷已经同意向饱受战祸的国家捐赠八万美元的人道援助金／紧急援助金。

words.meaning: n.劝告,忠告,(医生等的)意见
words.example:
Steven gave me some good advice.  斯蒂芬给了我一些好建议。
Can I give you a piece of advice?  你想听听我的建议吗？
We went to Paris on Sarah's advice.  我们听从萨拉的建议去了巴黎。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.(okey,OK,O.K.)好,行,不错 n.同意
words.example: Okay, I'll meet you there.  好的，我在那儿跟你碰头。

words.meaning: a.空的;空洞的 v.倒空,使成为空的
words.example:
Shall I take the empty bottles for recycling?  我把这些空瓶子拿去回收吧？
The train was empty (= There were no passengers) by the time it reached London.  火车到达伦敦的时候，车内已经没有乘客了。adjective
They're just empty promises.  这些承诺只不过是些空头支票。adjective

words.meaning: n.踪迹,痕迹;小路 v.追踪,跟踪;拖,拖曳;
words.example:
The dogs are specially trained to follow the trail left by the fox.  这些狗经过特别训练，能够追踪狐狸留下的气味。
He left a trail of muddy footprints behind him.  他身后留下了一串泥泞的脚印。
The police admit that the thieves have left no trail for them to follow up.  警方承认小偷没有留下可供他们追踪的线索。

words.meaning: n.(长篇)小说 a.新奇的,新颖的
words.example:
Have you read any of Jane Austen's novels?  你读过简．奥斯汀的小说吗？
His latest novel is selling really well.  他的最新小说非常畅销。UK adjective
Keeping a sheep in the garden is a novel way of keeping the grass short!  在花园里养只羊来阻止草长高，这办法可真新奇！

words.meaning: n.代码,代号,密码;法典,法规,规划
words.example:
The message was written in code.  电报是用密码写的。
She managed to decipher/break/crack (= succeed in understanding) the code.  她成功地破译了密码。
Each entry in this dictionary has a grammar code.  这本词典的每个词条都有一个文法标记。UK noun

words.meaning: ad.以某种方式,用某种方法;不知怎么地
words.example: It won't be easy, but we'll get across the river somehow.  过河不是件容易的事，但我们总会有办法的。

words.meaning: v.(organise)组织,编组
words.example:
They organized a meeting between the teachers and students.  他们组织了一次师生会议。
The books were organized on the shelves according to their size.  书按大小摆放在书架上。
informal My mother is always trying to organize me (= make me do things in the way she likes).  我母亲总是想要我按她喜欢的方式行事。(UK usually organise) UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.陪审团;全体评审员
words.example:
The jury has/have been unable to return a verdict (= reach a decision).  陪审团未能作出裁决。
Police officers aren't usually allowed to be/sit/serve on a jury.  警察通常不准当陪审团成员。
The jury's still out on the safety of irradiated food.  人们对于辐射处理过的食品是否安全尚没有一致的看法。

words.meaning: n.胸膛,乳房
words.example:
When a woman becomes pregnant her breasts tend to grow larger.  女性怀孕后，乳房会增大。
Do you think she's had breast implants ?  你觉得她做过隆胸手术吗？noun
He put a silk hanky in his breast pocket (= a pocket on the top front part of a shirt or coat).  他将一条丝绸手帕放入上衣口袋。noun

words.meaning: vt.承认;接受;告知(信件等的)收到;答谢
words.example:
You must acknowledge the truth of her argument.  你必须承认，她的论点是事实。
Historians generally acknowledge her as a genius in her field.  历史学家公认她在该领域中是天才。
They refused to acknowledge (= to recognize officially) the new government.  他们拒绝承认新政府。

words.meaning: n.题目,主题;主旋律,基调
words.example: The theme of loss runs through most of his novels.  失落这一主题贯穿了他的大多数小说作品。noun countable

words.meaning: n.暴风雨,暴风雪;激动,爆发 v.猛攻,直捣
words.example:
They're still clearing up the storm damage.  他们还在清理风暴留下的残局。UK noun
There was a storm of protest when the new tax was announced.  宣布新税目后，引发了抗议风潮。UK noun
Her performance has taken the London critics by storm.  她的表演完全征服了伦敦评论界。UK noun

words.meaning: n.联合,团结;联盟,联邦;协会,社团;和谐
words.example:
Meanwhile the debate on European political and monetary union continues.  同时，有关欧洲政治和货币联盟的争论还在继续。
formal or old use She believes that the union (= marriage) of man and woman in holy matrimony is for ever.  她相信男女之间的结合永远是神圣的。noun

words.meaning: n.书桌,办公桌,服务台
words.example:
She sat at her desk writing letters.  她坐在书桌前写信。
He had a pile of papers on his desk.  他的办公桌上有一叠文件。
The report arrived on/landed on/reached my desk (= I received it) this morning.  这份报告是今天早上送到我的桌上的。noun countable

words.meaning: n.水果,果实;成果,效果
words.example:
Apricots are the one fruit I don't like.  水果中只有杏子是我不爱吃的。
Oranges, apples, pears and bananas are all types of fruit.  柳橙、苹果、梨和香蕉都是水果。
Would you like some fruit for dessert?  餐后甜点你想要些水果吗？

words.meaning: a.花费的,昂贵的
words.example:
Rolls Royces are very expensive.  劳斯莱斯汽车价格昂贵。
Big houses are expensive to maintain.  大房子的维修费很高。
She has expensive tastes (= she likes things that cost a lot of money).  她喜欢昂贵的东西。

words.meaning: a.黄的,黄色的 n.黄色
words.example:
It was early autumn and the leaves were turning yellow.  正值初秋时节，树叶开始转黄。
You should wear more yellow - it suits you.  你应该多穿些黄色的衣服——那适合你。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.结论,推论;结尾;缔结,议定
words.example:
In conclusion, I would like to thank our guest speaker.  最后，我要感谢我们的演讲嘉宾。noun
Did you come to/reach/draw any conclusions at the meeting this morning?  今天上午的会议上你们有没有得出甚么结论？

words.meaning: a.首要的;最好的,第一流的 n.青春,全盛期
words.example:
This is a prime example of 1930s architecture.  这是20世纪30年代建筑风格的一个重要范例。
The president is a prime (= likely) target for the assassin's bullet.  总统是这名刺客的主要目标。
The hotel is in a prime location in the city centre.  该旅馆位于市中心的黄金地段。noun only singular

words.meaning: n.阴影,影子,荫;暗处,阴暗
words.example:
The children were playing, jumping on each other's shadows.  孩子们正在嬉戏，跳来跳去踩彼此的影子。
Jamie followed his mother around all day like a shadow.  杰米像影子一样整天跟着他母亲。
The sun shone through the leaves, casting/throwing shadows on the lawn.  阳光透过树叶，在草地上投下阴影。

words.meaning: n./v.斗争,奋斗,努力
words.example:
I've been struggling to understand this article all afternoon.  我琢磨了整整一个下午，想弄懂这篇文章的意思。
Fish struggle for survival when the water level drops in the lake.  湖水水位下降时，鱼会拼命挣扎求生。
He struggled along the rough road holding his son.  他抱着儿子在崎岖不平的路上艰难行进。

words.meaning: v.结束,终止;断定,下结论;缔结,议定
words.example:
She concluded the speech by reminding us of our responsibility.  她在演讲结束时提醒我们所承担的责任。
Before I conclude, I'd like to thank you all for coming.  在结束发言前，我想感谢诸位的光临。
The concert concluded with a rousing chorus.  音乐会以激动人心的大合唱结束。

words.meaning: n.舞(蹈);舞曲,舞会 v.跳舞;跳动
words.example:
We danced all night.  我们跳了一夜的舞。
We went dancing at a nightclub.  我们去夜总会跳舞。
What sort of music do you like dancing to ?  你喜欢伴着哪种歌曲跳舞？

words.meaning: n.规则,规章;调节,校准;调整
words.example:
The correct procedure is laid down in the rules and regulations.  正确的程式在规章条例中有规定。
It's regulation to wear suits at the office.  按规定在办公室要穿西装。

words.meaning: n.生物,生命,存在;
words.example: Strange beings from outer space are still a popular subject for sci-fi films.  外星人仍是不少科幻电影流行的主题。

words.meaning: n.戒指;环;铃声;(打)电话 v.按(铃),敲(钟)
words.example:
The game involved throwing metal rings over a stick.  这个游戏的玩法是扔金属环套在一根棍子上。
The children sat in a ring around the teacher.  孩子们围着老师坐成一圈。
He bought her a diamond/emerald/etc. ring (= a ring with a jewel fixed to it).  他为她买了一只钻石／祖母绿戒指。

words.meaning: ad.主要地,基本上;大量地,大规模地
words.example:
Their complaints have been largely ignored.  他们的抱怨几乎没有引起任何重视。
Until recently the civil war had been largely unreported in the press.  直到最近报纸才开始报道那场内战。

words.meaning: v.替换,转移n.转换,转变;(轮)班,(换)班
words.example:
She shifted (her weight) uneasily from one foot to the other.  她不安地把身体的重心由一只脚转移到另一只脚。
The wind is expected to shift (to the east) tomorrow.  预计风明天转向（为东风）。
Media attention has shifted recently onto environmental issues.  媒体关注的焦点最近转到了环保问题。

words.meaning: n.财政收入,税收
words.example:
Taxes provide most of the government's revenue.  政府岁入的大部分来自税收。
Government revenues fell dramatically.  政府财政收入大幅下降。

words.meaning: n.痕迹;记号;分数 v.标记,打分,使有特色
words.example:
The car has enjoyed modest success since its launch, but the Mark 2 version is expected to be far more popular.  这款汽车自推出以来受欢迎程度一直都不很高，不过预计2型车将会受欢迎得多。
Cook at Mark 5 for 20 minutes.  调到5号刻度，煮20分钟。
There were dirty marks on her trousers where she had wiped her hands.  她裤子上抹过手的地方留下了污渍。

words.meaning: v.查出,探出,查找…地点,使…坐落于,位于
words.example:
Our office is located in the city centre.  我们的办事处位于市中心。UK verb
Police are still trying to locate the suspect.  员警仍在努力寻找嫌疑人。UK verb
The company hopes to locate in its new offices by June.  该公司希望在六月前搬进新的办公楼。

words.meaning: n.(英国)郡,(美国)县
words.example:
Rutland used to be the smallest county in England, but in 1974 it became part of Leicestershire.  拉特兰曾经是英格兰最小的郡，1974年并入莱斯特郡。
Texas is divided into 254 counties.  德克萨斯州划分为254个县。UK adjective UK usually disapproving
She mixes with a very county set.  她跟一帮豪门子弟厮混在一起。

words.meaning: n.出现,露面;外表;(在会议等)作短暂露面
words.example:
It was his first appearance on television/television appearance as president.  这是他就任总统以来首次在电视上亮相。
She will be making a public appearance, signing copies of her latest novel.  她将公开亮相，为自己刚刚出版的小说签名售书。
This was the defendant's third court appearance for the same offence.  这是被告因为同一宗罪行第三次出庭受审。

words.meaning: n.包装,包裹,箱,包装费,标准部件,成套设备
words.example:
The postman has just delivered a package for you.  邮差刚刚送来一个包裹给你。
The package was wrapped in plain brown paper.  包裹用普通的牛皮纸包着。
The computer comes with a software package.  电脑附带一套套装软体。

words.meaning: n.困难,困境,难题
words.example:
We finished the job, but only with great difficulty.  我们非常艰难地完成了工作。
The difficulty of the task excited them.  这项任务之艰钜让他们感到非常刺激。
People with asthma have difficulty in breathing.  哮喘患者呼吸有困难。

words.meaning: n.桥;桥牌;鼻梁 vt.架桥;渡过
words.example:
We drove across/over the bridge.  我们开车驶过大桥。
Voluntary work can provide a bridge between staying at home and working full-time.  志愿工作是由在家待业过度到全职工作的桥梁。noun
The blow caught him right on the bridge of his nose.  那一拳正好打在他的鼻梁上。noun

words.meaning: v.推荐,介绍;劝告,建议
words.example:
She has been recommended for promotion.  已经有人推荐给她升职。
The headmistress agreed to recommend the teachers' proposals to the school governors.  女校长同意把这位老师的建议提请学校董事们考虑。
The city has much/little to recommend it (= It has a lot of/few pleasant qualities).  这个城市可圈可点的地方很多／几乎没有。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.明显的,显而易见的
words.example:
They have a small child so for obvious reasons they need money.  他们有个年幼的孩子，所以显然很需要钱。
Am I stating the obvious (= saying what everyone already knows) ?  我说的大家早就知道了吗？
There is no obvious solution.  还没有合情合理的解决办法。

words.meaning: n.(electronic mail)电子信函,电子邮件
words.example: Send me the details by e-mail.  把细节用电子邮件发给我。

words.meaning: vt.产生,发生;生殖
words.example:
Her latest film has generated a lot of interest/excitement.  她最近的一部影片引起了广泛的兴趣／使众多观众很是兴奋。
The new development will generate 1500 new jobs.  新开发项目将会创造1500个新的就业岗位。
These measures will increase the club's ability to generate revenue/income.  这些措施将会提升俱乐部的创收能力。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.提议,建议;提名,推荐;求婚
words.example:
She proposed a boycott of the meeting.  她建议抵制这次会议。
He proposed a motion that the chairman resign.  他提出动议请主席辞职。
To be nominated for union president you need one person to propose you and another to second you.  要被提名为工会主席，你需要有一个推荐人和一个附议人。

words.meaning: ad.可能地,也许;无论如何
words.example:
He may possibly decide not to come, in which case there's no problem.  他可能会决定不来，这样就没问题了。
He can't possibly have drunk all that on his own!  他一个人绝不可能喝了那么多酒！
We did all that we possibly could to persuade her to come.  我们尽了最大努力劝她来。

words.meaning: n.倾向,趋势 vi.伸向,倾向
words.example:
Surveys show a trend away from home-ownership and towards rented accommodation.  调查显示，出现了一种从私人拥有住房转向租赁住房的趋势。
There's been a downward/upward trend in sales in the last few years.  过去几年，销售额一直呈下降／上升趋势。
Whatever the latest fashion trend, you can be sure Nicki will be wearing it.  不管是甚么样的流行款式，尼基肯定会穿。

words.meaning: n.贷款;出借,借出 v.借出
words.example:
She's trying to get a $50 000 loan to start her own business.  为了开办自己的公司，她正在争取一笔五万美元的贷款。
We could apply for/take out a loan to buy a car.  我们可以申请贷款去买汽车。UK noun
Thank you very much for the loan of your bike.  谢谢你把脚踏车借给我。

words.meaning: a.舒适的,舒服的;感到舒适的,安逸的
words.example:
Are you comfortable or shall I turn the heat down?  你觉得舒服吗？还是要我把暖气调低点？
Do sit down and make your self comfortable.  请坐，别拘束。
I'm not comfortable with the idea of leaving her on her own.  要把她一个人留下来，我可不放心。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.利润,收益 v.(by,from)得利,获益;有利于
words.example:
She makes a big profit from selling waste material to textile companies.  她将废弃材料卖给纺织公司，从中赚取大笔利润。
Company profits are down on last year's figures.  从去年的统计数字看，公司的利润下降了。
You don't expect to make much profit within the first couple of years of setting up a company.  你不要指望在创立公司的头几年里会赚取很多利润。

words.meaning: a.生气的,愤怒的;(天气)风雨交加的
words.example:
He's really angry at/with me for upsetting Sophie.  因为我惹了索菲，他很生我的气。
It made me really angry.  这让我很恼火。adjective
On her leg was an angry sore.  她腿上长了一个疮，又红又肿。

words.meaning: n.全体船员,全体乘务员
words.example:
The aircraft has/carries a crew of seven.  这架飞机上有七名机组人员。
Apart from the 10 officers, a crew of 90 looks after the 300 passengers.  除了这10位高级船员，还有90名船员为300名乘客服务。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.意外遭遇,事故;意外(因素)
words.example:
Josh had an accident and spilled water all over his work.  乔希不小心把作业上洒得都是水。
She was injured in a car/road accident (= when one car hit another).  她在一宗车祸／交通意外中受伤了。
Even a six-year-old can have an accident at night sometimes.  即使是六岁大的孩子，晚上有时也可能会尿床。noun countable

words.meaning: n.膳食,一餐
words.example: You must come round for a meal sometime.  你有空一定要过来吃顿饭。noun

words.meaning: n.听,倾听;听力;审讯
words.example: He's getting old and his hearing isn't very good.  他年纪大了，听力也不好了。

words.meaning: n.交通,交通量
words.example:
There was heavy/a lot of traffic on the roads this morning.  今晨道路上车流量很大。
We got stuck in traffic for several hours.  我们碰上交通阻塞，被堵了好几个小时。
New measures have been introduced to try and ease traffic congestion in the city.  这个城市已经采取了新措施，试图缓解交通挤塞。

words.meaning: n.肌肉,体力
words.example:
He flexed his muscles (= tightened, especially his arm muscles, to make them look large and strong) so that everyone could admire them.  他将肌肉紧绷起来，这样大家就能欣赏到他的肌肉块。
These exercises build muscle and increase stamina.  这些运动能强健肌肉、增强体力。
Russell pulled a back muscle early in the game.  比赛开始没多久拉塞尔就拉伤了背部肌肉。noun

words.meaning: n.概念,想法,意念,看法,观点
words.example: He has a strange notion of fairness.  他对公平有种奇怪的观念。

words.meaning: v./n.捕获,俘虏;夺得,攻占
words.example:
Two of the soldiers were killed and the rest were captured.  两名士兵被杀，其余被俘。
Rebel forces captured the city after a week-long battle.  叛军经过一周的战斗攻取了该市。
The Democratic Party captured 70% of the vote.  民主党获得了70%的选票。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.(to)更喜欢,宁愿
words.example:
Do you prefer hot or cold weather?  你喜欢热天还是冷天？
formal I'd prefer you not to smoke (= I would like it better if you did not smoke) , please.  我希望你别抽烟。UK US (-rr-)
The police have decided not to prefer charges against them because of insufficient evidence.  由于证据不足，警方决定不对他们提出诉讼。UK US (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.地球;陆地;泥土,土壤;尘世,人间
words.example:
The Earth takes approximately 365 1 4 days to go round the Sun.  地球围绕太阳运转一周大约需要365又1/4天
The Circus has been described as the greatest show on Earth (= in the world).  这个马戏团被誉为是全世界最棒的。UK noun
The ploughed earth looked rich and dark and fertile.  耕过的土地看起来黑油油的，非常肥沃。UK noun

words.meaning: n.胸腔,胸膛;箱,柜
words.example:
He was shot in the chest at point blank range.  他被近距离射中胸部。
He folded his arms across his chest.  他双臂交叉放在胸前。
His shirt was open to the waist revealing a very hairy chest.  他的衬衫敞开到腰部，露出毛茸茸的胸膛。

words.meaning: a.厚的,粗的,稠的,浓的 ad.厚,浓,密
words.example: The fog was so thick we couldn't see.  雾太浓了，我们什么都看不见。

words.meaning: n.现金,现款 v.兑现,付(或收)现款
words.example:
Do you have any cash on you?  你身上有现金吗？
Will you pay by credit card or in cash?  你是刷信用卡还是付现金？
He says he wants cash in advance before he'll do the job.  他说他要先拿到预付现金才肯工作。

words.meaning: n.博物馆,展览馆
words.example: a museum of modern art  现代艺术博物馆

words.meaning: n.美,美丽;美人,美丽的事物
words.example:
This is an area of outstanding natural beauty.  这个地方的风景优美，浑然天成。
The piece of music he played had a haunting beauty.  他演奏的这首乐曲优美动听，教人久久不能忘怀。
She was a great beauty (= a beautiful woman) when she was young.  她年轻时是个大美人。

words.meaning: n.紧急情况,突然事件,非常时刻
words.example:
How would disabled people escape in an emergency?  如果发生紧急情况，伤残人士如何逃离？
Is the emergency exit suitable for wheelchairs?  安全出口适合轮椅通行吗？
The pilot of the aircraft was forced to make an emergency landing on Lake Geneva.  这架飞机的驾驶员不得不在日内瓦湖面上紧急迫降。

words.meaning: a.唯一的,独一无二的
words.example:
Each person's genetic code is unique except in the case of identical twins.  每个人的遗传密码都是独一无二的，同卵双胞胎除外。
I'd recognise your handwriting anywhere - it's unique.  无论在哪里，我都能认出你的笔迹——它太与众不同了。
Do not miss this unique opportunity to buy all six pans at half the recommended price.  购买全部六个平底锅只需半价——不要错过这难得的机会。

words.meaning: a.内部的,内的;国内的,内政的
words.example:
He sustained injuries to his arms, legs and several internal organs.  他的手臂、腿部和一些内脏都受了伤。
The bank conducted its own internal investigation into the robbery.  银行针对抢劫案进行了内部调查。
The government warned its neighbours not to interfere in its internal affairs.  该国政府警告邻国不要干涉其内政。

words.meaning: a.种族的;人种学的
words.example:
The factory's workforce reflects the ethnic mix from which it draws its labour.  这个工厂的员工组成反映了劳动力来源的种族杂居状况。
Conflicts between the different ethnic groups in the country exploded into civil war.  该国不同族群之间的冲突激化，引发了内战。

words.meaning: v.连接,联系 n.环节,链环
words.example: The link between diet and health is clear.  饮食与健康的联系很清楚。

words.meaning: n.压力;重要性;应力;重音vt.强调,重读
words.example:
People under a lot of stress may experience headaches, minor pains and sleeping difficulties.  压力大的人可能会出现头痛、轻微疼痛和睡眠障碍。
Yoga is a very effective technique for combating stress.  练瑜伽是舒缓压力非常有效的方法。
The meaning of a sentence often depends on stress and intonation.  句子的意思常常取决于重音和语调。

words.meaning: n.容量,内容,(pl.)目录 a.(with)满足的
words.example:
He seems fairly content with (his) life.  他好像对生活相当满足。
Not content with having upset my parents, he then insulted my sister!  他惹得我父母生气还不够，又欺辱我姐姐！noun UK SUBJECT  主题
It's a very stylish and beautiful film, but it lacks content.  这出电影很新潮而且画面美丽，但内容空洞。

words.meaning: v.选择,挑选 a.精选的,选择的
words.example:
There was a choice of four prizes, and the winner could select one of them.  有四种奖品可供选择，获胜者可以从中挑选一个。
How do you select people for promotion?  你如何选拔晋升者?
formal The supermarket's policy is to select out (= choose) the best fruit and discard the rest.  这家超市的原则就是挑选最好的水果，其余的就丢掉。adjective

words.meaning: n.根,根部;根本,根源 v.(使)生根,(使)扎根
words.example:
We must get to the root of (= discover the cause of) this problem.  我们一定要探本溯源，查出造成这个问题的原因。
What is/lies at the root of the problem is their lack of interest.  这一问题的根本原因是他们缺乏兴趣。
The high crime rate has its roots in unemployment and poverty.  高犯罪率的根源在于失业和贫穷。

words.meaning: n.鼻子;(飞机,船等的)前端,突出部分
words.example:
I've got a sore throat and a runny nose (= liquid coming out of the nose).  我喉咙痛，还流鼻涕。
Come on now, stop crying - blow your nose on my hankie.  好了，别哭了——用我的手帕擤擤鼻涕。
The symbol was painted on each side of the plane's nose.  飞机机头两侧都绘有这标志。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.宣布,宣告,声明;断言,宣称
words.example:
America declared war on Japan in 1941 (= announced officially that it was at war).  美国在1941对日本宣战。
figurative The government have declared war on (= publicly announced their opposition to) the drug dealers.  政府已对贩毒者宣战。
The country declared independence in 1952 (= announced that it was no longer under the control of another country).  该国于1952年宣布独立。

words.meaning: vt.为...表示感激,感谢;欣赏,赏识,评价
words.example:
There's no point buying him expensive wines - he doesn't appreciate them.  给他买名贵的酒没有用——他不懂品酒。
We appreciate the need for immediate action.  我们充分意识到了马上采取行动的必要性。
We really appreciate all the help you gave us last weekend.  上周末得到你们的大力帮助，我们非常感谢。

words.meaning: a.实际的;现实的,真实的,目前的
words.example:
We had estimated about 300 visitors, but the actual number was much higher.  我们估计大约会有300名来宾，可实际人数要多得多。
The exams are in July, but the actual results (= the results themselves) don't appear until September.  考试是在七月份，但是真正成绩要到九月份才公布。

words.meaning: n.瓶(子) v.装瓶
words.example:
Plastic bottles are lighter than glass ones.  塑胶瓶比玻璃瓶轻。
Give the baby her bottle when she wakes up.  婴儿醒来时用奶瓶给她喂奶。
Most medical experts believe that breast-feeding is better than bottle -feeding.  大多数医疗专家认为，母乳喂养比人工喂养好。UK noun

words.meaning: ad.几乎不,简直不;仅仅
words.example:
The party had hardly started when she left.  她离开的时候派对才刚刚开始。
He hardly ate anything/He ate hardly anything.  他几乎甚么都没吃。
We hardly ever (= almost never) go to concerts.  我们几乎从不去听音乐会。

words.meaning: n.安置;落山;(固定东西的)柜架底座;环境
words.example:
Their cottage is in an idyllic rural setting.  他们的农舍地处恬静宜人的乡村。
The play has its setting in a wartime prison camp.  这部戏的背景是战争时期的战俘营。
My hairdryer has three settings - high, medium and low.  我的吹风机有三段——高温、中温和低温。

words.meaning: v.发射;使(船)下水,发动,开展 n.发射,下水
words.example:
How much champagne will we need for the launch?  这次发表会我们需要多少香槟？
Illness prevented her attending the launch party for her latest novel.  她因病无法出席为她新近推出的小说举办的庆祝派对。UK noun countable
The launch of the space shuttle was delayed for 24 hours because of bad weather.  因天气情况不佳，太空船的发射延迟了24个小时。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.锉刀;文件,档案 v.锉
words.example:
You'll find it in the files under 'C'.  你会在标着C字母的资料夹里找到它。
We keep your records on file for five years.  我们把你的纪录归档保存五年。noun
The police have opened a file on local burglaries.  警方已为当地的入室行窃案设立了档案。noun

words.meaning: a.有病的,患病的;恶心的,想吐的
words.example:
My father has been off sick (= not working because of illness) for a long time.  因为生病，我父亲已经很久没有去上班了。
Anyone who could hurt a child like that must be sick (= mentally ill).  那样伤害孩子的人，脑子一定有毛病。
The old woman fell/took/was taken sick (= became ill) while she was away and had to come home.  那个老妇人出门在外时生病了，不得不回家。

words.meaning: n.结果,成果
words.example: It's too early to predict the outcome of the meeting.  现在预言会议的结果还言之尚早。

words.meaning: v.防守,保卫;为…辩护,为…答辩
words.example:
How can we defend our homeland if we don't have an army?  如果没有军队，我们怎能保护我们的家园？
White blood cells help defend the body against infection.  白细胞有助于保护身体免受感染。
They are fighting to defend their beliefs/interests/rights.  他们在为为捍卫自己的信仰／利益／权利而战。

words.meaning: n.义务,责任;职务;税
words.example:
The duty of the agency is to act in the best interests of the child.  这个机构的责任就是为孩子谋取最大利益。
You have a duty to yourself to take a holiday now and then.  偶尔你该给自己放个假。
He only went to see her out of duty (= because he thought he should).  他去看她只是出于义务。

words.meaning: n.被单;(一)张,(一)片,薄片;大片
words.example:
I've put clean sheets on the bed.  我已经给床铺上了干净的床单。
They fixed a polythene/plastic sheet over the broken window.  他们在破损的窗户上补上了一块聚乙烯／塑胶纸。
The application form was a single sheet of paper.  申请表是单张纸的。

words.meaning: aux.应该(使用时,之后应接to,再接动词原形)
words.example:
We ought not/oughtn't to have agreed without knowing what it would cost.  不知道它的费用，我们本不应该同意的。
He ought to be home by seven o'clock.  七时前他应该到家了。
They ought to have arrived at lunchtime but the flight was delayed.  他们本该在午饭时到达，可是航班延误了。

words.meaning: v.确保,保证;使安全
words.example: The airline is taking steps to ensure safety on its aircraft.  航空公司正在采取措施以确保其航班的飞行安全。

words.meaning: a.天主教的 n.天主教徒
words.example:
Is he (a) Catholic?  他是天主教徒吗？
As a young person he had more catholic tastes than he does now.  他年轻的时候兴趣比现在要广泛得多。

words.meaning: n.广度,宽度,长度;程度,限度
words.example:
From the top of the Empire State Building, you can see the full extent of Manhattan (= the area it covers).  你可以从帝国大厦的顶楼看到曼哈顿全景。
We don't yet know the extent of his injuries (= how bad his injuries are).  我们还不知道他的伤势有多严重。
Rosie's teacher was impressed by the extent of her knowledge (= how much she knew).  罗西的知识很丰富，给她的老师留下了深刻的印象。

words.meaning: n.组成部分,成分,元件 a.组成的,合成的
words.example:
The factory supplies electrical components for cars.  这家工厂供应汽车电器零件。
The course has four main components: business law, finance, computing and management skills.  这门课由四大部分组成：商业法、金融、电脑操作和管理技巧。
Fresh fruit and vegetables are an essential component of a healthy diet.  新鲜水果和蔬菜是健康饮食的一个基本要素。

words.meaning: v.使混合;混淆
words.example:
Oil and water don't mix. Even if you shake them together they separate into two layers.  油与水不相融。即使你将其混在一起摇晃，它们也会分为两层。
Radioactive material was mixed in/up (with) the effluent.  放射性物质被混入废水中。
Mix the eggs into the flour.  在面粉里加入鸡蛋混和。

words.meaning: a.慢的,不活跃的 v.(down)(使)放慢,减速
words.example:
She's a very slow eater.  她吃饭很慢。
We're making slow but steady progress with the decorating.  我们的装修进度缓慢但很顺利。
The government was very slow to react to the problem.  政府对这一问题反应迟缓。

words.meaning: n.对比,对照 vi.形成对比 vt.把…与…对比
words.example:
The antique furnishing provides an unusual contrast to the modernity of the building.  这座建筑物的古典装饰与它自身的现代风格形成了不同寻常的对比。
There's a marked contrast between his character and hers.  他的性格与她形成了鲜明对比。
Their economy has expanded enormously, while ours, by/in contrast, has declined.  他们的经济快速增长，相比之下，我们的经济则下滑了。

words.meaning: n.地区,区域 v.分区,划分地带
words.example:
He was charged with driving 75 mph in a 55 mph zone.  他被指控在限速55英里的区域内驾车时速达到75英里。
This stretch of coast has been designated a danger zone.  这段海岸已被划定为危险地带。
The UN Security Council has established a no-fly zone (= one into which aircraft are not permitted to fly).  联合国安全理事会设定了一处禁飞区。

words.meaning: v.醒来,唤醒;使觉醒,激发,引起
words.example:
Did you wake at all during the night?  夜里你一点都没醒吗？
Please wake me early tomorrow.  明天请早点叫醒我。
Jane's hand on my shoulder woke me out of/from a bad dream.  简的手放在我肩上，把我从噩梦中摇醒。verb intransitive or transitive (woke or waked, woken or waked or US ALSO woke)    (also wake up) US ALSO

words.meaning: n.机场,航空站,航空港
words.example: an international airport  国际机场

words.meaning: n./a.褐色(的),棕色(的)
words.example:
Both my parents have curly brown hair.  我的父母都有一头棕色的鬈发。verb intransitive or transitive
Lightly brown the onion before adding the tomatoes.  加番茄之前先把洋葱炒至略呈褐色。
Allow the meat to brown before adding the vegetables.  把肉炒成褐色再加蔬菜。

words.meaning: n.衬衫
words.example:
You've spilled something down your shirt front.  你把甚么东西洒在衬衫前襟上了。
Keep your shirt on! Your car isn't badly damaged!  别生气！你的车受损不严重！UK noun countable
I'd put my shirt on the President being re-elected.  我肯定总统会再次当选。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.飞行员;领港员 v.驾驶(飞机等);领航,引水
words.example:
If you'd seen the pilot, you'd know why they decided not to make a complete series of programmes!  如果你看了试播节目的话，就会明白他们为甚么决定不制作整套节目了。noun countable
If the UKpilot scheme / USpilot program is successful many more homes will be offered the new television service.  如果试验计划成功，会有越来越多的家庭享受到新的电视服务。verb
She piloted the aircraft to safety after one of the engines failed.  其中一个引擎发生故障后，她把飞机驾驶到安全的地方。verb

words.meaning: vt.警告 vi.发出警告
words.example:
There were signs warning of fog as soon as we got onto the motorway.  我们一上高速公路，就看到有“大雾”的警示牌。
This particular curry is extremely hot - be warned!  这种特别的咖哩食品极辣——小心食用！
Put that ball down and come over here, Laura - I'm warning you (= I will punish you if you do not) !  放下那个球到这里来，萝拉——我是在警告你！

words.meaning: n.猫;猫科动物;
words.example:
As kids we used to fight like cat and dog.  小时候，我们总是吵吵闹闹的。noun countable
What's the matter? Has the cat got your tongue?  你怎么了？为甚么不吭声？noun countable
They haven't a cat in hell's chance of getting over the mountain in weather like this.  天气如此，他们根本不可能翻越这座山。noun countable

words.meaning: n.贡献;捐款,捐献物;投稿
words.example:
All contributions (= presents of money) , no matter how small, will be much appreciated.  所有捐款，无论多少，我们都深表感谢。
All contributions (= articles to be printed) for the school magazine must be received by August 1st.  投给校刊的所有稿件截止到8月1日。
This invention made a major contribution to road safety.  这项发明对道路安全作出了卓越贡献。

words.meaning: n.容量,容积;能量,能力;接受力
words.example:
The stadium has a seating capacity of 50 000.  这个体育场能容纳五万人。
The game was watched by a capacity crowd/audience of 50 000 (= the place was completely full).  比赛场座无虚席，五万观众观看了比赛。
She has a great capacity for hard work.  她特别能吃苦耐劳。

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]我们自己;我们亲自
words.example:
We promised ourselves a good holiday this year.  我们给自己许下诺言，今年要好好度个假。
Will we be able to do it ourselves or will we need help?  我们自己能做呢，还是需要有人帮忙？
It's a big garden, but we do all the gardening (by) ourselves (= without other people's help).  花园很大，但所有的园艺工作都由我们自己做。

words.meaning: n.房地产;不动产;所有权;地位;生活状况
words.example:
It's a typical country estate with a large house for the owner, farm buildings and estate workers' houses.  这是一个典型的乡村庄园，建有主人的大宅子、许多农舍以及庄园工人的宿舍。
She left her entire estate to her niece.  她把所有的遗产都留给了自己的侄女。noun

words.meaning: n.领路人;指南,导游 v.领路;指导;支配;管理
words.example:
We hired a guide to take us up into the mountains.  我们雇了一个向导带我们进入山区。
Let your conscience be your guide.  凭你的良心办事。verb
Our lawyer guided us through the more complicated questions on the form.  我们的律师指导我们答完表格中较为复杂的问题。verb

words.meaning: n.雪,下雪 vi.下雪;如雪一般地落下
words.example:
Outside the snow began to fall.  外面开始下雪了。
Let's go and play in the snow!  我们一起去玩雪吧！
Her hair was jet-black, her lips ruby-red and her skin as white as snow.  她头发乌黑，嘴唇红润如宝石，肌肤洁白如雪。

words.meaning: n.政治家,政客
words.example: a distinguished/disgraced politician  著名／失势的政治家

words.meaning: v.偷,窃取;偷偷地做,巧取
words.example:
She admitted stealing the money from her employers.  她承认偷了雇主的钱。
The number of cars which are stolen every year has risen.  每年失窃车辆的数量都在上升。
They were so poor they had to steal in order to eat.  他们非常穷，为了填饱肚子只得去行窃。verb intransitive or transitive (stole, stolen)

words.meaning: v.追赶,追踪;继续,从事
words.example:
The car was pursued by helicopters.  这辆车遭到多架直升机追捕。
The hunters spent hours pursuing their prey.  猎人们花费数小时追捕猎物。
He was killed by the driver of a stolen car who was being hotly pursued by the police.  他被车撞死了，撞他的人开的是一辆赃车，警方正在加紧追捕。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.滑,滑倒;滑掉;溜走n.疏忽,小错,口误,笔误
words.example:
She slipped on the ice.  她在冰上滑倒了。
Careful you don't slip - there's water on the floor.  小心别滑倒了——地板上有水。
The razor slipped while he was shaving and he cut himself.  他刮胡子时刮须刀一滑，把自己划伤了。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.百分数,百分率,百分比
words.example:
What percentage of women return to work after having a baby?  生完小孩后继续工作的女性占多大比例？
Interest rates have risen by two percentage points.  利率上升了两个百分点。UK noun
There's no percentage in working such long hours.  这样加班超时地工作可没有甚么好处。

words.meaning: n.(食用)肉类
words.example: It was a nicely written article and quite amusing but there wasn't much meat to it.  这是篇文笔优美又饶有趣味的文章，但没甚么实质内容。noun

words.meaning: a.滑稽的,可笑的
words.example:
Do you know any funny jokes?  你知道甚么有趣的笑话吗？
I've never found Charlie Chaplin very funny.  我从来都不觉得查理‧卓别林很滑稽。
It's a really funny film.  这真是场滑稽的电影。

words.meaning: a.两者都不 pron.两者都不 ad.也不
words.example:
We've got two TVs, but neither works properly.  我们有两台电视，但没有一台是好的。
Neither of my parents likes my boyfriend.  我父母都不喜欢我的男朋友。
Neither one of us is particularly interested in gardening.  我们两个都不太喜欢园艺。

words.meaning: n.泥土,土地,土壤 v.弄脏,(使)变脏
words.example:
It was the first time we had set foot on foreign/French/American soil (= gone to a foreign country/France/America).  那是我们第一次踏上异国／法国／美国的土地。
The government is trying to encourage a return to the soil.  政府试图鼓励人们重新务农。verb transitive formal
These were top lawyers, the kind who wouldn't normally soil their hands with police work or criminal law.  这些是顶级律师，他们一般不会插手警务和触犯刑法。

words.meaning: n.外科,外科学;手术室,诊疗室
words.example:
The patient had/underwent surgery on his heart.  这位病人接受了心脏外科手术。
He made a good recovery after surgery to remove a brain tumour.  做了脑部肿瘤切除手术以后，他恢复得很好。UK noun
If you come to the surgery (USoffice)at 10.30, the doctor will see you then.  如果你十点半来诊所，医生正好有空为你看病。

words.meaning: a.正确的,恰当的,端正的 v.改正,纠正,矫正
words.example:
It 's not correct to describe them as 'students'.  把他们说成学生不确切。
He's very correct in his dress/speech/manner, isn't he?  他穿着／谈吐／举止很得体，是不是？verb transitive
Students said it was helpful if the teacher corrected their pronunciation.  学生们说老师纠正他们的发音错误会对他们很有帮助。

words.meaning: v.责备;怪,把…归咎于 n.责任,过错;责备
words.example:
Don't blame me (= It is not my fault) if you miss the bus!  如果你没赶上车可别怪我！
Hugh blames his mother for his lack of confidence.  晓治把自己缺乏自信心归咎于他的母亲。
Hugh blames his lack of confidence on his mother.  晓治把自己缺乏自信心归咎于他的母亲。

words.meaning: v./n.估计,估价;评估
words.example:
Government sources estimate a long-term 50% increase in rail fares.  政府消息人士估计火车票价将有一个涨幅达50%的长期调涨。
The number of people who applied for the course was 120 compared with an initial estimate of between 50 and 100.  最初估计申请选修这门课程的学生也就是50到100人，可是实际上报名的有120人。
We'll accept the lowest of three estimates for the building work.  在对这项建筑工程的三个投标中，我们将采纳报价最低的那个。

words.meaning: a.(to)应支付的;(车,船等)预定应到达的
words.example:
What time is the next bus due?  下一班公车甚么时候来？
The next meeting is due to be held in three months' time.  下次会议预计将在三个月后召开。
Their first baby is due in January.  他们的第一个孩子预产期在一月份。

words.meaning: n.篮球,篮球运动
words.example: Basketball is popular in our school.  篮球在我们学校很流行。

words.meaning: n.高尔夫球
words.example: We often play a round (= game) of golf at the weekend.  我们经常在周末打一场高尔夫球。

words.meaning: v.调查,调查研究
words.example: Police are investigating allegations of corruption involving senior executives.  警方正在调查对高级管理人员涉嫌贪污的指控。

words.meaning: a.疯狂的,古怪的,蠢的;(about)狂热的
words.example:
It's a crazy idea.  这是个荒唐的想法。
You're crazy to buy a house without seeing it.  看都没看就买下一所房子，你真荒唐。
The constant noise drove me crazy (= made me become angry).  吵声不断简直要把我逼疯了。adjective

words.meaning: n.链(条);(pl.)镣铐;一连串 v.用链条拴住
words.example:
She has built up a chain of 180 bookshops across the country.  她在全国各地开了180家连锁书店。
We witnessed a remarkable chain of events in eastern Europe in 1989.  我们目睹了1989年发生在东欧的一连串不寻常事件。noun
The gates were locked with a padlock and a heavy steel chain.  大门被一把挂锁和一根沉重的钢链锁着。

words.meaning: n.(树)条,分支;分店;(学科)分科,部门;支流
words.example:
Immunology is a branch of biological science.  免疫学是生物科学的一个分支。
One branch of their family (= One group of relatives) emigrated to Brazil.  他们家族的一支移居到了巴西。
In the US, the president is part of the executive branch of the government.  在美国，总统是政府行政分支的一部分。

words.meaning: n.结合,联合;化合;团体;组合数码
words.example:
Strawberries and cream - a perfect combination.  草莓加奶油——完美的组合。
This drug can be safely used in combination with other medicines.  这药可以与其他药物一起安全服用。
Her experience and energy are a winning combination (= a successful mixture) in business.  经验加干劲是她在生意上成功的秘诀。

words.meaning: n.统治者,管理者,总督,州(省)长
words.example: the governor of Texas  德克萨斯州州长

words.meaning: n.(痛苦等)减轻,解除;援救,救济
words.example:
After the exam, I felt an incredible sense of relief.  考试过后，我感到轻松无比。
Pop stars have raised millions of pounds for famine relief in Africa.  流行歌星们已经筹集了数百万英镑的善款救济非洲饥民。noun
Coins have pictures on them in relief.  硬币上面有浮雕图案。

words.meaning: n./v.踢
words.example:
He was accused of kicking a man in the face.  他被控踢到他人的脸。
She felt the baby kicking inside her.  她感觉到腹中的胎儿在踢她。
When I realized what I'd done I could have kicked myself.  当我意识到自已的所作所为，不禁懊恼不已。

words.meaning: n.方式;举止;(pl.)风度,礼貌;规矩;风俗
words.example:
She stared at me in an accusing manner.  她以责备的目光注视着我。
He was elected in the normal manner.  他依正常程式当选。
It was the manner of her death that stuck in the public's mind.  她的死亡方式使公众很受触动。

words.meaning: a.古代的,古老的,古式的
words.example:
People have lived in this valley since ancient times.  人们自古就居住在这个山谷里。
History, ancient and modern , has taught these people an intense distrust of their neighbours.  古今历史向这些人灌输了对其邻国极度不信任的思想。
He's got an ancient computer.  他有一台老掉牙的电脑。

words.meaning: n.寂静,沉默 v.使沉默,使安静
words.example:
Silence reigned (= There was complete silence) in the church.  教堂里一片寂静。noun
The soldiers listened in silence as their captain gave the orders.  指挥官下达命令时，士兵们静静地听着。
"Silence (= Stop talking) " shouted the teacher.  “安静！”老师喊道。

words.meaning: a.金黄色的;贵重的,极好的
words.example: He's got a place at university which gives him a golden opportunity to do research in the subject which interests him.  他在大学里获得了一个职位，这为他研究自己感兴趣的课题提供了绝佳的机会。

words.meaning: n.运动,动;提议,动议 v.提议,动议
words.example:
The violent motion of the ship upset his stomach.  船的剧烈摇晃使他的胃很不舒服。
He rocked the cradle with a gentle backwards and forwards motion.  他轻轻地前后晃动摇篮。
They showed the goal again in slow motion (= at a slower speed so that the action could be more clearly seen).  他们用慢动作又播了一次进球画面。

words.meaning: n.(生理上的)性;(名词、代词等的)性
words.example:
Does this test show the gender of the baby?  这种检测能测出胎儿的性别吗？
Discrimination on the basis of race, gender, age or disability is not allowed.  基于种族、性别、年龄或残疾的歧视都是不能容许的。

words.meaning: v.解决,解答
words.example:
Just calm down - shouting won't solve anything!  冷静下来——大喊大叫并不能解决任何问题！
This strategy could cause more problems than it solves.  这一策略引发的问题可能会比解决的还多。
Police are still no nearer to solving the crime.  警方在侦破此案上依然没有取得任何进展。

words.meaning: n.费(会费,学费等);酬金
words.example: We couldn't pay the lawyer's fee.  我们付不起律师费。

words.meaning: n.碗(状物),钵
words.example:
She eats a bowl (= the contents of a bowl) of cereal every morning.  她每天早上吃一碗麦片。
Sift the flour and baking powder into a mixing bowl.  将面粉和发酵粉筛进搅拌碗里。
The toilet bowl was cracked and stained, and the walls were covered in mould.  抽水马桶破裂了，污迹斑斑，四周墙上到处都是霉点。

words.meaning: a.相等的;胜任的n.相等的事务;对手v.等于
words.example:
All people are equal, deserving the same rights as each other.  所有人都是平等的，享有同等的权利。
They've got a long way to go before they achieve equal pay/status for men and women.  要实现男女同工同酬／地位平等，他们仍有很长的路要走。
One litre is equal to 1.76 imperial pints.  1升等于1.76 英制品脱。

words.meaning: ad.向前;向外,往外
words.example:
They set forth on their travels in early June.  他们六月初起程旅行。
From that day forth he never drank again.  从那天起，他再也没有沾过酒。

words.meaning: n.框架;体格;骨架;组织;机构 v.设计;制定
words.example:
My sister has a much bigger frame than me.  我姐姐的骨架比我大很多。
The most important thing is to go into the exam in a positive frame of mind.  最重要的是要以积极的心态参加考试。
How can Christians and atheists ever come to understand each other when their frames of reference are so different?  基督徒和无神论者的思想观念差异如此之大，他们又怎么能相互理解呢？noun countable

words.meaning: a.(of)典型的,有代表性的
words.example:
This sort of hot and spicy food is very typical of the food in the south of the country.  这种辛辣食品是该国南部具代表性的食物。
Typical symptoms would include severe headaches, vomiting and dizziness.  典型的症状包括剧烈的头痛、呕吐和眩晕。
It's just typical of Ian to spend all that money on the equipment and then lose interest half way through the course.  伊恩就是这种人，先把所有钱花在买装备上，中途又失去兴趣。

words.meaning: prep.除…之外 v.除外;反对
words.example: Everyone except me was invited.  除了我，所有人都被邀请了。

words.meaning: a.保守的,守旧的 n.保守主义者
words.example:
Did you vote Conservative at the last election?  上次选举你投的是保守党的票吗？
Older people tend to be quite conservative and a bit suspicious of any supposed advances.  上年纪的人往往很保守，对任何所谓的进步都有些怀疑。    Compare liberal
He's a very conservative dresser - he always looks like he's wearing his father's clothes!  他穿着十分保守——看上去总像是穿着他父亲的衣服！UK adjective

words.meaning: vt.除去;淘汰;排(删,消)除;削减(人员)
words.example:
We eliminated the possibility that it could have been an accident.  我们排除了这或许是一埸意外事故的可能性。
The police eliminated him from their enquiries.  员警已把他排除在调查对象之外。
He was eliminated in the third round of the competition.  他在第三轮比赛中被淘汰。

words.meaning: n.主人;旅店老板;节目主持人;一大群,许多
words.example:
We thanked our hosts for the lovely evening.  我们感谢主人家让我们渡过了一个愉快的夜晚。
The local language school is advertising for host families (= families with whom people stay when they are visiting another country).  当地的语言学校正在招募能接待外国访客的家庭。UK noun
Our host for tonight's show is Terry Wogan.  我们今晚节目的主持人是泰瑞‧沃根。UK noun

words.meaning: n.礼堂,会堂,办公大楼,门厅
words.example:
I'm playing in a concert at the village/church hall.  我将在村里的礼堂／教堂大厅所举行的音乐会参与演奏。UK noun countable
I've left my bags in the hall.  我把书包掉在大厅里了。

words.meaning: vt.信任;盼望;委托 n.(in)信任,依赖;委托
words.example:
My sister warned me not to trust him.  我姐姐告诫我不要相信他。
Trust me - I know about these things.  相信我——我了解这些东西。
Trust your instincts and do what you think is right.  相信你的直觉，做你认为正确的事情。

words.meaning: n.海洋
words.example:
These mysterious creatures live at the bottom of the ocean.  这些神秘的生物居住在海底。
We've got oceans of time.  我们的时间很多。

words.meaning: n.(一)排,(一)行;吵嚷 v.划(船等),荡桨
words.example:
We had seats in the front/back row of the theatre.  我们坐在剧场前／后排。
She's been voted Best Actress three years in a row.  她已经连续三年当选为最佳女演员。
They've gone for a row to the island.  他们划船去那个岛了。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.担负得起(损失、费用、后果等),买得起
words.example:
Few people are able to afford cars like that.  很少人买得起那样的车。
She couldn't afford the time off work to see him.  她工作太忙，抽不出时间去看他。
The hut afforded little protection from the elements.  这间棚屋几乎不能遮风挡雨。

words.meaning: n.其时,其间 ad.当时,与此同时
words.example: Carl's starting college in September. Meanwhile, he's travelling around Europe.  卡尔九月将开始大学生活。此间他正在环游欧洲。

words.meaning: n.政体,制度
words.example:
The old corrupt, totalitarian regime was overthrown.  腐败的旧极权政府被推翻。
The regime in this office is hard work and more hard work.  这个事务所的管理方式就是，让你工作努力再努力。noun countable

words.meaning: n.分,分割;部门,科,处;除法;分界线
words.example:
Norwich are currently top of Division one.  诺里奇队目前在第一组中居于首位。noun
Disagreements about defence cuts have opened up deep divisions within the military.  在削减国防开支问题上的看法不一导致军方内部出现了严重的分歧。
Division within the party will limit its chances at the election.  内讧将会降低该党在选举中获胜的机会。

words.meaning: v.使更坚固,使更坚定;(进一步)证实;确认
words.example:
Flights should be confirmed 48 hours before departure.  应该在起飞前48小时确认航班。
I've accepted the job over the phone, but I haven't confirmed in writing yet.  我已在电话中接受了这份工作，但还没有书面确认。UK verb
The leader's speech was impressive and confirmed her faith in the party.  这位领导人的讲话令人难忘，坚定了她对该党的信心。UK verb

words.meaning: v.(使)固定;修理;安装;决定;注视 n.困境
words.example:
They couldn't fix my old computer, so I bought a new one.  他们修不好我的旧电脑了，所以我买了台新的。verb
Shall we fix a time for our next meeting?  我们确定一下下次会议的时间吧？
We fixed the bookcase to the wall.  我们把书架固定在墙上。verb

words.meaning: vi.呼吁,恳求;申诉 n.呼吁;申诉;吸引力
words.example:
They're launching (= starting) an appeal to raise money for famine victims.  他们正在呼吁社会为饥民捐款。
The case went to the court of appeal/the appeal court.  案件被提交到上诉法院。
He won his appeal and the sentence was halved.  他上诉获胜，刑期减半。

words.meaning: n.镜子;反映,反射 v.反映,反射
words.example:
She was looking at her reflection in the mirror.  她正看着自己在镜中的影像。UK noun
The movie is a mirror of daily life in wartime Britain.  这部电影真实地反映了英国人在战时的日常生活。UK verb transitive
Our newspaper aims to mirror the opinions of ordinary people.  我们的报纸旨在反映普通民众的意见。

words.meaning: n.(pl.teeth)牙齿;齿状物;
words.example:
Brush/Clean your teeth thoroughly morning and night.  早晚要好好刷牙。
This committee can make recommendations but it has no real teeth.  这个委员会可以提出建议，但没有实权。 (plural teeth)
We fought tooth and nail to get the route of the new road changed.  我们奋力抗争，争取改变新修道路的路线。 (plural teeth)

words.meaning: a.漂亮的;聪明的;巧妙的 v.剧痛,刺疼
words.example:
Guy looks very smart in his new suit, doesn't he?  盖伊穿上新西装显得精神十足，不是吗？
She works in a very smart new office overlooking the River Cam.  她在一间非常漂亮的新办公室里工作，从那里可以俯瞰康河。
We went to a very smart party on New Year's Eve.  除夕我们去参加了一个非常时尚的派对。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.长,长度;一段,一节,程度,范围
words.example:
The boat is ten metres in length.  这条船长十米。
The length of the bay is approximately 200 miles.  海湾的长度约为200英里。
She planted rose bushes (along) the length of the garden (= the whole distance along it).  她把花园的四周都种上了玫瑰花丛。

words.meaning: v.(on)依赖,依靠;信赖,信任
words.example: British weather can never be relied on - it's always changing.  英国的天气向来靠不住——它总是变幻无常。

words.meaning: n.话题,主题,题目
words.example: Our discussion ranged over various topics, such as acid rain and the hole in the ozone layer.  我们的讨论涉及各种话题，例如酸雨和臭氧层空洞。

words.meaning: v.(about,of)抱怨;申诉
words.example:
Lots of people have complained about the noise.  许多人抱怨过这噪音。
You're always complaining!  你总是满腹牢骚！
If the service was so bad why didn't you complain to the manager?  如果服务品质这么差的话，你为甚么不向经理投诉呢？verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.电话,电话机 v.打电话
words.example: The telephone rang twice then stopped.  电话响了两声就不响了。

words.meaning: vt.引起的注意(或兴趣等),吸引;引起;激起
words.example:
These flowers are brightly coloured in order to attract butterflies.  这些花朵都有着鲜艳的色彩以便能够吸引蝴蝶。
The circus is attracting huge crowds/audiences.  马戏团吸引了大批的观众。
Magnets attract iron filings.  磁铁吸铁屑。

words.meaning: n.(in)信任;信心,自信;秘密,机密
words.example:
She's very timid - completely lacking in (self-)confidence.  她很腼腆——一点自信也没有。
They talked endlessly, exchanging confidences.  他们聊个不停，互诉心事。

words.meaning: a.秘密的,机密的 n.秘密
words.example:
Why did you have to go and tell Bob about my illness? You just can't keep a secret, can you?  你为甚么一定要跑去把我生病的事告诉鲍勃？你就是不能保守秘密，是吗？
Aren't you going to let me in on (= tell me) the secret?  难道你不打算告诉我这个秘密？
There's no secret (= everyone knows) about his homosexuality.  他是同性恋，这已不是秘密了。

words.meaning: n.债,债务
words.example:
He managed to pay off his debts in two years.  他设法在两年内还清债务。
The firm ran up huge debts.  公司很快就负债累累。
They are in debt to (= owe money to) the bank.  他们欠银行的钱。

words.meaning: a.稀有的,难得的,珍奇的;稀薄的,稀疏的
words.example:
The museum is full of rare and precious treasures.  这所博物馆里收藏的满是奇珍异宝。
a rare occasion/opportunity/visit/treat, etc.  难得的时机／机会／探访／款待等
