It's very rare to find someone who combines such qualities.  同时具有这些素质的人非常罕见。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.罐,槽,箱;坦克 vt.储于槽中
words.example: a water tank  水箱

words.meaning: n.护士,保姆 v.护理,看护
words.example:
He worked as a nurse in a psychiatric hospital.  他在精神病院当护士。
Nurse Millard will be with you shortly.  米勒德护士很快会来照顾你。
[as form of address] Thank you, Nurse.  谢谢你，护士。

words.meaning: ad.在旁边,到一边 n.旁白;离题的话
words.example:
Stand aside, please, and let these people pass.  请往边上站一站，让这些人过去。
He pulled the curtain aside.  他把窗帘拉开。
I've forgotten my cheque book, so could you put this book aside (= keep this book) for me and I'll come back later on.  我忘了带支票簿，麻烦你把这本书替我留一下，我稍后再来买。

words.meaning: ad.无论哪里;(用于否定、疑问等)任何地方
words.example: I've been sorting out my study all day, but it's such a mess I don't feel I'm getting anywhere.  我一整天都在整理书房，但是里面太乱了，我觉得忙来忙去还是没甚么头绪。

words.meaning: n.结合(物),粘结(剂),联结;公债,债券,契约
words.example:
There has been a close bond between them ever since she saved him from drowning.  他溺水被她救了以后他们之间一直来往密切。
In societies with strong family bonds (= relationships) , people tend to live longer.  在家庭关系牢固的社会中，人们的寿命往往更长。UK noun
They have entered into a solemn bond.  他们已经缔结了一项正式契约。

words.meaning: n.愉快,快乐;乐事,乐趣
words.example:
His visits gave his grandparents such pleasure.  他来探望爷爷奶奶，这让他们非常开心。
Why do so many boys take pleasure in torturing insects and small animals.  为甚么有这么多的男孩子喜欢以虐待昆虫和小动物为乐？
He wrote an article on the pleasures and pains of camping.  他写了一篇关于露营甘苦的文章。

words.meaning: n.男主人;师傅;硕士 v.精通,控制 a.主要的
words.example:
With careful training, a dog will obey its master completely.  经过精心训练的狗会完全服从主人的命令。
He was a master of disguise.  他是个伪装大师。
This painting is clearly the work of a master.  这幅画显然是名家的作品。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.时代,年代,阶段,纪元
words.example:
They had worked for peace during the long era of conflict.  在漫长而冲突不断的年代里，他们努力争取和平。
The fall of the Berlin wall marked the end of an era.  柏林围墙的倒塌标记着一个时代的结束。

words.meaning: n.(for)需要,需要的东西,要求
words.example: Students who fail to meet the requirements (of the course) will fail.  达不到（本门课程）要求的学生将不能及格。

words.meaning: n.玩笑,娱乐;有趣的人(或事物)
words.example:
Have fun (= Enjoy yourself) !  玩个痛快！
Having fun (= Are you enjoying yourself) ?  玩得痛快吗？
She's great fun to be with.  跟她在一起你会觉得很有意思。

words.meaning: n.预期,期望,指望
words.example:
The holiday lived up to all our expectations (= was as good as we were expecting).  假期过得一点也没有令我们失望。
We did so well - beyond all (= better than) our expectations.  我们做得非常好——远远超出我们的预期。
Considering the injuries he's had there can be little expectation of him winning the race.  考虑到他的伤势，他赢这场比赛的希望不大。

words.meaning: n.翅,翅膀;翼,机翼;派别 vt.装以翼
words.example:
She walked in the hills, letting her thoughts take wing.  她走在山坡上，任思绪自由飞扬。
The president is on the left/right wing of the Democratic party.  总统属于民主党左翼／右翼。noun countable
The maternity ward will be in the new wing of the hospital.  产科病房将设在医院新建的一侧。

words.meaning: a.(from)分离的,分开的
words.example:
The art department and the main college are in two separate buildings.  艺术系和主要的学院在两座独立的大楼中。
Three youths have been shot and killed in separate incidents this month.  这个月有三名年轻人在不同的事件中被枪杀。adjective UK go your (own) separate ways
In 1983 the group disbanded and went their separate ways.  1983年乐队解散，成员各奔东西。verb UK  ESSENTIAL  intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: pron.&ad.一点儿,几分
words.example:
The resort has changed somewhat over the last few years.  近几年来，这个旅游胜地出现了些变化。
She's somewhat more confident than she used to be.  她比过去自信了一些。
We were somewhat tired after our long walk.  走了很长的路之后，我们有些累了。

words.meaning: v.灌注, 倾泻, 涌入, 流, 倾盆大雨
words.example:
Pour the honey into the bowl and mix it thoroughly with the other ingredients.  把蜂蜜倒进碗里，让它和其他原料充分混合。
Would you like to pour (= pour a drink into a glass or cup) while I open some bags of nuts?  我开几袋坚果，你倒饮料好吗？UK verb
The bus was pouring out thick black exhaust fumes.  公共汽车在排出大量浑浊的黑色废气。

words.meaning: v.搅拌,搅动;动,摇动;激动;轰动;煽动,鼓动
words.example:
Stir the sauce gently until it begins to boil.  慢慢搅动酱汁直至煮沸。
Stir the egg yolks into the mixture.  将蛋黄搅拌至混合料中。
She paused to stir some milk into her coffee.  她停了一下，往咖啡里掺了点牛奶。

words.meaning: n.啤酒
words.example:
He asked for a pint of beer.  他要了一品脱啤酒。
This beer is brewed in Mexico.  这种啤酒是在墨西哥酿制的。
After a hard day's work I enjoy a beer or two.  我喜欢在辛苦工作了一整天后，喝一两杯啤酒。

words.meaning: n.提及,涉及;参考,参考书目;证明书(人)
words.example:
Knowing what had happened, I avoided making any reference to (= mentioning) weddings.  因为我知道发生了甚么，所以就避开不谈婚礼的事情。
formal I am writing with/in reference to (= in connection with) your letter of 15 March.  现就3月15日贵函致覆。UK noun
In all future letters on this subject, please use/quote our reference JW/155/C/1991.  今后有关此事项的所有信件都请标明我方信函编号UK noun

words.meaning: n.(pl.)眼泪 vt.撕裂;使…分裂 vi.破裂
words.example:
You have to be very careful with books this old because the paper tends to tear very easily.  对这么旧的书你得格外小心，因为它的纸张很容易撕破。
He went tearing along the road after the bus.  他在路上飞奔追赶公车。UK verb (tore, torn)
She's been tearing her hair out over the final chapter of her novel for the last month.  一个月来，她绞尽脑汁构思小说的最后一章。UK verb (tore, torn)

words.meaning: n./v.怀疑,疑虑
words.example:
I'm having doubts about his ability to do the job.  我对他是否能胜任此项工作还有一些疑问。
If there's any doubt about the rocket's engines, we ought to cancel the launch.  如果对火箭引擎还存有任何疑虑，我们都应该取消此次发射。
The prosecution has to establish his guilt UK beyond (reasonable) doubt] US beyond a (reasonable) doubt.  此次起诉必须证明他所犯的罪行证据确凿。

words.meaning: v.同意,准予;授予 n.授予物;津贴;转让证书
words.example:
He was granted asylum.  他的避难请求被接受了。
formal She granted their request/wish.  她答应了他们的请求／满足了他们的愿望。UK verb
One of the problems with relationships is that after a while you just take each other for granted.  恋爱中会遇到的一个问题是，相处一段时间后，双方就都把对方为自己所做的一切视为理所当然。

words.meaning: n.部长,大臣
words.example:
formal The priest ministers to his flock (= the people who go to his church).  牧师对他的教徒给予关爱。
humorous I spent most of the morning ministering to my sick husband.  我上午的大部分时间都在照顾生病的丈夫。

words.meaning: n.英雄,勇士;男主角,男主人公
words.example: In the movie, the hero saves the city.  电影里英雄拯救了城市。

words.meaning: a.工业的,产业的
words.example:
He has an industrial background (= He has worked in industry).  他在工业领域工作过。noun countable specialized
He owns a series of industrials across the US and beyond.  他在美国以及其他地区拥有一系列工业公司。
Industrials were up 1.2% at the close of trading.  在交易结束的时候工业股票上升了1.2个百分点。

words.meaning: n.云(状物);遮暗物,阴影;一大群
words.example:
Do you think those are rain clouds on the horizon?  你看天边那些云是雨云吗？
The sky was a perfect blue - not a cloud in sight.  天空一片湛蓝——万里无云。
There was so much cloud, we couldn't see anything.  云层太厚，我们甚么也看不见。

words.meaning: v.伸展,延伸 n.拉长;伸展;一段时间/路程
words.example:
She stretched out her hand and helped him from his chair.  她伸手将他从椅子上扶起来。
"I'm so tired, " she said, yawning and stretching.  “我太累了。”她打着呵欠伸了个懒腰说。
It's a good idea to stretch before you take vigorous exercise.  在进行剧烈运动前，应该先伸展一下身体。verb

words.meaning: n.容积,体积;卷,册;音量
words.example:
Which of these bottles do you think has the greater volume?  你认为这些瓶子中哪个容积最大？
It's the sheer volume of traffic in the city that is causing the problems.  造成这些问题的就是城里的交通流量。UK noun
Could you turn the volume down, please, I'm trying to sleep.  你能把音量调低些吗？我要睡觉。

words.meaning: n.种子 v.播种;结实,结籽
words.example:
Sow the seeds (= put them in the ground) about 3 cm deep.  把这些种子种进约三厘米深的地方。
The chemical will stop all seeds from sprouting (= starting to grow).  这种化学制品可制止种子发芽。
The farmers grow these crops for seed (= for planting to grow more crops, rather than for eating).  农民种这些作物是为了育种。

words.meaning: n.流行式样(或货品),风尚,风气;样子,方式
words.example:
Long hair is back in fashion for men.  男士又流行留长发了。
Fur coats have gone out of fashion.  皮草大衣已经过时了。
She always wears the latest fashions.  她总是穿着最新款式的服装。

words.meaning: n.胡椒粉,胡椒;辣椒
words.example:
Peppers are usually cooked with other vegetables or eaten raw in salads.  甜椒通常与其他蔬菜一同烹调，或放在沙拉里生吃。
Red peppers are ideal for roasting in the oven.  红椒很适合用烤箱烘烤来吃。UK verb
The city's walls were peppered with bullets.  城墙被子弹打得满目疮痍。

words.meaning: a.忙,忙碌的;热闹的,繁忙的;(电话)占线
words.example:
Mum was busy in the kitchen.  妈妈在厨房里忙着呢。
The kids are busy with their homework.  孩子们在忙着做家课。
She's busy writing out the wedding invitations.  她在忙着写婚礼请柬。

words.meaning: n.抄本,摹本;(一)本 vt.抄写;考试中抄袭
words.example:
They've copied the basic design from the Japanese model and added a few of their own refinements.  他们仿照日本模型的基本设计，又加上了一些自己的改良。
Patricia's going to copy her novel onto disk and send it to me.  帕特里夏打算把她的小说复制到磁片上寄给我。
He tends to copy his brother in the way he dresses.  他常常仿效哥哥的穿着。

words.meaning: n.尖端;末端;小费 n./v.轻击;倾斜;给小费
words.example:
The table tipped and all our drinks fell on the floor.  桌子翻了，结果我们的所有饮料都掉在地上。
If you put too many books on one end of the shelf, it'll tip up.  如果你在书架的一头放太多书，书架就会翻掉。
Don't tip your chair back like that, you'll fall.  不要那样向后仰椅子，你会翻倒的。

words.meaning: a.便宜的;低劣的,不值钱的
words.example:
Food is usually cheaper in supermarkets.  超市里的食物通常比较便宜。
Children and the elderly are entitled to cheap train tickets.  儿童和老人可以使用廉价火车票。
The scheme is simple and cheap to operate.  这个计划实施起来简单又省钱。

words.meaning: n.目的;瞄准 vi.(at)目的在于 vt.把…瞄准
words.example:
My main aim in life is to be a good husband and father.  我人生的主要目标是做一个好丈夫和好爸爸。
Our short-term aim is to deal with our current financial difficulties, but our long-term aim is to improve the company's profitability.  我们的短期目标是解决当前的财政困难，但长远目标是提高公司的盈利。
The leaflet has been produced with the aim of increasing public awareness of the disease.  印发该传单的目的是为了提高公众对这种疾病的认识。noun

words.meaning: v.引用,引证,举(例)
words.example:
She cited three reasons why people get into debt.  她举出了人们负债的三个原因。
The company cited a 12% decline in new orders as evidence that overall demand for its products was falling.  公司举出新订单减少12%这一事实，以此来证明其产品的总需求在下降。
She cites both T.S. Eliot and Virginia Woolf in her article.  她在文章中引用了托马斯‧斯特恩斯‧艾略特和维吉尼亚‧伍尔芙的作品。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.福利;幸福;福利事业
words.example:
This national fund pays for welfare benefits such as unemployment and sickness pay.  此项国家基金提供多项福利救济，例如失业和医疗等。
The police are very concerned for the welfare of the missing child.  警方非常担心失踪儿童的安危。
These organizations have fought very hard for the rights and welfare of immigrants.  这些机构竭力为移民争取权利和福利。

words.meaning: n.碟子,盘子,菜肴
words.example:
Have you done/washed the dishes?  你洗完餐具没有？noun
He's gorgeous - what a dish!  他太棒了——非常性感！verb
She agreed to dish the dirt on her ex-husband for a fee of fifty thousand pounds.  她同意接受五万英镑揭前夫的短。verb

words.meaning: n.海滩,湖滩,河滩
words.example:
We spent the day on the beach.  我们在海滩渡过了一整天。
The boat had been beached near the rocks.  船已经被拖到了礁石附近。

words.meaning: n.改进,进步,增进;改进措施
words.example:
These white walls are a big improvement on that disgusting old wallpaper.  这些白墙比起那些令人生厌的旧墙纸来说好看多了。
He's been having treatment for two months now without any improvement.  他接受治疗已有两个月了，但毫无起色。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: ad.到处,各处,无论何处
words.example:
His children go everywhere with him.  他去哪里，他的孩子就跟到哪里。
Everywhere looks so grey and depressing in winter.  冬天，处处都灰蒙蒙，令人感到压抑。
Reasonable people everywhere will be outraged by this atrocity.  无论在哪里，任何一个讲道理的人都会对这种暴行感到愤怒。

words.meaning: n.开,开放,开始,空缺,机会 a.开始的,开幕的
words.example:
The children crawled through an opening in the fence.  孩子们从篱笆上的一个缺口里爬了过去。UK noun
The official opening of the new school will take place next month.  这所新学校将于下月正式启用。UK noun
The opening of the novel is amazing.  这部小说开篇惊人。

words.meaning: a.全面的,综合的 n.(pl.)(套头)工作服
words.example:
The overall situation is good, despite a few minor problems.  尽管有些小问题，局势总的来说是好的。
Overall, it has been a good year.  总的来说，这一年很不错。
The overall winner, after ten games, will receive $250 000.  10场比赛后，总冠军将获得25万美元。

words.meaning: v.分,划分,分开;分配;(by)除
words.example:
At the end of the lecture, I'd like all the students to divide into small discussion groups.  讲座结束后，我想让所有学生分成几个讨论小组。
After World War Two, Germany was divided into two separate countries.  第二次世界大战之后，德国被分成了两个独立的国家。
There's a narrow alley which divides our house from the one next door.  一条窄窄的小巷将我们的房子和邻居的隔开了。

words.meaning: a.最初的,开头的;词首的 n.词首大写字母
words.example:
My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.  我最初的惊讶很快变成了兴奋。
Initial reports say that seven people have died, though this has not yet been confirmed.  最初的报道说有七人丧生，但这个消息还未得到证实。noun countable usually plural
He wrote his initials, P.M.R., at the bottom of the page.  他在页尾写上了他名字的首字母P.M.R.。

words.meaning: a.很糟的;可怕的,骇人的;极度的,厉害的
words.example:
The weather was terrible.  天气糟透了。
We have just received some terrible news.  我们刚刚收到一些可怕的消息。adjective
This project is a terrible waste of money.  这个专案计划特别浪费钱财。

words.meaning: v.反对,使对立,使对抗,使相对
words.example:
The proposed new examination system has been vigorously opposed by teachers.  实行新考试制度的提议遭到教师们的强烈反对。
Most of the local residents opposed the closing of their hospital.  当地大多数居民反对关闭他们的医院。

words.meaning: a.现代的,当代的;同时代的
words.example:
Although it was written hundreds of years ago, it still has a contemporary (= modern) feel to it.  尽管它写于几百年前，但读来仍具现代感。UK adjective
Almost all of the contemporary accounts of the event have been lost.  几乎所有关于这一事件的同时期的记载都遗失了。
Most of the writers he was contemporary with were interested in the same subjects.  和他同时代的大多数作家都对同样的题材感兴趣。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.路线,路程
words.example:
The route we had planned took us right across Greece.  我们计划走的路线正好穿过希腊。
Deliveries are routed via/by way of London.  货物经由伦敦运送。

words.meaning: a.多样的,多重的 n.倍数 v.成倍增加
words.example:
The youth died of multiple burns.  那个年轻人因多处烧伤死亡。
We made multiple copies of the report.  我们把报告影印了多份。
These children have multiple (= many different) handicaps.  这些孩子身患多种残疾。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.本质的,基本的;净化的 n.本质;要素
words.example:
Government support will be essential if the project is to succeed.  这个企划案能否成功，政府的支援至关重要。
There is essential work to be done before the building can be re-occupied.  这栋建筑在重新入住前必须进行必要的维修。
Water is essential for/to living things.  水对于生物来说是不可或缺的。

words.meaning: n.同盟,联盟;联合会,社团
words.example:
Who do you think will win the league championship this year?  你认为谁会获得今年的联赛冠军？
Liverpool were top of the Football League that year.  利物浦队是那一年的足球联赛冠军。
They are currently bottom of the league.  他们目前在联赛中垫底。noun countable

words.meaning: n.罪犯,刑事犯 a.犯罪的,刑事的
words.example:
It's criminal to charge so much for a book.  一本书要这么高的价钱，真是太不应该了。
The way we waste this planet's resources is criminal.  我们这样浪费地球的资源简直就是犯罪。

words.meaning: a.小心的,仔细的;细致的,精心的
words.example:
Be careful with the glasses.  小心玻璃杯。
Be careful wh ere you put that hot pan.  要注意把热锅放在合适的地方。
Be careful to look both ways when you cross the road.  过马路时要注意向两边看。

words.meaning: n.果核;中心,核心
words.example:
The basic lack of government funding is at the core of the problem.  缺乏基本的政府拨款是问题的关键所在。
The final status negotiations would focus on the core issues of the peace process.  最终地位的谈判会把重心放在和平进程这一核心问题上。
The company's core operations include entertainment and aviation.  公司的核心业务包括娱乐和航空。

words.meaning: v.(使)冲;奔n.冲,急速行进 a.(交通)繁忙的
words.example:
Whenever I see him, he seems to be rushing (about/around).  我甚么时候见到他，他都是匆匆忙忙的。
When she turned it upside down the water rushed out.  她把它底朝上翻转过来时，水一下倾泻出来。
You can't rush a job like this.  你不应该这样粗粗地赶活。

words.meaning: a.疲劳的;厌倦的
words.example:
My legs are tired.  我的腿酸了。
She spoke in a tired voice.  她说话有气无力的。UK adjective
It's always the same tired old faces at these meetings.  在这些会上总是些不变的令人生厌的老面孔。

words.meaning: n./v.雇用;用,使用
words.example:
How many people does your company employ?  你们公司雇有多少员工？
Can't we employ someone as an assistant to help with all this paperwork?  我们不可以雇一位助理来协助处理这些文书工作吗？
More people are now employed in service industries than in manufacturing.  现在服务业的就业人数多于制造业。verb

words.meaning: n.假日,节日,假期,休假
words.example:
Have you decided where you're going for your holiday(s) this year?  你决定今年到哪里渡假了吗？
Patricia is on holiday next week.  派翠夏下星期休假。
How many days' holiday do you get with your new job?  你的新工作有几天假期？

words.meaning: n.坚决,决心;决定,决议
words.example: He showed great resolution in facing the robbers.  面对强盗，他表现得英勇无畏。noun

words.meaning: n.家庭,家人 a.家庭(务)的,家常的
words.example: By the 1960s, most households had a TV.  到了20世纪60年代，绝大多数家庭都拥有电视。

words.meaning: ad.分离,离开,隔开 a.分离的,分隔的
words.example:
Stand with your feet wide apart.  两腿叉开站立，双脚间距要大。
How far apart should the speakers be?  两个喇叭应相距多远？
We were asked to stand in two lines three metres apart.  要求我们站成间距为三米的两排。

words.meaning: n.目击者,证人;证据,证明 v.目击,目睹;作证
words.example:
Police are appealing for witnesses to the accident to come forward.  警方呼吁那场事故的目击者站出来。
According to (eye) witnesses, the robbery was carried out by two teenage boys.  据目击者说，抢劫案是两个十几岁的少年犯的。
She was witness to the tragic event.  她目睹了这悲剧。

words.meaning: n.火柴;比赛,竞赛;对手,配偶 v.匹配,相称
words.example:
We won/lost the match.  我们赢／输掉了比赛。
Liverpool have a match with (= against) Blackburn next week.  利物浦队下周将与布莱克本队对赛。
You should always strike a match away from you.  擦火柴时应该离身体远一些。

words.meaning: ad.赤裸裸地,无遮蔽地;仅仅,勉强,几乎没有
words.example:
They have barely enough (= no more than what is needed) to pay the rent this month.  他们这个月差一点就付不起房租了。
She was barely (= only just) fifteen when she won her first championship.  她初次获得冠军时刚满15岁。

words.meaning: n.部门,部分;防御地段,防区;扇形
words.example:
In the financial sector, banks and insurance companies have both lost a lot of money.  在金融领域，银行和保险公司都损失严重。
The new government's policy is to transfer state industries from the public sector to the private sector.  新政府的政策是将国有工业私有化。UK noun countable
What is the total oil output from the British sector of the North Sea?  北海英国产区的石油总产量是多少？

words.meaning: n.代表,代理人 a.(of)典型的,有代表性的
words.example:
The firm has two representatives in every European city.  这间公司在每个欧洲城市设有两名销售代表。
Are your views/opinions representative of all the workers here?  你的观点／意见可以代表这里所有工人的想法吗？

words.meaning: prep.在…下边,在…之下 ad.在下方
words.example:
Jeremy hid the letter beneath a pile of papers.  杰瑞米把信藏在一叠文件下面。
We huddled together for warmth beneath the blankets.  我们裹着毛毯，挤成一堆取暖。
After weeks at sea, it was wonderful to feel firm ground beneath our feet once more.  在海上呆了数星期后，双脚再次接触坚实土地的感觉真棒。

words.meaning: prep.在...旁边,在...附近;和...相比
words.example:
Come and sit here beside me.  过来坐在我身边。
Our school was built right beside a river.  我们的学校就建在河边。
Those books seem rather dull beside this one.  与这本书相比，那些书似乎都很枯燥。

words.meaning: n.事件,事变
words.example: Despite fears of violence, the demonstration passed off without incident.  尽管担心发生暴力事件，示威活动还是平静地结束了。

words.meaning: a.有限的,被限制的
words.example:
Places on the bus are limited to fifty - so book early!  大客车定员50人——所以请尽早预订！
The problem of stress is certainly not limited to people who work (= it exists for others too).  压力当然并非只有工作的人才有。

words.meaning: a.(of)自豪的;引以自豪的;妄自尊大的
words.example:
You must be very proud of your son.  你一定为你的儿子感到非常自豪。
We're particularly proud of our company's environmental record.  我们为我们公司在环保方面的良好记录感到特别自豪。
When she received her prize I think I was the proudest parent on the face of the Earth.  她领奖时，我感到我是世界上最自豪的父母。

words.meaning: v.流,流动 n.流量,流速
words.example:
Lava from the volcano was flowing down the hillside.  火山岩浆顺着山坡往下流。
Many short rivers flow into the Pacific Ocean.  许多小河汇入太平洋。
The river flows through three counties before flowing into the sea just south of here.  这条河流在汇入此处正南边的大海之前流经了三个郡县。

words.meaning: n.才能;学院,系;(学院或系的)全体教学人员
words.example:
Even at the age of 100, she still had all her faculties.  尽管年届一百高龄，她的一切身体机能仍然保持正常。
Is he in command/possession of all his faculties (= Can he still hear, speak, see and think clearly) ?  他身体一切机能均正常吗？
She has a faculty for inspiring confidence in people.  她具有激发他人信心的能力。

words.meaning: v.浪费 a.无用的;荒芜的 n.浪费;废物
words.example:
That meeting achieved absolutely nothing - it was a complete waste of time.  那次会议根本没有取得甚么成果——纯粹是浪费时间。
She's been unemployed for two years and it's such a waste of her talents.  她已经失业两年了，这纯粹是浪费她的才华。
My mother couldn't bear waste - she always made us eat everything on our plates.  我母亲不能容忍浪费——她总是让我们吃光自己碟子里的所有东西。

words.meaning: adv.仅仅,只不过
words.example: The medicine won't cure her - it merely stops the pain.  这种药不能治愈她的病——只能止痛罢了。

words.meaning: n.大量,众多;团,块;(pl.)群众,民众;质量
words.example:
Thousands of troops have massed along the border in preparation for an invasion.  数千大军已经集结在边境上，准备入侵。adjective [before noun]
Opposition groups plan to stage mass demonstrations all over the country.  反对派计划在全国发起大规模游行示威。noun
The explosion reduced the church to a mass of rubble.  爆炸使教堂变成一堆瓦砾。

words.meaning: v.(emphasise)强调
words.example:
You can use italics or capitals to emphasize a word in a piece of writing.  你可以用斜体或者大写来强调文章中的某个词。
Tight jeans will only emphasize any extra weight that you are carrying.  紧身牛仔裤只会使你身上的赘肉更明显。

words.meaning: n.实验;试验 v.(on)进行实验;做试验
words.example:
Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.  有些人认为应该禁止拿动物做实验。
I've bought a different kind of coffee this week as an experiment (= in order to see what it is like).  这个星期我买了不同牌子的咖啡来尝试。
We can only find the best solution by experiment.  我们只能摸石头过河，寻找最好的解决办法。verb intransitive /ɪkˈsper.ɪ.ment/

words.meaning: n.炸弹 v.投弹于,轰炸
words.example:
The terrorists had planted a bomb near the police station.  恐怖分子在警察局附近设置了一枚炸弹。
During the Second World War, the British dropped a huge number of bombs on Dresden.  二战期间，英国在德累斯顿城投下了大量炸弹。
The US was the first country to have the bomb.  美国是第一个拥有原子弹的国家。UK noun

words.meaning: a.巨大的,庞大的
words.example:
He earns an enormous salary.  他工资极高。
You've been an enormous help.  你真是帮了大忙。

words.meaning: n.音调,音色;风气,气氛;腔调,语气;色调
words.example:
Don't speak to me in that tone of voice (= angrily) , young lady!  小姐，别用那种语气跟我说话！
It wasn't so much what she said that annoyed me - it was her tone.  令我生气的不是她所说的话，而是她说话的语气。
She recounted the story to me in shocked tones (= in a shocked voice).  她用震惊的语气向我叙述这个故事。

words.meaning: a.慷慨的,大方的;富足的;自由的,思想开放的
words.example:
Her parents were far more liberal than mine.  她父母比我父母开明得多。    Opposite illiberal or intolerantUK adjective
He was very liberal with the wine.  对于酒他毫不吝啬。UK adjective
He's a good old-fashioned liberal.  他是个老式的自由主义者。

words.meaning: a.大而重的,厚实的,粗大的;大规模的,大量的
words.example:
They've got a massive house.  他们有一座很大的房子。
She died after taking a massive overdose of drugs.  她在吸食过量毒品后死亡。
If the drought continues, deaths will occur on a massive scale.  如果旱情持续，将有大批人死亡。

words.meaning: n.工程师
words.example:
The engineer is coming to repair our phone tomorrow morning.  技工明天上午来修我们的电话。
Left-wing groups engineered a coup against the military government.  左翼集团密谋策划了一场反军政府的政变。
I'm trying to engineer a meeting between them.  我正在尽力谋划，好让他们见面。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.轮,车轮
words.example:
He lost control of his car when a front/rear wheel hit a stone as he approached the first bend.  在快到第一个转弯处时，他的汽车前／后轮碰到了一块石头，失去了控制。
My suitcase is on wheels so that makes life a little easier.  我的旅行箱装有轮子，所以用起来省力一些。
Do you think you could take the wheel (= drive) for a couple of hours?  你能不能来开几个小时车？

words.meaning: v.下降,衰落;拒绝 n.下降;斜面,倾斜,衰落
words.example:
His interest in the project declined after his wife died.  妻子死后，他对该企划案的兴趣逐渐淡薄了。
The party's popularity has declined in the opinion polls.  民意调查显示该党的支持率已经下滑。
formal The land declines sharply away from the house.  地势从房屋那边开始大幅度向下倾斜。verb

words.meaning: vt.投资,投入(精力、时间等)
words.example:
The institute will invest 5 million in the project.  该机构将在这个专案上投资500万。
He's not certain whether to invest in the property market.  他拿不定主意该不该投资房地产市场。
You have all invested significant amounts of time and energy in making this project the success that it is.  你们都为这个专案的成功投入了大量的时间和精力。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.电报;电缆;缆,索,钢丝绳 v.拍电报
words.example:
The road has been dug up in order to lay cables.  道路已被挖开，以便铺设电缆。
The office has gone over to cable.  办公室改用有线系统了。
This channel is only available on cable.  这个频道只有透过有线电视才能收到。

words.meaning: v.(to)使暴露,受到;使曝光
words.example:
The plaster on the walls has been removed to expose the original bricks underneath.  墙上的灰泥已经抹去，露出了里面的墙砖。
He damaged his leg so badly in the accident that the bone was exposed.  他的脚在车祸中受了重伤，骨头都露了出来。
This photograph was under-/over- exposed (= too little/too much light was allowed to reach the film).  这张照片曝光不足／过度。

words.meaning: a.乡下的,田园的,乡村风味的
words.example: The area is still very rural and undeveloped.  这个地区仍是一片乡村景象，没有被开发。    Compare urban

words.meaning: a.狭窄的,狭的,狭隘的
words.example:
The little village has very narrow streets.  小村子里的街道很窄。UK adjective
They are unable to see beyond the narrow world of the theatre.  他们看不到狭小的戏剧界以外的天地。
It was regarded as a very narrow interpretation of the law.  这被认为是对法律非常狭隘的诠释。

words.meaning: n.乳脂,(鲜)奶油;奶油色
words.example:
Do you like cream in your coffee?  你的咖啡要加鲜奶油吗？
Put some sun cream on to protect your face.  抹点防晒霜保护脸部。
The cream of this year's graduates have gone abroad for jobs.  今年的优秀毕业生都出国谋职去了。

words.meaning: n.秘书,书记;部长,大臣
words.example:
My secretary will phone you to arrange a meeting.  我的秘书会打电话给你安排会议。UK noun countable
The company secretary has written to all the shareholders to apologise for the mistake.  公司的文书已就这个错误向所有股东写信致歉了。

words.meaning: n.大门;入口;观众人数,门票收入
words.example:
The lift won't move if the safety gate isn't shut properly.  如果防护门没有关好，电梯不会开动。
All passengers for flight LH103 please proceed to gate 16.  搭乘 LH103号班机的乘客请前往16号登机口登机。noun countable
Gates at football matches were lower than average last season.  上个赛季观看足球比赛的人数低于平均水准。

words.meaning: a.固体的;结实的,稳固的,可靠的 n.固体
words.example:
The lecture hall was packed solid (with students).  演讲大厅里挤满了（学生）。
Liquid and solid waste is collected in the tank.  液体和固体废弃物集中在箱罐里。
Freeze the mixture for about 3 hours or so until solid.  把混合物冷冻三小时左右，直到其变成固体。

words.meaning: n.小山,山岗,高地;[pl.]丘陵(地带)
words.example:
Hills are not as high as mountains.  丘陵不像山脉那样高大。
Their house is on the top of a hill.  他们的房子在小山顶上。
In the summer, the shepherds move their sheep up into the hills (= an area where there are hills).  夏天，牧羊人把羊群赶到丘陵地带放牧。

words.meaning: n.喧闹声,噪声,吵嚷声
words.example:
The noise out in the street was deafening.  外面街道上的喧闹声震耳欲聋。
Using a single chip reduces (the) noise on the output signal by 90%.  使用单晶片可使对输出信号的干扰降低90%。noun
He made all the right noises about my audition but I couldn't tell if he was genuinely impressed.  他不停说我的试唱好，但我判断不出他是否真的这样觉得。noun

words.meaning: n.草,草地
words.example: Dan grassed on them to the local police.  丹向当地警方告发了他们。UK verb

words.meaning: ad.不幸地
words.example: Unfortunately, I didn't have my credit card with me or I'd certainly have bought it.  很不凑巧，我没带信用卡，否则我肯定早买了。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.帽子(一般指有边的帽子)
words.example:
This is me with my manager's hat on talking.  我这是以经理的身份在讲话。noun countable
Hats off to Connie for finding such a splendid venue for a party!  感谢康妮找到了这个理想的派对场地！noun countable
So Emma actually manages to juggle two small children and a full-time job, does she? Well, I take my hat off to her.  这么说艾玛在照顾好两个小孩子的同时还做着一份全职工作，是吗？我可真佩服她。noun countable

words.meaning: n.法律(规);立法,法律的制定(或通过)
words.example: New legislation protects workers.  新立法保护工人。

words.meaning: vi.成功;继承,接替 vt.接替;继…之后
words.example:
She's been trying to pass her driving test for six years and she's finally succeeded.  六年来，她一直努力想通过驾照考试，终于得偿所愿。
You need to be pretty tough to succeed in the property world.  要想在地产界出人头地，你必须要坚忍不拔。
The campaign has certainly succeeded in raising public awareness of the issue.  毫无疑问，这项活动成功唤起大众对这问题的关注。

words.meaning: vt.庆祝;颂扬,赞美vi.庆祝,过节
words.example:
We always celebrate our wedding anniversary by going out to dinner.  每年的结婚纪念日我们都出去吃饭庆祝。
If this plan works, we'll celebrate in style (= in a special way).  要是这个计划奏效，我们就隆重地庆贺一下。verb
His work celebrates the energy and enthusiasm of the young.  他的作品赞颂年轻人的活力和热情。verb

words.meaning: vt.控告,指责 vi.指控,指责
words.example:
He's been accused of robbery/murder.  他被指控犯有抢劫／谋杀罪。
Are you accusing me of lying ?  你是在指责我撒谎吗？
The surgeon was accused of negligence.  这名外科医生被控怠忽职守。

words.meaning: v.拒绝,抵制,丢弃,排斥,退掉 n.落选者
words.example:
The appeal was rejected by the High Court.  上诉被最高法院驳回。
Coin-operated machines in England reject Irish money.  英格兰的投币机不接受爱尔兰钱币。
The prime minister rejected the suggestion that it was time for him to resign.  首相拒绝了他该辞职的建议。

words.meaning: n.才能,天资;人才
words.example:
Her talent for music showed at an early age.  她小时候就表现出了音乐天赋。
His artistic talents were wasted in his boring job.  他的艺术天分被枯燥乏味的工作消磨殆尽。noun
There was plenty of talent at the party last night.  昨晚的派对上有许多佳丽。

words.meaning: v.品尝;(of)有…味道;体验 n.滋味;味觉
words.example:
Olives are perhaps an acquired taste (= you only like them after you have become familiar with their taste).  橄榄的味道可能要慢慢习惯才会喜欢。
Have a taste of the sauce and tell me if it needs salt.  尝尝酱汁，看看是否需要加盐。noun
I've never really cared much for flash new cars - old vintage cars are more to my taste (= what I like).  我一向不怎么喜欢豪华的新款车——倒是更喜欢老式汽车。

words.meaning: a.(of)特有的,独特的 n.特征,特性
words.example:
Unfortunately a big nose is a family characteristic.  不幸的是，大鼻子是家族特征。
Sentimentality seems a characteristic of all the writers of that period.  多愁善感似乎是那个时期所有作家的特征。
The male bird displays (= has) several characteristics which distinguish him from the female.  雄鸟有几个有别于雌鸟的特征。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.牛奶;(植物流出的)白色乳液 v.挤奶
words.example:
Breast/Mother's milk is the best nourishment for a baby.  母乳是婴儿最好的营养品。
She's full of the milk of human kindness.  她本性仁慈善良。verb
Milking a cow by hand is a skilled process.  挤牛奶是一项需要专门技术的工作。

words.meaning: n.逃跑,逃脱 v.逃跑;避开,避免
words.example:
Two prisoners have escaped.  两个犯人逃走了。
She was lucky to escape serious injury.  她真是万幸，逃过一劫，没有受重伤。
He narrowly (= only just) escaped a fine.  他差一点被罚款。

words.meaning: v.投,扔,掷,抛;铸造;投票;n.演员表
words.example:
He was often cast as the villain.  他经常演反面角色。
In her latest film she was cast against type (= played a different character than the one she usually played or might be expected to play).  在最近拍的电影中，她改变了戏路。
figurative They like to cast the opposing political party as (= to say that they are) the party of high taxes.  他们喜欢把敌对政党说成是征收高额税收的政党。

words.meaning: n.句子;判决,宣判 v.宣判,判决
words.example:
He's very impatient and always interrupts me mid-sentence.  他很不耐烦，总是在我说到一半的时候就打断我。
Your conclusion is good, but the final sentence is too long and complicated.  你的结论没错，但最后一句话太长太复杂。noun countable
He got a heavy/light sentence (= He was severely/not severely punished).  他被判以重刑／轻判。

words.meaning: a.不平常的,与众不同的
words.example: "Do you like the new settee?" "Very much, it's most unusual."  “你喜欢这新的沙发吗？”“非常喜欢，它太特别了。”

words.meaning: v.(of)使信服,使确信
words.example: He managed to convince the jury of his innocence.  他使陪审团相信他是无辜的。

words.meaning: n.高,高度;(常pl.)高地,高处
words.example:
The sheer height of New York's skyscrapers is so impressive.  纽约的摩天大楼光高度就气势非凡。
She's about average height (= neither short nor tall).  她大约中等个子。
The bullet entered the body at chest height.  子弹从胸部的高度进入身体

words.meaning: n.内科医生
words.example: She consulted her physician about the pain.  她就疼痛咨询了内科医生。

words.meaning: vt.(为征税)评估(财产、收入);征税;评价
words.example:
The insurers will need to assess the flood damage.  保险公司需要对洪水造成的损失进行评估。
They assessed the cost of the flood damage at £1500.  他们估计洪水造成的损失为1500英镑。
Examinations are not the only means of assessing a student's ability.  考试并不是评定学生能力的唯一手段。

words.meaning: n.丰富,大量
words.example:
Don't grab at the balloons, children - there are plenty for everyone.  孩子们，别抢气球——气球还很多，每人都有。
We've got plenty of time before we need to leave for the airport.  去机场前我们有的是时间。
They've always had plenty of money.  他们总是有很多钱。

words.meaning: n.加,加法;附加部分,增加(物)
words.example:
Twice a week the children are tested in basic mathematical skills such as addition (= calculating the total of different numbers put together) and subtraction.  孩子每周要参加两次加减法等基础数学能力的测试。
In addition to his flat in London, he has a villa in Italy and a castle in Scotland.  除了在伦敦拥有一层公寓外，他在义大利还有一座乡间别墅，在苏格兰有一座城堡。
humorous I hear you're expecting a small addition to the family (= you are going to have a baby) !  我听说你家里要添一名小成员了！

words.meaning: a.锋利的;轮廓分明的;急转的ad.(指时刻)正
words.example:
a knife with a sharp edge/blade.  刀刃锋利的刀子
The point of this pencil isn't sharp enough.  这支铅笔的头还不够尖。
She nudged me with a sharp elbow, to tell me to be quiet.  她狠狠地用手肘捅了我一下，要我安静点。

words.meaning: a.有创造力的,创造性的
words.example: Several leading creatives are involved in the advertising campaign.  好几位顶级创意人员参与策划了这次广告宣传运动。

words.meaning: a.较低的,下级的,下游的 v.降下,放低
words.example:
They lowered the coffin into the grave.  他们把棺材放入了墓穴。
He lowered his eyes (= looked down) in embarrassment when he saw me.  他看到我后尴尬地垂下了双眼。UK verb transitive
Interest rates have been lowered again.  利率又降了。

words.meaning: v.(of)赞成,赞许,同意;批准,审议,通过
words.example:
She doesn't approve of my friends.  她不喜欢我的朋友。
He doesn't approve of smoking.  他反对抽烟。
We had to wait months for the council to approve our plans to extend the house.  我们要等几个月，直到政务委员会批准我们扩建房屋的计划。

words.meaning: n.解释,说明
words.example:
Could you give me a quick explanation of how it works?  你可以向我简要说明一下它的运作原理吗？
What was her explanation for why she was late?  她是如何解释她迟到的原因的？
He said, by way of explanation, that he hadn't seen the traffic light change to red.  他解释说他没有看到红灯亮起。

words.meaning: a.快乐的,愉快的,色彩鲜艳的 n.同性恋
words.example:
Mark knew he was gay by the time he was fourteen.  马克到14岁时知道了自己是同性恋。
We had a gay old time down at the dance hall.  我们在下面舞厅玩得开心极了。
The streets were gay and full of people.  大街上色彩缤纷，熙熙攘攘。adjective

words.meaning: n.(大学)校园
words.example: There's accommodation for about five hundred students on campus.  校园内可供约500名学生食宿。

words.meaning: a.适合的;合乎体统的;固有的;有礼貌的
words.example:
This is Sara's first proper job - she usually does temporary work just for the money.  这是莎拉的第一份正式工作——她通常只是为了赚钱而打零工。
If you're going to walk those sort of distances you need proper walking boots.  如果你要走那么远的路，就需要一双合脚的健步鞋。
I've had sandwiches but I haven't eaten a proper meal.  我吃了三明治，但还没有好好吃一顿饭。

words.meaning: a.(of)有罪的,内疚的
words.example:
She must have done something wrong, because she's looking so guilty.  她一定是做错甚么事了，因为她一脸愧疚。
You've got a guilty conscience - that's why you can't sleep.  你问心有愧——所以会睡不着觉。UK adjective
The jury has to decide whether a person is guilty or innocent of a crime.  陪审团必须就一个人是否有罪作出裁决。

words.meaning: v.获得;学到(知识等);养成(习惯)
words.example:
He acquired the firm in 1978.  他于1978年收购了这家公司。
During this period he acquired a reputation for being a womanizer.  这期间他得了个玩弄女性的名声。UK verb transitive
Olives are an acquired taste.  橄榄这种东西吃得多就爱吃了。

words.meaning: vi.比赛;竞争;对抗
words.example:
It's difficult for a small supermarket to compete against/with the big supermarkets.  小超市很难与大超市竞争。
Both girls compete for their father's attention.  两个女孩在父亲面前争宠。
figurative Turn the music down - I'm not competing against/with that noise (= I can't/won't try to speak louder than that music) !  把音乐调小声一点——我可不想跟那噪音较量！

words.meaning: a.技术(性)的,工艺的;专门性的,专业性的
words.example:
Personally, I found some parts of the book a little too technical to follow.  我个人认为，书中有些部分过于专业化，一般人不易看懂。
In her performance as the Snow Queen she showed great technical brilliance.  她演冰雪女王时表现出了高超的演技。

words.meaning: prep.加上 a.正的,加的 n.加号,正号
words.example:
What is six plus four?  6加4等于几？
The rent will be £75 a week, plus (= added to the cost of) gas and electricity.  加上煤气和电费，每周租金为75英镑。preposition conjunction
There will be two adults travelling, plus three children.  旅行时将有两个大人，外加三个小孩。

words.meaning: a.(从国外)移来的,移民的 n.移民,侨民
words.example: Illegal immigrants are sent back across the border if they are caught.  非法移民如果被抓住就会从边境被遣返。

words.meaning: a.虚弱的,软弱的;不够标准的;淡薄的,稀的
words.example:
It's not surprising you feel weak if you haven't eaten properly for days.  如果你好几天都吃得不好的话，觉得虚弱无力是不足为奇的。
The electromagnetic field strength becomes weaker as you move further away from high voltage cables.  当你远离高压线时，电磁场强度就会变弱。
He was a weak king surrounded by corrupt advisers.  他是个软弱无能的国王，身边都是些腐败的顾问。

words.meaning: a.不合法的,非法的
words.example:
Prostitution is illegal in some countries.  卖淫在某些国家是不合法的。
It is illegal to drive a car that is not taxed and insured.  驾驶未上税、未上保险的汽车是违法的。
Cocaine, LSD and heroin are all illegal drugs/substances.  古柯碱、迷幻药和海洛因都是非法毒品。

words.meaning: interj.(hey)嗨!喂!
words.example:
Hi, there!  喂，那里的
Hi, how're you doing?  嗨，你好吗？

words.meaning: n.二选一;供选择的东西;取舍 a.二选一的
words.example:
There must be an alternative to people sleeping on the streets.  一定要想办法解决街头露宿者的问题。
I'm afraid I have no alternative but to ask you to leave (= that is what I have to do).  恐怕我别无选择，只有让你离开。UK adjective
The opposition parties have so far failed to set out an alternative strategy.  反对党到目前为止还没有提出其他的策略。

words.meaning: n.圆柱,柱状物;列;(报刊中的)专栏
words.example:
She writes a weekly fashion/gossip column for the Evening Standard.  她每周都在《旗帜晚报》的时尚／漫谈专栏中发表文章。
Add the column of figures and divide the sum by three.  把这列数字相加，再将总数除以3。UK noun countable
The roof of the temple was held up by a row of thick stone columns.  这座寺庙的屋顶由一排粗大的石柱支撑着。

words.meaning: n.人格,个性
words.example:
She has a very warm personality.  她个性非常热情。
He is well qualified for the job, but he does lack personality (= he is a boring person).  他非常胜任这份工作，但他确实缺乏个性。UK noun
The show is hosted by a popular TV personality.  该节目由一位广受欢迎的电视名人主持。

words.meaning: n.信号,暗号 v.发信号,用信号通知
words.example:
When she gave (them) the signal, they all cheered.  她发出信号后，他们都欢呼起来。
The signal for a race to start is often the firing of a gun.  赛跑常以发令枪响作为开始的信号。
The poor result is a clear signal of his deteriorating confidence.  糟糕的结果清楚地显示他信心日渐不足。

words.meaning: n.(pl.curricula)课程,(学校等的)全部课程
words.example: the school curriculum  学校课程

words.meaning: n.(honour)尊敬,敬意;荣誉,光荣 v.尊敬
words.example: It's an honor to meet you.  很荣幸见到您。

words.meaning: n.乘客,旅客
words.example: The two passenger trains involved in the accident had both come from south-west London.  这次意外中的两列客运火车都是从伦敦西南部开出的。

words.meaning: n.协作; 援助; 帮助
words.example:
The company needs more financial assistance from the Government.  这间公司需要政府提供更多的财政援助。
Can I be of any assistance, madam (= Can I help) ?  小姐，我可以帮上甚么忙吗？
Teachers can't give pupils any assistance in exams.  考试中老师不能以任何形式帮助学生。

words.meaning: adv.(for ever)永远;总是
words.example:
She's forever telling him she's going to leave him but she never actually does.  她老是跟他说要离开他，但实际上从未那样做过。
We'd better walk a bit quicker - it's going to take forever if we go at this pace.  我们最好走快一点——如果以这个速度走下去，我们要走很久。

words.meaning: v.(as)把…看作为;考虑n.(pl.)敬重,问候
words.example:
Local people regard this idea of a motorway through their village with horror.  当地居民对修建横穿他们村庄的高速公路这一计划感到惶惶不可终日。
Her parents always regarded her as the cleverest of their children.  她父母一贯把她看作是所有子女中最聪明的。
The bird regarded me with suspicion as I walked up to its nest.  我走向鸟巢的时候，那只鸟怀疑地注视着我。

words.meaning: n.联盟,协会,社团;交往,联合;联想
words.example:
The British Medical Association is/are campaigning for a complete ban on tobacco advertising.  英国医学协会正发起一项全面禁止烟草广告的运动。UK noun
This event was organized in association with the Sports Council.  这场赛事由体育委员会协办。
The south of France has positive associations for me as I used to holiday there as a child.  法国南部总能给我一种美好的联想，因为我童年时代常去那里渡假。

words.meaning: num.二十 pron./a.二十(个,只...)
words.example: space for twenty people  可容纳20个人的空间

words.meaning: v.敲,敲打,碰撞 n.敲,击
words.example:
She knocked on the window to attract his attention.  她敲窗想引起他的注意。
There's someone knocking on/at the door.  有人在敲门。
Please knock before entering.  进来前请先敲门。

words.meaning: v.裹,缠,卷,包 n.披肩,围巾
words.example:
She wrapped the present and tied it with ribbon.  她把礼物包起来，并用丝带扎紧。
Wrap the chicken in foil and cook it for two hours.  用锡纸将鸡肉包起来，加热两个小时。
She wrapped the baby in a blanket.  她用一块毯子把婴儿包起来。

words.meaning: n.(laboratory)实验室
words.example: a science lab  科学实验室

words.meaning: v./n.陈列,展览,显示(器)
words.example:
Family photographs were displayed on the wall.  墙上挂着全家人的照片。verb transitive
The British traditionally tend not to display much emotion in public.  传统上，英国人不太喜欢在公开场合表露感情。noun
There's an Egyptian art collection on display (= being shown) at the museum at the moment.  埃及艺术收藏展正在博物馆举行。

words.meaning: n.评论性的文章,评论;批评,指责,非难
words.example:
The designs for the new mosque have attracted widespread criticism.  人们普遍对新清真寺的设计不满意。
If you've got any constructive (= positive) criticism of the project, I'd be glad to hear it.  如果你对这个方案有甚么建设性的意见，我很乐意听一听。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)资产,财产;有价值的物品;天赋
words.example:
He'll be a great asset to the team.  他将会成为球队的得力主将。
Her eyes are her best asset (= most attractive feature).  她的眼睛是她最迷人的地方。
Knowledge of languages is a real asset in this sort of work.  做这项工作，通晓数种语言确实是一种优势。

words.meaning: a.精神(上)的,心灵的
words.example: Traditional ways of life fulfilled both economic and spiritual needs.  传统的生活方式满足了经济和精神的双重需求。noun countable (also negro spiritual)

words.meaning: a.音乐的;有音乐才能的 n.音乐片
words.example:
Mozart's musical compositions include symphonies and operas.  莫劄特的音乐创作包括交响乐和歌剧。
The family all play instruments - they're all very musical.  这家人都会演奏乐器——他们都很喜欢音乐。noun countable

words.meaning: n.记者,新闻工作者
words.example: a freelance political journalist  政论文章自由撰稿人

words.meaning: n.祈祷,祷告,祷文
words.example:
She always says her prayers (= prays) before she goes to sleep.  她睡前总要念祷文。
We thought he'd been killed, but our prayers were answered when he arrived home unexpectedly.  我们以为他已经死了，但我们的祷告实现了，他出人意料地回家了。
The prisoners find their only solace in prayer.  犯人们从祈祷中寻求仅有的慰藉。UK noun

words.meaning: v.猜想;怀疑;察觉 a.可疑的 n.嫌疑犯
words.example:
So far, the police do not suspect foul play.  目前，员警没有怀疑是谋杀案件。
No one knows who killed her, but the police suspect her husband.  没有人知道谁杀了她，但是警方认为她丈夫有嫌疑。
The police suspect him of carrying out two bomb attacks.  警方怀疑他发动两宗爆炸案。

words.meaning: n.学者
words.example:
Dr Miles was a distinguished scholar of Russian history.  迈尔斯博士是一位研究俄国历史的著名学者。
David's never been much of a scholar.  戴维从来不是一个善于学习的人。

words.meaning: n.气候;风气,社会思潮
words.example:
The Mediterranean climate is good for growing citrus fruits and grapes.  地中海气候适宜柑橘属水果和葡萄的生长。
When we retire, we're going to move to a warmer climate.  我们打算退休后搬到气候比较暖和的地方去。noun
Terrorism creates a climate of fear.  恐怖主义制造了一种恐惧气氛。

words.meaning: n.干酪,乳酪
words.example:
Would you like a slice/piece of cheese with your bread?  你想要块起司配面包吃吗？
You need 250g of grated cheese for this recipe.  按照这张食谱，你需要250克磨碎的起司。
So he's fed up because he's got to get up early one morning in seven, is he? Well hard cheese!  “因为那天早上七点就要起床，他烦透了，是不是？”“嗯，真倒楣！”noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.观察,观测,监视;(pl.)观察资料;观察力
words.example:
The police are keeping the suspect under observation.  警方监视着犯罪嫌疑人。
She was admitted to hospital for observation (= so that doctors could watch her and see if anything was wrong with her).  她被收治入院接受观察。UK noun
She has remarkable powers of observation (= is very good at noticing things).  她具有非凡的观察力。

words.meaning: n.幼年,童年
words.example:
She had an unhappy childhood.  她的童年很不幸。
Childhood is not always a happy time.  童年并不总是快乐的时光。    Compare boyhood ; girlhood

words.meaning: n.支付,付款额
words.example:
Usually we ask for payment on receipt of the goods.  我们通常要求对方货到付款。
We need a deposit of £165 followed by twelve monthly payments of £60.  你需要先付165英镑的订金，之后12个月内每月支付60英镑。
When is the first payment due ?  第一期付款甚么时候到期？

words.meaning: n.先生,长官;[S -用于姓名前]…爵士
words.example:
Would you like to see the menu, sir?  您要看看菜单吗，先生?
I'm not going to ride the subway, no sir!  我不会去乘地铁，绝对不会！

words.meaning: v.许可,允许 n.许可证,执照
words.example:
The regulations do not permit much flexibility.  这些规章不允许有太大的弹性空间。
As it was such a special occasion, she permitted herself a small glass of champagne.  鉴于场合特殊，她破例喝了一小杯香槟。
formal The law permits of no other interpretation.  法律不容许有其他解释。

words.meaning: n.定义,解释;(轮廓影像等的)清晰度;阐明;
words.example:
What is the definition of 'mood'?  生字 mood 的定义是甚么？
The legal definition of what is and what is not pornography is very unsatisfactory.  法律对甚么是色情、甚么不是色情的解释很难令人满意。
Psychology is by definition an inexact science.  从本质上来说，心理学不是一门精确的科学。noun

words.meaning: n.先,前;优先,重点,优先权
words.example:
The management did not seem to consider office safety to be a priority.  管理部门似乎并不认为应该优先考虑办公室安全问题。
My first/top priority is to find somewhere to live.  我首先要考虑的是找个地方住。
You have to learn to get your priorities right/straight (= decide which are the most important jobs or problems and deal with them first).  你必须学会先处理最重要的事。

words.meaning: n.面包
words.example:
This bread is fresh/stale.  这面包是新鲜的／变味了。
Do you bake your own bread?  你自己烤面包吗？noun uncountable
He earns his daily bread as a tourist guide.  他靠做导游谋生。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.大学毕业生,研究生 v.大学毕业a.毕了业的
words.example:
Chris is a physics graduate.  克里斯是物理专业的毕业生。
Lorna graduated from the University of London.  洛娜毕业于伦敦大学。
Tom has just graduated with first-class honours in psychology.  汤姆刚刚大学毕业，获得心理学一级荣誉学位。

words.meaning: v./n.请求,要求
words.example:
They received hundreds of requests for more information.  数以百计的人要求他们提供更多的资讯。
The clause was added to the contract at Carlos's request (= because Carlos asked for this).  这一条款是在卡洛斯的要求下添加到合同中的。
An application form will be sent to you on request (= if you ask).  申请表格承索即寄。    Compare order

words.meaning: n.情绪,情感,感情
words.example:
Like a lot of men, he finds it hard to express his emotions.  像很多男人一样，他不大会表达自己的感情。
My mother was overcome with emotion and burst into tears.  我母亲控制不住自己的感情，泪如雨下。

words.meaning: v./n.尖声叫,喊叫着说出,(风)呼啸
words.example:
Through the smoke, the rescuers could hear people screaming for help.  透过烟雾，救援者可以听见人们在喊救命。
He was screaming in/with pain and begging for anaesthetic.  他痛得直叫，哀求用麻醉药。
They screamed with laughter at her jokes.  听了她的笑话，他们大笑了起来。

words.meaning: a.戏剧的,戏剧性的;剧烈的
words.example:
We watched scenes of the dramatic (= exciting) rescue on the news.  我们在新闻中看到了惊心动魄的救援场面。UK adjective
She bought me the complete dramatic works (= texts to be performed) of Brecht for my birthday.  她买了全套的布莱希特戏剧集送给我作生日礼物。

words.meaning: n.宇宙,万物
words.example:
Is there intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?  宇宙中其他地方存在有智慧的生命吗？
Scientists have speculated about the possibility of parallel universes.  有科学家思考过平行世界存在的可能性。
The characters in his novels inhabit a bleak and hopeless universe.  他小说中的人物生活在一个悲凄无望的世界里。

words.meaning: n.缺口;差距;空白;缺乏
words.example:
The children squeezed through a gap in the wall.  孩子们从墙的一个缺口处硬挤了过去。
She has a small gap between her front teeth.  她的门牙之间有条细缝。
There is a gap in the magazine market that needs to be filled.  在杂志市场上还有一个缺口需要填补。noun

words.meaning: a.卓越的,极好的
words.example:
The food was excellent.  这食物非常美味。
Her car is in excellent condition.  她的汽车车况非常好。
The fall in interest rates is excellent news for borrowers.  对于借贷人来讲，利率降低是个好消息。

words.meaning: a.幸运的,侥幸的
words.example:
The lucky winner will be able to choose from three different holidays.  幸运的获胜者可以从三种不同的假日方案中选择一种。
He's lucky that he wasn't fired.  他很幸运，没有被解雇。
It sounds as if you had a lucky escape (= by good chance you were able to avoid something dangerous or unpleasant).  听起来好像你是侥幸逃脱啊。

words.meaning: v.拖,拖曳
words.example:
Pick the chair up instead of dragging it behind you!  把椅子拿起来，不要在地上拖！
She dragged the canoe down to the water.  她把独木舟拉到水边。
She had to drag her child away from the toy shop.  她不得不把孩子从玩具店硬拉出来。

words.meaning: n.(飞机)航线 a.(飞机)航线的
words.example: What airline did you fly?  你乘坐哪家航空公司的飞机？

words.meaning: n.图书馆;藏书室;藏书,丛书,文库
words.example: a public/university library  公共／大学图书馆

words.meaning: n.议事日程,记事册
words.example:
There were several important items on the agenda.  会议议程中有几项重要的议题。
The question of security is high on the agenda for this afternoon's meeting.  今天下午的议程中，安全问题是首要议题。
Women's rights have been put back on the agenda (= are being discussed publicly again).  妇女权益的问题再次得到广泛关注。

words.meaning: v.收回;(from)恢复,痊愈;重新获得
words.example:
It took her a long while to recover (= become completely well again) from/after her heart operation.  她心脏动手术后很长时间身体才复原。
He never really recovered from the shock of his wife dying (= He was never happy after his wife died).  他再也没有从丧妻之痛中真正恢复过来。
She went into a coma and died without recovering consciousness.  她陷入昏迷后再也没有醒过来。

words.meaning: n.工厂
words.example: a car/shoe/textile factory  汽车／制鞋／纺织厂

words.meaning: n.选择,挑选;选集,精选物
words.example:
Success is achieved by the careful selection of projects.  成功是靠仔细慎选计划而取得的。
The coach made her selection (= chose who she wanted) for the team.  教练为球队挑选了她的意中人选。
Most schools would have a good selection of these books in their libraries.  大多数学校的图书馆都有许多这样的书供选择。

words.meaning: n.屋顶,顶
words.example:
The house has a sloping/flat/tiled/thatched/etc. roof.  这间房子是斜顶／平顶／瓦顶／茅草等屋顶。
Put the luggage on the roof of the car.  把行李放在车顶上。
The roof (= upper surface) of the cave is 50 metres up.  洞顶距地面有50米高。

words.meaning: n.花费,消费,消耗
words.example:
Buying a bigger car has proved to be well worth the expense.  事实证明，买辆大一点的车还是值得的。
We've just had a new garage built at great expense.  我们刚用了很多钱盖一座新车库。
We went on holiday at my father's expense (= he paid for it).  我们去度了假，一切费用由我父亲支付。

words.meaning: a.创始的,起始的 n.第一步,创始,主动精神
words.example:
The peace initiative was welcomed by both sides.  和平倡议受到了双方的欢迎。UK noun
Although she was quite young, she showed a lot of initiative and was promoted to manager after a year.  她虽然很年轻，但工作积极主动，一年后就获提拔为经理。

words.meaning: n.饮食,食物
words.example:
Diet varies between different countries in the world.  世界各国的饮食各不相同。
Rice is the staple diet (= most important food) of many people in China.  在中国大米是很多人的主食。
The children seem to exist on a diet of burgers and chips.  孩子们好像离不开汉堡包和炸薯条。

words.meaning: n.逮捕,扣留 vt.逮捕,扣留;阻止;吸引
words.example:
He was arrested when customs officers found drugs in his bag.  海关人员在他的手提包里发现了毒品，把他拘捕了。
The police arrested her for drinking and driving.  她因酒后驾车被警方拘捕。verb transitive
The treatment has so far done little to arrest the spread of the cancer.  这种疗法到目前为止几乎没有抑制癌细胞的扩散。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.治疗,(不需要药物或手术的)物理疗法
words.example: Joining a club can be a therapy for loneliness.  加入俱乐部可能是消解孤独的一种方法。

words.meaning: n.洗;洗的衣物 vt.冲刷,洗;冲出 vi.洗澡
words.example:
These sheets need washing.  这些床单需要洗洗。
I'll wash the bottle out (= clean its inside) and use it again.  我要把瓶子洗干净再用。
I'd like to wash before dinner.  吃饭前我要洗洗手。

words.meaning: n.时间表,进度表 v.安排,预定
words.example:
Everything went according to schedule (= as planned).  一切按照排程进行。
We expect the building work to be completed ahead of schedule.  我们希望建筑工程能提前竣工。
The meeting has been scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.  会议安排在明天下午。

words.meaning: a.悲哀的,忧愁的
words.example:
I've just received some very sad news.  我刚刚得到一些令人伤心的消息。
She gave a rather sad smile.  她露出一丝苦笑。
I'm so sad (that) you can't come.  你不能来，我很遗憾。

words.meaning: a.简短的,简洁的 v.简短介绍,简要汇报
words.example:
His acceptance speech was mercifully brief.  幸而他的提名演讲很简短。
It'll only be a brief visit because we really haven't much time.  我们的时间真的不多，所以只能作短暂的参观游览。
After a brief spell/stint in the army, he started working as a teacher.  在军队呆了短暂的一段时间以后，他当起了教师。

words.meaning: n.住房,住房供给;(外、阀)壳,防护罩
words.example: There's a shortage of cheap housing in the region.  这地区缺乏廉价住宅。

words.meaning: v.贴出;公告;投寄 n.(支)柱;邮政,邮寄;职位
words.example:
I'd been away for a few days so I had a lot of post waiting for me.  我离开了几天，所以有好多邮件等着我处理。
Unless it's marked 'private', my secretary usually opens my post.  除非写有“亲启”，否则通常由我的秘书来拆我的邮件。
Has the post come/arrived yet?  邮件到了吗？

words.meaning: v.买,购买 n.购买的物品
words.example:
Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.  门票必须提前两周购买。
Except under clearly defined circumstances, it is illegal in Britain for a company to purchase its own shares.  在英国，除非是在明确规定的情况下，否则一间公司购买自己的股票是违法的。
She purchased her first house with the money.  她用这笔钱买了她的第一栋房子。UK US  formal

words.meaning: n.钢
words.example: steel girders/rods/struts  钢梁／条／柱

words.meaning: prep.关于,有关
words.example: Regarding your question, here is the answer.  关于你的问题，答案如下。

words.meaning: v.大声叫,喊,呼出 n.呼喊,叫
words.example:
There's no need to shout, I can hear perfectly well.  没有必要大声喊叫，我完全听得见。
Dad really shouted at me when I broke the window.  我打碎了窗户后，父亲对着我大吼大叫。
He shouted abuse at the judge after being sentenced to five years imprisonment.  被宣判五年监禁之后，他大声辱骂法官。

words.meaning: ad.公正地,正当地;相当,还算
words.example:
She's fairly tall.  她个子比较高。
I'm fairly sure that this is the right address.  我相当肯定这个地址没错。
We get on fairly well.  我们相处得不错。

words.meaning: n.切屑,碎片;(土豆等的)薄片;集成电路块
words.example:
Polly fell and knocked a chip out of her front tooth.  波莉摔了一跤，磕掉了一小块门牙。
This mug's got a chip in it/ out of it.  这个马克杯上有个缺口。noun
figurative The hostages are being held as a bargaining chip by terrorist organizations.  恐怖组织扣押了人质作为讨价还价的筹码。noun

words.meaning: a.寂静,沉默的
words.example:
The empty house was completely silent.  那栋空房子一片寂静。
literary It was four o'clock in the morning and London was as silent as the grave (= completely silent).  凌晨四点，伦敦如坟墓一样沉寂，十分安静。adjective
She whispered a silent prayer that her wounded brother would not die.  她默默地祷告，希望她受伤的兄弟不会死去。

words.meaning: v.料想,猜想;假定;conj.假使...结果会怎样
words.example:
He found it a lot more difficult to get a job than he supposed it would be.  他发现找工作比他想像的要难多了。
It is widely supposed (that) the minister will be forced to resign.  很多人都猜测首相会被迫辞职。
Her new book is supposed to be (= generally people think it is) very good.  大多数人都认为她的新书写得很好。

words.meaning: n.自我,自己(pl.selves)
words.example:
The hero of the film finally finds his true self.  电影的主角最后找到了真正的自我。
When I saw them this afternoon they were more like their old/normal selves (= as they were in the past).  我今天下午见到他们的时候，他们更像是平时的老样子了。
Her reply was typical of her constant regard for self.  她的答覆明显说明她一向只顾私利。noun

words.meaning: n.茶(叶);午后茶点
words.example:
I'd love a cup of tea, please.  请给我来一杯茶。
Tea and biscuits will be provided at 11 o'clock.  11点会提供茶点。
How do you like your tea - strong or weak ?  你喜欢喝甚么样的茶——浓的还是淡的？

words.meaning: v.察觉,感知;理解,领悟
words.example:
How do the French perceive the British?  法国人是如何看待英国人的？
Women's magazines are often perceived to be superficial.  人们往往认为女性杂志内容肤浅。UK verb transitive
Bill perceived a tiny figure in the distance.  比尔注意到远处有个很小的身影。

words.meaning: n.比较,对比,比喻,比拟
words.example:
They made a comparison of different countries' eating habits.  他们对不同国家的饮食习惯作了一番比较。
By/In comparison with the French, the British eat far less fish.  与法国人相比，英国人吃鱼要少得多。UK noun countable or uncountable
She drew a comparison between life in the army and life in prison.  她把军队生活和狱中生活作了比较。

words.meaning: n.解决,决定,调停;居留区,住宅区
words.example:
It now seems unlikely that it will be possible to negotiate/reach a peaceful settlement of the conflict.  现在看来和平解决这一冲突是不可能的。
As part of their divorce settlement, Geoff agreed to let Polly keep the house.  作为离婚协议的一部分，杰夫同意房子归波莉所有。
They reached an out-of-court settlement.  他们达成了庭外和解。

words.meaning: n.层,层次;铺设者
words.example:
There was a thin layer of oil on the surface of the water.  水面上有一层薄薄的油膜。
We stripped several layers of paint off the door.  我们从门上剥落了好几层漆。UK verb transitive
Layer the pasta with slices of tomato.  把番茄片分层摆放在义大利粉里。

words.meaning: n.描写,形容;种类
words.example:
Write a description of your favourite seaside resort.  描述一下你最喜欢的海滨胜地。
She has given the police a very detailed/full description of the robber.  她向员警详细描述了抢劫者的相貌。
Your essay contains too much description, and not enough discussion of the issues.  你的文章描述性内容太多，而对问题的讨论不足。

words.meaning: v.(使)滑动 n.滑坡,滑道;滑,滑动;幻灯片
words.example:
When I was little I used to like sliding on the polished floor in my socks.  小时候我喜欢穿着短袜在光亮的地板上滑行。
We've got one of those doors in the kitchen that slides open.  我们厨房的门中有一扇装的是那种滑动开关的。
He slid the letter into his pocket while no one was looking.  趁没人看见，他把信塞进了口袋。

words.meaning: n.婚礼
words.example:
Do you know the date of Caroline and Matthew's wedding?  你知道卡罗琳和马修的婚礼哪天举行吗？
It was their twenty-fifth wedding anniversary last week.  上周是他们结婚25周年纪念。

words.meaning: v.(of,about)通知,告诉,报告;告发,告密
words.example:
The name of the dead man will not be released until his relatives have been informed.  在通知死者亲属之前，不会公布死者的姓名。
Why wasn't I informed about this earlier?  为甚么不早点将这件事通知我？
Walters was not properly informed of the reasons for her arrest.  沃尔特斯并未按规定被告知其被捕的原因。

words.meaning: n.一部分,一份
words.example:
The portions are very generous in this restaurant.  这家餐厅每道菜量都很足。verb UK   Phrasal Verbs   [M] portion sth out
We'll have to portion the money out among/between the six of us.  我们得把这些钱在我们六个人中分。

words.meaning: n.领土;版图;领域,范围
words.example:
He was shot down in enemy territory.  他在敌方领土上被击落。
The UN is sending aid to the occupied territories.  联合国正在向被占领地区提供援助。
The robin keeps other birds off that part of the garden - that's his territory.  这只知更鸟不许其他鸟进入花园的那块地方，那是它的领地。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.立即的,即时的;直接的,最接近的
words.example:
We must make an immediate response.  我们必须立即作出反应。
Dioxin is a poison that takes immediate effect.  二恶英是一种速效毒药。
There are few facilities in the immediate area.  在邻近地区几乎没有甚么设施。

words.meaning: n.对手,反对者,敌手 a.对立的,对抗的
words.example:
Leading opponents of the proposed cuts in defence spending will meet later today.  反对削减国防开支建议的带头人将在今天晚些时候会面。
In the second game, her opponent hurt her leg and had to retire.  在第二局，她的对手拉伤了腿，不得不退出比赛。

words.meaning: vt.离弃,丢弃;遗弃,抛弃;放弃
words.example:
We had to abandon the car.  我们不得不弃车而去。
By the time the rebel troops arrived, the village had already been abandoned.  当叛军杀到时，村民已经撤离了村庄。
As a baby he'd been abandoned by his mother.  他在繦褓之中就被母亲遗弃了。

words.meaning: n.湖泊,湖水
words.example:
We used to go boating on that lake.  我们过去常去那个湖里划船。
Overproduction caused butter mountains and wine lakes.  生产过剩导致奶油堆积如山、葡萄酒汇流成河。

words.meaning: vt.改变,变换;变压;转化;改造,改造
words.example: The reorganization will transform the British entertainment industry.  这次重组将使英国的娱乐业大为改观。

words.meaning: n.(紧张)状态;拉(绷)紧;张力,拉力
words.example:
You could feel the tension in the room as we waited for our exam results.  我们等待考试结果出来的时候，你可以感觉到屋里的紧张气氛。
There are growing tensions betweeen the two countries.  两国间的关系日益紧张。noun

words.meaning: a.领导的,指导的;第一位的;最主要的
words.example: a leading expert on the country's ecology  研究该国生态的顶级专家

words.meaning: vt.打扰,麻烦 vi.担心,烦恼 n.烦恼,焦急
words.example:
You could have phoned us but you just didn't bother.  你本可以给我们打电话的，可你就是懒得打。
You won't get any credit for doing it, so why bother?  你做这件事不会受到任何赞扬的，为甚么还要做呢？
Most evenings I can't be bothered cooking.  大多数晚上我都懒得做饭。UK verb

words.meaning: v.(in)在于,存在于;(of)由…组成,由…构成
words.example:
The beauty of air travel consists in its speed and ease.  乘飞机旅行的好处在于快捷、舒适。
The team consists of four Europeans and two Americans.  该队由四个欧洲人和两个美国人组成。
It's a simple dish to prepare, consisting mainly of rice and vegetables.  这道菜很容易做，主料是米饭和蔬菜。

words.meaning: n.酒精,乙醇;含酒精的饮料
words.example: Most wines contain between 10% and 15% alcohol.  大多数的葡萄酒酒精含量都在10%到15%之间。

words.meaning: v.使能够,使成为可能;授予权利或方法
words.example: The app enables offline reading.  这个应用支持离线阅读。

words.meaning: v.(使)弯曲;屈从,屈服 n.弯曲(处),曲折处
words.example:
Now, bend forward/over and touch your toes!  现在，向前弯腰触摸脚趾。
Make sure you bend your knees when you're picking up heavy objects.  提重物时一定要屈膝。
The road bends to the left after the first set of traffic lights.  过了第一个交通灯号后，道路弯向左侧。

words.meaning: n.挽救,救助,节约,储蓄;(pl.)储蓄金,存款
words.example:
He spent all his savings on an expensive car.  他花了自己所有的存款买了一辆昂贵的汽车。
You can make huge savings (= save a lot of money) by buying food in bulk.  大量购买食品会省下很多钱。

words.meaning: n.沙漠,不毛之地 v.抛弃,遗弃;擅离,开小差
words.example:
They were lost in the desert for nine days.  他们在沙漠里迷路已经有9天了。
We had to cross a large area of arid, featureless desert.  我们必须穿越一大片干燥荒芜的沙漠。
This town is a cultural/intellectual desert.  这个城镇是一片文化沙漠。verb UK RUN AWAY  跑掉

words.meaning: aux.v.(我,我们)将要,会;必须,应该
words.example:
If you do that one more time, I shall be very cross.  如果你再那么做，我就要生气了。
Shall we be able to get this finished today, do you think?  你认为我们今天能完成这项工作吗？
I'm afraid I shall not/shan't be able to come to your party.  恐怕我不能参加你的派对了。

words.meaning: n.错误,过失
words.example:
He admitted that he'd made an error.  他承认犯了一个错误。
The letter contains a number of typing errors.  信中有一些打字错误。
Human error has been blamed for the air crash.  飞机坠毁被归咎于人为失误。

words.meaning: n.警察(slang 俚语)
words.example:
Quick, run - there's a cop coming!  快跑——员警来了！UK noun
His last book wasn't much cop.  他上一本书不怎么样。UK noun
He was copped for driving without a licence last week.  上星期他因无牌驾驶被拘捕。UK verb transitive (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.沙;(pl.)沙滩,沙地
words.example:
The children played all day in/on the sand.  孩子们玩了一整天沙子。
Mix one part sand to three parts cement.  将一份沙和三份水泥混合。
Sand the door (down) thoroughly before starting to paint.  粉刷之前要把门用砂纸彻底磨光。

words.meaning: n.印刷,印刷品,字体 v.印刷,出版;洗印
words.example:
The title is in bold print.  标题是粗体字。
This novel is available in large print for readers with poor eyesight.  这本小说有大字本，以满足视力差的读者的需要。
The book was rushed into print (= was produced and published) as quickly as possible.  这本书很快就印了出来。

words.meaning: v.保护,维持;保存,保藏
words.example:
We want to preserve the character of the town while improving the facilities.  我们想在改善市镇设施的同时保存其特色。
The agreement preserved our right to limit trade in endangered species.  这项协定保留了我们限制濒危物种贸易的权利。
Putting varnish on wood is a way of preserving it.  在木料上涂清漆是保护木料的一种方法。

words.meaning: n.通过,经过;通路,走廊;(一)段落,(一)节
words.example:
The bathroom's on the right at the end of the passage.  浴室在走廊尽头的右边。
Several passages from the book were printed in a national newspaper before it was published.  该书出版前，书中有几段文字被刊载在一份全国性的报纸上。noun
The gunman then took a hostage and demanded a plane and safe passage to an unspecified destination.  持枪歹徒随后劫持了一名人质，要求派飞机把他安全送到某个未指明的目的地。

words.meaning: a.正式的;形式的
words.example: Tom had little in the way of a formal education.  汤姆没怎么受过正规教育。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.转变,变迁,过渡(时期)
words.example:
The health-care system is in transition at the moment.  医疗保健制度目前正在变革。
There will be an interim government to oversee the transition to democracy.  将会有一个临时政府来进行监督过度到民主政治的过程。

words.meaning: n.存在,实在;生存,生活(方式)
words.example:
Many people question the existence of God.  很多人怀疑上帝是否真的存在。
Modern cosmology believes the Universe to have come into existence about fifteen billion years ago.  现代宇宙论认为，宇宙大约在150亿年前就已经形成了。
The theatre company that they started is still in existence today.  他们创办的剧团直到今日仍在演出。

words.meaning: n.(同一表演者的)集锦密纹唱片;集邮册,相册
words.example:
Have you heard their new album?  你听过他们的新专辑吗？noun countable
We've put the best wedding photos into an album.  我们已经把婚礼上拍得最好的照片放进了相册。

words.meaning: v.安排,筹划;整理,使有条理,排列,布置
words.example:
I'm trying to arrange my work so that I can have a couple of days off next week.  我正设法把工作安排好，以便下周能够休息一两天。
The meeting has been arranged for Wednesday.  会议已经安排在周三了。
I've already arranged with him to meet at the cinema.  我已和他约好了在电影院见面。

words.meaning: n.大气(层);空气;气氛,环境;大气压
words.example:
These factories are releasing toxic gases into the atmosphere.  这些工厂向大气中排放有毒气体。
The atmosphere in the room was so stuffy I could hardly breathe.  房间里空气污浊，我都快喘不过气来了。
There's a very relaxed atmosphere in our office.  我们办公室的气氛非常轻松。

words.meaning: n.接合处,接头;关节a.联合的,共同的,连接的
words.example:
The project was a joint effort/venture between the two schools (= they worked on it together).  这个项目是两所学校共同合作的。
The two Russian ice-skaters came joint second (= They were both given second prize) in the world championship.  两名俄罗斯溜冰运动员在世界锦标赛中并列第二。
In court, the parents were awarded joint custody of their son (= the right to care for him was shared between them).  法庭上这对父母获判对他们的儿子共同拥有监护权。

words.meaning: v./n.(to)回答,答复,以…作答
words.example:
She replied to the threats by going to the police.  她受到威胁后便去报了警。
Newport took an early lead before Bridgend replied with three tries in 14 minutes.  开球不久纽波特队便率先进球，之后布里真德队大举反攻，14分钟内先后三次试图破门。noun countable or uncountable
There were very few replies to our advertisement.  我们的广告没有得到甚么回应。

words.meaning: n.自行车;周期,循环 v.骑自行车;循环
words.example: It's one in a cycle of plays that are being performed on successive evenings.  这几部连台戏连续几晚都在上演，这只是其中一部。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.对面的,相对的,相反的 n.对立面
words.example:
You'd never know they're sisters - they're completely opposite to each other in every way.  你怎样也不会知道她们是姐妹——她们各方面都全然不同。
Police attempts to calm the violence had the opposite effect.  警方试图平息暴力活动，却适得其反。UK adjective
My brother and I live on opposite sides of London.  我哥哥和我住在伦敦两个方向相反的区。

words.meaning: n.锁 v.锁,锁上
words.example:
Thieves got in by smashing the lock off the door.  盗贼砸坏门锁闯了进去。
She's a lock for promotion this year.  她今年肯定会晋升的。UK noun
There is a lock of Napoleon's hair in the display cabinet.  在展柜中有一缕拿破仑的鬈发。

words.meaning: v.应受,值得
words.example:
After all that hard work, you deserve a holiday.  辛劳过后，你该放假了。
Chris deserves our special thanks for all his efforts.  我们应该特别感谢克里斯所付出的心血。
She deserves a medal for putting up with that husband of hers.  她能够忍受那样的丈夫真不容易。UK verb transitive not continuous

words.meaning: a.(in)前后一致的;(with)一致,符合
words.example:
There has been a consistent improvement in her attitude.  她的态度一直在改进。
Her work is sometimes good, but the problem is she's not consistent.  她工作有时不错，问题是她不能始终如一。    Opposite inconsistentadjective
What the witness said in court was not consistent with the statement he made to the police.  证人在法庭上的证供和他对警方的陈述不一致。

words.meaning: n.(to)抵抗,反抗;抵抗力,阻力;电阻
words.example:
Government troops offered no resistance (to the rebels).  政府军没有（对叛军）作出任何抵抗。
There's a lot of resistance (= opposition) to the idea of a united Europe.  很多人反对欧洲统一的想法。
The car's speed was reduced by air/wind resistance.  汽车速度因为空气／风的阻力而下降。

words.meaning: n.发现;被发现的事物
words.example:
Leonardo made many scientific discoveries.  李奥纳多有许多科学发现。
The discovery of a body in the undergrowth started a murder enquiry.  在灌木丛中发现的尸体引发了一场凶杀案调查。

words.meaning: n.暴露,揭露;方向;陈列;遗弃;照射量
words.example:
You should always limit your exposure to the sun.  无论甚么时候，都不要长时间晒太阳。
Even a brief exposure to radiation is very dangerous.  即使只是短期接受辐射也是非常危险的。UK noun
The exposure of the minister's love affair forced him to resign.  部长在风流韵事曝光后，被迫辞职。UK noun

words.meaning: n.姿势,姿态 v.造成,提出,摆姿势,佯装
words.example:
Nuclear weapons pose a threat to everyone.  核子武器对所有人都构成了威胁。
The mountain terrain poses particular problems for civil engineers.  这个高山地势为土木工程师带来了特殊问题。UK verb
Can we go back to the question that Helena posed earlier?  我们能否回到海伦娜早先提出的那个问题？UK verb

words.meaning: n.小河,溪流;流,一股,一串 v.流出,涌
words.example:
There's a lovely stream that flows through their garden.  有一条美丽的小溪流过他们的花园。
She stopped rowing and let the boat float with the stream.  她不再划，任由小船顺流漂荡。noun countable
There has been a steady stream of phone calls from worried customers.  不断有忧心忡忡的顾客打电话来。

words.meaning: n.出售,上市;贱卖,廉价出售;销售额
words.example:
The sale of cigarettes/alcohol is forbidden.  禁止出售香烟／酒。
The building company get 10% commission on each house sale.  建筑公司每卖出一栋房子能获得10%的佣金。
They'll drop the price rather than lose the sale.  他们将下调价格而不是停止销售。

words.meaning: n.罐,壶
words.example:
Fill a large pot with salted water and bring it to the boil.  用一个大壶装满盐水并煮开。
There's plenty of cupboard space in the kitchen for all your pots and pans.  厨房的碗橱有足够的空间放你的盆盆罐罐。
Most lilies grow well in pots.  大多数百合花在盆中都生长良好。

words.meaning: a.盛大的,豪华的;重大的,主要的
words.example:
She has all kinds of grand ideas.  她脑子里都是些经天纬地的想法。
His job has a grand title, but he's little more than a clerk.  他的工作听起来名堂很大，可他不过是个职员。adjective
The Palace of Versailles is very grand.  凡尔赛宫非常宏伟。

words.meaning: pron.(I的物主代词)我的(东西)n.矿 v.采矿
words.example:
Your son is the same age as mine.  你儿子的年纪和我儿子一样大。
She's an old friend of mine.  她是我的一个老朋友。noun countable
My grandfather used to work in/ UKdown the mines.  我祖父以前在矿井里工作。noun countable

words.meaning: int.英(美)喂,你好(用来打招呼或引起注意)
words.example:
Hello, Paul. I haven't seen you for ages.  “你好，保罗。好久不见了。”
And a big hello (= welcome) to all the parents who've come to see the show.  非常欢迎所有来看演出的家长。
Hello, this is very strange - I know that man.  嘿，这可真奇怪——我认识那个人。

words.meaning: n.结合体,同盟;结合,联合
words.example:
Government by coalition has its own peculiar set of problems.  联合政府有其自身特有的一系列问题。
By forming a coalition, the rebels and the opposition parties defeated the government.  叛乱者与反对党结成联盟，击败了政府。

words.meaning: n.故事,传说
words.example:
He told some fascinating tales about his life in India.  他讲了他在印度生活的一些奇闻轶事。
She told me/invented/concocted a tale about missing the bus to explain her lateness.  为了解释迟到的原因，她向我讲了／编造了一通没赶上公车的鬼话。noun countable

words.meaning: n.刀,餐刀 v.用刀切,用匕首刺
words.example:
He drew/pulled a knife and stabbed her.  他拔出刀，刺中了她。noun countable (plural knives)
More and more women are choosing to go under the knife to improve their appearance.  越来越多的女性选择接受外科手术来改善容貌。noun countable (plural knives)
The knives are out for the former president.  对前总统大有剑拔弩张之势。noun countable (plural knives)

words.meaning: v.决心;(使)分解,溶解;决议 n.解决;决心
words.example:
Have you resolved the problem of transport yet?  你们解决交通问题了吗？
The couple resolved their differences and made an effort to get along.  这对夫妻消除了他们之间的分歧，尽力融洽相处。UK verb

words.meaning: a.种的,种族的
words.example:
He had a vision of a society living in racial harmony.  他梦想在一个社会中各种族能和谐共处。
They are members of a racial minority.  他们属于一个少数民族。

words.meaning: n.阶段,状态,时期;相,相位
words.example:
The project is only in the initial phase as yet, but it's looking quite promising.  该专案计划到目前为止才刚起步，但看起来大有可为。
We're entering a new phase in international relations.  我们现正进入国际关系的新阶段。
When I was in my early teens I went through a phase of only ever wearing black.  我在十几岁的时候有一阵子只穿黑色衣服。

words.meaning: n.笑话,玩笑 v.说笑话,开玩笑
words.example:
Did I tell you the joke about the chicken crossing the road?  我跟你讲过小鸡过马路的笑话吗？
She spent the evening cracking (= telling) jokes and telling funny stories.  她整个晚上都在说笑话，讲有趣的故事。
She tied his shoelaces together for a joke.  她跟他开玩笑，把他的鞋带系在一起。

words.meaning: n.上衣,外套;表皮;层,覆盖物 v.涂(盖)上
words.example:
Do your coat up, Joe, or you'll freeze.  扣好外套，乔，不然你会冻坏的。
We need a coat hook on the back of this door.  我们需要在这扇门后装一个衣钩。
I'll give the walls a quick coat of paint.  我要给墙快速上一层漆。

words.meaning: n.(疾病的)症状;(不好事情的)征兆,表征
words.example:
He's complaining of all the usual flu symptoms - a high temperature, headache and so on.  他抱怨所有常见的感冒症状——高烧、头痛等，都出现在他身上。
He's been HIV-positive for six years, but just recently he's started to develop the symptoms of AIDS.  他 HIV 病毒检测呈阳性反应已有六年了，但直到最近才开始出现爱滋病的征状。
It's her feeling that the recent outbreaks of violence are a symptom of the dissatisfaction that is currently affecting our society.  她觉得最近爆发的暴力事件，显示了目前不满的情绪正在影响我们的社会。

words.meaning: n.哲学,哲理,人生观,价值观,世界观
words.example:
René Descartes is regarded as the founder of modern philosophy.  勒奈‧笛卡尔被视为现代哲学的奠基人。
Live now, pay later - that's my philosophy of life !  现在享受，以后付出——这是我的人生哲学。

words.meaning: n.马铃薯,土豆
words.example: boiled/roasted/fried potatoes  煮／烤／炸马铃薯

words.meaning: n.基础,根本,建立,创立;地基,基金,基金会
words.example:
Her youngest child starts (in) foundation in September.  她最小的孩子九月份上幼儿学校基础班。noun
The foundations will have to be reinforced to prevent the house from sinking further into the ground.  地基必须进行加固以防房屋继续下陷。noun
These allegations are completely without foundation.  这些说法完全没有根据。noun

words.meaning: v.引用,援引
words.example:
He's always quoting from the Bible.  他总是引用《圣经》上的话。
"If they're flexible, we're flexible", the official was quoted as saying.  援引那位官员的话说：“如果他们能变通，我们也能变通。”
She worked, to quote her daughter, "as if there was no tomorrow".  用她女儿的话来说，她工作起来“就像没有明天似的”。

words.meaning: n.场合,时节,时刻;时机,机会
words.example:
We met on several occasions to discuss the issue.  我们几次会面讨论这个问题。
I've heard him be rude to her on a number of occasions.  我有好几次听到他对她说话很粗鲁。
Sara's party was quite an occasion - there were over a hundred people there.  萨拉的聚会真是一次盛会——有一百多人参加。

words.meaning: n.灰尘,尘土 v.拂,掸
words.example:
The furniture was covered in dust and cobwebs.  家俱上落满了灰尘和蜘蛛网。
We thought we'd let the dust settle before discussing the other matter.  我们认为应该在形势明朗之后再讨论另一个问题。noun uncountable
Every promise they have made has turned to dust.  他们的承诺都一文不值。verb

words.meaning: v.呼吸,吸入
words.example:
It's so airless in here - I can hardly breathe.  这里太闷了——我几乎不能呼吸。
The instructor told us to breathe in deeply and then breathe out slowly.  教练让我们深吸气，然后慢慢吐气。
I'm sorry if I'm breathing (= blowing out air containing) garlic fumes all over you!  如果我口里的大蒜味儿薰着你了，我很抱歉！verb

words.meaning: v.选举,推选;选择,作出选择
words.example:
The Government is elected for a five-year term of office.  政府由选举产生，执政期为五年。
She elected to take early retirement instead of moving to the new location.  她不想前往新的工作地点，就选择了提前退休。plural noun

words.meaning: n.短上衣,茄克衫
words.example: The keys are in my jacket pocket.  锁匙在我的夹克口袋里。noun countable

words.meaning: a.高兴的,快活的;乐意的,情愿的
words.example:
We were glad about her success.  我们都为她的成功感到高兴。
I'm glad (that) you came.  你来了，我真的很高兴。
I'm glad to know the parcel arrived safely.  得知包裹安全寄到，我感到非常欣慰。

words.meaning: a.普通的,平凡的,平常的;平庸的
words.example:
Readers of the magazine said they wanted more stories about ordinary people and fewer stories about the rich and famous.  这本杂志的读者说，他们希望多刊登一些普通人的故事，少一些关于富人和名人的事情。
Her last concert appearance in Britain was no ordinary (= a very special) performance.  她在伦敦的最后一场音乐会不同凡响。
If we hadn't seen the TV programme, we would have carried on giving money to the charity in the ordinary way.  要是我们没有看这个电视节目，我们还会像往常那样给该慈善组织捐钱的。

words.meaning: n.减小,减少,缩小
words.example: a reduction in traffic  交通量的减少

words.meaning: ad.很少,难得,非常地
words.example:
We rarely see each other now.  我们现在很少见面。
formal Rarely have I seen such a beautiful sunset.  如此美丽的日落景象我真是难得一见。

words.meaning: v.捆扎,打包;塞满,挤满n.包裹,背包,一群/副
words.example:
We're leaving early tomorrow morning, so you'd better pack (= put clothes and other possessions into a bag or bags) tonight.  我们明天一大早就要出发，所以你最好今晚就收拾行李。
She packed a small suitcase for the weekend.  她收拾好一小箱行李准备度周末。
He just packed his bags and walked out on his wife and children.  他收拾了行李就抛下妻儿离家出走了。

words.meaning: n.自杀;给自己带来恶劣后果的行为
words.example:
The suicide rate among men between the ages of 16 and 25 has risen alarmingly.  16至25岁之间男性的自杀率攀升速度惊人。
Many suicides occur in prisons.  监狱中的自杀事件很多。    Compare manslaughter ; murdernoun

words.meaning: a.众多的,许多的,大批的
words.example:
We have discussed these plans on numerous occasions.  我们已经多次讨论过这些计划。
Shops of this type, once rare, are now numerous (= there are many of them).  这种商店从前很少见，但现在已经遍地开花。

words.meaning: n.物质;实质,本质;主旨;财产,资产
words.example:
What sort of substance could withstand those temperatures?  哪种物质能够承受那样的温度？
There is no substance in/to the allegation.  这项指控毫无根据。
This new information gives substance to the stories we have heard.  这项新资讯为我们所听到的情况提供了根据。

words.meaning: n.纪律,学科
words.example:
There should be better discipline in schools.  学校的纪律应该更严一些。
Maintaining classroom discipline (= control of the students) is the first task of every teacher.  维护课堂纪律是每位教师的首要任务。noun

words.meaning: ad.在别处,向别处
words.example:
The report looks at economic growth in Europe and elsewhere.  这份报告研究了欧洲和其他地区的经济成长状况。
They couldn't find what they wanted and decided to look elsewhere.  他们找不到他们想要的东西，就决定到别处去看看。

words.meaning: n.铁,铁制品,烙铁,熨斗 v.熨(衣),熨平
words.example:
Iron rusts easily.  铁易生锈。
Liver is a particularly rich source of dietary iron.  肝脏中含有特别丰富的饮食铁质。
He'll probably use a 2 or 3 iron for the shot.  他这一击很可能要用2号或3号铁头球杆。UK noun

words.meaning: a.实际的,实用的
words.example:
Qualifications are important but practical experience is always an advantage.  资历固然重要，但实际经验总是个优势。
The service offers young people practical advice on finding a job.  这项服务为年轻人提供就业方面的实用建议。
What's the use of theoretical knowledge that has no practical application ?  理论知识如果没有实际应用又有甚么用呢？

words.meaning: conj./ad.再者,加之,而且
words.example: The whole report is badly written. Moreover, it's inaccurate.  整个报告都写得很差，而且还内容不实。

words.meaning: n.热情,激情,爱好;激怒;强烈感情
words.example:
Football arouses a good deal of passion among its supporters.  足球唤起了球迷巨大的热情。
At school, his early interest in music developed into an abiding passion.  他早年对音乐萌生的兴趣在求学时期发展成一种始终不渝的热爱。
Politics and philosophy were his lifelong passions.  政治学和哲学是他毕生热爱的学科。

words.meaning: n./v.自愿(者,兵);自愿(提供)
words.example:
The Health clinic is relying on volunteers to run the office and answer the telephones.  这家健康门诊依靠志愿者来负责办公室的日常工作和接听电话。
Since it would be a highly dangerous mission, the Lieutenant asked for volunteers.  由于那项任务非常危险，所以中尉请大家自告奋勇。
It's a volunteer army with no paid professionals.  这是一支志愿军，没有领军饷的职业军人。    Compare conscriptUK verb

words.meaning: n.(pl.)工具,器具 v.贯彻,实现
words.example:
The changes to the national health system will be implemented next year.  国民医疗保健制度的改革将于明年实行。noun countable /ˈɪm.plɪ.mənt/
Shopkeepers are not supposed to sell knives and other sharp implements to children.  店主不应该向儿童出售小刀或其他锋利的器具。

words.meaning: n.基因
words.example: The illness is believed to be caused by a defective gene.  据信，这种疾病是由基因缺陷引起的。

words.meaning: n.酱汁,调味汁
words.example:
Gran's been on the sauce again - she's passed out in the den.  奶奶又喝酒了——她醉倒在房间里。UK noun
That's enough of your sauce, my girl!  你无礼的话说够了吧，我的小姐！UK noun

words.meaning: n.独立,自主
words.example:
Mexico gained its independence from Spain in l821.  墨西哥于1821年脱离西班牙独立。
It's important that parents should allow their children some independence.  父母让子女在一定程度上独立非常重要。

words.meaning: n.教士,神父
words.example:
Father O'Dooley was ordained a priest in 1949.  奥杜利神父是1949年被授予神父职位的。
Many in the Anglican Church are still opposed to women priests.  英国圣公会中的许多人仍然抵制女祭司。

words.meaning: a.强烈的,剧烈的;热烈的,热情的
words.example: He suddenly felt an intense pain in his back.  他突然觉得背部一阵剧痛。

words.meaning: n.前进,预付 vi.前进,进展 vt.促进,推进
words.example:
The fire advanced steadily through the forest.  大火在森林中不断蔓延。
The troops advanced on the city (= approached it, ready to attack).  军队向该城推进。
We have advanced greatly in our knowledge of the universe.  在认识宇宙方面，我们已经取得长足的进步。

words.meaning: n.雇主
words.example: We need a reference from your former employer.  我们需要你前任雇主的推荐信。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.震动;电击,触电;休克v.(使)震动/震惊
words.example:
Her mother's death came as a great shock - it was so unexpected.  她母亲的去世让人倍感震惊——简直太出乎意料了。
It was such a loud crash - it gave me/I got quite a shock.  轰隆一声巨响就撞上了——真把我吓了一跳。
It was a shock to see her looking so ill.  看到她病得如此厉害，真让人震惊。

words.meaning: vt.鼓舞,激起;使产生灵感
words.example:
His confident leadership inspired his followers.  他那自信的领导风采激励着他的追随者。
She inspires great loyalty among her followers.  她激起了追随者强烈的忠诚感。
The captain's heroic effort inspired them with determination.  船长的英勇行为激发了他们的决心。

words.meaning: vt.调节;整顿,调整 vi.适应(to);使调节
words.example:
If the chair is too high you can adjust it to suit you.  如果椅子太高了，你可以把它调到适合你的高度。
As a teacher you have to adjust your methods to suit the needs of slower children.  作为一名老师，你必须调整教学方法来适应那些学得较慢的孩子的需要。
She adjusted her skirt, took a deep breath and walked into the room.  她整理一下裙子，深吸一口气，走进了房间。verb

words.meaning: v.退休,引退;退却,撤退;就寝
words.example:
Since retiring from the company, she has done voluntary work for a charity.  从公司退休后，她就一直在为一间慈善机构做志愿工作。
He is due to retire as chief executive next year.  明年他就该从总裁职位上退下来了。
She retired from the competition after pulling a leg muscle.  她因腿部肌肉拉伤退出了比赛。

words.meaning: n./v.吻,接吻
words.example:
There was a young couple on the sofa, kissing passionately.  沙发上一对年轻人正在热吻。
She kissed him on the mouth.  她吻了一下他的嘴唇。
The breeze/sun kissed her bare shoulders.  微风轻拂／阳光洒照她裸露的肩膀。

words.meaning: n.病,疾病
words.example:
He died at home after a long illness.  久病之后他在家里死去。
She had five days off work due to illness.  她因病请了五天假。

words.meaning: n.便帽,军帽;盖,罩,套 v.覆盖于…顶端
words.example:
Davis has 17 Scottish caps (= has played for Scotland 17 times).  戴维斯17次代表苏格兰参赛。
The team contains five international caps.  这支队伍里有五位国际体育比赛选手。noun countable
The camera has a lens cap to protect the lens surface.  相机有镜头盖保护镜头表面。

words.meaning: n.习惯,习性,脾性
words.example:
I'm trying not to get into (= start) the habit of always having biscuits with my coffee.  我尽量避免养成喝咖啡时总是吃饼干的习惯。
His eating habits are extraordinary.  他的饮食习惯很不寻常。
I'm trying to get him to break (= end intentionally) the habit of switching on the TV when he comes home at night.  我设法让他改掉晚上一回家就打开电视的习惯。

words.meaning: a.竞争的;好竞争的;(价格等的)有竞争力的
words.example:
Acting is very competitive - you've got to really push yourself if you want to succeed.  演艺界竞争非常激烈——想成功就必须拚命努力。
You're very competitive - it's meant to be a friendly match!  你太争强好胜了——这本来是场友谊赛！

words.meaning: n.(水果等)汁,液
words.example:
Fry the meat first to seal in the juices.  先把肉煎一煎锁住肉汁。noun
My cousin Gianni's got all the juice in this neighborhood.  我的堂哥吉安尼在这一带很有影响力。noun
This early in the morning it's hard to get the creative juices flowing (= to start thinking of good ideas).  这么一大早很难想出甚么好点子。

words.meaning: v.支配,统治,控制;占优势
words.example:
He refuses to let others speak and dominates every meeting.  每次开会他都专横跋扈，不让他人讲话。
