Imposing sanctions is a moderate action when you consider that the alternative is military intervention.  如果考虑到另一选择是军事干预的话，你就会发现实施制裁并不是过分的举措。adjective UK SLIGHT  轻微的

words.meaning: a.随后的,后来的
words.example:
The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from the government.  书中讲述了他患病及随后辞去政府职务的事。
Those explosions must have been subsequent to our departure, because we didn't hear anything.  那些爆炸一定是在我们离开后发生的，因为我们甚么也没听到。

words.meaning: n.搬运人;载体
words.example: There are an estimated 1.5 million HIV carriers in the country.  据估计，这个国家有150万 HIV 病毒带原者。

words.meaning: a.时常发生的,频繁的
words.example:
The most frequent cause of death is heart attack.  最常见的死因是心脏病发作。
The attacks were increasingly frequent and serious.  攻击变得越来越频繁，越来越猛烈。verb transitive UK US     formal

words.meaning: v.取缔,查禁;(from)禁止 n.禁止,禁令
words.example:
The film was banned (= the government prevented it from being shown) in several countries.  有几个国家都禁止播放这部电影。
There should be a ban on talking loudly in cinemas.  戏院里应该禁止大声交谈。

words.meaning: a.极度的,极坏的;威严的,可怕的
words.example:
He suffered awful injuries in the crash.  他在车祸中受了重伤。
We had awful weather.  我们碰上了糟糕的天气。
She's got an awful boss.  她的老板极难相处。

words.meaning: vt.钦佩,赞赏,羡慕;称赞,夸奖
words.example: We stood for a few moments, admiring the view.  我们驻足了一会儿，欣赏美丽的景色。

words.meaning: n.爱畜,宠儿 a.宠爱的,表示亲昵的
words.example:
They have several pets - a dog, two rabbits and a guinea pig.  他们有好几只宠物：一只狗、两只兔子和一只天竺鼠。
The other children hated her because she was the teacher's pet.  别的孩子都讨厌她，因为她是老师的宠儿。
He's always sending me flowers - he's a real pet!  他总是送花给我——他真讨人喜欢！

words.meaning: n.奇迹,令人惊奇的人(或事)
words.example: You've performed a miracle on this kitchen - I've never seen it so clean!  你真是创造了奇迹——我从没见过这个厨房如此干净过！

words.meaning: v.超过,胜过;越出
words.example:
The final cost should not exceed $5000.  最终的费用不应超出5000美元。
The success of our campaign has exceeded our wildest expectations.  我们发起的运动获得了意想不到的成功。
She was found guilty on three charges of exceeding the speed limit.  她被指控三次超速驾驶，并被判有罪。

words.meaning: n.节奏,韵律
words.example:
He beat out a jazz rhythm on the drums.  他击出爵士乐节奏的鼓点。
I've got no sense of rhythm, so I'm a terrible dancer.  我根本没有节奏感，所以舞跳得很差劲。
She was lulled to sleep by the gentle rhythm of the boat in the water.  船在水中有节奏地轻轻摇动，使她昏昏入睡。

words.meaning: a.分布广泛的,普遍的
words.example:
There are reports of widespread flooding in northern France.  有报道说法国北部到处洪水泛滥。
Malnutrition in the region is widespread - affecting up to 78% of children under five years old.  这个地区营养不良的现象十分普遍——五岁以下的儿童中78%营养不良。
The campaign has received widespread support.  这场运动得到广泛支持。

words.meaning: a.可爱的,好看的;令人愉快的,美好的
words.example:
We had a lovely time with them.  我们和他们在一起渡过了一段快乐的时光。adjective
She has lovely eyes.  她的眼睛很漂亮。
You look lovely in that dress.  你穿那条裙子很好看。

words.meaning: n.罪,罪恶 v.犯罪
words.example:
He thinks a lot about sin.  他对罪孽有很多思考。
humorous For my sins (= As if it were a punishment) , I'm organizing the office party this year.  真是活该，今年将由我来安排办公室派对。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.慈善(团体),仁慈,施舍
words.example:
She does a lot of work for charity.  她做了很多慈善工作。
People tend to give to (= give money to) charity at Christmas time.  人们往往在圣诞节向慈善组织捐钱。
Proceeds from the sale of these cards will go to (= be given to) local charities.  卖这些贺卡所得的收益将捐献给地方慈善组织。

words.meaning: n.剧本(原稿);手稿,原稿;笔迹,手迹
words.example:
Bruce Robinson wrote the script for 'The Killing Fields'.  布鲁斯‧罗宾逊为《战火屠城》写了剧本。
The invitation was written in beautiful italic script.  邀请函是用漂亮的斜体字写成的。noun

words.meaning: n.(tactics)策略,战术
words.example: These bomb attacks represent a change of tactics by the terrorists.  这些炸弹袭击事件表明恐怖分子改变了策略。

words.meaning: n.识别,鉴别;证件;认同
words.example:
Most of the bodies were badly burned, making identification almost impossible.  大部分尸体都严重烧焦，几乎无法辨认。
We were asked to show some identification before the security guards would let us in.  保安人员要我们出示身分证明文件才让我们进去。

words.meaning: adj.每日的,日常的
words.example: Death was an everyday occurrence during the Civil War.  在内战期间，死亡是很普遍的事。adjective

words.meaning: n.大字标题,新闻标题
words.example:
The news of his death was splashed in headlines across all the newspapers.  所有报纸均以显著的标题刊登了他死亡的消息。
The story was headlined 'Killer dogs on the loose'.  这篇报道的标题是：“杀人恶犬肆意逞凶”。
The band's headlining appearance at the Reading Festival could be their last.  这支乐队在雷丁音乐节上担纲演出，但这可能是他们的最后一次表演了。

words.meaning: n.入侵,侵略,侵犯
words.example: They were planning to mount an invasion of the north of the country.  他们正计划发动对该国北部的侵略。

words.meaning: ad.[nevertheless]虽然如此, 但是
words.example: There are serious problems in our country. Nonetheless, we feel this is a good time to return.  我们国家存在严重问题。但尽管如此，我们仍然觉得这是归国的好时机。

words.meaning: adj.充足的,足够的;适当的,胜任的
words.example:
Have we got adequate food for twenty guests?  我们的食物够招待20位客人吗？
It's not by any means a brilliant salary but it's adequate for our needs.  薪资一点也谈不上优厚，但足以满足我们的需要了。
The council's provision for the elderly is barely adequate (= is not enough).  地方议会给长者提供的保障不足。

words.meaning: n.钢琴
words.example:
We're buying a new piano.  我们准备买一架新钢琴。
mainly US or specialized She used to play piano in a jazz band.  她以前在一支爵士乐队演奏钢琴。
The music was written for piano.  这首乐曲是为钢琴谱写的。

words.meaning: n.强烈,剧烈;强度
words.example:
The explosion was of such intensity that it was heard five miles away.  爆炸的巨响五英里以外都能听见。
The intensity of their relationship was causing problems.  他们关系中所牵涉的感情强烈得引发了问题。

words.meaning: v.展出,陈列 n.展览品,陈列品
words.example:
He frequently exhibits at the art gallery.  他经常在艺廊展出作品。
In the summer the academy will exhibit several prints which are rarely seen.  该学会将于今年夏天对外展出几幅罕见的版画作品。
He exhibited great self-control considering her rudeness.  她那么无礼，他表现得如此克制已经很好了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.毯子(可数);厚厚一层(可数) vt.铺上一层
words.example:
The ground was covered by a thick blanket of snow.  地上覆盖着一层厚厚的雪。adjective [before noun]
'Man', as a blanket term for both men and women, is now considered sexist.  man 用作一个广义词来指代男人和女人，现在被认为有性别歧视色彩。verb transitive often passive literary
Outside the fields were blanketed in fog.  外面，田野被浓雾笼罩着。

words.meaning: n.页边空白;边缘;余地;幅度
words.example:
The Senate approved the use of military force by a margin of 52 votes to 47.  参议院以52票对47票通过了使用武力的提议。
The poll shows that the government is leading by the narrowest of margins.  民意调查显示，政府以极其微弱的优势领先。UK noun countable
If I have any comments to make, I'll write them in the margin.  如果我有评语，就会写在页边的空白处。

words.meaning: n.(pl.mice)鼠,耗子
words.example: a field mouse  田鼠

words.meaning: n.绳,索
words.example:
The middleweight boxing champion had his opponent up against the ropes.  那个中量级拳击冠军将对手逼到了拳击台的护栏上。UK noun
Lynn spent an afternoon showing the new girl the ropes.  林恩花了一下午的时间教那个新来的年轻女职员入门。UK verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition
I'll rope my horse to your car and pull you out of the ditch.  我把我的马套在你的汽车上把你从沟里拉出来。

words.meaning: a.具体的,实质性的n.混凝土v.用混凝土修筑
words.example:
Why did you concrete over that nice garden?  你为甚么把那个漂亮的花园铺上混凝土？UK adjective
They think she killed her husband, but they've no concrete evidence.  他们认为她杀死了自己的丈夫，但是他们没有确凿的证据。
We've got a general idea of what we want, but nothing concrete at the moment.  我们对需要甚么有个大致的想法，可是具体的东西目前还没有想好。

words.meaning: n.药方,处方
words.example:
These drugs are only available on prescription (= with a prescription from a doctor).  这些药只能凭处方购买。
Prescription charges (= the standard amount of money you pay for any medicine prescribed by a doctor) are rising in June.  六月份处方药费在上涨。noun
So what is his prescription for success?  那么他认为成功的诀窍是甚么？

words.meaning: v./n.追逐,追求
words.example:
The police car was going so fast, it must have been chasing someone.  警车开得这么快，一定是在追捕甚么人。
She was chasing (after) a man who had snatched her bag.  她在追赶一个抢走她的手提包的男子。
She couldn't study with the children chasing around the house.  孩子在房子里跑来跑去，她没法温习。verb

words.meaning: n.砖块,砖;v.用砖围砌,用砖填补
words.example:
The chimney was made of bricks.  烟囱是用砖砌的。
We lived in a Victorian terrace of red -brick houses.  我们住在维多利亚式的红砖房连排屋中。
He was so embarrassed - his face went brick -red (= a dark red).  他尴尬极了，脸涨得紫红紫红的。

words.meaning: v.征募(新兵),吸收;补充 n.新成员,新兵
words.example:
Charities such as Oxfam are always trying to recruit volunteers to help in their work.  诸如牛津饥荒救济委员会这样的慈善组织总是在尽力吸收志愿者来帮助他们工作。
Even young boys are now being recruited into the army.  就连很小的男孩子都被征召入伍了。
Raw recruits (= completely new soldiers) were trained for six months and then sent to the war front.  刚入伍的新兵接受了六个月的训练后就被送往战争前线。

words.meaning: n.补丁,斑点,碎片小块 v.补,修补,掩饰
words.example:
Our dog has a black patch on his back.  我们的狗背上有块黑斑。
The hotel walls were covered in damp patches.  饭店的墙壁上满是湿渍。
There were lots of icy patches on the road this morning.  今天早上路上有多处地方结了冰。

words.meaning: n.(意见等的)一致,一致同意,共识
words.example:
The general consensus in the office is that he's useless at his job.  办公室成员一致认为他在工作中碌碌无为。
Could we reach a consensus on this matter? Let's take a vote.  我们能在这件事上达成共识吗？我们来表决吧。

words.meaning: n.恐怖,战栗
words.example:
The crowd cried out in horror as the car burst into flames.  当汽车突然起火时，人群发出一阵惊恐的叫声。
The thought of speaking in front of so many people fills me with horror.  一想到要在那么多人面前讲话，我心里就不由得一阵害怕。
What the book does convey very successfully is the horror of war.  那本书的确成功描绘出战争的恐怖。

words.meaning: n.漆工,画家
words.example: The painter mixed blue and yellow.  画家把蓝色和黄色调在一起。

words.meaning: a.殖民地的,关于殖民的 n.殖民地居民
words.example:
Turkey was once an important colonial power.  土耳其曾是一个显赫的殖民强国。
Various parts of Africa have suffered under colonial rule.  非洲各地都遭受过殖民统治。

words.meaning: n.馅饼
words.example:
Would you like some more pork pie?  你想再要点猪肉馅饼吗？
Their plans to set up their own business are just pie in the sky.  他们自行创业的计划只不过是空想罢了。

words.meaning: n.缘故,理由
words.example:
Please do it, for David's sake.  为了戴维，请做这件事。
Their parents only stayed together for the sake of the children.  他们的父母仅仅是为了孩子才没有分居。
Let's not disagree for the sake of (= because of) a few pounds.  我们不要因为几英镑闹别扭。

words.meaning: v./n.凝视,注视
words.example:
Annette gazed admiringly at Warren as he spoke.  沃伦说话时，安妮特一脸崇拜地注视着他。
He spends hours gazing out of the window when he should be working.  他在本应工作的时候一连几个小时盯着窗外发呆。noun only singular
literary As I looked out, my gaze fell on a small child by the road.  我看看窗外，目光落到了路边一个小孩身上。

words.meaning: n.勇气,胆量
words.example:
They showed great courage when they found out about their baby's disability.  发现自己的婴儿身有残疾时，他们表现出了巨大的勇气。
It took me ages to summon/pluck up the courage to ask for a promotion.  过了很久我才鼓足勇气要求升职。
Although many of his policies were unpopular, he had the courage of his convictions to see them through.  尽管他的许多政策不受欢迎，但他仍然有勇气按照自己的信念去贯彻。

words.meaning: v.(at)诅咒,骂人;宣誓,发誓
words.example:
She had a good seat at the President's swearing-in ceremony.  她在总统宣誓就职仪式上占了个好座位。UK US  (swore, sworn)
After years of addiction, he swore off drugs completely.  上瘾几年后，他发誓彻底戒毒。

words.meaning: n.击败,战胜,失败 v.击败,战胜;使失败
words.example:
Napoleon was defeated by the Duke of Wellington at the battle of Waterloo.  拿破伦在滑铁卢战役中被威灵顿公爵击败。
If we can defeat the Italian team, we'll be through to the final.  如果我们能打败义大利队，我们将晋身决赛。
The proposal to change the rules was narrowly (= only just) defeated by 201 votes to 196.  变更规则的提案仅以196票对201票的微弱劣势未获通过。

words.meaning: n.线索,暗示
words.example:
Police are still looking for clues in their search for the missing girl.  警方仍在寻找能帮助搜索失踪女孩的线索。
I'm never going to guess the answer if you don't give me a clue.  要是你不给我一点提示，我永远也猜不到答案。noun countable
Don't ask your father which key to press - he hasn't got a clue about computers.  别问你父亲该按哪个键——他对电脑一窍不通。verb (clueing, clued, clued)

words.meaning: v.增援,加强
words.example:
The pockets on my jeans are reinforced with double stitching.  我牛仔裤的裤兜缝了两道线，很结实。
The final technical report into the accident reinforces the findings of initial investigations.  对事故作出的最终的技术性报告进一步证实了最初的调查结果。
His behaviour merely reinforced my dislike of him.  他的行为只能使我更讨厌他。

words.meaning: n.困惑,糊涂;混淆;混乱,骚乱
words.example:
There seems to be some confusion over who is actually giving the talk.  好像不是很清楚到底是谁在作报告。
To avoid confusion, the twins never wore the same clothes.  为了避免混淆，这对双胞胎从不穿一样的衣服。
In the confusion after the bomb blast, I lost my bag and wasn't able to stop and look for it.  在爆炸发生后的一片混乱中，我丢了袋子，也无法停下来寻找它。

words.meaning: n.薄片,切片;一份;部分切(片)
words.example:
Would you like another slice of ham/beef?  要不要再来一片火腿／牛肉?

The film presents us with a fascinating slice of history.  这部电影向我们展示了一个非常有趣的历史片段。

words.meaning: n.占领,占据;占用;职业,工作
words.example:
In the space marked 'occupation' she wrote 'police officer'.  在“职业”一栏里她写了“员警”。UK noun
It seems to me his favourite occupation is eating.  在我看来，他最喜爱的消遣就是吃。UK noun

words.meaning: a.昂贵的;亲爱的;珍贵的 int.呵!哎呀!
words.example:
She was a very dear friend.  她是一位非常亲密的朋友。
He was very dear to me.  他跟我非常亲近。
This place is very dear to me - we came here on our honeymoon.  这个地方对我来讲非常亲切——我们曾到这里度过蜜月。

words.meaning: n.煤,煤块

How much coal was mined here?  这里出了多少煤？
Exporting pine to Scandinavia seems a bit like carrying coals to Newcastle.  往斯堪的纳维亚出口松木似乎有点多此一举。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.神圣的;宗教的;庄严的
words.example:
This area is sacred to the Apaches.  对阿帕契人而言，这一个地区是神圣的。

humorous The cricketers wore blue, not their usual white - is nothing sacred?  板球队员们身穿蓝色队服，不是他们常穿的白色——难道这也是可以改的吗？

words.meaning: n.(pl.formulae)公式;规则;分子式;药方
words.example:
We have changed the formula of the washing powder.  我们已经更换了洗衣粉的配方。

words.meaning: a.认知的,认识能力的
words.example: Some of her cognitive functions have been impaired.  她的部分认知能力受到了损害。

words.meaning: n.集体 a.集体的,共同的

words.meaning: a.确切的,正确的,精确的

words.meaning: n.伯父,叔父,舅父,姑父,姨父
words.example:
I've got several uncles and aunts.  我有几个叔叔和姑姑。
We invited my Uncle Steve round.  我们邀请了我的叔叔史蒂夫过来。
[as form of address] Did you bring me a present, Uncle Jack?  你给我带礼物了吗，杰克叔叔？

words.meaning: n.首领,队长;船长;上尉 v.做…的首领,指挥
words.example:
This is your captain speaking. We expect to be landing at London Heathrow in an hour's time.  我是机长。我们预计一小时后在伦敦希斯洛机场降落。
It's unusual to have a goalkeeper as (the) captain of a football team.  让守门员当足球队的队长是很少见的。

words.meaning: n.叹息,叹息声 v.叹息,叹气
words.example:
She sighed deeply and sat down.  她深叹一口气，坐了下来。
He leaned back in his seat with a sigh.  他向后靠在座位上长出了一口气。
"Ah, you're here, " she said and heaved/let out/gave a sigh of relief.  “啊，你在这里，”她说道，如释重负地松了口气。

words.meaning: v.(to)归因于,归属于 n.属性,品质,特征

Organizational ability is an essential attribute for a good manager.  组织能力是一个出色经理必备的素质。verb[əˈtrɪb.jʊt/    /-juːt]
The doctors have attributed the cause of the illness to an unknown virus.  医生们认为这种疾病是由一种未知的病毒引起。

words.meaning: v.敢,胆敢
words.example:
Do you dare (to) tell him the news?  你敢告诉他这个消息吗？

I'd never dare (to) talk to my mother the way Ben talks to his.  我永远也不敢像宾对他母亲讲话那样跟我母亲说话。

words.meaning: n.长廊,画廊,美术馆
words.example: the National Portrait Gallery  国家肖像画廊

words.meaning: n.足球
words.example: Soccer is played in nearly every country.  几乎每个国家都踢足球。

words.meaning: n.隧道,山洞
words.example:
The train went into the tunnel.  火车驶入隧道。verb intransitive or transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
The decision has not yet been made whether to tunnel under the river or build a bridge over it.  还没有决定是在河底挖掘隧道还是在河上建桥。
The alternative is to tunnel a route through the mountain.  另一个办法是挖一条穿山隧道。

words.meaning: n.大腿,(跑道的)一圈,一段路程,工作阶段
words.example:
Come and sit on my lap and I'll read you a story.  过来坐在我的腿上，我念故事给你听。noun
He recorded the fastest lap in last weekend's Hungarian Grand Prix.  在上周的匈牙利大奖赛中他创造了最快单圈成绩纪录。
After a strong start, she was passed by several runners in/on the final/last lap and finished ninth.  她在起跑阶段很有优势，但在最后一圈时被几名选手超出，最终获得了第九名。

words.meaning: n.坟墓 a.严肃的,庄重的
words.example:
He visits his mother's grave every Sunday.  他每个星期天都去母亲墓前拜祭。noun countable
Do you think there's life beyond the grave?  你认为人死后有来生吗？noun countable
She'd turn in her grave if she knew what he was spending his inheritance on.  如果得知他是如何挥霍她留下的遗产的，她在九泉之下也不得安宁。adjective

words.meaning: n.脚趾,足尖
words.example: Ministers who wouldn't toe the party line were swiftly got rid of.  不愿遵从该政党方针的部长立刻被免职。

words.meaning: n.容器;集装箱
words.example: an airtight container  密封容器

words.meaning: ad.到国外,在国外;在传播,在流传
words.example:
He's currently abroad on business.  目前他在国外出差。

words.meaning: n.建筑师;设计师;缔造者;创造者
words.example: Bevan was the architect of the British National Health Service.  比万是英国国民保健制度的创立者。

words.meaning: n.(enquiry)询问,打听,调查

words.meaning: n.玫瑰,蔷薇
words.example:

words.meaning: v.使显著,使突出;强调 n.最精彩的部分
words.example:
The report highlights the need for improved safety.  那份报告强调了加强安全的重要性。
The spelling mistakes in the text had been highlighted in green.  文本中的拼写错误用已经用绿色标出了。noun

words.meaning: n.减少,减小;减少量 v.减少,变少,降低

words.meaning: n.指出,指示;表明,暗示
words.example:

words.meaning: n.栏杆,围栏;(pl.)铁路;铁轨;横杆,栏杆

words.meaning: n.周年,周年纪念日

words.meaning: n.混乱,混杂,脏乱 v.弄脏,弄乱,搞糟

words.meaning: n.(for)报酬,赏金 v.(for)酬劳;酬谢

words.meaning: a.宗教仪式的,典礼的 n.(宗教)仪式,典礼

words.meaning: v.中断,遮断,阻碍;打断(话),打扰

words.meaning: n.魔术,魔(魅)力,巫术 a.有魔力的,魔术的

words.meaning: v./n.战斗,搏斗,格斗

There was fierce combat between the two sides.  双方展开了激烈的战斗。

words.meaning: n.茎,干 vt.堵(挡)住 vi.起源于,由…造成

words.meaning: v./n.劝告,忠告 n.法律顾问,辩护人

Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.  盐是钠和氯的化合物。
Many fertilizers contain nitrogen compounds.  许多化学肥料都含有含氮化合物。
Then there was his manner, a curious compound of humour and severity.  还有他的态度，那是一种幽默与严厉的奇异混合。

words.meaning: v.(into,with)(使)成为一体,(使)结合在一起
words.example:
He seems to find it difficult to integrate socially.  他似乎觉得很难与别人打成一片。
Children are often very good at integrating into a new culture.  孩子通常很善于融入新的文化。
The aim, said the minister, was to integrate Britain both politically and economically into the European Community.  大臣说，目标是使英国在政治和经济上都与欧共体融为一体。

words.meaning: n.面粉
words.example: Grease and flour the tins thoroughly.  细细地给烤盘涂一层油脂并撒满面粉。

words.meaning: a.(有)苦(味)的;痛苦的,厉害的
words.example:
She'd suffered terribly over the years but it hadn't made her bitter.  多年来她受尽了苦，但她并不怨恨。
Failing the final exams was a bitter disappointment for me.  期末考试不及格令我非常痛苦。
She learnt through bitter experience that he was not to be trusted.  她从痛苦的经历中意识到他不可信。

words.meaning: a.赤裸的,空的;稀少的,仅有的 v.露出,暴露
words.example:
Don't walk around outside in your bare feet.  别赤脚在外面到处走。
There's no carpet in the room, just bare floorboards.  房间里地板裸露，没有铺上地毯。
There isn't much time, so I'll just give you the bare facts/details.  时间不多了，我只能给你提供一些最基本的事实／细节。

words.meaning: n.斜坡,斜面;倾斜,斜度 v.(使)倾斜
words.example:
The roof is at a slope (= at an angle to a horizontal surface) of 30°.  屋顶有30°的坡度。
Snow had settled on some of the higher slopes.  雪堆积在一些较高的山坡上。
There's a very steep slope just before you reach the top of the mountain.  在你到达山顶之前要经过一个陡坡。

words.meaning: v.租,租赁 n.租金
words.example:
Rents here are ridiculously high/low.  这里的房租高／低得出奇。
There was a large rent in his parachute.  他的降落伞上裂了个大口子。verb
My Dad has a cottage which he rents (out) to tourists.  我爸爸有一处乡间小屋，他把它出租给游客们。

words.meaning: a.精巧的,巧妙的;细微的,微妙的
words.example:
The room was painted a subtle shade of pink.  房间被刷成了淡粉色。
The play's message is perhaps too subtle to be understood by young children.  这部戏的内涵过于隐晦，小孩子可能难以理解。
There is a subtle difference between these two plans.  两个计划之间有一点细微的差别。

words.meaning: n.接受,接收,验收,接纳;承认,认可
words.example:
The idea rapidly gained acceptance (= became approved of) in political circles.  这个想法很快就得到了政界的认同。
The party marked his acceptance into the community.  这次聚会意味着社团已接纳他为成员。
Her acceptance of the award was very controversial.  她接受该奖项引发了很大的争议。

words.meaning: n.泵 v.用(泵)抽(水);打气,泵送
words.example:
Our latest machine can pump a hundred gallons a minute.  我们最新的机器每分钟能抽100加仑的液体。
The new wine is pumped into storage tanks.  新酿的酒被抽送到储藏罐里。
The heart pumps blood through the arteries/ round the body.  心脏透过动脉输送血液／将血液输送到全身。verb

words.meaning: n.糖果,vt.用糖煮
words.example: a candy bar  条形糖

words.meaning: a.邪恶的,罪恶的 n.邪恶,罪恶
words.example:
These people are just evil.  这些人太恶毒了。
Each new leader would blame his predecessor for all the evils of the past.  每个新上任的领导人都会把过去所有弊病全部归咎于前任。
Drug-addiction is one of today's great social evils.  吸毒成瘾是现今社会的一大罪恶。

words.meaning: n.奖章,勋章,纪念章
words.example:
He was awarded a medal for bravery.  他因表现英勇而获授勋章。
She won three Olympic gold medals.  她获得了三块奥运金牌。verb intransitive (-ll- or -l-)
She's medalled in both the heptathlon and the long jump.  她在七项全能和跳远两个项目中都获得了奖牌。

words.meaning: vt.请求,乞求 vi.恳请,行乞
words.example:
They begged for mercy.  他们乞求饶恕。
There are more and more homeless people begging on the streets these days.  近来越来越多无家可归的人在街上行乞。
She had to beg for money and food for her children.  她不得不为孩子们乞讨金钱和食物。

words.meaning: n.发起人,主力者,保证人 v.发起,主办
words.example:
The team is sponsored by JVC, so the players wear the letters JVC on their shirts.  该队是由JVC公司赞助的，所以队员们的衬衫上都有JVC几个字母。
Eva said she was doing a ten-mile walk for charity and asked if I'd sponsor her for £1 a mile.  伊娃说她打算步行十哩募集慈善捐款，问我愿不愿意一哩赞助她一英镑。

words.meaning: a.次要的,二级的;中级的,第二的
words.example:
Marcus has just started at secondary school.  马库斯刚开始上中学。UK adjective
Her health is what matters - the cost of the treatment is of secondary importance.  她的健康是最重要的，治疗费用是其次。
The need for secrecy is secondary to the need to take immediate action.  立即采取行动比保守秘密更重要。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.(门、窗等)砰地关上 n.猛然关闭的声音
words.example:
The wind made the door/window slam (shut).  风吹过来门／窗户砰地关上了。
Close the door carefully, don't slam it.  小心关门，别使劲关。
He slammed the brakes on (= used them quickly and with force) when a child ran in front of his car.  一个孩子在他车前跑过，他猛地踩下煞车。

words.meaning: v./n.输出,出口 n.出口商品
words.example:
French cheeses are exported to many different countries.  法国的起司出口到很多国家。
Our clothes sell so well in this country that we have no need to export.  我们生产的服装在本国销路很好，所以没有必要出口。    Compare import
American culture has been exported all over the world.  美国文化已经传到世界各地。

words.meaning: a.实验(性)的,试验(性)的
words.example:
The drug is still at the experimental stage (= is still being tested).  这种药物仍处于试验阶段。
The changes to the distribution system are purely experimental at the moment.  目前分配体系的变革纯粹是试验性的。

words.meaning: v.(使)融化,(使)熔化
words.example:
The snow usually melts by mid March.  通常雪到三月中旬就融化了。
Melt the chocolate slowly so that it doesn't burn.  将巧克力慢慢融化，这样就不会烧焦。
The meat's beautifully cooked - it melts in your mouth (= is so pleasantly soft that you do not need to chew it).  肉煮得极好——柔嫩可口。verb

words.meaning: n.曲线,弯曲(物) v.弄弯,成曲形
words.example: The road curves round to the left.  道路转向左边。

words.meaning: n.正直,诚实;完整,完全
words.example:
No one doubted that the president was a man of the highest integrity.  没有人怀疑会长是个光明磊落的人。
Keen to preserve his artistic integrity, he refused several lucrative Hollywood offers.  他十分重视保持自己的艺德，几次拒绝了好莱坞报酬丰厚的演出邀请。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.给以权利(或资格);给…称号(题名);授权
words.example:
Being unemployed entitles you to free medical treatment.  失业时，你有权享受免费医疗。
Her latest novel, entitled 'The Forgotten Sex', is out this week.  她名为《被遗忘的性别》的最新小说将于本周出版。

words.meaning: a.明显的,明白的
words.example:
The full extent of the damage only became evident the following morning.  直到第二日早上，人们才全面了解到破坏程度有多严重。
From the smell it was evident that the drains had been blocked for several days.  散发出的气味证明下水道显然已经被堵塞好几天了。
Harry's courage during his illness was evident to everyone.  生病期间哈利表现出的勇气大家有目共睹。

words.meaning: n.逻辑,逻辑学
words.example:
If prices go up, wages will go up too - that's just logic.  如果物价上涨，工资也要增长——这样才合乎逻辑。
There's no logic in the decision to reduce staff when orders are the highest for years.  在这些年来，订单最多的时候决定裁员，一点都不合乎逻辑。
The internal logic of her argument is undeniable.  不可否认的是，她的论点具有内在逻辑性。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.本质,实质
words.example:
The essence of his argument was that education should continue throughout life.  他的观点的要旨是教育应该持续终生。
Yet change is the very essence of life.  然而变迁正是人生的本质。
In essence, both sides agree on the issue.  从本质上说，双方在这个问题上的意见是一致的。

words.meaning: v.拒绝,把…排除在外,排斥
words.example:
Women are still excluded from the club.  这间俱乐部仍然不让女性进入。
Microbes must, as far as possible, be excluded from the room during an operation.  在手术过程中，要尽可能防止细菌进入手术室。
Tom has been excluded from school (= he is not allowed to go to school) for bad behaviour.  汤姆因为行为不正被学校开除了。    Compare include

words.meaning: a.粗糙的;(声音)刺耳的;苛刻的,严酷的
words.example:
The children had had a harsh upbringing.  孩子们的家教很严。
We thought the punishment was rather harsh for such a minor offence.  我们认为对这样的小错，这种惩罚太严酷了。
"There is no alternative, " she said in a harsh voice.  “没有选择的余地。”她用生硬的口气说道。

words.meaning: n.(壁)橱a.私下的vt.把…引进密室会谈
words.example:
The President is closeted with (= having a private meeting with) his advisers.  总统与他的顾问在密谈。UK adjective [before noun]
Dole portrayed the president in campaign speeches as a 'closet liberal'.  杜尔在竞选演讲中将总统描绘为“藏而不露的自由主义者”。

words.meaning: v.致敬,敬意,迎接;扑(鼻),入(耳),触(目)
words.example:
He greeted me at the door.  他在门口迎接我。
The unions have greeted the decision with delight/anger.  工会听到这个决定非常高兴／愤怒。
As we walked into the house, we were greeted by a wonderful smell of baking.  我们一进屋，一股烘烤食物的香味扑鼻而来。

words.meaning: a.内部的,里面的 n.内部,内地
words.example:
The estate agent had pictures of the house from the outside but none of its interior.  房地产经纪人有这栋房子的外观照片，但没有其内部的照片。
The car's interior is very impressive - wonderful leather seats and a wooden dashboard.  这款汽车的内部看上去很气派——优质的皮座椅及木制的仪表板。    Compare exterior
The interior walls have patches of damp on them.  内墙上有片片湿斑。

words.meaning: n.走廊,通道
words.example: Her office is at the end of the corridor.  她的办公室在走廊尽头。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.零售
words.example:
The job is open to applicants with over two years' experience in retail.  这份工作面向有两年以上零售经验的求职者。
The clothing company has six retail outlets (= shops) in south-eastern Australia.  这间服装公司在澳大利亚东南部地区开设了六家零售店。
The company makes and retails moderately priced sportswear.  这间公司生产和零售价格适中的运动服。

words.meaning: n.三月(略作 Mar.)
words.example:
My birthday is on the eleventh of March/March the eleventh/ mainly USMarch eleventh.  我的生日是3月11日。
He retired last March/is retiring next March.  他在刚过去的／将在下一个三月退休。
The meeting will be one day in/during March.  会议将在三月份的某一天召开。

words.meaning: n.蛇
words.example:
He's terrified of being bitten by a snake.  他很害怕被蛇咬。
The river snakes through some of the most spectacular countryside in France.  这条河蜿蜒穿过法国一些最美丽的乡村地区。
The queue for tickets snaked all the way around the block.  买票的队伍弯弯曲曲地一路排到了与这条街交叉的另一条街上。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: v.原谅,宽恕,免除 n.借口,辩解
words.example:
Please excuse me for arriving late - the bus was delayed.  我来迟了，请原谅——因为公车延误了。
Nothing can excuse that sort of behaviour.  无论如何那种行为都是不可原谅的。
No amount of financial recompense can excuse the way in which the company carried out its policy.  这间公司竟如此执行制度，这种行为无论赔多少钱都不能宽恕。

words.meaning: n.猪,猪肉;猪一般的人(指肮脏,贪吃的人)
words.example:
The meat produced from a pig is called pork, bacon or ham.  从猪身上取得的食用肉品有鲜猪肉、熏咸肉和火腿。
He was an absolute pig to her.  对她来说他讨厌至极。
He's a real pig of a man.  他这人真讨厌。

words.meaning: a.经典的,古典(文学)的
words.example:
The mature works of Haydn, Mozart, Beethoven and Schubert belong to the Classical period.  海顿、莫劄特、贝多芬和舒伯特的晚年成熟作品均创作于欧洲古典音乐时期。
Do you prefer classical music like Mozart and Mahler, or pop?  你喜欢莫劄特和马勒这样的古典音乐还是流行音乐？adjective
Does she study classical ballet or modern ballet?  她学的是古典芭蕾还是现代芭蕾？

words.meaning: n.失业,失业人数
words.example: Unemployment has fallen/risen again for the third consecutive month.  失业人数连续第三个月上升／下降。

words.meaning: n.(=civilisation)文明,文化
words.example:
Some people think that nuclear war would mean the end of civilization.  有人认为核战争将意味著文明的终结。
Cuzco was the centre of one of the world's most famous civilizations, that of the Incas.  库斯科是世界上最著名的文明之一，即印加文明的中心。
How does it feel to be back in civilization after all those weeks in a tent?  在帐篷里住了这么多星期，重返舒适的文明世界，感觉如何？noun (ALSO UK usually civilisation)

words.meaning: v.折叠;合拢;抱住 n.褶,褶痕;羊栏;信徒
words.example:
He had a neatly folded handkerchief in his jacket pocket.  他的上衣口袋里有一方叠得整整齐齐的手帕。
Will you help me to fold (up)the sheets?  你能帮我把床单叠起来吗？
She folded her baby in a blanket.  她把婴儿裹在一块毯子里。

words.meaning: n.相反;背面 a.相反的 v.颠倒,倒转
words.example:
She reversed the car into the parking space.  她把车倒进停车位。
The new manager hoped to reverse the decline in the company's fortunes.  新经理希望能够扭转公司江河日下的状况。
Now that you have a job and I don't, our situations are reversed.  你找到了工作，我倒没有工作了，我们的情况正好相反。

words.meaning: a.漏掉的,失去的,失踪的
words.example:
Her father has been missing since September 1992.  她父亲从1992年9月起就下落不明。
The burglars have been arrested but the jewellery is still missing.  盗贼已经被捕，但珠宝仍下落不明。
When did you realise that the money was missing from your account?  你在甚么时候发现钱从你的帐户上消失？

words.meaning: n.人类,人性,人情;(pl.)人文科学
words.example:
The massacre was a crime against humanity.  这次大屠杀是有违人道的罪行。UK noun
If only he would show/display a little humanity for once.  但愿他这次能表现出一点人性。UK noun
I've always been more interested in the humanities than the sciences.  我一直对人文学科比对自然科学更感兴趣。

words.meaning: n./a.闪光(的) v.发闪光,闪亮;闪现
words.example:
Stop flashing that light in my eyes!  别拿那个手电筒晃我的眼睛了！
The lightning flashed and distant thunder rolled.  电光闪过，远处雷声隆隆。
You'd better slow down, that car was flashing (its lights) at you.  你最好减速，那辆车正朝你闪车灯呢。

words.meaning: a.可靠的,可信赖的,确实的
words.example:
Is your watch reliable?  你的表准吗？
Gideon is very reliable - if he says he'll do something, he'll do it.  吉迪恩为人很可靠——他说到做到。    Opposite unreliable

words.meaning: n.刺激,激动,兴奋
words.example:
Robin's heart was pounding with excitement.  罗宾的心激动得怦怦跳。
If you want excitement, you should try parachuting.  如果你想寻求刺激，应该去试一下跳伞。

words.meaning: n.牛肉
words.example:
The spaghetti sauce is made with UK minced / US ground beef.  这种意粉的调味汁是用牛肉碎做成的。
People in England often have roast beef and Yorkshire pudding for lunch on Sundays.  英国人在星期天的午餐，通常是吃烤牛肉和约克郡布丁。
He is a beef cattle farmer.  他专门饲养菜牛。noun

words.meaning: n.建筑,建筑学;建筑式样或风格,建筑物
words.example: to study architecture  学习建筑学

words.meaning: a.偶然的,非经常的,特殊场合的;临时的
words.example: He has the occasional cigar after dinner.  他饭后偶尔抽支雪茄。

words.meaning: n.肘,(衣服的)肘部vt.用肘推,用肘挤
words.example:
Her arm was bandaged from the elbow to the fingers.  她的手臂从肘部一直到手指全部缠上了绷带。
The sleeve of his shirt was torn at the elbow.  他衬衫的肘部被撕了个洞。UK noun countable
During the visit, the interpreter was always at her elbow.  在她参观的过程中，翻译始终紧随其后。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.致命的;势不两立的; 极度的;必定的
words.example:
The party was deadly.  那个派对非常乏味。adjective
They have been deadly enemies ever since Mark stole Greg's girlfriend.  自从马克抢走了葛列格的女朋友后，他们两人就成了死对头。adverb

words.meaning: v.使混乱,混淆
words.example:
You're confusing him! Tell him slowly and one thing at a time.  你把他搞糊涂了！慢慢跟他讲，一次说一件事。
Stop confusing the issue (= making the problem unnecessarily difficult) !  别再把事情越搞越乱！
You're confusing me with my sister, - she's the one studying drama.  你把我当成我姐姐了——她才是学戏剧的那个。

words.meaning: a.每月的 ad.每月一次,按月 n.月刊
words.example: Most of these people are paid monthly.  这些人大多数按月领薪。noun countable

words.meaning: n.鸭,鸭肉 v.迅速俯身;快速低头;躲避
words.example:
[as form of address] Come and sit beside me, duck.  过来坐我边上，乖乖。noun
He took to fatherhood like a duck to water.  他天生就是个好父亲。verb
Duck your head or you'll bang it on the doorframe.  请低头以免撞到门框。

words.meaning: n.剂量,一服,一剂 v.(给…)服药
words.example:
The label says to take one dose three times a day.  标签上写着每次一剂，每日三次。
Twenty or thirty of these pills would be a lethal dose (= enough to kill you).  二三十粒这样的药丸就会达到致命剂量。
The government received a hefty dose of bad news this week.  本周政府得到了许多坏消息。

words.meaning: v.恳求,请求;为…辩护;提出…为理由
words.example:
He was on his knees, pleading for mercy/forgiveness.  他跪在地上，乞求宽恕／原谅。
She appeared on television to plead with the kidnappers.  她出现在电视上，向绑架者求情。
legal The defendant pleaded not guilty/innocent to robbery with violence.  被告不承认暴力抢劫。

words.meaning: vt.开始,创始,发动;启蒙,使入门;引入
words.example:
Who initiated the violence?  谁先使用暴力的？verb transitive /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/
At the age of eleven, Harry was initiated into the art of golf by his father.  哈里11岁时，他的父亲教他高尔夫球基本技巧。
Each culture had a special ritual to initiate boys into manhood.  每种文化都有特殊的男孩成人礼。noun countable /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.ət/    formal

words.meaning: n./v.演讲,讲课
words.example:
We went to a lecture on Italian art.  我们去参加了一个关于义大利艺术的讲座。
Who's giving the lecture this afternoon?  今天下午的讲座由谁来讲？    Compare seminar
My dad gave me a lecture on the evils of alcohol last night.  昨天晚上爸爸教训了我一顿，给我讲了酒的危害。UK verb

words.meaning: n.海湾,(港)湾
words.example:
We sailed into a beautiful, secluded bay.  我们驶进了一个美丽、僻静的海湾 。
Visitors must park their cars in the marked bays.  来访者必须把车停在划定的区域内。
Exercise can help keep fat at bay.  锻炼身体有助于防止变胖。noun countable

words.meaning: n.市郊,郊区
words.example:
Box Hill is a suburb of Melbourne.  博克斯希尔属于墨尔本的近郊住宅区。
We drove from middle-class suburbs to a very poor inner-city area.  我们从中产阶级的近郊住宅区驱车前往市中心的贫民区。
The company decided to relocate to the suburbs because the rent was much cheaper.  公司决定搬到城郊去，因为那里的租金便宜得多。

words.meaning: n.三明治,夹肉面包 v.夹入,挤进
words.example: On the train I was sandwiched between two very large men.  在火车上，我被两个壮汉夹在中间。verb

words.meaning: n.大衣箱,皮箱;(汽车后部)行李箱;树干,躯干
words.example:
He's got a thick trunk.  他的躯干很结实。noun
Her husband's dismembered body was later discovered in the trunk of her car.  她丈夫被肢解的尸体后来在她汽车的行李箱中找到了。

words.meaning: n.(rumour)传闻,谣言
words.example: The rumor spread quickly through the office.  谣言很快传遍了办公室。

words.meaning: n.燕子;吞咽vt.吞,咽;轻信;忍受;vi.咽口水
words.example:
My throat is so sore that it really hurts when I swallow.  我的喉咙很痛，吞咽起来很难受。
He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.  他把一颗葡萄放进嘴里，整个吞了下去。
An increasing amount of the countryside is being swallowed (up) by the town.  越来越多的乡村被城镇吞并。

words.meaning: vt.促动;激励,鼓励,作为…的动机
words.example:
Like so many people, he's motivated by greed.  像许多人一样，他为贪婪所驱使。
He is genuinely motivated by a desire to help people.  他做事完全是出于助人之心。

words.meaning: v.使得,致使;提出,提供,呈报
words.example:
New technology has rendered my old computer obsolete.  新技术发展太快，我的旧电脑已经过时了。
She is rendering the book into English from French.  她正在把这本书从法语译成英语。UK verb transitive
The singers rendered the song with enthusiasm.  歌手们热情洋溢地演唱了这首歌。

words.meaning: n.陷阱,圈套 vt.诱捕;使中圈套 vi.设圈套
words.example:
The fox got its foot caught in a trap.  狐狸的一只脚被夹子夹住了。
The undercover agents went to the rendezvous knowing that it might be a trap.  尽管知道这可能是个圈套，这些秘密特工还是去了会面地点。
She's too clever to fall into the trap of doing any unpaid work.  她这人很聪明，决不会上当去做任何没有报酬的工作。noun

words.meaning: v.限制,约束
words.example:
The government has restricted freedom of movement into and out of the country.  政府已经限制出入境自由了。
Having small children really restricts your social life.  家里有很小的孩子确实会妨碍你的社交生活。verb transitive
If I'm driving, I restrict myself to one glass of wine.  我要开车的时候，只许自己喝一杯葡萄酒。

words.meaning: n.(一块)布,织物,衣料
words.example: a piece/length of cloth  一块布料

words.meaning: ad.外观上,表面上
words.example:
He remains confident and seemingly untroubled by his recent problems.  他依然自信如初，似乎没有被最近的问题所困扰。
The factory closure is seemingly inevitable.  看来，工厂关闭势在难免。
Seemingly, she's gone off to live with another man.  看样子，她去和另外一个男人同居了。

words.meaning: v.实施,执行;强制;支持,坚持(要求,主张等)
words.example:
It isn't always easy for the police to enforce speed limits.  对员警来说，严格执行限速规定并不总是件易事。
The new teacher had failed to enforce any sort of discipline.  这位新教师一点都管不住学生，搞得纪律涣散。

words.meaning: n.透镜,镜头
words.example: a camera with a zoom lens  变焦（镜头）照相机

words.meaning: vt.借给,贷(款)
words.example:
She doesn't like lending her books.  她不喜欢把书借给别人。
The bank refuses to lend to students.  银行拒绝向学生们发放贷款。
formal These events lend support to the view that the law is inadequate.  这些事件进一步证明了法律还不健全的观点。 (lent, lent)

words.meaning: a.明白的;朴素的;坦率;平凡 n.平原,旷野
words.example:
She wore a plain black dress.  她穿着一件朴素的黑色连身裙。
We've chosen a plain carpet (= one without a pattern) and patterned curtains.  我们挑了一张没有图案的地毯和带图案的窗帘。
He prefers plain food - nothing too fancy.  他喜欢清淡简单的食物——不喜欢太花巧讲究的。

words.meaning: n.欺诈,诈骗;欺骗(行为);骗子;假货
words.example:
He is fighting extradition to Hong Kong to face trial on fraud charges.  他正在力争免于被引渡到香港就诈骗指控接受审判。UK noun
She was a psychic who was later revealed to be a fraud.  她是一个通灵巫师，后来被发现是个骗子。

words.meaning: n.同伴,共事者;伴侣
words.example:
The dog has been her constant companion these past ten years.  在过去的这十年里，这只狗一直与她形影不离。
I've still got one of the candlesticks but I've lost its companion.  我还拥有一个烛台，却把另一个配对的弄丢了。noun countable

words.meaning: v.竞争,斗争;坚决主张
words.example:
There are three world-class tennis players contending for this title.  有三位世界顶级网球选手争夺这项冠军。
He's contending against someone with twice his experience.  他在和经验比他丰富一倍的人竞争。verb
The lawyer contended (that) her client had never been near the scene of the crime.  该律师声称她的委托人从未走近过犯罪现场。verb

words.meaning: n.指甲,爪;钉 v.将…钉牢,钉住
words.example:
Hammer a nail into the wall and we'll hang the mirror from it.  在墙上钉个钉子，我们要把镜子挂在上面。noun countable
Stop biting your nails!  别再咬指甲了！
Each successive revelation of incompetence is another nail in the chairman's coffin.  接二连三地显露出不称职，是导致董事长下台的一道道催命符。

words.meaning: n.大量;排列;盛装 v.列阵;装扮;排列
words.example:
There was a splendid array of food on the table.  满桌子都是美味佳肴。
They sat before an array of microphones and cameras.  他们坐在那里，面对着无数的麦克风和摄影机镜头。verb transitive usually passive
Arrayed (= Standing in a group) before him were 40 schoolchildren in purple and green.  40名身穿紫绿两色校服的小学生列队站在他面前。

words.meaning: a.(with)严格的,严厉的;严谨的,精确的
words.example:
My parents were very strict with me when I was young.  小时候父母对我要求非常严格。
Stricter controls on air pollution would help to reduce acid rain.  加强控制空气污染将会有助于减少酸雨。
We follow very strict guidelines on the use and storage of personal details on computers.  对于电脑上个人资料的使用和储存，我们遵循极为严格的规定。

words.meaning: vt.集合,召集;装配;收集 vi.集合,聚集
words.example:
We assembled in the meeting room after lunch.  午饭后我们在会议室集合。
At the staff meeting, the manager told the assembled company (= everyone there) that no one would lose their job.  在全体员工大会上，经理对所有与会者说他们谁也不会失业。verb

words.meaning: n.鼠
words.example:
Rats carry disease.  老鼠传播疾病。
He ratted on us.  他出卖了我们。
They ratted on the deal.  他们不守信用，谈好的交易出尔反尔。

words.meaning: v.爆裂,炸破;突然发生 n.突然破裂,爆发
words.example:
Balloons make me nervous - I hate it when they burst.  气球令我感到紧张——我讨厌它们突然爆破。
The river was threatening to burst its banks.  河流有决口的危险。
Suddenly the door burst open (= opened suddenly and forcefully) and police officers carrying guns rushed in.  门突然被撞开了，员警端着枪冲了进来。

words.meaning: n.洞,穴
words.example:
Because of the explosion, the roof of the building caved in, trapping several people.  由于发生爆炸，建筑物的顶部坍塌，几个人被困在里面。
At first, they refused to sign the agreement, but they caved in when they heard another firm was being approached.  起先，他们不肯在协议上签字，但听说我们正跟另一家公司接洽就答应了。

words.meaning: a.不可避免的,必然发生的
words.example:
The accident was the inevitable consequence/result/outcome of carelessness.  这次意外是粗心导致的必然结果。
Eventually the inevitable happened and he had a heart attack.  最终不可避免的情况还是发生了——他心脏病发作。

words.meaning: n./a.西南(的),西南部(的)
words.example:
There will be rain in the Southwest.  西南部将会有雨。 (written abbreviation SW)
They moved southwest in an attempt to find better land.  他们搬到了西南部，希望能找到更好的土地。

words.meaning: n.怪物,妖怪,畸形的动植物
words.example:
You'd have to be a monster to hit a child like that.  你一定是丧失人性了，这样打一个孩子。UK noun countable
You should have seen the onions he grew for the competition - they were monsters!  你应该看看他为参加这次比赛所种的洋葱，它们都大得离奇！UK adjective [before noun] informal
Andy Smith has been monstered by the media.  安迪•史密斯受到媒体的猛烈批评。

words.meaning: a.想不到的, 意外的, 未预料到
words.example: Well, fancy seeing you here! This really is an unexpected pleasure !  哇，真想不到在这里碰上你！真是个意外之喜！

words.meaning: n.障碍(物),妨碍,阻碍,干扰
words.example:
The biggest obstacle in our way was a tree trunk in the road.  我们路上最大的障碍是横在路上的一棵树。
This decision has removed the last obstacle to the hostages' release.  这个决定清除了释放人质的最后障碍。

words.meaning: v.使变得(更)容易;使便利;推动;帮助;处进
words.example:
The new ramp will facilitate the entry of wheelchairs.  新的坡道将可方便轮椅进入。
The current structure does not facilitate efficient work flow.  当前的体系不利于实施高效的工作流程。

words.meaning: v.撕,剥,劈,锯,裂开,撕裂 n.裂口,裂缝
words.example:
His new trousers ripped when he bent down.  他弯腰时把新裤子撑开了线。
The wind ripped the flag to/into shreds (= into little pieces).  风把旗子刮成了一缕缕的破布条。
We ripped up the carpets and laid a new wooden floor.  我们拖走了地毯，铺了新木地板。 (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.药草,(调味用的)香草,草本植物
words.example: Basil, oregano, thyme and rosemary are all herbs.  罗勒、牛至、百里香和迷迭香都是香草。

words.meaning: a.势不可挡的,压倒的
words.example:
She felt an overwhelming urge/desire/need to tell someone about what had happened.  她感到有一种抑制不住的冲动／欲望／需要想告诉别人所发生的事情。
She said how much she appreciated the overwhelming generosity of the public in responding to the appeal.  她发言表达了她对公众为响应这个呼吁所表现出的极大慷慨的万分感激。
An overwhelming majority have voted in favour of the proposal.  绝大多数的人投票赞成该提议。

words.meaning: n.水晶,水晶饰品;结晶 a.水晶的,透明的
words.example:
When sea water is allowed to evaporate, salt crystals are deposited.  海水蒸发后，盐的结晶体就沉淀下来。
Cirrus clouds are composed of ice crystals.  卷云是由冰的结晶体构成的。noun
The evidence is now crystal clear.  现在证据很清楚了。

words.meaning: n.动机,目的 a.发动的,运动的
words.example:
Why would she have killed him? She has no motive.  为甚么她会杀害他？她没有动机。
Does he have a motive for lying about where he was?  他有必要隐瞒自己去过哪里吗？
What is the motive behind (= the reason for) the bombing?  轰炸的动机是甚么？

words.meaning: n.洪水,水灾 v.淹没,发大水,泛滥
words.example: The flood washed away the bridge.  洪水冲走了桥。

words.meaning: n.钢笔,圆珠笔,作家,围栏 vt.写,关入栏中
words.example:
Don't write in (= using a) pen, or you won't be able to rub out any mistakes you make.  不要用钢笔写，否则写错就擦不掉了。noun countable
He served nine years in the state pen.  他在州立监狱服刑九年。noun countable
It's time you put pen to paper and replied to that letter from your mother.  该动笔给你妈妈回信了。verb transitive (-nn-)    formal

words.meaning: n.所有(权),所有制
words.example:
Do you have any proof of ownership of/for this car?  你有证据能证明你是这辆车的车主吗？
Rates of home ownership have remained relatively constant.  拥有住房者的比率一直保持在相对稳定的水准。

words.meaning: n.恶梦;可怕的事物,无法摆脱的恐惧
words.example:
Being trapped underwater is my worst nightmare.  被困水下是我最害怕的事情。
The whole journey was a nightmare - we lost our luggage and we arrived two days late.  整个旅程就像一场噩梦——我们遗失了行李，而且迟了两天到达。

words.meaning: v.请教,向...咨询,找...商量;查阅,查看
words.example:
If the symptoms get worse, consult your doctor.  如果症状恶化就要去就医。
I'm not quite sure how to get there - I'd better consult a map.  我不是很清楚怎么去那里——我最好查查地图。
Why didn't you consult me about this?  你怎么没跟我商量这件事？

words.meaning: n.持有,拥有;所有权;所有物;(pl.)财产,财富
words.example:
The possession of large amounts of money does not ensure happiness.  拥有大量金钱并不能保证一定会幸福。
formal I have in my possession a letter which may be of interest to you.  我有一封信，也许你会感兴趣。
formal He was found in possession of explosives.  他被发现私藏爆炸物。

words.meaning: v.原谅,饶恕
words.example:
I've never found it easy to forgive and forget (= to behave as if something wrong had never happened).  我觉得不念旧恶殊为不易。
Forgive me for asking, but how much did you pay for your bag?  请原谅我问一下，你的袋子花了多少钱？

words.meaning: n.建筑物的底部,地下室,地窖
words.example: Our kitchenware department is in the basement.  我们的厨具部门设在地下室。

words.meaning: v./n.漂,漂流(物)
words.example:
No one noticed that the boat had begun to drift out to sea.  没有人注意到船已经开始漂向大海了。
After the band stopped playing, people drifted away in twos and threes.  乐队演奏结束后，人们便三三两两地散去了。
figurative The talk drifted aimlessly from one subject to another.  谈话漫无目的地从一个主题转向另一个主题。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n.排水沟,阴沟;消耗,负担 v.排去,放干
words.example:
Drain the pasta thoroughly.  把义大利面中的水完全沥干。
We drained the pond and filled it with fresh water.  我们把池塘中的水放干后重新注入清水。
Drain (off) any liquid that is left in the rice.  把大米彻底沥干。

words.meaning: n.最大值,极限 a.最大的,最高的
words.example:
The bomb was designed to cause the maximum amount of damage.  设计这种炸弹是为了造成最大程度的破坏。noun countable usually singular (plural maxima or maximums)
The temperature will reach a maximum of 27°C today.  今天最高气温将达摄氏27度。    Compare minimum

words.meaning: n.调查表,问卷
words.example: Visitors to the country have been asked to fill in a detailed questionnaire.  访问该国的游客被要求填写一份详细的调查表。

words.meaning: n.泥,泥浆 v.弄脏,使沾污泥
words.example:
The vehicles got bogged down in the heavy mud.  车辆深陷淤泥，动弹不得。
Modern houses have replaced the one-room mud huts with grass roofs that had been home to generations of peasants.  新式住房取代了农民世代居住的单间草顶土屋。
These mud flats (= level ground near the sea) are a site of special scientific interest.  这片淤泥滩有特殊的科研价值。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.基础结构,基础设施
words.example: The war has badly damaged the country's infrastructure.  战争严重破坏了该国的基础建设。

words.meaning: vi.匆忙 vt.催促;急运(派) n.急(匆)忙
words.example:
Hurry or you'll be late.  快点，否则你会迟到的。
Don't hurry your food (= Don't eat it too quickly).  吃东西不要太急。
After spending her lunch hour shopping, she hurried back (= returned quickly) to work.  利用午饭时间买完东西后，她匆忙赶回去工作。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.特权,优惠,特许 v.给予优惠,给予特权
words.example:
Healthcare should be a right, not a privilege.  医疗保健应该是权利，而非特权。
Senior management enjoy certain privileges, such as company cars and private healthcare.  高级管理阶层享受公司配车和私人医疗保健等特权。
It was a real privilege to meet her.  见到她真是莫大的荣幸。

words.meaning: n.庙宇,神殿,寺;太阳穴
words.example: The temple is over a thousand years old.  这座寺庙有一千多年历史。

words.meaning: a.室外的,野外的
words.example: Sara's not really the outdoor type.  莎拉算不上是那种真正热衷于户外运动的人。

words.meaning: v.&n.吸,舐;吸收(取)
words.example:
She was sitting on the grass sucking lemonade through a straw.  她坐在草地上，用吸管吸着柠檬汁。
They used to give you sweets to suck on (UK alsoat)in aeroplanes to stop your ears from going pop.  以前搭飞机时，他们会提供糖果供吮食，以防止耳鸣。
The waves came crashing over my head and I could feel myself being sucked under by the currents.  海浪袭来，打在我的头顶上，我能感觉到自己被水流吞噬。

words.meaning: v./n.广播(节目)
words.example:
Radio Caroline used to broadcast from a boat in the North Sea.  加罗林电台过去在北海的一艘船上广播。
The tennis championship is broadcast live to several different countries.  网球锦标赛向几个国家现场直播。
figurative I'm leaving but please don't broadcast (= tell everyone) the fact.  我要走了，但请不要到处说。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.跳,跳跃 n.跳跃,飞跃
words.example:
He leapt out of his car and ran towards the house.  他跳下车朝那所房子跑去。
The dog leapt over the gate into the field.  狗越过大门朝田野跑去。verb (leapt or leaped, leapt or leaped)
He leapt to his friend's defence.  他立即为他的朋友进行辩护。

words.meaning: a.随机的,随意的 n.随机,随意
words.example:
We asked a random sample/selection of people what they thought.  我们随机挑选一些人，问了他们的想法。
The winning entry will be the first correct answer drawn at random.  从所有给出正确答案的参赛者中，随意抽出的第一个将获得大奖。

words.meaning: n.腕,腕关节
words.example: He wears a watch on his left wrist.  他左腕戴着手表。

words.meaning: n.窗帘,门帘;幕(布);结束; vt遮掩
words.example:
Heavy curtains blocked out the sunlight.  厚厚的窗帘挡住了阳光。
They could see nothing through the curtain of rain/smoke.  透过密密的雨帘／浓浓的烟雾，他们甚么也看不到。
It'll be curtains for him, if he doesn't do what I tell him!  要是他不按我说的办，他就完了！UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.池塘
words.example: a duck pond  养鸭塘

words.meaning: n.(活动,思想等)领域,范围;领地
words.example:
She treated the business as her private domain.  她把公司看作是自己的私人势力范围。
These documents are in the public domain (= available to everybody).  这些文件已向公众开放。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.罪过,内疚
words.example:
He suffered such feelings of guilt over leaving his children.  他因为抛弃了自己的孩子而备感愧疚。
She remembered with a pang of guilt that she hadn't called her mother.  她想起没有给妈妈打电话，感到一阵强烈的内疚。noun uncountable
Both suspects admitted their guilt to the police.  两名嫌疑人都向警方认了罪。

words.meaning: n.牛;牲口,家畜
words.example: beef/dairy cattle  肉／乳牛

words.meaning: n.最小值,最低限度 a.最小的,最低的
words.example:
Wage increases are being kept to a minimum because of the recession.  由于经济衰退，工资增长的幅度被保持在最低水准。
She hoped that her fiftieth birthday would pass with the minimum of fuss.  她希望她的50岁生日能尽量安安静静地度过。
We need a minimum of ten people to play this game.  玩这个游戏我们至少需要十个人。    Opposite maximum (written abbreviation min.)

words.meaning: n.裙子;边缘,郊区
words.example:
Take the road which skirts (round) the village, not the one which goes through it.  沿村边的那条路走，不要走穿过村庄的那条路。
Though the government has promised to deal with drug abuse, it has been accused of skirting round the issue.  虽然政府承诺要解决毒品滥用问题，但还是被指责在闪躲回避。

words.meaning: v.倾倒,倾卸 n.垃圾场
words.example:
He came in with four shopping bags and dumped them on the table.  他进门后将手里提着的四个购物袋往桌上一扔。verb transitive
The tax was so unpopular that the government decided to dump it.  这项税款非常不得人心，于是政府决定将其取消。
Several old cars had been dumped near the beach.  几辆旧汽车被丢弃在海滩附近。

words.meaning: ad.从此,今后;因此
words.example:
His mother was Italian, hence his name - Luca.  他母亲是义大利人，所以他的名字叫——卢卡。adverb formal
The project will be completed at the end of the decade, two years hence.  本专案将于这个十年结束时完成，从现在算起还有两年时间。

words.meaning: n.(databank)数据库
words.example: We're linked to the on-line database at our head office.  我们连接到总部的线上资料库。

words.meaning: v.实行;实施;执行;完成;履行;处死
words.example:
He was executed for murder.  他因犯谋杀罪被处死。verb transitive
The whole play was executed with great precision.  这出戏由头到尾都表演得丝丝入扣，有板有眼。

words.meaning: n.肢,翼,大树枝
words.example:
The accident victims mostly had injuries to their lower limbs (= legs).  事故受害者大多腿上都有伤。
She's going out on a limb in criticizing her own party leadership.  她对自己所在党的领导提出的批评并没有得到大多数人的赞同。

words.meaning: n.意识形态,(政治或社会的)思想意识
words.example: The people are caught between two opposing ideologies.  民众被夹在两种对立的意识形态之间。

words.meaning: n.调子,曲调;和谐,协调 vt.调音,调节,调整
words.example:
He was humming a tune as he dried the dishes.  他边哼着调子，边擦干碗碟。
That's a very catchy (= easy to remember and pleasant) tune.  那是一首很容易上口的曲子。
I'm afraid the piano is out of tune.  恐怕这架钢琴走调了。UK noun

words.meaning: n./v.伤害,损害,危害
words.example:
Both deny conspiring to cause actual bodily harm.  两人都否认蓄意造成人身伤害。
Missing a meal once in a while never did anyone any harm.  偶尔少吃一顿饭对身体无害。
You could always ask Jim if they need any more staff in his office - (there's) no harm in asking (= no one will be annoyed and you might benefit).  你可以随时问问吉姆他们办公室里还需不需要人——问问看没坏处。

words.meaning: n.(railway)铁路 v.由铁道运输
words.example: We were railroaded into signing the agreement.  我们被迫仓促签定协定。

words.meaning: v.忍受,持久,持续
words.example:
We had to endure a nine-hour delay at the airport.  航班延误，我们不得不在机场苦等了九个小时。
She's already had to endure three painful operations on her leg.  她已经承受了三次腿部手术的巨大痛苦。UK verb
The political system established in 1400 endured until about 1650.  建立于1400年的政治体系一直沿用到1650年前后。

words.meaning: n.(牛羊等的)角;号,喇叭;角状物;角制品
words.example:
The driver blew/sounded / informalhonked her horn.  那位司机按了喇叭。
He'll have to draw in his horns now he's lost his job.  由于失业，他将不得不减少开支。UK verb
She's always horning in on our conversations.  她总是在我们说话的时候插嘴。

words.meaning: a.(疾病)慢性的;积习难改的;严重的,坏的
words.example:
There is a chronic shortage of teachers.  教师长期短缺。UK adjective
The acting was chronic.  表演很糟糕。

words.meaning: a.和平的,平静的,安宁的,爱好和平的
words.example: She hoped the different ethnic groups in the area could live together in peaceful co-existence.  她希望该地区不同的种族群体能和平共处。adjective

words.meaning: n.改革,革新;新观念,新方法,新发明
words.example: the latest innovations in computer technology  电脑科技最新的发展

words.meaning: v.拉紧;紧张;扭伤;竭尽全力 n.拉紧;负担
words.example:
The hurricane put such a strain on the bridge that it collapsed.  在飓风强大的威力之下，桥塌了。
As you get older, excess weight puts a lot of strain on the heart.  随着年龄的增长，体重过重会给心脏造成很大负担。
Their constant arguments were putting a strain on their marriage.  他们持续不断的争吵使他们的婚姻关系非常紧张。

words.meaning: n.吉他 vi.弹吉他
words.example: He sat on the grass, strumming his guitar.  他坐在草地上弹着吉他。

words.meaning: n.取代,替换,替换物,代替物
words.example: The agency sent a replacement for the secretary who resigned.  代理行派来了一个人接替辞职的秘书。

words.meaning: v.举止,举动,表现;运转,开动
words.example:
She always behaves well/badly when her aunts come to visit.  每当她姨妈来作客时，她总是表现很好／很差。
Whenever there was a full moon he would start behaving strangely.  每当月圆之时他就怪怪的。

words.meaning: v.施行,实施;掌管,料理...的事务;给予
words.example:
The country was administered by the British until very recently.  直到不久前，这个国家还由英国人来管辖。
The economy has been badly administered by the present government.  现任政府一直不善处理经济工作。UK verb
Tests will be administered to schoolchildren at seven, twelve and sixteen years.  7岁、12岁和16岁的学生将接受测试。

words.meaning: n.垫,衬垫;便笺簿 v.加上衬垫
words.example:
Footballers often wear shin pads to protect their legs.  足球运动员经常穿护膝以保护双腿。
In the 1980s, shoulder pads were very fashionable in women's clothes.  20世纪80年代，女性服装非常流行使用垫肩。
She wiped her eye make-up off with a cotton wool pad.  她用卸妆棉擦去了眼影。noun countable

words.meaning: n.播送,发射;传动,传送
words.example:
We apologize for the interruption to our transmissions this afternoon.  我们为今天下午广播节目的中断表示歉意。UK noun
The car had a faulty transmission.  这辆汽车的传动装置出现故障。

words.meaning: vt.等候,期待;(事情等)降临于
words.example:
He's anxiously awaiting his test results.  他正焦急地等待着他的测试结果。
The long/eagerly awaited sequel is now available on video.  大家期待已久的续集的录影带已经上市。

words.meaning: n.扳机 vt.触发,引起
words.example:
It's not clear who actually pulled the trigger.  不清楚究竟是谁扣动的扳机。UK noun
There are fears that the incident may be a trigger for further violence in the capital.  有人担心，这次事件可能在首都引发进一步的暴力活动。UK verb transitive
Some people find that certain foods trigger their headaches.  有些人发现某些食物导致他们头痛。

words.meaning: v.溢出,溅出 n.摔下,跌下
words.example:
You've spilt something down your tie.  你把甚么东西洒在领带上了。
Let's see if I can pour the juice into the glass without spilling it.  来试试看我能不能一滴不漏地把果汁倒进玻璃杯里。
He dropped a bag of sugar and it spilt all over the floor.  他把一袋糖掉在地上，撒得地板上到处都是。

words.meaning: a.(to,for)感激的;感谢的
words.example:
I'm so grateful (to you) for all that you've done.  你为我做了这一切，我（对你）真是感激不尽。
If you could get that report finished by Thursday I'd be very grateful.  如果你能在星期四之前完成那份报告，我将感激不尽。
After the earthquake we felt grateful to be alive.  地震后，我们大难不死，真是应该感谢上苍。

words.meaning: n.优美,文雅;恩惠,恩泽;宽限,缓刑;感恩祷告
words.example:
Joanna has natural grace and elegance.  祖安娜举止自然优雅。noun
They accepted their defeat with good grace.  他们很有风度地认输了。
Ken is sadly lacking in social graces.  糟糕的是，肯在社交场合很没有风度。noun

words.meaning: n.殖民地;侨民;聚居区;(动植物的)群体
words.example: Australia and New Zealand are former British colonies.  澳大利亚和纽西兰从前是英国的殖民地。

words.meaning: v.(经审讯)证明…有罪,宣判…有罪 n.囚犯
words.example: He has twice been convicted of robbery/arson.  他两次被判犯有抢劫罪／纵火罪。    Compare acquitnoun countable UK US [ˈkɑːn-/

words.meaning: n.毛巾 vt.用毛巾擦或擦干
words.example:
She came downstairs after her shower, wrapped in a towel.  她淋浴后裹着毛巾走下楼来。
The school provides paper towels for the children to dry their hands on.  学校给孩子提供纸巾擦亁手。noun countable
Three of the original five candidates for the Democratic presidential nomination have now thrown in the towel.  原来竞争民主党总统候选人提名资格的五人中，有三位已经放弃了。verb transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)

words.meaning: v.更改,修改,修饰
words.example:
Instead of simply punishing them, the system encourages offenders to modify their behaviour.  这个制度并不是单单惩罚犯罪者，而是鼓励他们改正自己的行为。
The proposals were unpopular and were only accepted in a modified form.  这些建议不受欢迎，修改之后才得以接受。UK verb transitive
In the sentence 'She ran quickly', the adverb 'quickly' modifies the verb 'ran'.  在句子 She ran quickly 中，副词 quickly 修饰动词ran。

words.meaning: n.粒子,微粒;极小量;小品词,虚词
words.example:
In the sentence 'I tidied up the room', the adverb 'up' is a particle.  在句子 I tidied up the room 中，副词 up 是个小品词。UK noun
Dust particles must have got into the motor.  马达一定是进尘了。
Electrons are atomic particles.  电子是原子粒子。

words.meaning: n.奖赏,奖金,奖品 v.珍视,珍惜
words.example:
The critics' prize for best film was won by Marc Abbott for 'Belly Laugh'.  马克•阿博特的《捧腹大笑》被评论家们评为最佳影片。
The first (= main) prize is a weekend for two in Bruges.  头奖是布鲁日双人周末游。
The prize money for literary competitions can be as high as £40 000.  文学创作竞赛的奖金可能高达四万英镑。

words.meaning: n./ vt.提升;增加;抬高(价格);支援;
words.example:
The theatre managed to boost its audiences by cutting ticket prices.  剧院设法透过降低票价来增加观众数量。
Share prices were boosted by reports of the President's recovery.  总统康复的报导导致股票价格上扬。
The lowering of interest rates will give a much-needed boost to the economy.  利率的下调将会给经济注入急需的推动力。

words.meaning: n.球拍,球棒,短棒;蝙蝠
words.example:
You can't expect to be accepted in a new town right/straight off the bat.  你不能期望刚到一个新的城镇，就立刻被人们接受。verb (-tt-)
She smiled and batted her eyelashes at him.  她微笑着，向他眨了眨眼睛。verb (-tt-)
He batted the ball high into the air.  他发了一个高球。

words.meaning: n.惊恐;警报(器) vt.惊动,惊吓;向…报警
words.example:
If there's any trouble, raise/sound the alarm by pulling the emergency cord.  如果出现任何问题，拉紧急警报索报警。
The first two bomb alerts were false alarms, but the third was for real.  前两次炸弹警报是一场虚惊，但是第三次是真的。
Villagers have reacted with alarm to news of a proposed new road.  听说有修新路的计划，村民都十分恐慌。UK noun

words.meaning: n.节日;音乐节;戏剧节 a.节日的;快乐的
words.example: The Brighton Festival is held every year around May time.  布莱顿艺术节每年五月份左右举行。

words.meaning: v./n.紧握,抓紧;掌握
words.example:
The baby gripped my finger with her tiny hand.  婴儿的小手紧紧握住我的手指。
Old tyres won't grip (= stay on the surface of the road) in the rain very well.  在雨天，旧轮胎在路面上防滑性能不是太好。verb (-pp-)
This trial has gripped the whole nation.  这场审判引起了全国的关注。

words.meaning: a.古怪的,离奇的;怪诞的,神秘而可怕的
words.example:
He was sitting alone by a window with a weird contraption on the bench in front of him.  他独自坐在窗边，面前的长椅上摆着个奇怪的装置。
Her boyfriend's a bit weird but she's all right.  她的男朋友有点怪，不过她倒很正常。
That's weird - I thought I'd left my keys on the table but they're not there.  真奇怪——我记得把锁匙放在桌子上，但现在却不见了。

words.meaning: v.暗中破坏,逐渐削弱;侵蚀…的基础
words.example:
The President has accused two cabinet ministers of working secretly to undermine his position/him.  总统指责有两位内阁部长在暗中算计他。
Criticism just undermines their confidence.  批评只是削弱了他们的信心。

words.meaning: n.汗 v.(使)出汗
words.example:
It was so hot when we arrived in Tripoli that we started to sweat as soon as we got off the plane.  我们到达的黎波里时天气太热，我们一下飞机就开始出汗。
The prisoners were sweating with fear.  囚犯们吓得直冒汗。
informal I was so afraid, I was sweating like a pig (= sweating a lot).  我害怕极了，浑身冒汗。

words.meaning: a.外部的,外面的,外层的
words.example: outer London  外伦敦

words.meaning: a.醉酒的;(喻)陶醉的 n.酗酒者,醉汉
words.example:
I'd had a couple of glasses of wine but I certainly wasn't drunk.  我是喝了几杯酒，但肯定没喝醉。
Andy staggered in last night drunk as a lord.  昨晚安迪回来时摇摇晃晃，喝得酩酊大醉。noun

words.meaning: v.统治,管理;决定,支配
words.example:
The country is now being governed by the Labour Party.  这个国家现在由工党执政。
They accused the government of being unfit to govern.  他们指责这届政府施政无能。UK verb
Prices of goods are governed by the cost of the raw materials, as well as by the cost of production and distribution.  商品的价格不但取决于生产和行销成本，而且取决于原材料的价格。

words.meaning: n./a.东南(的),东南部(的)
words.example:
We live in the southeast.  我们住在东南部。
The Southeast is already overpopulated.  东南地区已经是人口过密了。 (written abbreviation SE)
The mountains are/lie southeast of the city.  群山位于城市的东南方。 (written abbreviation SE)

words.meaning: a.聪明的,明智的,理智的
words.example: Helen had a few intelligent things to say on the subject.  对于这个主题，海伦有一些颇有见地的想法要说。

words.meaning: conj.无论在哪里 ad.无论在哪里,究竟在哪里
words.example:
We can go wherever you like.  你想去哪里，我们就去哪里。
Wherever I go I always seem to bump into him.  无论去哪里，我似乎总是能碰见他。
All across Europe, wherever you look, marriage is in decline and divorce rates are soaring.  整个欧洲，无论在甚么地方，结婚率都在下降，而离婚率却在猛升。

words.meaning: n.(不记名)投票;投票总数;投票权 vi.投票
words.example:
Representatives were elected by ballot.  代表们是透过不记名投票选举出来的。
They decided to hold a ballot.  他们决定组织一次不记名投票。
The union decided to ballot its members on the issue.  工会决定让会员就这件事进行不记名投票。

words.meaning: n.热情,热心;狂热;积极性(for)
words.example:
One of the good things about teaching young children is their enthusiasm.  教小孩子的好处之一就是他们对甚么都充满了兴趣。
After the accident he lost his enthusiasm for the sport.  经历这场事故后，他对这项体育运动失去了热情。
One of his greatest enthusiasms was yoga.  他最热衷的活动之一就是瑜伽。

words.meaning: vt.向…提供住处;对...予以照顾性考虑
words.example:
New students may be accommodated in halls of residence.  新生可以住在学校宿舍里。
formal There wasn't enough space to accommodate the files.  没有足够的空间存放这些档案。UK verb transitive
The new policies fail to accommodate the disabled.  新政策没有照顾到残疾人士的利益。

words.meaning: v.赞扬,歌颂;表扬 n.称赞,赞美;赞美的话
words.example:
He should be praised for his honesty.  他应该因为诚实而获得表扬。
My parents always praised me when I did well at school.  我在学校里表现好时父母总是夸奖我。
He was highly praised for his research on heart disease.  他因在心脏病方面的研究而受到高度赞扬。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.损害,损伤,伤害
words.example:
She fell and injured her shoulder.  她摔伤了肩膀。
He was badly injured in the crash.  他在车祸中受重伤。
He claimed that working too hard was injuring his health.  他声称工作过度损害了他的健康。

words.meaning: n.混乱,紊乱
words.example:
Snow and ice have caused chaos on the roads.  冰雪造成道路交通秩序混乱。
Ever since our secretary walked out, the office has been in a state of total/utter chaos.  自从我们的秘书离开后，办公室就陷入了极度混乱中。
We muddled up the name labels and chaos ensued (= resulted).  我们弄乱了姓名标签，结果一片混乱。

words.meaning: a.机械的,由机构制成的;机械似的,呆板的
words.example:
The company produces mechanical parts for airplane engines.  这家公司生产飞机引擎的机械零件。
The plane appeared to have crashed because of a mechanical problem.  这架飞机看来是因机械故障而坠毁的。adjective

words.meaning: n.帆布;帆布画布,(帆布)油画
words.example: These two canvases by Hockney would sell for £500 000.  这两幅霍克尼的油画能卖到50万英镑。

words.meaning: num./a.四十 pron.四十(个,只...)
words.example: He looks about forty.  他看上去40岁上下。

words.meaning: n.门廊,门厅,(会议)休息厅
words.example: Small businesses have lobbied hard for/against changes in the tax laws.  小公司极力游说支援／反对修改税法。

words.meaning: a.深刻的,意义深远的;渊博的,造诣深的
words.example:
His mother's death when he was aged six had a very profound effect on him.  他六岁时母亲的过世对他的影响很大。
The invention of the contraceptive pill brought about profound changes in the lives of women.  避孕药的发明为女性的生活带来了重大变化。
Those two lines of poetry express perfectly the profound sadness of loss.  那两行诗贴切表达了失去亲人的深切悲痛。

words.meaning: n.(出版物的)开本,版式,格式 vt.设计;安排
words.example: The meeting will have the usual format - introductory session, group work and then a time for reporting back.  这次会议将采取常规模式——情况介绍，分组讨论，然后是反馈汇报。

words.meaning: n.特征,特点,特性
words.example:
His sense of humour is one of his better traits.  具有幽默感是他更讨人喜欢的特点之一。
Arrogance is a very unattractive personality/character trait.  傲慢是一种非常令人讨厌的性格特点。

words.meaning: n.流传,流通;通货,货币
words.example:
His ideas enjoyed wide currency during the last century.  他的思想在上个世纪广为流传。
Many informal expressions are gaining currency in serious newspapers.  许多非正式表达方法正在为严肃报刊所接受。

words.meaning: n.火鸡(肉)
words.example:
His last film was a complete turkey.  他上一部电影完全是一部失败之作。
What did you do that for, you turkey?  为甚么要那样做，你这个傻瓜？

words.meaning: n.储备(物),储备金;缄默 v.保留,储备;预定
words.example:
These seats are reserved for the elderly and women with babies.  这些座位是专留给老人和抱小孩的妇女的。
She keeps a little money in reserve (= for use if and when needed).  她留下了一些钱以备不时之需。
The librarian has put the book on reserve for me (= will keep it for me when it becomes available).  图书管理员已经替我预约了这本书。

words.meaning: n.(横)梁,桁条;(光线的)束,柱 v.微笑
words.example:
We could just pick out the path in the weak beam of the UK usuallytorch/ USflashlight.  我们借着手电筒微弱的光线，仅能勉强认清路。
The rabbit stopped, mesmerized by the beam of the car's headlights.  兔子被汽车车前大灯射出的光束迷住了眼，停了下来。
The sitting room had exposed wooden beams.  客厅顶上的木梁露出来了。

words.meaning: a.真正的,名副其实的
words.example:
If it is a genuine Michelangelo drawing, it will sell for millions.  如果这幅画是米高安哲罗（米开朗基罗）的真迹，它的售价将会达数百万。
He's a very genuine person.  他为人很真诚。
Machiko looked at me in genuine surprise - "Are you really going?" she said.  町子真的很惊讶，她看着我问道：“你果真要走吗？”adjective

words.meaning: n.拇指 v.示意要求搭车;迅速翻阅
words.example:
Can you untangle this thread for me? I'm all thumbs today.  你能帮我解开这个线结吗？我今天手指不灵活。noun countable
They've given our plan the thumbs down (= They have disagreed with our plan).  他们不赞成我们的计划。noun countable
So it's the thumbs up for Brighton's latest night club.  那么这就是对布赖顿最近开的那家夜总会表示认可了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.团结;统一,一致,整体
words.example: European political and economic unity  欧洲政治和经济的统一

words.meaning: n.妥协,折衷vi.妥协vt.危及,放弃(原则等)
words.example:
It is hoped that a compromise will be reached in today's talks.  希望今天的会谈能达成妥协。
In a compromise between management and unions, a 4% pay rise was agreed in return for an increase in productivity.  资方与工会达成和解，同意以加薪4%来作为提高生产力的回报。
The government has said that there will be no compromise with terrorists.  政府声称不会对恐怖分子让步。UK verb

words.meaning: a.令人恐惧的,可怕的;极讨厌的,糟透的
words.example:
He's got a horrible cold.  他得了重感冒。
What's that horrible smell?  是甚么气味这么难闻？
That was a horrible thing to say!  说那种话真是可恶！

words.meaning: a.独占的;排他的;孤高的;唯一的;高级的
words.example:
This room is for the exclusive use of guests.  这间房是专供客人使用的。
Is the total exclusive of service charges?  总金额是不是不包括服务费？
Some people think that uncontrolled economic growth and environmental stability are mutually exclusive.  有些人认为，无节制的经济发展和生态环境的平衡稳定是互不相容的。noun countable

words.meaning: v.散开,驱散;散布,散播
words.example:
The protesters scattered at the sound of gunshots.  听到枪声后抗议者就鸟兽散了。
The soldiers came in and scattered the crowd.  士兵进来把人群驱散了。UK verb
Scatter the powder around the plants.  把这种药粉撒在植物周围。

words.meaning: v.运送,搬运,转运;传达,传播
words.example:
His poetry conveys a great sense of religious devotion.  他的诗歌表达了献身宗教的强烈感情。
If you see James, do convey my apologies (to him).  要是你见到詹姆斯，一定要转达我（对他）的歉意。
You don't want to convey the impression that we're not interested.  你不想给人留下我们不感兴趣的印象吧。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.捻;拧;扭曲;蜿蜒曲折而行 n.拧;歪曲;曲折
words.example:
The path twists and turns for over a mile.  这条小路弯弯曲曲，长达一英里多。
She sat there nervously twisting the ring around on her finger.  她紧张地坐在那里，不停转着手指上的戒指。
She twisted her head (round) so she could see what was happening.  她扭过头来，想看看发生了甚么事。

words.meaning: n.叉,耙;叉形物;餐叉
words.example:
a knife and fork.  一副刀叉UK noun countable
a garden fork.  园艺用叉UK noun countable
When you reach a fork in the road take the right-hand path.  到了岔路口走右边那条路。UK verb

words.meaning: v.减轻,解除,援救,救济,换班
words.example:
She was given a shot of morphine to relieve the pain.  医生给她注射了一针吗啡来止痛。
She relieved her boredom at home by learning how to type.  她在家学打字来打发无聊的时光。
The council is considering banning vehicles from the town centre to relieve congestion.  市政会正在考虑禁止车辆驶入市中心，以缓解交通拥堵的问题。verb

words.meaning: n.怀疑,猜疑;一点儿,少量
words.example:
She had a nagging/sneaking suspicion that she might have sent the letter to the wrong address.  她心烦意乱地猜想／心里暗想自己可能把信寄错了地址。noun
He gave just a suspicion of a smile.  他只是微微一笑。
"I'm arresting you on suspicion of illegally possessing drugs," said the police officer.  警官说：“你涉嫌非法持有毒品，我将拘捕你。”

words.meaning: n.住处,住宅
words.example:
The Queen is in residence at the Palace this week.  女王本周在王宫驻跸。
She took up residence in Canada.  她在加拿大定居。
She took up permanent residency abroad.  她永久定居国外。

words.meaning: n.羞耻,耻辱;可耻的人(或事物) v.使羞愧
words.example:
He said he felt no shame for what he had done.  他说他并不为自己的所作所为感到羞愧。
The children hung/bowed their heads in shame.  孩子们羞愧地低下了头。
The shame of the scandal was so great that he shot himself a few weeks later.  这件丑闻让他无地自容，所以几个星期后他开枪自杀了。

words.meaning: n.签名,署名,签字
words.example: The contract needs your signature.  合同需要你签字。

words.meaning: a.令人愉快的 vt.使高兴 vi.满意;喜欢
words.example:
Harold did his best to be pleasant to the old man.  哈乐德竭力和颜悦色地对待那位老人。
It was pleasant to sit down after standing for hours.  站了好几个小时后，能坐下来真让人感到舒坦。

words.meaning: v.悬(浮),挂;暂停,取消;推迟
words.example:
The ferry service has been suspended for the day because of bad weather.  因为天气恶劣，渡船已经停开。
The President has suspended the constitution and assumed total power.  总统废除宪法，独揽大权。
When you go to the theatre, you have to be willing to suspend disbelief (= to act as if you believe that what you are seeing is real or true, although you know that it is not).  去戏院看戏时，你得对剧情深信不疑。

words.meaning: v.反抗,反叛,起义 n.叛逆者,起义者
words.example:
The rebels took over the capital and set up a new government.  叛乱分子占领了首都并成立了新政府。
He was a bit of a rebel when he was a teenager and dyed his hair pink.  他十几岁的时候有些叛逆，把头发染成了粉红色。verb intransitive /rɪˈbel/
The people rebelled against the harsh new government.  人民起来反抗这个残暴的新政府。

words.meaning: n.配偶(指夫或妻)
words.example: In 60% of the households surveyed both spouses went out to work.  在60%的受调查的家庭中，夫妻双方都外出工作。

words.meaning: a.流动的,液体的 n.流体,液体
words.example:
If you have a fever you should drink plenty of fluid(s).  如果发烧，应多喝流质。
The virus is contracted through exchange of bodily fluids.  这种病毒透过体液感染。adjective
The military situation is still very fluid.  军事局势依然很不稳定。

words.meaning: n.养老金,抚恤金
words.example:
They find it hard to live on their state pension.  他们觉得靠政府的养老金很难生活下去。
He won't be able to draw (= receive) his pension until he's 65.  他要等到65岁以后才能领取养老金。verb
Workers in the company are being pensioned off at 50.  该公司的工人到50岁时就要领养老金退休。verb

words.meaning: n.个人简历 v.再继续,重新开始;再用;恢复
words.example:
Normal services will be resumed in the spring.  春天将恢复正常服务。
The talks are due to resume today.  会谈预定今天继续进行。
Please resume your seats, as the performance will continue in two minutes.  请大家回到自己的座位上去，两分钟后演出继续。

words.meaning: a.理论(上)的
words.example: theoretical physics  理论物理

words.meaning: a.纤弱的;精致的;微妙的;灵敏的
words.example:
Peaches have delicate skins which are easily bruised.  桃子的表皮很娇嫩，容易碰伤。
Delicate plants need to be kept in a greenhouse during the winter.  娇贵的植物需要在温室里过冬。
Molly's health has always been delicate (= She becomes ill easily).  莫莉的身体一直都很娇弱。

words.meaning: n.前额;(任何事物的)前部
words.example: She's got a high forehead.  她额头很高。

words.meaning: n./vi.(球)弹起,弹回;弹起,跳起;n.弹力
words.example:
The ball bounced off the post and into the net.  球击中门柱弹进了球网。
She bounced the ball quickly.  她快速地拍球。
Her bag bounced (= moved up and down) against her side as she walked.  她走起路来身旁的袋子一颠一颠的。

words.meaning: a.电的,电学的
words.example: electrical equipment/goods/devices  电气设备／电器产品／电气装置

words.meaning: n.钩,吊钩,钩状物 v.钩住
words.example:
She told him she needed the money for her baby and he fell for it hook, line and sinker.  她告诉他，她需要这笔钱给她的孩子用，他便完全相信了。noun countable
This product has really got its hooks into the American market.  这种产品已经主导了美国市场。noun countable
John's agreed to go to the meeting in my place so that gets/lets me off the hook.  约翰答应帮我去开会，这样我就能脱身了。verb

words.meaning: n.侦探
words.example: a private detective  私家侦探

words.meaning: n.滴答声;vi.发出滴答声
words.example:
If you want to open a file, click twice on the icon for it.  如果你想开启一个档案，按两下该档案图示。
When you have selected the file you want, click the 'Open' box.  选中了你想要的档案，用滑鼠点击“开启”方框。verb
The door clicked shut behind her.  门在她身后哢嗒一声关上了。

words.meaning: n.补偿(或赔偿)的款物;补偿,赔偿
words.example:
She received £40 000 in compensation for a lost eye.  她得到四万英镑，作为对失去一只眼睛的赔偿。
You should claim/seek compensation.  你应该要求赔偿。
Free food was no compensation for a very boring evening.  免费食物并不能弥补晚会的乏味无聊。

words.meaning: n.出口,通道
words.example:
He saw Emma arrive and made a quick exit.  他见到艾玛匆匆而来又匆匆离去。
She made her exit from the stage to rapturous applause.  在观众热烈的掌声中，她退场走下舞台。    Compare entrancenoun countable
Come off the motorway at the Duxford exit.  从达克斯福德出口驶出高速公路。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: vt.奉献;献身于
words.example:
He has dedicated his life to scientific research.  他把自己的一生都奉献给科学研究工作。
The book is dedicated to the author's husband.  该书为作者的丈夫而作。verb transitive
The church was dedicated on 1st March 1805 to the local Saint Jude.  教堂于1805年3月1日落成以纪念当地的圣裘德。

words.meaning: ad.完全,总之,全部地;总共;总而言之
words.example:
That'll be £52.50 altogether, please.  一共是52.5英镑。
The government ought to abolish the tax altogether.  政府应该彻底取消这一税收。
She wrote less and less often, and eventually she stopped altogether.  她动笔的次数越来越少，最后完全停笔了。

words.meaning: n.拾起,获得
words.example: The pickup of the package takes two days.  包裹揽收需要两天。

words.meaning: v.(雕)刻
words.example:
This totem pole is carved from/out of a single tree trunk.  这根图腾柱是由一整根树干雕刻而成的。
He carved her name on a tree.  他将她的名字刻在树上。
Some of the tunnels in the cliff are natural, some were carved out (= cut into the rock) by soldiers for defensive purposes.  峭壁中的一些隧道是天然形成的，一些是士兵在石头上开凿出来用于防御的。

words.meaning: n.针,指针,针状物
words.example:
Here, your eyes are better than mine - could you thread (= put thread through) this needle for me?  来，你的眼睛比我好——帮我把线穿进这根针，好吗？
The needle on a compass always points to magnetic north.  指南针的指针总是指向磁北极。noun countable
It sounds like the needle on your record player needs to be replaced.  听上去像是唱机的唱针该换了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.肚子,腹部;(像肚子一样)鼓起的部分,膛
words.example:
He fell asleep with a full belly and a happy heart.  他吃饱喝足后，心满意足地睡着了。
Now six months pregnant, Gina's belly had begun to swell.  吉娜已有六个月身孕，肚子开始鼓起来了。
The belly of the aircraft was painted red.  机身底部漆成红色。noun countable

words.meaning: n.惊恐,恐慌v.惊吓,受惊
words.example:
Sudden noises scare her.  突然的响声把她吓了一跳。
She's very brave - she doesn't scare easily.  她很勇敢——她不会那么容易害怕的。
He scared me out of my wits (= made me extremely frightened) when he was driving so fast.  他开得那么快，把我吓得半死。

words.meaning: n.往返汽车/列车/飞机;穿梭 v.往返穿梭
words.example:
To get across town, you can take the shuttle from Times Square to Grand Central.  要穿越市区，你可以乘坐从时代广场穿梭到中央车站的公车。
The American (space) shuttle can be used many times to put payloads in space.  美国的太空梭可以多次使用，向太空运送物品。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.看不见的,无形的
words.example:
The aircraft is designed to be invisible to radar.  这种飞机的设计目的是能躲过雷达探测。
These bacteria are invisible unless viewed with a microscope.  这些细菌只有用显微镜才能看得见。
Tourism brings in 40% of the island's invisible earnings.  旅游业为该岛带来了40%的无形收益。

words.meaning: n.约会,约定;婚约,订婚
words.example:
They announced their engagement at the party on Saturday.  他们在周六的派对上宣布了他们订婚的消息。
I'm afraid I have a previous/prior engagement (= another arrangement already made).  对不起，我已经有约了。noun]ɪnˈgeɪdʒ.mənt/

words.meaning: n.足踝,踝关节
words.example: My ankle swelled after the fall.  摔倒后我的脚踝肿了。

words.meaning: n.办理,处理;交易,事务;(pl.)会报,学报
words.example:
Each transaction at the foreign exchange counter seems to take forever.  外币兑换柜枱的每笔交易似乎都要花很长时间。
We need to monitor the transaction of smaller deals.  我们需要监控规模较小的交易。

words.meaning: v./n.营救,援救
words.example:
The lifeboat rescued the sailors from the sinking boat.  救生艇将水手们从正在下沉的船上救起。
The government has refused to rescue the company from bankruptcy.  政府已经拒绝援助这间濒于破产的公司。noun countable or uncountable
Lifeboats carry out many rescues every month.  救生艇每月都会执行很多救援任务。

words.meaning: n.对应的人(或物)
words.example: The Prime Minister is to meet his European counterparts to discuss the war against drugs.  首相将会见欧洲各国首脑就打击毒品犯罪进行商讨。

words.meaning: a.温和的,轻微的,味淡的,不含有害物质的的
words.example:
She can't accept even mild criticism of her work.  即使别人对她的作品略有微词，她也不能接受。
He has suffered a mild heart attack - nothing too serious.  他只是轻微的心脏病发作，并不太严重。adjective
We've had a mild winter this year.  我们今年过了个暖冬。adjective

words.meaning: n.玩偶,玩具娃娃
words.example: I'm not going to doll myself up just to go to the shops.  我不会就为了去趟商店而特意打扮一番。    dolled up

words.meaning: n.中午,正午
words.example:
We used to ski before noon then take a long lunch.  我们过去经常在中午之前滑雪，然后悠闲地吃午餐。
By noon, we had had ten phone calls.  到中午，我们已经接了十个电话。

words.meaning: prep.在…中间,在…之中,被…围绕
words.example:
On the floor, amid mounds of books, were two small envelopes.  地板上的书堆里有两个小信封。
The new perfume was launched amidst a fanfare of publicity.  这种新香水在一阵大张旗鼓的广告宣传下推出市场。

words.meaning: a.(to.with)同一的,同样的
words.example:
I've got three identical blue suits.  我有三套完全相同的蓝色西装。
The two rooms were virtually identical.  这两个房间几乎一模一样。
The interests of both parties may not be identical, but they do overlap considerably.  双方的利益可能并不完全相同，但的确也有很多重合之处。

words.meaning: a.精确的,准确的
words.example:
The bunker's precise location is a closely guarded secret.  掩体的确切位置严格保密。
He caught me at the precise moment that I fainted.  他正好在我晕倒的那一刻抓住了我。
There was a good turnout for the meeting - twelve of us to be precise.  出席会议的人不少——确切地说有我们12个人。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.焦虑的,担心的;急于(得到的),渴望的
words.example:
My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.  如果我们说好回家却没有回去，我母亲总会有些担心。
The drought has made farmers anxious about the harvest.  这场旱灾使农民因担心收成而焦虑不安。adjective
Developing countries which are anxious for hard currency can rarely afford to protect the environment.  急于获得强势货币的发展中国家很难顾及环保问题。

words.meaning: vt.诊断(疾病);判断(问题)
words.example:
The specialist diagnosed cancer.  那位专家作出的诊断是癌症。
His condition was diagnosed as some sort of blood disorder.  他的病被诊断为某种血液病。
She was diagnosed with/as having diabetes.  她被查出患有糖尿病。

words.meaning: n.碳水化合物; 糖类;(plural)淀粉质或糖类
words.example: Rice is a carbohydrate.  米饭是碳水化合物。

words.meaning: n.自由,自由权;特权
words.example:
For most citizens, liberty means the freedom to practise their religious or political beliefs.  对大多数公民而言，自由意味着可以不受限制地信奉自己的宗教或政治信仰。
Hundreds of political prisoners are to be given their liberty (= released from prison).  数百名政治犯将获得自由。
Of the ten men who escaped this morning from Dartmoor Prison, only two are still at liberty (= free or not yet caught).  今晨从达特摩尔监狱逃跑的十人当中，目前只有两人依然在逃。

words.meaning: n海报,张贴的大幅广告
words.example:
The children put up posters on the classroom walls.  孩子们在教室的墙上张贴了海报。
We noticed a poster advertising a circus.  我们看到一张马戏演出的海报。

words.meaning: v./n.爬行,蠕动;缓慢(的)行进
words.example:
The child crawled across the floor.  那个孩子爬过了地板。
The injured soldier crawled to safety.  受伤的士兵慢慢爬向安全的地方。
The lorry crawled noisily up the hill.  货车轰轰隆隆吃力地爬上山坡。

words.meaning: n.氧,氧气
words.example: Plants release oxygen during the day.  植物白天释放氧气。

words.meaning: a.漂亮的,英俊的;慷慨的,数量可观的
words.example:
She's dreaming she'll be whisked off her feet by a tall, dark handsome stranger.  她梦想自己被一位高大黝黑的英俊陌生男子迷得神魂颠倒。
They made a handsome profit on their house.  他们利用自己的房子赚了一大笔钱。

words.meaning: n.总数,和;金额;算术题;要旨 v.合计,总计
words.example:
Huge sums of money are spent on national defence.  巨额的钱财都投入到国防上。
He'll get £50 000 from the company when he retires, which is a tidy (= large) sum.  他退休的时候会从公司拿到五万英镑，这可不是一个小数目。
humorous I worked for three whole weeks for which I received the princely (= very low) sum of $100.  我整整工作了三周，却只得到可怜兮兮的100美元。noun

words.meaning: conj.倘若,只要,假如
words.example: We'll start provided everybody agrees.  只要大家都同意我们就开工。

words.meaning: a.有希望的,有前途的
words.example:
They won the award for the most promising new band of the year.  他们赢得了该年度最有前途新进乐团奖。
It's a great restaurant but it doesn't look at all promising from the outside.  这间餐厅棒极了，不过从外面看可一点都看不出来。    Opposite unpromising

words.meaning: a.(of)意识到的,自觉的;神志清醒的
words.example:
The tooth doesn't exactly hurt, but I'm conscious of it (= I can feel it) all the time.  牙齿并不痛 ，可是我总觉得不舒服。
He's still conscious but he's fairly badly injured.  他神志还清醒，但伤得很重。
They've brought her out of the operating theatre, but she's not fully conscious yet.  他们把她推出了手术室，可是她还没有完全清醒。

words.meaning: pron.[she的物主代词]她的(所有物)
words.example: Nicky and I both have red hair but hers is lighter than mine.  尼基和我的头发都是红色，但她的颜色稍浅一些。

words.meaning: n.爵士乐
words.example:
They sell televisions and radios and all that jazz.  他们经销电视、收音机之类的商品。verb
Jazz the dress up with some bright accessories.  用些鲜艳的饰物为连身裙增色。
He jazzed up the food with a spicy sauce.  他用辣酱使食物更美味。

words.meaning: n.歌剧
words.example:
'Carmen' is my favourite opera.  《卡门》是我最喜爱的歌剧。
I've never been a huge fan of opera.  我对歌剧一向不是很着迷。
He goes to the opera (= to see an opera) whenever he can.  他一有机会就去看歌剧。

words.meaning: n.取得,学到,养成(习惯);获得的东西
words.example:
The acquisition of huge amounts of data has helped our research enormously.  我们获得的大量数据对我们的研究有莫大的帮助。
The museum has been heavily criticized over its acquisition of the four-million-dollar sculpture.  该博物馆因为购置了一件价值400万美元的雕塑而备受批评。

words.meaning: n.坑,陷阱;煤矿,矿井
words.example:
They'd dug a shallow pit and left the bodies in it.  他们挖了一个浅坑把尸体扔在里面。
These pits in my skin are from when I had chickenpox.  我皮肤上的麻子是我出水痘时留下的。
The coal-mining industry wants new pits to be opened.  煤矿业需要开凿新的矿井。

words.meaning: v./n.热烈拥抱,紧抱
words.example:
Have you hugged your child today?  你今天拥抱过你的孩子没有？
They hugged each other when they met at the station.  他们在车站碰面时互相拥抱。
Emily hugged her teddy bear tightly to her chest.  艾蜜莉把她的泰迪熊紧紧抱在胸前。

words.meaning: v.惩罚,处罚
words.example:
Those responsible for these crimes must be brought to court and punished.  那些该为罪行负责的人必须被送上法庭接受惩罚。
He punished the class by giving them extra work.  他给这班学生多派了些作业作为对他们的惩罚。
The oil company was found guilty on ten counts of pollution, and was punished with a $250 million fine.  这家石油公司被判犯了十项污染环境的罪状，被罚款2.5亿美元。

words.meaning: n.门口
words.example: She stood in the doorway smiling.  她微笑着站在门口。

words.meaning: n.离开,起程
words.example:
