There are several departures (= buses, trains, ships or aircraft leaving) for Paris every day.  每天都有几班次去巴黎。
Our departure was delayed because of bad weather.  由于天气不好，我们的出发时间延后了。
Everyone in the office was surprised by Graham's sudden departure.  格雷厄姆的突然离职让办公室里的每个人都感到非常意外。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.电梯,升降机
words.example: The elevator is out of order.  电梯坏了。

words.meaning: n.引导,指导
words.example: I've always looked to my father for guidance in these matters.  在这些问题上我总是依靠父亲指点迷津。

words.meaning: n.塑像,雕像
words.example: They planned to put up/erect a statue to the President.  他们计划为总统设一尊雕像。

words.meaning: n.追赶,追求;职业,工作
words.example:
Three people have been killed in high-speed pursuits by the police recently.  有三人在最近员警的高速追捕中毙命。
The robbers fled the scene of the crime, with the police in pursuit.  抢劫者逃离了犯罪现场，员警紧追不舍。UK noun
The company is ruthless in its pursuit of profit.  公司为追求利润毫不放松。

words.meaning: n.修理,修补 v.补救,纠正;修理
words.example:
The garage said the car was so old it wasn't worth repairing.  修车厂的人说这辆车太旧，不值得修了。
Is it too late to repair the damage we have done to our planet?  现在采取措施挽回我们对地球所造成的破坏已为时太晚了吗？UK verb transitive
After dinner, we repaired to the lounge for coffee.  晚餐后，我们一起去了酒吧雅间喝咖啡。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.体面的;正派的,合乎礼仪的;合适的
words.example:
Everyone should be entitled to a decent wage/standard of living.  人人都应该有权获得像样的工资／过着体面的生活。
It was very decent (= kind) of you to help.  你能帮忙，真是个大好人啊。
It made quite a decent-sized (= large) hole.  它弄出了一个很大的洞。

words.meaning: a.口头的
words.example: When do you have your Spanish oral (= exam in spoken Spanish) ?  你们甚么时候进行西班牙语口试？

words.meaning: n.职员,办事员;店员
words.example:
The (desk) clerk checked us in and gave us our key.  （服务台的）接待员给我们办理了入住手续，然后给了我们锁匙。
Take your purchases to the (sales) clerk, and he will wrap them for you.  把你买的东西交给售货员，他会帮你包好。UK verb intransitive
Debbie has a summer job clerking in an office.  戴比暑期在一间办公室当文书。

words.meaning: n.信封,信皮;封套
words.example: The prices were very roughly calculated - it looked as though he'd done them on the back of an envelope.  计算出来的价格不很精确——看起来似乎他只是粗略算了一下。

words.meaning: n.目的地,终点
words.example:
We arrived at our destination tired and hungry.  我们到达目的地时又累又饿。
His letter never reached its destination.  他的信没有被送到收信人处。
The Caribbean is a popular tourist / UK holiday / US vacation destination.  加勒比海是人们喜爱的旅游／渡假胜地。

words.meaning: n.拳头 vt.用拳头打;紧握
words.example:
She clenched her fists.  她紧握双拳。
Protestors were shaking their fists at the soldiers.  抗议者向士兵们挥舞着拳头。

words.meaning: a.宽宏大量的,慷慨的
words.example:
She's been very generous with her time.  她不吝投入大量时间。
There's a generous (= kinder than deserved) review of the book in today's newspaper.  今天的报纸刊登了一篇书评，对该书赞赏有加。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.沐浴,洗澡;浴室(池,盆) v.(给…)洗澡
words.example:
mainly UK Susannah has a long hot bath every evening.  苏珊娜每天晚上都要美美地泡个热水澡。
mainly US I took a bath this morning.  今天早上我洗了个澡。
I'll run you a bath while you take off those wet clothes.  你把湿衣服脱掉，我帮你给浴缸放水。

words.meaning: ad.因此,从而
words.example: "Why are you limping?" "Ah, thereby hangs a tale."  “你为甚么一瘸一拐的？”“唉！说来话长。”

words.meaning: n.反馈;反应;回授
words.example:
Have you had any feedback from customers about the new soap?  有关新款肥皂你有没有收到顾客的回馈意见？
Jimi Hendrix loved to fling his guitar around to get weird and wonderful sounds from the feedback.  吉米‧罕醉克斯喜欢用力弹拨他的吉他，这样扬声器的啸声中就会传出一种怪诞奇妙的声音。
Feedback from the sensors ensures that the car engine runs smoothly.  侦测器的回馈能确保汽车引擎平稳运转。

words.meaning: n.谱,光谱,频谱;范围,幅度,系列
words.example:
The colours of the spectrum - red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet - can be seen in a rainbow.  光谱中的红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫诸色可以在彩虹中见到。 (plural spectra or spectrums)
He has support from across the whole political spectrum.  他得到了所有政治派别的支援。
The group includes students from both ends of the social spectrum (= range of social classes).  这个团体包括了来自社会上、下两个阶层的学生。

words.meaning: a.紫的 n.紫色
words.example:
Despite occasional patches of purple prose , the book is mostly clear and incisive.  这本书尽管偶尔有几段词藻华丽的文句，但总体来讲文风简洁明了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Purple is my favourite colour.  我喜欢的颜色是紫色。
The evening sky was full of purples and reds.  傍晚的天空布满紫色和红色的云彩。

words.meaning: n.激光
words.example: laser beam  雷射光束

words.meaning: a.大胆的,勇敢的;冒失的;黑体的,粗体的
words.example:
She was a bold and fearless climber.  她是一位勇敢无畏的登山者。
The newspaper made the bold move /took the bold step of publishing the names of the men involved.  该报采取大胆行动，将有关人员的名字都公布了出来。UK adjective
They painted the kitchen in bold colours - crimson, purple and blue.  他们用于粉刷厨房的油漆色彩鲜艳——有绯红色、紫红色和蓝色。

words.meaning: a.不愿的,勉强的
words.example:
Many parents feel reluctant to talk openly with their children.  很多父母都不愿意和儿女们敞开心扉交谈。
She persuaded her reluctant husband to take a trip to Florida with her.  她说服了丈夫跟她一起去佛罗里达旅游，尽管他不太情愿。

words.meaning: n.专门知识(或技能等),专长
words.example:
We admired the expertise with which he prepared the meal.  我们很羡慕他那一手烹调绝技。
She has considerable expertise in French history.  她研究法国历史有很深的造诣。

words.meaning: ad.几乎,实际上,简直
words.example:
She blamed me for practically every mistake in the report.  她几乎把报告里所有的错误都怪在我头上。
These changes would cost us practically nothing.  这些变化对我们几乎不会有任何损失。
It's practically impossible for me to get home in less than an hour.  要我在一小时内到家几乎是不可能的。

words.meaning: n.暗示,提示,线索 v.暗示,示意
words.example:
Did she give you any hints about where she was going?  她有没有向你暗示过她要去哪里呢？
You can't take (= understand) a hint, can you? Just go away and leave me alone!  你就是听不懂暗示，对不对？滚开，不要管我！noun
Could you give us a hint about how to do this exercise, please?  你能不能给我们一些关于如何做这个练习的建议？

words.meaning: n./v.游行,夸耀n.检阅,阅兵式v.使列队行进
words.example:
For three hours a committee of state senators listened to a parade of local residents giving their opinions.  整整三个小时，州参议员组成的委员会听取了一批又一批当地居民发表自己的看法。
The entire regiment was on parade.  整个军团在接受校阅。noun countable
The Saint Patrick's Day marchers paraded up Fifth Avenue, past the cathedral.  在圣派屈克节那天，游行者一路经过第五大道，途经大教堂。

words.meaning: n.王国,国土;领域
words.example:
Her interests are in the realm of practical politics.  她的兴趣在于那些需要采取具体行动去做的事情。noun countable
The matter was hotly debated in all the towns of the realm.  此事在该王国内的各个城镇都进行了激烈的讨论。noun countable

words.meaning: v.取消,把…作废;删去,划掉
words.example:
They've had to cancel tomorrow's football match because of the bad weather.  因为天气太糟，他们不得不取消了明天的足球比赛。
The 7.10 train to London has been cancelled.  7点10分开往伦敦的火车被取消了。
This month's pay cheque will cancel out his debt, but it won't give him any extra money.  这个月的工资支票将抵消他的债务，可那样他就一点钱都不剩了。

words.meaning: n.混合(物) v.混和,混杂
words.example:
Their music is a blend of jazz and African rhythms.  他们的音乐融合了爵士乐和非洲音乐。verb intransitive or transitive
Blend the ingredients into a smooth paste.  将这些原料混和成均匀的糊糊。
The cushions blend well with the colour of the carpet.  靠垫与地毯的颜色配搭得十分和谐。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: v.削皮,剥皮 n.果皮
words.example:
Peel, core and chop the apples.  把苹果去皮、去核并剁碎。verb
We peeled the wallpaper off the walls.  我们把壁纸从墙上撕了下来。
Peel off the backing strip and press the label down firmly.  撕下背垫条，将标签用力下压。

words.meaning: a.接受的,感受性强的 n.接受者,感受者,容器
words.example:
This latest cut in government spending will affect income support recipients and their families.  最近这次政府削减开支会影响到拿政府补助金的人及其家庭。
He was a recipient of the Civilian Service Award.  他被授予平民服务奖章。

words.meaning: v.犹豫,踌躇;含糊,支吾
words.example:
She hesitated slightly before answering the inspector's question.  在回答调查员的问题之前，她稍稍犹豫了一下。
"Do you love me?" she asked. He hesitated and then said, "I'm not sure".  ｢你爱我吗？｣她问道。他犹豫了一下，然后说：｢我不确定。｣

words.meaning: n./v.(使有)偏见,偏心,偏袒
words.example:
The government has accused the media of bias.  政府指责新闻媒体有偏见。
Reporters must be impartial and not show political bias.  新闻记者必须公正，不应有政治偏见。
There was clear evidence of a strong bias against her.  有明显证据显示，她受到了严重不公平的对待。

words.meaning: n.隐喻,暗喻
words.example:
'The mind is an ocean' and 'the city is a jungle' are both metaphors.  “思维是海洋”和“城市是丛林”都是隐喻。
Metaphor and simile are the most commonly used figures of speech in everyday language.  隐喻和明喻是日常语言中最常用的修辞手法。UK noun countable or uncountable
The author uses disease as a metaphor for the corruption in society.  这位作家用疾病来比喻社会中的腐败。

words.meaning: n.蜡烛
words.example: Shall I light a candle?  我点支蜡烛好吗？

words.meaning: a.司法的,法庭的,审判的;明断的,公正的
words.example: the judicial system  司法制度

words.meaning: n.实体;存在(物);组织,机构;本质
words.example:
The museums work closely together, but are separate legal entities.  这些博物馆密切合作，但它们都是独立的法人实体。
He regarded the north of the country as a separate cultural entity.  他把这个国家的北部地区视为一个独立的文化实体。

words.meaning: n.灯
words.example: an electric/oil/gas lamp  电／油／煤气灯

words.meaning: n.垃圾
words.example:
He talks a lot of garbage about education.  他废话连篇地大谈自己对教育的看法。UK noun uncountable
The meals are pretty poor but then they never use fresh ingredients - garbage in, garbage out.  这饭真难吃，因为他们从来不用新鲜材料——也难怪，垃圾进，垃圾出。

words.meaning: n.仆人
words.example: Public servants should be incorruptible.  公务员应该做到清正廉洁。

words.meaning: a.外交的,从事外交的;策略的,有手腕的
words.example: Ask him nicely - be diplomatic.  好好向他提出请求——要委婉一些。

words.meaning: a.优雅的;端庄的;雅致的
words.example: an elegant woman  举止优雅的女性

words.meaning: n.接待,招待会;接收,接受,接收效果
words.example:
The President gave a reception for the visiting heads of state.  总统举行招待会款待来访的外国元首。
Her first book got a wonderful/warm/frosty reception from the critics.  评论家对她的第一本书反应很好／热烈／冷淡。
The new hospital was ready for the reception of its first patients.  新医院已经可以用了，准备收治第一批病人。

words.meaning: n.下巴,颏
words.example:
To keep the helmet in position, fasten the strap beneath the chin.  将带子在下巴下系紧以固定好头盔。
She sat behind the table, her chin resting in her hands.  她坐在桌子后面，双手托着下巴。noun countable
Chin up! It'll soon be the weekend.  别泄气！马上就到周末了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.必要性,需要;必然性;(pl.)必需品
words.example:
You can come early if you want to, but there's no necessity for it.  如果你愿意，可以早点儿来，但不是非早来不可。
The report stresses the necessity of eating plenty of fresh fruit and vegetables.  这份报告强调大量食用新鲜水果及蔬菜的必要性。
With a personal fortune of six million pounds, she certainly doesn't work out of necessity (= because she needs to).  她有600万英镑的身家，当然不是为了生计而工作。

words.meaning: v.供认,承认,坦白,忏悔
words.example:
He confessed to sleeping /having slept through most of the film.  他承认看这出电影时，大部分时间都在睡觉。
He has confessed to the murder.  他供认了谋杀罪行。

words.meaning: a.偶然的,碰巧的;临时的,非正式的
words.example:
The psychologist's attitude seemed far too casual, even brutal.  那个心理学家的态度似乎太过冷淡了，甚至有些冷酷。
Security around the conference hotel seemed almost casual.  举行会议的饭店周围的安全措施似乎不太严格。
Although close to tears, she tried to make her voice sound casual.  尽管都快掉眼泪了，可她还是尽力使自己的声音听起来满不在乎。adjective

words.meaning: n.重力,引力;严肃,庄重
words.example: the laws of gravity  万有引力定律UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.(enrol)招收;登记;入学;参军;成为会员
words.example: About fifty students enrolled in the course.  大约五十名学生选了这门课。

words.meaning: v.缩小,减少,递减
words.example:
These memories will not be diminished by time.  这些记忆不会随着时间的流逝而淡漠。
What he did has seriously diminished him in many people's eyes.  他的所作所为严重损害了他在许多人眼里的形象。
We've seen our house diminish greatly/sharply/substantially in value over the last six months.  在最近六个月里，我们这座房屋的价格暴跌。

words.meaning: v.(minimize)使减少到最少,使降到最低
words.example:
We must minimize the risk of infection.  我们必须将感染的风险降到最低。
Environmentalists are doing everything within their power to minimize the impact of the oil spill.  环保人士正竭尽全力把石油外溢造成的影响减到最少。    Opposite maximize
She accused the government of minimizing the suffering of thousands of people.  她指责政府对成千上万的人所受的疾苦轻描淡写。

words.meaning: v.砍,劈,斩 n.排骨,肉块
words.example:
He was chopping wood in the yard.  他在院子里劈木头。
Add some fresh parsley, finely chopped.  加一些剁碎的新鲜香芹。
Chop (up) the onions and carrots roughly.  把洋葱和胡萝卜切成大块。

words.meaning: vt.隔离,孤立
words.example:
He was isolated from all the other prisoners.  他被人从其他所有囚犯隔离开来。
They tried to isolate (= find) the cause of the problem.  他们试图找出问题的原因。
specialized Virus particles were eventually isolated from the tissue.  终于将病毒粒子与组织分离开了。

words.meaning: n.详细目录,存货,财产清册,总量
words.example: Our inventory of used cars is the best in town.  我们卖的二手车是城里最好的。

words.meaning: a.生产(性)的,能产的,多产的
words.example:
In order to turn the deserts into fertile and productive land, engineers built an 800-mile canal.  为了把沙漠变成肥沃富饶的农田，工程师们修建了一条800英哩长的运河。
He had an amazingly productive five years in which he managed to write four novels.  五年内他写了四部小说，如此多产真让人难以置信。    Opposite unproductive
We had a very productive meeting - I felt we sorted out a lot of problems.  我们开了一个极有成效的会议——我觉得我们解决了很多问题。

words.meaning: n.集合;会议;装配;(美)洲议会的众议院
words.example:
She has been tipped as a future member of the Welsh Assembly.  大家预测她将会成为威尔士议会议员。
The Senate and the Assembly put aside political differences to pass the aid package.  州参众两院搁置了政治分歧，以通过有关援助的一连串计划。
All pupils are expected to attend school assembly.  所有学生都要参加学校集会。

words.meaning: n.丝,绸
words.example: a silk dress  丝绸连衣裙

words.meaning: n.大小,数量;巨大,广大
words.example: They don't seem to grasp the magnitude of the problem.  他们似乎没有领会到问题的重要性。

words.meaning: a.陡峭的;险峻的;急剧升降的vt.浸泡,沉浸
words.example:
It's a steep climb to the top of the mountain, but the view is worth it.  爬上山顶的路非常陡，不过风景非常好，值得一爬。
The castle is set on a steep hill/hillside.  城堡坐落在陡峭的山／山坡上。
There has been a steep increase/rise in prices.  物价飞涨。adjective

words.meaning: n.人质
words.example:
She was taken/held hostage by the gunmen.  她被持枪歹徒劫持作为人质。
The terrorists have seized 20 hostages and are threatening to kill one a day unless their demands are met.  恐怖分子劫持了20名人质，并威胁除非他们的要求得到满足，否则将每天杀掉一名人质。UK noun countable
The Prime Minister was extremely cautious, saying nothing inflammatory and giving no hostages to fortune.  首相极为谨慎，不说任何具有煽动性和可能在将来引起麻烦的话。

words.meaning: n.外侨,外国人;外星人 a.外国的;相异的
words.example:
When I first went to New York, it all felt very alien to me.  我初到纽约的时候，觉得一切都非常陌生。
When war broke out the government rounded up thousands of aliens and put them in temporary camps.  战争爆发时，政府把数以千计的外国人集中在一起，关在临时拘留营中。

words.meaning: a.动力的,电动的;有生气的
words.example:
She's young and dynamic and will be a great addition to the team.  她年轻活泼，会给团队增添不少活力。
We need a dynamic expansion of trade with other countries.  我们需要大力发展与其他国家的贸易。adjective

words.meaning: n.(数学)等式,方程式;(with)相等;均衡
words.example:
In the equation 3x - 3 = 15, x = 6.  在方程式 3x-3 = 15中，x = 6。
Managing the economy is a complex equation of controlling inflation and reducing unemployment.  经济管理包括控制通货膨胀、降低失业率等复杂的因素。noun
There is a tendency in films to make the equation between violence and excitement.  电影倾向把暴力和刺激画上等号。

words.meaning: n.天使,安琪儿
words.example:
According to the Bible, an angel told Mary that she would have God's son, Jesus.  据《圣经》所述，一位天使告知玛利亚她将生下上帝之子耶稣。
Be an angel and help me with this.  行行好，帮我把这个做了。
What's the matter, angel?  怎么啦，宝贝？

words.meaning: n.愤怒
words.example:
Her sudden towering rages were terrifying.  她突然暴跳如雷，很吓人。
He flew into a fit of rage over the smallest mistake.  微不足道的小错误就会使他大发雷霆。noun
The party was a rage.  派对办得热闹极了。noun

words.meaning: n.厕所,盥洗室
words.example:
Don't forget to flush the toilet.  别忘了冲马桶。
Excuse me, Miss Lewis, I need/want (to go to) the toilet.  对不起，刘易斯小姐，我要去一下洗手间。
The toilet seat was cracked and there was no paper.  马桶座圈裂了，也没有卫生纸。

words.meaning: a.珍贵的,贵重的
words.example:
Clean water is a precious commodity in many parts of the world.  在世界上很多地方洁净的水是昂贵的商品。
You're so precious to me.  你对我来说就是珍宝。adjective
He's so precious about his work that he never gets anything done.  他对自己的工作太讲究了，反而甚么都做不成。

words.meaning: v.禁止,不准;阻止
words.example:
Motor vehicles are prohibited from driving in the town centre.  机动车辆禁止在市中心行驶。
The government introduced a law prohibiting tobacco advertisements on TV.  政府颁布了一项法律： 禁止在电视上播放烟草广告。
Parking is strictly prohibited between these gates.  这些大门之间严禁停车。

words.meaning: a.现实(主义)的
words.example:
Let's be realistic (about this) - I just can't afford to pay that much money.  （在这一点上）我们还是现实一点吧——我根本就付不起那么一大笔钱。
It isn't realistic to expect people to work for so little money.  给那么点报酬还指望人们做这个工作，这是不现实的。
The special effects were so realistic.  那些特技镜头太逼真了。

words.meaning: a.嫩的;敏感的;温柔的 v.提出,提供;投标
words.example:
What you need is some tender loving care.  你需要的是体贴入微的关怀。UK adjective
My arm was very tender after the injection.  打针后，我的胳膊一碰就痛。UK adjective
My steak was beautifully tender.  我的牛排做得很嫩，好极了。

words.meaning: a.突出的,显著的,杰出的
words.example:
It's an area of outstanding natural beauty.  这地区自然风景极为优美。adjective
There are still a couple of problems outstanding.  还有几个问题未解决。

words.meaning: n.跌倒,绊倒 vi.绊(摔)倒;结结巴巴说
words.example:
Running along the beach, she stumbled on a log and fell on the sand.  她沿着海滩跑步时绊到一块木头上摔倒了。
In the final straight Meyers stumbled, and although he didn't fall it was enough to lose him first place.  迈耶斯在最后的直线跑道绊了一下，虽然没有摔倒，但也足以使他丢掉第一的位置。
We could hear her stumbling about/around the bedroom in the dark.  我们可以听到她摸黑在卧室里跌跌撞撞地走动。

words.meaning: a.孤独的,寂寞的;荒凉的,人迹稀少的
words.example: She gets lonely now that all the kids have left home.  现在孩子们都离开了家，她感到有些孤独。

words.meaning: a.人工的,人造的,人为的;虚伪的,做作的
words.example: Their cheerfulness seemed rather strained and artificial.  他们的高兴表情看上去非常造作虚伪。

words.meaning: n.黎明,拂晓 v.破晓;开始现出
words.example:
We woke at dawn.  天一亮我们就醒了。
We left as dawn was breaking (= starting).  我们离开时天将破晓。
We left at the break of dawn.  我们是在天刚破晓时离开的。

words.meaning: a.抽象的 n.摘要,文摘,梗概vt.提取;摘录要点
words.example:
Truth and beauty are abstract concepts.  真和美都是抽象的概念。
This debate is becoming too abstract - let's have some hard facts!  这场辩论变得太空洞了——拿出一些具体的事实根据来吧！
So far we've only discussed the question in the abstract (= without referring to any real examples).  目前我们只是笼统地讨论过这个问题。adjective

words.meaning: v.下来,下降;遗传(指财产,气质,权利)
words.example:
The path descended steeply into the valley.  这条路很陡，一直通到山谷。
Jane descended the stairs.  简走下了楼梯。
Silence descended on the room/ over the countryside.  寂静笼罩着房间／田野。verb

words.meaning: a.傻的,糊涂的,愚蠢的
words.example:
Don't do that, you silly boy!  不要那么做，你这个傻小子！
It was silly of you to go out in the sun without a hat.  你不戴帽子就顶着太阳出门真是太傻了。
You're being a silly billy, now stop it.  你在做傻事啊，快停下来。

words.meaning: n.潮,潮汐;潮流,趋势
words.example:
The tide is out/in.  潮退了／涨了。noun
We must look for ways of stemming (= stopping) the rising tide of protest.  我们必须想办法阻止日益高涨的抗议活动。noun
Can you lend me some money to tide me over till the weekend?  你能借些钱帮我撑到周末吗？

words.meaning: ad.容易地;乐意地,欣然地
words.example:
He readily agreed to help.  他乐意帮忙。
Larger sizes are readily available.  较大号随时都有货。

words.meaning: v.(with)合作,协作,相配合
words.example:
The two companies have cooperated in joint ventures for the past several years.  两家公司在过去几年中合作经营合资企业。
The Spanish authorities cooperated with the British police in finding the terrorists.  西班牙当局与英国警方相互配合搜捕恐怖分子。

words.meaning: a.革命的,革新的 n.革命者
words.example: Penicillin was a revolutionary drug.  青霉素是具有革命性意义的药物。

words.meaning: n.传奇,爱情故事
words.example:
French, Italian and Spanish are all Romance languages.  法语、义大利语和西班牙语都是罗曼语。
They got married last year after a whirlwind (= very short and unexpected) romance.  一段闪电式恋爱后，他们去年就结了婚。
It was just a holiday romance.  那只是假期中的一场浪漫恋情而已。

words.meaning: n.五金,金属制品;硬件
words.example: The hardware store is near the station.  五金店在车站附近。

words.meaning: n.枕头
words.example: Do you prefer a feather pillow or a foam pillow?  你喜欢羽绒枕头还是海绵枕头？

words.meaning: n.成套工具,用具包,工具箱
words.example:
He's making a model car from a kit.  他在用整套元件组装汽车模型。
Come on, get your kit off!  快，把你的衣服脱下来！verb (-tt-)
They went shopping to get kitted out for the trip.  他们去购买旅行所需的东西。

words.meaning: n.大陆,洲
words.example: the North American continent  北美大陆

words.meaning: n.封铅,封条;印,图章;海豹 v.封,密封
words.example:
Clean the seal on/around the fridge door regularly so that it remains airtight.  定期清洁冰箱门上的密封条，可以使它保持密闭。
The lawyer stamped the certificate with her seal.  律师在证书上盖上了她的印章。noun countable
The Government has given the proposal its seal of approval.  政府已经批准了这项提案。noun countable

words.meaning: n.环行,周线,巡回;电路,线路
words.example:
They first met each other on the tennis circuit (= while at different tennis competitions).  他们在网球巡回赛上首次交锋。
He was a familiar figure on the lecture circuit.  他是巡回讲学中的座上常客。
The judge had served for many years on the Northeast Circuit.  这位法官多年来效力于东北部巡回法庭。

words.meaning: n.不足,缺少
words.example:
There's a shortage of food and shelter in the refugee camps.  难民营里缺少足够的食物和住处。
The long hot summer has led to serious water shortages.  这个夏天漫长而炎热，导致严重缺水。

words.meaning: ad.最近,不久前
words.example: Have you been doing anything interesting lately?  最近你做了甚么有趣的事吗？

words.meaning: v.细看,审视;浏览;扫描 n.扫描
words.example:
She anxiously scanned the faces of the men leaving the train.  她急切地盯着一张张走下火车的人的脸。
Doug scanned the horizon for any sign of the boat.  道格注视着海平面，搜寻着那只船。
Scan the newspaper article quickly and make a note of the main points.  把报上的那篇文章快速浏览一遍，记下要点。

words.meaning: n.傻子,笨蛋vt.欺骗,愚弄vi.干蠢事
words.example:
[as form of address] You fool, you've missed your chance!  你这个傻瓜，你错过机会了！
He's a fool if he thinks she still loves him.  如果他以为她还爱着自己，那他就是个傻瓜。
He's fool enough to think she still loves him.  他可够蠢的，以为她还爱着自己。

words.meaning: n.最后期限
words.example:
There's no way I can meet that deadline.  我根本无法在那个期限内完成。
We're working to a tight deadline (= We do not have much time to finish the work).  我们的工作期限很紧。
I'm afraid you've missed the deadline - the deadline for applications was May 30th.  恐怕你已经错过了规定的期限——申请的截止日期是5月30日。

words.meaning: n.后面,背后,后方 v.饲养,抚养,栽培,举起
words.example:
There's a sticker on the rear door/window.  后门／后窗户上贴着一张纸条。
The horse had injured one of its rear legs.  这匹马一条后腿受伤了。
We walked round to the rear of the house.  我们绕道走到房子的后面。

words.meaning: v.承担,担任;许诺,保证;着手,从事
words.example: Students are required to undertake simple experiments.  要求学生们做些简单的实验。UK US (undertook, undertaken)

words.meaning: a.荒谬的,可笑的
words.example:
Do I look ridiculous in this hat?  我戴这顶帽子看着很可笑吗？
Don't be so ridiculous! I can't possibly afford to go on holiday.  别那么傻了！我才不可能有那么多钱去渡假呢。
It's ridiculous to expect a two-year-old to be able to read!  指望一个两岁的孩子会读书真是太荒唐了！

words.meaning: a.自动(装置)的;无意识的;n.自动机械
words.example:
Over time, driving just becomes automatic.  时间长了，开车也就成了一个机械的过程。
My automatic response was to pull my hand away.  我不自觉的反应就是把手抽回。UK adjective
Citizenship is automatic for children born in this country.  婴儿出生在这个国家，就自然而然地成为这个国家的公民。

words.meaning: n.金钢石,钻石;菱形
words.example:
The tiara was set with diamonds and rubies.  头饰上镶嵌着钻石和红宝石。
He had worked in the diamond mines of South Africa.  他曾在南非的钻石矿上干活。
Shall I wear the diamonds or the pearls with this dress?  我到底是戴钻石还是珍珠来配这件礼服好呢？noun

words.meaning: v./n.进口,输入,(pl.)进口商品;要旨,含意
words.example:
We import a large number of cars from Japan.  我们从日本进口大量的汽车。    Compare export
The fashion for wearing baseball hats was imported directly from the States.  戴棒球帽的潮流是直接从美国传进来的。
Whether it is to be a 'working' visit or an 'official' visit is of little/no import.  是“工作访问”还是“正式访问”，这并不重要。

words.meaning: a.神的,神授的,天赐的;极好的,极美的
words.example:
The Ayatollah described the earthquake in Iran as a divine test.  那位阿亚图拉把伊朗发生的地震说成是神的一次考验。
Some fans seem to regard footballers as divine beings.  有些球迷似乎把球员神化了。
England have fallen so far behind in the championship that their only hope of victory is divine intervention (= help from God).  英格兰队在此次锦标赛中的名次已经远远落后了，他们获胜的唯一希望就是要靠神来帮忙了。

words.meaning: n.感情,柔情;看法;感觉
words.example:
Nationalist sentiment has increased in the area since the bombing.  爆炸案发生以来，该地区的民族主义情绪开始高涨。
His son was overwhelmed by the sentiments of love and support in the cards and letters he received.  他儿子陶醉在自己所收到卡片和信件所表达的爱意和支持之中。
The film is flawed by slightly treacly sentiment.  这部电影的缺点在于其有点过于伤感滥情。

words.meaning: n.(二轮货运)马车,手推车
words.example:
a horse and cart.  一套马车
Aren't you putting the cart before the horse by deciding what to wear for the wedding before you've even been invited to it?  还未被邀请参加婚礼，就先决定该穿甚么，你这不是本末倒置吗？UK verb transitive + adverb or preposition
We carted all the rubbish to the bottom of the garden and burned it.  我们把所有的垃圾都运到了花园的尽头烧掉了。

words.meaning: a.年长的,资格老的 n.长辈
words.example:
You should listen to the advice of your elders.  你应该听长辈的建议。
They consulted the village elders.  他们向村里的长辈们咨询了意见。
formal She is my elder by three years (= three years older than me).  她比我年长三岁。

words.meaning: n.灵感;鼓舞,激励
words.example:
The golden autumn light provided the inspiration for the painting.  秋天金色的阳光给这幅画的创作带来了灵感。
He went to church, perhaps seeking divine inspiration.  他去做礼拜，也许为的是寻找神的启示。
He had an inspiration - why not apply for some government money?  他突然想到一个好主意——为甚么不去申请一些政府资金呢？

words.meaning: n.量,数量;大量
words.example:
Police found a large/small quantity of drugs in his possession.  警方发现他携带大/少量的毒品。
We consumed vast quantities of food and drink that night.  那天晚上我们大吃大喝了一顿。
The (sheer)quantity (= large amount) of equipment needed for the trip is staggering.  这次旅行所需的装备数实在多得惊人。

words.meaning: n.伙伴,同事,同伴,配偶 v. 结伴,配对,交配
words.example:
We've been mates since our school days.  我们从学生时代起就是朋友。
She's my best mate.  她是我最好的朋友。
Have you got a light, mate?  有火吗，老兄？noun countable

words.meaning: n.天才
words.example:
Einstein was a (mathematical) genius.  爱因斯坦是个（数学）天才。
From the age of three, she showed signs of genius.  从三岁起，她就表现出了天赋。
It was such a brilliant idea - a real stroke of genius.  这主意太妙了——真是天才的设想。

words.meaning: n.纪念碑,纪念馆,遗迹,不朽的业绩
words.example:
In the square in front of the hotel stands a monument to all the people killed in the war.  在那家饭店前的广场上矗立着纪念所有战争死难者的纪念碑。
Parts of the Berlin wall are being allowed to stand as historic monuments.  当局允许把柏林围墙的一部分保留下来，作为历史遗迹。UK noun countable
The annual arts festival is a monument to her vision and hard work.  一年一度的艺术节展示了她的广阔视野和勤奋创作的成果。

words.meaning: v.祝愿;命令,吩咐;报价,投标 n.出众,投标
words.example:
She knew she couldn't afford it, so she didn't bid.  她知道买不起，所以没有出价。
The communications group has shown an interest in bidding for the company.  该通讯集团有意出价竞买这间公司。
The department is trying to ensure fairer competition among firms bidding for government contracts.  该部门正努力确保竞标政府合约的公司之间能更公平地竞争。

words.meaning: n.探寻,探求;寻求,追求
words.example:
Nothing will stop them in their quest for truth.  没有甚么可以阻止他们对真理的追求。
She went to India on a spiritual quest.  她为了追求宗教而去印度。

words.meaning: n.牺牲,牺牲品;祭品 v.(for,to)牺牲,献出
words.example:
Many women sacrifice interesting careers for their family.  许多女性为了家庭牺牲了自己感兴趣的工作。verb
Service and quality have been sacrificed on the altar of profit.  为了利润牺牲了服务和品质。noun countable or uncountable
We had to make sacrifices in order to pay for our children's education.  为了支付孩子们的教育费用，我们不得不作出牺牲。

words.meaning: n.邀请,招待;请柬
words.example:
Thanks for the invitation to your birthday party.  谢谢你邀请我参加你的生日聚会。
I'm happy to accept your invitation.  我很高兴接受你们的邀请。
The first day of the exhibition will be by invitation (only) (= only those who have been invited can come).  展览会的第一天只有持请柬者可以入场。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.准确(性);精确;准确度
words.example: We can predict changes with a surprising degree of accuracy.  我们可以出奇准确地预测变化。

words.meaning: n.财宝,财富;珍品 v.珍爱,珍惜
words.example:
Stories about pirates often include a search for buried treasure.  海盗故事中经常包括搜寻宝藏。
When they opened up the tomb they found treasure beyond their wildest dreams.  他们挖开坟墓，发现了做梦也想像不到的珍宝。
The museum houses many priceless treasures.  这家博物馆收藏了许多价值连城的珍品。UK noun

words.meaning: n.忠诚,忠心
words.example:
His loyalty was never in question.  他的忠诚从未受到怀疑。
Her loyalty to the cause is impressive.  她对事业的忠诚给人留下了深刻印象。
My loyalties to my family come before anything else.  对家庭尽责对我来说是第一位的。

words.meaning: n.(gasolene)汽油
words.example: Gasoline prices went up again.  汽油价格又涨了。

words.meaning: a.硬的,僵直的;拘谨的;呆板的;艰难的
words.example:
His clothes were stiff with dried mud.  他衣服上的泥巴干了，硬邦邦的。
This hair spray has made my hair stiff.  这种发胶使我的头发变硬。
Mix the powder and water into a stiff paste.  把粉末和水混合成稠糊。

words.meaning: n.产量,输出(量)
words.example: Last year British manufacturing output fell by 14%.  去年英国制造业的产量下降了14%。

words.meaning: n./v.拍,掌击
words.example:
She gave her son a slap for behaving badly.  她因儿子不听话给了他一巴掌。
It was a real slap in the face for him when she refused to go out to dinner with him.  她拒绝和他一起出去吃晚饭，这对他真是一种侮辱。
He's won - give him a slap on the back.  他赢了——应该好好祝贺他一下。

words.meaning: a.有毒的;中毒的
words.example: toxic waste/chemicals/effluent  有毒的废料／化学品／废水UK adjective

words.meaning: n.颌,颚
words.example:
He has a strong/square jaw.  他有着结实的／方下巴。
The lion opened its jaws and roared.  狮子张开大嘴咆哮了起来。
His foot was caught in the jaws of the trap.  他的脚被夹在捕兽夹的钳口里。UK noun

words.meaning: n.悲伤,悲痛;悲伤的事,悲痛的缘由
words.example:
Her grief at her son's death was terrible.  丧子之痛使她肝肠寸断。
Newspapers should not intrude on people's private grief.  报纸不应再去侵扰那些正承受丧亲之痛的人们。
The Italian champion was in second position when he came to grief on the third lap.  跑到第三圈时，处在第二位置上的义大利卫冕冠军突然马失前蹄。

words.meaning: a.神秘的,可疑的,难理解的
words.example:
She's an actress whose inner life has remained mysterious, despite the many interviews she has given.  作为一名演员，她虽然接受过多次采访，但私生活依然很神秘。
He died in mysterious circumstances , and there is still a possibility that it was murder.  他死得蹊跷，仍不排除是谋杀的可能。

words.meaning: n.火箭
words.example:
They launched a rocket to the planet Venus.  他们向金星发射了一枚火箭。
The rebels were firing anti-tank rockets.  叛军在发射反坦克火箭弹。
Her Mum gave her a rocket for tearing her new jeans.  她把新买的牛仔裤被弄破了，挨了她妈一顿臭骂。UK verb intransitive often + adverb or preposition (also skyrocket) informal

words.meaning: vt.损赠(金钱等);赠予
words.example:
An anonymous businesswoman donated one million dollars to the charity.  一位女商人匿名向该慈善机构捐赠了100万美元。
Please donate generously.  请您慷慨解囊。
The appeal for people to donate blood was very successful.  这个献血号召非常有效。

words.meaning: n.滑车;用具,器械 v.处理,解决;抱住,抓住
words.example: There are many ways of tackling this problem.  处理这个问题有许多办法。

words.meaning: v./n.鞠躬,点头 n.弓(形);蝴蝶结
words.example:
They bowed to the Queen.  他们向女王鞠躬。
We bowed our heads in prayer.  我们俯首祷告。
He bowed down (= very low) before (= in front of) the king and begged for mercy.  他向国王深深鞠躬乞求宽恕。    Compare curtsyverb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: pron.[we的物主代词]我们的(所有物)
words.example:
Which table is ours?  哪张桌子是我们的？
He's a cousin of ours.  他是我们的一个表兄。
Ours is the red car parked over there.  我们的车是停在那边红色那辆。

words.meaning: n.(举止,态度等的)庄严,端庄;尊贵,高贵
words.example:
He is a man of dignity and calm determination.  他是个沉稳、冷静而果断的人。
She has a quiet dignity about her.  她身上有一种恬静端庄的气质。
He longs for a society in which the dignity of all people is recognized.  他渴望看到一个人人都有尊严的社会。

words.meaning: n.地毯
words.example:
We've just had a new carpet fitted/laid in our bedroom.  我们刚在卧室里铺了块新地毯。
Our lawn is a carpet of daisies.  我们的草坪上开满了雏菊。UK noun
We need to carpet the stairs.  我们需要在楼梯铺上地毯。

words.meaning: n.泡,水泡,气泡 v.冒泡,起泡,沸腾
words.example:
As water begins to boil, bubbles rise ever faster to the surface.  水开了，气泡更快地升向水面。
He made millions before the dot.com bubble burst.  在纲际网路泡沫爆破之前他赚了几百万。verb intransitive
We could hear the porridge bubbling away (= bubbling strongly) in the pot.  我们能听见锅子里的粥咕嘟咕嘟的冒泡声。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.谷仓,仓库 vt.把…贮存入仓
words.example: The barn stores wheat for winter.  谷仓里存着过冬的小麦。

words.meaning: n.剑,刀;武力
words.example:
Thousands of innocents were put to the sword.  数千名无辜者被杀。UK noun countable
Government threats to cut the budget by 50% are hanging over the Opera House like a sword of Damocles.  政府威胁说要将预算削减50%，这就好像是一把悬在歌剧院上方的达摩克利斯剑。

words.meaning: n.光荣,荣誉
words.example:
Glory be to God!  荣耀属于上帝！
He dedicated his poetry to the glory of God.  他把自己的诗作敬献给无上荣耀的上帝。
He revelled in the glory of scoring three goals in the final 8 minutes.  比赛的最后八分钟，他连进三球，这种荣耀令他陶醉不已。

words.meaning: v.卷起;塞进
words.example:
Should I tuck my shirt into my trousers?  我应该把衬衫下摆塞进裤子里吗？
He tucked the bottom of the sheet under the mattress.  他把床单边缘塞入床垫下。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition
Tuck your gloves in your pocket so that you don't lose them.  把手套放进口袋里，这样就不会弄丢了。

words.meaning: n.鼓;圆桶
words.example:
They danced to the beat of the drums (= sound of the drums being hit).  他们随着鼓声翩翩起舞。noun countable
Labour are banging the drum for a united Europe.  工党正极力鼓吹建立一个统一的欧洲。verb intransitive or transitive (-mm-)
She drummed her fingers impatiently on the table.  她不耐烦地用手指敲打桌子。

words.meaning: a.微弱的;不明显的;暗淡的 n./v.昏倒;昏晕
words.example:
The lamp gave out a faint glow.  灯发出微弱的光。
She gave me a faint smile of recognition.  她认出了我，向我淡淡一笑。
There's not the faintest hope of ever finding him.  没有丝毫找到他的希望。

words.meaning: n.女王,皇后,王后
words.example:
How long did Queen Victoria reign ?  维多利亚女王在位多久？
The Queen is meeting the Prime Minister today.  今天女王要接见首相。
She's the reigning queen of crime writers.  她是当今首屈一指的犯罪小说作家。

words.meaning: n.(进退两难的)窘境,困境
words.example:
The President is clearly in a dilemma about/over how to tackle the crisis.  对于如何化解危机总统明显处于两难境地。
She faces the dilemma of disobeying her father or losing the man she loves.  她面临着要么违抗父亲要么失去心上人的两难境地。

words.meaning: n./v.输入
words.example:
The power input will come largely from hydroelectricity.  电力输入主要来自水力发电。
The inputs for the CD-ROM are at the back of the computer.  光碟唯读记忆体的输入端在电脑的背后。
I've spent the morning inputting data into the computer.  我花了一个上午将资料输入电脑。

words.meaning: v.(specialise)(in)专攻,专门研究,专业化
words.example: She's hired a lawyer who specializes in divorce cases.  她请了个专打离婚官司的律师。

words.meaning: n.东北 a.东北方的 ad.向东北,在东北
words.example: The northeast is rich in timber.  东北地区木材丰富。

words.meaning: a.浅的,浅薄的 n.浅滩,浅处
words.example:
The stream was quite shallow so we were able to walk across it.  小溪很浅，所以我们可以涉水过去。
She told her children to stay in the shallow end (of the swimming pool).  她叫孩子们留在（游泳池的）浅水区。
Fry the onions in a shallow pan.  用浅平底锅把洋葱煎一下。

words.meaning: n.责任,义务;(pl.)债务
words.example:
He denies any liability for the damage caused.  他对造成的损失拒绝承担任何责任。
The business has liabilities of £2 million.  该公司负债达200万英镑。    Compare assetUK noun
After a certain age, a car's just a liability.  汽车在使用了一定年限后就会变成一个累赘。

words.meaning: n.帆,航行 v.航行
words.example:
The boat sailed along/down the coast.  那艘船沿着海岸航行。
As the battleship sailed by/past, everyone on deck waved.  战舰驶过时，甲板上所有的人都挥手致意。
The ship was sailing to China.  这艘船开往中国。

words.meaning: n.商人,零售商
words.example: With exports rising and unemployment falling, the merchants of gloom are having to revise their opinions of the economy.  随着出口产品的增加和失业率的下降，悲观派将不得不改变他们对经济的看法。

words.meaning: n.体育场
words.example: Thousands of football fans packed into the stadium to watch the match.  成千上万的足球迷涌进体育场观看比赛。

words.meaning: a.流血的,血腥的
words.example:
I've had a bloody awful week.  我这个星期他妈糟透了。
It's a bloody disgrace that some war widows don't get a decent pension.  有些因战争而守寡的妇女没有得到数额合理的抚恤金，这种事真他妈丢人。
Don't be a bloody idiot !  别他妈像个傻瓜似的！

words.meaning: n.窝,巢 v.筑巢
words.example:
Cuckoos are famous for laying their eggs in the nests of other birds.  杜鹃以在其他鸟的窝巢里下蛋而闻名。
The alligators build their nests out of grass near the water's edge.  短吻鳄在水边用草给自己搭窝。
The diplomats have been sent home because their embassy has become a nest of spies and espionage.  外交官被遣送回国，因为他们的大使馆已经沦为间谍窝。noun countable

words.meaning: n.小路,小巷,行车道
words.example:
He drives so fast along those narrow country lanes.  在那些狭窄的乡间小路上他把车开得飞快。
The northbound lane is closed because of an accident.  北上的车道因发生事故已经封闭。
The British runners/swimmers are in lanes 4 and 6.  英国径赛／游泳选手处在第四道和第六道。

words.meaning: n.祖宗,祖先;原型,先驱
words.example:
There were portraits of his ancestors on the walls of the room.  房间墙壁上挂着他祖先的画像。    Compare descendant
This wooden instrument is the ancestor of the modern metal flute.  这种木制乐器是现在金属长笛的雏形。

words.meaning: v.谴责,指责;判刑,宣告有罪
words.example:
The terrorist action has been condemned as an act of barbarism and cowardice.  人们谴责这一恐怖行径是野蛮和懦弱的行为。
The film was condemned for its sexism.  这出电影被指责带有性别歧视。verb transitive
She was condemned to death and executed two weeks later.  她被宣判死刑，两星期后被处决。

words.meaning: n.水汽,蒸汽,水蒸气 v.蒸发;蒸;用蒸汽开动
words.example:
Steam rose from the simmering stew.  火上的炖肉咕嘟咕嘟冒着热气。
The pump is driven by steam.  这个泵是由蒸汽驱动的。noun uncountable
After the first three months, the fundraising project really started to pick up steam.  最初的三个月后，筹款活动开始变得如火如荼。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.口音,腔调;重音(符号)vt.重读
words.example:
He's got a strong French/Scottish accent.  他说话带有很重的法国／苏格兰口音。
She's French but she speaks with an impeccable English accent.  她是法国人，但说话却是地道的英国腔。
He speaks with a broad/heavy/strong/thick Yorkshire accent.  他说话带有很重的约克郡口音。

words.meaning: a.乐观主义的
words.example: She is optimistic about her chances of winning a gold medal.  她对赢得金牌很乐观。

words.meaning: vi.联合,团结;统一,合并vt.使联合
words.example:
If the opposition groups manage to unite, they may command over 55% of the vote.  如果反对派能联合起来，可能会赢得55%以上的选票。
If ever a dance company could unite the differing worlds of rock and ballet, the Joffrey Ballet is it.  如果有哪个歌舞团能把芭蕾和摇滚融合在一起的话，那这个歌舞团就是乔弗利芭蕾舞团。

words.meaning: n.笼,鸟笼;牢房,监狱
words.example: Sam's been prowling about like a caged animal all morning.  萨姆整个上午都像困兽一样走来走去。

words.meaning: v.(with)装备,配备;训练
words.example:
It's going to cost $4 million to equip the hospital.  给这所医院配齐医疗设备将耗资400万美元。
All the police officers were equipped with shields to defend themselves against the rioters.  所有员警都配备了盾牌以便在与暴乱分子的对抗中防身。 (-pp-)
The course aims to equip people with the skills necessary for a job in this technological age.  本课程旨在使人们获得在这个科技时代必备的工作技能。

words.meaning: n.挂物架,搁物架 v.使痛苦,折磨
words.example:
The butcher prepared a rack of pork.  那个屠夫准备了一块猪颈肉。
We're having rack of lamb for dinner.  我们今天晚餐会煮羊颈肉。noun
The whole farm was going to rack and ruin.  整个农场逐渐变得破败不堪。noun

words.meaning: n.(流行的)服饰;戏装,(特定场合的)套装
words.example:
Singers performing Mozart's operas often dress in /wear historical costume.  歌手们经常穿古装出演莫劄特的歌剧。
The dancers leading the procession were in colourful and elaborate costumes.  走在队伍前头的舞蹈演员身着色彩绚丽、制作考究的服装。
Our host was wearing a clown costume.  我们的主人穿着小丑服。

words.meaning: n.狼
words.example:
Wolves hunt in groups known as packs.  狼群集体觅食。
We could hear wolves howling in the distance.  我们能听到远处的狼嗥声。noun (plural wolves)
He had the reputation of being a bit of a wolf.  他因好色而声名狼藉。noun (plural wolves)

words.meaning: n.成文法,法令,法规;章程,规则,条例
words.example: The statute limits working hours.  法规限制了工作时长。

words.meaning: n.漫画,幽默画;动画片
words.example: The children drew a cartoon.  孩子们画了一幅漫画。

words.meaning: n.生产率
words.example:
Studies show that if a working environment is pleasant, productivity increases.  研究显示如果工作环境舒适，生产效率会提高。
Productivity in the steel industry improved by 5% last year.  钢铁工业的生产率去年提高了5%。

words.meaning: n./vi.露齿而笑,咧嘴一笑
words.example:
He grinned at me from the doorway.  他在门口向我咧着嘴笑。
What are you grinning about?  你龇牙咧嘴笑甚么？verb intransitive (-nn-)

words.meaning: n.臭虫;小毛病;窃听器 v.窃听
words.example:
There's a bug going around (= an illness that many people are getting).  有种细菌引起的疾病现正在流行。noun
He's been bitten by the sailing bug.  他迷上了帆船运动。verb transitive (-gg-)
He's been bugging me all morning.  他整个上午都在烦我。verb transitive (-gg-)

words.meaning: v.祝福,保佑
words.example: "Here, let me help you with your shopping." "Oh, bless you, dear."  “嘿，我来帮你拿买的东西吧。”“哦，上帝保佑你，亲爱的。”

words.meaning: n.姨母,姑母,伯母,婶母,舅母,阿姨
words.example: Auntie Camille  卡米尔姑妈

words.meaning: n.农业,农艺,农耕
words.example:
Agriculture is still largely based on traditional methods in some countries.  一些国家的农业仍然主要依靠传统耕作方式。
The area depends on agriculture for most of its income.  这个地区的大部分收入来自农业。
Seventy percent of the country's population practises subsistence agriculture.  这个国家70%的人口以务农为生。    Compare horticulture

words.meaning: a.敌对的,敌方的,敌意的
words.example:
The President had a hostile reception in Ohio this morning.  总统今天早上在俄亥俄州受到了不友善的接待。
I'm not hostile to (= against) the idea of change as such.  我并不反对作这样的改变。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.(of)设想,构思,想象;以为;怀胎,怀有
words.example:
He couldn't conceive of a time when he would have no job.  他不能想像有一天他会没有工作。
He conceived the plot for this film while he was still a student.  他还是个学生的时候就已经构想出了这部影片的情节。
The exhibition was conceived by the museum's director.  这次展览是由博物馆馆长构思设计的。

words.meaning: n.奖金,红利
words.example: The company used to give discretionary bonus payments.  公司过去常常会酌情发放一些奖金。

words.meaning: n.轨道 v.(使)沿轨道行
words.example:
The satellite is now in a stable orbit.  卫星目前在稳定的轨道上运行。
Once in space, the spacecraft will go into orbit around the Earth.  一旦进入太空，太空船将进入环绕地球的轨道。UK noun countable or uncountable
Prices have gone into orbit this year.  今年物价大幅攀升。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: v./n.抓住,抓紧;掌握,领会
words.example:
Rosie suddenly grasped my hand.  罗茜突然抓住了我的手。
We must grasp every opportunity to strengthen economic ties with other countries.  我们必须把握住一切机会加强与其他国家的经济联系。UK verb transitive
The Government has acknowledged that homelessness is a problem but it has failed to grasp the scale of the problem.  政府已经承认很多人无家可归是个问题，但还没有意识到问题的严重性。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.耐心,忍耐
words.example:
You have to have such a lot of patience when you're dealing with kids.  和孩子相处需要有这么大的耐心才行。
In the end I lost my patience and shouted at her.  最后我失去了耐性，对她大吼大叫起来。
He's a good teacher, but he doesn't have much patience with the slower pupils.  他是个好老师，但对较迟钝的学生没多大耐心。

words.meaning: n.恶意;怨恨
words.example:
In spite of his injury, Ricardo will play in Saturday's match.  尽管里卡多有伤在身，星期六的比赛他仍然会出场。
She started to laugh, in spite of herself.  她不由自主地笑了起来。noun
He's the sort of man who would let down the tyres on your car just out of/from spite.  他是那种会为了泄愤而让你车胎泄气的人。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.热带的
words.example:
Leprosy is one of the few tropical diseases which could be eradicated early in the 21st century.  21世纪初有几种热带病可以彻底根除，麻风病就是其中之一。
She specialises in tropical medicine (= the treatment of diseases from the tropical areas of the world).  她专门医治热带病。
The Amazon river basin contains the world's largest tropical rainforest.  亚马孙河流域有世界上最大的热带雨林。

words.meaning: v.巡逻,巡查 n.巡逻,巡查;巡逻队
words.example:
The whole town is patrolled by police because of the possibility of riots.  为防止发生骚乱，整个城镇都有员警巡逻。
Coastguards found a deserted boat while patrolling (along) the coast.  海岸警卫队在岸边巡逻时发现了一艘被遗弃的船。UK noun
Three reconnaissance aircraft are permanently on patrol.  三架侦察机在不停巡逻。UK noun

words.meaning: n.揭示,揭露,显示,启示,新发现,被揭露的事
words.example:
Shocking revelations about their private life appeared in the papers.  有关他们私生活的惊人内幕见诸报端。
This book came as a complete revelation to me.  这本书使我茅塞顿开。

words.meaning: a.(天气,海洋等)静的 n.平静 v.(使)平静
words.example:
After a night of fighting, the streets are now calm.  经过一夜的战斗，街上现在平静了。
He has a very calm manner.  他举止沉着镇静。
Now keep calm everyone, the police are on their way.  现在请大家保持安静，员警就要来了。

words.meaning: n.(jewllery)(总称)珠宝
words.example: She keeps her jewelry in a safe.  她把珠宝放在保险箱里。

words.meaning: v.拖曳,拖运,用力拖
words.example:
They hauled the boat out of the water.  他们把船拉上了岸。
She hauled herself up into the tree.  她费劲地爬上了树。UK verb transitive
When the shooting started we hauled ass out of there.  枪击开始后，我们就赶快离开了那里。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.承认;容许;(比赛结束前)认输;退让
words.example:
The president is not expected to concede these reforms.  估计总统不会同意这些改革。
He is not willing to concede any of his power/authority.  他不愿交出自己的任何权力。
Britain conceded (= allowed) independence to India in 1947.  英国在1947年承认印度独立。

words.meaning: n.运货马车,运货车;敞蓬车厢
words.example:
The first white settlers journeyed across America in covered wagons.  最早的白人定居者是驾着大篷车穿越美洲大陆的。
When her husband died, she fell off the wagon.  她丈夫死后，她又重新喝起酒来。(UK also waggon) ['wæg.ən]
He was on the wagon for ten years, when he was living in Connecticut.  住在康乃狄克期间，他戒了十年的酒。

words.meaning: ad.(afterwards)以后,后来
words.example: We talked afterward about the film.  之后我们聊了聊那部电影。

words.meaning: a.壮观的,引人注目的 n.壮观的演出
words.example:
He scored a spectacular goal in the second half.  他在下半场攻进了漂亮的一球。
There was a spectacular sunset last night.  昨天的日落非常壮观。
We've had spectacular success with the product.  我们的产品取得了惊人的成功。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.毁灭;(使)破产 n.毁灭,崩溃;(pl.)废墟
words.example:
Huge modern hotels have ruined this once unspoilt coastline.  庞然大物般的现代旅馆已经完全毁掉了这片曾经如世外桃源般的海岸。
Her injury ruined her chances of winning the race.  她受了伤，毁掉了赢得比赛的机会。
Cheap imported goods are ruining many businesses.  廉价的进口商品使众多公司正走向破产。

words.meaning: a.纯粹的,十足的,全然的;陡峭的,险峻的
words.example:
The suggestion is sheer nonsense.  这个建议纯粹是胡言乱语。
His success was due to sheer willpower/determination.  他的成功全靠自己的意志力／决心。
It was sheer coincidence that we met.  我们的相遇纯属巧合。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.免疫的,有免疫力的;有受影响的;豁免的
words.example:
Most people who've had chicken pox once are immune to it for the rest of their lives.  大多数出过水痘的人终生都对此病具有免疫力。
He seems to be immune to colds - he just never gets them.  他好像对感冒具有免疫力——他从不感冒。
The press had criticised her so often that in the end she had become immune (to it).  新闻界如此频繁地批评她，以至于到最后她都（对此）变得无动于衷了。

words.meaning: ad.在旁边 prep.和...在一起;在...旁边
words.example:
The new pill will be used alongside existing medicines.  这种新药将配合现有药物一起服用。
Most of the staff refused to work alongside the new team.  大多数职员拒绝和这个新团队一起工作。
Britain fought alongside France, Turkey and Sardinia during the Crimean War.  在克里米亚战争中，英国和法国、土耳其以及撒丁尼亚王国并肩作战。

words.meaning: n.灌木(丛)
words.example: The baby was born with a surprising bush of black hair.  令人吃惊的是，这个婴儿生下来就长着浓密的黑发。noun

words.meaning: a.奇异的;异国情调的;外(国)来的
words.example: exotic flowers/food/designs  奇花异草／外国风味的食物／奇异的设计

words.meaning: v.剪,修剪;钳,夹住 n.夹,钳;回形针
words.example:
The wires were fastened together with a plastic clip.  这些电线用一个塑胶夹子扣在一起。noun
I've seen a clip from the film.  我看过这部电影的一个片段。noun
We set off at a good clip, but we gradually slowed down.  我们出发时速度很快，可是后来渐渐慢了下来。noun

words.meaning: n.大腿;股骨
words.example: The recipe calls for chicken thigh.  这个食谱要用鸡腿肉。

words.meaning: n.公牛
words.example:
They did not see the sign by the gate saying 'Beware of the bull'.  他们没有看见门旁边“当心公牛”的警示。noun
Don't give me that bull about not knowing the time.  别跟我说你不知道时间，那纯粹是瞎说。noun
We told her it was a delicate situation but she went into the meeting like a bull in a china shop.  我们告诉她情况非常微妙，但她还是冒冒失失闯到会上说了一通。noun

words.meaning: n.抽屉
words.example: The top drawer is stuck.  最上层抽屉卡住了。

words.meaning: n.(绵)羊;易受人摆布的人
words.example:
The farmer has several large flocks (= groups) of long-haired sheep.  这位农夫养着好几大群长毛绵羊。
We heard sheep bleating/baaing in the field.  我们听见绵羊在田野里咩咩叫。
The uphill stages of the race will really sort the sheep from the goats.  上坡的几个路段会真正拉开选手们的距离。

words.meaning: v.使泄气,使失去信心
words.example:
The thought of how much work she had to do discouraged her.  一想到还有那么多工作得做她就泄了气。    Opposite encourageUK verb transitive
The authorities have put tanks on the streets to discourage any protest.  当局调动坦克上街去阻止抗议活动。    Opposite encourage

words.meaning: a.亲密的,密切的 n.熟友,熟人
words.example:
The restaurant has a very intimate atmosphere.  这家餐厅的气氛很幽静。
He's become very intimate with an actress.  他和一名女演员的关系变得非常亲密。adjective UK EXPERT  精通的
She has an intimate knowledge of Tuscany, where she has lived for twenty years.  她在托斯卡纳住了20年，对那里非常熟悉。noun countable UK US     formal

words.meaning: n.帝国
words.example: In the space of just ten years, her company has grown from one small shop to a multi-million-pound empire.  仅仅十年的时间，她的公司就由一个小商店发展成为一家拥有数百万英镑资产的企业集团。

words.meaning: n.出租车,出租马车;驾驶室 vi.乘出租马车
words.example: It'll save time if we go by cab.  我们搭计程车去能节省时间。

words.meaning: n.(examination)考试,测验
words.example: How many pupils are taking the geography exam this term?  这个学期有多少位小学生参加地理考试？

words.meaning: a.文献的 n.记录片
words.example:
The documentary took a fresh look at the life of Darwin.  这部纪录片从一个崭新的角度介绍了达尔文的一生。
They showed a documentary on animal communication.  他们放映了一部关于动物之间交流沟通的纪录片。UK adjective [before noun]
Human rights campaigners have discovered documentary evidence of torture.  人权活动家们已经发现了刑讯逼供的书面证据。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: a.中立的;中性的,中和的
words.example:
If there's an argument between my daughter and her mother, it's important that I remain neutral.  如果我女儿和她母亲发生争吵，我保持中立是很重要的。
The peace conference would have to be held in a neutral country.  和平会议必须在一个中立国举行。
I'd rather meet on neutral ground/territory (= somewhere not controlled by or connected to either of us) rather than in his apartment.  我宁愿在一个与双方都无关的地方和他见面，而不是在他的公寓里。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.生物学
words.example: The book deals with the reproductive biology of the buffalo.  这本书讲述野牛的生殖习性。

words.meaning: a.柔韧的,易弯曲的,灵活的,能变形的
words.example:
My schedule is quite flexible - I could arrange to meet with you any day next week.  我的时间安排很灵活——下周任何一天我都可以安排与你见面。adjective
Rubber is a flexible substance.  橡胶是一种有弹性的物质。
Dancers and gymnasts need to be very flexible (= able to bend their bodies easily).  舞蹈演员和体操运动员的身体必须非常柔韧。

words.meaning: a.进步的,先进的;前进的
words.example:
There's been a progressive decline in the standard of living over the past few years.  最近几年的生活水准每况愈下。
The left of the party is pressing for a more progressive social policy.  该政党的左派人士敦促实行更加进步的社会政策。
'He's working hard at the moment' is an example of the present progressive form of the verb 'work'.  He's working hard at the moment 是动词 work 的现在进行式的一个例子。

words.meaning: n.网,蜘蛛网
words.example:
We watched a spider spin a web between three tall grass stems.  我们注视着一只蜘蛛在三根高高的草茎之间织了一张网。
figurative Those involved in the fraud created an intricate web of trading companies to hide their activities.  那些参与诈骗的人建立起一个交易公司的复杂网路，试图掩盖他们的活动。

words.meaning: n.阴谋,密谋,共谋
words.example: The three men are accused of conspiracy.  这三人被指控图谋不轨。

words.meaning: n.伤亡人员;受害人;损失的东西;急诊室
words.example:
The train was derailed but there were no casualties, police said.  警方称，火车出轨了，但没有人员伤亡。
The rebels suffered heavy casualties.  叛乱分子伤亡惨重。noun
She lost her job in 1989, a casualty of the recession.  1989年她失业了，成了经济衰退的受害者。

words.meaning: n.共和国,共和政体
words.example: the People's Republic of China  中华人民共和国

words.meaning: a.极好的,非常的,极度的
words.example:
You look terrific!  你看起来棒极了！ informal
The police car drove past at a terrific speed.  警车疾驶而过。

words.meaning: n.鲸;庞然大物
words.example:
We had a whale of a time on holiday.  假期里我们玩得非常痛快。noun countable
That's a whale of a story.  那个故事棒极了。
Another thousand dollars would make a whale of a difference.  再有1000美元的话，情况就大不相同了。

words.meaning: n.本能,直觉,天性
words.example:
All his instincts told him to stay near the car and wait for help.  他的直觉告诉他要留在车旁、等待救援。
It is instinct that tells the birds when to begin their migration.  是本能让鸟类知道何时开始迁徙。
figurative Bob seems to have an instinct for (= is naturally good at) knowing which products will sell.  鲍勃好像能凭直觉知道哪些产品有销路。

words.meaning: n.(aluminium)铝
words.example: The pot is made of aluminum.  这口锅是铝制的。

words.meaning: pron.[引导名词从句]谁;无论谁;究竟是谁
words.example:
Whoever uprooted that tree ought to be ashamed of themselves.  把树连根拔起的那个人应当感到羞耻。
Could I speak to whoever is in charge of International Sales please?  能找负责国际销售的人接电话吗？UK pronoun
Can whoever leaves last please lock up?  最后走的人请锁门好吗？

words.meaning: n.(政府的)部;牧师
words.example:
He practised a preaching and teaching ministry there for over 40 years.  他在那里当了40多年的传教和教学牧师。
In 1985 he decided to go into/leave the ministry.  他在1985年决定当牧师／辞去牧师职务。

words.meaning: v.教,教授;命令,指示
words.example:
The police have been instructed to patrol the building and surrounding area.  员警奉命在这幢大楼里及周围地区巡逻。
He works in a sports centre instructing people in the use of the gym equipment.  他在体育中心工作，教人们如何使用健身器材。

words.meaning: n.头盖骨,颅骨
words.example:
The soldiers discovered a pile of human skulls and bones.  士兵们发现了一堆人的头盖骨和白骨。noun countable
Has he got the truth into his thick skull yet?  他还没有弄清楚实情？

words.meaning: a.合作的,协作的 n.合作社
words.example:
I've asked them not to play their music so loudly, but they're not being very cooperative.  我叫他们不要把音乐声放得这么大，可是他们不肯合作。    Opposite uncooperativeUK noun countable (ALSO UK also co-operative) (also abbreviation co-op)
The magazine is run by a cooperative.  这份杂志由一家合作企业出版。

words.meaning: vt.(熟练地)使用,操作;(巧妙地)处理
words.example:
Throughout her career she has very successfully manipulated the media.  她在整个职业生涯中非常成功地控制了媒体。
The opposition leader accused government ministers of manipulating the statistics to suit themselves.  反对派领导人指责政府部长篡改统计数据以满足自身利益。verb transitive
The wheelchair is designed so that it is easy to manipulate.  轮椅设计得很容易操纵。

words.meaning: n.蜂,蜜蜂;忙碌的人
words.example:
My arm swelled up where I was stung by a bee.  我手臂上被蜜蜂螫的地方肿了起来。
Have you tried this ice-cream? It's the bee's knees, it really is.  你吃过这种雪糕吗？这是最好的，真的。noun countable
She never stops talking about dieting - she's got a real bee in her bonnet about it.  她不停地谈论节食——她已完全着魔了。

words.meaning: n.实践者,从事者;(医生或律师等)开业者
words.example:
Elizabeth Quan is a London-based practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.  伊莉莎白‧康是一位在伦敦执业的中医医师。
She was a medical practitioner (= a doctor) before she entered politics.  从政前她是个医生。

words.meaning: n.圈,环
words.example:
The tape ran in a continuous loop, repeating the same songs over and over.  这盒磁带处于回圈播放状态，反反复复地播放那几首歌曲。
You can tell she's in the loop. She always knows about policy decisions before the rest of us.  她很明显是圈内人。她总是比我们所有人都更早知道政策决定。
I've been out of the loop since I changed jobs. I didn't realize Wendy and Bob had got engaged.  我换工作之后一直消息闭塞。我还不知道温蒂和巴布已经订婚了呢。noun countable

words.meaning: v.编辑,校订
words.example:
Janet edited books for a variety of publishers.  珍妮特为许多出版社编辑过图书。
The film's 129 minutes were edited down from 150 hours of footage.  这部129分钟的影片是从总长150小时的底片中剪辑出来的。
He edits a national newspaper.  他是一家全国性报纸的主编。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.鞭子;车夫 v.鞭打,抽打;突然移动
words.example:
She lashed the horses mercilessly with her long whip.  她毫不留情地用长鞭抽打马匹。
The lion-tamer cracked his whip.  驯狮员打了个响鞭。noun
Hargreaves is the MP who got into trouble with his party's chief whip for opposing the tax reform.  哈格里夫斯就是那位因反对税收改革而与其党内的组织秘书产生矛盾的议员。

words.meaning: n.难题,谜,迷惑 v.(使)迷惑,(使)为难
words.example:
Scientists have been trying to solve this puzzle for years.  多年来科学家们一直试图解开这个谜。
The findings of the survey puzzle me - they're not at all what I would have expected.  调查的结果使我感到迷惑——它们根本不像我原本预料的那样。
Management are still puzzling about/over how the accident could have happened.  管理部门仍然对事故发生的原因感到迷惑不解。verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive

words.meaning: n.蘑菇 vt.迅速生长,迅速增加,采蘑菇
words.example:
For this recipe choose mushrooms with large caps (= top parts).  做这道菜要选菌盖大的蘑菇。
Unfortunately some poisonous mushrooms look like edible mushrooms.  遗憾的是，某些有毒蘑菇外表与可食用蘑菇相似。    Compare toadstoolverb intransitive
The number of computers in schools has mushroomed in recent years.  近年来，学校里电脑的数量迅速增长。

words.meaning: n.补助金;津贴费
words.example:
The company received a substantial government subsidy.  公司得到大笔政府津贴。
The government is planning to abolish subsidies to farmers.  政府正计划取消对农场主人的补贴。

words.meaning: v.(使)沸腾,煮(沸)
words.example:
Liquid nitrogen boils at a very low temperature.  液态氮在很低的温度下就会达到沸点。
She scalded herself on some boiling water.  她被开水烫伤了。
If you give water to a small baby to drink, you have to boil it first.  如果你喂婴儿喝水，必须先把水烧开。

words.meaning: a.悲剧的,悲惨的
words.example:
His friends were deeply shocked and saddened by the tragic news of his death.  朋友得知他不幸去世的消息都深感震惊和哀痛。
The bomb explosion resulted in a tragic loss of life.  炸弹爆炸造成人员丧生的惨剧。
Hospital authorities admitted that a tragic mistake/error had taken place.  医院管理方承认出现了造成悲惨后果的错误／失误。

words.meaning: n.技工,机修工
words.example: He knows a lot about the mechanics of running a school.  对于如何管理一所学校，他所知甚多。

words.meaning: n.罐坛,广口瓶
words.example:
We often have a jar or two at the pub after work.  我们经常在下班后到酒吧喝一两杯啤酒。UK noun countable
With every jar of the carriage, the children shrieked with excitement.  车厢每剧烈震动一下，孩子就兴奋地尖叫。UK verb (-rr-)
The sudden movement jarred his injured ribs.  突然的一个动作震痛了他受伤的肋骨。UK verb (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.地震
words.example: In 1906 an earthquake destroyed much of San Francisco.  1906年的大地震给旧金山大部分市区带来毁灭性的灾难。

words.meaning: n.猪肉
words.example: a pork chop  猪排

words.meaning: a.含蓄的,潜在的;在下面的
words.example: And what might be the underlying significance of these supposedly random acts?  这些看似偶然的行为，其暗含的意义可能是甚么呢？

words.meaning: n.正餐后的水果或甜食
words.example:
For dessert there's apple pie, cheesecake or fruit.  甜品有苹果派、起司蛋糕和水果可供选择。
If you make the main course, I'll make a dessert.  如果你做主菜，那我就来做甜品。

words.meaning: n.同情,同情心;赞同,同感;慰问
words.example:
The president has sent a message of sympathy to the relatives of the dead soldiers.  总统已经向阵亡士兵的家属发出吊唁电报。
Of those people questioned, 93% said their sympathies were with the teachers.  接受调查的人当中有93%表示支持教师。
He is known to have right-wing sympathies.  大家都知道他支持右派。

words.meaning: n.渔夫,捕鱼人
words.example: The fisherman mended his nets.  渔夫在补网。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)短袜
words.example:
Put on your shoes and socks.  穿上鞋袜。
The little boy was wearing odd/ US usuallymismatched socks (= socks of different colours).  小男孩穿着两只不成对的袜子。UK noun
I'm going to take you to a restaurant that'll knock your socks off.  我要带你去看一家餐厅去，你准会大吃一惊。UK noun

words.meaning: num.十一 pron./a.十一(个,只...)
words.example: There are eleven girls in my class and fifteen boys.  我班上有11个女生和15个男生。noun countable [+ sing/pl verb]

words.meaning: n.[法]企业家, 主办人
words.example: He was one of the entrepreneurs of the eighties who made their money in property.  他是80年代靠房地产生意赚钱起家的企业家之一。

words.meaning: n.综合病征;并存特性
words.example: It's a classic case of the bored-housewife syndrome - she's got nothing to do all day except drink and go shopping.  这是百无聊赖的家庭主妇的典型特征——整天除了喝酒、购物，就没有甚么事情可做了。

words.meaning: n.署,局,司,处
words.example: The weather bureau issued a warning.  气象局发布了预警。

words.meaning: n.对(成功、权力等)的强烈欲望,野心;雄心
words.example:
She's got a lot of ambition.  她很有抱负。
He has already achieved his main ambition in life - to become wealthy.  他已经实现了他人生最大的志向——发财致富。
She doubts whether she'll ever be able to fulfil her ambition.  究竟是否能够实现自己的理想，她没有把握。

words.meaning: n.微风;轻而易举的事 vi.来去匆匆,急速走
words.example:
She let the gentle breeze cool her face.  她任由清凉的微风吹拂着自己的脸颊。noun
You won't have any problems with the entrance test - it's an absolute breeze.  入学考试你决不会有问题——那实在是轻而易举的事。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition
She just breezed in as if she'd only been away a day instead of a year.  她如风似地走进来，好像她只离开了一天而不是一年。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: a.昂贵的,价值高的,豪华的
words.example:
disapproving The project was subject to several costly delays/setbacks.  该工程经历了几次代价昂贵的拖延／挫折。UK adjective
Building this bridge has already been too costly in terms of lives (= people have been killed while working on it).  就建这座桥付出的生命而言，造这座桥的代价已经太高了。

words.meaning: a.有抱负的,雄心勃勃的;有野心的
words.example:
He's very ambitious for his children (= He wants them to be successful).  他望子成龙。
She has some ambitious expansion plans for her business.  她雄心勃勃，打算扩大经营规模。
The government has announced an ambitious programme to modernize the railway network.  政府已经宣布了实现铁路网现代化的宏伟规划。

words.meaning: ad.推测起来,大概
words.example:
They can presumably afford to buy a bigger apartment.  他们大概买得起一间大一点的公寓。
Presumably he just forgot to send the letter.  他可能是忘了寄信。

words.meaning: a.有影响的;有权势的
words.example:
She wanted to work for a bigger and more influential (= powerful) newspaper.  她希望为一家规模和影响力更大的报纸工作。
Johnson was influential (= important) in persuading the producers to put money into the film.  詹森在说服制作人投资拍摄此片方面起了重要作用。

words.meaning: n.翻译;译文,译本
words.example:
The children do one French translation a week.  孩子们每周做一次法语翻译。
The English version is boring - perhaps it has lost something in translation (= is not as good as the original).  英语版读起来枯燥乏味——也许翻译得有点走味。
She reads Proust in translation.  她读的是普鲁斯特作品的译本。

words.meaning: v.(使)溶解,(使)融化;解散,取消
words.example:
Dissolve two spoons of powder in warm water.  将两勺粉末溶解在温水中。
Nitric acid will dissolve most animal tissue.  硝酸能溶解大部分动物组织。UK verb
Parliament has been dissolved.  议会已被解散。

words.meaning: a.统计的,统计学的
words.example: statistical errors/evidence  统计错误／证据

words.meaning: n.[pl.]胆量;内脏a.本能的vt.取出内脏
words.example:
Meat stays in the gut longer than vegetable matter.  和蔬菜相比，肉类在消化道中停留的时间更长。
He's got a huge beer gut (= large stomach caused by drinking beer).  他有个大啤酒肚。
My guts hurt.  我五脏六腑都痛。

words.meaning: a.首都的,主要都市的,大城市
words.example: He was drawn to the metropolitan glamour and excitement of Paris.  他为巴黎的大都会魅力与激情所吸引。

words.meaning: a.(esthetic)美学的,艺术的;审美的
words.example: The new building has little aesthetic value/appeal.  新楼几乎没有甚么美学价值。

words.meaning: v.拼写
words.example:
"How do you spell 'receive'?" "R E C E I V E".  “receive 怎么拼？”“R-E-C-E-I-V-E。”
Shakespeare did not always spell his own name the same way.  莎士比亚并非总是用同样的拼法拼写自己的名字。
Our address is 1520 Main Street, Albuquerque - shall I spell that (out) (= say in the correct order the letters that form the word) for you?  我们的地址是阿尔布开克大街1520号——要我把它拼出来吗？

words.meaning: v.插入,嵌入;登载 n.插入物
words.example: These magazines have too many annoying inserts (= extra loose pages) advertising various products.  这些杂志里令人讨厌的各类产品广告插页太多。

words.meaning: n.电话亭,货摊
words.example: a telephone booth  电话亭

words.meaning: n.头盔,钢盔
words.example: a crash helmet  防撞头盔

words.meaning: n.腰,腰部
words.example:
These trousers are a bit tight around my waist.  这条裤子我穿着腰有点紧。
The skirt had an elasticated waist.  这条裙子的腰部是松紧性的。

words.meaning: n.狮子
words.example: Reputable charities spend the lion's share of donations on aid and a tiny fraction on administration.  声誉好的慈善机构将捐款的大部分都花在援助上，只有极少部分用于管理。

words.meaning: a.王室的,皇家的;第一流的,高贵的
words.example:
The team was given a royal reception/welcome.  球队受到了隆重的欢迎。
The press follow the royals everywhere.  王室成员们到哪里，新闻记者们就跟到哪里。

words.meaning: n./a.恐慌(的),惊慌(的) vt.使惊慌,使害怕
words.example:
Panic spread through the crowd as the bullets started to fly.  子弹开始满天飞，人群惊慌起来。
Carmel was in a panic about her exam.  卡梅尔很害怕考试。
He got in(to)a panic that he would forget his lines on stage.  他慌张起来，怕自己在台上会忘记台词。verb intransitive or transitive (panicking, panicked, panicked)

words.meaning: n./v.压碎,压坏 v.压服,压垮
words.example:
The package had been badly crushed in the post.  包裹在邮寄过程中被压而严重受损。
Add three cloves of crushed garlic.  加入三瓣捣碎的大蒜。
His arm was badly crushed in the car accident.  他的手臂在车祸中被压成重伤。

words.meaning: n.悬崖;峭壁
words.example: Keep away from the edge of the cliff - you might fall.  离悬崖边远一点——小心不要掉下去。

words.meaning: n.绳,索
words.example:
Where's the cord that ties back the curtains?  系着窗帘的绳子在哪里？
Have you got some cord that I can tie this parcel up with?  你有能让我捆上这个包裹的绳子吗？

words.meaning: n.可卡因,古柯碱(用作局部麻醉剂)
words.example: Cocaine possession is illegal.  持有可卡因是违法的。

words.meaning: n.幻想,错误的观念;错觉,幻觉,假象
words.example:
He had no illusions about his talents as a singer.  他对自己作为歌手的才华不抱幻想。
I'm under no illusions (= I understand the truth) about the man I married.  我对我所嫁的男人不抱幻想。
My boss is labouring under the illusion that (= wrongly believes that) the project will be completed on time.  我的老板还存有工程能按时完成的幻想。

words.meaning: a.匿名的,无名的,姓氏不明的
words.example:
The money was donated by an anonymous benefactor.  这笔钱来自一位不愿透露姓名的捐赠者。
Police said an anonymous caller warned that a bomb was about to go off.  警方说有人打来匿名电话，警告一枚炸弹即将爆炸。
An attempt to implant an embryo using an egg from an anonymous woman donor was unsuccessful.  用一位匿名女性捐赠的卵子来植入胚胎的尝试未获成功。

words.meaning: vt.容忍,默许;对(药物、毒品等)有耐力
words.example: It seems these ants can tolerate temperatures which would kill other species.  看来这些蚂蚁能够忍受可以导致其他物种死亡的高温。

words.meaning: vi.(快速地)爬,攀登;互相争夺,争先
words.example:
She scrambled up the steep hillside and over the rocks.  她爬上了陡峭的山坡，翻过岩石。
He scrambled into his clothes (= put them on quickly) and raced to fetch a doctor.  他匆匆套上衣服，跑去请医生。
As the burning plane landed, the terrified passengers scrambled for the door (= tried to reach the door quickly).  起火的飞机降落后，受惊的乘客奋力向舱门口跑去。

words.meaning: v.装饰,装璜,布置
words.example:
They decorated the wedding car with ribbons and flowers.  他们用丝带和鲜花装饰婚车。
We're going to decorate the kitchen next week.  我们下周要粉刷厨房。
They were decorated for their part in the rescue.  他们因在此次救援行动中的表现而受到嘉奖。

words.meaning: n.脉搏,脉冲
words.example:
The child's pulse was strong/weak.  那个孩子的脉搏很有力／虚弱。
Exercise increases your pulse rate.  运动能加快你的脉搏。
The data, normally transmitted electronically, can be changed into pulses of light.  这一资料通常是电子传送的，现在可被改为光波脉冲。noun

words.meaning: a.(to)相等的,等价的 n.相等物,等价物
words.example:
She's doing the equivalent job in the new company but for more money.  她在新公司做同样的工作，但薪水比以前高。
Is $50 equivalent to about £30?  50美元是不是大约相当于30英镑？noun countable usually singular
There is no English equivalent for 'bon appetit' so we have adopted the French expression.  英语中没有和 bon appetit 相对应的词，所以我们就借用了法语的这个表达方式。

words.meaning: n.日记,日记簿
words.example:
Don't forget to write/enter the date of the meeting in your diary.  别忘了在日程簿上标出开会的日期。
I've never kept (= written about what has happened to me in) a diary.  我从不写日记。

words.meaning: n.反话, 讽刺, 讽刺之事
words.example:
The irony (of it) is that the new tax system will burden those it was intended to help.  讽刺的是，新的税收制度反而将使该制度本来打算要帮助的人背上沉重负担。UK noun uncountable
Her voice heavy with irony, Simone said, "We're so pleased you were able to stay so long." (= Her voice made it obvious they were not pleased).  西蒙娜说：“你能留这么久，我们真高兴。”语气里明显带有讽刺。    Compare sarcasm

words.meaning: n.匙,调羹
words.example:
He spooned the mush into the baby's open mouth.  他用杓舀了玉米粥喂到婴儿张开的嘴里。
Spoon a little sauce over the fish.  用调羹舀一点调味汁淋到鱼上。

words.meaning: n.中间,当中
words.example:
She caught sight of Johnny in their midst (= among them) , laughing and talking.  她看到强尼在他们当中，又说又笑。
I'm afraid I'm too busy - I'm in the midst of writing up a report.  恐怕我太忙了——我正在写一份报告。
The country is in the midst of an economic crisis.  这个国家正在经历一场经济危机。preposition literary

words.meaning: v.互相作用,互相影响
words.example:
Dominique's teacher says that she interacts well with the other children.  多明尼克的老师说她与别的孩子相处得很好。
It's interesting at parties to see how people interact socially.  在聚会上看人们如何交流沟通是很有趣的。
We are studying how these two chemicals interact.  我们在研究这两种化学物质是如何相互作用的。

words.meaning: n.肥皂
words.example:
She bought me a box of prettily coloured soaps.  她买了一箱颜色漂亮的肥皂给我。
Have you soaped yourself all over, Alice?  你全身都涂肥皂了吗，艾丽斯？
Let me soap your back.  我来帮你的后背抹肥皂吧。

words.meaning: n.竞争者,对手 v.竞争,对抗 a.竞争的
words.example:
He beat his closest/nearest rival by 20 marks.  他以领先20分的成绩打败了和他水准最接近的对手。
The companies produce rival versions of the toy.  这些公司生产的玩具跟我们的产品争夺市场。verb transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
No computer can rival a human brain for/in complexity.  没有任何电脑比得上人脑复杂。

words.meaning: n.冲压机,冲床;穿孔机 v.冲压,穿孔
words.example:
She gave him a punch UKon / USin the nose.  她朝着他的鼻子打了一拳。noun
Have you seen the hole punch anywhere?  你看到打孔器在哪里了吗？verb transitive
He punched him in the stomach.  他朝他的肚子上猛击了一拳。

words.meaning: n.钉;大头针,别针,徽章 v.(up)钉住,别住
words.example:
I'll keep the trouser patch in place with pins while I sew it on.  在把裤子的补丁缝上去时，我会用别针把它固定好。
If you pull the pin out of a hand-grenade, it'll explode.  拉掉手榴弹上的保险栓它就会爆炸。
Is it a two-pin plug or a three-pin plug?  那是双脚插头还是三脚插头？

words.meaning: v.(in)坚持,持续
words.example:
If the pain persists, consult a doctor.  如果疼痛持续就去看医生。
The cold weather is set to persist throughout the week.  寒冷天气很可能将持续整个星期。
If he persists in asking awkward questions, then send him to the boss.  如果他没完没了地问令人尴尬的问题，就把他打发到老板那里去。

words.meaning: n.动力,要素
words.example:
Once you push it, it keeps going under its own momentum.  一旦你推动了它，它就会在自己的动量作用下持续运动。
The spacecraft will fly round the Earth to gain/gather momentum for its trip to Jupiter.  太空船将绕着地球飞行以获取飞向木星所需的动力。
The play loses momentum (= becomes less interesting, energetic, etc.) by its half-way stage.  这部戏演到一半时就没看头了。

words.meaning: n.钱包
words.example:
Having a lot of people out of work places a large drain on the public purse.  大量人口失业使政府的财力消耗很大。UK noun
The players in the golf tournament are competing for a purse of £525 000.  参加本次高尔夫锦标赛的选手正在为52.5万英镑的奖金而展开争夺。UK noun

words.meaning: v.流出;发散,散发,脱落,脱去 n.棚,小屋
words.example:
Psychotherapy helped him to shed some of his insecurity/inhibitions.  心理疗法帮助他摆脱了一些不安全感／自我压抑。
I'm going on a diet to see if I can shed (= become thinner by losing) a few kilos.  我要节食，看能不能甩掉几公斤。
The trees shed their leaves in autumn.  树木在秋天落叶。

words.meaning: n.液体 a.液体的,液态的
words.example:
Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.  水银在室温下为液体。adjective
She has very few liquid assets as most of her wealth is tied up in stocks and shares.  她的流动资金很少，大部分财产都投到了证券和股票上。adjective

words.meaning: n.(动物)象
words.example: An elephant drank from the river.  大象在河边喝水。

words.meaning: ad.结果,因此,所以
words.example: He ignored the warning; consequently, he got hurt.  他无视警告，结果受了伤。

words.meaning: vt.养育;收养;怀抱;鼓励 a.收养的 n.养育者
words.example:
Would you consider fostering (a child) ?  你会考虑代养一个孩子吗？    Compare adoptUK verb
I'm trying to foster an interest in classical music in my children.  我正努力培养我的孩子们对古典音乐的兴趣。
They were discussing the best way to foster democracy and prosperity in the former communist countries.  他们正在讨论促进前共产主义国家民主和繁荣的最佳办法。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.(bike)自行车 vi.骑自行车
words.example:
He got on his bicycle and rode off.  他骑着脚踏车走了。
You should never ride your bicycle without lights at night.  你千万不要在晚上不开车灯骑脚踏车。noun countable

words.meaning: v.欺骗;作弊 n.骗子;欺诈,欺骗行为
words.example:
Anyone caught cheating will be immediately disqualified from the exam.  任何人如被发现作弊将被立即取消考试资格。
He cheats at cards?  他玩牌时作弊吗？
She cheated in the test by copying from the boy in front.  她在测验中作弊，抄袭前座男孩的答案。

words.meaning: v.治愈,愈合
words.example:
The wounds were gradually healing (up).  伤口在逐渐愈合。
The plaster cast helps to heal the broken bone.  石膏绷带有利于断骨的愈合。
Peace talks were held to try to heal the growing rift between the two sides.  双方举行了和谈以弥合日益扩大的裂痕。

words.meaning: n.发热,狂热
words.example:
He's got a headache and a slight fever.  他头痛，还有点发烧。UK noun
The whole country seems to be in the grip of football fever.  全国似乎都陷入了对足球的狂热中。

words.meaning: n.滤器,滤纸
words.example:
Ozone is the Earth's primary filter for ultraviolet radiation.  臭氧层是地球上阻挡紫外线辐射的主要屏障。UK noun countable
News filtered down to us during the day.  白天的时候消息慢慢传到了我们这里。
Reports about an accident began to filter in.  有关一次意外的报道开始慢慢传开。

words.meaning: n.兔子
words.example: He's always rabbiting on about his stamp collection.  他总是没完没了地说他的集邮。

words.meaning: n.硬币,货币 v.铸造(硬币),创造(新词)
words.example:
That machine doesn't take 50p coins.  那台机器不收50便士的硬币。
Allen Ginsberg coined the term "flower power".  艾伦•金斯堡创造了 flower power（权力归花）这个说法。verb

words.meaning: v.开拓;开发;剥削 n.功绩[勋];业绩
words.example:
We need to make sure that we exploit our resources as fully as possible.  我们要确保尽可能充分利用资源。verb transitive /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/
Laws exist to stop companies exploiting their employees.  法律规定禁止公司剥削其员工。noun countable usually plural /ˈek.splɔɪt/
She was telling me about her exploits while travelling around Africa.  她跟我讲述了在非洲各地旅游时的奇遇。

words.meaning: n.生物,有机体
words.example: Amoebae and bacteria are single-celled organisms.  变形虫和细菌是单细胞生物。

words.meaning: n.感觉,知觉;激动,轰动,轰动一时的事情
words.example:
The disease causes a loss of sensation in the fingers.  这种病会使手指失去知觉。
Their affair caused a sensation.  他们的暧昧关系引起了轰动。
The books have been a publishing sensation on both sides of the Atlantic.  这些书在大西洋两岸的出版界都引起了轰动。

words.meaning: n.保存,保护,保守;守恒,不灭
words.example: Energy conservation reduces your fuel bills and helps the environment.  节省能源能减少你的燃油费，而且还有利于环境。

words.meaning: vt.乱推;乱塞vi.用力推,挤n.猛推
words.example:
She was jostled and shoved by an angry crowd as she left the court.  她离开法庭时，被愤怒的人群推来搡去。
Just wait your turn - there's no need to shove.  请按顺序等——没必要挤来挤去。
Reporters pushed and shoved as they tried to get close to the princess.  记者们推来挤去，想靠近公主身边。verb

words.meaning: v.租船,租车,租用飞机;n.宪章,特许状
words.example:
Education is one of the basic human rights written into the United Nations Charter.  受教育权是写入《联合国宪章》的基本人权之一。
The Government have produced a Citizen's/Parents'/Patients' Charter.  政府制定了一套公民／家长／病人权利章程。UK noun
They've chartered a plane to take delegates to the conference.  他们包了一架飞机送代表参加会议。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.炉子,火炉
words.example: Put the pot on the stove.  把锅放到炉子上。

words.meaning: v./n.(to)同意,赞成,答应
words.example:
They can't publish your name without your consent.  未经你的同意他们不能公布你的名字。
You can only come on the trip if your parents give their consent.  只有你父母允许，你才能参加这次旅行。
Her latest film, by common consent, is her best yet.  她的最新电影被普遍认为是她迄今最好的作品。verb intransitive

words.meaning: vt.包含,包括,由...组成;构成,组成
words.example:
The course comprises a class book, a practice book and an audio tape.  这门课的教材包括一册课本、一本练习用书和一盒录音带。
The class is comprised mainly of Italian and French students.  这个班主要由义大利和法国学生组成。
Italian students comprise 60% of the class.  义大利学生占全班人数的60%。

words.meaning: a.同样的,相像的ad.一样地;同程度地
words.example:
The children all look very alike.  孩子长得都很像。adverb
The twins even dress alike.  这对双胞胎就连衣着都一样。
My father treated us all alike.  父亲待我们一视同仁。

words.meaning: n.水坝,水闸
words.example: The Aswan High Dam is on the River Nile in Egypt.  阿斯旺水坝位于埃及境内的尼罗河上。    Compare dykeverb transitive (-mm-)

words.meaning: a.有名的,著名的
words.example: She's a well-known scientist.  她是知名的科学家。

words.meaning: n.用具,机构,全套装配 v.配备,(得到)装备
words.example:
I've got a cowboy outfit for the fancy dress party.  我有一套牛仔装，参加化装晚会时可以穿。noun
He has recently set up his own research outfit, which has as yet no name.  他最近建立了自己的研究队伍，目前还没有命名。verb transitive often passive (outfitting, outfitted, outfitted)
The ambulances have all been outfitted with new radios.  所有救护车都装备了新的无线电发收设备。

words.meaning: a.预备的,初步的
words.example:
Preliminary results show that the vaccine is effective, but this has to be confirmed by further medical trials.  初查结果显示疫苗是有效的，但这有待于进一步医学实验的证实。
We've decided to change the design based on our preliminary findings.  我们决定依据初步调查的结果对设计方案进行更改。UK noun countable usually plural
After a few polite preliminaries (= introductions) , we stated our main ideas and intentions.  几句开场白后，我们陈述了我方的主要看法和意图。

words.meaning: a.专利的,特许的n.专利(权、品)v.批准专利
words.example: "No," he replied, with patent distaste.  “不，”他回答道，语气明显地流露出厌恶感。adjective

words.meaning: a.怕羞的,腼腆的;胆怯的vi.惊退,畏缩
words.example:
He was too shy to ask her to dance with him.  他太害羞了，不敢邀请她跳舞。
She gave a shy smile.  她害羞地笑了一下。
Children are often shy of/with people they don't know.  孩子们和不认识的人在一起时常常会害羞。

words.meaning: n.垃圾;拙劣的作品;渣滓,败类
words.example:
There's only trash on the television tonight.  今晚的电视节目尽是些垃圾。
The trash really stinks - why don't you take it out?  这垃圾真臭——你为甚么不拿出去？noun uncountable
We don't have anything to do with the people in the apartment below us - they're trash.  我们与楼下公寓的人没有任何关系——他们是群废物。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.总的,毛(重)的;粗鲁的,粗俗的 n.总额
words.example:
Once wrapped, the gross weight of the package is 2kg.  包装后，这个包裹的总重量是两公斤。
She earns £30,000 a year gross.  她每年的总收入是三万英镑。    Compare netUK adjective
I'd put on ten kilos and felt gross in my bikini.  我体重增加了十公斤，穿着比基尼觉得臃肿难看。UK adjective

words.meaning: int.该死 vt.遣责;使失败 a.十足的 ad.极
words.example:
Damn, I've spilt coffee down my blouse!  真倒楣，我把咖啡洒到衬衫上了！
He knew damn well how much trouble it would cause.  他非常清楚它会带来多大的麻烦。
Next time he can damn well do it himself!  下一次他自己去做吧！

words.meaning: n.(织物)质地;(材料)构造;结构;肌理
words.example:
This artificial fabric has the texture of silk.  这种人造织物有丝一样的质感。
The writing has a rich texture.  这篇作品韵味无穷。

words.meaning: n.铅笔 vt.用铅笔写
words.example:
He sat with his pencil poised , ready to take notes.  他坐着，手里拿着铅笔准备写笔记。
The pencil's blunt - you'd better sharpen it (= make its point sharp).  铅笔钝了——你最好削一下。
Write your comments in the margin of the report in (= using) pencil.  把你的意见用铅笔写在报告的页边上。

words.meaning: n.国境,边境;尖端,新领域
words.example:
Nepal has frontiers with both India and China.  尼泊尔与中国和印度都接壤。
They lived in a town close to the frontier.  他们居住在一个离边界很近的城镇。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.喷雾,飞沫,浪花,水花 v.喷,喷射
words.example:
Can you feel the spray from the sea/waterfall?  你能感觉到海上的浪花／瀑布溅起的水雾吗？
Farmers use a lot of chemical sprays on crops.  农场主们在农作物上喷了很多化学药剂。noun
All the wedding guests wore sprays of carnations.  所有参加婚礼的来宾都戴着小枝康乃馨。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep]

words.meaning: v.揭示,泄露
words.example: Several companies have disclosed profits of over £200 million.  几家公司已公布其利润超过两亿英镑。

words.meaning: n.兽,牲畜;凶残的人,举止粗鲁的人
words.example:
The room wasn't fit for man or beast.  这个房间根本就住不了。
He was a beast to her throughout their marriage.  结婚后，他一直对她很粗暴。noun countable

words.meaning: v.(in)干涉,干预;(with)妨碍,打扰
words.example:
It's their problem and I'm not going to interfere.  那是他们的问题，我不想干涉。
I'd never interfere UKbetween a husband and wife/ USwith a husband and wife.  我从不会干涉两夫妻间的事。
Interfering in other people's relationships is always a mistake.  干涉他人谈恋爱从来都是不对的。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.橡树,橡木 a.橡木的
words.example: The timbers of those old sailing ships were mainly oak.  制造那些老帆船的木料主要是橡木。

words.meaning: n.笔记本
words.example: She was jotting things down in a little notebook.  她在一个小笔记本上匆匆记了些东西。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.轮廓,略图;大纲,梗概 v.概述,略述
words.example:
She drew the outline of the boat and then coloured it in.  她画了这只船的草图，然后给它着色。
The mountain was visible only in outline as the light faded.  光线暗了下来，只能看见山的轮廓。noun countable
If you read the minutes of the meeting, they'll give you a broad outline of what was discussed.  如果你看了会议记录，就会知道讨论的大概内容。

words.meaning: n.出席;出席人数;护理,照料
words.example:
Attendance at lectures is compulsory.  这些讲座必须去听。
Attendances at church are falling.  去教堂做礼拜的人越来越少了。noun
He never goes out without his security men in attendance.  他出门必有保镖跟随左右。

words.meaning: v.揭开,揭露
words.example:
The investigation uncovered evidence of a large-scale illegal trade in wild birds.  调查发现了大规模非法交易野生鸟类的证据。
The biography is an attempt to uncover the inner man.  该传记试图揭示他内心世界的隐秘。
Digging in her garden, she uncovered a hoard of gold dating back to the 9th century.  在花园挖土时，她挖出了一批九世纪时埋下的金子。

words.meaning: n.利益
words.example:
On behalf of the entire company, I would like to thank you for all your work.  我代表全公司对你的工作表示感谢。
Unfortunately, George cannot be with us today so I am pleased to accept this award on his behalf.  可惜乔治今天不能出席，因此我很荣幸能替他代领这个奖。
Please don't leave on my behalf.  请不要因为我而离开。

words.meaning: n.鲨鱼
words.example:
The movie 'Jaws' is about a man-eating shark.  电影《大白鲨》讲的是一条食人鲨。UK US  (plural shark or sharks)
People who need a place to live can often find themselves at the mercy of local property sharks.  需要住房的人常常会发现自己被当地那些奸诈的房地产商人所摆布。

words.meaning: n.磨粉机,磨坊;作坊,工厂
words.example:
The grain is still milled locally.  谷物仍然在当地碾磨。
In the village square, people were milling about in the sunshine.  在村庄广场上，人们在阳光下徜徉。

words.meaning: n.安装,设置;装置,设备
words.example:
Do you have to pay extra for installation?  你需要额外付安装费吗？noun
The Americans still have several military bases and installations on the island.  美国人在岛上仍有几处军事基地及设施。noun
The installation of the new archbishop will take place in January.  新任大主教的就职仪式将于一月举行。noun

words.meaning: v.刺激,使兴奋;激励,鼓舞
words.example:
The government plans to cut taxes in order to stimulate the economy.  政府计划减税以刺激经济发展。
The film was intended to stimulate and amuse.  这部电影的主要目的是助兴和娱乐。
Erotic images are often more sexually stimulating to men than to women.  色情影像在性方面对男性的刺激作用大于女性。

words.meaning: n.标签;鞋带;垂饰;vt.加标签于;附加vi.紧随
words.example: Tag on a couple of paragraphs about recent events.  添加几段最近发生的事。

words.meaning: n.舰队,船队
words.example:
The British fleet sailed from Southampton early this morning.  英国海军舰队今天清晨从南安普敦启航。noun countable
He owns a fleet of taxis.  他拥有一队计程车。adjective literary
She was slight and fleet of foot /fleet- footed.  她身材苗条，跑得快。

words.meaning: n.(catalogue)目录(册) v.编目(录)
words.example: The catalog lists all our products.  目录列出了我们所有的产品。

words.meaning: v.强迫,迫使
words.example:
formal The new circumstances compelled a change in policy.  新情况迫使在政策上作出改变。
Over the years her work has compelled universal admiration and trust.  这些年来，她的工作获得了大家的一致钦佩和信赖。

words.meaning: a.立即的;紧迫的;(食品)速溶的 n.瞬间,时刻
words.example:
This type of account offers you instant access to your money.  这种帐户允许随时支取存款。
Contrary to expectations, the film was an instant success.  与预期相反，这部电影一上映即获得成功。
In an instant her mood had changed.  顷刻间她的情绪就变了。

words.meaning: v.宣告,声明
words.example:
All the countries have proclaimed their loyalty to the alliance.  所有的国家都显示了它们对联盟的忠诚。
Republican party members were confidently proclaiming victory even as the first few votes came in.  才刚得到几张选票，共和党员就信心十足准备宣布胜利了。
Wearing scarves and hats which proclaimed their allegiance, the football fans flooded into the bar.  足球迷们戴着表示忠诚的头巾和帽子，如潮水般涌入酒吧。

words.meaning: a.全世界的,世界范围的 ad.遍及全世界
words.example: An increase in average temperature by only a few degrees could cause environmental problems worldwide.  平均气温仅仅升高几度便可能导致全球性的环境问题。
