words.meaning: n.徒步旅行;增加vi.徒步旅行vt.提高
words.example:
The recent hike in train fares came as a shock to commuters.  最近火车票价的上涨让通勤者十分震惊。noun countable
The Chancellor has hiked (up) interest rates again.  财政大臣再次提高利率。verb
She hiked up her skirt and climbed onto the bicycle.  她快速撩起裙子，跨上脚踏车。

words.meaning: n.构成,构造,组成(方式),成分;体格;宪法
words.example:
Britain has no written constitution.  英国没有成文宪法。
Under (= As part of) the union constitution, a new committee must be elected each year.  根据工会章程，委员会必须每年改选一次。UK noun countable
He has a very strong constitution.  他体质很强壮。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.感恩节
words.example: Thanksgiving is a family holiday.  感恩节是家庭节日。

words.meaning: n.气味,香味,香水,线索,嗅觉 v.嗅,发觉
words.example:
The hounds had lost the scent of the fox near the river.  猎狗在河边就闻不到狐狸的臭迹了。
"We're on the scent of something big, " said the police chief.  “我们快要抓到大鱼了，”警长说。noun
Halfway through the match, the team could already scent victory.  打了半场以后，这个球队已经嗅到胜利了。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.堆,一堆 v.堆积,堆起
words.example:
He chose a cartoon from the stack of videos on the shelf.  他从架子上的一堆录影带中挑了盒卡通片。
Don't worry, we've got stacks of time.  别担心，我们有的是时间。
Once the last few people had left the hall, the caretaker began stacking (up) the chairs.  最后几个人一离开大厅，看门人就开始把椅子堆起来。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.眉毛
words.example:
Do you pluck your eyebrows (= remove some of the hairs to change their shape) ?  你修眉毛吗？
He's got really bushy (= thick) eyebrows.  他的眉毛很浓。noun countable

words.meaning: n.袋,包,麻袋 v.解雇
words.example:
The corn was stored in large sacks.  玉米装在大麻袋里。
They gave him the sack for being late.  因为迟到，他们开除了他。
Two workers got the sack for fighting in the warehouse.  两名工人因为在仓库打架而被解雇了。noun

words.meaning: v./n.停止,中止
words.example:
Whether the protests will cease remains to be seen.  抗议活动是否会停止还说不准。
The company has decided to cease all UK operations after this year.  公司决定从明年开始停止一切在英国的业务活动。

words.meaning: vt.继承(金钱等),经遗传而得(性格、特征)
words.example:
Who will inherit the house when he dies?  他死后由谁继承房子？
All her children will inherit equally.  她所有的子女将平分遗产。verb
Rosie inherited her red hair from her mother.  罗茜那头红发遗传自她母亲。verb

words.meaning: n.盘,碟,托盘
words.example:
She was carrying a tray of drinks.  她端着一托盘饮料。
She put the letter in your in- tray.  她把信放在你的收文盘里。

words.meaning: n.先驱,倡导者,开拓者
words.example:
The pioneers went west across North America, cutting down forests and planting new crops.  拓荒者横越北美洲向西部进发，砍伐林木，种植新的农作物。UK verb transitive
It was universities that pioneered these new industries.  是大学开创了这些新兴产业。

words.meaning: n.课本,教科书
words.example:
That was a textbook goal from Taylor.  泰勒那个入球堪称典范。
It was a textbook example of how to deal with the problem.  这是如何处理此问题的一个范例。

words.meaning: a.肮脏的,卑劣的,下流的;令人厌恶的
words.example:
There's a nasty smell in here.  这里有股难闻的气味。
He had a nasty cut above the eye.  他眼睛上方有一道严重的伤口。
She has a nasty habit of picking on people in meetings.  她有一个坏习惯，经常在会上故意挑别人的毛病。

words.meaning: v.起皱,收缩;退缩,畏缩
words.example:
Your sweater will shrink if you wash it at too high a temperature.  用温度过高的水洗毛衣，毛衣会缩水。
The company's profits have shrunk from £5.5 million to £1.25 million.  公司利润从550万英镑减少到了125万英镑。
The productivity improvements have shrunk our costs by 25%.  生产率的提高使我们的成本下降了25%。

words.meaning: n.点,圆点 v.在…上打点
words.example:
The full stop at the end of this sentence is a dot.  这个句子末尾的句号是一个小圆点。
Her skirt was blue with white dots.  她的蓝裙子上有一些白色小圆点。
"What's the web address?" "www dot cambridge dot org".  那个网址是甚么? “www.cambridge.org。”

words.meaning: n.小麦
words.example:
Wheat is a staple crop for millions of people across the world.  小麦是一种为全世界亿万人提供主食的农作物。
The first round of interviews really separates the wheat from the chaff.  第一轮面试确实分出了优劣。

words.meaning: a.凶猛的,残忍的;狂热的,强烈的
words.example:
Two men were shot during fierce fighting last weekend.  上周末的激战中两人被枪击。
Fierce winds/seas prevented the race from taking place.  狂风／汹涌的海浪致使比赛无法进行。
Fire fighters had to retreat from the fierce heat.  消防员面对逼人的热浪只好后撤。

words.meaning: a.理性的,合理的
words.example: He was too upset to be rational.  他心烦意乱得很，无法保持头脑清醒。

words.meaning: n.王国,领域
words.example: The bombs are capable of blasting a whole city to kingdom come.  这些炸弹能将整座城市完全摧毁。noun countable

words.meaning: n.(教堂、教室、戏院等里的)过道,通道
words.example:
Would you like an aisle seat or would you prefer to be by the window?  您想要靠近走道的座位还是靠近窗户的？
You'll find the shampoo and the soap in the fourth aisle along from the entrance.  洗发水和肥皂在从入口处数第四个通道的货架上。noun countable

words.meaning: a.声音的;有声的;歌唱的 n.元音;声乐作品
words.example:
The six principal roles in this opera have an average vocal range of two octaves.  这出歌剧里六个主要角色的平均音域覆盖两个八度。UK adjective
He had always been a very vocal critic of the president.  他一直都直言不讳地批评总统。
During these years, suffrage demands by women became increasingly vocal.  近些年，女性要求获得投票权的呼声越来越高。UK noun countable usually plural

words.meaning: v.分散;使分心;打扰;使心情烦乱
words.example:
Don't distract her (from her studies).  不要让她（在学习上）分心。
He tried to distract attention from his own illegal activities.  他试图转移人们对其非法活动的注意。

words.meaning: n.优点,价值,功绩 v.值得,应得
words.example:
Her ideas have merit.  她的想法很有价值。
Brierley's book has the merit of being both informative and readable.  布赖尔利的书兼具内容丰富和可读性强的优点。
We discussed the merits of herbal tea.  我们讨论了药草茶的好处。

words.meaning: n.折扣;贴现(率) vt.打折扣;不重视
words.example:
They usually give you a discount if you buy multiple copies.  你如果多买几本他们通常会给你打折。
They offer a 10 percent discount on rail travel for students.  他们给乘火车旅行的学生提供10%的折扣。verb[dɪˈskaʊnt/
You shouldn't discount the possibility of him coming back.  你不应该排除他回来的可能性。verb[dɪˈskaʊnt/

words.meaning: n.梯子,阶梯
words.example:
She was up a ladder, cleaning the window.  她站在梯子上擦窗子。UK noun
Once he started at Paramount in 1967, he moved rapidly up the corporate ladder.  1967年他开始在派拉蒙电影公司工作，此后他在公司里升得很快。
Damn! That's the second pair of tights I've laddered today!  真该死！我今天换上的第二条紧身裤也抽丝了。

words.meaning: n.丛林,生死地带
words.example:
The Yanomami people live in the South American jungle.  亚诺马米人生活在南美丛林中。
Either side of the river is dense, impenetrable jungle.  河的两岸是茂密得难以穿行的丛林。noun
Our garden is a real jungle.  我们的花园真是乱七八糟。

words.meaning: vt.入侵,侵略,侵袭,侵扰
words.example:
Concentrations of troops near the border look set to invade within the next few days.  部队在边境附近集结，看来几天内必定会入侵。
Hundreds of squatters have invaded waste land in the hope that they will be allowed to stay.  数百人涌入荒地，希望能获准留在那里。
Maria looks set to invade the music scene with her style and image.  看来玛丽亚准备好了要凭借她自身的风格和形象进军乐坛。

words.meaning: n.飓风
words.example:
The state of Florida was hit by a hurricane that did serious damage.  佛罗里达州遭受了飓风袭击，损失严重。
Hurricane force (= very strong) winds are expected tonight.  预计今晚会有飓风级的强风。

words.meaning: v.分类,分等(级)
words.example:
The books in the library are classified by/according to subject.  图书馆的书是按照学科分类的。
Biologists classify animals and plants into different groups.  生物学家把动物和植物归入不同的类别。

words.meaning: n.大使;特使,(派驻国际组织的)代表
words.example:
Britain's ambassador in Moscow has refused to comment.  英国驻莫斯科大使已拒绝发表评论。
She's a former ambassador to the United States.  她是前任驻美国大使。
Late last night, the French ambassador was summoned to the Foreign Office to discuss the crisis.  昨晚深夜法国大使被外交部召见，商讨危机事宜。

words.meaning: n.密集,密度,浓度
words.example:
The area has a high/low population density.  该地区人口密度大／小。
We were unable to move because of the density of the crowd.  人太多，我们根本就动不了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Lead has a high density.  铅的密度大。

words.meaning: n.好奇心;古董,古玩
words.example:
I'm burning with curiosity - you must tell me who's won!  我心急火燎地想知道——你一定要告诉我是谁赢了！
She decided to call her ex-boyfriend out of curiosity.  她出于好奇决定给以前的男友打电话。
Cars like mine are curiosities nowadays.  像我拥有的这种车如今实属罕见了。

words.meaning: vi.略过,跳过 n.跳跃 vt.故意忽略;略过
words.example:
She watched her little granddaughter skip down the path.  她看着自己的小孙女沿着小路蹦蹦跳跳地往前走。
The lambs were skipping about in the field.  这些小羊在田里蹦来跳去。verb (-pp-)
Sports players often train by skipping.  运动员经常透过跳绳进行训练。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.机器人,自动机械
words.example: The robot assembles the parts.  机器人组装零件。

words.meaning: v./n.浸,蘸
words.example:
Dip the fish in the batter, then drop it into the hot oil.  先把鱼在面糊中浸一下，然后再放进热油中。
She dipped her toe into the pool to see how cold it was.  她把脚趾伸到水塘里试试水有多凉。
As you turn the corner, the road dips suddenly.  转过那个街角，路陡然下降。

words.meaning: ad.同样地,照样地;又,也,而且
words.example: Just water these plants twice a week, and likewise the ones in the bedroom.  这些植物一周浇两次水，睡房里的那些也一样。

words.meaning: n.羽毛
words.example:
The bird ruffled its feathers.  这只鸟竖起了羽毛。UK noun countable
It's a real feather in our cap to be representing Britain in this contest.  代表英国参加这次比赛是真正让我们引以自豪的事。UK verb transitive specialized

words.meaning: n.球,球体;范围,领域
words.example: Doctors have replaced the top of his hip bone with a metal sphere.  医生们用一个金属球替换了他的髋骨顶端。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.(of,about)自夸,夸耀 n.自夸,大话
words.example:
He didn't talk about his exam results in case people thought he was boasting.  他没有谈论自己的考试成绩，以免让别人以为他在自我吹嘘。
Parents enjoy boasting about their children's achievements.  父母喜欢夸耀子女所取得的成绩。
Ireland boasts beautiful beaches, great restaurants and friendly locals.  爱尔兰拥有美丽的海滩、很棒的餐馆和友好的当地人。UK noun countable disapproving

words.meaning: v./n.轻拍,轻打,抚摸
words.example:
He patted my head/patted me on the head affectionately.  他慈爱地拍了拍我的头。
The minister came out with a pat answer/response.  那位部长作出了一个预先准备好的答覆。adjective usually disapproving
I'd given the talk so many times I had it off pat.  这个讲座我讲的次数太多了，都滚瓜烂熟了。

words.meaning: a.单独的,唯一的 n.脚垫,鞋底
words.example:
My sole objective is to make the information more widely available.  我唯一的目的就是让更多的人能了解到这些资讯。
The sole survivor of the accident was found in the water after six hours.  事故唯一的幸存者于六小时后在水里被发现。
She has sole responsibility for the project.  她独立负责该企划案。

words.meaning: n.公开,宣传,广告,推销
words.example:
He attracted a lot of adverse/bad publicity with his speech about unmarried mothers.  他针对未婚妈妈所作的演讲招致了媒体的不少抨击。
Her first novel was published last year in a blaze of (= with a lot of) publicity.  她的第一部小说去年在大张旗鼓的宣传下出版。
We have planned an exciting publicity campaign with our advertisers.  我们和广告人员一起策划了一场十分精彩的宣传活动。

words.meaning: vt.打开;显露;展示 vi.呈现;显示;展示
words.example:
If we unfold the table we can fit eight people around it.  如果我们把折叠桌打开，就能坐下八个人了。
He watched her expression as she unfolded the letter.  他注视着她拆信时的表情。UK verb
Like a lot of people, I've watched the events of the last few days unfold on TV.  和许多人一样，我在电视上看到了最近几天的事件报道。

words.meaning: a.部分的,不完全的;偏袒的,不公平的,偏爱的
words.example:
The general has ordered a partial withdrawal of troops from the area.  将军已下令部队部分人员撤出该地区。UK adjective
The reporting in the papers is entirely partial and makes no attempt to be objective.  报纸上的报道毫不客观，而且也没打算保持客观。    Opposite impartialUK adjective
I'm rather partial to red wine.  我特别爱喝红葡萄酒。

words.meaning: n.衣领;环状物
words.example:
The bird has grey feathers with a lighter collar.  这种鸟长有灰色羽毛，但颈部的颜色要淡一些。
She was collared by the police at the airport.  她在机场被警方逮捕了。

words.meaning: n.杂草,野草 v.除草,锄草
words.example:
He looks like a real weed in those shorts.  他穿着那条短裤看起来真的很瘦弱。verb intransitive or transitive
I've been weeding (the vegetable garden).  我一直在（菜园子里）除草。verb intransitive or transitive
The first round of interviews only really serves to weed out the very weakest of applicants.  第一轮面试实际上只是要淘汰那些实力最弱的申请者。

words.meaning: n./v.一瞥,瞥见
words.example:
We glimpsed the ruined abbey from the windows of the train.  透过火车车窗，我们瞥见了修道院的废墟。noun countable
This biography offers a few glimpses of his life before he became famous.  这部传记展示了他成名前的一些生活情况。

words.meaning: n.前提,房屋连地基v.提论,预述,假定
words.example:
The research project is based on the premise stated earlier.  这项研究计划是基于早先提出的假设之上的。verb transitive /prɪˈmaɪz/    /ˈprem.ɪs]    formal
He premised his argument on several incorrect assumptions.  他把自己的论证建立在了几个错误的假设之上。

words.meaning: v.认为,相信
words.example: The risk was deemed acceptable.  该风险被认为可接受。

words.meaning: vi.偷偷地走,溜vt.偷偷地做(或拿、吃)
words.example:
Jan hasn't got a ticket but I thought we might sneak her in.  简没有票，但我想我们或许可以把她偷偷带进去。
She was one of those dreadful children who was always sneaking on other kids in the class.  几个讨人厌的孩子总是向老师打小报告，说班里其他孩子的坏话，她就是其中一个。noun countable UK (US snitch) (Australian dobber)    slang disapproving
You told Mrs Cooper that it was me who tipped the paint over, didn't you - you nasty little sneak!  是你告诉了库珀夫人我打翻了油漆，对吗——你这卑鄙的告密者！

words.meaning: n.猴子
words.example:
They ate all the cakes, the monkeys.  他们吃掉了所有的蛋糕，这些捣蛋鬼。
[as form of address] Hey, put that down, you little monkey!  嘿，放下它，你这个小淘气！noun countable
The children were bored and started monkeying around.  孩子都感到厌烦了，开始胡闹。

words.meaning: n.闪电 a.闪电般的,快速的
words.example:
That tree was struck by lightning.  那棵树被闪电击中了。
She changed her clothes with lightning speed (= extremely quickly).  她飞快地换了衣服。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.袖子
words.example:
The sleeves are too long for me.  对我来说，这袖子太长了。
You'd better roll your sleeves up or you'll get them dirty.  你最好卷起袖子，否则会把它们弄脏的。noun countable
Can you put the record back in its sleeve, please?  你能把唱片放回封套里吗?

words.meaning: v.扰乱,妨碍,使不安
words.example:
Please don't disturb Georgina - she's trying to do her homework.  请不要打扰乔治娜——她正在用功做功课。
I'm sorry to disturb you so late, but my car's broken down and I was wondering if I could use your phone.  很抱歉这么晚来打扰你，我的汽车坏了，想借用一下你的电话。
Several England supporters were arrested and charged with disturbing the peace after the match.  几位英格兰队的支持者被捕，他们被指控在赛后扰乱治安。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.肋骨,肋状物
words.example:
My son broke a rib when he fell off a ladder.  我儿子从梯子上摔了下来，摔断了一根肋骨。
He cooked rib of lamb for Sunday lunch.  星期天午饭时他做了羊排。
His brothers ribbed him about his new girlfriend.  兄弟们拿他新交的女朋友取笑他。

words.meaning: a.过多的;过分的;额外
words.example:
Excessive exercise can sometimes cause health problems.  过度的运动有时也会导致健康问题。
Any more pudding would simply be excessive.  不能再吃布丁了，再吃就太多了。

words.meaning: n.杆,棒
words.example:
He was given a fishing rod for his birthday.  别人送给他一根钓鱼竿作为生日礼物。
The concrete is strengthened with steel rods.  混凝土内加入钢筋变得更加牢固。UK noun countable
By giving in to the terrorists' demands, the government will simply be making a rod for its own back.  政府要是屈从于恐怖分子的要求就只会惹火烧身。

words.meaning: a.逻辑的,符合逻辑的
words.example:
Students need the ability to construct a logical argument.  学生要具备逻辑论证的能力。
It was the logical thing to do (= the decision was a reasonable one when all the facts were considered).  这样做才合乎逻辑。    Opposite illogical

words.meaning: n.灰,灰末;(pl.)骨灰;(pl.)废墟
words.example:
Her ashes were scattered at sea.  她的骨灰撒在大海里去了。
Allied bombing left Dresden in ashes in 1945.  1945年盟军对德累斯顿发动轰炸，将其夷成平地。noun

words.meaning: a.空白的,空着的;失色的 n.空白;表格
words.example:
Sign your name in the blank space at the bottom of the form.  在表格底部的空白处签名。adjective
Some of the names in the report have been blanked out.  报告中有些名字已经被抹掉了。
There may be traumatic incident in your past that you have blanked out.  过去你可能经历过创伤，而你已经从记忆中抹去了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.(pl.)日用品;商品;农/矿产品;有用之物
words.example:
The country's most valuable commodities include tin and diamonds.  该国最有价值的商品包括锡和钻石。
If you're going into teaching, energy is a necessary commodity.  如果你要当教师这一行，就必须有充沛的精力。

words.meaning: v.(of)治愈,医治;矫正 n.治愈,痊愈;良药
words.example:
At one time the doctors couldn't cure TB/cure people of TB.  曾经有一段时期，医生无法治愈肺结核／肺结核病人。
Finance Ministers meet this week to discuss how to cure inflation.  财政部长们本周将举行会晤讨论如何解决通货膨胀问题。UK verb transitive
There's still no cure for cancer.  还没有能治愈癌症的方法。

words.meaning: n.矿物,矿石 a.矿物的,矿质的
words.example: The speaker emphasized that much of South Africa's importance lay in its mineral wealth.  发言者强调说南非的重要性很大程度上源于其丰富的矿藏。

words.meaning: n./v.饥饿;渴望
words.example:
By about 9 o'clock she started to feel faint from/with hunger.  九点的时候，她开始饿到有点头晕。
All over the world, people die of hunger every day.  世界上每天都有人饿死。UK noun
I've never hungered after power.  我从不渴望权力。

words.meaning: a.多余的,备用的 v.节约,节省;抽出(时间)
words.example:
Have you got a spare pen?  你有多余的笔吗？
We've got a spare room if you want to stay overnight with us.  要是你想在我们这里过夜的话，我们有一个空房间。
Could I have a word with you when you've got a spare moment/minute ?  如果你有时间，我能否和你谈两句？

words.meaning: n.同等;平等;相等;等式;等同性
words.example: equality between the sexes  男女平等

words.meaning: n.坟墓,墓地,坟场
words.example: An old cemetery sits behind the church.  教堂后面有座老墓地。

words.meaning: n.骚扰,扰乱;烦恼,烦乱
words.example: sexual harassment  性骚扰

words.meaning: n.名声;名望;传说 vt使出名;传扬…的名
words.example:
She first rose to fame as a singer at the age of 16.  她16岁时便作为歌手一举成名。
She moved to London in search of fame and fortune.  她为了追逐名利移居伦敦。
The town's fame rests on its beautiful 14th-century abbey.  这个镇因其建于14世纪的美丽修道院而闻名。

words.meaning: v./n.遗憾,懊悔,抱歉
words.example:
The manager expressed deep regret at/for the number of staff reductions.  被裁减的员工人数众多，对此经理深表遗憾。
We think, much to our regret (= and we are very sorry about this) , that we will not be able to visit you next year.  我们觉得，明年可能没法到你们家去做客了，真是遗憾。
We did have an invitation, but we had to send Graham our regrets.  我们确实收到了请柬，但是我们脱不开身，不得不向格雷厄姆致歉辞谢。verb transitive (-tt-)

words.meaning: a.显著的;惹人注目的,容貌出众的
words.example:
She bears a striking resemblance to her mother.  她酷似她母亲。
There's a striking contrast between what he does and what he says he does.  他的所作所为和他所说的话大相径庭。
St Peter's Church is a striking example of mission revival architecture.  圣彼得教堂是教会复兴风格建筑的典范之作。

words.meaning: n.可能性
words.example:
This latest dispute greatly increases the likelihood of a strike.  最近的这场冲突极大地增加了罢工的可能性。
There is little likelihood now that interest rates will come down further.  现在利率进一步下降的可能性几乎为零。

words.meaning: n.胡萝卜
words.example: Sometimes I just have to resort to the carrot and stick approach with my children.  有时候我只能对我的孩子采取软硬兼施的办法。

words.meaning: n.(道路、桥等的)通行费;牺牲;死伤人数
words.example:
He's just got a job collecting tolls at the start of the motorway.  他刚刚得到了一份在高速公路入口处收通行费的工作。
Is Bayonne a toll call (= a more expensive telephone call) from New York?  从纽约打电话到贝约纳是长途吗？UK noun
Independent sources say that the death toll from the earthquake runs into thousands.  独立消息人士称地震中的伤亡人数达到数千人。UK noun

words.meaning: n.(圆物的)边,边缘;(眼镜)框
words.example:
The rim of the cup was chipped and broken.  杯口上碰出了裂纹，碎了。
My reading glasses have wire rims.  我阅读用的眼镜是金属丝边的。verb transitive (-mm-)
The glass was rimmed with sugar.  杯口上沾了一圈糖。

words.meaning: v.(to)粘住;依附;坚持
words.example:
We got so wet that our clothes clung to us.  我们湿透了，衣服紧紧地贴在身上。
They clung together in terror as the screams grew louder.  尖叫声越来越大，他们惊慌地紧紧抱在一起。
One little girl was clinging onto a cuddly toy.  一个小女孩紧紧抱着一件可爱的玩具。

words.meaning: a.(of)可疑的,多疑的,疑心的
words.example:
Her behaviour was very suspicious (Australianinformalsuss).  她的举止相当启人疑窦。
The fire at the bank is being treated as suspicious.  银行起火这件事被认为相当可疑。
It 's a bit suspicious that no one knows where he was at the time of the murder.  有点可疑的是，没有人知道谋杀案发当时他在哪里。

words.meaning: a.符合条件的;(尤指婚姻等)合适(意)的
words.example:
Are you eligible for early retirement/maternity leave?  你符合提前退休／休产假的条件吗？
You might be eligible for a grant.  你或许有资格得到奖学金。
Only people over 18 are eligible to vote.  只有18岁以上的人才有资格投票。

words.meaning: v.(into)(使)投入,(使)插进,陷入;猛冲
words.example:
We ran down to the beach and plunged into the sea.  我们跑向海滩，纵身跳入海中。
The car went out of control and plunged over the cliff.  轿车失去控制坠下悬崖。
Cook the peas by plunging them into boiling water.  把豌豆倒入沸水中煮。

words.meaning: n.寒冷,寒气,寒战 v.使寒冷
words.example:
I've put the beer in the fridge to chill.  我把啤酒放到了冰箱里冰镇一下。
Chill the wine before serving.  上酒前先冰镇一下。verb intransitive or transitive
This is a film that will chill you to the marrow.  这是部令人毛骨悚然的影片。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.避难处,藏身处
words.example:
These people are seeking/taking refuge from persecution.  这些受到迫害的人正在寻求庇护。
The climbers slept in a mountain refuge.  这些登山者在山上一个可以避风挡雨的地方睡下了。
She had fled from her violent husband to a women's refuge in Chelmsford.  她从她残暴的丈夫身边逃离，躲进了切姆斯福德的一间妇女庇护所。

words.meaning: vt.驾驶,为…操舵;引导vi.驾驶
words.example:
She carefully steered the car around the potholes.  她小心开车绕过那些坑洞。
This car is very easy to steer.  这辆车很容易开。
The ship passed Land's End, then steered towards southern Ireland.  船绕过兰兹角，接着向爱尔兰南部驶去。

words.meaning: v.重整,恢复,振作 n.聚集,集会,拉力赛
words.example:
The French driver has taken the lead in the Paris-Dakar rally.  在巴黎─达喀尔汽车拉力赛中，法国车手一路领先。noun countable
Share prices fell again today after yesterday's rally.  股票价格在昨天回升后再次下跌。verb
Supporters/Opponents of the new shopping development are trying to rally local people in favour of/against it.  新购物中心开发项目的支持者／反对者们试图召集当地居民支援／反对该项目。

words.meaning: v.(使)振奋,(使)高兴 v./n.喝彩,欢呼
words.example:
Everyone cheered as the winners received their medals.  当优胜者接受奖牌时，大家都欢呼起来。
He was cheering for the other side.  他正为另一方喝彩。UK verb intransitive
As the runners went by, we cheered them on.  赛跑者经过时，我们为他们呐喊加油。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.出路,出口;销路,市场;发泄方法;电源插座
words.example:
Her work provided no outlet for her energies and talents.  她的工作没有给她提供发泄精力及施展才华的机会。
Writing poetry was his only form of emotional outlet.  写诗是他宣泄感情的唯一方式。noun countable

words.meaning: a.完整无缺的,未经触动的,未受损伤的
words.example:
The church was destroyed in the bombing but the altar survived intact.  教堂在轰炸中被毁，但神坛却完好无损。
It's difficult to emerge from such a scandal with your reputation still intact.  经历这样的丑闻难保你的名声不受损害。

words.meaning: v.兴旺,繁荣
words.example:
His business thrived in the years before the war.  战前那些年，他的生意很兴隆。
She seems to thrive on stress.  她似乎很擅长在压力下工作。

words.meaning: n.花生
words.example: They pay people peanuts in that organization.  那家机构给的酬金微不足道。

words.meaning: v.咀嚼;思量
words.example:
This meat is difficult to chew.  这肉很难嚼。
You don't chew your food enough - that's why you get indigestion.  你没把食物嚼碎——这就是你患上消化不良的原因。
Would you like some gum to chew?  你想吃口香糖吗？

words.meaning: v./a.精心制作(的);详细阐述(的)
words.example:
You want a plain blouse to go with that skirt - nothing too elaborate.  你应该用一件样式简单的衬衫来配那条裙子，不要样式太复杂的。
They're making the most elaborate preparations for the wedding.  他们正为婚礼做极为精心周到的准备。
He came out with such an elaborate excuse that I didn't quite believe him.  他突然说了那么一大套理由，搞得我不敢相信他。verb intransitive /ɪˈlæb.ə.reɪt/    slightly formal

words.meaning: n./vt.拍卖
words.example:
They're holding an auction of jewellery on Thursday.  他们将在周四举行一场珠宝拍卖会。
The painting will be sold at / UK also by auction next week.  这幅画将在下周拍卖。
The house and its contents are being put up for auction.  这座房子及里面的家俱已被交付拍卖。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.牛排;大块肉(或鱼)片
words.example: Shall we have steak for dinner?  我们晚餐吃牛排好吗？

words.meaning: v.(with)遵照,照做,应允;顺从,服从
words.example:
He's been ordered to have the dog destroyed because it's dangerous, but he refuses to comply.  那只狗很危险，因此他接到了把它人道毁灭的命令，但他拒绝服从。
There are serious penalties for failure to comply with the regulations.  不遵守规定者将受到严惩。

words.meaning: n.胜利,成功 v.得胜,战胜
words.example:
The book celebrates the hostages' remarkable triumph over appalling adversity.  这本书颂扬人质脱离可怕险境的壮举。
The signing of the agreement was a personal triumph for the Prime Minister.  签订该协议对首相而言是一项伟大的个人成就。
It was the Republican Party's third election triumph in a row.  这是共和党连续第三次赢得选举胜利。

words.meaning: a.(with,to)可比较的,比得上的
words.example:
The girls are of comparable ages.  这群女孩年龄相仿。
Our prices are comparable to/with those in other shops.  我们的价格和其他商店的差不多。
The two experiences aren't comparable.  这两段经历不能相比。

words.meaning: v.运输,运送,搬运n.运输;运输系统,运载工具
words.example:
The company will arrange transport from the airport.  公司将安排从机场起的运输。
Do you have your own transport (= vehicle) ?  你自己有车吗？
Bicycles are a cheap and efficient form of transport.  脚踏车是一种便宜而高效的交通工具。

words.meaning: n.良心,良知
words.example:
You didn't do anything wrong - you should have a clear conscience (= not feel guilty).  你没做错甚么——你应该觉得问心无愧。
My conscience would really trouble me if I wore a fur coat.  要是我穿件皮草大衣，确实会良心不安。
He's got no conscience at all (= does not feel guilty) about leaving me to do the housework.  他对于把家务丢给我一点都不觉得内疚。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.间隔,间歇;(幕间或工间)休息
words.example:
We see each other at regular intervals - usually about once a month.  我们定期见面——通常大约是每月一次。
There's often a long interval between an author completing a book and it appearing in the shops.  从作者完成一本书到它出现在书店里常常有一段较长的间隔。
There will be two twenty-minute intervals during the opera.  歌剧演出中有两次20分钟的幕间休息。

words.meaning: v.抓,搔,扒 n.抓,搔,抓痕;起跑线
words.example:
We scratched the paintwork trying to get the bed into Martha's room.  我们把床搬进玛莎的房间里时，把漆面给划坏了。
People have been scratching their names on this rock for years.  许多年来人们都在这块岩石上刻写名字。
I'm afraid I scratched some paint off the door as I was getting out of the car.  恐怕我下车时磨掉了车门上的一些漆。

words.meaning: a.醒着的 vt.唤醒,使觉醒 vi.醒来,醒悟到
words.example:
She used to lie awake at night worrying about how to pay the bills.  她过去常常夜里躺在床上合不上眼，发愁怎样付帐单。
Businesses need to be awake to the advantages of European integration.  企业界应意识到欧洲一体化的好处。verb intransitive or transitive (awoke or US ALSO awaked, awoken)    US ALSO    literary
She awoke me at seven.  她七点时叫醒了我。

words.meaning: n.远征(队),探险(队)
words.example:
We're going on a shopping expedition on Saturday.  星期六我们要去购物。
Scott died while he was on an expedition to the Antarctic in 1912.  史考特1912年死于南极探险途中。
The British expedition to Mount Everest is leaving next month.  英国珠穆朗玛峰探险队将于下个月启程。noun

words.meaning: n.盖
words.example:
Can you get the lid off this jar?  你能把罐子的盖打开吗？
Put a lid on the saucepan.  给平底深锅盖上盖子。
She looked at him from under half-closed lids.  她眯着眼睛看着他。noun countable

words.meaning: a.哑的,无言的
words.example:
He's been deaf and dumb since birth.  他生下来就又聋又哑。
She was struck dumb by what she had seen.  她被自己看到的一切吓得说不出话来。adjective
Are they brave or just dumb?  他们是真的勇敢还是只是匹夫之勇？

words.meaning: n.体积,容积;主体,大批,大量,大块
words.example:
She eased her large bulk out of the chair.  她缓缓地将她那庞大的身躯从椅子上挪开。
It was a document of surprising bulk.  这是一份篇幅惊人的文件。
The office buys paper in bulk to keep down costs.  办公室大量买进纸张以减少成本。

words.meaning: n.洒,喷,淋
words.example:
Sprinkle a few herbs on the pizza./Sprinkle the pizza with a few herbs.  在比萨上撒些香料调味。
figurative The speech was liberally sprinkled with (= contained many) jokes about the incident.  这场演讲多次拿那件事开玩笑。noun countable usually singular (US also sprinkling)

words.meaning: n.转变,转换;信仰的改变;
words.example:
Her conversion to Buddhism/Islam was a very gradual process.  她对佛教／伊斯兰教的皈依是一个渐进的过程。
He used to be very right-wing, but he's undergone something of a conversion recently.  他过去是个极右翼分子，但最近有些转变。
Solar power is the conversion of the sun's energy into heat and electricity.  太阳能动力是将太阳能转化为热和电。

words.meaning: n.赞助人;资助人;老顾客,老主顾
words.example:
The Princess Royal is a well-known patron of several charities.  众所周知，长公主是好几家慈善机构的赞助人。noun countable
Will patrons kindly note that this shop will be closed on 17th July.  各位顾客请注意，本店7月17日将暂停营业。

words.meaning: a.市(立,政)的;地方性的,地方自治的
words.example: municipal authorities  市政当局

words.meaning: n.肝,肝脏
words.example: The doctor checked his liver function.  医生检查了他的肝功能。

words.meaning: n.协调,和谐;融洽
words.example:
It is a simple melody with complex harmonies.  这是一首和声复杂的简单旋律。UK noun
Imagine a society in which everyone lived together in (perfect) harmony.  设想一下有这样一个社会，所有人都和睦地生活在一起。
We must ensure that tourism develops in harmony with the environment.  我们必须确保旅游业与环境和谐发展。

words.meaning: n.宽容;容忍,忍受;耐药力;公差
words.example:
This period in history is not noted for its religious tolerance.  历史上的这个时期在宗教上并不宽容。
Some members of the party would like to see it develop a greater tolerance of/towards contrary points of view.  党内的一些成员希望看到党对反面意见能更加宽容。UK noun
My tolerance of heat is considerably greater after having lived in the Far East for a couple of years.  在远东生活了几年后，我的耐热能力大为增强。

words.meaning: n.山羊
words.example:
Stop acting the goat!  别再做蠢事了！UK noun countable
That sort of attitude really gets my goat.  那种态度实在是让我发火。

words.meaning: n.香蕉
words.example: a bunch of bananas  一串香蕉

words.meaning: n.宫,宫殿
words.example:
The Queen has agreed to open Buckingham Palace to the public.  女王同意对外开放白金汉宫。
An old movie palace is being restored.  一家豪华的老电影院正在修复中。

words.meaning: n.(不用于英国或美国)小农;佃农;农民
words.example:
Tons of internationally donated food was distributed to the starving peasants.  数吨国际社会所捐赠的食品被分给了这些饥饿的农民。
Most of the produce sold in the market is grown by peasant farmers.  市场上出售的大部分产品是由自耕农民种植的。
Peasant women with scarves around their heads were working in the fields.  农妇头上都包着围巾，正在田地里工作。

words.meaning: a.整洁的,干净的,优美的,精致的
words.example:
Your house is always so neat - how do you manage it with three children?  你的房子总是这么整洁——你有三个孩子，是怎么做到的？
She likes everything neat and tidy.  她喜欢一切都井井有条。
You've got such neat handwriting.  你的字写得真工整。

words.meaning: n.超级市场
words.example: The supermarket is open twenty-four hours.  超市二十四小时营业。

words.meaning: v.巡航;以节省燃料的速度前进 n.乘船巡游
words.example: He spends the weekends cruising the bars.  周末他泡在酒吧里寻花问柳。

words.meaning: a.可动的,活动的,运动的
words.example:
You've broken your ankle but you'll be fully mobile (= able to walk as usual) within a couple of months.  你摔断了脚踝，但用不了几个月你就可以行动自如了。UK noun countable
My mobile's 07796 10253.  我的手机号码是07796 10253。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.日历,月历
words.example: the Christian/Jewish/Chinese calendar  基督教／犹太教／中国历法

words.meaning: n.寡妇
words.example: The widow inherited the house.  寡妇继承了这所房子。

words.meaning: v.存放;使沉淀;付(保证金) n.存款;沉积物
words.example:
The flood waters fell, depositing mud over the whole area.  洪水退去后，留下的淤泥覆盖了整个地区。
The bus deposited me miles from anywhere.  公车把我扔在一个前不着村后不着店的地方。
The cuckoo deposits (= puts) her eggs in other birds' nests.  布谷鸟把自己的蛋下在其他鸟类的窝里。

words.meaning: n.胡须
words.example:
He's growing a beard.  他在留胡子。
He shaved off his beard but kept his moustache.  他剃了下巴上的胡须，但保留了嘴唇上面的胡子。
With a nervous swallow he bearded the formidable-looking librarian behind the desk.  他紧张地咽了咽口水，鼓起了勇气，看着桌子后面那个凶神恶煞般的图书管理员。UK verb transitive literary

words.meaning: v./n.制动(器),闸,刹车
words.example:
She had no brakes on her bicycle.  她的脚踏车没有煞车器。
The taxi driver suddenly UK applied / US put on his brakes.  计程车司机突然踩了刹车。
informal I slammed on (= quickly used) the brake, but it was too late.  我赶忙踩刹车，可已经来不及了。

words.meaning: v.推动 n.推动;冲动,刺激
words.example: an electrical/nerve impulse  电脉冲／神经冲动noun

words.meaning: v.禁止,不许
words.example:
The law forbids the sale of cigarettes to people under the age of 16.  法律禁止向16岁以下的未成年人出售香烟。
He is forbidden from leaving the country.  他被限制出境。UK US (forbidding, forbade or old use forbad, forbidden)    old use
Heaven forbid (that) his parents should ever find out.  但愿他的父母永远都不会发现。

words.meaning: n.毛,毛皮
words.example:
She stroked the rabbit's soft fur.  她轻抚着兔子身上软软的毛。
Native Americans traded furs with early European settlers.  美洲印第安人与早期的欧洲定居者进行毛皮交易。UK noun
The fur was really flying during that meeting.  那次会议上吵得很厉害。UK noun

words.meaning: a.残忍的;严峻的;严酷的
words.example:
He had presided over a brutal regime in which thousands of people had 'disappeared'.  在他残暴的统治下，成千上万的人“失踪”了。
He was imprisoned in 1945 for the brutal murder of a 12-year old girl.  1945年，他因残忍杀害了一名12岁女孩而入狱。
She spoke with brutal honesty - I was too old for the job.  她毫不留情地直接告诉我，我年纪太大，不适合这份工作。

words.meaning: n.刺,戳,懒汉,袋子 v.戳,刺,伸出,刺探,闲荡
words.example:
You'll poke someone in the eye with that umbrella if you're not careful!  你不小心的话伞尖会戳到别人眼睛的！
Two kids were poking a stick into the drain.  两个孩子正在把一根棍子插到排水管里面去。UK verb
Cathy poked her head round the door to say hello.  凯茜从门后探出头来打招呼。

words.meaning: vi.抉择,选择
words.example:
Mike opted for early retirement.  麦克选择了提前退休。
Within any society, there will usually be people who decide to opt out (= choose not to live the way most people do).  通常，任何社会都会有人决定不按常规方式生活。
The government has been encouraging individuals to opt out of the state pension scheme.  政府一直在鼓励个人不参加国家养老金制度。    opt-out

words.meaning: a.自愿的,志愿的
words.example:
They chose to take voluntary redundancy.  他们选择自愿离职。
She does voluntary work for the Red Cross two days a week.  她每周志愿为红十字会服务两天。
The hospital has asked various voluntary organizations to help raise money for the new operating theatre.  医院已经请求各种志愿组织为筹建新手术室募集资金。

words.meaning: n.论坛,讨论会
words.example: Discussion forums are a way of contacting people with similar interests from all over the world.  各种交流讨论的论坛可以把世界各地兴趣相同的人联系起来。UK noun countable

words.meaning: vi.(指鸟等)高飞,翱翔;飞涨;高耸
words.example:
All night long fireworks soared into the sky.  整个晚上烟火不断地窜上高空。
Temperatures will soar into the eighties over the weekend say the weather forecasters.  天气预报员说，周末气温会骤升至华氏80多度。
House prices had soared a further twenty per cent.  房价又窜升了20％。

words.meaning: n.移动,迁居;除去
words.example:
Does your firm do removals?  你们公司承接搬家业务吗？noun uncountable
There have been calls for the president's removal.  一直有要求总统下台的呼声。

words.meaning: n.自治,自治权;
words.example:
Demonstrators demanded immediate autonomy for their region.  游行示威者要求立即实现该地区的自治。
The universities are anxious to preserve their autonomy from central government.  大学都迫切希望维护其自主办学权，不受中央政府的控制。

words.meaning: n.线,细丝;线索,思路;螺纹 v.穿线,穿过
words.example:
One of the main threads of the film is the development of the relationship between the boy and his uncle.  电影的其中一条主线是男孩和他叔叔之间的关系发展。
Unfortunately my attention wandered for a moment and I lost the thread of (= forgot) what I was saying.  遗憾的是我一时失神，忘了刚才在说甚么。
The sari had gold strands threaded through the material.  这件莎丽的布料间穿上了金线。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.碎片,小部分,一点儿;分数
words.example:
Although sexual and violent crimes have increased by 10%, they remain only a tiny/small fraction of the total number of crimes committed each year.  尽管性犯罪和暴力犯罪案件增长了10%，但它们在每年的罪案总数中所占比例仍然很小。
They can produce it at a fraction of the cost of (= much more cheaply than) traditional methods.  他们能够以大大低于传统方法的成本生产它。

words.meaning: n.门槛;入门,开端
words.example:
His secretary earns £268 a month, well below the threshold for paying tax.  他的秘书每月赚268英镑，远远不够纳税的标准。UK noun
We are on the threshold of a new era in European relations.  我们欧洲国家间的关系即将进入一个新时代。

words.meaning: n.套间;一套家具;套,组,系列
words.example:
The singer was interviewed in his £1500 a night hotel suite.  这位歌手在每晚1500英镑的饭店套房里接受采访。
They've got a whole suite of offices on the 34th floor.  他们在34层有一整套的办公室。noun countable
We're having a new bathroom/bedroom suite fitted at the weekend.  周末我们要请人在浴室／卧室安装一套新家俱。

words.meaning: n.稻草,麦杆;吸管
words.example:
Why don't you drink your milkshake through a straw?  你为甚么不用吸管喝奶昔？UK noun
She offered to take a pay cut to keep her job, but she was just clutching at straws.  她提出减薪以保住工作，但这只不过是在乱抓救命稻草。UK noun
Losing my job was bad enough, but being evicted from my house was the final straw.  失去工作已经够糟，但被房东赶出门后我彻底崩溃了。

words.meaning: v.使筋疲力尽,耗尽;抽完 n.排气装置;废气
words.example:
The long journey exhausted the children.  长途旅行后，孩子们疲惫不堪。
I've exhausted myself with all that cleaning.  打扫完，我累得筋疲力尽。UK verb transitive
How long will it be before the world's fuel supplies are exhausted?  再过多长时间地球上的燃料就耗尽了？

words.meaning: n.球体,地球仪;地球,世界
words.example:
His greatest ambition is to sail round the globe.  他最远大的志向就是驾船环球航行。
She is a superstar all around the globe.  她是一位国际超级巨星。
She spun the globe, and pointed to the Solomon Islands.  她转动地球仪，然后指向所罗门群岛。UK noun

words.meaning: a.易碎的,脆的,易损坏的;虚弱的,脆弱的
words.example:
Be careful with that vase - it's very fragile.  拿那个花瓶要小心——它很容易碎。
The assassination could do serious damage to the fragile peace agreement that was signed last month.  这宗行刺事件可能会对上月签署的脆弱的和平协定造成严重损害。
humorous No breakfast for me, thanks - I'm feeling rather fragile (= ill, upset or tired) after last night's party.  我不吃早餐了，谢谢——昨晚派对后到现在我还觉得很不舒服。

words.meaning: n.(to)反对,异议,不喜欢,反对的理由
words.example: Her objection to/against the plan is based on incorrect facts.  她对这项计划的反对基于错误的数据。

words.meaning: n.化学
words.example:
She studied chemistry and physics at college.  她在大学学的是化学和物理。
There was an immediate sexual chemistry between us the first time we met.  我们两性相吸，初次见面就擦出了火花。

words.meaning: n.一阵(风);爆炸冲击波;管乐器声 v.爆炸
words.example:
They heard the guns blasting away all night.  他们听到枪炮声响了一整夜。
figurative Their latest record blasted (its way) up the charts (= moved very quickly because of its popularity).  他们最新的唱片在排行榜上名次直线上升。
The government was blasted by the opposition for failing to reduce inflation.  政府因未能缓解通货膨胀而遭到反对派的抨击。UK verb

words.meaning: v.(over,against)取胜,占优势;流行,盛行
words.example:
And did reason prevail over (= become a more powerful influence than) emotion?  理智战胜了情感吗？
This attitude still prevails among the middle classes.  这种观点在中产阶级里仍然很普遍。 formal
He was eventually prevailed upon to accept the appointment.  他最后被说服，接受了这项任命。

words.meaning: a.通宵的,晚上的 ad.在昨夜,一夜工夫,突然
words.example:
You can stay overnight if you want to.  要是你愿意，可以住一晚。
Don't forget to pack an overnight bag (= a bag for things that you need when you stay away from home for a night).  别忘了收拾在外过夜的用品旅行袋。UK adjective adverb
She became a star overnight.  她一夜之间成了明星。

words.meaning: n.否认;拒绝;否认某事或某事实的声明
words.example:
The prime minister issued a denial of the report that she is about to resign.  首相发表声明，对她将辞职的报道予以否认。
His denial of responsibility for the accident was unconvincing.  他声称自己毋须为这次事故负上责任，但他的说法并不令人信服。
He's still in denial about the break-up of his relationship.  他仍然无法接受他们分手的事实。noun

words.meaning: a.(fantastical)奇异的,幻想的,异想天开的
words.example:
You look fantastic in that dress.  你穿着那条连身裙看起来棒极了。
We had a fantastic time.  我们玩得很痛快。
They've won a holiday? How fantastic!  他们赢得了一个假期？太棒了！adjective

words.meaning: n.碎片,小部分,片断
words.example:
The road was covered with fragments of glass from the shattered window.  马路上到处是车窗的碎玻璃片。
Literary scholars are piecing together her last unpublished novel from fragments of a recently discovered manuscript.  文学研究者们正在把最近发现的她最后一部未发表小说的手稿残片一点点拼凑起来。verb intransitive or transitive /frægˈment/
The satellite will fragment and burn up as it falls through the Earth's atmosphere.  卫星坠经地球大气层时会碎裂起火，化为灰烬。

words.meaning: n.螺旋,螺丝(钉) v.拧,拧紧
words.example:
Give it another screw to make sure the lid doesn't come off while we're travelling.  把盖子再拧紧一点，那么我们在路上的时候盖子就不会掉落。noun
He's a really good screw.  他真是个很棒的性伴侣。noun
They put the screws on him until he paid up.  他们给他施加压力，直到他把钱全部付清为止。verb

words.meaning: n.暖和,温暖;热心,热情
words.example: We felt the warmth of the sun.  我们感受到了阳光的温暖。

words.meaning: n.大学生,大学肆业生
words.example: As an undergraduate, she studied physics.  本科时她学物理。

words.meaning: n.头痛
words.example:
I've got a splitting (= severe) headache.  我头痛得很厉害。noun countable
Finding a babysitter for Saturday evening will be a major headache.  要在星期六晚上找个照顾小孩的人真是件让人头痛的事。

words.meaning: n.警察
words.example: A policeman directed the crowd.  警察疏导着人群。

words.meaning: a.(for)合适的,适宜的
words.example:
The film is suitable for children.  这部电影适宜儿童观看。
My mother doesn't like me wearing short skirts to church - she doesn't think they're suitable.  我妈妈不喜欢我穿着短裙去教堂——她认为这不太合适。    Opposite unsuitable

words.meaning: v.练习;操练;钻孔 n.操练;练习;钻孔(机)
words.example:
In some of these schools, army-style drills are used to instil a sense of discipline.  这些学校中有一些利用军训来培养纪律观念。
What's the drill for getting money after four o'clock?  四点钟以后怎么取钱？verb
Drill three holes in the wall for the screws.  在墙上打三个拧螺丝钉用的小孔。

words.meaning: a.残忍的,残酷的
words.example:
Don't tease him about his weight - it's cruel.  别拿他的体重开玩笑——这样太刻薄了。
Children can be very cruel to each other.  小孩相互之间会很残忍。
His death was a cruel blow.  他的死是个无情的打击。 [krʊəl] (crueller, cruellest or crueler, cruelest)

words.meaning: n.葡萄
words.example: black/white/red/green grapes  紫／白／红／绿葡萄

words.meaning: n.村舍,小屋,别墅
words.example: They live in an idyllic country/thatched cottage, with roses round the door.  他们住在田园诗般的乡村小屋／茅舍，门前玫瑰环绕。

words.meaning: n.吸引力,魅力 v.迷人,(使)陶醉;施魔法于
words.example:
It's a town with a lot of old-world charm.  这是座极具古朴魅力的城镇。
Even as a young boy he knew how to turn on the charm (= be pleasant intentionally) when he wanted something.  即使在小时候，他也知道在想要东西时怎样施展魅力。
He keeps a rabbit's paw as a lucky/good luck charm.  他保留着一只兔爪作为能带来好运的护身符。UK noun

words.meaning: a.(to)忠诚的,忠贞的
words.example:
Jack has been a loyal worker in this company for almost 50 years.  杰克是这间公司忠诚的员工，已经工作了快50年了。
When all her other friends deserted her, Steve remained loyal.  当其他朋友都离她而去的时候，史蒂芬依然对她不离不弃。
She's very loyal to her friends.  她对朋友非常忠诚。    Opposite disloyal

words.meaning: n.粘土,泥土
words.example: The artists shaped the clay into bowls.  艺术家们把黏土捏成碗。

words.meaning: n.气球,飞船;a.气球状的 v.乘坐气球;膨胀
words.example:
We tied balloons and streamers to the ceiling ready for the party.  我们把气球和彩带系在天花板上，晚会的布置已准备妥当。
People first flew in a balloon in 1783.  人类于1783年首次乘热气球飞行。
The balloon went up last Friday when the scandal became public.  自上周五丑闻公开以后，局面就变得一片混乱。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.发明,创造,发明物
words.example:
The world changed rapidly after the invention of the telephone.  电话发明后世界的变化日新月异。
All that gossip about Linda was just pure invention.  有关琳达的所有流言都纯属虚构。
Be careful what you believe - her powers of invention (= ability to think of excuses, etc.) are well known.  注意你该信甚么——她编瞎话的本领是出了名的。

words.meaning: n.自我,自负,利已主义;(心理学)自我意识
words.example:
That man has such an enormous ego - I've never known anyone so full of themselves!  那个人自负得要命——我从来没有见过这么目中无人的人。
I'm glad she got the job - she needed something to boost/bolster her ego (= give her confidence).  我很高兴她得到了这份工作——她太需要点甚么来增强她的信心了。

words.meaning: n.车费,船费;伙食;乘客 v.过活;进展;经营
words.example:
Train fares are going up again.  火车票又涨价了。
How did you fare in your exams?  你考得怎么样？
Low-paid workers will fare badly/well under this government.  在这届政府执政期间，低收入工人的境况会很糟／很好。

words.meaning: n.(学生的)家庭作业、课外人员
words.example:
You can't watch TV until you've done your homework.  做完功课之后你才能看电视。
It was obvious that she had done her homework and thoroughly prepared for her interview.  很明显她为面试做足了功课，准备很充分。

words.meaning: n.(disk)圆盘,圆面,盘状物
words.example: The dog's name was engraved on a little metal disc attached to its collar.  那条狗的名字刻在一块吊在项圈上的金属小圆盘上。

words.meaning: n.长沙发,沙发
words.example: The cat sleeps on the sofa.  猫睡在沙发上。

words.meaning: n.雷达
words.example: Other vessels in the area show up on the ship's radar (screen).  该船的雷达（萤幕）显示这一海域有其他船只。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.皱眉
words.example:
She frowned at me, clearly annoyed.  她皱着眉头看着我，显然是生气了。
He frowned as he read the instructions, as if puzzled.  他看说明书时皱着眉头，一副迷惑不解的样子。verb intransitive
Smoking is frowned upon in many restaurants.  很多餐馆里都禁止吸烟。

words.meaning: n.毛衣,绒衣,厚运动衫
words.example: Put a sweater on if you're cold.  如果你觉得冷就穿件毛线衫吧。

words.meaning: n.橡皮,橡胶;橡胶制品,胶鞋
words.example:
Tyres are almost always made of rubber.  几乎所有轮胎都是用橡胶制成的。
We played a rubber of bridge.  我们进行了一次三局两胜制的桥牌比赛。UK noun

words.meaning: v.撤退,退却
words.example:
Attacks by enemy aircraft forced the tanks to retreat (from the city).  敌机的轰炸迫使坦克（从这座城市）撤离。
When she came towards me shouting, I retreated (behind my desk).  她大叫着冲向我时，我就后退（到了桌子后面）。
When he's done something wrong, he retreats to his bedroom.  他要是做了甚么错事，就会躲到自己睡房里去。verb

words.meaning: n.分子
words.example: The molecule contains six atoms.  这个分子含六个原子。

words.meaning: a.(favourable)赞许的,有利的,讨人喜欢的
words.example: The weather was favorable for sailing.  天气适合航海。

words.meaning: n.小伙子,年轻人;少年,儿童
words.example: The scheme is for youngsters between the ages of 10 and 16.  该方案适用于年龄介乎10至16岁之间的少年儿童。

words.meaning: n.额外费用,奖金,奖赏,保险费
words.example:
We're willing to pay a premium for the best location.  为了得到最好的地段，我们愿意多付些钱。
Because of their location, these offices attract a premium.  由于地段好，这些办公室租金更高。
The modified cars are available at a premium of 5% over the original price.  改装后的汽车的售价要比原价高5%。

words.meaning: v.淹没,覆没,压倒,制服,使不知所措
words.example:
Government troops have overwhelmed the rebels and seized control of the capital.  政府军已击败了叛乱者，控制了首都。UK verb
They were overwhelmed with/by grief when their baby died.  婴儿夭折时他们悲痛欲绝。

words.meaning: vt.盘算,计议;周密考虑;注视,凝视
words.example:
You're not contemplating a change of job, are you?  你没考虑要换工作，是吗？
It's too awful/horrific/dangerous to contemplate.  这件事太糟糕／可怕／危险，简直不敢想。

words.meaning: v.更新,使现代化
words.example:
We'll update you on this news story throughout the day.  我们将全天向您报道该新闻事件的最新进展。noun countable /ˈʌp.deɪt/
Jo's just doing an update on the mailing list.  乔正在更新邮寄名单。
I'll need regular updates on your progress.  我要定期了解你的最新进展。

words.meaning: n.火花,火星 v.发火花,发电花
words.example:
That small incident was the spark that set off the street riots.  那件小事是引发街头暴动的导火线。UK noun
Sparks were flying out of the bonfire and blowing everywhere.  营火中飞溅出很多火星，迸得到处都是。
You can start a fire by rubbing two dry pieces of wood together until you produce a spark.  你可以透过摩擦两块干木头直到产生火花来点火。

words.meaning: n./v.(使)疲劳
words.example:
She was suffering from fatigue and a stress-related illness.  她劳累不堪，还患了与压力有关的疾病。
The crash was caused by metal fatigue in one of the propeller blades.  坠机事件是因一片螺旋桨叶发生金属疲劳造成的。
Get dressed right now or you'll find yourself on fatigues.  马上整装，否则罚你做杂役。verb transitive old use or formal

words.meaning: vi.思索;推测vt.投机;思索,推测
words.example:
Journalists are speculating about whether interest rates will be cut.  记者们在猜测是否会降息。
He made his money speculating on the London gold and silver markets.  他在伦敦黄金市场和白银市场上做投机生意赚了钱。
The company has been speculating in property for years.  这家公司做房地产投机生意已经有好几年了。

words.meaning: v.宣讲(教义),布道;竭力鼓吹,宣传;说教
words.example:
Father Martin preached to the assembled mourners.  马丁神父向聚集的哀悼者们布道。
During the sermon, he preached about the need for forgiveness.  在布道期间，他宣讲了宽恕的必要性。verb
They preach the abolition of established systems but propose nothing to replace them.  他们竭力鼓吹废除现行体制，但没有提出取代方案。verb

words.meaning: n.水桶,吊桶
words.example:
Armed with a bucket and a mop, I started washing the floor.  提着桶和拖把，我开始拖地板。
The rain came down in buckets.  天下起了倾盆大雨。noun countable
It was my first interview and I was sweating buckets.  那是我第一次面试，我紧张得大汗淋漓。noun countable

words.meaning: v.挑动;激发;招惹
words.example:
The prospect of increased prices has already provoked an outcry.  物价上涨的预测已经引发了强烈抗议。
Test results provoked worries that the reactor could overheat.  检测结果引发了核子反应炉可能过热的担忧。UK verb transitive
It was a vicious-looking dog and I didn't want to provoke it.  那只狗看起来很凶，我并不想招惹它。

words.meaning: n.大理石,云石
words.example: a marble floor/statue  大理石地板／雕像UK noun

words.meaning: a.详述的,明确的;坦率的;显然的
words.example: She was very explicit about (= said very clearly and exactly) what she thought was wrong with the plans.  她明确地指出了计划中她认为有误的地方。

words.meaning: a.磁的,有磁性的;有吸引力的
words.example: The magnetic field is strongest at the poles.  磁场在两极最强。

words.meaning: n.技术员,技师,技工
words.example: a laboratory technician  实验室技术员noun countable

words.meaning: n.喃喃而语,小声低语;抱怨 v.低声说,抱怨
words.example:
Stop muttering and speak up!  别咕哝了，大声说出来！
He was muttering (away) to himself.  他在喃喃自语。
Laurence muttered something about his wife and left.  劳伦斯低声说了他妻子的甚么事就离开了。

words.meaning: vi.离开,起程 a.过去的,逝世的
words.example:
The plane departs at 6.00 a.m.  那架飞机在早上六时起飞。
The train for London departs from Platform 2.  前往伦敦的列车从2号月台开出。UK US  formal
In loving memory of my dear husband, who departed this life on May 5, 1978.  深切怀念我亲爱的丈夫，他于1978年5月5日辞世。UK US  formal

words.meaning: n.箭,矢,箭状物;箭头符号
words.example: Robin Hood asked to be buried where his arrow landed.  罗宾汉让人们把他安葬在他的箭落下的位置。    Compare dart

words.meaning: v.浸泡,浸湿,浸透
words.example:
The wind had blown the rain in and soaked the carpet.  雨被风吹进了屋里，打湿了地毯。
You'd better wipe up that red wine you've spilt before it soaks (= is absorbed) into the carpet.  你最好把洒在地毯上的红酒擦掉，免得渗进地毯里。
Blood had soaked through both bandages.  血已经把两条绷带都浸透了。

words.meaning: n.缎带,丝带,带,带状物
words.example:
Sandra often wears a ribbon in her hair.  桑德拉常在头发上扎条丝带。
He tied up the present with ribbon.  他用缎带将礼物包扎起来。
My typewriter needs a new ribbon.  我的打字机得换色带了。noun

words.meaning: n.(meanwhile)其间,其时 ad.同时,当时
words.example: Your computer won't be arriving till Thursday. In the meantime, you can use Jude's.  你的电脑星期四才到。在这段时间里你可以用祖德的。

words.meaning: vt.传输/导;转送;发射 vi.发射信号;发报
words.example:
Radio Seven transmits on 201 medium wave (= uses those particular radio waves to broadcast on).  广播七台透过中波201千赫广播。
The information is transmitted electronically to the central computer.  这些资讯以电子化的方式传送到中央电脑。UK US  (-tt-)
Cholera is transmitted through contaminated water.  霍乱是透过受污染的水传播。

words.meaning: n.收获,收成;成果,后果 v.收获,收割
words.example:
We had a good harvest this year.  今年我们收成不错。
Farmers are reporting a bumper (= very big) harvest this year.  农民说今年的收成非常好。
It won't be long now till harvest (time).  现在离收获时节不远了。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: a.连续的;连贯的;顺序的
words.example: This is the fifth consecutive weekend that I've spent working, and I'm a bit fed up with it.  这是我连续第五个周末加班，我有点厌倦了。

words.meaning: a.同等的,并列的;坐标的 n.坐标
words.example:
We need someone to coordinate the whole campaign.  我们需要有个人来协调整个活动。
The bed linen coordinates with the bedroom curtains.  床单和睡房的窗帘很相配。

words.meaning: n.间谍 v.当间谍,刺探;察觉,发现
words.example:
He was arrested for spying on missile sites.  他因搜集有关飞弹基地的情报而被捕。
We drove around the area where our new house is to spy out the land.  我们开车在新房子的周遭地区绕了一圈，了解一下环境。verb
He was spying on her through the keyhole.  他从锁孔里窥探着她。

words.meaning: n.狭缝;空位vt.放入狭缝中;把…纳入
words.example:
The holder has slots for 100 CDs.  这个CD架的凹槽可以放100张CD。UK noun countable
The programme will occupy that half-hour slot before the nine o'clock news.  那个节目将在九点新闻前的半小时这一时段播出。UK verb intransitive or transitive [+ adv/prep] (-tt-)
The legs of the chair are meant to slot into the holes at the back.  椅子脚要插到后面的洞里。

words.meaning: n.暴(骚)乱,蔓延,彩色缤纷 v.骚乱,暴动
words.example:
Inner-city riots erupted when a local man was shot by police.  在市中心的贫民区，由于一名当地男子被员警开枪打死而突然引发了暴乱。
Jim's rose garden is a riot of colour.  占姆的玫瑰园五彩缤纷。noun
My imagination was running riot, thinking of all the ways that I could spend the money.  我的思维像匹脱缰的野马，放任地想着花掉那笔钱的种种方法。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.岭,山脉;屋脊;鼻梁
words.example:
We walked along the narrow mountain ridge.  我们沿着狭窄的山脊行进。
figurative A ridge (= narrow area) of high pressure will bring good weather this afternoon.  今天下午高压脊将会带来好天气。

words.meaning: a.勇敢的 v.勇敢地面对(危险等)
words.example:
It was a brave decision to quit her job and start her own business.  她辞职自己创业是个大胆的决定。
She was very brave to learn to ski at fifty.  她50岁开始学滑雪可真勇敢。
Of the three organizations criticized, only one was brave enough to face the press.  三家受到批评的机构中，只有一家敢于面对媒体。

words.meaning: v.指定,详细说明
words.example:
He said we should meet but didn't specify a time.  他说我们应该见个面，但没说具体时间。
The peace treaty clearly specifies the terms for the withdrawal of troops.  和平条约明确规定了撤军的条件。
The loan must be repaid within a specified period/by a specified date.  贷款必须在指定期限内／指定日期前偿还。

words.meaning: vt.挫败,阻挠,使灰心
words.example:
It frustrates me that I'm not able to put any of my ideas into practice.  我的任何想法都无法付诸实践，这让我很灰心。verb transitive
The continuing civil war is frustrating the efforts of relief agencies.  持续的内战使救济机构的努力受挫。

words.meaning: a.善于表达的;有关节相连的 v.清楚地讲话
words.example:
Many people are opposed to the new law, but have had no opportunity to articulate their opposition.  很多人不赞成这项新法律，但是却没有机会表达他们的反对意见。
When children first learn to talk, there are some sounds that they find difficult to articulate.  小孩子刚学说话时，有一些音他们很难发出来。

words.meaning: a.浓厚的,密集的,稠密的
words.example:
The body was found hidden in dense undergrowth.  尸体被发时是藏在密密的树丛下面。
We've got some really dense people in our class.  我们班有些人特笨。adjective
Plutonium is very dense.  钚的密度很大。

words.meaning: n.(大学的)研究班,研讨会
words.example: I'm giving a seminar on the latest developments in genetic engineering next week.  下周我将举行一个有关遗传工程最新进展的研讨会。

words.meaning: n./v.肿胀;膨胀;增大;增加;
words.example:
It was obvious she had broken her toe, because it immediately started to swell (up).  她的脚趾显然已经骨折，因为它开始肿胀了。
Twenty-five employees have joined the union in this month alone, swelling its ranks (= increasing its size) to 110.  仅这个月就有25位员工加入工会，使工会的人数增加到110人。
literary His heart/breast swelled with pride (= He felt very proud) as he stood watching his son graduate.  当他站在那里观看儿子的毕业典礼时，心中充满自豪。

words.meaning: 暗示, 提示, 球杆
words.example:
She watched his lips carefully and took her cue from him.  她紧盯着他的嘴唇，照他的吩咐行事。noun countable
The architects took their cue for the design of the new pub from the nearby Jacobean house, Aston Hall.  建筑师们对新酒吧的设计深受附近詹姆斯一世时期的建筑——阿斯顿大厅的影响。verb transitive (cueing, cued, cued)    (also cue in)
With a nod of his head, the drummer cued the lead singer in.  鼓手点了一下头，给领唱作了个暗示。

words.meaning: n.新娘
words.example:
He returned from New York with his lovely new bride.  他和漂亮的新娘一起从纽约回来了。
The bride and groom posed for pictures outside the church.  新娘和新郎在教堂外摆姿势照相。
As the mother of the bride, I feel obliged to wear something really spectacular.  作为新娘的母亲，我得穿戴得华丽一些。

words.meaning: n.传记;传记文学
words.example: He wrote a biography of Winston Churchill.  他撰写了温斯顿‧丘吉尔的传记。    Compare autobiography ; hagiography

words.meaning: n.危险,冒险,危害 v.冒险,拼命
words.example:
The busy traffic entrance was a hazard to pedestrians.  那个繁忙的车辆入口处对行人来说很不安全。UK verb transitive
The policy hazarded the islands and put the lives of the inhabitants at risk.  这项政策将这些岛屿和岛上的居民置于危险的境地。

words.meaning: ad.很少,不常
words.example:
Now that we have a baby, we seldom get the chance to go to the cinema.  有了孩子以后，我们很少有机会看电影。
formal Seldom do we receive any apology when mistakes are made.  出错的时候，我们很少收到道歉。

words.meaning: n.瓦片,瓷砖 vt.铺瓦于,贴砖于
words.example: We're going to tile the bathroom.  我们要给浴室贴瓷砖。

words.meaning: n.外国人
words.example: The foreigner struggled with chopsticks.  这个老外用筷子很费劲。

words.meaning: n.便利,方便;(pl.)便利设备
words.example:
Just for convenience, I'm going to live at my mother's place until my new house is ready.  为了方便，我打算在我的新居收拾好之前先住在我母亲那里。
The goods will be delivered at your convenience.  货物随传随到。
Please return the completed form at your earliest convenience.  请将填好的表格尽快交回。noun

words.meaning: n.快乐,高兴 v.(使)高兴,(使)欣喜
words.example:
My sister's little boy is a real delight.  我姐姐的小儿子很讨人喜欢。
The children squealed in delight when they saw all the presents under the Christmas tree.  孩子们看到圣诞树下的各种礼物时兴奋地叫了起来。
He seems to take great delight in (= enjoys) teasing his sister.  他似乎觉得逗他妹妹玩很有趣。

words.meaning: v.编(织) n.编织法,编织式样
words.example:
This type of wool is woven into fabric which will make jackets.  这种羊毛被织成衣料，用来做外套。
We were shown how to roughly weave ferns and grass together to make a temporary shelter.  有人给我们示范了如何将蕨类植物和草简单地编起来，搭成临时的栖身之所。
It takes great skill to weave a basket from/out of rushes.  用灯心草编篮子需要很高技巧。

words.meaning: n.木材,木料
words.example: These trees are being grown for timber.  这些树是供材用而栽种的。

words.meaning: prep.直到,直到…为止,与until意思相同
words.example:
We waited till half past six for you.  我们一直等你到六点半。
Up till 1918, women in Britain were not allowed to vote.  在1918年以前，英国不允许妇女参加选举。
How long is it till your baby is due?  你还有多久生孩子？noun countable mainly UK (US usually register)

words.meaning: n.(法律)抗辩;请求,恳求,托词,口实
words.example:
He made a plea for help/mercy.  他恳求得到帮助／宽恕。noun countable
Mr Wilson entered a plea of not guilty.  威尔逊先生提出了无罪申诉。

words.meaning: n.灯泡,球状物
words.example: tulip bulbs  郁金香球茎noun countable

words.meaning: n.魔鬼
words.example:
Those little/young devils broke my window.  那些小淘气鬼打破了我的窗户。
Have another slice of cake - go on, be a devil!  再吃一件蛋糕——吃吧，豁出去了！
He's been ill for weeks, poor devil.  他已病了好几个星期了，可怜的家伙。noun

words.meaning: n.螺栓,(门,窗的)插销 v.闩(门),关窗,拴住
words.example:
The house next to ours was struck by a bolt of lightning.  我们隔壁的房子被闪电击中了。
The thief tried to make a bolt for the exit.  小偷想从安全出口溜走。UK noun countable
The news of his marriage was a bolt from the blue.  他结婚的消息真是出人意料。UK verb

words.meaning: n.船货,货物
words.example: The ship was carrying a cargo of wool from England to France.  这艘船正将羊毛货品从英格兰运往法国。

words.meaning: n.脊柱,脊椎;(动植物的)刺;书脊
words.example:
She injured her spine in a riding accident.  她在一次坠马事故中脊椎受伤。
figurative The Apennine mountains form the spine (= central row of mountains) of Italy.  亚平宁山脉是义大利的中心山脉。noun countable

words.meaning: a.(in)熟练的,有技能的;需要技能的
words.example:
My mother is very skilled at/in dressmaking.  我母亲很会做衣服。
Nursing is a highly skilled job.  护理工作是技术性要求很高的工作。plural noun

words.meaning: a.海的,海生的;船舶的,航海的
words.example:
The oil slick seriously threatens marine life around the islands.  浮油严重威胁着岛屿周围的海洋生物。
Marine biologists are concerned about the effects of untreated sewage that is flowing into coastal waters.  污水未经处理就排到近海海域，海洋生物学家对其后果十分担心。
One plane, a marine F18, was lost in the raid.  突袭行动中损失了一架F18舰载战斗机。

words.meaning: n.船坞,码头
words.example:
The strike has led to the cancellation of some ferry services and left hundreds of passengers stranded at the docks.  罢工导致部分轮度停业，数百名旅客滞留码头。
The defendant seemed nervous as he left the dock and stepped up to the witness box.  被告人在离开被告席走向证人席时似乎有些紧张。
The company will find itself in the dock (= in court) if it continues to ignore the pollution regulations.  如果该公司继续无视控制污染的规定，它就会被告上法庭。UK noun

words.meaning: n.雾气,雾 v.以雾笼罩,被雾笼罩
words.example:
Thick/Heavy/Dense fog has made driving conditions dangerous.  浓雾使开车颇为危险。
Mists, freezing fogs and snow are common in this area.  薄雾、寒雾和雪在这个地区很常见。
It took several hours for the fog to lift.  几个小时以后雾才散去。UK noun

words.meaning: ad.将来(或过去)某个时候a.以前的
words.example:
We really should meet sometime soon to discuss the details.  我们的确应当尽快抽个时间讨论一下细节。
The enquiry will be headed by Lord Jones, sometime editor of the 'Daily News'.  《每日新闻》的前主编琼斯勋爵将主持这项调查。

words.meaning: n.摘要,概要 a.概括的,简略的
words.example: At the end of the news, they often give you a summary of the main news stories.  在新闻结束的时候，他们常常会总结一下主要的新闻内容。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: a.教会的,传教(士)的 n.传教士
words.example: He did missionary work for the Presbyterian Church in Alaska.  他曾在阿拉斯加为基督长老教会做传教工作。

words.meaning: a.流行性的;传染的 n.流行病;传播
words.example:
Poverty in this country has reached epidemic proportions.  这个国家很多人处于贫困之中。
Crime and poverty are epidemic in the city.  犯罪和贫穷如瘟疫一般在这个城市肆虐。

words.meaning: a.致命的,毁灭性的
words.example:
This illness is fatal in almost all cases.  这种病几乎是不治之症。
He made the fatal mistake/error of believing what they told him.  他听信了他们的话，犯了灾难性的错误。
It just shows how you should never say how well things are going for you - it's fatal (= it causes bad things to happen).  这件事恰恰说明你决不能说事情进展很顺利——这么讲会带来大麻烦。

words.meaning: a.整齐的,整洁的 v./n.整理,修整,装饰
words.example:
My hair needs trimming.  我的头发需要剪一剪。
Trim off the leafy ends of the vegetable before cooking.  烹饪之前，去掉菜多叶的一端。verb transitive (-mm-)
They're trying to trim their costs, so staff who leave are not being replaced.  他们正试图降低成本，所以没有安排填补离职员工的空缺。adjective (trimmer, trimmest)

words.meaning: n.仓库,货栈
words.example:
The goods have been sitting in a warehouse for months because a strike has prevented distribution.  因为罢工无法发货，货物已经堆在仓库里好几个月了。
We bought both sofas from a big furniture warehouse that's just off the motorway.  这两张沙发都是我们在高速公路旁的一家大型家俱店里买的。

words.meaning: v.使加速,使增速,促进 vi.加快,增加
words.example:
Inflation is likely to accelerate this year, adding further upward pressure on interest rates.  今年通货膨胀可能会加剧，迫使利率持续上升。
They use special chemicals to accelerate the growth of crops.  他们使用特殊的化学品来刺激农作物生长。

words.meaning: n.蝴蝶
words.example: She's such a social butterfly.  她可真是个交际花。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.青铜;青铜色,古铜色;青铜制品,铜牌
words.example:
The church bells are made of bronze.  教堂大钟是青铜制成的。
He got a bronze in the high jump.  他跳高得了铜牌。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.溺死,淹没
words.example:
He drowned in a boating accident.  他在一次划船事故中溺水身亡。
Many animals were drowned by the tidal wave.  许多动物被潮水淹死了。verb
disapproving He drowned his food in/with tomato sauce.  他在食物上浇了很多番茄酱。verb

words.meaning: a.固有的,内在的,天生的
words.example: There are dangers/risks inherent in almost every sport.  几乎每种运动本身都带有危险／风险。

words.meaning: v.吐(唾沫),吐痰 n.唾液
words.example:
Bob Ewell spat contemptuously right in the lawyer's face.  鲍勃‧尤厄尔轻蔑地朝律师脸上吐了口唾沫。
He spat the meat out in disgust.  他厌恶地把肉吐了出来。
They bought watermelons and ate them as they walked, spitting out the seeds.  他们买了西瓜，边走边吃，一路吐着西瓜籽。

words.meaning: v.跪,下跪
words.example:
She knelt (down) beside the child.  她在孩子身旁跪下。
He knelt in front of the altar and prayed.  他跪在圣坛前祈祷。

words.meaning: v.口授;(使)听写;指令,指示,命令;
words.example:
The UN will dictate the terms of troop withdrawal from the region.  联合国将决定军队从该地区撤军的条件。
The party's change of policy has been dictated by its need to win back the support of voters.  该党政策上的变化是由于它需要赢回选民的支持。
She spent the morning dictating letters to her secretary.  她花了一上午的时间向秘书口述信件。verb UK   Phrasal Verbs   dictate to sb

words.meaning: n.陈规,老套,模式化 vt.使定型,使模式化
words.example:
He doesn't conform to/fit/fill the national stereotype of a Frenchman.  他不符合一般人心目中法国人的形象。
The characters in the book are just stereotypes.  书中的人物毫无新意。 disapproving
The study claims that British advertising stereotypes women.  这项研究声称英国的广告对女性抱有成见。

words.meaning: n.洗衣房(店);待洗衣物,所洗衣物
words.example:
I've got to do (= wash) my laundry.  我要把衣服洗了。
It wasn't much of a speech - just a laundry list of accusations against the government.  这不算是演讲，只是在将一连串对政府的控诉罗列出来。

words.meaning: a.手的,手工做的,体力的 n.手册,指南
words.example:
She tried to cure the pain in my knee by putting manual pressure on the joint.  她尝试用手按压我的膝关节来治疗我的膝痛。
He still works on an old manual typewriter.  他还在用一台老式手动打字机。
Computer-controlled robots are taking over manual jobs in many industries.  在许多行业中，体力工作正逐步由电脑控制的机器人代劳。noun countable

words.meaning: n.手枪
words.example: a loaded pistol  上膛手枪

words.meaning: n.海军的,军舰的
words.example: a naval officer  海军军官

words.meaning: n.道歉,认错,辩解,辩护
words.example:
He's demanding a full apology from the newspaper for making untrue allegations about his personal life.  他要求这家报纸对关于他私生活的不实报导正式道歉。
She complained to the company about its awful service and they sent her a written apology.  就其低劣的服务品质，她向这家公司提出投诉，公司对她作出了书面道歉。
The vice-chair has sent his apologies - he's abroad at present.  副主席寄来了道歉信——他目前在国外，不能出席。

words.meaning: v.钻(孔),挖(洞);烦扰 n.讨厌的人,麻烦事
words.example:
"Am I boring you?" she asked anxiously.  “我让你厌烦了吗?”她焦急地问道。
We were all bored silly by the play.  这出戏让我们觉得无聊得要死。UK verb
He used a drill to bore a hole in the wall.  他用钻子在墙上凿了一个洞。

words.meaning: a./n.受爱戴的,敬爱的;爱人,被心爱的人
words.example:
Her beloved husband died last year.  她深爱的丈夫去年死了。
She was forced to leave her beloved Paris and return to Lyon.  她被迫离开热爱的巴黎，回到里昂。
Eric was a gifted teacher beloved by all those he taught over the years.  埃里克是位天才的教师，多年来他一直受到所有学生们的热爱。 [-'lʌvd] slightly formal

words.meaning: v.招待,款待;使娱乐;使欢乐;容纳,接受
words.example:
We hired a magician to entertain the children.  我们请了一位魔术师表演节目让孩子们开心。
Most children's television programmes aim to educate and entertain at the same time.  大多数儿童电视节目都旨在寓教于乐。UK verb
We entertain a lot of people, mainly business associates of my wife's.  我们经常在家请客，主要都是我妻子的业务伙伴。

words.meaning: adj.异乎寻常的,稀奇古怪的
words.example: a bizarre situation  异乎寻常的情形

words.meaning: a.外国的,海外的 ad.在海外
words.example:
We need to open up overseas markets.  我们需要开拓海外市场。
There are a lot of overseas students in Cambridge.  剑桥有许多外国留学生。
My brother is a student overseas.  我哥哥在外国留学。

words.meaning: n.贡品;颂词,称赞,(表示敬意的)礼物
words.example:
Tributes have been pouring in from all over the world for the famous actor who died yesterday.  昨天，这位著名男演员去世，世界各国人士纷纷发来唁电表示哀悼。
For wedding bouquets, floral tributes (= flowers sent to someone's funeral) and all your flower needs, call Mandy's Florists.  婚礼、葬礼以及其他各种用花需求，请致电曼迪花店。
The minister paid tribute to the men who had fought the blaze.  部长高度赞扬奋力扑灭大火的勇士们。noun

words.meaning: vt.重新得到,取回;挽回,补救;检索
words.example:
We taught our dog to retrieve a ball.  我们教狗捡球。
Computers are used to store and retrieve information efficiently.  电脑用于快速高效地存储和检索资讯。

words.meaning: vt.设计;发明;图谋;作出(计划);想出(办法)
words.example:
He's good at devising language games that you can play with students in class.  他善于设计可供师生在课堂上使用的语言游戏。
The cartoon characters Snoopy and Charlie Brown were devised by Charles M. Schultz.  卡通人物史诺比和查理‧布朗是由查尔斯设计的。

words.meaning: v.提名,任命
words.example:
He's been nominated by the Green Party as their candidate in the next election.  他被绿党提名为下届选举的候选人。
Would you like to nominate anyone for/as director?  请您推荐一下经理的候选人，好吗？
The film was nominated for an Academy Award.  这部电影获得奥斯卡提名。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.廉价货;交易,契约,合同 v.议价,成交
words.example:
This coat was half-price - a real bargain.  这件大衣是以半价购买的——真便宜。
The airline regularly offers last-minute bookings at bargain prices.  航空公司定期提供最后时刻的廉价订票服务。
The sales had started and the bargain hunters (= people looking for things at a low price) were out in force.  大减价开始了，那些到处搜寻便宜货的人倾巢而出。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.怀疑的 [英]sceptical
words.example: I'm skeptical about the new policy.  我对新政策持怀疑态度。

words.meaning: n.周密的调查;仔细看;监视;选票复查
words.example: The Government's record will be subjected to/come under (close) scrutiny in the weeks before the election.  政府的作为将在选前几个星期接受审查。

words.meaning: v.镇压,压制;抑制,忍住;查禁
words.example:
The Hungarian uprising in 1956 was suppressed by the Soviet Union.  1956年匈牙利起义受到苏联武力镇压的。verb transitive
She couldn't suppress her anger/annoyance/delight.  她无法抑制内心的愤怒／气恼／喜悦。
His feelings of resentment have been suppressed for years.  他的怨恨之情已经压抑多年。

words.meaning: n.黄铜,铜器
words.example:
The door handles were made of brass.  门把手是黄铜做的。
The church has several beautiful medieval brasses.  这个教堂有几块精美的中世纪黄铜纪念牌。
The brass seems to me too loud in this recording.  我觉得这张唱片中铜管乐器部分似乎太响了。UK noun

words.meaning: n./v.锚;危难时可依靠的人或物;用锚泊船
words.example:
We dropped anchor (= lowered the anchor into the water) and stopped.  我们抛锚停船。
It was time to weigh anchor (= pull up the anchor and sail away).  该是起锚开船的时候了。UK noun countable
She was my anchor when things were difficult for me.  我身处困境时，她就是我的精神支柱。

words.meaning: n.零,零度 num.零
words.example:
The number one million is written with a one and six zeroes (mainly UK alsonoughts).  数字100万要写一个1和六个0。
Heavy rain has reduced visibility almost to zero (= its lowest point).  大雨已使能见度降到最低。
The temperature is expected to drop to ten degrees below zero tonight.  今晚气温预计会降至零下十度。UK adjective

words.meaning: v./n.拔出,抽出;摘录 n.抽取物;精华;选集
words.example:
They used to extract iron ore from this site.  他们曾经在这个地方开采铁矿。
The oil which is extracted from olives is used for cooking.  这种橄揽油是用于烹饪的。
The tooth was eventually extracted.  那只牙终于拔掉了。

words.meaning: a.加强的,集中的,深入细致的,精耕细作的
words.example: Intensive bombing had reduced the city to rubble.  密集轰炸曾把城市炸成一片瓦砾。

words.meaning: v.背叛,出卖;暴露,流露,泄露
words.example:
He was accused of betraying his country during the war.  他被指控在战争期间背叛了祖国。
She felt betrayed by her mother's lack of support.  她觉得母亲背弃了她，因为母亲没有支持她。
For years they betrayed Britain's secrets to Russia.  他们持续多年向俄国出卖英国的机密情报。

words.meaning: n.官僚主义,官僚机构;(非民选的)委任官员
words.example: Too much bureaucracy slows decisions.  官僚程序太多拖慢了决策。

words.meaning: a.聪明的,伶俐的,机敏的,精巧的
words.example:
Judy has never been very clever, but she tries hard.  裘蒂向来不是很聪明，可是她很用功。
Fiona is very clever at physics.  菲奥纳很擅长物理。
Charlie has a clever idea / plan for getting us out of our present difficulties.  查利有个妙计可以使我们摆脱现在的困境。

words.meaning: a.美味的;美妙的;使人愉快的
words.example:
The delicious smell of freshly-made coffee came from the kitchen.  新煮好的咖啡的芳香从厨房里飘了出来。
This wine is delicious.  这种酒味道很好。
I've got some delicious gossip.  我听到了一些有趣的小道消息。

words.meaning: ad.&prep.在船(飞机、车)上;ad.上船(飞机、车)
words.example:
The flight attendant welcomed us aboard.  空服员迎候我们登机。
Welcome aboard flight BA345 to Tokyo.  欢迎乘坐飞往东京的 BA345 航班。
The train's about to leave. All aboard!  火车即将离站，请所有乘客上车！

words.meaning: v.生殖;翻版;繁殖;复制,仿造
words.example:
His work was reproduced on posters, leaflets and magazines.  他的作品被翻印在海报、宣传页和杂志上。
They said the printing was too faint to reproduce well.  他们说这材料印得太模糊，无法复印清楚。
The new design unfortunately reproduced some of the problems of the earlier model.  很遗憾，新的设计中又出现了原来型号的一些问题。UK verb

words.meaning: n.同情;怜悯(for)
words.example: She showed compassion for the homeless.  她对无家可归者很有同情心。

words.meaning: n.虫,蠕虫
words.example:
The kiwi eats worms, other invertebrates, and berries.  鹬鸵以蠕虫、其他无脊椎动物和浆果为食。
It's distressing enough to find a worm in your apple but finding half of one is worse.  在苹果里发现一条虫子已经够叫人厌恶，如果发现半条就更糟了。
The vet says our dog has worms.  兽医说我们的狗体内有寄生虫。

words.meaning: a.(to)有利的,有益的
words.example: The improvement in sales figures had a beneficial effect /influence on the company as a whole.  销售额的上升使整间公司受益。

words.meaning: a.笨拙的;尴尬的;使用不便的;难处理的
words.example:
It's an awkward corner to drive round, so take it slowly.  这个转弯不好过，开慢一点。
Some of the questions were rather awkward.  有些问题是很难回答的。
It was an awkward ascent, but we reached the top eventually.  那段上坡路很难走，但最后我们还是爬到了山顶。

words.meaning: n.复杂,纠纷;并发症
words.example:
Dave couldn't find his passport at the airport and then there were further complications when Fiona lost her baggage.  戴夫在机场找不到护照了，后来事情越发麻烦，菲奥娜又把行李遗失了。
If any complications arise , let me know and I'll help.  如果发生甚么麻烦事，告诉我一声，我会帮忙的。
If there are no complications, the doctor says that she'll be able to come home within two weeks.  如果没有并发症的话，医生说她两周内就可以出院了。

words.meaning: n.让步,妥协;特许(权);
words.example:
Both sides involved in the conflict made some concessions in yesterday's talks.  在昨天的谈判中，冲突双方都作出了让步。
He stated firmly that no concessions will be made to the strikers.  他强硬地宣称不会对罢工者作出任何让步。
The former president's concession came even before all the votes had been counted.  选票还没完全统计出来，前总统就承认落败了。

words.meaning: a.真的,真正的;可靠的,可信的,有根据的
words.example: He was there and saw what happened, so his is the only authentic account.  他在现场，并看到了事情的经过，所以他的叙述是唯一可靠的说法。

words.meaning: n.(thieves)贼;小偷
words.example: The thief climbed through the window.  小偷从窗户爬了进来。

words.meaning: n.圆屋顶
words.example: Gerald had a long grey beard and a shiny bald dome (= head).  杰拉尔德留着长长的灰色胡须，头上却秃得锃亮。

words.meaning: n.更衣箱
words.example: We had several hours to wait for our train, so we left our bags in a (luggage) locker, and went to look around the town.  由于还得等好几个小时的火车，我们就把袋子存到衣物柜后到城里转了转。

words.meaning: n.社论 a.社论的;编辑上的
words.example:
All the papers deal with the same subject in their editorials.  所有的报纸都针对同一问题发表了社论。UK adjective
Editorial decisions are generally made by senior editors.  通常由资深编辑们来决定编务事宜。
It's plain reporting of the facts - there's not much editorial content (= opinion).  那只是纯粹的事实报道，没有多少评论内容。

words.meaning: n.秋,秋季;成熟期,渐衰期
words.example: Autumn is my favorite season.  秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

words.meaning: a.守信的,忠实的,如实的,可靠的
words.example:
They are faithful supporters of the Labour Party.  他们是工党的忠实拥护者。
His faithful old dog accompanied him everywhere he went.  无论去哪里，他那只忠诚的老狗总是陪伴左右。
Was your wife faithful during your marriage?  你的妻子婚后忠诚吗？

words.meaning: a.天然的,未加工的;未熟的;粗鲁的,粗野的
words.example: a crude device/weapon  简陋的装置／粗制的武器adjective

words.meaning: vt.唤起(回忆、感情等);引起
words.example: That smell always evokes memories of my old school.  那种气味经常唤起我对母校的回忆。

words.meaning: n.疤,疤痕;创伤 v.使留下伤痕,创伤
words.example:
That burn will leave a nasty scar.  烫伤会留下严重的伤疤。
His early years in the refugee camp left a deep psychological scar.  早年的难民营生活给他留下深深的心理创伤。
Every village bears the scars of war.  每一个村庄都布满了战争留下的疮痍。UK verb transitive often passive (-rr-)

words.meaning: vi.投降,屈服 vt.放弃,交出 n.投降,认输
words.example:
They would rather die than surrender (to the invaders).  他们宁死也不（向侵略者）投降。
The police demanded that the gang surrender their weapons.  警方要求那个团伙交出武器。
Neither side is willing to surrender any territory/any of their claims.  双方都不愿意在领土上作出任何让步／坚持各自对所有权的主张，谁也不愿放弃。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: vi.汹涌;彭湃;蜂拥而至 n.巨浪;汹涌;彭湃
words.example:
An unexpected surge in electrical power caused the computer to crash.  突然出现的电压遽增导致电脑当机。
There has been a surge in house prices recently.  最近房价飞涨。
At the end of the game, there was a surge of fans onto the field.  比赛结束后，大群球迷涌向比赛场地。

words.meaning: vt.检查,调查,视察
words.example: Officials inspect the food regularly.  官员定期检查食品。

words.meaning: n.水手,海员
words.example: The sailor read the stars to navigate.  水手靠看星星导航。

words.meaning: a.帝国的,帝王的;(度量衡)英制的
words.example: Imperial units have in many cases been replaced by metric ones in Britain.  在英国，很多情况下英制已经被公制取代。    Compare metric

words.meaning: v.(for)补偿,赔偿
words.example:
Victims of the crash will be compensated for their injuries.  车祸的受害者会得到伤害赔偿。UK verb
Nothing will ever compensate for his lost childhood.  甚么也不能弥补他失去的童年。
His enthusiasm more than compensates for his lack of experience.  他的热情大大弥补了经验的不足。

words.meaning: n.化石
words.example: The fossil is on display in the museum.  化石在博物馆展出。

words.meaning: vi.(鸟)盘旋,翱翔,(人)逗留在附近徘徊
words.example: Inflation is hovering at 3%.  通货膨胀率在3%左右徘徊。

words.meaning: n.光线,射线
words.example:
Light rays bend as they pass from air to water.  光线从空气射入水中会发生折射。noun
There's still a ray of hope that the missing child will be found alive.  失踪的孩子尚有一丝被活着找到的希望。noun
We love looking after our grandchild. He's a ray of sunshine!  我们喜欢照顾孙儿，他给我们带来了快乐！

words.meaning: n.素描;略图,草图;梗概 v.绘略图,速写,写生
words.example:
My mother made a (pencil) sketch of my brother reading a book.  我母亲画了一张我弟弟在读书的（铅笔）素描。
The art students were told to sketch the landscape.  艺术专业的学生被告知要画一张实地风景素描。
When I have some spare time, I like to sketch.  有空闲的时候，我喜欢画素描。

words.meaning: v.澄清,阐明
words.example:
Could you clarify the first point please? I don't understand it completely.  请你把第一点再阐释一下，好吗？我一点也不明白。
The position of all shareholders will be clarified next month when we finalize our proposals.  下月我们将计划书定下后，所有股东的立场便清晰明确了。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v./n.闲谈,聊天
words.example: We chatted about old times.  我们聊起了旧时光。

words.meaning: n.铜;铜币,铜制器
words.example: Rosie's hair shone copper (= reddish brown) in the sunlight.  罗茜的头发在阳光下闪着红褐色。

words.meaning: n.学生,小学生;瞳孔
words.example:
The school has over 400 pupils.  这所学校有400多名小学生。
There is a very relaxed atmosphere between staff and pupils at the school.  这所学校师生之间的气氛很轻松。
Her school report described her as a very promising pupil.  她在成绩单中被描述成一个非常有前途的学生。

words.meaning: v.奋斗,努力
words.example: In her writing she strove for a balance between innovation and familiar prose forms.  她在写作中力图在创新和传统散文形式之间取得平衡。

words.meaning: v./n.忽视;疏忽,漏做,忽略
words.example:
He neglects that poor dog - he never takes him for walks or gives him any attention.  他对那只可怜的狗漠不关心——从不带它散步，也从不关心它。
I'm afraid I've rather neglected my studies this week.  恐怕这个星期我忽略了自己的功课。
I'd neglected to give him the name of the hotel where I'd be staying.  我忘记告诉他我住的宾馆的名字。

words.meaning: n.病房;行政区;监护;被监护人 vt.挡住
words.example:
The girl was made a ward of court to stop her father taking her out of the country.  这个女孩由法院监护，以防止她的父亲将她带出这个国家。UK verb
In the winter I take vitamin C to ward off colds.  冬天我服用维他命C以预防感冒。
She was given a magic charm to ward off evil spirits.  她被赠予一个魔法护身符，可以驱鬼避邪。

words.meaning: n.战争(状态);斗争;冲突
words.example: guerrilla/naval/nuclear/trench warfare  游击战／海战／核战／堑壕战

words.meaning: a.中世纪的,中古(时代)的,老式的,原始的
words.example: a medieval building/painting/town  中世纪建筑／画作／城镇

words.meaning: v.(of)抢劫,盗取;非法剥夺
words.example:
The terrorists financed themselves by robbing banks.  恐怖分子靠抢银行来获得资金。
My wallet's gone! I've been robbed!  我的钱包没了！我被偷了！
They robbed the company of £2 million.  他们从这间公司盗取了两百万英镑。

words.meaning: n.砰砰的声音;猛击 v.砰地关上,猛撞,猛击
words.example:
She banged her fist angrily on the table.  她气愤地一拳打在桌子上。
Outside a door was banging in the wind.  外面的一扇门被风吹得砰砰作响。
He could hear someone banging at the door.  他听到有人在砰砰地敲门。

words.meaning: n.(绳)结;(树)节;节(=海里/小时) v.打结
words.example:
Alice's hair is always full of knots and tangles.  爱丽斯的头发总是缠结在一起，乱作一团。UK noun countable
Knots of anxious people stood waiting in the hall.  一群群人焦虑不安地站在大厅里等候。UK noun countable
a top speed of about 20 knots.  最高约为20节的航速UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.龙
words.example: She's a real old dragon.  她真是个老恶婆。

words.meaning: v.(使)倾侧;(使)倾斜 n.倾侧;倾斜
words.example:
He tilted his chair backwards and put his feet up on his desk.  他把椅子向后倾，双脚搁在写字枱上。
Anna looked up at him with her head tilted to one side.  安娜歪着脑袋，抬头望着他。
The front seats of the car tilt.  汽车前座倾斜了。verb

words.meaning: a.金融的,货币的
words.example: The monetary unit of the UK is the pound.  英国的货币单位是英镑。

words.meaning: n.繁荣,兴旺
words.example: The war was followed by a long period of peace and prosperity.  战争过后是长时间的和平与繁荣。

words.meaning: vt.堆积,积累,积聚vi.累积,聚积
words.example:
As people accumulate more wealth, they tend to spend a greater proportion of their incomes.  人们积累了更多财富后，他们的花费占收入的比重也往往会增加。
The company said the debt was accumulated during its acquisition of nine individual businesses.  该公司称其在收购九家个体公司的过程中，债务越积越多。
We've accumulated so much rubbish over the years.  多年来我们已经堆积了这么多的垃圾。

words.meaning: vt.实行,从事 v.起诉,告发 vi.作检察官
words.example:
Shoplifters will be prosecuted.  商店扒手将遭到起诉。
He was prosecuted for fraud.  他因诈骗而被起诉。
Any manufacturer who does not conform to the standards could be prosecuted under the Consumers Protection Act, 1987.  对任何不遵守标准的生产商都可依据1987年通过的《消费者保护法》予以起诉。

words.meaning: vt.具体表达,使具体化;包含,收录
words.example:
She embodied good sportsmanship on the playing field.  在运动场上，她展现了优秀的体育精神。
Kennett embodied in one man an unusual range of science, music and religion.  肯尼特集科学、音乐、宗教等方面一系列非凡成就于一身。

words.meaning: n.(小)地毯;围毯
words.example: My dog loves lying on the rug in front of the fire.  我的狗喜欢趴在炉火前的小地毯上。

words.meaning: a.单调的;迟钝的,愚笨的;不锋利的
words.example:
She wrote dull, respectable articles for the local newspaper.  她为当地报纸写一些乏味的官样文章。
He's pleasant enough, but deadly dull (= very boring).  他很和善，但太乏味。adjective
We could just see a dull glow given off by the fire's last embers.  我们只能看见炉火的余烬发出的微弱的光。

words.meaning: v.(in)干涉,干预;插入,介入
words.example:
The Central Bank intervened in the currency markets today to try to stabilize the exchange rate.  中央银行今天对货币市场进行了干预，试图稳定汇率。
Two decades intervened between the completion of the design and the opening of the theatre.  从设计完成到剧场投入使用相隔20年。

words.meaning: n/v..袭击,搜查
words.example:
The commandos made/staged/carried out a daring raid (on the enemy).  突击队大胆（向敌人）发起了突袭。
Millions of dollars were stolen in a bank raid last night.  昨晚一间银行被劫走数百万美元。
The drugs were found during a police raid on the house.  这些毒品是在警方查抄这栋房子时发现的。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.发热,发光,发红 n.白热
words.example:
This substance is so radioactive that it glows in the dark.  这种物质辐射性很强，在黑暗中都可以发出亮光。
The children's faces were glowing with excitement.  孩子们兴奋得满脸通红。
They came back from their week by the sea, glowing with health.  他们在海边渡假一周，回来时个个都容光焕发。

words.meaning: n.王冠,冕;君权,君王 v.为…加冕
words.example:
He plans to defend his Olympic crown.  他计划卫冕奥运会冠军。noun countable
Queen Elizabeth II was crowned (queen) (= made queen in a special ceremony) in 1953.  伊丽莎白女王二世于1953年加冕。
The church was crowned with golden domes.  教堂顶部是金色的穹顶。

words.meaning: n.假货,赝品 a.假的,冒充的 v.伪造;伪装
words.example:
Experts revealed that the painting was a fake.  专家透露那幅画是赝品。
The gun in his hand was a fake.  他手里的枪是假的。
After working for ten years as a doctor, he was exposed as a fake.  行医十年后，他被揭发是个冒牌货。adjective

words.meaning: n.说明;例证,插图;举例说明
words.example: This delay is a perfect illustration of why we need a new computer system.  这次延误再好不过地说明了我们为甚么需要新的电脑系统。

words.meaning: n.螃蟹,蟹肉
words.example:
We walked along the beach collecting small crabs.  我们沿着海滩走，一路捡拾小螃蟹。
All the shops on the seafront had crab for sale.  滨海区的所有商店都出售螃蟹。
This crab meat/salad is delicious!  这份蟹肉／蟹肉色沙拉味道好极了！noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: v.爬,爬行;(植物)蔓延
words.example:
She turned off the light and crept through the door.  她关上灯，悄悄溜出门。
Someone was creeping around outside my window.  有人在我的窗户外潜行。
The spider crept up the wall.  蜘蛛缓缓地爬上墙。

words.meaning: a.(of)值得…的,配得上…的;有价值的
words.example:
He is unlikely to succeed in getting his bill through Congress, however worthy it is.  无论他的提案多么有价值，他也不可能使其在国会上通过。
Every year she makes a large donation to a worthy cause.  她每年都为一项高尚的事业捐一大笔钱。
Two points in this report are especially worthy of notice.  这份报告中有两点特别值得注意。

words.meaning: n.氢
words.example: Hydrogen burns with a pale flame.  氢气燃烧时发出淡蓝色火焰。

words.meaning: n.资本主义
words.example: They debated the merits of capitalism.  他们辩论了资本主义的利弊。

words.meaning: n.可能性,或然性,概率
words.example:
What is the probability of winning ?  获胜的可能性有多大？
The probability of getting all the answers correct is about one in ten.  答案全部正确的可能性大约是1／10
There's a high/strong probability (that) (= It is very likely that) she'll be here.  她很可能会来。

words.meaning: n.药品;治疗措施 v.治疗,医治;纠正,补救
words.example:
The best remedy for grief is hard work.  排解忧伤的最好办法就是努力工作。
We have exhausted all possible legal remedies for this injustice.  为了纠正这一不公正的行为，我们已经采取了一切法律手段。verb transitive formal
This mistake must be remedied immediately.  这一错误必须立即予以纠正。

words.meaning: n.手稿,原稿
words.example:
He sent the 400-page manuscript to his publisher.  他将400页的手稿寄给他的出版商了。
