It is thought that the manuscript is the work of a monk and dates from the twelfth century.  一般认为那部手抄本出自12世纪一位僧侣手笔。

words.meaning: v./n.打碎,粉碎
words.example:
Rioters ran through the city centre smashing windows and looting shops.  暴动者穿过市中心，砸碎商店橱窗，掠劫店铺里的东西。
She dropped her cup and watched it smash to pieces/to smithereens on the stone floor.  她失手摔落了杯子，看着它在石地板上摔得粉碎。verb
Several boats were smashed against the rocks during the storm.  暴风雨期间，几艘小船撞上了礁石。

words.meaning: a.给人希望的,抱有希望的
words.example:
He was hopeful about the outcome of the meeting.  他对会议的结果充满希望。
They were hopeful of a successful agreement.  他们对成功达成协议充满希望。
I'm hopeful (that) we can reach a compromise.  我对我们能达成和解充满希望。

words.meaning: n.爱好,迷恋 v.想象,幻想 a.花式的,奇特的
words.example:
Do you fancy a drink this evening?  你今晚想喝一杯吗？
He could tell she fancied him.  他看得出她喜欢他。
That Dave really fancies himself, doesn't he?  那个戴夫挺自命不凡的，是吧？verb

words.meaning: n.道德,美德
words.example: They argued for a new morality based on self-sacrifice and honesty.  他们大力宣扬一种以自我牺牲和诚实为基础的新道德观。

words.meaning: v./n.潜水,跳水,俯冲
words.example:
Look at those children diving for oysters over there!  看那边那些潜水摸蚝的孩子们！
They ran to the pool, dived in , and swam to the other side.  他们跑到池边，一头栽进水里，然后游到池子的另一侧。
Mark dived off the bridge into the river.  马克从桥上跳进了河里。

words.meaning: n.苏打,汽水
words.example: I'll have a soda, thanks.  我要杯汽水，谢谢。

words.meaning: vt.公告,公布;为...做广告 vi.登广告
words.example:
We advertised our car (= published a description of it together with the price we wanted for it) in the local newspaper.  我们在当地报纸上登了广告出售我们的轿车。
He advertises his services on the company notice board.  他在公司的布告版上张贴广告来宣传其服务业务。
I'm going to advertise for (= put a notice in the newspaper, local shop, etc., asking for) someone to clean my house.  我打算登广告雇个人来做家庭清洁。

words.meaning: n.(memorandum)备忘录
words.example: Did you get my memo about the meeting?  你收到我的会议备忘录了吗？

words.meaning: vt.使…失去知觉;使目瞪口呆,使吃惊
words.example:
News of the disaster stunned people throughout the world.  灾难消息使全世界的人震惊。
She was stunned by the amount of support she received from well-wishers.  居然有这么多人送上祝福，他们的支持令她受宠若惊。 (-nn-)
Stunned by the impact, he lay on the ground wondering what had happened.  遭重击昏倒后，他躺在地上想弄清楚发生了甚么事。

words.meaning: n.废物,旧货;舢板
words.example: We ought to clear out this cupboard - it's full of junk.  我们应该清理一下这个橱柜——里面都是没用的东西。

words.meaning: v.制造,加工 n.制造,制造业;产品
words.example:
He works for a company that manufactures car parts.  他在一家生产汽车零件的公司工作。
The report notes a rapid decline in manufactured goods.  报告指出工业产品数量迅速下滑。UK verb transitive
She insisted that every scandalous detail of the story had been manufactured.  她坚称报道中每一个骇人听闻的细节都是捏造出来的。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.爱,喜爱;爱慕之情;感情;疾病,不适
words.example:
He had a deep affection for his aunt.  他非常喜爱他的姑妈。
She felt no affection for the child.  她一点都不疼爱这个孩子。
The former president still holds a place in the nation's affections.  前总统仍深得全国人民的爱戴。

words.meaning: a.成熟的,熟的;成年人的 v.(使)成熟
words.example:
He's very mature for his age.  以他的年纪来说，他已非常成熟。
Upon mature reflection, we find the accused guilty.  经过慎重考虑，我们裁定被告有罪。UK adjective
Mature male gorillas have silver-grey hairs on their backs.  成年雄性大猩猩背部有银灰色毛发。

words.meaning: n.邮票;印;跺脚;标志v.跺脚,顿足;盖章
words.example:
Although this painting clearly bears the stamp of genius, we don't know who painted it.  虽然这幅画明显是天才之作，但我们却不知其出自谁手。
Each manager has left his or her own stamp on the way the company has evolved.  每一位经理都在公司的发展道路上留下了自己的印记。noun
With a stamp of her foot she stormed out.  她一跺脚，冲了出去。verb

words.meaning: n.哲学家,哲人
words.example: Plato was a Greek philosopher.  柏拉图是古希腊哲学家。

words.meaning: v.抓住,攫住,掌握 n.离合器
words.example:
Silent and pale, she clutched (onto) her mother's hand.  她一声不吭，面色苍白，死死抓着母亲的手。
Clutching the money to his chest, he hurried to the bank.  他把钱紧紧捂在胸前，急急忙忙赶到了银行。
He collapsed, clutching his stomach.  他紧紧捂着肚子，倒了下去。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.崩溃;衰竭;(关系、计划或讨论等的)中断
words.example:
Both sides blamed each other for the breakdown of talks.  双方都指责对方导致了谈判的破裂。
We asked for a breakdown of the accident figures into day time and night time.  我们要白天和夜间事故的统计数字的分列明细表。
The rate of breakdown of muscle protein was assessed.  肌肉蛋白质的分类比率测定统计出来了。noun

words.meaning: v.隐藏,隐瞒,隐蔽
words.example:
The listening device was concealed in a pen.  窃听装置藏在笔里。
It was said that the police concealed vital evidence.  据说警方隐瞒了关键的证据。
Is there something you're concealing from me?  你是不是有事瞒着我？

words.meaning: n.肾,肾脏
words.example: kidney failure  肾衰竭

words.meaning: v.(使)卷曲,蜷缩 n.卷发;卷曲状;卷曲物
words.example:
Her hair fell in curls over her shoulders.  她的头发卷曲着垂在肩上。
Curls of smoke were rising from the chimney.  缕缕青烟从烟囱中升起。    Compare waveUK verb intransitive or transitive
Does your hair curl naturally , or is it permed?  你的头发是自然卷曲还是烫过？

words.meaning: n.善良,仁慈;(食物等)精华 int.天哪
words.example:
Don't cook vegetables for too long - they'll lose all their goodness.  烹煮蔬菜时间不要太长——这会使菜里的所有营养成分都被破坏掉。noun uncountable
Mother Teresa's goodness is an example to us all.  特莉莎修女的高尚品德是我们所有人学习的榜样。exclamation    (also goodness gracious)
(My)goodness! how many more times do I have to tell you!  （我的）天哪！我还要告诉你多少次！

words.meaning: n.地理(学)
words.example: It's impossible to work out the geography of this hospital.  没有办法弄清楚这家医院的布局。

words.meaning: n.命运;天数,天命
words.example:
The destiny of our nation depends on this vote!  我们国家的前途取决于这次选举！
She felt that her destiny had been shaped by her gender.  她觉得自己的性别已经决定了自己的命运。
People want to control/determine/take charge of their own destinies.  人们想要掌控自己的命运。

words.meaning: n.有文化,有教养,有读写能力
words.example:
Far more resources are needed to improve adult literacy.  提高成年人的读写能力所需要的资源还远远不够。
Computer literacy is becoming as essential as the ability to drive a car.  会用电脑与会开车一样将成为一种必备的技能。

words.meaning: n.出租汽车v.[指飞机](使)滑行
words.example: a taxi driver  计程车司机verb intransitive (taxiing, taxied, taxied)

words.meaning: v.漏,泄漏 n.漏洞,漏隙;泄漏,漏出
words.example:
Water was leaking from the pipe.  水正从管子里漏出来。
Oil leaked out of the car.  油从车里漏了出来。
The tin was leaking.  罐漏了。

words.meaning: n.独奏 a.&ad.单独的(地);独唱的(地)
words.example:
He used to play with a group but now he's going solo/pursuing a solo career.  他以前曾经加入过某个乐队，但如今已单独发展。UK noun countable (plural solos)
Parker's solo on 'A Night in Tunisia' was so amazing that the pianist backing him simply stopped playing.  派克的独奏《突尼斯之夜》实在是太精彩了，以至于为他伴奏的钢琴手干脆停了下来。

words.meaning: n.国会,议会
words.example:
On Tuesday the country's parliament voted to establish its own army.  该国议会于周二投票决定建立自己的军队。
She was elected to Parliament in 1997.  她于1997年获选为国会议员。

words.meaning: n.群,兽群,牛群 v.放牧,群集
words.example:
Poor Janine - she just follows the herd (= does what all the other people are doing).  可怜的雅尼娜——她只是在跟随主流。UK verb
The football fans complained that they had been herded into a small alley.  足球迷抱怨说他们被集中赶进了一条小巷里。

words.meaning: n.温室
words.example: Gladys grows a lot of tomatoes in her greenhouse.  格拉迪丝在她的温室里种了好多番茄。

words.meaning: n.花费;(时间,金钱等的)支出,消耗
words.example:
It's part of a drive to cut government expenditure.  这是削减政府开支的一个方法。
The government's annual expenditure on arms has been reduced.  政府已经缩减了年度军备开支。
The expenditure of effort on this project has been enormous.  已经在这项工程上付出了重大的努力。

words.meaning: n.探针,探测器 v.(以探针等)探查,穿刺,查究
words.example:
The interviewer probed deep into her private life.  采访者深入打探她的私生活。
Detectives questioned him for hours, probing for any inconsistencies in his story.  侦探们盘问了他好几个小时，寻找他话里任何自相矛盾之处。
The article probes (= tries to describe and explain) the mysteries of nationalism in modern Europe.  这篇文章探索了现代欧洲民族主义的奥秘。

words.meaning: n.原子;微粒,微量
words.example: figurative He hasn't an atom of sense (= He has no sense) , that boy.  那个孩子啊，一点头脑也没有。

words.meaning: n.快餐,小吃,点心
words.example:
Fresh or dried fruit makes an ideal snack.  新鲜水果或果干是理想的点心。
Many snack foods are high in salt, sugar and fat.  很多速食都是高盐、高糖、高脂肪。verb intransitive
I've been snacking all day.  我吃了一天的零食。

words.meaning: n.结尾,结局
words.example:
People want love stories with happy endings.  人们希望爱情故事的结局是有情人终成眷属。noun countable
To make the plural of 'dog', you add the plural ending '-s'.  要把 dog 这个词变成复数形式，需在其后加表示复数的词尾 s。

words.meaning: n.补遗;增刊;附录 v.增刊,补充
words.example:
The doctor said she should be taking vitamin supplements.  医生说她应该服用维生素补充剂。
The money I get from teaching evening classes provides a supplement to my main income.  我晚上教课所赚的钱可以补充我的主要收入。
We paid a supplement (= an extra amount of money) so that we could have a cabin on board the ship.  我们多付了一些钱，这样我们在船上就可以有一个单独的小舱住。

words.meaning: n.墨水,油墨
words.example:
Please write in ink, not in pencil.  书写请用墨水笔，不要用铅笔。
The book is printed in three different coloured inks.  这本书是用三色油墨印刷的。noun countable or uncountable
The ink was barely dry on the peace agreement when fighting broke out again.  和平协议才刚签好，战斗又再爆发了。verb transitive specialized

words.meaning: n.苦恼;危难;不幸 v.使苦恼
words.example:
She claimed that the way she had been treated at work had caused her extreme emotional and psychological distress.  她说自己在工作中受到的待遇让她在情感和心理上都感到非常痛苦。
Many of the horses were showing signs of distress at the end of the race.  比赛接近尾声时，许多马匹都表现出非常痛苦的样子。
Six people were rescued by helicopter from a fishing boat in distress off the Cornish coast.  直升机从康沃尔郡海岸附近的一艘遇险渔船上救出了六个人。

words.meaning: n.誓约;保证 v.发誓;保证
words.example:
Thousands of people made pledges (= promised to give money) to the Children in Need charity campaign.  数千人承诺捐款给救助儿童慈善运动。
What's this then, you're only drinking orange juice - have you signed the pledge or something?  这是怎么回事？你只喝柳橙汁——你是发过誓不再喝酒了，还是其他甚么原因？verb transitive
We are asking people to pledge their support for our campaign.  我们正请求人们承诺支持我们的运动。

words.meaning: n.典范; 范例; 示例
words.example: Some of these educators are hoping to produce a change in the current cultural paradigm.  这些教育家中有些希望改变当今的文化典型。

words.meaning: a.记忆的,纪念的 n.纪念物,纪念碑,纪念馆
words.example:
The statue was erected as a memorial to those who died in the war.  这尊雕像是为纪念战争中死去的人而竖立的。UK adjective [before noun]
Hundreds of people came to Professor Conner's memorial service.  数百人参加了康纳教授的悼念仪式。

words.meaning: n.等级制度;统治集团,领导层
words.example:
Some monkeys have a very complex social hierarchy.  某些猴群有非常复杂的种群阶级。
He rose quickly through the political hierarchy to become party leader.  他的政治地位迅速提升，成了该党领袖。

words.meaning: vt.传染,感染;影响(思想等)
words.example:
The ward was full of children infected with TB.  病房里住满了感染结核病的孩子。
All the tomato plants are infected with a virus.  所有的番茄植株都染上了一种病毒。verb transitive
Her optimism seemed to infect all those around her.  她的乐观情绪似乎感染了周围所有的人。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.向后的,倒行的;迟钝的 ad.向后,朝反方向
words.example:
When he was a child, his teachers thought he was backward (= unable to learn as much as most children).  小时候，老师认为他愚笨迟钝。
People still think of it as a backward country/region/area (= one without industry or modern machines).  人们仍然认为这是一个落后的国家／地区。UK adjective
She left without a backward glance.  她头也不回地离去了。

words.meaning: v.犯罪,冒犯,违反,得罪,使...不愉快
words.example:
He looked a bit offended when you called him middle-aged.  你称他为中年人时，他看上去有些不快。
If the sight of a few dirty dishes offends you, then I think you've got problems!  如果看到几个脏碟子就让你不舒服，那么我想你有问题了！verb
Obviously if a police officer offends it's a fairly serious matter.  显然，员警如果犯罪那可是件相当严重的事情。verb

words.meaning: n.食欲,胃口;欲望,性欲;爱好,趣味
words.example:
All that walking has given me an appetite.  走了那么远的路，我胃口大开。
The children all have healthy/good appetites (= they eat a lot).  孩子胃口都很好。
Both viruses cause fever and loss of appetite.  两种病毒都会引起发烧以及食欲不振。noun

words.meaning: a.有同情心的;赞同的;n.交感神经
words.example:
He suffers from back trouble too, so he was very sympathetic about my problem.  他自己也受背痛的困扰，所以对我的烦恼深表同情。
She just needed someone who would lend a sympathetic ear to her (= listen to her in a kind and understanding way) once in a while.  她只是需要一个人能不时以一种理解的态度听她倾诉。    Opposite unsympathetic
She comes across as a more sympathetic character in the film.  她在影片中扮演的角色很能引起观众的共鸣。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.观众,旁观者
words.example: They won 4-0 in front of over 40 000 cheering spectators.  他们在四万多名观众的加油声中以四比零获胜。

words.meaning: vt.使出血,榨取vi.出血,流血
words.example:
Your arm is bleeding.  你的手臂在流血。
He was bleeding heavily.  他在大量失血。
The West is bleeding poorer countries dry through interest payments on their debts.  西方国家透过收取债务利息正在把穷国榨干。

words.meaning: v.窒息,噎住;闷塞,堵塞,阻塞
words.example:
She choked to death on a fish bone.  她被鱼刺鲠住后窒息而死。
Children can choke on peanuts.  小孩子吃花生会噎住的。
Peanuts can choke a small child.  花生会噎住小孩。

words.meaning: n.圣人,基督教徒;(S-或St.用于人,地名前)圣
words.example:
She must be a real saint to stay with him all these years.  这些年来能一直待在他身边，她一定是位大圣人。
He has the patience of a saint with those kids.  他对那些孩子有着圣人般的耐心。

words.meaning: n.豌豆
words.example: frozen/dried peas  冷冻／晒干的豌豆

words.meaning: n.代表 vt.委派…为代表;授权;委托
words.example:
Delegates have voted in favour of the motion.  代表们对这项动议投了赞成票。
Each union elects several delegates to the annual conference.  每个工会选出数名代表参加年度大会。verb[ˈdel.ɪ.geɪt/
As a boss you have to delegate (responsibilities to your staff).  你作为老板必须要分派工作。

words.meaning: n.战栗,颤抖 v.发抖,颤抖;摇动;焦虑
words.example:
When he came out of the water, he was trembling with cold.  他从水里出来时，冷得直打哆嗦。
Her bottom lip trembled and tears welled up in her eyes.  她的下嘴唇颤抖，泪水也涌上眼眶。
His voice started to tremble and I thought he was going to cry.  他的声音开始颤抖，我以为他要哭了。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.(of)小心的,谨慎的
words.example: He's a cautious driver.  他开车很小心。

words.meaning: n.偏见,成见;损害,侵害 v.使抱偏见,损害
words.example:
Laws against racial prejudice must be strictly enforced.  禁止种族歧视的法律必须严格执行。
He claims that prejudice against homosexuals would cease overnight if all the gay stars in the country were honest about their sexuality.  他主张如果国内所有的同性恋明星都能对自己的性向开诚布公，那么对同性恋者的偏见就会立即消失。
My client accepts the formal apology without prejudice to any further legal action she may decide to take.  我的委托人接受了正式道歉，这不会影响她将来可能会采取的法律手段。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.证(明)书,执照
words.example: She has a Certificate in Drama Education.  她有戏剧教育资格证书。

words.meaning: n.长袍,上衣
words.example:
Judges wear black robes when they are in court.  法官在法庭上都身穿黑袍。
He wrapped a robe around himself before answering the door.  他裹了件浴衣过来开门。

words.meaning: v.指明,指出;任命,指派
words.example:
Traditionally, the president designates his or her successor.  按照传统，总统要选定其接班人。
Thompson has been designated (as/to be) team captain.  汤姆森被指定担任队长。
This area of the park has been specially designated for children.  公园的这个区域被指定为儿童活动区。

words.meaning: n.仁慈,怜悯,宽恕
words.example:
She appealed to the judge to have mercy on her husband.  她请求法官宽恕她的丈夫。
The prisoners pleaded for mercy.  囚犯都恳求从轻发落。
The gunmen showed no mercy, killing innocent men and women.  那些枪手毫无怜悯之心，滥杀无辜的男男女女。

words.meaning: (名)同班同学
words.example: My classmate shared her notes.  同学把笔记借给了我。

words.meaning: a.剧烈的;敏锐的;成锐角的;尖的,高音的
words.example:
She felt acute embarrassment/anxiety/concern at his behaviour.  她对他的行为感到极其尴尬／忧虑／担忧。
The problem of poverty is particularly acute in rural areas.  贫穷问题在农村地区尤为严重。

words.meaning: n.(附有停车场的)汽车旅馆
words.example: We slept at a motel near the highway.  我们住在高速公路旁的汽车旅馆。

words.meaning: n.憎恨,憎恶,怨恨
words.example:
What is very clear in these letters is Clark's passionate hatred of his father.  这些信非常清楚地表明了克拉克对他父亲的深切痛恨。
The motive for this shocking attack seems to be racial hatred.  看起来这件令人震惊的攻击事件的动机像是种族仇恨。

words.meaning: n.直径
words.example:
The diameter measures twice the radius.  直径是半径的两倍。
The pond is six feet in diameter.  这个池塘的直径为六英尺。

words.meaning: n.前辈,前任
words.example:
My predecessor worked in this job for twelve years.  我的前任做这份工作做了12年。
The latest Ferrari is not only faster than its predecessors but also more comfortable.  最新款的法拉利赛车不仅比旧款的更快，而且更舒适。

words.meaning: v.引诱,劝使;引起,导致;感应
words.example:
They induced her to take the job by promising editorial freedom.  他们向她保证有编辑自由，以劝服她接受这项工作。
Nothing could induce me (= I definitely cannot be persuaded) to climb a mountain/ride a bike.  没有甚么能诱使我去爬山／骑脚踏车的。UK US  formal
Pills for seasickness often induce drowsiness.  晕船药经常会令人昏昏欲睡。

words.meaning: n.青少年,少年读物 a.青少年的, 幼稚的
words.example: juvenile crime/offenders  青少年犯罪／少年罪犯

words.meaning: n.长袍,特殊场合穿的长服
words.example: a ball gown  舞会礼服

words.meaning: n.止步,停步,停止前进 v.止步,(使)停止
words.example:
Production has halted at all of the company's factories because of the pay dispute.  由于工资纠纷，这家公司所有工厂都停产了。
Security forces halted the demonstrators by blocking the road.  警卫部队用封路的办法来制止示威者前进。UK noun only singular
Severe flooding has brought trains to a halt (= prevented them from moving) on several lines in Scotland.  凶猛的洪水使苏格兰几条铁路线上的火车停驶。

words.meaning: n.相互关联的事物 v.(with,to)(使)互相关联
words.example: Income and education correlate strongly.  收入与教育高度相关。

words.meaning: n.流放;被流放者 vt.流放,放逐,把…充军
words.example:
The king went into exile because of the political situation in his country.  迫于国内的政治局势，国王流亡国外。
The deposed leaders are currently in exile in the neighbouring country.  遭到罢免的那些领导人现在流亡邻国。
The monarch was exiled because of the coup.  由于发生了政变，国王被迫流亡。

words.meaning: n./v.吼叫,怒号;轰鸣,咆哮
words.example:
We could hear the lions roaring at the other end of the zoo.  我们可以听到狮子在动物园的另一端咆哮。
She looked up as a plane roared overhead.  一架飞机轰鸣着掠过她的头顶，她抬头张望。
The street was full of boys roaring up and down on their motorbikes.  大街上到处是些年轻小伙子骑着摩托车来回呼啸而过。

words.meaning: v.拷问,拷打;折磨,磨难 n.拷问;折磨,痛苦
words.example:
Half of the prisoners died after torture and starvation.  半数的囚犯死于拷打和饥饿。
He revealed the secret under torture.  在严刑拷打之下，他招供了。
The rush-hour traffic was sheer torture as usual.  交通尖峰期像往常一样令人煎熬。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.合唱队;合唱 v.异口同声地说,随声附和
words.example:
I'll sing the verses and I'd like you all to join in the chorus.  我唱独唱部分，我希望你们都加入合唱。
The choir will be performing the Hallelujah Chorus at the concert.  唱诗班将在音乐会上演唱《哈利路亚大合唱》。
They burst into a chorus of (= they sang the song) Happy Birthday.  他们突然开始齐唱“祝你生日快乐”。UK noun

words.meaning: n.泉水,喷泉,源泉
words.example: The fountain plays at noon.  喷泉中午喷水。

words.meaning: v.恢复;(使)复苏
words.example:
My plants revived as soon as I gave them some water.  我给花浇了一些水，它们立即又生机盎然了。
Traditional skills are being revived.  传统手艺正在得到复兴。

words.meaning: a.喜剧的,滑稽的n.连环漫画杂志;喜剧演员
words.example: a comic actor/performance  滑稽演员／表演UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.报复,复仇 v.替…报仇
words.example:
She took/got/exacted (her) revenge on him for leaving her by smashing up his car.  他抛弃了她，她就砸烂了他的车来报复。
He is believed to have been shot by a rival gang in revenge for the shootings last week.  据信，敌对帮派为了报复上周的枪击事件将他枪杀。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.酸的;发酸的;酸痛的;脾气坏的;刻薄的
words.example:
These plums are a bit sour.  这些李子有点酸。UK adjective
Overnight, it seemed, their relationship had turned sour.  一晚上的时间，他们的关系似乎变糟了。
She gave me a sour look.  她没好气地瞪了我一眼。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.谨慎;注意(事项),警告vt.劝…小心
words.example:
They treated the story of his escape with (some/great/extreme) caution (= thought that it might not be true).  他们对他逃跑的报道有些／相当／极为怀疑。UK noun
As it was her first offence, she was only given a caution.  由于是初犯，所以只给了她一个口头警告。
Just a word of caution - the cheaper models probably aren't worth buying.  只是提醒一句——便宜一点的模型很可能不值得购买。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.(in,from)起源,发生;首创,创造
words.example:
Although the technology originated in the UK, it has been developed in the US.  尽管这项技术起源于英国，但它在美国得到了发展。
The game is thought to have originated among the native peoples of Alaska.  据认为，这项运动始于阿拉斯加的土著人。
Who originated the saying 'Small is beautiful'?  “小即美”这句话最早是谁说的？

words.meaning: a.凭经验(或观察)的,经验主义的
words.example:
This theory needs to be backed up with solid empirical data/evidence.  这个理论需要翔实的实验资料／实际经验来支援。
Empirical studies show that some forms of alternative medicine are extremely effective.  临床研究显示某些替代疗法极其有效。

words.meaning: n.吸引力,魅力,诱惑物 vt.引诱,吸引
words.example:
She was lured into the job by the offer of a high salary.  她受高薪诱惑接受了那份工作。
He had lured his victim to a deserted house.  他将受害者引诱到一座废弃的房子。
Supermarket chains try to lure customers with price discounts.  连锁超级市场试图用折扣来吸引顾客。

words.meaning: vt.编辑,编制,搜集
words.example: We're compiling some facts and figures for a documentary on the subject.  我们正在为一部有关这个主题的纪录片汇集资料。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.(尤指火山)爆发
words.example:
Since the volcano last erupted, many houses have been built in a dangerous position on its slopes.  自从火山上次喷发后，很多房屋建在了火山山坡上的危险地带。verb intransitive
At the end of a hot summer, violence erupted in the inner cities.  一个炎热的夏末，在市中心贫民区突然爆发了暴力事件。
The crowd erupted in applause and cheering.  人群中爆发出掌声和欢呼声。

words.meaning: a.绘画似的, 图解的,生动的
words.example: He insisted on describing his operation in graphic detail while we were eating lunch.  我们吃午饭的时候，他偏要绘声绘色地描述他动手术的情形。adjective

words.meaning: n.织布机,织机 v.隐现,(危险、忧虑等)迫近
words.example:
Dark storm clouds loomed on the horizon.  天边隐约出现了一团团的乌云。verb intransitive
Her exams are looming.  考试日益逼近，她非常担心。
Here, too, the threat of unemployment has been looming on the horizon.  另外还有失业的威胁在逼近，令人忧虑。

words.meaning: n.女巫, 巫婆,巫师
words.example: Witches were persecuted all over western Europe from the 15th to the 17th century as it was claimed that they had dealings with the Devil.  从15世纪到17世纪，整个西欧的女巫都受到迫害，因为据称她们与魔鬼有来往。

words.meaning: n.值得注意的,显著的,著名的
words.example:
Getting both sides to agree was a notable achievement.  使双方达成共识是一项显著的成就。
This attractive building is particularly notable for its garden setting.  这幢漂亮的建筑因其花园布局而格外引人注目。UK noun countable literary
Other notables among his pupils were the kings of Saudi Arabia and Thailand.  他的学生中，另外两位显要人物是沙乌地阿拉伯国王和泰国国王。

words.meaning: a.幸运的,侥幸的
words.example: He was fortunate in his choice of assistant.  他很幸运，选择了一位好助手。

words.meaning: v.锻造,伪造 n.锻工车间;锻炉
words.example:
The accident forged a close bond between the two families.  事故使两个家庭紧密地联系在了一起。
She forged a new career for herself as a singer.  她成了一名歌唱家，为自己开创了一番新事业。UK verb
Just 100 metres from the finishing line Jackson forged ahead.  离终点线还有100米时，杰克逊突然加速冲刺。

words.meaning: vt.使混乱,使崩溃,使分裂,使瓦解
words.example: The meeting was disrupted by a group of protesters who shouted and threw fruit at the speaker.  一群抗议者一边呼喊一边向发言者投掷水果，让会议无法正常进行下去。

words.meaning: n.商业,贸易;交际,交往
words.example: the world of commerce and industry  工商界

words.meaning: n.叩击,轻拍,斥责 v.敲,拍,打,斥责,使着迷
words.example:
He always said he was jailed on a bum rap (= false accusation).  他总说自己坐牢是冤枉的。
The police caught him, but somehow he managed to beat the rap (= escape punishment).  员警抓住了他，但不知怎么他竟设法逃脱了罪责。
I'm not going to take the rap for you (= be punished for something you did).  我才不会替你去背黑锅。noun

words.meaning: a.值得做的;合意的,称心的;期望得到的
words.example:
Reducing class sizes in schools is a desirable aim.  大家希望减少学校的班别人数。
It's regarded as a highly desirable job.  那是一份很多人都很想得到的工作。
The house is in a very desirable area of the city.  那座房子坐落在城里一个很多人向往居住其中的区域。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.苗条的;(机会)少的 v.减轻体重,变苗条
words.example:
She's got a lovely slim figure.  她有一副迷人的苗条身材。
figurative They've only a slim chance of winning (= It's unlikely that they will win).  他们获胜的机会微乎其微。verb intransitive (-mm-)    UK
You haven't got much lunch - are you slimming?  你午饭吃得不多——在减肥吗？verb intransitive (-mm-)    UK

words.meaning: n.(pl.)剩余,残余,遗迹
words.example:
The remains of lunch were still on the table.  吃剩的午饭仍在桌子上。
We visited the remains of a 12th-century monastery.  我们参观了一处12世纪修道院的遗迹。
Fifty years after he died, his remains were returned to his homeland.  他去世50年后，遗体被送回他的故乡。

words.meaning: v.断言,宣称;指控
words.example: The report alleges corruption.  报告声称存在腐败。

words.meaning: a.机警的,警觉的;机灵的 vt.使…警觉
words.example:
I'm not feeling very alert today - not enough sleep last night!  今天我感觉特别迟钝——昨晚没睡好！
Parents should be alert to sudden changes in children's behaviour.  父母应该对孩子行为的突然变化有所警觉。UK noun countable or uncountable
The army was put on (full) alert as the peace talks began to fail.  当和谈快要破裂的时候，军队进入（全面）戒备状态。

words.meaning: vt.达到;完成;获得 vi.达到
words.example:
He has attained the highest grade in his music exams.  他在音乐考试中得了最高分。
We need to identify the best ways of attaining our objectives/goals.  我们需要确定达到目标的最佳方法。
India attained independence in 1947, after decades of struggle.  经过几十年的斗争，印度于1947年获得独立。

words.meaning: n.乡下,农村
words.example:
The countryside around there is lovely.  那周围的乡村很美。
The mansion is set in 90 acres of beautiful, unspoilt countryside.  那所官邸占地90英亩，坐落在未遭破坏的美丽乡村。
Every summer thousands of people flock to the countryside.  每年夏天成千上万的人涌向乡村。noun [S or U]

words.meaning: n.小屋,棚屋
words.example: a mountain hut  山间小屋

words.meaning: v.刺激,使激动;激发,激励
words.example:
Nothing about my life excites me at present.  我目前的生活就好像一潭死水。verb transitive
This product has excited a great deal of media interest.  这种产品引起了媒体的极大兴趣。
The statement excited new speculation that a senior minister may be about to resign.  这项声明又引发了新一波的猜测，大家都猜想一位高级部长可能立即就要辞职。

words.meaning: v.发…的音;宣布,宣判
words.example:
How do you pronounce your surname?  你的姓怎么念？
She pronounced his name so badly he didn't even recognise it.  念他的名字时她发音如此不标准以至于连他本人都没听出来。
Sade, pronounced shah-day, is a singer.  Sade，读作 Shah-day，是一位歌手。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.旗(帜)
words.example:
The demonstrators walked along the street, waving banners and shouting angrily.  示威者沿着大街行进，一边挥舞着横布条，一边怒吼。
They won the election under the banner of lower taxes.  他们打着降低税收的口号，在选举中胜出。

words.meaning: vt.限制;使不外出,禁闭n.[pl.]界限,范围
words.example:
Let's confine our discussion to the matter in question, please!  请把讨论集中在正题上！
Please confine your use of the telephone to business calls.  请注意电话仅限于办公用途。
By closing the infected farms we're hoping to confine the disease to the north of the region (= stop it from spreading to other areas).  透过关闭受感染的农场，我们希望把疾病限制在该地区的北部。

words.meaning: a.地下的;秘密的 n.地铁 ad.在地下
words.example:
Moles live underground.  鼹鼠生活在地下。adjective adverb UK PEOPLE  人
The Communist Party was forced (to go)underground, and its leaders went into hiding.  共产党被迫转为地下活动，其领导人也隐藏了起来。noun UK TRANSPORT  交通
They went on the underground.  他们乘地铁去的。noun UK PEOPLE  人

words.meaning: a.传统的,正统的,习惯的,保守的,东正教的
words.example: We would prefer a more orthodox approach/solution to the problem.  我们愿意用一种更为正统的方法处理／解决该问题。    Compare heterodox

words.meaning: n.(odour)气味,香味,臭味,名声
words.example: An odor of paint hung in the room.  屋里弥漫着油漆味。

words.meaning: n.(战争,愤怒,火灾等的)爆发,(疾病的)发作
words.example: Last weekend saw further thundery outbreaks.  上周末仍然雷声不断。

words.meaning: a.严酷的,令人害怕的;不愉快的,讨厌的
words.example:
The future looks grim.  未来一片渺茫。 (grimmer, grimmest)
Her face was grim as she told them the bad news.  她满脸愁容地把这个坏消息告诉了他们。
The expression on his face was one of grim determination.  他脸上一副破釜沉舟的神情。

words.meaning: a.有利可图的,有益的
words.example: Over the years it has developed into a highly profitable business.  经过这些年，它发展成了高获利企业。

words.meaning: n.管弦乐队
words.example: She's a cellist in the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra.  她是伯明罕交响乐团的大提琴手。UK noun

words.meaning: n.旱灾,干旱
words.example: This year (a) severe drought has ruined the crops.  今年严重的旱灾把庄稼都给毁了。

words.meaning: v.(使)结合,(使)合并,(使)合为一体
words.example:
They decided to merge the two companies into one.  他们决定将两家公司合并起来。
The country's two biggest banks are planning to merge.  这个国家最大的两家银行正计划合并。
After a while the narrow track merges with a wider path.  过了一会儿，窄道并入了一条较宽的小路。

words.meaning: n.轴;杆状物
words.example:
John came out with an unexpected shaft of wit/wisdom.  约翰出人意料地妙语如珠。UK noun countable
After years of loyal service, his boss gave him the shaft by firing him just before he would have qualified for a pension.  他忠实地工作了多年，当他就要获得领退休金的资格时，他的老板却无情地解雇了他。UK verb transitive informal
She was shafted by her agent over the film rights to her book.  她在书的电影版权问题上受到经纪人欺骗。

words.meaning: a.(to)便利的,方便的
words.example:
Our local shop has very convenient opening hours.  我们当地的商店营业时间很合宜。
What time would it be convenient for me to come round?  我甚么时候方便过来呢？    Opposite inconvenient
Our new flat is very convenient for (= near to) the kids' school.  我们的新公寓离孩子们的学校很近。adjective

words.meaning: n.(accommodations)住宿,留宿;膳宿供应
words.example:
There's a shortage of cheap accommodation (= places to live).  便宜的住所供不应求。
We have first and second class accommodation (= seats) on this flight.  本航班备有头等和二等舱位。UK US mainly UK

words.meaning: n.偷窃(行为),偷窃罪
words.example:
Unfortunately, we have had several thefts in the building recently.  很不幸，我们大厦最近发生了几宗盗窃案。
Shoplifting is theft.  偷拿商店的商品是偷窃。

words.meaning: n.蛙
words.example: Frogs make a low noise called a croak.  青蛙会发出“呱呱”的低沉叫声。

words.meaning: v.磨(碎),碾(碎)
words.example:
Shall I grind a little black pepper over your pizza?  要不要我磨一点黑胡椒粉给你撒在比萨饼上？
They grind the grain into flour (= make flour by crushing grain) between two large stones.  他们把谷粒放在两块大石头之间磨成粉。verb transitive (ground, ground)
She has a set of chef's knives which she grinds every week.  她有一套厨房用刀具，每个星期都把它们磨一次。

words.meaning: v.指示,规定;处(方),开(药)
words.example:
The drug is often prescribed for ulcers.  这种药通常是开来治疗溃疡的。
Penalties for not paying taxes are prescribed by law.  法律上规定了不缴税的惩罚措施。

words.meaning: n.谦恭有礼;有礼貌的举止(或言词)
words.example:
You might get on better with your parents if you showed them some courtesy.  要是你对父母礼貌些，或许会和他们相处得更好。
The President welcomed the Queen with the usual courtesies.  总统以惯常的礼仪规格欢迎女王。
Phil Collins appears on the album courtesy of Virgin Records.  承蒙维京唱片公司支援，菲尔‧柯林斯发行了唱片专辑。

words.meaning: n.地铁;地下行人隧道
words.example: We took the subway uptown to Yankee Stadium.  我们搭地铁到城外的洋基体育场去。

words.meaning: n./v.移植(植物;组织,器官等);迁移;
words.example:
The plants should be grown indoors until spring, when they can be transplanted outside.  这些植物应该先种在室内，到了春天就可以移栽到外面。
Doctors transplanted a monkey's heart into a two-year old child (= removed the child's faulty heart and put a monkey's heart in its place).  医生们给一个两岁的儿童移植了猴子的心脏。    Compare implantUK noun
He had a heart transplant (= Doctors gave him a different, healthier heart instead of his old one).  他接受过心脏移植。

words.meaning: a.爆炸(性)的,爆发(性)的 n.爆炸物,炸药
words.example:
Certain gases are highly explosive.  一些气体极易爆炸。
An explosive device (= a bomb) was found at one of London's busiest stations this morning.  今早在伦敦一个最繁忙的火车站发现一枚炸弹。
There was an explosive clap of thunder overhead.  突然一个轰隆声在头顶炸开。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.穿过,渗入,看穿
words.example:
Amazingly, the bullet did not penetrate his brain.  令人惊讶的是，子弹并未射入他的脑部。
In a normal winter, the frost penetrates deeply enough to kill off insect eggs in the soil.  在正常的冬季里，霜会深深渗入土壤，足以杀死昆虫的卵。
The organization had been penetrated by a spy.  一名间谍渗入了该组织。

words.meaning: vt.照亮,照明;用灯光装饰;说明,阐释
words.example: The streets were illuminated with strings of coloured lights.  这些街道被一串串彩灯照亮了。

words.meaning: n.参数,参量
words.example:
The researchers must keep within the parameters of the experiment.  研究员必须在实验既定的范围内进行研究。
The central office sets/establishes the parameters which guide policy at the local level.  总部制定规范，指导地方政策。

words.meaning: n.运河;(沟)渠
words.example: The Panama Canal provides a crucial shipping link between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.  巴拿马运河是连接大西洋和太平洋至关重要的航道。

words.meaning: n.香槟酒;微黄色
words.example:
We always celebrate our wedding anniversary with a bottle of champagne.  我们总是用一瓶香槟酒来庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。
The champagne corks were popping (= Bottles of champagne were opened) when Guy got his new job.  盖伊找到新工作时，一瓶瓶香槟酒砰砰打开了。

words.meaning: n.裂缝;缺陷 v.使破裂;使有缺陷
words.example:
There's a fatal flaw in your reasoning.  你的推理有一处致命的缺陷。
This report is full of flaws.  这个报告充满错谬。

words.meaning: n.姿势,姿态,心态,态度 v.作出某种姿势
words.example:
She's got very good/bad posture.  她仪态优美／极不优美。
He always adopts/assumes (= moves into) the same posture for the cameras.  他在镜头前总是摆出同样的姿势。UK noun
For the third time this week the opposition has attacked the government's posture on defence.  本周反对派已是第三次攻击政府的国防政策了。

words.meaning: a.(systematical)系统的,有组织的
words.example:
approving We've got to be a bit more systematic in the way that we approach this task.  我们应该更具条理地完成这项任务。
disapproving We're hearing reports of the systematic rape and torture of prisoners.  我们听到一些报道提及囚犯们受到蓄意强暴和折磨。

words.meaning: n.排练,排演,演习,预演,试演
words.example:
They didn't have time for (a) rehearsal before the performance.  他们演出前根本就没有时间排练。
He's a producer with three plays in rehearsal.  他是个制片人，他的三部剧现在都在排演中。

words.meaning: v.使安心,使放心;使消除疑虑
words.example: He reassured us that all was well.  他安慰我们一切都好。

words.meaning: vt.丢弃,抛弃,遗弃
words.example: Discarded food containers and bottles littered the streets.  街上到处都是被丢弃的食品包装和瓶子。

words.meaning: n.木盆,澡盆
words.example:
Outside was a stone patio with tubs of flowering plants.  外面是一个石砌的露台，上面摆着一盆盆开着花的植物。
We've got a tub for compost at the bottom of our garden.  我们家花园的尽头有个盛堆肥的缸。
It's good to sink into a hot tub at the end of a hard day's work.  一天劳累之后，泡在盛满热水的浴缸里真舒服。

words.meaning: n.抑制,制止
words.example:
He showed admirable restraint, and refused to be provoked.  他表现出极大的克制，面对挑衅泰然处之。
The security forces exercised (= used) great restraint by not responding to hostile attacks and threats.  面对充满敌意的攻击和威胁，安全部队没有进行还击，表现出极大的克制。
Lack of space is the main restraint on the firm's expansion plans.  建筑空间的缺乏是阻碍这间公司实施其扩建计划的主要原因。

words.meaning: a.预期的
words.example: We've had three sets of prospective buyers looking round the house.  已经有三批可能买我们房子的人来看过房子了。

words.meaning: v.通信,(with)符合,一致;(to)相当于,对应
words.example:
The money I've saved corresponds roughly to the amount I need for my course.  我存的钱大致够我上学所需。
The American FBI corresponds to the British MI5.  美国的联邦调查局相当于英国的军情五处。
His story of what happened that night didn't correspond with the witness's version.  关于那天晚上发生的事情他的陈述和证人所说的不相符。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: pron.[they的物主代词]他(她、它)们的
words.example: The choice is theirs, not mine.  选择权在他们，不在我。

words.meaning: n.持久;期间;持续时间
words.example: He planned a stay of two years' duration.  他计划停留两年。

words.meaning: n.罐头;锡 a.锡制的 vt.镀锡于
words.example:
The children ate two tins of beans.  孩子们吃了两罐豆子。
We used four tins of paint when we painted the ceiling.  我们漆天花板用了四桶涂料。
Put both cake tins in the oven for half an hour.  把两个蛋糕烤模都放在烤箱里烤半小时。

words.meaning: n.丰富,充裕,大量
words.example:
There was an abundance of wine at the wedding.  婚礼上有足够多的葡萄酒。
We had wine in abundance.  我们有充足的葡萄酒。

words.meaning: n.主张,建议;陈述,命题
words.example:
He wrote to me last week regarding a business proposition he thought might interest me.  他上周写信给我，提出一项他认为我会感兴趣的提案。
I've put my proposition to the company director for his consideration.  我已将我的提议交给公司主管考虑。
They were debating the proposition that 'All people are created equal'.  他们正就“人人生而平等”这一命题展开辩论。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.绝望;失望;令人失望的人(事物)v.绝望
words.example:
They're in (the depths of) despair over/about the money they've lost.  他们对找回丢失的钱已经不抱（任何）希望了。
To her teacher's despair, Nicole never does the work that she's told to do.  妮歌从不做功课，这让她的老师感到非常失望。
Their fourth year without rain drove many farmers to (= caused them to feel) despair.  第四年仍然没有雨水，让许多农民感到非常绝望。

words.meaning: n.陪从;出席人;服务员 a.出席的;伴随的
words.example:
The Prince was followed by his attendants.  王子由其侍从陪同。adjective formal
There are too many risks attendant on such a large investment of money.  这样巨额的投资伴随太多的风险。

words.meaning: v.(fulfil)完成,履行,实践,满足
words.example: She fulfilled her dream of becoming a doctor.  她实现了当医生的梦想。

words.meaning: n.接替的人或事物,继任者
words.example:
Oxford Brookes University is seeking a successor to its vice-chancellor who retires this Easter.  牛津布鲁克斯大学在寻找一位继任者，接替将于今年复活节退休的副校长。
This range of computers is very fast, but their successors will be even faster.  这个系列的电脑速度很快，但它的换代产品速度会更快。

words.meaning: a.轻便的,手提(式)的,可移动的
words.example: a portable radio/telephone/computer  可携式收音机／行动电话／手提电脑

words.meaning: n.草莓
words.example: strawberry jam  草莓酱

words.meaning: n.持有者,占有者;(台,架等)支持物
words.example: Holders of shares in the company receive various benefits.  公司的股东有多种收益。

words.meaning: n.清晰,明晰
words.example:
There has been a call for greater clarity in this area of the law.  人们要求这个领域的法规应该更加明确一些。UK noun uncountable
She was phoning from Australia, but I was amazed at the clarity of her voice.  她从澳大利亚打电话来，可是声音那么清晰，让我觉得惊讶。UK noun uncountable
He has shown great clarity of mind.  可以看出他的思维极其清晰。

words.meaning: n.潮湿,湿气,湿度
words.example: These plants need a rich soil which retains moisture.  这些植物需要一种能保持水分、养分充足的土壤。

words.meaning: n.反驳,否认;矛盾,不一致
words.example:
You say that you're good friends and yet you don't trust him. Isn't that a bit of a contradiction?  你说你们是好朋友，可你又不信任他。那不是有点矛盾吗？
Many people think that an honest politician is a contradiction in terms.  许多人认为“诚实的政客”在用词上自相矛盾。

words.meaning: a.华丽的;灿烂的;美丽的;宜人的;棒的
words.example:
What a gorgeous room/dress/colour!  多漂亮的房间／连身裙／颜色啊！
The bride looked gorgeous.  新娘看上去太美丽了。
The weather was so gorgeous.  天气非常怡人。

words.meaning: n.碎片;粉碎　v.粉碎;使疲惫;使震骇
words.example:
The glass shattered into a thousand tiny pieces.  玻璃碎成无数块细小的碎片。
His leg was shattered in the accident.  他在事故中腿骨碎裂。
The book shattered all her illusions about the Romans.  这本书让她对罗马人的幻想完全破灭。

words.meaning: n.下降,降下;斜坡;血统,家世
words.example:
She's a woman of mixed/French descent.  她是一个混血／法裔女人。
They trace their line of descent back to a French duke.  他们的先人可以追溯到一位法国公爵。
He claims direct descent from Mohammed.  他自称是穆罕默德的直系后代。noun

words.meaning: v.戏弄,取笑;挑逗 n.(爱)戏弄他人者;戏弄
words.example:
It took me a while to tease the truth out of him.  我好不容易才从他嘴里套出真相。
While it was still wet, I gently teased out the tangled knots in Rosie's hair.  趁罗茜的头发还是湿的，我轻轻地用手指梳理开她打了结的头发。noun countable
Johnny, don't be such a tease - leave your sister alone!  强尼，别这样戏弄人——不要惹你妹妹！

words.meaning: v.惊吓,使吃惊
words.example:
She was concentrating on her book and his voice startled her.  她正在聚精会神地看书，被他的声音吓了一跳。
The noise of the car startled the birds and the whole flock flew up into the air.  汽车声把一大群鸟惊吓得振翅飞了起来。
Her article on diet startled many people into changing their eating habits.  她那篇有关饮食的文章使很多人惶惶不安，开始改变饮食习惯。

words.meaning: n.王子,亲王
words.example:
Prince Juan Carlos of Spain became king in 1975.  胡安‧卡洛斯王子于1975年成为西班牙国王。
Prince Rainier is the ruling prince of Monaco.  雷尼尔国王是摩纳哥的君主。

words.meaning: n.侍者,服务员
words.example: The waiter brought the wrong order.  服务员上错了菜。

words.meaning: n.精确,精确度
words.example:
Great precision is required to align the mirrors accurately.  校准反光镜需要极高的精确性。
Precision bombing was used to destroy enemy airbases and armaments factories.  精确轰炸被用来摧毁敌人的空军基地和军工厂。UK noun uncountable
His books are a pleasure to read because he writes with such clarity and precision.  他的书读起来赏心悦目，因为他的写作清晰而又严谨。

words.meaning: ad.在楼下,往楼下
words.example: The kids are playing downstairs.  孩子们在楼下玩。

words.meaning: a.刚性的;刻板的;严厉的
words.example: disapproving We were disappointed that they insisted on such a rigid interpretation of the rules.  他们坚持对规则进行如此呆板僵化的解释，令我们非常失望。

words.meaning: n.学期
words.example: the first/second semester  第一／第二学期

words.meaning: n.阻塞,轧住;果酱 v.(使)阻塞,(使)轧住不动
words.example:
We were stuck in a jam for two hours.  我们塞车塞了两个小时。noun
I'm in a bit of a jam - could you lend me some money till next week?  我手头有点紧——你能借我一点钱到下周再还吗？
How are we going to get ourselves out of this jam?  我们如何才能摆脱这个困境？noun

words.meaning: v.(使)摔倒;打滚,翻腾 n.摔跤,跌倒
words.example:
At any moment the whole building could tumble down.  整幢建筑随时有可能倒塌。
He lost his balance and tumbled over.  他失去平衡摔倒了。
Share prices tumbled yesterday.  昨天股票大跌。

words.meaning: n.发现者,侦察器,探测器,检波器,检电器
words.example: a metal/smoke detector  金属／烟雾探测器

words.meaning: num.十八,十八个
words.example: an eighteen-storey building  一座十八层建筑物

words.meaning: v.(使)旋转
words.example:
Rotate the handle by 180° to open the door.  要想打开门，将把手旋转180度。
The wheel rotates around an axle.  轮子绕轮轴旋转。
The satellite slowly rotates as it circles the Earth.  人造卫星围绕地球旋转的同时也在缓慢自转。

words.meaning: a.华丽的,高尚的,宏伟的
words.example: They live in a magnificent Tudor house.  他们住在一座都铎时代的豪宅内。

words.meaning: a.有礼貌的,客气的;有教养的,文雅的
words.example:
I'm afraid I wasn't very polite to her.  恐怕那时我对她有点不礼貌。
She sent me a polite letter thanking me for my invitation.  她给我写了一封客气的信，感谢我的邀请。
He was too polite to point out my mistake.  他太客气，没有指出我的错误。

words.meaning: a.(to)相反的,矛盾的 n.反对,矛盾;相反
words.example:
For a long time it was thought to be a harmless substance, but we now have proof/evidence to the contrary.  长期以来这种物质被认为是无害的，但最近我们有了相反的证据。noun only singular UK US US US US [-'trer.i/
He doesn't really mean it - he's just being contrary.  这不是他的本意——他只是在故意作对。

words.meaning: v.刮(掉),擦过,勉强通过 n.刮,擦痕,刮擦声
words.example:
We'll have to scrape the snow off the car before we go out in it.  我们开车出去之前必须先扫除车上的积雪。
Emily scraped away the dead leaves to reveal the tiny shoot of a new plant.  艾蜜莉把枯叶扫去，使新苗的嫩芽露了出来。verb
Jackie fell over and scraped her knee (on the pavement).  杰基跌倒了，（在路面上）擦伤了膝盖。

words.meaning: a.眼的,视力的;光学的
words.example: an optical effect  视觉效果

words.meaning: num.十四,十四个
words.example: Her baby is fourteen months old.  她的孩子14个月大了。

words.meaning: n.救护车,救护船,救护飞机
words.example:
We were woken in the night by the wail of ambulance sirens.  深夜，我们被救护车凄厉的警报声吵醒了。
An ambulance crew was called to his home, but he was dead by the time they arrived.  救护人员接到了求救电话，但是赶到他家时他已经咽气了。

words.meaning: v.(against,into)碰;颠簸着前进 n.碰撞
words.example:
She bumped into his tray, knocking the food onto his lap.  她碰着了他的盘子，把食物撞翻到了他的腿上。
We bumped along the track in our car holding on to our seats.  汽车沿着小路颠簸而行，我们紧紧抓牢座位坐好。verb
We bumped into Alison when we were in London last week.  我们上周在伦敦撞见了爱丽森。verb

words.meaning: n.被掠食者,牺牲者,掠食 v.捕食,掠夺,折磨
words.example:
Homeless young people are easy prey for drug-dealers and pimps.  无家可归的年轻人很容易成为毒品贩子和皮条客的猎物。noun uncountable
Small children are prey to all sorts of fears.  幼童深受各种恐惧的折磨。verb
The spider preys on small flies and other insects.  蜘蛛捕食小苍蝇和其他昆虫。

words.meaning: a.热情的,热心的
words.example: You don't seem very enthusiastic about the party - don't you want to go tonight?  你好像对这个派对不怎么热衷——你今晚不想去了吗？

words.meaning: a.古怪的,异常的;特殊的,特有的
words.example:
She has the most peculiar ideas.  她的想法非常古怪。
What a peculiar smell!  多么奇怪的气味！
It 's peculiar that they didn't tell us they were going away.  真奇怪，他们并没有告诉我们他们要离开。

words.meaning: v.审计;查帐;核对;旁听
words.example:
As a senior citizen, he is allowed to audit university classes.  作为一个老年人，他得到准许可以旁听大学的课程。UK noun countable
The company has an audit at the end of each financial year.  这间公司在每个财政年度的年末都要进行一次审计。

words.meaning: n.晚餐
words.example:
We usually have tea at about 5.30 p.m., then supper before we go to bed.  我们通常会在下午五点半用茶点，然后吃晚饭、睡觉。
Would you like to come to supper tonight?  你今天一起来吃晚饭好吗?
They had an early supper before going to the theatre.  他们早早吃完晚饭，去看电影了。

words.meaning: a.缺席的;缺乏的,不存在的;心不在焉的
words.example:
John has been absent from school/work for three days now.  约翰到现在已经旷课／旷工三天了。
We drank a toast to absent friends.  我们为不能来的朋友干杯祝福。adjective]ˈæb.sənt/
Any sign of remorse was completely absent from her face.  她脸上没有一丝自责的神情。adjective]ˈæb.sənt/

words.meaning: n.拯救,救助;救济(者,品),救助工具;救世主
words.example:
After the diagnosis, getting to know Mary was his salvation.  调查之后，他才知道玛丽是他的救星。
The Gospel message is one of personal salvation.  福音资讯是人们灵魂得救的消息。

words.meaning: ad.即,也就是
words.example: We need to get more teachers into the classrooms where they're most needed, namely in high poverty areas.  我们要让更多教师到最需要他们的课堂中去，也就是极度贫困地区的课堂。

words.meaning: v.(使)更新,恢复,重新开始,继续
words.example:
Every year I renew my membership of the sports club.  我每年都将体育俱乐部会员资格续期。
I'll use this material to renew the chair covers.  我要用这块布料做新的椅子罩来换掉旧的。UK verb transitive
The kidnappers renewed their threats.  绑架者又发出威胁了。

words.meaning: a.在头顶上的;架空的 ad.在头顶上
words.example:
This room needs overhead lighting (= lights in the ceiling).  这个房间需要有顶灯。UK adjective [before noun]
One way of increasing profit margins is to cut overhead costs.  增加利润的其中一个方法是减少管理费用。UK noun
We need to reduce our overheads.  我们需要减少经常性开支。

words.meaning: n.桃,桃树
words.example: Would you like peaches and cream for dessert?  你想来点蜜桃冰淇淋当甜点吗？noun

words.meaning: n.(pl.geese)鹅,雌鹅,鹅肉
words.example: A goose honked at the lake.  一只鹅在湖边叫。

words.meaning: n.壁炉
words.example: She swept the ashes from the fireplace.  她把壁炉的灰烬扫掉。

words.meaning: n./v.养育,教育,教养 n.营养品v.给与营养物
words.example:
She wants to stay at home and nurture her children.  她想留在家里照顾孩子。
As a record company director, his job is to nurture young talent.  作为唱片公司主管，他的职责是培养有才华的年轻人。UK verb transitive formal
Winifred nurtured ambitions for her daughter to be a surgeon.  威妮弗雷德一直盼望她女儿会成为外科医生。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.键盘 vt.用键盘输入(信息)
words.example: Her fingers flew across the keyboard.  她的手指在键盘上飞舞。

words.meaning: v.使惊恐
words.example: Don't frighten the child with stories.  别用故事吓孩子。

words.meaning: a.狂怒的,狂暴的,猛烈的
words.example:
He's furious about/at the way he's been treated.  他因自己受到这样的对待而大发雷霆。
We had a furious row last night.  我们昨晚吵了个天翻地覆。UK adjective
There is a furious struggle going on between the two presidential candidates.  两位总统竞选人之间进行着激烈的争斗。

words.meaning: n.毒物,毒药 v.放毒,毒害,污染
words.example:
The pest control officer put bowls of rat poison in the attic.  虫害防治官员在阁楼里放了几碗老鼠药。
Her drink had been laced with a deadly poison.  她的饮料里掺进了致命的毒药。noun countable or uncountable
Four members of the family had been poisoned, but not fatally.  这家中有四口人被人下毒，但未致命。

words.meaning: n.统治者,支配者;尺,直尺
words.example: The country was without a ruler after the queen died.  女王死后，这个国家陷入了无人统治的状态。UK noun countable

words.meaning: ad.无疑,必定
words.example: He is undoubtedly the best player.  他无疑是最棒的球员。

words.meaning: n.承租人;房客;佃户 vt.租借,承租
words.example: The tenant reported a leak.  房客报告了漏水。

words.meaning: v.省略,删去;遗漏,忽略
words.example:
She was omitted from the list of contributors to the report.  这篇报道的撰稿人中漏掉了她的名字。
The Prince's tour conveniently omitted the most deprived areas of the city.  亲王的巡查为避开麻烦，没有去该市最贫困的地区。

words.meaning: n.蜘蛛
words.example: a spider's web  蛛网

words.meaning: n.迷住, 困扰
words.example: He's always wanted to find his natural mother but recently it's become an obsession.  他一直想找到自己的生母，但最近这成了他的一块心病。

words.meaning: n.潮湿 a.潮湿的 vt.使潮湿;使衰减
words.example:
The grass is still damp.  草还有些潮湿。
This shirt still feels a bit damp.  这件衬衫摸上去还有点湿的。
It was a damp, misty morning.  那是一个潮湿而又雾气蒙蒙的早晨。verb

words.meaning: n.必然,肯定;必然的事
words.example:
There are few absolute certainties in life.  世事无绝对。
I'm unable to answer that question with any certainty.  我不能确切地回答那个问题。UK noun
Joan will win - that's a certainty.  琼会赢的——这是必然的。

words.meaning: n.营养,营养学
words.example:
Good nutrition is essential if patients are to make a quick recovery.  病人如果要迅速康复，必须补足营养。
She's a professor of nutrition at Columbia University.  她是哥伦比亚大学的营养学教授。

words.meaning: n.旋律,曲调;悦耳的音乐
words.example:
He played a few well-known melodies.  他演奏了几首很有名的乐曲。
His songs are always strong on melody.  他的歌曲一贯以旋律见长。

words.meaning: n.电子
words.example: An electron carries a negative charge.  电子带负电荷。

words.meaning: n.物理学家
words.example: The physicist won the Nobel Prize.  这位物理学家获得了诺贝尔奖。

words.meaning: n.羊毛,毛线,毛织品
words.example:
The blankets are made from wool and the sheets from cotton.  毯子是羊毛的，床单是棉的。
Put on your red wool cardigan - it'll be nice and warm.  穿上你的红色羊毛衫——会很暖和。
How many balls of wool did you need to knit that sweater?  你织那件毛衣需要多少团毛线？noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.售货员,推销员
words.example: a car salesman  汽车销售员

words.meaning: v.耕作,栽培,养殖;培养,教养,磨炼
words.example:
Most of the land there is too poor to cultivate.  那里大部分土地太贫瘠，无法耕种。
The villagers cultivate mostly maize and beans.  村民们主要种植玉米和豆类。UK verb transitive
She has cultivated an image as a tough negotiator.  她将自己的形象塑造成一个强硬的谈判者。

words.meaning: n.话筒,扩音器
words.example:
The interviewer asked her to speak into/use the microphone.  采访者请她对着扩音器说话。
My laptop has a built-in microphone.  我的笔记型电脑有一个内置麦克风。

words.meaning: n.樱桃(树)
words.example: cherry-red lips  樱唇

words.meaning: n.奢侈,华贵;奢侈品 a.奢华的,豪华的
words.example: to live in luxury  生活奢华

words.meaning: v.(summarise)概括,总结
words.example: I'll just summarize the main points of the argument in a few words if I may.  如果可以的话，我会用几句话把争论的要点概括一下。

words.meaning: n.草地,牧场
words.example: There was a path through the meadow to the village.  有一条小径穿过草地通向村庄。

words.meaning: n.处理,处置;布置,安排
words.example: Having sold the house she had a large sum of money at her disposal (= to spend as she wanted).  卖掉房子后，她手头有一大笔钱可用。

words.meaning: ad.相应地,照着办,按照;于是,因此
words.example:
When we receive your instructions we shall act accordingly.  我们接到你的指示就会遵命行事。
She's an expert in her field, and is paid accordingly.  她是这个领域的专家，且得到了相对的报酬。

words.meaning: v.(公然)违抗,反抗;蔑视
words.example:
The fact that aircraft don't fall out of the sky always seems to me to defy (= act against) the law of gravity.  我总认为飞机没有从天上掉下来，是不符合万有引力定律的。
The chaos at the airport defies description.  机场里乱得一塌糊涂。

words.meaning: n.塞子,插头 v.堵,塞,插上,插栓
words.example:
If a plug is wired incorrectly, it can be dangerous.  如果插头接线接错的话会很危险。
Is there a plug in the bedroom that I can use for my hairdryer?  卧室里有没有插座让我用一下吹风机？
Put the plug in the sink and run some water.  把水槽排水孔塞上，然后放些水。

words.meaning: n.皮夹,钱包
words.example: He pulled out a big fat wallet stuffed with bank notes.  他掏出一个塞满钞票的鼓鼓囊囊的大钱包。    Compare purse     (also document wallet)

words.meaning: n.羔羊,小羊;羔羊肉
words.example: lambs gambolling about in the fields  在牧场上跳来跳去的一群羊羔

words.meaning: n.碎片;废料 v.废弃,报废
words.example:
They're considering scrapping the tax and raising the money in other ways.  他们正在考虑废除这个税目，用其他方法募集款项。
We scrapped our plans for a trip to France.  我们取消了法国之行的计划。
Hundreds of nuclear weapons have been scrapped.  数百件核子武器已被销毁。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: v.诱惑,引诱;吸引,使感兴趣
words.example:
The offer of a free car stereo tempted her into buying a new car.  免费赠送汽车音响让她禁不住诱惑买了一辆新车。
You're tempting fate by riding your bike without wearing a cycle helmet.  你不戴头盔骑自行车简直是在玩命。

words.meaning: n.宣言,宣布,声明
words.example:
Members of Parliament must make a declaration of their business interests.  议员们必须将自己的商业股权公诸于众。
As witnesses to the accident, we were asked to make written declarations of what we had seen.  作为事故的目击者，我们被要求以书面形式陈述看到的一切。
The company made a declaration of intent to follow an equal opportunities policy.  公司宣称愿意遵守平等机会原则。noun countable

words.meaning: n.轴,轴线,中心线;坐标轴,基准线
words.example:
The Earth revolves about the axis which joins the North and South Poles.  地球围绕贯穿南北两极的地轴自转。
The diameter of a circle is also an axis.  一个圆的直径也是一条轴线。
Plot distance on the vertical Y-axis against time on the horizontal X-axis.  用纵坐标Y轴表示距离，用横坐标X轴表示时间。

words.meaning: n.(高等)专科院校;学术社团,协会,研究院
words.example: a military/police academy  军事／员警学院

words.meaning: n.鼓掌;喝彩;夸奖,赞扬
words.example:
His speech met with (= received) loud applause.  他的讲话赢得热烈的掌声。
So let's have a round of applause, please, for (= please applaud) a very lovely and talented young lady who is going to sing for us.  好，让我们热烈鼓掌，欢迎一位集美丽与才华于一身的年轻女士为我们演唱。

words.meaning: vt.注射(药液等);注入
words.example: Phil's a diabetic and has to inject himself with insulin every day.  菲尔患有糖尿病，每天都要替自己注射胰岛素。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.领先(于),在(…之前);优先,先于
words.example:
Boutros Boutros-Ghali preceded Kofi Annan as the Secretary-General of the UN.  布特罗斯•布特罗斯－加利在科菲•安南之前担任联合国秘书长。
It would be helpful if you were to precede the report with an introduction.  你帮这份报告加上一段引言会更好些。

words.meaning: v.管理,监督
words.example:
The UN is supervising the distribution of aid by local agencies in the disaster area.  联合国正在监督灾区地方机构救援物资的发放。
The children play while two teachers supervise (= make certain that they behave correctly and are safe).  孩子们在两位教师的监管下玩耍。

words.meaning: n.防护物,护罩;盾,盾状物 v.保护,防护
words.example:
The police held up their riot shields against the flying rocks and bricks.  员警举着防暴盾牌阻挡飞来的石头和砖块。
The anti-personnel mines were laid as a protective shield around the town.  城镇周围布设了杀伤性地雷作为保护屏障。
Anger can function as a shield against (= a way of avoiding) even more painful emotions of loss and hurt.  愤怒可以起到这样的作用：避免更加痛苦的失落感和受伤害情绪。

words.meaning: n.三角(形)
words.example: Which earrings did you buy in the end - the triangles or the circles?  最后你买了甚么样的耳环——三角形的还是圆的？

words.meaning: n.钙(化学符号Ca)
words.example: Calcium builds strong bones.  钙能强健骨骼。

words.meaning: n.代替者;替身;代用品 v.(for)代替,替换
words.example:
You can substitute oil for butter in this recipe.  这道菜中你可以用食用油代替牛油。
Dayton was substituted for Williams in the second half of the match.  下半场比赛戴顿上场取代了威廉斯。
Gas-fired power stations will substitute for less efficient coal-fired equipment.  以煤气为燃料的发电站将会代替效率较低的燃煤装置。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.野餐 v.(去)野餐
words.example:
If the weather's nice we could have a picnic in the park.  天气好的话我们就能去公园野餐。
Why don't you take a picnic with you?  你为甚么不带着野餐时吃的东西？
Being a single parent is no picnic, I can tell you.  我跟你说，做个单亲父母绝非易事。verb intransitive (picnicking, picnicked, picnicked)

words.meaning: n.纺织品 a.纺织的
words.example: the textile industry  纺织业

words.meaning: n.先例
words.example:
There are several precedents for promoting people who don't have formal qualifications.  提拔没有正式学历的人是有几个先例的。
Some politicians fear that agreeing to the concession would set a dangerous precedent.  一些政客担心同意让步会开创危险的先例。
Would it be breaking with precedent for the bride to make a speech?  新娘发表讲话是否有悖于惯例？

words.meaning: n.永久的,永恒的
words.example:
The company is engaged in the eternal search for a product that will lead the market.  该公司一直在进行长期的研究，以开发出可以引领市场的产品。
Will you two never stop your eternal arguing!  你们两个吵个没完没了，就不能停一停吗！UK adjective

words.meaning: n.碰撞;(利益,意见等的)冲突,抵触
words.example:
There has been a collision on the southbound stretch of the motorway.  在高速公路南向路段上发生了一宗撞车事故。
Two drivers were killed in a head-on (= direct) collision between a car and a taxi last night.  昨晚，一辆轿车与一辆计程车迎面相撞，两名司机身亡。
The cyclist was in collision with a bus.  那个骑脚踏车的人与一辆公车相撞。noun

words.meaning: n.托儿所
words.example:
Does Jake go to a nursery or a childminder?  杰克是去托儿所还是由家庭保育员照顾？
Do you think the state should provide free nursery education ?  你认为国家应该提供免费幼儿教育吗？

words.meaning: n.席子,垫子
words.example:
Wipe your feet on the mat before you come inside.  你进来前先在地垫上擦擦脚。
Please remember to bring a mat and a towel with you to the next aerobics class.  下次上有氧健身课时请记得带垫子和毛巾。noun countable
The top few buttons on his shirt were open, revealing a mat of dark hair on his chest.  他衬衫最上面的几颗钮扣没扣上，露出一片黑色的胸毛。

words.meaning: v.人单足跳;跳上(车等) n.蹦跳;短程飞行
words.example:
We hopped over to Bruges for the weekend.  我们飞速赶到布鲁日去度周末。
The rabbit/bird hopped across the grass.  兔子／鸟蹦跳着穿过草地。UK verb (-pp-)
With his feet tied together he could only move in little hops.  他双脚被捆在一起，只能小步跳。

words.meaning: a.广大的,巨大的;[口]极好的
words.example:
They spent an immense amount of time getting the engine into perfect condition.  他们花了大量时间使引擎运转完美。
He's an immense goalkeeper.  他是一名非常出色的守门员。

words.meaning: num./a.十三 pron.十三(个,只...)
words.example: Some people think that thirteen is an unlucky number.  一些人认为十三是个不吉利的数字。

words.meaning: a.惭愧的,羞耻的,害臊的
words.example:
You've got nothing to be ashamed of.  你没有需要对甚么感到内疚的。
She ought to be thoroughly ashamed of herself - talking to her mother like that!  她应该感到无地自容才对——她怎么能那样跟她母亲说话！
I'm ashamed to be seen with you when you behave so badly!  你表现得那么恶劣，让别人看到我跟你在一起我都觉得丢面！

words.meaning: n.(大学)院长;主持牧师; (基督教)教长
words.example:
She is the new dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences.  她是社会科学学院的新任院长。
Parsons is the dean of the TV news correspondents at Channel Nine.  帕森斯是9频道电视新闻记者中的元老。noun countable

words.meaning: a.仪器的;器械的;乐器的;起作用的;有帮助的
words.example: She was instrumental in bringing about the prison reform act.  监狱改革条例得以出台多亏她大力促成。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.高尚的;贵族的,高贵的 n.贵族
words.example: His followers believe they are fighting for a noble cause.  他的追随者相信他们是在为一项崇高的事业而奋斗。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.喘息,气喘 v.喘息;气吁吁地说
words.example:
When she saw the money hidden in the box she gasped in surprise.  她看到藏在盒子里的钱时，惊得倒吸了一口气。
I'm absolutely gasping for a cigarette.  我真想抽支烟。UK noun countable
He gave a gasp of amazement.  他惊讶得倒吸了一口气。

words.meaning: n.太空人,太空旅行者
words.example: The astronaut floated weightlessly.  宇航员在失重状态下漂浮。

words.meaning: n.外皮,壳;地壳
words.example: Could you cut the crusts off the sandwiches, please?  请把三明治的面包皮切掉，好吗？

words.meaning: n.(influenza)流行性感冒
words.example: a flu virus  流感病毒

words.meaning: n.伞
words.example:
Mr. Hughes's agency is one of 980 community agencies under the umbrella of the National Community Action Foundation (NCAF) in Washington, D.C.  休斯先生的办事处是全国社区行动基金会辖下的980个社区办事处中的一个，该基金会总部设在华盛顿特区。
Donations should be sent to the Disaster Emergency Committee, an umbrella organization for UK-based aid agencies.  捐助应送到赈灾委员会——该委员会是设在英国的各个援助机构的一个综合机构。
Existentialism was really an umbrella term to lump together the works of several philosophers and writers.  存在主义实际上是一个把几位哲学家和作家的作品归并在一起的总称。

words.meaning: n.蚊子
words.example: Some types of the anopheles mosquito transmit malaria to humans.  某些种类的按蚊能将疟疾传染给人类。

words.meaning: vt.使转向,使改道;转移(注意力);使娱乐
words.example:
Traffic will be diverted through the side streets while the main road is resurfaced.  这条主干道重铺路面时，车辆行人将被分流到小路通行。
Our flight had to be diverted to Stansted because of the storm.  由于暴风雨，我们的班机被迫改在斯坦斯特德机场降落。
Should more funds/money/resources be diverted from roads into railways?  是否应该将更多的资金／资源从公路转投到铁路上？UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.服从, 顺从
words.example:
The soldiers refused to obey (orders).  士兵们拒不服从（命令）。
Falling objects obey the law of gravity.  自由落体遵循引力定律。
She was so tired her legs just wouldn't obey her any longer.  她疲惫不堪，再也迈不动腿了。

words.meaning: a.认真思考的,沉思的;体贴的,关心的
words.example:
He has a thoughtful approach to his work.  他工作很细心周到。
You look thoughtful.  你看起来心里有事。
Thank you for phoning when I was ill - it was very thoughtful of you.  我生病时谢谢你打电话来问候——你真是体贴人。

words.meaning: a.被动的,消极的
words.example:
He's very passive in the relationship.  他在这段关系中非常被动。
Men have always played an active part in leading worship while women have been confined to more passive roles.  男性在宗教崇拜方面一直起着主导作用，而女性则一直被局限于较被动的角色。
'He was released from prison' is a passive sentence.  He was released from prison 是个被动句。noun only singular specialized

words.meaning: n.垄断,专卖,专利权,专利事业
words.example:
The government is determined to protect its tobacco monopoly.  政府决意保护其烟草专卖权。
Is Microsoft a monopoly?  微软是垄断企业吗？
The drafting of a new constitution cannot be a monopoly of the white minority regime (= other people should do it too).  新宪法的起草不能由占人口少数的白人政权垄断。

words.meaning: n.暴行,侮辱,愤怒 v.凌辱,引起…义愤,强奸
words.example:
These murders have provoked outrage across the country.  这些谋杀事件激起了全国公众的愤慨。
Many politicians and members of the public expressed outrage at the verdict.  许多政治家和公众人物表达了对这判决的愤慨。
The bomb, which killed 15 people, was the worst of a series of terrorist outrages.  炸弹炸死了15人，这是恐怖主义者一系列暴行中最严重的一次。

words.meaning: a.可以任选的,随意的,非强制的
words.example: English is compulsory for all students, but art and music are optional.  英语是所有学生的必修课，而艺术和音乐则是选修的。

words.meaning: v.召唤;传讯,传唤;鼓起(勇气),振作(精神)
words.example:
General Rattigan summoned reinforcements to help resist the attack.  拉蒂根将军命令增援部队协助抵挡进攻。
humorous I'm afraid I'll have to go - I'm being summoned by my wife.  恐怕我得走了——我妻子命令我回去。
On July 20th, the council was summoned to hear an emergency report on its finances.  7月20日，理事会被临时召集听取有关财务问题的紧急报告。verb transitive

words.meaning: adv.出声地,大声地
words.example:
He read her letter aloud to the rest of the family.  他把她的信大声读给家人听。
People are starting to wonder aloud (= question publicly) whether the economic reforms have gone too far.  人们开始公开质疑经济改革是否矫枉过正了。

words.meaning: n.雪茄烟
words.example: an after-dinner cigar and brandy  饭后抽支雪茄，喝杯白兰地

words.meaning: v.(使)繁殖,生殖;产生;教养,抚养 n.品种
words.example:
Terriers are bred for their fighting instincts.  交配繁殖梗狗是为了保持它们好斗的本性。
His main income comes from breeding cattle.  他的主要收入来自养牛。
The blackbird, like most birds, breeds in the spring.  画眉和大多数鸟一样是在春天繁殖。verb (bred, bred)

words.meaning: n.保证,担保;确信,断言;信心,信念
words.example:
Despite the Government's repeated assurances to the contrary , taxation has risen over the past decade.  尽管在过去十年中政府一再保证不会增税，可税收还是提高了。UK noun
He spoke with calm assurance.  他说话时冷静而自信。UK noun

words.meaning: n.乌合之众(尤指暴力者) vi.围攻,聚众闹事
words.example:
The angry mob outside the jail was/were ready to riot.  监狱外愤怒的暴民准备闹事。
Fifty people were killed in three days of mob violence.  三天的暴乱中有50人丧生。
The usual mob were/was hanging out at the bar.  酒吧里闲混的还是往常那伙人。

words.meaning: vt.断言,坚持声称;肯定;证实,确认;
words.example:
She affirmed her intention to apply for the post.  她承认自己有意应征这个职位。
The government has affirmed its commitment to equal rights.  政府声明了其致力于权利平等的承诺。

words.meaning: v.哭泣,流泪;滴下 n.哭泣
words.example:
People in the street wept with joy when peace was announced.  当宣布和平来临时，街上的人们喜极而泣。
She wept buckets (= cried a lot) when Paul left.  保罗离开时，她大哭了一场。 (wept, wept)
The sore is still weeping a lot so you'll have to change the dressing once a day.  感染处依然流出很多脓，所以你必须每天换一次药。

words.meaning: n.酒;溶液,液剂
words.example: The store doesn't sell liquor.  这家店不卖酒。

words.meaning: v.小口地喝,抿,呷n.一小口的量
words.example:
This tea is very hot, so sip it carefully.  这茶很烫，喝的时候小心点。
She slowly sipped (at) her wine.  她慢慢地啜饮葡萄酒。

words.meaning: n.跨度,跨距
words.example:
He has a short attention / concentration span.  他的注意力持续时间很短。
Over a span of just three years, the new government has transformed the country's economic prospects.  仅仅三年的时间，新政府已经使该国的经济前景出现改观。
The bridge crosses the river in a single span.  河上的桥是单孔桥。verb

words.meaning: vt.鼓掌欢迎;赞同 vi.鼓掌欢迎,欢呼
words.example:
You should have heard the audience applaud - the noise was fantastic.  你真应该听听观众的掌声——那才叫掌声雷动。
She was applauded for a full five minutes after her speech.  她演讲结束后，掌声持续了整整五分钟。UK verb
We applaud the family's decision to remain silent over the issue.  我们非常赞赏这一家人对此事保持沉默的决定。

words.meaning: v.逗留,徘徊,拖延,留恋,浪费光阴,苟延残喘
words.example:
After the play had finished, we lingered for a while in the bar hoping to catch sight of the actors.  戏演完后我们在酒吧里等了一会儿，希望能与演员见上一面。
The smell from the fire still lingered days later.  大火过后好几天还能闻到烧焦的味道。
It's impossible to forget such horrific events - they linger (on) in the memory forever.  这样恐怖的事件让人难以忘记——它们会永远留在人们的记忆中。

words.meaning: n.立方形,立方体;立方,三次幂
words.example: Cut the cheese into small cubes.  将起司切成小方块。noun countable

words.meaning: n./v.传真(机)
words.example:
I'll send you a fax with the details of the proposal.  我会把提案的细节用传真发给您。
I'll send you the agenda by fax.  我会把议程用传真发给您。
Have you got a fax at home?  你家里有传真机吗？verb transitive

words.meaning: prep.在…下面 ad.在下面,在底下
words.example:
The tunnel goes right underneath the city.  隧道正好位于城下。
They found a bomb underneath the car.  他们在车底下发现了一枚炸弹。
Underneath that shy exterior, she's actually a very warm person.  在羞涩的外表下，她其实是个非常热心的女孩。

words.meaning: n.大使馆;大使及其随员
words.example:
We used to be friendly with some people who worked at the Swedish Embassy.  过去我们和瑞典大使馆的一些官员关系非常友好。
The Ambassador held a reception at the embassy.  大使在大使馆举行了招待会。

words.meaning: n.种植园
words.example: a tea/cotton/rubber plantation  茶叶／棉花／橡胶种植地

words.meaning: a.暗淡的,模糊的
words.example:
The lamp gave out a dim light.  那盏灯发出暗淡的光芒。
He sat in a dim corner of the waiting-room.  他坐在候车室一个昏暗的角落里。
We could see a dim (= not easily seen) shape in the fog.  在雾中我们可以看见一个模模糊糊的影子。

words.meaning: n.日落,傍晚;晚霞
words.example:
The fishermen set out at sunset for a night's fishing.  渔夫们日落时分出海，准备夜间捕鱼。
We sat on the beach watching a spectacular sunset.  我们坐在海滩上观看壮丽的晚霞。noun
At the end of the film, the pair of them ride off into the sunset.  在电影的结尾，他们俩过上了幸福的新生活。

words.meaning: v.假定,假设,认为,揣测,滥用,擅自行动
words.example:
In British law, you are presumed innocent until you are proved guilty.  按照英国法律，你在证明有罪之前，一律假定是无辜的。
He presumes on (= takes unfair advantage of) her good nature.  他利用了她的善良本性。

words.meaning: n.X射线,X光
words.example:
The X-ray showed a slight irregularity in one lung.  X光照片显示有一叶肺有点不正常。
She had an X-ray to see if any of her ribs were broken.  她作了X光检查，以确定肋骨是否骨折。

words.meaning: a.过量的,额外的 n.过量;过剩;超额;无节制
words.example:
An excess of enthusiasm is not always a good thing.  过分热情不见得总是件好事。
They both eat to excess (= too much).  他们两个都吃得太多了。
There will be an increase in tax for those earning in excess of (= more than) twice the national average wage.  对于那些收入超过全国平均薪资一倍以上的人，税收额将要增加。

words.meaning: n.选民;成分,组分a.组成的,构成的
words.example:
What are the basic constituents of the mixture?  这种混合物的基本成分是甚么？noun countable
The senator worked hard, always talking to his constituents and hearing their problems.  这位参议员工作卖力，总是跟本区选民交谈，听取他们的难处。

words.meaning: a.古式的,过时的　n.有价值的古物,古董
words.example:
You can't give away Granny's old bookcase - it's a valuable antique.  你不能把奶奶的旧书柜送人，那可是件值钱的古董啊。
My mother collects antiques.  我母亲收藏古玩。adjective

words.meaning: v.磨光,擦亮;使优美,润饰 n.擦光剂,上光蜡
words.example:
Polish your shoes regularly to protect the leather.  定期擦拭你的鞋以保护皮革。UK verb transitive
He polished off the whole pie.  他风卷残云般地吃掉了一整块馅饼。
Arsenal polished off Chelsea 5-0 in Saturday's match.  阿森纳队在周六的比赛中以5：0干净俐落地击败了切尔西队。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.牛奶场,奶店
words.example: dairy cattle  奶牛

words.meaning: v.溜冰,滑冰 n.冰鞋
words.example:
Get your skates on, or we'll be late.  快点，否则我们会迟到的。verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive
The ice on the river is thick enough to skate on/across/over.  河上的冰够厚，可以在上面滑冰。
Shall we go skating tomorrow?  我们明天去滑冰好吗？verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive

words.meaning: n.智力,才智,智慧
words.example:
Her conversation sparkled with her own subtle blend of wit and charm.  她的谈话透着她特有的难以言传的风趣与魅力。
He was known for his dry / ready / sharp wit.  他以言辞尖刻而闻名。
Sydney Smith, a notable wit, once remarked that he never read a book before he reviewed it because it might prejudice his opinion of it.  悉尼‧史密斯，一个风趣出了名的家伙，曾说过他从来不在评论一部书之前去读它，因为这样会让他对这部书产生偏见。noun

words.meaning: n.诅咒,咒语,祸因 vt.诅咒,咒骂,使受罪
words.example:
We could hear him cursing and swearing as he tried to get the door open.  我们听到他一边努力想把门打开，一边骂骂咧咧。
Things were going so badly - it was as if I'd been cursed.  事情这么不顺利——我好像被施了魔咒。UK noun
In the story, a wicked witch put a curse on the princess for 100 years.  故事中，一个邪恶的女巫给公主施了一百年才能破解的咒语。UK noun

words.meaning: a.极好的;极为巨大的;寓言中的,传说中的
words.example:
She looked absolutely fabulous in her dress.  她穿着这条连身裙看起来漂亮极了。
They've got a fabulous apartment in the centre of Paris.  他们在巴黎市中心有一间极佳的公寓。
We had a fabulous time at the party.  我们在聚会上玩得很痛快。adjective

words.meaning: n.相交,交叉;道路交叉口,十字路口
words.example:
The intersection of the lines on the graph marks the point where we start to make a profit.  图上几条线的交点就是我们开始赚取盈利的地方。UK noun
Turn right at the next intersection.  在下个十字路口向右转。

words.meaning: n.行为,行动;功绩,事迹;证书;契据
words.example:
It seems to me that a lot of evil deeds are done in the name of religion.  在我看来，很多坏事都是打着宗教旗帜的。
She's always helping people and doing other good deeds.  她总是帮助别人，经常做好事。noun countable

words.meaning: a.痛苦的,悲惨的
words.example:
She's miserable living on her own.  她独自生活，非常可怜。
What a miserable existence! How could anyone live in such dreadful conditions.  多么痛苦的生活！一个人怎么能在这么糟糕的条件下过活。UK adjective
informal She only offered me a miserable £20 for my old computer.  她只出少得可怜的20英镑买我的旧电脑。

words.meaning: n.(总称)机器,机械
words.example: His hand was injured when he got it caught in the machinery.  他的手卷到机器里受伤了。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.活泼的,活跃的;栩栩如生的,真实的
words.example:
It's hard work teaching a class of lively children.  给一班活泼好动的孩子们当老师很辛苦。
They take a lively interest in their grandchildren.  他们非常喜欢自己的孙辈。
There was some lively discussion at the meeting.  会上讨论得很热烈。

words.meaning: v.剃,刮,刨,削 n.刮脸
words.example:
John has to shave twice a day.  约翰每天得刮两次脸。
Do you shave under your arms?  你刮腋毛吗？
When my dad shaved his beard (off) , he looked ten years younger.  我爸爸刮完胡子后，看起来年轻了十岁。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.学会,研究所;学院 v.设立,设置,制定
words.example: She is threatening to institute legal proceedings against the hospital.  她威胁说要对该医院提出诉讼。

words.meaning: v.擦掉;删去;消磁
words.example:
It's in pencil so you can just erase anything that's wrong.  这是用铅笔写的，这样你就可以把任何错误的地方擦掉。UK verb transitive
Tiger Woods is determined to erase the memory of a disappointing Cup debut two years ago.  老虎·伍兹决心要把两年前初次参加高球赛时令人失望的表现永远忘掉。
Taylor wants a convincing victory to erase doubts about his team's ability to reach the World Cup finals.  泰勒想要透过大比数获胜来消除人们对他的球队能否打入世界杯决赛的疑虑。

words.meaning: a.晚期的;终点的;期末的 n.终点(站);终端
words.example:
She has terminal cancer.  她患有末期癌症。
He has nothing to do all day and is suffering from terminal boredom.  他终日无所事事，极其无聊。
She claims that the shipbuilding industry is in terminal decline.  她声称造船业已经衰败到极点。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(harbour)海港;避难所 v.隐匿,窝藏
words.example: The ship waited in the harbor.  轮船在港口等待。

words.meaning: a.愚笨的,愚蠢的
words.example:
That was a rather foolish thing to do.  做那样的事可真是蠢。
She was afraid that she would look foolish if she refused.  她怕如果拒绝会使自己看起来像个傻瓜。
It was foolish of them to pay so much.  他们花了这么多钱，真傻。

words.meaning: n.无知,愚昧;不知道
words.example:
Public ignorance about the disease is still a cause for concern.  公众对这个疾病的无知仍是一个令人担忧的问题。
Patients, it is claimed, were kept/left in ignorance of what was wrong with them.  据称，病人被蒙在鼓里，对于自己得了甚么病还毫不知情。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.运动场,游戏场
words.example: This area of the coast is the playground of the rich and famous.  海滨的这片区域是富人和名人们的娱乐场。

words.meaning: a.&n.业余(水平)的(运动员、艺术家等)
words.example:
He was an amateur singer until the age of 40, when he turned professional.  40岁之前他一直是个业余歌手，之后才转为职业歌手。    Compare professional
This tennis tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.  这次网球锦标赛业余运动员和职业运动员都可以参加。    Compare professional    disapproving

words.meaning: a.有能力的,能胜任的;足够的
words.example: a competent secretary/horse-rider/cook  能干的秘书／骑手／厨师

words.meaning: a.线的,直线的,线状的;长度的;线性的
words.example:
These mental exercises are designed to break linear thinking habits and encourage the creativity that is needed for innovation.  设计这些思维训练旨在打破线性思维习惯，激发革新所需的创造思维。
Is there a linear relationship between salaries and productivity?  薪水和生产效率有直接关系吗？

words.meaning: a.原始的,远古的,早期的;粗糙的,简单的
words.example:
Primitive races colonized these islands 2000 years ago.  原始种族2000年前开拓了这些岛屿。
The spiny anteater is a mammal, although a very primitive one.  针鼹属于哺乳动物，尽管是非常原始的一种。
Early settlers had to cope with very primitive living conditions.  早期殖民者不得不克服非常原始的生存条件。

words.meaning: n.阳台;(电影院等的)楼厅,楼座
words.example:
We had drinks on the hotel balcony.  我们在饭店的阳台上喝酒。
Our seats are in row F of the balcony.  我们的座位在楼座的F排。

words.meaning: n.眉(毛);额
words.example:
She wrinkled her brow as she thought.  她思考时皱起眉头。
He paused at the top of the hill and mopped his brow (= rubbed the sweat away).  他在山顶停了会儿，擦去额头上的汗。noun

words.meaning: n.蚁;蚂蚁
words.example: An ant climbed the table.  一只蚂蚁爬上了桌子。

words.meaning: v./n.再循环,重复利用
words.example: The Japanese recycle more than half their waste paper.  日本人将一半以上的废纸回收利用。

words.meaning: n.礼拜,礼拜仪式;崇拜 v.崇拜,敬仰;做礼拜
words.example:
In the various regions of India, Hindus worship different gods and observe different religious festivals.  在印度的不同地区，印度教信徒敬奉不同的神灵，并庆祝不同的宗教节日。
They work for the same company, socialise together and worship in the same mosque.  他们为同一家公司工作，一同参加社交活动，并且在同一清真寺做礼拜。
The poll showed that over 40% of Americans worship on a weekly basis.  民意调查显示，超过40%的美国人每周都去做礼拜。UK verb (-pp- or US ALSO -p-)

words.meaning: n.巧合;同时发生,共同存在;符合,一致
words.example:
You chose exactly the same wallpaper as us - what a coincidence!  你选的壁纸跟我们的一模一样——真巧！
Is it just a coincidence that the wife of the man who ran the competition won first prize?  赢得冠军的人是竞赛组织者的老婆，这难道只是巧合吗？
Just by coincidence, I met my old school-mate again fifty years later.  纯粹是碰巧了，我在50年后又遇到了我的老同学。

words.meaning: a.女性的;娇柔的
words.example:
With his long dark eyelashes, he looked almost feminine.  他的睫毛又长又黑，看起来就像个女人。
The current style in evening wear is soft, romantic and feminine.  现在的晚装风格是轻柔、浪漫并充满女性风韵。
Her clothes are always very feminine.  她的衣服总是非常女性化。    Compare masculineadjective

words.meaning: a.破坏性
words.example: Lack of trust is very destructive in a relationship.  恋爱时缺乏信任是非常不利的。

words.meaning: n.重复,反复
words.example:
His books are full of repetition.  他的那些书都是在翻来覆去写同样的东西。
We want to prevent a repetition of last summer's fires which destroyed more than 500,000 acres of land.  去年夏天的火灾毁了超过500,000英亩的土地，我们希望预防此类火灾再次发生。

words.meaning: n.学费;(某一学科的)教学,讲授,指导
words.example:
All students receive tuition in logic and metaphysics.  所有学生都学习逻辑学和玄学。
Few can afford the tuition of $12 000 a term.  很少人能支付得起每学期12 000美元的学费。

words.meaning: n.红利,股息;回报,效益;被除数
words.example: Dividends will be sent to shareholders.  红利将被派发给股东。

words.meaning: v.修订,校订;修正,修改
words.example:
His helpfulness today has made me revise my original opinion /impression of him.  他今天所表现出的乐于助人的品质使我改变了对他的最初看法／印象。
His publishers made him revise his manuscript three times.  出版公司让他把手稿修改了三次。verb
We're revising (algebra) for the test tomorrow.  我们正在为明天的（代数）考试进行复习。

words.meaning: vi.(狗等)吠,叫n.吠声,叫声;树皮
words.example:
Don't let her frighten you, her bark is worse than her bite.  别被她吓倒了，她这人口直心快。UK verb
They heard a dog barking outside.  他们听见外面有狗吠声。
The sergeant barked (out) a succession of orders to the new recruits.  中士向那些新兵大声地下了一连串命令。UK verb

words.meaning: v.使害怕,使惊恐
words.example: The idea of parachuting out of a plane terrifies me.  一想到从飞机上跳伞，我就害怕。

words.meaning: n.院子,庭院,天井
words.example: We ate in the courtyard.  我们在院子里吃饭。

words.meaning: v.迷住,强烈吸引
words.example:
Science has always fascinated me.  科学一直令我着迷。
Anything to do with aeroplanes and flying fascinates him.  一切有关飞机和飞行的东西都令他着迷。

words.meaning: n.发电机,发生器
words.example: The generator kicked in during the outage.  停电时发电机启动了。

words.meaning: v./n.刺,戳
words.example:
She was stabbed several times in the chest.  她胸口被捅了几刀。
He was jailed for fifteen years for stabbing his wife to death.  他因刺死妻子被判入狱15年。
As she spoke she stabbed the air with her finger.  她一边说一边用手指在空中比划着。

words.meaning: n.咖啡馆,(小)餐馆
words.example: I work from a cafe in the mornings.  我早上在咖啡馆工作。

words.meaning: n.影响程度,影响范围;发生率
words.example: There have been quite a few incidences of bullying in the school this year.  今年该校发生了好几次欺凌弱小的事件。

words.meaning: n.宣传(机构);[天主教]传道总会
words.example:
At school we were fed communist/right-wing propaganda.  在学校时我们被灌输了右翼思想。
One official dismissed the ceasefire as a mere propaganda exercise.  某位官员只是把停火当作宣传伎俩而不予理睬。

words.meaning: v. 用公式表示;规划;设计;系统地阐述
words.example: to formulate a new plan  制订一个新计划

words.meaning: v.贿赂,收买 a.腐败的,贪污的
words.example:
Both companies are under investigation for corrupt practices.  两家公司都在接受腐败行为调查。
The whole system was corrupt - every official she approached wanted money before helping her.  整个体系都腐败了——她接触的所有官员在帮她之前都索要钱财。
The study claimed that violence on television corrupts the minds of children.  研究称电视上的暴力镜头腐蚀了孩子们的思想。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.城堡;(国际象棋中的)车
words.example: The castle dates back to the 12th century.  城堡建于 12 世纪。

words.meaning: a.平行的,相同的,类似的n.平行线,类似,对比
words.example:
Draw a pair of parallel lines.  画两条平行线。
Hills Road is parallel to Mill Road.  希尔斯路和米尔路平行。UK adjective
Parallel experiments are being conducted in Rome, Paris and London.  类似的实验正在罗马、巴黎和伦敦同时进行。UK noun

words.meaning: a.彻底的,完全的;精心的
words.example:
They did a thorough search of the area but found nothing.  他们仔细搜索了该地区，但一无所获。UK adjective
It was a thorough waste of time.  这完全是浪费时间。

words.meaning: n.标本,样本
words.example:
He has a collection of rare insect specimens.  他收集了很多稀有昆虫的标本。
Museums will pay large amounts of money for good dinosaur fossil specimens.  博物馆愿意出大价钱购买完好的恐龙化石标本。
Astronauts brought back specimens of moon rock.  太空人带回了月球岩石的样本。

words.meaning: a.暗的,朦胧的;模糊的,晦涩的
words.example:
Official policy has changed, for reasons that remain obscure.  官方的政策已改变，原因尚不清楚。
His answers were obscure and confusing.  他的回答模糊不清，令人费解。UK verb transitive
Two new skyscrapers had sprung up, obscuring the view from her window.  两座新摩天大楼拔地而起，挡住了她窗外的风景。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)眼镜;场面,景象;奇观,壮观
words.example:
It was a strange spectacle to see the two former enemies shaking hands and slapping each other on the back.  见到两个宿敌握手言欢，彼此拍肩，真是一幅奇怪的场景。
We witnessed the extraordinary spectacle of an old lady climbing a tree to rescue her cat.  我们目睹了一件奇事：有个老妇人爬上树去救她的猫noun
The carnival was a magnificent spectacle.  嘉年华场面十分壮观。

words.meaning: n.一阵激动(恐惧) v.激动;(使)毛骨悚然
words.example:
So why do people still go hunting - is it the thrill of the chase?  那么为甚么人们还去打猎——是不是因为追捕猎物让人感到兴奋刺激?
It gave me a real thrill to see her again after so many years.  这么多年以后与她重逢，着实令我激动。
The video shows the thrills and spills (= excitement and accidents) of motor racing.  录像呈现了紧张刺激的赛车场面。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.海洛因
words.example:
Heroin is obtained from morphine and is extremely addictive.  海洛因是从吗啡中提取出来的，极容易使人上瘾。
She died from a heroin overdose.  她死于过量吸食海洛因。

words.meaning: n.景色,风光;观点,见解;展望,前景
words.example:
The outlook for the economy is bleak.  经济前景暗淡。
The outlook for today is cloudy and dry at first with showers later.  今天多云，气候干燥，晚些时候有阵雨。noun
He has a fairly positive outlook on life.  他的人生观相当积极。noun

words.meaning: n.膝上型电脑
words.example: My laptop needs a new battery.  我的笔记本该换电池了。

words.meaning: vi.嗅…味道;抽鼻涕;对嗤之以鼻,蔑视
words.example:
He sniffed his socks to see if they needed washing.  他嗅了嗅自己的袜子，看是否需要洗了。
Dogs love sniffing each other.  狗喜欢相互嗅闻。
She sniffed at her glass of wine before tasting it.  品尝那杯酒之前，她先闻了闻。

words.meaning: n.&v.漫步;散步;游荡
words.example: We could stroll into town if you like.  如果你愿意的话，我们可以去城里走走逛逛。

words.meaning: n.[化]氮
words.example: Nitrogen is inert at room temperature.  氮气在常温下不活泼。

words.meaning: a.透明的,透光的;易理解的;明显的
words.example:
Grow the bulbs in a transparent plastic box, so the children can see the roots growing.  把球茎种在透明的塑胶盒里，这样孩子就能看到根的生长。
Her blouse was practically transparent!  她的衬衫几乎是透明的！    Compare opaque ; translucent

words.meaning: a.构成整体所必需的;完整的
words.example:
He's an integral part of the team and we can't do without him.  他是球队不可或缺的一员，没有他我们可不行。
Bars and terrace cafés are integral to the social life of the city.  酒吧和露天咖啡座是这个城市社交生活中不可缺少的一部分。

words.meaning: a.各自的,各个的
words.example:
Everyone would go into the hall for assembly and then afterwards we'd go to our respective classes.  所有人都去礼堂参加集会，会后各自回各自的班级。
Clinton and Zedillo ordered their respective Cabinets to devise a common counter-drug strategy.  克林顿和塞迪略命令他们各自的内阁制订两国共同的反毒品战略。

words.meaning: v.(使)循环,(使)流通
words.example:
Hot water circulates through the heating system.  热水在供暖系统中循环。
I've circulated a good luck card for everyone to sign.  我拿了一张好运卡传着让每个人都签名。

words.meaning: v./n.预测,预报
words.example:
The weather forecast said it was going to rain later today.  天气预报说今天晚些时候有雨。UK verb transitive (forecast or forecasted, forecast or forecasted)
They forecast a large drop in unemployment over the next two years.  他们预测今后两年失业人口会大幅下降。
Snow has been forecast for tonight.  预报今晚有雪。

words.meaning: n.复活节
words.example: We dye eggs for Easter.  我们为复活节染彩蛋。

words.meaning: n.分类,分级
words.example: Do you understand the system of classification used in ornithology?  你懂鸟类学的分类体系吗？

words.meaning: n.段,节;小新闻,短评
words.example: Write a short paragraph about your city.  写一段关于你城市的短文。

words.meaning: vt.插入;猛推 n.插,推力 vi.刺,戳,冲
words.example:
She thrust the money into his hand.  她把钱塞进他手中。
They thrust a microphone in front of me and fired questions at me.  他们把麦克风推到我面前，不断向我发问。
She thrust the papers at me (= towards me).  她把报纸塞给我。

words.meaning: n.娱乐,消遣
words.example:
His favourite recreations are golf and playing Scrabble.  他最喜欢的消遣方式是打高尔夫球和玩拼字游戏。
Emma's only form of recreation seems to be shopping.  埃玛唯一的消遣好像就是购物。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.荒谬的,荒诞的,荒唐可笑的;不合理的
words.example:
What an absurd thing to say!  这话多荒唐啊！
Don't be so absurd! Of course I want you to come.  别说傻话了！我当然想让你来。
It's an absurd situation - neither of them will talk to the other.  这情形真是让人哭笑不得——他们谁也不愿意理谁。

words.meaning: n.引诱,诱惑;诱惑物
words.example: He knew it was wrong to steal, but the money just lying there was too great a temptation.  他知道偷盗是不对的，但钱就摆在那里，对他的诱惑实在太大了。

words.meaning: n.水库,蓄水池
words.example: The universities constitute a reservoir of expert knowledge.  大学是专业知识的宝库。

words.meaning: n.节日;宴会
words.example:
"What a feast!" she said, surveying all the dishes on the table.  “多丰盛的宴席啊！”她一边打量着桌上的菜肴，一边说道。
His food is a feast for the eyes as well as the palate.  他做的菜既赏心悦目又让人大饱口福。
The team contains a veritable feast of international talent.  这个团队里有一批名副其实的国际人才。noun

words.meaning: n.类似,相似,类比,类推
words.example:
He drew an analogy between the brain and a vast computer.  他把大脑比作一台庞大的电脑。
It is sometimes easier to illustrate an abstract concept by analogy with (= by comparing it with) something concrete.  有时用具体事物作比拟来阐释抽象概念会更容易些。

words.meaning: n.管理者;(汽车)售票员;领队,指挥;导体
words.example:
The conductor raised his baton.  指挥举起了指挥棒。
Metal is a good conductor of heat.  金属是良好的热导体。

words.meaning: n.居民,住户
words.example: a city of 5 million inhabitants  拥有500万居民的城市
