words.meaning: n.皮带,带子v.用带扣住,束牢;用绷带包扎
words.example:
Could you help me fasten this strap around my suitcase?  你能帮我用这条带子把手提箱系紧吗？
Are the kids strapped into their car seats?  给孩子系好坐椅安全带了吗？
We strapped the surfboard to the car roof.  我们把冲浪板绑在汽车顶蓬上。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition (-pp-)

words.meaning: vi.摇动;倾斜 vt.使摇动 n.摇动;影响力
words.example:
The trees were swaying in the wind.  树在风中摇曳。
The movement of the ship caused the mast to sway from side to side/backwards and forwards.  桅杆随着船的行驶左右／前后摇摆。
Recent developments have swayed the balance of power in the region.  最近的发展使这个地区的实力均势产生了改变。verb

words.meaning: (中学、大学)二年级学生
words.example: He is a sophomore majoring in economics.  他是经济学大二学生。

words.meaning: v.提升,使升级
words.example:
It's quite simple to upgrade the indexing software.  升级索引软体很简单。
Congratulations, I hear you've been upgraded to divisional manager.  祝贺你啊，听说你被提升为部门经理了。    Opposite downgradenoun countable /ˈʌp.greɪd/
The upgrade to version 5.0 costs $395.  升级到5.0版本要花费395美元。

words.meaning: v.表明,证明,显示 a.明白的,明了的
words.example:
The workers chose to manifest their dissatisfaction in a series of strikes.  工人决定藉一连串罢工来表达他们的不满。
The illness first manifested itself in/as severe stomach pains.  这种疾病最初表现为严重的胃痛。
Lack of confidence in the company manifested itself in a fall in the share price.  人们对公司缺乏信心，股价下跌正好显示此情况。 formal

words.meaning: n.拒绝,回绝
words.example: Our request for permission to travel met with/received a flat/point-blank (= complete) refusal from the authorities.  我们向当局申请旅游签证，但遭到断然拒绝。

words.meaning: n.腐蚀,磨损;削弱,减少
words.example: Soil erosion ruins farmland.  水土流失毁坏农田。

words.meaning: n.脸红v.发红;奔流a.洋溢的;富裕的;齐平的
words.example:
She flushed with pleasure as she accepted the prize.  她领奖时高兴得红光满面。
The champagne had caused his face to flush.  香槟使他脸色发红。verb
My children never flush the loo/toilet after them.  我的孩子们用过马桶后从来不冲。

words.meaning: vt.舔;(火焰或浪)掠过;打败 n.舔;少量
words.example:
He licked the chocolate off his fingers.  他把手指上的巧克力舔干净了。
She licked the stamps and stuck them on the parcel.  她舔了一下邮票，然后贴在包裹上。
Within a few seconds flames were licking at the curtains.  几秒钟之内火舌就蔓延到了窗帘。verb

words.meaning: n.白痴;极蠢的人;笨蛋
words.example:
Some idiot left the tap running in the bathroom and there's water everywhere.  哪个白痴忘了关浴室的水龙头，水流得到处都是。
[as form of address] You stupid idiot - that's a month's work you've lost!  你这个十足的白痴，你白做一个月的工！

words.meaning: a.主观(上)的,个人的
words.example: More specific and less subjective criteria should be used in selecting people for promotion within the company.  公司内部决定升职人选时，需要藉助更具体、更客观的标准。    Compare objective

words.meaning: n.过失;缺点;不足
words.example:
All R45 aircraft have been grounded, after a defect in the engine cooling system was discovered.  自从发现引擎冷却系统有缺陷之后，所有R45型飞机都已经停飞了。
There are so many defects in our education system.  我们的教育制度有太多缺陷了。
It's a character defect in her that she can't ever accept that she's in the wrong.  她在性格上有缺陷，因为她从来都不承认自己有责任。

words.meaning: n.会计人员,会计师
words.example: a firm of accountants  会计师事务所

words.meaning: n.猫头鹰
words.example: An owl camouflaged against the bark.  猫头鹰伪装得和树皮一样。

words.meaning: n.请愿书,申请书 v.(向…)请愿,正式请求
words.example:
She's filing a petition for divorce.  她将要递交离婚诉状。verb intransitive or transitive
They're petitioning for/about better facilities for disabled people on public transport.  他们正在请愿，希望当局能在大众交通工具上为残障人士安装更好的设施。
legal She is petitioning for a re-trial.  她将上诉要求重审。

words.meaning: n.通信,信件;(with)符合;(to)相当于,对应
words.example:
Any further correspondence should be sent to my new address.  以后来信请寄到我的新地址。
Her correspondence with Jim lasted many years.  她和吉姆保持了多年的通信联系。UK noun
The survey found no correspondence between crime and unemployment rates.  调查发现犯罪与失业率之间没有关联。

words.meaning: a.(statical)静态的,静力的
words.example:
Oil prices have remained static for the last few months.  过去几个月里油价保持稳定。UK noun uncountable
There's so much static on this radio I can't hear what they're saying.  收音机的静电干扰太大，我听不清他们在说甚么。

words.meaning: n.动脉;干线,要道
words.example: Hardening of the coronary arteries can lead to a heart attack.  冠状动脉硬化可能导致心脏病发作。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.薄雾,霭
words.example:
The mountain villages seem to be permanently shrouded in mist.  山村好像永远笼罩在薄雾之中。
The early-morning mist soon lifted/cleared.  清晨的薄雾很快就散了。
Through a mist of tears, I watched his train pull out of the station.  我泪眼模糊，看着他乘坐的火车驶离车站。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.胡说,废话
words.example:
This report is nonsense and nothing but a waste of paper.  这份报告一派胡言，纯粹是浪费纸张。
The accusations are (absolute/complete/utter) nonsense.  这些指控纯属子虚乌有。
Nonsense/Don't talk nonsense! She's far too ill to return to work!  一派胡言／别胡说！她远不至于病得没法回来上班！

words.meaning: n.树胶;口香糖
words.example:
By gum, he's a big lad!  好家伙，他块头真大啊！verb transitive (-mm-)    slightly old-fashioned
The labels were already gummed to the envelopes.  标签已经黏贴在信封上了。verb transitive (-mm-)    slightly old-fashioned
When I woke up this morning my eyes were all gummed up.  今天早晨我醒来时，眼睛被眼屎给糊住了。

words.meaning: n.(pl.theses) 论文;论题;论点
words.example: Their main thesis was that war was inevitable.  他们的主要论点是战争不可避免。

words.meaning: n./a.音频(响)(的);声音(的),听觉(的)
words.example: an audio cassette  卡式录音带

words.meaning: a.宇宙的;无比巨大的,无穷尽的
words.example: The earthquake was a disaster of cosmic proportions/scale.  这次地震是一场巨大的灾难。

words.meaning: v.沉思,考虑
words.example: She sat back for a minute to ponder her next move in the game.  她靠在椅背上坐了一会儿，思考下一步棋该怎么走。

words.meaning: v.使..复杂;使..难懂;使(疾病等)恶化;
words.example:
It will only complicate the situation if we invite his old girlfriend as well.  如果我们同时也邀请他以前的女友，只会使事情更加复杂。
The rescue operation has been complicated by bad weather.  恶劣的天气使救援工作变得更加艰难。
These new rules have complicated the tax system even further.  这些新规定使税收制度更加复杂。

words.meaning: vt.公开指责,公然抨击;谴责
words.example:
The government's economic policy has been denounced on all sides.  政府的经济政策受到了各方面的谴责。
We must denounce injustice and oppression.  我们必须对不公和压迫现象予以谴责。verb transitive
His former colleagues have denounced him as a spy.  他以前的同事告发他是间谍。

words.meaning: n.休息室,起居室,客厅
words.example:
All the family were sitting in the lounge watching television.  全家人都坐在客厅里看电视。
We spent our days lounging around the pool.  我们整天在游泳池消磨时间。

words.meaning: n.凳子;(pl.)大便
words.example: He told the doctor he had been passing bloody stools.  他告诉医生他便血。

words.meaning: a.地平线的;水平的
words.example:
Draw a horizontal line across the bottom of the page.  在本页底部画一条水准线。
Keep the patient horizontal with the feet slightly raised.  让病人平躺，双脚略微抬高。    Compare verticalUK noun countable usually singular
Rotate it slowly from the horizontal into a vertical position.  慢慢将它从水准位置旋转到垂直位置。

words.meaning: n.日光,白昼,黎明
words.example:
The colours look much better in daylight.  这些颜色在日光下看起来更漂亮。noun uncountable
I'll knock the living daylights out of him if he says that again!  他再这样说，我就把他揍扁了！noun uncountable
Don't jump out on me like that! You scared the living daylights out of me!  别这样跳出来吓我！你差点把我吓死！

words.meaning: n.正当理由;许可证,委任状 v.保证,担保
words.example:
Obviously what she did was wrong, but I don't think it warranted quite such severe punishment.  显然她做得不对，但我认为她不应该受到如此严厉的惩罚。
It's a relatively simple task that really doesn't warrant a great deal of time being spent on it.  这是一个相对来说比较简单的任务，不必在上面花费大量的时间。
Judge La Riva had issued an arrest warrant/a warrant for his arrest.  拉里瓦法官已经签署了一份逮捕状／逮捕他的令状。UK noun

words.meaning: a.例外的,异常的
words.example: The company has shown exceptional growth over the past two years.  过去两年里面，这间公司的发展业绩不俗。

words.meaning: vt.把…嵌(埋、插)入,扎牢;使深留脑中
words.example: Embed the chart in the report.  把图表嵌入报告。

words.meaning: n.捆,包,束
words.example:
Three days after the birth, Paul and Sandra took their precious bundle of joy home.  孩子出生三天后，保罗和桑德拉把宝宝抱回了家。noun countable
He's not exactly a bundle of laughs, is he?  他并不是个很滑稽搞笑的人，是不是？noun countable
Sorry for shouting - I'm a bundle of nerves these days.  很抱歉冲你大叫大嚷——这些天我很焦躁。noun countable

words.meaning: n.亚麻布,亚麻布制品
words.example: a linen jacket  亚麻上衣

words.meaning: n.臭氧;(海岸等的)新鲜空气
words.example: Ozone protects life from ultraviolet rays.  臭氧保护生命免受紫外线伤害。

words.meaning: n.脚步(声),足迹
words.example:
Walking along the darkened street, he heard footsteps close behind him.  走在黑漆漆的大街上，他听到有脚步声紧随其后。
When he realized he'd lost his wallet, he retraced his footsteps (= went back the way he had come).  他发现自己丢了钱包，于是沿原路返回。

words.meaning: v.滴下,漏水 n.滴,水滴,点滴
words.example:
Water dripped down the wall.  水顺着墙滴下来。
She dripped paint on the carpet.  她把油漆滴在了地毯上。
Watch out - the candle's dripping.  小心——蜡烛滴油了。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.记录员;录音机
words.example: The recorder captured the whole lecture.  录音笔录下了整堂课。

words.meaning: v.解开,放松
words.example:
The screws holding the bed together had loosened.  床上的螺丝钉松了。verb
He loosened his tie.  他松开了领带。verb
He held my hand very tightly at first but gradually his grip loosened.  一开始他紧紧地握着我的手，但后来慢慢地松开了。verb

words.meaning: vt.举起,提拔,振奋,提升...的职位
words.example:
The platform was elevated by means of hydraulic legs.  平台由液压支架抬升起来。
They want to elevate the status of teachers.  他们想提高教师的社会地位。
These factors helped to elevate the town into the list of the ten most attractive in the country.  这些因素提高了该镇的声望，使之成为该国十大最具魅力城镇之一。

words.meaning: n.抽彩;碰运气的事,难于算计的事
words.example: Education in England is something of a lottery.  在英格兰接受教育有点像碰运气。

words.meaning: n.边缘;(窗帘)缘饰;额前垂发 vt.饰…的边
words.example: The river is fringed with wild flowers.  河两岸长满了野花。

words.meaning: n.篱笆,树篱,障碍物 v.用树篱围住
words.example:
She'd made some overseas investments as a hedge against rising inflation in this country.  她在海外有一些投资，可以抵消该国不断上升的通货膨胀所带来的损失。verb
We've got permission, but it's hedged about/around with strict conditions.  我们得到了许可，但却有严格的限制条件。
Stop hedging and tell me what you really think.  别再拐弯抹角了，告诉我你真正的想法。verb

words.meaning: vt.出租,租用 n.租借,租期,租赁物
words.example:
The estate contains 300 new homes, about a third of which are leased to the council.  住宅区里有300所新房屋，其中约1／3租给了市政委员会。
He has the flat on a long lease.  他长期租用该公寓。
The lease runs out/expires in two years' time.  租借契约将在两年后到期。

words.meaning: n.电器;器械,装置;应用,适用
words.example: electric/domestic/household appliances  电器／家用电器／家电

words.meaning: n.人口普查(调查)
words.example:
We have a census in this country every ten years.  我们在这个国家每十年进行一次人口普查。
She was stopped in her car for a traffic census.  她被拦下来接受交通情况调查。

words.meaning: n.少女,处女,女仆
words.example:
In the beach resort, the apartments and villas have daily maid service.  海滩渡假胜地的公寓和别墅里每天都有女佣打扫。
In California many illegal immigrants work as maids, nannies and gardeners.  在加利福尼亚州，许多非法移民当女佣、保姆和园丁。noun countable

words.meaning: v./n.小声说(话);小声抱怨,咕哝
words.example:
He was murmuring to him self.  他正喃喃自语。
humorous He murmured sweet nothings (= romantic talk) in her ear.  他在她耳边低声说着情话。UK verb
They were murmuring about the boss's nephew getting the job.  他们私下嘀咕着老板的侄子得到了那份工作的事。UK noun

words.meaning: n.马戏团,杂技团;马戏场,杂技场
words.example:
She ran away to join the circus.  她离家出走参加了马戏团。
The horses trotted into the circus ring (= the large circle, with seats all round, in which a circus performs).  马小跑着进入圆形马戏场。
The children loved being taken to the circus.  孩子喜欢大人带他们去看马戏表演。

words.meaning: n.标准尺寸;规格;量规,量表 v.测量
words.example:
Use a thermometer to gauge the temperature.  用温度计测量一下温度。
The fact that the play has transferred to New York is a gauge of its success.  该剧转往纽约演出，从这一点就可以判定它是很成功的。

words.meaning: vt.居住于,存在于;栖息于
words.example: These remote islands are inhabited only by birds.  这些偏僻的岛屿上只有鸟类栖息。

words.meaning: n.(生产、进出口等的)配额,(移民的)限额
words.example:
The country now has a quota on immigration.  该国目前对外来移民人数有限额。
figurative The class contains the usual quota (= number) of troublemakers.  班上也有那些捣乱的人。

words.meaning: n./vt.摘录;引用
words.example: An excerpt from her new thriller will appear in this weekend's magazine.  本周末出版的杂志将刊登她的最新惊悚小说的片段。

words.meaning: vi.大踏步走;跨越 n.一大步(pl.)长足进步
words.example:
The West made impressive strides in improving energy efficiency after the huge rises in oil prices during the seventies.  20世纪70年代石油价格大幅上涨之后，西方国家在提高能源使用效率方面有了显著进步。
The group has made strides to expand internationally.  这个集团在拓展国际市场方面获得很大的进展。noun
She attributes her record-breaking speed to the length of her stride.  她认为她的速度之所以能打破纪录是因为步幅大。noun

words.meaning: n./a.版权(的)
words.example:
Who owns/holds the copyright on this article?  谁拥有这篇文章的著作权？
His work is no longer protected by copyright.  他的作品不再受版权保护。
The symbol © shows that something is protected by copyright.  ©这个标志表示受版权保护。

words.meaning: n.缩小的模型,缩图 a.微型的,缩小的
words.example: He's made a model of our village, with all the buildings and roads in miniature.  他做了个我们村庄的模型，里面有所有建筑物和道路的缩微景观。

words.meaning: a.熟的,成熟的;(for)时机成熟的
words.example:
Those bananas aren't ripe yet - they're still green.  那些香蕉还没有成熟——还是绿的。adjective
This brie smells good and ripe.  这种法国布里起司味道醇正而浓郁。adjective
There was a ripe smell from his socks.  他的袜子发出一股刺鼻的味道。adjective

words.meaning: n.标语,口号
words.example: an advertising slogan  广告口号

words.meaning: vt.给予(欢迎、称颂等) vi.&n.符合,一致
words.example:
On 31 May the two leaders signed a peace accord.  5月31日两位领导人签署了一项和平协议。
Before 1987, the accord between the Labour government and the unions was a simple affair.  1987年以前，工党政府和工会之间很容易达成一致。
The project is completely in accord with government policy.  该企划案完全符合政府政策。

words.meaning: n.宝石,宝石饰物
words.example:
She was wearing a large gold necklace set with jewels.  她戴着一条很粗的镶有宝石的黄金项炼
Many visitors consider the Sistine Chapel to be the jewel of the Vatican.  许多游客认为西斯廷教堂是梵蒂冈的瑰宝。noun countable

words.meaning: n./v.攫取,抢夺
words.example:
He snatched the photos out of my hand before I had a chance to look at them.  我还没来得及看，他就一把抢走了我手里的照片。
figurative Running the best race of his career, Fletcher snatched (= only just won) the gold medal from the Canadian champion.  弗莱彻跑出了他职业生涯中的最好成绩，从加拿大冠军手中夺走了金牌。
The six-year-old girl was snatched from a playground and her body was found two days later.  那名六岁的女孩在游乐场被绑架了，两天后就有人发现她的尸体。

words.meaning: n.痛苦,悲惨,不幸
words.example:
We have witnessed the most appalling scenes of human misery.  我们目睹了最令人震惊的人间苦难。
Ten years of marriage to him have made her life a misery.  和他的十年婚姻使她的生活非常痛苦。UK noun
Oh come on, don't be such a misery!  好了，别做牢骚大王了！

words.meaning: n.钟(表)面,刻度盘,拨号盘 v.拨号,打电话
words.example:
Can I dial this number direct , or do I have to go through the operator?  我可以直接拨这个号码还是需要透过话务员接转？
Dial 0 for the switchboard.  总机拨0。noun countable
Can you read what it says on the dial?  你能读出仪表盘上的读数吗？

words.meaning: n.林荫路,大街;(比喻)途径,渠道,方法
words.example:
We should explore/pursue every avenue in the search for an answer to this problem.  我们应该尝试一切途径寻求该问题的答案。
Only two avenues are open to us - either we accept his offer or we give up the fight completely.  我们只有两条路可走——要么接受他的提议，要么完全放弃斗争。

words.meaning: v.使沉溺;使上瘾 n.沉溺于不良嗜好的人
words.example: humorous I'm a chocolate/shopping addict.  我是个吃巧克力成瘾的人／购物狂。

words.meaning: a.记在页边的,旁注的;(意识)边缘的
words.example:
The report suggests that there has only been a marginal improvement in women's pay over the past few years.  报告显示，过去几年间女性的工资只有轻微增长。
The marginal Tory constituency was held by 2200 votes in 1992.  1992年，保守党以2200票获得这个边缘选区。UK noun countable UK
Labour lost two of the key marginals in London.  工党失去了伦敦两个关键性的边缘选区。

words.meaning: n.(有柄的)大茶杯
words.example:
He's such a mug, he believes everything she tells him.  他真傻，无论她说甚么他都相信。noun countable
Teaching's a mug's game.  当老师是件吃力不讨好的事。verb transitive (-gg-)
He was mugged in broad daylight.  他在光天化日之下遭到抢劫。verb transitive (-gg-)

words.meaning: n.绰号,浑名vt.给…起绰号
words.example:
We always use the nickname Beth for our daughter Elizabeth.  我们总是把女儿伊利莎白匿称为“贝丝”。
"Darwin" was the nickname he was given at high school, because of his interest in science.  他上高中的时候外号叫“达尔文”，因为他对科学很感兴趣。

words.meaning: ad.(用于否定句中以加强语气)任何
words.example:
He has no respect for authority whatsoever.  他对权威一点也不尊重。
There is no evidence whatever to show that this is in fact the case.  根本就没有任何证据显示这就是实际情况。

words.meaning: v.下雹;欢呼,欢迎 n.雹
words.example:
The Prime Minister was greeted with a hail of insults as she arrived at the students' union.  女首相来到学生会时遭到一阵辱骂。verb
Shall we hail a taxi?  我们要叫计程车吗？
She's being hailed as one of the best up-and-coming young dancers today.  她被誉为当今最有前途的年轻舞蹈家之一。

words.meaning: n.(一件)衣服
words.example: The factory exports garments.  这家工厂出口服装。

words.meaning: a.室内的,户内的
words.example: indoor sports/activities  室内运动／活动

words.meaning: v.通知,告知,报告
words.example:
The school is required to notify parents if their children fail to come to school.  如果孩子没来上学，学校必须通知其家长。
Has everyone been notified of the decision?  这决定已经通知每一个人了吗？

words.meaning: vt.启动,激活;驱动,驱使;使开始起作用
words.example: The alarm is activated by the lightest pressure.  最轻微的压力也会触动警报器。

words.meaning: v.尽(力),施加(压力等),努力
words.example:
If you were to exert your influence they might change their decision.  如果你可以施加你的影响，他们或者会改变决定。
Some managers exert considerable pressure on their staff to work extra hours without being paid.  一些老板向员工施加巨大的压力迫使他们无薪加班。UK verb

words.meaning: a.天真的
words.example:
She was very naive to believe that he'd stay with her.  她居然天真地相信他会和她在一起。
They make the naive assumption that because it's popular it must be good.  他们幼稚地认为，流行的就一定是好的。
It was a little naive of you to think that they would listen to your suggestions.  你以为他们会听从你的建议，你真是有点天真。

words.meaning: n.幼儿园
words.example: The kindergarten opens at eight.  幼儿园八点开门。

words.meaning: n.加工而成的谷类食物;谷类植物,谷物
words.example: cereal crops  谷类作物

words.meaning: n.被子
words.example: Grandma made the quilt by hand.  奶奶手工做了这床被子。

words.meaning: a.明智的,达理的;可觉察的,明显的
words.example:
It would be sensible to take an umbrella.  带把伞是明智的。
It could be cold and wet so pack some sensible clothes.  天可能会又冷又湿，因此带些合适的衣服。adjective
He did not appear to be sensible of the difficulties that lay ahead.  他看起来并没有意识到前面的困难。

words.meaning: n.翻倒(物);人员调整;(资金等)周转;营业额
words.example:
Large supermarkets have high turnovers (= their goods sell very quickly).  大型超市的货品销售量很大。
The business has an annual turnover of £50 000.  这家公司的年营业额达5万英镑。UK noun
The large number of temporary contracts resulted in a high turnover of staff.  临时合约多，人员变更率就很高。

words.meaning: n.裂缝(痕);骨折 v.(使)断裂,(使)折断
words.example:
She fractured her skull in the accident.  她在事故中颅骨骨折。
Two of her ribs fractured when she was thrown from her horse.  她从马上摔下来，折断了两根肋骨。
Intense disagreement over economic policy risks fracturing the coalition government.  经济政策上的严重分歧使联合政府面临解体的危险。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.金字塔
words.example:
The acrobats formed a pyramid by standing on each other's shoulders.  杂技演员一个站上另一个的肩膀上表演叠罗汉。
figurative Many organizations have a pyramid structure (= there are fewer people at the top levels of them than there are at the bottom).  许多团体呈现金字塔式的组织结构。

words.meaning: n.单身汉;(亦作B-)学士(学位)
words.example:
He remained a bachelor until he was well into his 40s.  他直到四十多岁时还是单身。
Simon is a confirmed bachelor (= He is unlikely ever to want to get married).  西蒙是个信守独身主义的人。

words.meaning: a.谦卑的,恭顺的;地位低下的 v.降低,贬低
words.example:
He's very humble about his success.  他对自己的成功十分谦虚。
formal Please accept our humble apologies for the error.  出现这样的差错，请接受我们真诚的道歉。
In my humble opinion (= I want to emphasize that I think that) we should never have bought the car in the first place.  依愚见，首先我们就不应该买这辆汽车。

words.meaning: a.操作的,运转的,起作用的,经营的
words.example:
There are operational advantages in putting sales and admin in the same building.  将销售部门和行政部门设在同一幢大楼，有利经营。
Repairs have already begun and we expect the factory to be fully operational again with six months.  维修工作已经开始，我们预计这家工厂在六个月后会再次全面运作起来。

words.meaning: n.子孙,后代
words.example:
He has no descendants.  他没有后代。
They claim to be descendants of a French duke.  他们自称是一位法国公爵的后代。
We owe it to our descendants (= people younger than us who will live after we have died) to leave them a clean world to live in.  给子孙后代留下一个清洁的生活环境是我们的职责。    Compare ancestor

words.meaning: n.围巾,头巾,领巾,领带
words.example: a knitted/woollen/silk scarf  针织／羊毛／丝绸围巾UK verb transitive    US for

words.meaning: n.团,块 v.(使)成团,(使)成块
words.example:
You don't want lumps in the sauce.  谁都不希望调料汁中出现结块。
I'll be getting the insurance money in two lumps.  我将获得的保险金有两大部分。noun countable
She found a lump in her breast.  她在胸部发现了一个肿块。noun countable

words.meaning: n.哺乳动物
words.example: Humans, dogs, elephants and dolphins are all mammals, but birds, fish and crocodiles are not.  人、狗、大象和海豚都是哺乳动物，而鸟、鱼和鳄鱼则不是。

words.meaning: v./n.碰撞 n.碰撞声
words.example:
Students clashed with police after demonstrations at five universities.  学生在五所大学示威之后与员警发生了冲突。
The government and the opposition parties have clashed over the cuts in defence spending.  政府与反对党派在削减国防开支的问题上发生了激烈的争执。
This latest statement from the White House clashes with important aspects of US foreign policy.  白宫的最新声明与美国外交政策的重要方面相抵触。verb

words.meaning: v.模仿,仿效;仿造,伪造
words.example:
Some of the younger pop bands try to imitate their musical heroes from the past.  一些较年轻的流行乐队极力模仿心目中昔日的音乐巨星。
They produce artificial chemicals which exactly imitate particular natural ones.  他们生产酷似某些天然物质的人造化学品。

words.meaning: v.(by)乘,使相乘;倍增,增加,繁殖
words.example:
In warm weather these germs multiply rapidly.  在温暖的天气里这些细菌会迅速繁殖。
If you multiply seven by 15 you get 105.  用15乘以7，结果是105。    Compare add ; divide ; subtract

words.meaning: v./n.咳嗽
words.example:
The smoke made me cough.  烟呛得我直咳嗽。
The car engine coughed a few times, but wouldn't start.  汽车引擎吭哧吭哧响了几声，但没发动起来。UK verb intransitive
Doctors were worried when she started to cough up blood.  她开始咳血了，医生有些担心了。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.臭名昭著的,声名狼藉的
words.example: The company is notorious for paying its bills late.  该公司出了名地喜欢拖欠帐单。

words.meaning: n.立体声音响;立体声装置 n./a.立体声(的)
words.example: The concert will be broadcast in stereo.  音乐会将用立体声播放。

words.meaning: vt.使承担;需要;把(疾病等)遗传给;限定
words.example: Such a large investment inevitably entails some risk.  这样的钜额投资必然会有一定的风险。

words.meaning: n.烤面包,吐司;祝酒(词)v.烘,烤;(向…)祝酒
words.example:
I'm having beans on toast for supper.  晚饭我吃烤面包片加豆子。UK noun
Now, if you'd all please raise your glasses, I'd like to propose a toast to the bride and groom.  现在请大家都举起杯来，我提议为新娘新郎干杯。
Champagne corks popped as the guests drank a toast to the happy couple.  香槟酒瓶砰地打开了，客人举杯为这对幸福的伉俪干杯。UK noun

words.meaning: v./n.(endeavour)努力,尽力,力图
words.example: Space travel is a great human endeavor.  太空旅行是人类的伟大事业。

words.meaning: n.凭证,(pl.)国书,证明书
words.example:
All the candidates had excellent academic credentials.  所有候选人都具有优秀的学历证书。
She was asked to show her press credentials.  她被要求出示记者证。

words.meaning: n.火腿
words.example:
They had some dreadful old ham in the main part.  他们起用了一些极为蹩脚的老演员担纲主角。
He's a radio ham.  他是个业余无线电台技术员。verb (-mm-)

words.meaning: n.盆,脸盆;内海,盆地
words.example: I've cleaned the basin and scrubbed the bath.  我已经清洗了脸盆，还刷了浴缸。noun countable

words.meaning: v.(用力地)扔,抛,丢
words.example:
He crumpled up the letter and flung it into the fire.  他把信揉成一团，猛地扔进火中。
"And you can take your ring back too!" she cried, flinging it down on the table.  “你还可以把你的戒指也拿走！”她喊道，猛地把戒指摔到桌子上。
informal Could you fling the paper over here (= give me the paper) ?  你能把报纸丢过来吗？verb (flung, flung)

words.meaning: v./n.泡沫,起泡沫
words.example: The Almeida theatre's recent staging of the opera had critics foaming at the mouth.  阿尔梅达剧院最近上演的歌剧招致评论家大加贬斥。

words.meaning: a.英雄的,英勇的,崇高的
words.example: Despite Roz's heroic efforts to liven it up, the party was a disaster.  尽管罗兹费了很大力气来活跃气氛，这次派对还是很糟。

words.meaning: n.继承人
words.example:
The guest of honour was the Romanoff heir to the throne of all Russia.  这位贵宾是统治全俄罗斯的罗曼诺夫王朝的王位继承人。
Despite having a large family, they still had no son and heir.  尽管家庭成员众多，他们仍然没有儿子作为继承人。
The French finance minister is heir to a tradition of central control that goes back to Louis XIV's minister, Colbert.  法国的财政部长承袭了中央集权财政管理方式的传统，该传统可以追溯到路易十四时代的财政部长柯尔贝尔。

words.meaning: n.坟,冢
words.example: The pharaoh's tomb was filled with gold.  法老的墓里装满了黄金。

words.meaning: n.分支,补偿 v.抵消,补偿
words.example:
The extra cost of travelling to work is offset by the lower price of houses here.  这里低廉的房价抵消了因上班路途远而产生的额外费用。
We offset all our long-haul flights.  我们就所有长途运输机的排放所带来的损害都作出补偿。

words.meaning: a.秃的,秃头的
words.example:
At twenty he was already going bald.  他20岁就开始秃头了。
When he took off his hat, we saw that he was as bald as a coot!  他脱帽后，我们发现他的头全秃了！UK adjective
There was just this bald statement of resignation - no explanation or anything.  只有简单的辞职声明——没有解释之类的东西。

words.meaning: a.正直的;简单的,易懂的 ad.坦率地
words.example:
Just follow the signs to Bradford - it's very straightforward.  顺着路标走就到布拉德福德了——非常简单。UK adjective
Roz is straightforward and let's you know what she's thinking.  罗兹很坦诚，会告诉你她的想法。

words.meaning: vt.保险,给…保险;保证
words.example:
The house is insured for two million pounds.  该房子投保了200万英镑。
All our household goods are insured against accidental damage.  我们家里所有的物品都保了意外损失险。
They refused to insure us because they said we're too old.  他们拒绝为我们提供保险，因为他们认为我们年纪太大了。

words.meaning: n.接合部位,分界面 v.(使)互相联系
words.example:
My computer has a network interface, which allows me to get to other computers.  我的电脑有网路介面，可以与其他电脑连在一起。
The new version of the program comes with a much better user interface (= way of showing information to a user) than the original.  新版程式的使用者介面比原来的好得多。
We need a clearer interface between management and the workforce.  我们希望管理层与员工之间的沟通更加顺畅。UK verb

words.meaning: n.罗马教皇,主教,大腿上要害部位
words.example: Pope John Paul II  教皇约翰•保罗二世

words.meaning: a.脆的,易碎的;简明扼要的;(空气)清爽的
words.example: Now that we have cable, we get a wonderfully crisp picture, even on our old TV.  有了有线电视，即便是用我们那台老电视机收看，图像也十分清晰。

words.meaning: n.香肠,腊肠
words.example: fried/grilled pork sausages  煎／烤猪肉香肠

words.meaning: a.壮丽的,辉煌的;光荣的
words.example:
The beetroot had turned the soup a glorious pink.  甜菜使汤呈现出极为诱人夺目的粉红色。
Your roses are glorious!  你的玫瑰太漂亮了！
They had glorious weather for their wedding.  他们举行婚礼的那天天气好极了。

words.meaning: n.倾覆,破灭,革命 v.打翻,推翻,颠倒,翻倒
words.example:
The car skidded off the road, hit a tree and overturned.  汽车滑出道路，撞到树上后翻了。
The burglars had overturned all the furniture in the house.  入屋爆窃的贼人翻了屋子里所有家俱。UK verb
The Court of Appeal overturned the earlier decision.  上诉法庭推翻了早前作出的裁决。

words.meaning: a.紧密的,结实的;简明的 v.使紧凑,压缩
words.example:
What a compact office! How did you fit so much into so little space?  多么小巧的办公室！你们是如何把这么多东西塞进这么小的空间的？noun countable UK CASE  盒子
Cars had compacted the snow until it was like ice.  汽车把雪碾得越来越结实，直到变得像冰一样。

words.meaning: vt.剥夺,夺去,使丧失
words.example:
He claimed that he had been deprived of his freedom/rights.  他声称本身自由／权利被剥夺。
You can't function properly when you're deprived of sleep.  如果被剥夺了睡眠，人体就无法正常运作。verb transitive
Where have you been? We've been deprived of your company for far too long!  你到哪里去了？这么长时间都没见到你！

words.meaning: a.可怕的,吓人的;害怕,担心,惊恐
words.example:
He hesitated before ringing her, fearful of what she might say.  给她打电话之前他犹豫不决，害怕她会说甚么。
She's fearful (that) she may lose custody of her children.  她担心自己会失去对几个子女的监护权。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.熟虑;(尤指宗教的)默想,沉思;(pl.)冥想录
words.example:
She practises meditation.  她时常静坐冥想。
Let us spend a few moments in quiet meditation.  让我们花片刻时间静静思考一下。
The book is a meditation on the morality of art.  这本书探讨了艺术道德。

words.meaning: v./n.战栗,发抖
words.example:
The poor dog - it's shivering!  可怜的狗——它在发抖！
He shivered with cold in his thin cotton shirt.  他只穿着薄薄的棉布衬衫，冻得瑟缩发抖。UK noun countable
She's aching and she's got the shivers, so I've sent her to bed.  她浑身疼痛，直打寒颤，所以我叫她躺到床上去了。

words.meaning: n./v.繁荣,茂盛,兴旺
words.example:
My tomatoes are flourishing this summer - it must be the warm weather.  今年夏天我的番茄长势很好——这一定是天气暖和的原因。
Watercolour painting began to flourish in Britain around 1750.  1750年左右，水彩画开始在英国兴盛起来。UK verb
She came in smiling, flourishing her exam results.  她微笑着走进来，手里挥舞着她的考试成绩单。UK noun

words.meaning: v./n.卸货,排出;发射,放(电);遣散,解雇
words.example:
Patients were discharged from hospital because the beds were needed by other people.  由于其他人需要床位，患者们便被允许出院了。
More than half of all prisoners discharged (= allowed to leave prison) are reconvicted within two years.  在获释的犯人中有一半多在两年内又被再次判刑。verb UK SEND OUT  发出
Large amounts of dangerous waste are discharged daily by the factory.  这个工厂每天排放大量危险的废物。

words.meaning: n.大陆,本土
words.example: The island is close to the mainland.  这座岛离大陆很近。

words.meaning: n.立场,观点
words.example: From an economic standpoint, it makes sense.  从经济角度看这说得通。

words.meaning: v.用力拖(或拉);苦干 n.拖;苦干;拖船
words.example:
Tom tugged at his mother's arm.  汤姆拽着妈妈的胳膊。noun countable
Feeling a tug at his sleeve, he turned to see Joe beside him.  他感觉到有人拉他的袖子，一转身，看到乔在他身边。

words.meaning: n.团结;休戚相关
words.example:
The situation raises important questions about solidarity among member states of the UN.  当前形势引发了联合国成员国能否团结一致的质疑。
The lecturers joined the protest march to show solidarity with their students.  演讲者加入抗议队伍，以示他们与学生们团结一致。

words.meaning: n.发生,出现;事件,事故,发生的事情
words.example:
Street-fights are an everyday occurrence in this area of the city.  在该市的这一地区，街头斗殴每天都会发生。UK noun
The study compares the occurrence of heart disease in various countries.  该项研究比较了不同国家心脏病的发病率。

words.meaning: n.鞍,马鞍,鞍状物
words.example:
He swung himself into the saddle and rode off.  他跨上马鞍，骑马走了。
The chairman is back in the saddle after his heart attack.  心脏病愈之后，主席又重新掌权了。noun
She saddled (up) the horse for her friend.  她为朋友备好了马鞍。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.倾向于,俯伏的,倾斜的,陡的
words.example:
I've always been prone to headaches.  我总是容易头痛。
He was prone to depressions even as a teenager.  甚至在青少年时期他就容易情绪抑郁。
She's prone to exaggerate, that's for sure.  她喜欢夸大其词，这一点是肯定的。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.水龙带,软管 v.用软管(淋浇,冲洗)
words.example:
The severe drought has led to a hosepipe ban in eastern England.  严重的干旱导致英格兰东部禁用水龙带。UK noun
He was covered in mud so we hosed him down.  他满身是泥，所以我们用软管接水给他冲洗干净。

words.meaning: a.大量(充足)的;(in)丰富(富裕)的
words.example:
There is abundant evidence that cars have a harmful effect on the environment.  有充分证据显示，汽车对环境有害。
Cheap consumer goods are abundant (= exist in large amounts) in this part of the world.  在这个地区，大量的低廉消费品充斥其间。

words.meaning: n.铁锤,槌,榔头 v.锤击,敲打
words.example:
Can you hold this nail in position while I hammer it into the door?  你能托住这颗钉子，好让我把它钉进门里吗？
My car's got a dent, and I was hoping they'd be able to hammer it out (= remove it by hammering).  我的车上有一处凹痕，我希望他们能把它敲平。UK verb
He hammered the ball into the net, giving France a 3-2 win over Italy.  他将球劲射入网，使法国队以3比2战胜了义大利队。UK verb

words.meaning: a.强大的;令人敬畏的;可怕的;艰难的
words.example: a formidable obstacle/task  令人生畏的障碍／任务

words.meaning: n.小包裹,小捆;盒;一捆,一扎;邮船,班轮
words.example:
How many seeds are there in a packet?  一袋里有多少颗种子？    Compare parcelnoun countable
That house must have cost a packet!  那幢房子一定花了一大笔钱！
Someone's making a packet out of this business.  有人做这门生意发了大财。

words.meaning: v.(mobilise)动员,赋予可动性
words.example:
Representatives for all the main candidates are trying to mobilize voter support.  所有主要候选人的代表正在努力鼓动选民给予支持。
The government has mobilized several of the army's top combat units.  政府已调动了若干陆军精锐作战部队。
Troops have been mobilising for the past three weeks.  过去三个星期里，部队一直在备战。

words.meaning: a.懒惰的,懒散的
words.example:
Managers had complained that the workers were lazy and unreliable.  经理们抱怨工人们懒惰而且不可靠。
Get out of bed you lazy thing!  起床了，懒蛋！
He's too lazy to walk to work.  他很懒，不愿走路上班。

words.meaning: n.护照,达到某种目的的手段
words.example:
Many refugees have arrived at the border without passports.  许多难民到达边境时身上没有护照。
He was a German, travelling on a Swiss passport.  他是个德国人，持瑞士护照旅行。
Many students opt for business studies simply because it sounds like a passport to a good job.  许多学生选择学商，只因它似乎是找到好工作的一种手段。

words.meaning: a.婚姻的,夫妻之间的
words.example:
They've been having marital problems , apparently.  显然他们的婚姻一直有问题。
humorous You can't expect to live in a state of marital bliss.  你别指望婚姻会一直美满。

words.meaning: a.(of)喜爱的,爱好的
words.example:
She was very fond of horses.  她非常喜欢马。
"I'm very fond of you, you know," he said.  他说：“你知道吗，我很喜欢你。”
My brother is fond of pointing out my mistakes.  我哥哥喜欢给我挑错。

words.meaning: n.过剩,剩余;余款,余额 a.过剩的,剩余的
words.example:
The world is now producing large food surpluses.  世界上目前生产的食品大大过剩。
We are unlikely to produce any surplus this year.  我们今年不太可能有任何盈余。
The government has authorized the army to sell its surplus weapons.  政府已经授权军队出售多余的武器。

words.meaning: n.周围的事物,环境
words.example:
Some butterflies blend in with their surroundings so that it's difficult to see them.  有些蝴蝶能和周围的环境融为一体，所以很难看见它们。
They live in very comfortable/pleasant/drab/bleak surroundings.  他们生活的环境很舒适／惬意／单调／荒凉。plural noun

words.meaning: n.楔,楔形 vt.楔牢,楔入,挤进
words.example:
Push a wedge under the door to keep it open while we're carrying the boxes in.  在门底下塞一个楔子让门敞开着，我们好往里面搬箱子。
Pieces of stone can be split off by forcing wedges between the layers.  在层与层之间入楔子可以把一块块石头凿开。
Auntie Ann put a huge wedge of fruit cake on my plate.  安姨妈把一大块三角形的水果蛋糕放在我盘子里。

words.meaning: n.鹰
words.example: An eagle nested on the cliff.  一只鹰在崖上筑了巢。

words.meaning: n.动乱,骚乱,干扰
words.example:
Residents are fed up with the disturbance caused by the nightclub.  居民受够了夜总会造成的干扰。
Phone calls are the biggest disturbance at work.  接听电话是工作中最大的干扰。
There was a minor disturbance (= violent event in public) during the demonstration, but nobody was injured.  示威活动中发生了一件轻微的骚乱事件，但没有人受伤。

words.meaning: n.时态 v.拉紧,(使)紧张 a.绷紧的,紧张的
words.example:
She was very tense as she waited for the interview.  她等待面试时非常紧张。
There were some tense moments in the second half of the game.  比赛下半场有几次紧张的局面。adjective
Don't tense your shoulders, just relax.  别缩紧肩膀，放松点。

words.meaning: n.空闲,闲暇;悠闲,安逸
words.example:
Most people only have a limited amount of leisure time.  大多数人只有有限的空闲时间。
The town lacks leisure facilities such as a swimming pool or squash courts.  这个城镇缺少游泳池、壁球场等休闲设施。UK noun uncountable
You can take the documents home and study them at (your) leisure.  你可以把这些档带回家，有空时再好好看一看。

words.meaning: vt.发出;放射;吐露;散发;发表;发行
words.example:
The alarm emits infra-red rays which are used to detect any intruder.  警报器能发出红外线探测入侵者。
The machine emits a high-pitched sound when you press the button.  一按这个按钮，机器就会发出尖厉的鸣叫声。

words.meaning: n.原型;典型,范例
words.example: a prototype for/of a new car  新型轿车的原型

words.meaning: n.认识,相识,了解;相识的人,熟人
words.example:
It was at the Taylors' party that I first made his acquaintance (= first met him).  我是在泰勒家的聚会上初次和他相识的。
Sadly, my acquaintance with Spanish literature is rather limited.  可惜，我对西班牙文学所知相当有限。noun
I'm afraid I have only a nodding acquaintance with his works.  恐怕我对他作品的了解只是皮毛而已。

words.meaning: a.比较的,相当的
words.example:
'Fatter' is the comparative of 'fat'.  fatter 是 fat 的比较级。
'More difficult' is the comparative of 'difficult'.  more difficult 是 difficult 的比较级。UK adjective
She's carrying out a comparative study of health in inner cities and rural areas.  她正在对市中心区和乡村地区的健康问题进行比较研究。

words.meaning: n.磁体,磁铁
words.example: The United States has always acted as a magnet for people seeking fame and fortune.  美国一直像磁石般吸引着追名逐利的人。

words.meaning: n.轻视,藐视;受辱,丢脸
words.example:
At school she had complete contempt for all her teachers.  在学校读书时她对所有老师都不屑一顾。
You should treat those remarks with the contempt that they deserve.  你理应对那些话不屑一顾。
She's beneath contempt (= I have no respect for her) !  她为人所不齿！

words.meaning: n.组件,模块,模件;(航天器的)舱
words.example:
The emergency building is transported in individual modules, such as bedrooms and a kitchen, which are put together on site.  急难住所将各模组，如卧室和厨房，分别运送至现场再当场组装。
The full computer program is made up of several modules (= small programs) which should be individually tested before being integrated.  电脑的整个程式由几个模组组成，在整合之前须分别进行独立测试。

words.meaning: a.充分的,富裕的;宽敞的,宽大的
words.example:
You'll have ample opportunity to ask questions after the talk.  演讲结束后你们会有足够的时间提问。
There's ample evidence that the lawyer knew exactly what she was doing.  有充分的证据显示，该律师十分清楚她自己在做甚么。
They had ample warning of the factory closure.  对于工厂的倒闭，他们早就得到了大量警告。adjective

words.meaning: n.动物园
words.example: The zoo breeds rare animals.  动物园繁殖稀有动物。

words.meaning: n.长条,条纹;军服上表示军阶的臂章条纹
words.example:
The zebra is a wild African horse with black and white stripes.  斑马是一种身体上有黑白条纹的非洲野马。noun countable
By the age of 25 he'd already got his third stripe and become a sergeant.  25岁时，他为自己的军服添上了第三道军阶条，成为一名中士。noun countable
Governments of every stripe (= of all political opinions) have a bad habit of interfering in state broadcasting.  持各种政治主张的政府都有干涉公营广播电台的坏习惯。

words.meaning: a.最先的;最初的; 主要的 ad.首要地
words.example:
This is one of the country's foremost arts centres.  这是全国最重要的艺术中心之一。
She's one of the foremost experts on child psychology.  她是儿童心理学领域最顶尖的专家之一。

words.meaning: v.呼喊,惊叫,大声说
words.example:
"Rubbish!" he exclaimed in disgust.  “废话！”他充满厌恶地大声说。
She exclaimed in delight upon hearing the news.  她听到这个消息高兴得大叫。

words.meaning: n.牙医
words.example:
You should have your teeth checked by a dentist at least twice a year.  你每年至少应该请牙科医生检查两次牙齿。
I've got to go to the dentist's on Friday.  周五我要去看牙。

words.meaning: a.逆的,相反的;敌对的;不利的;有害的
words.example:
The match has been cancelled due to adverse weather conditions.  由于天气恶劣，这场比赛已被取消。
They received a lot of adverse publicity/criticism about the changes.  这些变化为他们招致种种负面报导／非议。
So far the drug is thought not to have any adverse effects.  迄今为止，人们一直认为这种药物没有任何副作用。

words.meaning: n.悲衰,悲痛
words.example: For years she sorrowed over her missing son.  多年来，她一直为走失的儿子悲伤难过。

words.meaning: v.夸大,夸张
words.example:
The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.  遭受袭击的威胁被过分夸大了。
Don't exaggerate - it wasn't that expensive.  不要言过其实——没有那么贵。
I'm not exaggerating - it was the worst meal I've ever eaten in my life.  我不是在夸大其词——那是我这辈子吃过最难吃的饭。

words.meaning: a.决定性的
words.example:
You need to be more decisive.  你要更果断一些。
These results could prove decisive in establishing the criminal's identity.  这些结果对确定罪犯的身份将具有决定性的作用。

words.meaning: n.拱门,桥拱洞 v.拱起,(使)变成弓形
words.example:
In many churches the side aisles are separated from the central aisle by a row of arches.  很多教堂中，侧廊与主廊之间都有一排拱门相隔。
Passing through the arch, you enter an open courtyard.  穿过拱门，你就到了天井中。
She's got very high arches.  她足弓很高。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.火山
words.example: Erupting volcanoes discharge massive quantities of dust into the stratosphere.  火山喷发导致大量灰尘进入大气平流层。

words.meaning: n.问候,致敬
words.example:
They briskly exchanged greetings before starting the session.  他们开会前简短地互相致意。
He nodded his head in greeting.  他点头致意。
formal My father sends his greetings.  我父亲向你们问好。

words.meaning: a.(of)妒忌的;猜疑的,警惕的
words.example:
He had always been very jealous of his brother's good looks.  他总是很妒忌他哥哥帅气的长相。
Anna says she feels jealous every time another woman looks at her boyfriend.  安娜说每当别的女人看她的男朋友她都会感到妒忌。    Compare enviousadjective
She is very jealous of her independence, and doesn't want to get married.  她很珍惜自己的自由，不想结婚。

words.meaning: n.牧草地,牧场
words.example:
The sheep were grazing on the lush green pastures.  羊群正在郁郁葱葱的牧场上吃草。
Some fields are planted with crops for several years, and then returned to pasture for the cattle.  有些田地种了几年作物后又退耕还牧用来养牛了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Many scientists working for the government have left for greener pastures in the private sector.  许多原先为政府工作的科学家现在都到私人单位另谋高就了。

words.meaning: n.沼泽;湿地 vt.浸没;使…应接不暇
words.example:
The Everglades are an area of swamp in southern Florida.  佛罗里达大湿地是佛罗里达州南部的一片沼泽地区。UK verb
High tides have swamped the coast.  高涨的潮水淹没了海岸。
The boat was swamped by an enormous wave.  小船被巨浪吞没了。UK verb

words.meaning: n.叛乱,反抗,起义
words.example: The government has brutally crushed the rebellion.  政府残酷镇压了叛乱。

words.meaning: v./n.冲,猛冲,突进 n.破折号
words.example:
I've been dashing around all day.  我一整天都在东奔西跑。
The tidal wave dashed the ship against the rocks.  潮汐把那艘船抛向岩石。
Waves dashed against the cliffs.  海浪拍击悬崖。verb

words.meaning: n.饵,引诱物 vt.用饵引诱;折磨,奚落
words.example:
They were digging up worms to use for bait.  他们在挖虫子制饵。
We put down some poisoned bait to kill the rats.  我们放了一些毒饵灭鼠。noun
Free holidays were offered as (a) bait to customers.  以免费渡假来吸引顾客。

words.meaning: a.疼痛的;痛心的 n.痛处,疮口
words.example:
All the dust has made my eyes sore.  灰尘使我的眼睛酸痛。
I've got a sore throat.  我喉咙痛。
My feet were sore with all the walking.  走了这么多的路，我的脚很痛。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.深思熟虑的,故意的 vt.研讨,商讨
words.example:
We made a deliberate decision to live apart for a while.  经过慎重考虑，我们决定分开居住一段时间。
From her slow, deliberate speech I guessed she must be drunk.  她说话慢吞吞的，我猜她肯定喝醉了。verb intransitive or transitive /dɪˈlɪb.ə.reɪt/    formal
The jury took five days to deliberate on the case.  陪审团花了五天时间对此案进行了慎重讨论。

words.meaning: v.树立,建立,使竖立 a.直立的,垂直的
words.example:
The war memorial was erected in 1950.  这座战争纪念碑建于1950年。
The soldiers had erected barricades to protect themselves.  士兵们筑起了街垒用以自卫。verb transitive formal
They erected a marquee to accommodate 500 wedding guests.  他们搭起了一个大帐篷以接待参加婚礼的500位客人。adjective

words.meaning: n.誓言,誓约,诅咒
words.example:
Medieval knights took an oath of allegiance/loyalty to their lord.  中世纪骑士宣誓效忠于君主。
The witness placed her hand on the Bible and took the oath (= promised to tell the truth).  证人将手放在《圣经》上，起誓要讲真话。
The judge reminded the witness that she was under oath.  法官提醒证人她宣过誓要据实作证。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.缺乏,不足;缺点,缺陷
words.example:
Pregnant women often suffer from iron deficiency.  孕妇常常缺铁。
Deficiencies in the education system have been much in the news.  新闻媒体对教育体制的种种不足进行了大量的报道。

words.meaning: n.侄子,外甥
words.example: My nephew is turning three.  我侄子快满三岁了。

words.meaning: vi.怒目而视;发射强光 n.强光;怒视;炫耀
words.example:
She gave me a fierce glare.  她狠狠瞪了我一眼。UK noun
Tinted windows will cut down the glare/the sun's glare.  有色玻璃窗会遮挡刺眼的阳光。
This screen gives off a lot of glare.  这种萤幕发出的光太刺眼。UK noun

words.meaning: n.模糊不清的事物;污点 vt.使模糊;玷污
words.example:
If I don't wear my glasses, everything is just a blur.  如果不戴眼镜，我看任何东西都是模糊的。
It all happened so long ago that it's just a blur to me now.  这件事发生在很久以前，我现在记不清了。
The last few days seem to have gone by in a blur.  过去几天似乎是在恍恍惚惚中度过的。UK verb intransitive or transitive (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.(fertiliser)肥料
words.example: organic fertilizer  有机肥料

words.meaning: a.幻想中的;虚构的;优雅的 n.仙女;精灵
words.example:
Do you believe in fairies?  你相信有小仙子吗？
She used to think there were fairies at the bottom of her garden.  她曾经以为她的花园深处有小精灵。
It's no good asking her to look after the children - she's away with the fairies most of the time.  她这人有点怪，让她照顾孩子不好。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.高度,海拔;[pl.]高处,高地
words.example:
We are currently flying at an altitude of 15 000 metres.  现在我们正在15 000米的高度上飞行。
Mountain climbers use oxygen when they reach higher altitudes.  到了海拔较高的地方，登山者就要使用氧气。

words.meaning: a.手边的,近便的;方便的
words.example:
First-time visitors to France will find this guide particularly handy.  初次来法国的游览者会发现这本旅游指南很有用。
It's a nice house and it's handy for (= near) the station.  这座房子很漂亮，离车站也很近。
informal Don't throw those bottles away - they'll come in handy (= be useful) for the picnic next Sunday.  别把那些瓶子扔掉——下周日出去野餐会派上用场。adjective

words.meaning: v.区分,区别;(使)不同
words.example:
We do not differentiate between our workers on the basis of their background or ethnic origin.  我们不会因工人的背景或种族不同而区别对待。verb
The slate roof differentiates this house from others in the area.  石板瓦屋顶使这座房子在该地区与众不同。

words.meaning: vi.协作,合作;(与敌人)勾结
words.example:
Two writers collaborated on the script for the film.  两位作家合写了这部电影的剧本。
The British and Italian police collaborated in catching the terrorists.  英国警方和义大利警方通力合作，抓住了恐怖分子。verb intransitive
Anyone who was suspected of collaborating with the occupying forces was arrested.  任何涉嫌与占领军勾结的人都被逮捕了。

words.meaning: n.连续,系列;继任,继承
words.example:
Life was just an endless succession of parties and dinners.  生活只不过是一连串没完没了的聚会和晚宴。
She had her first three children in rapid succession.  她的前三个孩子是连年紧接着出生的。
This is the seventh year in succession that they've won the cup.  这是他们连续第七年夺冠。

words.meaning: n.女侍者,女服务员
words.example: The waitress recommended the fish.  女服务员推荐了鱼。

words.meaning: n.剩余(物),零料,遗迹[风] a.剩余的,残留的
words.example: the remnants of last night's meal  昨晚的剩饭

words.meaning: n.水泥;胶泥,胶接剂 v.胶合;巩固,加强
words.example:
Dentists use cement to hold crowns and bridges in place.  牙医用黏固剂固定住齿冠和齿桥。verb transitive
The university's exchange scheme has cemented its links with many other academic institutions.  这所大学的交流计划加强了它与许多其他学术机构的联系。

words.meaning: v.背诵,朗诵
words.example:
She proudly recited the Oath of Allegiance.  她自豪地背诵《效忠誓言》。
The opposition party recited a long list of the government's failings.  反对党列举出政府一大堆失误之处。

words.meaning: n.(in)干涉,干预;(with)妨碍,打扰
words.example:
She seems to regard any advice or help from me as interference.  她似乎把我的任何建议或帮助都看作是干涉。
The government's interference in the strike has been widely criticized.  政府对罢工的干预措施受到了广泛的批评。

words.meaning: n.咸猪肉,熏猪肉
words.example: a bacon sandwich  培根三明治

words.meaning: v.损坏,搞错;宠坏,溺爱
words.example:
He tried not to let the bad news spoil his evening.  他努力不让那个坏消息破坏他晚上的兴致。
The oil spill has spoilt the whole beautiful coastline.  溢出的石油破坏了整段漂亮的海岸线。
You'll spoil your appetite for dinner if you have a cake now.  你要是现在吃蛋糕的话，就没胃口吃晚饭了。

words.meaning: vt.低估,看轻
words.example:
Originally the builders gave me a price of £2000, but now they say they underestimated and it's going to be at least £3000.  起初建筑商向我报价2000英镑，但现在他们说当初估价过低，至少要3000英镑。
One shouldn't underestimate the difficulties of getting all the political parties to the conference table.  要让各个党派都坐下来谈判，其难度不可小觑。    Opposite overestimate
Never underestimate your opponent!  永远不要低估你的对手！

words.meaning: a.强健的,雄壮的,精力充沛的,坚固的,浓的
words.example: He looks robust and healthy enough.  他看起来非常强壮健康。

words.meaning: n.(正式文件或法律文件的)条款;从句,分句
words.example:
They have added/deleted/amended a clause in the contract which says the company can make people redundant for economic reasons.  他们在合同中增加／删除／修改了一项条款，该条款称公司可以因为经济原因裁减人员。
Clause 4 of the constitution is thought to be the most important section.  宪法第四条被认为是最重要的部分。UK US  specialized
In the sentence 'I can't cook very well but I make quite good omelettes', both 'I can't cook very well' and 'I make quite good omelettes' are main/independent clauses (= they are of equal importance and could each exist as a separate sentence).  在 I can't cook very well but I make quite good omelettes（我菜烧得不太好，可是蛋饼煎得很不错）这句话中，I can't cook very well 和 I make quite good omelettes 都是主句／独立分句。

words.meaning: n.公报,公告,告示
words.example: The company publishes a fortnightly bulletin for its staff.  这家公司每两周为员工出一期简报。

words.meaning: n.心爱的人,亲爱的
words.example:
Oh darling, I do love you.  哦，亲爱的，我真的爱你。
Here's your change, darling.  亲爱的，这是找给你的零钱。
In spite of his unpopularity in the USSR, Gorbachev remained a/the darling of (= very popular with) the West right to the end.  尽管戈巴契夫在苏联并不受欢迎，但他自始至终都受到西方的大力追捧。UK adjective [before noun]    old-fashioned

words.meaning: n.生态学
words.example:
The oil spill caused terrible damage to the fragile ecology of the coast.  石油外泄给脆弱的海岸生态环境带来严重的破坏。
She hopes to study ecology at college.  她希望在大学里读生态学。

words.meaning: v.对…表示忿恨,怨恨
words.example: She bitterly resented her father's new wife.  她对她父亲新娶的妻子恨之入骨。

words.meaning: n.花(簇);花期;青春 vi.开花;展开;繁荣
words.example:
The cherry tree is beginning to blossom.  樱桃树开始开花了。
She has really blossomed recently.  她近来确实变得惹人喜爱了。
She is suddenly blossoming into a very attractive woman.  她突然出落成了一位很有魅力的女子。

words.meaning: n.脾气;韧度vt.调和,使缓和;使回火
words.example:
She has a real temper.  她很容易发脾气。
He's got a really bad temper.  他的脾气真坏。
The children behaved so badly that I lost my temper.  孩子们太不懂规矩，我不由得发了火。

words.meaning: n.附件,附属品;(为全套衣服增加美感的)服饰
words.example:
She wore a green wool suit with matching accessories (= shoes, hat, bag, etc.).  她身穿一套绿色羊毛套装，全身的配饰都是跟它配套的。
Sunglasses are much more than a fashion accessory.  太阳镜不仅仅是时尚的装饰品。
Accessories for the top-of-the-range car include leather upholstery, a CD player, electric windows and a sunroof.  顶级轿车的配置包括真皮座椅、CD播放机、电动窗以及活动车顶。UK noun

words.meaning: a.小(器、规模)的,不重要的,细微的,卑鄙的
words.example:
Prisoners complain that they are subjected to too many petty rules and restrictions.  犯人抱怨他们受到太多繁文缛节的管制。
Don't be so petty!  别这么小心眼！

words.meaning: n.宇宙飞船
words.example: a manned/unmanned spacecraft (= with/without people inside)  载人／无人驾驶的太空船

words.meaning: vt.残杀,集体屠杀 n.残杀,大屠杀
words.example:
He ordered the massacre of 2, 000 women and children.  他下令屠杀了2000名妇女和儿童。
The changes to the team come after their 7-2 massacre in the final.  决赛中以2比7惨败后，球队作了些调整。UK verb transitive
Hundreds of civilians were massacred in the raid.  数百平民在那次袭击中惨遭杀戮。

words.meaning: n.靴刺,马刺;刺激,刺激物 v.刺激,激励
words.example:
Rising consumer sales have the effect of spurring the economy to faster growth.  消费的成长有刺激经济加速发展的作用。
Spurred (on) by her early success, she went on to write four more novels in rapid succession.  受到之前成功的鼓励，她紧接着又连续写了四部小说。UK verb transitive (-rr-)
The manager said that the team's win on Saturday would be a spur to even greater effort this season.  主教练说球队周六的胜利将会激励全队在本赛季中有更好的表现。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.&v.(挖)沟,(挖)战壕
words.example: the trenches of World War I  第一次世界大战时的战壕

words.meaning: n.口哨,汽笛;口哨声,汽笛声 v.吹口哨;鸣笛
words.example:
He whistled as he worked.  他一边工作一边吹口哨。
On the days when she wore a skirt the men on the building site would whistle at her.  那些天她穿了裙子，建筑工地的男人们一见到她就向她吹口哨。
Someone was whistling Beatles tunes outside my window.  有人在我窗外用口哨吹着甲壳虫乐队的曲子。

words.meaning: n.天文学
words.example: Astronomy is the oldest science.  天文学是最古老的科学。

words.meaning: n.骨骼;骨架,框架;梗概,提要
words.example:
We found an old sheep skeleton up on the cliffs.  我们在悬崖上发现了一副老绵羊的骨架。
figurative Her long illness reduced her to a skeleton (= made her very thin).  长期的疾病使她瘦得只剩皮包骨了。
The skeleton of my book is written/My book is in skeleton form - now I just have to add the details.  我的书已经有了架构——现在我只需要添加细节了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.缝,缝纫
words.example:
I've got to sew up that hole in your jeans.  我得把你牛仔裤上的那个洞缝起来。
The Democrats appear to have the election sewn up.  民主党看来已确信会在选举中获胜。
It's going to take another week or two to sew up this deal.  要再花一两个星期才能谈妥这笔交易。

words.meaning: n.摆渡;渡船;渡口v.摆渡;渡运(人,车或物等)
words.example:
We're going across to France by / on the ferry.  我们正在坐渡船去法国。
We took the ferry to Calais.  我们乘渡船去了加莱。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: ad.此后,以后
words.example: He left the priesthood in 1970 and settled in the Washington area shortly thereafter (= soon after that).  他在1970年结束牧师生涯，不久以后在华盛顿地区定居。

words.meaning: a.粘的,粘性的;棘手的;(道路)泥泞的
words.example:
The floor's still sticky where I spilled the juice.  我把果汁洒到地上，现在那里还黏乎乎的。
The children's faces were sticky with chocolate.  孩子们的脸上沾满了巧克力，黏乎乎的。    Compare non-stick ; stuck
There were a few sticky moments during the meeting, but everything turned out all right in the end.  会议过程中有几处困难，但最后总算是一切顺利。adjective

words.meaning: n.尽善尽美,完美
words.example:
In his quest for physical perfection, he spends hours in the gym.  为了追求完美的体形，他在健身房里花许多时间锻炼身体。
The fish was cooked to perfection.  这条鱼烧得极好。

words.meaning: n.[总称]牧师,神职人员
words.example: We were surprised when he announced he wanted to join the clergy (= become a priest).  他宣布自己想成为一名牧师时，我们大吃一惊。

words.meaning: v.迁移,移居(国外)
words.example:
These animals migrate annually in search of food.  这些动物为寻找食物每年都迁徙。
In September, these birds migrate 2000 miles south to a warmer climate.  九月，这些鸟会向南迁徙2000英里到更温暖的地方。
Mexican farm workers migrate into the US each year to find work at harvest time.  每年收获季节来临时，大批墨西哥农场工人都会涌入美国找工作。

words.meaning: a.锋利的;敏锐的;敏捷的;(on)热心的,渴望的
words.example:
They were very keen to start work as soon as possible.  他们渴望尽早开始工作。
Joan wanted to go to a movie but I wasn't keen (= I didn't want to go).  琼想去看电影，但我不想去。
She's keen on (playing) tennis.  她很喜欢打网球。

words.meaning: n.东方,亚洲 v.使朝东,为…定位,使适应
words.example: New employees need time to orient.  新员工需要时间熟悉环境。

words.meaning: a.想象的,虚构的
words.example:
As a child I had an imaginary friend called Polly.  小时候我有个想像中的朋友叫波莉。
The story is set in an imaginary world.  故事发生在一个虚构的世界中。

words.meaning: a.数学的;数学上的
words.example: The proof is purely mathematical.  这个证明纯属数学推导。

words.meaning: n.子孙,后代;结果,产物
words.example:
In the case of the guinea pig, the number of offspring varies between two and five.  以豚鼠为例，它一胎产2到5个幼仔。
Tom's sister came round on Saturday with her numerous offspring.  汤姆的姐姐星期六带着她的一大群子女过来串门。

words.meaning: n.柱,台柱,栋梁
words.example:
Mrs Maple is a pillar of the local church.  梅普尔夫人是当地教会的中坚分子。
Equality is one of the pillars of socialism.  平等是社会主义理论的重要组成部分之一。UK noun countable
My parents were always on the move and so my childhood was spent being dragged from pillar to post.  父母总是不停地搬家，所以我的童年是在四处迁移中度过的。

words.meaning: vi.(to)粘着;坚持,遵守;依附,追随
words.example:
She adhered to her principles/ideals throughout her life.  她终生对自己的原则／理想忠贞不渝。
They failed to adhere to the terms of the agreement/treaty.  他们没有遵守协议／条约的条款。
The translator has obviously adhered very strictly to the original text.  显然，译者严格忠实于原文。

words.meaning: n.收据,收条;收到,接到
words.example:
Make sure you are given a receipt for everything you buy.  买甚么东西都一定记着要发票。noun
Goods will be delivered on receipt of payment (= after the money is received).  款到即发货。
You have been in receipt of unemployment benefit for two months.  你领失业救济金已经两个月了。

words.meaning: a.不安的,焦虑的
words.example:
Who can predict how long this uneasy peace between the two countries will last?  谁能预言两国之间勉强维持的和平能持续多久？
She has a rather uneasy relationship with her mother-in-law.  她和婆婆的关系相当紧张。

words.meaning: n.保留,保持,保持力,记忆力
words.example:
Two influential senators have argued for the retention of the unpopular tax.  两位有影响的参议员主张保留这项不得人心的税收。
The retention of old technology has slowed the company's growth.  死守着旧技术不放减缓了这家公司的发展。

words.meaning: n.(四轮)马车;(火车)客车厢
words.example: That will be £150, carriage included.  总共150英镑，包括运费。UK noun

words.meaning: n.送信者,使者,传令兵
words.example: The documents were delivered by special messenger.  文件由特派信使送达。

words.meaning: n.人行道
words.example: Keep to the pavement, Rosie, there's a good girl.  沿着人行道走，罗茜，乖孩子。

words.meaning: a.潮湿的,湿润的,多雨的
words.example:
Keep the soil in the pot moist, but not too wet.  让花盆中的土保持湿润，但不要太湿。
approving This cake is lovely and moist!  这个蛋糕很好吃，非常松软！

words.meaning: n.拖拉机,牵引车
words.example: The tractor pulled the heavy plough.  拖拉机拉着沉重的犁。

words.meaning: v.推迟,延期
words.example: They decided to postpone their holiday until next year.  他们决定将假期延后到来年。

words.meaning: n.芭蕾舞,芭蕾舞剧;芭蕾舞团
words.example: By the age of fifteen he had already composed his first ballet (= music for a ballet).  他15岁就写了第一首芭蕾舞曲。

words.meaning: n.业余爱好,嗜好,兴趣
words.example: Ben's hobby is restoring vintage motorcycles.  班的业余爱好是修复旧型摩托车。

words.meaning: v.使和好,调解,使调和;(to,with)使一致
words.example:
It is sometimes difficult to reconcile science and religion.  有时很难调和宗教和科学之间的矛盾。
It's difficult to reconcile such different points of view.  差别如此悬殊的观点是很难达成一致的。
How can you reconcile your fur coat and/with your love of animals?  如果你爱动物，那怎么还穿毛皮大衣呢？

words.meaning: a.吵闹的,喧闹的
words.example: a noisy crowd of fans  一群喧闹的球迷

words.meaning: n.卧车包房,(客车车厢内的)隔间;分隔的空间
words.example: a first class compartment  头等包厢

words.meaning: vt./n.侮辱,凌辱
words.example:
She made several insults about my appearance.  她说了几句侮辱我长相的话。
The steelworkers' leader rejected the 2% pay-rise saying it was an insult to the profession.  钢铁工人的领导者拒绝接受2%的加薪，认为这是对他们职业的侮辱。
The instructions are so easy they are an insult to your intelligence (= they seem to suggest you are not clever if you need to use them).  说明如此简单，简直是在侮辱你的智商。verb transitive /ɪnˈsʌlt/

words.meaning: a.自发的,自然产生的
words.example:
His jokes seemed spontaneous, but were in fact carefully prepared beforehand.  他讲的笑话看似即兴的，但实际上是事先精心准备好的。
approving She's such a spontaneous, lively woman.  她是个为人率直、充满活力的女子。

words.meaning: v.(使)上船(或飞机,汽车等);着手,从事
words.example:
We embarked at Liverpool for New York.  我们从利物浦登船，前往纽约。    Opposite disembarkUK US  formal
We're embarking upon a new project later this year.  今年晚些时候我们会着手进行一个新企划。

words.meaning: n.花(朵);开花(期) v.开花
words.example:
These flowers will bloom all through the summer.  这些花整个夏天都会绽放。verb intransitive
Rimbaud's poetic genius bloomed early.  兰波很早就展露了诗歌才华。noun
The apple trees are in full bloom (= completely covered in flowers).  苹果树开满了花。

words.meaning: a.修长的,细长的,苗条的;微小的,微薄的
words.example:
He put his hands around her slender waist.  他双手搂住了她纤细的腰。
The plant's leaves are long and slender.  这株植物叶子细长。
The chances of settling this dispute through talks seem increasingly slender.  透过对谈解决这场争端的机会似乎越来越渺茫。

words.meaning: n.女衬衣,短上衣,宽阔的罩衫
words.example: a white silk blouse  女装白色丝绸衬衫

words.meaning: n.项链,项圈
words.example: a gold/silver/pearl necklace  金／银／珍珠项链verb transitive

words.meaning: n.小册子
words.example: Pick up a brochure at the counter.  在柜台拿份小册子。

words.meaning: n.香味,芳香;香料 v.使发香,洒香水于
words.example:
What perfume are you wearing?  你用的是甚么香水？
She adores French perfume.  她非常喜欢法国香水。
The perfume of the roses filled the room.  玫瑰的香气充满了整个房间。

words.meaning: v.使防备;支撑;使(手,足,肩等)绷紧 n.托架
words.example:
He was recently fitted with a brace for his bad back.  他最近因背部受伤戴了一个支撑架。
The side wall of the old house was braced with a wooden support.  老房子的边墙用木结构加固了。verb transitive
The passengers were told to brace themselves (= to press their bodies hard against something or hold them very stiff) for a crash landing.  乘客们被告知要做好紧急迫降准备。

words.meaning: n.(一)群,(禽,畜等的)群;大量 v.群集,成群
words.example:
The shepherd is bringing his flock down from the hills.  牧羊人正把他的羊群往山下赶。
The vicar invited all the members of his flock (= all the people who go to his church) to attend the special service.  牧师邀请教区的所有信徒参加这一特别仪式。UK noun
Hundreds of people flocked to the football match.  数百人蜂拥前来观看足球比赛。

words.meaning: v.精炼,精制,提纯;使文雅,使高尚
words.example:
Crude oil is industrially refined to purify it and separate out the different elements, such as benzene.  原油经过工业提炼来提纯并且分离出诸如苯之类的不同元素。
Engineers spent many months refining the software.  工程师们花了数月来完善这个软体。

words.meaning: a.严格的,严厉的,严酷的,严密的,严谨的
words.example: rigorous testing/checking/methods  精确的测试／严格的检查／严谨的方法UK adjective

words.meaning: a.卵形的,椭圆形的 n.卵形,椭圆形
words.example: an oval mirror  椭圆形镜子

words.meaning: a.坚定的,不屈不挠的;强健的,结实的
words.example: They put up a sturdy defence of their proposal.  他们坚定地为自己的提议辩护。

words.meaning: n.独木舟,小游艇
words.example: We canoe down the river every summer.  每年夏天我们都划独木舟顺流而下。

words.meaning: n.航海;航行;旅行
words.example:
He was a young sailor on his first sea voyage.  他第一次出海航行时还是个年轻的水手。
figurative The first year of a loving relationship is a voyage (= period) of discovery.  谈恋爱的第一年是彼此了解的阶段。verb intransitive old use or literary
In their little boat they planned to voyage to distant lands.  他们打算乘他们的小船出行去遥远的地方。

words.meaning: vt.推进,推动;激励,驱使
words.example:
The Kon-Tiki sailed across the Pacific Ocean propelled by wind power.  “太阳号”草船借助风力横渡了太平洋。
The film propelled him to international stardom.  这部电影使他成为了国际巨星。

words.meaning: v.弄歪(嘴脸等);扭曲;歪曲(真理、事实等)
words.example: My original statement has been completely distorted by the media.  我最初的说法被媒体彻底歪曲了。

words.meaning: a./ad.快的(地);敏捷的(地)a.立刻的n.雨燕
words.example:
The local police took swift action against the squatters.  当地警方对擅自占地者采取了迅速的行动。
Thank you for your swift reply.  感谢您的即时回覆。
The gazelle is one of the swiftest and most graceful of animals.  瞪羚是最敏捷、最优雅的动物之一。noun countable

words.meaning: v.松开,解开
words.example:
Can someone help me to undo my seat belt?  有人能帮我解开安全带吗？ (undoing, undid, undone)
It's very difficult to undo the damage that's caused by inadequate parenting in a child's early years.  孩子年幼时缺少父母关爱所造成的不良后果很难消除。

words.meaning: n.茎,梗vt.悄悄地跟踪vi.高视阔步地走
words.example:
She trimmed the stalks of the tulips before putting them in a vase.  她修剪了一下郁金香的花梗，然后把它们插进了花瓶。
The eyes of shrimps are on movable stalks.  虾的眼睛长在能够活动的肉柄上。UK noun countable
His eyes were out on stalks as he watched his neighbour drive past in a brand new Porsche.  看到邻居开着一辆崭新的保时捷经过时，他吃惊得瞪大了眼睛。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.胁迫,威胁(某人做某事)
words.example: They were intimidated into accepting a pay cut by the threat of losing their jobs.  他们因为受到失去工作的威胁而被迫同意减薪。

words.meaning: n.瘟疫,灾害,麻烦,苦恼 vt.折磨,使苦恼
words.example:
Financial problems have been plaguing their new business partners.  财务问题一直困扰着他们的新业务伙伴。
My shoulder's been plaguing me all week.  我的肩膀整个星期都很难受。
The children plagued him with questions all through lunch.  吃午餐时孩子不停地问他问题，使他感到烦厌。

words.meaning: n.一批,一组,一群
words.example:
The cook brought in a fresh batch of homemade cakes.  那位厨师带来了一炉刚刚烤好的自制蛋糕。
We looked at the job applications in two batches.  我们把那些求职申请分两批浏览了一遍。

words.meaning: n.花边;带子,鞋带 v.系带,扎带
words.example:
Your shoe laces are undone.  你的鞋带没有系好。verb transitive
She can lace up her shoes and she's only five!  她才五岁就能自己系鞋带！

words.meaning: n.(Lord)上帝,主;主人,长官,君主,贵族
words.example:
Praise the Lord!  赞美上帝！
[as form of address] Lord, hear our prayer.  主啊，听听我们的祈祷吧。UK noun
Oh Lord! I've forgotten the tickets!  喔，天啊！我忘了拿票！

words.meaning: v.期满,(期限)终止;呼气;断气,死亡
words.example:
Our television license expires next month.  我们的电视下个月到期要缴费了。
The contract between the two companies will expire at the end of the year.  两间公司之间的合约将在年底到期。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.(to)(时间上)紧接着的;邻近的,毗邻的
words.example:
They work in adjacent buildings.  他们在相邻的两座楼里工作。
They lived in a house adjacent to the railway.  他们家住在铁路旁边。

words.meaning: n.大灾难;(悲剧)结局
words.example:
They were warned of the ecological catastrophe to come.  警告过他们生态灾难即将来临。
The emigration of scientists is a catastrophe for the country.  大量科学家移居国外对这个国家大为不利。

words.meaning: vt.使停止;拒给;保留;抑制 vi.忍住
words.example:
During the trial, the prosecution was accused of withholding crucial evidence from the defence.  审判期间，原告被指控对被告隐瞒了十分重要的证据。
Police are withholding the dead woman's name until her relatives have been informed.  在通知女性死者的亲属之前，警方拒绝透露她的名字。
She withheld her rent until the landlord agreed to have the repairs done.  她拒付房租，直到房东答应进行维修。

words.meaning: vi.同时发生;巧合;一致;相符;
words.example:
If the heavy rain had coincided with an extreme high tide, serious flooding would have resulted.  如果暴雨来临时潮水汹涌，就会导致严重的水灾。
Our views coincide on a range of subjects.  我们在一系列问题上的观点不谋而合。
If our schedules coincide, we'll go to Spain together.  如果我们的排程一致，就能一起去西班牙。

words.meaning: vt.超出,超越(经验、知识、能力的范围等)
words.example:
The best films are those which transcend national or cultural barriers.  最优秀的影片是那些超越了民族或文化障碍的影片。
The underlying message of the film is that love transcends everything else.  这部电影内在的中心意旨是爱超越其他一切。

words.meaning: a.(to)抵抗的,有抵抗力的
words.example: Why are you so resistant to change?  你为甚么会如此强烈地抵制变革？adjective

words.meaning: vt.护送(卫);陪同 n.警卫,护送者;仪仗兵
words.example:
Several little boats escorted the sailing ship into the harbour.  在数只小船的护航下，帆船驶入海港。
Security guards escorted the intruders from the building.  保安把闯入者押送出了大楼。
The police escorted her to the airport, and made sure that she left the country.  员警将她押送到机场，确保其离境。

words.meaning: n.抹布,破布,碎布
words.example:
an old man dressed in rags.  衣衫褴褛的老人
Their clothes were in rags (= torn).  他们的衣服又破又旧。noun countable
He had his picture taken for some local rag.  他为一家地方小报拍了照片。noun countable

words.meaning: n.货摊;畜栏,厩 v.(使)停转,(使)停止
words.example:
In the village market, the stalls are piled high with local vegetables.  村子市集的摊位上高高堆着当地产的蔬菜。UK noun
There was one bathroom with a shower stall in the corner.  有一个洗手间，角落里有个淋浴的小隔间。UK noun
She says she'll give me the money next week but I think she's just stalling (for time).  她说下周会把钱给我，但我认为她只不过是在拖时间。

words.meaning: n.合同,条约,公约,协定
words.example: The United States and Canada have signed a free-trade pact.  美国和加拿大签署了自由贸易协定。

words.meaning: v.表示,意味;要紧,有重要性
words.example:
Nobody really knows what the marks on the ancient stones signify.  没人真正知道那些古老石头上的记号代表甚么含意。
She signified her agreement by nodding her head.  她点头表示同意。
Don't worry about being late - it doesn't signify.  别担心迟到——不要紧。

words.meaning: v.强迫,迫使;责成;(使)感激,施恩于
words.example:
The law obliges companies to pay decent wages to their employees.  法律强制公司向其雇员支付适当的工资。
Sellers are not legally obliged to accept the highest offer.  法律没有强制卖主必须接受最高的出价。verb
We only went to the party to oblige some old friends who especially asked us to be there.  我们去参加这个聚会只是为了照顾一些老朋友的面子，他们特意要求我们到场。

words.meaning: v.溅,泼 n.溅,飞溅声
words.example:
Water was splashing from a hole in the roof.  水从屋顶的洞里泼溅下来。
Unfortunately some paint splashed onto the rug.  糟糕的是小地毯上溅到了一些油漆。
She splashed her face with cold water.  她往脸上泼冷水。

words.meaning: n.声望,威望,威信
words.example:
The company has gained international prestige.  该公司赢得了国际声誉。
Many people are attracted by the prestige of working for a top company.  在一家一流公司工作令人羡慕，很多人因此被吸引了。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: a.语言的,语言学的
words.example: I'm particularly interested in the linguistic development of young children.  我对幼儿语言能力的发展尤其感兴趣。

words.meaning: n.污点,瑕疵 v.沾污;染色
words.example:
Tomato sauce stains terribly - it's really difficult to get it out of clothes.  蕃茄酱一沾上就很麻烦——很难把它从衣服上洗掉。
While she was changing the wheel on her car, her coat had become stained with oil.  她帮汽车换轮胎时，外套沾上了油污。
This carpet is ideal for the kitchen because it doesn't stain easily.  这块地毯很适合在厨房里用，因为它很耐脏（不怕脏）。

words.meaning: v.拍手,拍,轻拍 n.拍(手),掌声,霹雳声
words.example:
"When I clap my hands, you must stand still," said the teacher.  老师说：“我拍手时，你们必须站立不动。”
The band played a familiar tune which had everyone clapping along.  乐队演奏了一首熟悉的曲子，大家都跟着一起拍手。
The audience clapped in time to the music.  观众随着音乐的节拍拍手。

words.meaning: n.轴承;忍受;关系,影响;举止;方向
words.example:
The road system was so complicated that we had to stop to get our bearings several times.  路线非常复杂，好几次使我们不得不停下来确定方位。
It takes a while to get your bearings when you start a new job.  刚开始做一份工作时，需要花上一段时间才能适应新环境。
They lost their bearings in the dark.  他们在黑暗中迷路了。

words.meaning: a.粗鲁的;猛烈的,残暴的;粗糙的,粗陋的
words.example:
He's a very rude man.  他这人很粗鲁。
It 's rude not to say "Thank you" when you are given something.  别人给你东西，你不说“谢谢”是不礼貌的。
He's got no manners - he's rude to everyone.  他这人很无礼——他对谁都很粗鲁。

words.meaning: n.房东,地主
words.example:
The landlord had promised to redecorate the bedrooms before we moved in.  房东承诺在我们搬进去之前会把睡房重新装修一番。
Housing associations are the biggest landlords in this area.  住房协会是本地区最大的房东。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.路边,场外证券市场,vt.制止,抑制
words.example:
The Government should act to curb tax evasion.  政府应该采取行动抑制逃税。UK noun countable
You must try to put a curb on your bad temper/spending habits.  你必须尽量控制你的坏脾气／挥霍无度的习惯。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.混合成的,综合成的n.合成物,复合材料
words.example:
The main character in her latest novel is a composite of several public figures of that era.  她那新小说中的主角是集那个时期几位公众人物形象于一身的综合形象。
Scientists have put together a composite picture of what the Earth's crust is like.  科学家拼出了一幅地壳形状复合图。
The bodies of these racing cars are moulded from the same composite that is used for making aircraft fuselage.  这些赛车的车身所用的是一种与制造飞机机身相同的复合材料。

words.meaning: v.征服,战胜,占领;克服,破除(坏习惯等)
words.example:
The Spanish conquered the New World in the 16th century.  西班牙人在16世纪征服了新大陆。
The English were conquered by the Normans in 1066.  诺曼人于1066年征服了英格兰人。
He has finally conquered his fear of spiders.  他终于战胜了对蜘蛛的恐惧。

words.meaning: a.含蓄的;(in)固有的;无疑问的;绝对的
words.example:
He interpreted her comments as an implicit criticism of the government.  他将她的评论理解为对政府的含蓄批评。
Implicit in the poem's closing lines are the poet's own religious doubts.  在这首诗最后几行中隐含着诗人自己的宗教疑虑。    Compare explicitadjective
All her life she had implicit faith in socialism.  她一生都对社会主义坚信不疑。

words.meaning: v.吸入(气体等),吸(烟)
words.example:
She flung open the window and inhaled deeply.  她打开窗户，深深地吸了口气。
She became ill shortly after inhaling the fumes.  她吸入浓烟后不久就生病了。    Compare exhaleverb
Tony inhaled his burger.  托尼狼吞虎咽地吃汉堡。

words.meaning: a.即将到来的;准备好的;乐意帮助的;n.来临
words.example:
We have just received the information about the forthcoming conference.  我们刚刚收到即将举行的大会的资料。UK adjective
No explanation for his absence was forthcoming.  他缺席一事没有任何解释。
Will financial support for the theatre project be forthcoming?  剧院企划案会得到财政支援吗？

words.meaning: n.宽度;宽阔,广阔
words.example:
It is 5 metres in width.  它的宽度是五米。
The needle is seven times smaller than the width of a human hair.  这根针的粗细只有人类头发的1/7。
The material is available in various widths.  这种材料有很多种宽度可供选择。

words.meaning: v.取来;接来;引出;售得;吸引 n.取得;拿
words.example:
The paintings fetched over a million dollars.  这些油画卖了100多万美元。
The house didn't fetch as much as she was hoping it would.  房子没有卖到她期望的那个价钱。verb
After a whole hour of driving, we fetched up back where we started.  开车开了整整一小时后，我们竟然又回到了出发地。

words.meaning: a.圆(形)的,环形的;循环的 n.传单,通报
words.example: Circulars and other junk mail go straight in the bin.  传单和其他的垃圾邮件直接扔进垃圾桶。

words.meaning: n.警报声,警报器
words.example: When the air raid siren went off people ran to their shelters.  空袭警报响起时，人们纷纷跑向掩蔽所。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.疲倦的;令人厌烦的 v.使疲倦,使厌倦
words.example:
Here, sit down and rest your weary legs.  来，坐下歇歇脚。
I've been going out with the same people to the same clubs for years and I've just grown weary of it.  多年来一直和同一批人去同一所俱乐部，我已经开始感到厌倦了。UK verb formal
Children weary me all day with their constant inquiries and demands.  孩子们整天不停地问这要那，真把我累坏了。

words.meaning: n.补足物,船上的定员;补语 vt.补充,补足
words.example:
Strawberries and cream complement each other perfectly.  草莓加鲜奶油相得益彰。
The music complements her voice perfectly.  音乐使她的嗓音妙不可言。

words.meaning: a.聋的;不愿听的
words.example:
He's been totally/partially deaf since birth.  他一出生就完全失聪／有些听力障碍。
The local council has remained deaf to all the objections to its proposals.  当地议会对反对其提案的各种声音充耳不闻。adjective
Grandad's as deaf as a post.  爷爷一点儿声音也听不见了。adjective

words.meaning: n.虎;老虎
words.example: A tiger stalked its prey.  一只老虎悄悄跟踪猎物。

words.meaning: v.分配,分派;拨给;划归
words.example:
The government is allocating £10 million for health education.  政府将拨出1000万英镑作为健康教育经费。
It is not the job of the investigating committee to allocate blame for the disaster/to allocate blame to individuals.  调查委员会的任务不是确定谁该为这场灾难负责任／哪些人应该负责任。

words.meaning: n.百万富翁
words.example: You want me to buy you a new car - do you think I'm a millionaire or something?  想要我买辆新车给你，你以为我是百万富翁吗？

words.meaning: n.似非而是的话,自相矛盾的话,反论
words.example: It's a paradox that busy people find time.  忙人反而有时间，真是矛盾。

words.meaning: v.哀悼,忧伤
words.example:
Queen Victoria mourned Prince Albert/Prince Albert's death for 40 years.  维多利亚女王为亚伯特亲王的去世服丧40年。
She was still mourning for her brother.  她还在悼念她的哥哥。
They mourned the passing of traditional folk dancing (= felt sad because it had stopped existing).  他们为传统民间舞蹈的消亡而感到痛心。

words.meaning: a.缺乏的,不足的;稀少的,罕见的
words.example:
Food and clean water were becoming scarce.  食物和干净的水越来越少了。
Dad's really angry with you, so you'd better make yourself scarce.  爸爸很生你的气，你最好离他躲远一点。

words.meaning: n.包围,围攻,围困
words.example:
The siege of Mafeking lasted for eight months.  对马弗京的围攻持续了八个月。
The soldiers laid siege to (= started a siege of) the city.  士兵们包围了这座城市。
The castle was under siege for months.  城堡被围困了数月。

words.meaning: a.很可能的,大概的;有希望的,可能的
words.example:
The probable cause of death was heart failure.  死因很可能是心脏衰竭。
An election in June seems increasingly probable.  六月举行选举的可能性似乎越来越大了。

words.meaning: n.烤肉;烤肉用的台架 vt.炙烤(肉等)
words.example: We had a barbecue in the yard.  我们在院子里烧烤。

words.meaning: a.明确的;一定的;意志坚强的,立场坚定的
words.example:
The date for the meeting is now definite: 5th March.  开会的日期现在已经确定了：3月5日。
She has very definite opinions.  她的意见非常明确。
We need a definite answer by tomorrow.  我们需要在明天之前得到明确的答覆。

words.meaning: v.(at,over)主持
words.example:
Who would be the best person to preside at/over the public enquiry?  谁来主持大众调查最合适呢？verb intransitive
Judge Langdale is to preside over the official enquiry into the case.  兰代尔法官将主持这个案子的正式调查。
This government has presided over some of the most significant changes in education this century.  本任政府主导了本世纪某些最重大的教育变革。

words.meaning: a.逐渐的,逐步的
words.example:
There has been a gradual improvement in our sales figures over the last two years.  在过去的两年里，我们的销售额一直在逐步上升。
As you go further south, you will notice a gradual change of climate.  当你一路往南走下去的时候，你就会注意到气候的细微变化。

words.meaning: ad.现今,现在
words.example:
Who remembers those films nowadays?  如今谁还记得那些电影？
Nowadays, I bake my own bread rather than buy it.  现在，我自己烤面包而不去买现成的了。adverb

words.meaning: v.移置,转移;取代,置换
words.example: The building of a new dam will displace thousands of people who live in this area.  建造新水坝将迫使居住在这一地区的数千人迁往别处。

words.meaning: v.区别,辨别;(against)有差别地对待,歧视
words.example:
She felt she had been discriminated against because of her age.  她认为自己受到了年龄歧视。
In order to increase the number of female representatives, the selection committee decided to discriminate in favour of women for three years.  为了增加女性代表的人数，选拔委员会决定在三年内特别礼遇妇女。verb
Police dogs can discriminate between the different smells.  警犬能辨别各种不同的气味。

words.meaning: n.商标;特征 vt.注册的…商标
words.example:
Velcro is a registered trademark.  维可牢是一个注册商标。UK noun countable
He was wearing one of the brightly coloured ties that are his trademark.  他戴着一条有个人特色的亮色领带。
She gave one of her trademark smiles.  她展露她那特有的微笑。

words.meaning: a.(好)孤独的;偏僻的;单一的,唯一的
words.example:
On the hill, a solitary figure was busy chopping down trees.  山上，有个人正忙着砍树。
In the distance was a solitary building.  远处是一栋孤零零的建筑。
He was a solitary child (= He enjoyed being alone).  他是个喜欢独处的小孩。

words.meaning: a.两极的,极地的,南辕北辙的 n.极线,极面
words.example: The novel deals with the polar opposites of love and hate.  这部小说涉及爱和恨的两个对立面。

words.meaning: n.剩余物,剩下的;余数,余项
words.example:
It rained the first day but the remainder of the trip was lovely.  旅行中第一天下了雨，不过其余的日子天气都很好。UK noun
His autobiography never sold very well and was soon remaindered.  他的自传一直卖得不太好，过了不久就被削价处理了。

words.meaning: n.徽章,像章;标记;象征;记号
words.example:
Everyone at the conference wore a badge with their name on.  出席会议的人都戴着写有自己名字的徽章。noun countable
For Tony, owning a big car was a badge of success.  对东尼来说，拥有一辆大房车是成功的象征。

words.meaning: n.海军
words.example:
My brother is an officer in the Navy.  我兄弟是海军军官。
Gabriel joined the navy in 1997.  加伯利于1997年加入海军。
He was wearing a navy sweater.  他穿着一件深蓝色的毛线衣。

words.meaning: n./v.不喜欢,厌恶
words.example:
Why do you dislike her so much?  你为甚么这么不喜欢她？
She has a dislike of cold weather.  她不喜欢寒冷的天气。
I'm afraid Dad took an instant dislike to (= decided he does not like) this new boyfriend of yours.  依我看，爸爸恐怕不喜欢你的这个新男友。

words.meaning: a.空虚的;没有的;无效的
words.example:
She stood at the edge of the chasm and stared into the void.  她站在裂缝的边缘凝视着下面的深渊。
Before Einstein, space was regarded as a formless void.  在爱因斯坦之前，太空被认为是无形的虚空之地。
They tried to describe their attempts to fill the void left by their son's death.  他们竭力想要描述他们曾如何试图填补儿子死后留下的空虚感。adjective

words.meaning: v.哼曲子;发嗡嗡声;忙碌n.嗡嗡声,嘈杂声
words.example:
The computers were humming in the background.  电脑在某个不显眼的地方嗡嗡作响。
What's that strange humming sound?  那种奇怪的嗡嗡声是甚么？
She hummed to herself as she walked to school.  她在上学的路上边走边哼曲子。

words.meaning: a.合成的,人造的;综合的
words.example: She criticized the synthetic charm of television presenters.  她批评电视节目主持人矫揉造作。

words.meaning: v.(from)抑制,制止
words.example:
When he started fighting, it took four police officers to restrain him.  他要是出手打人，要四个员警才能把他制服。
You should try to restrain your ambitions and be more realistic.  你应该尽量控制自己的野心，更现实一些。
Growth in car ownership could be restrained by increasing taxes.  或许可以透过提高税费来限制汽车保有量的增长。

words.meaning: n.(水,酒等之外的)饮料
words.example:
Hot beverages include tea, coffee and hot chocolate.  热饮包括茶、咖啡和热巧克力。
We do not sell alcoholic beverages.  我们不出售含酒精的饮料。

words.meaning: n.害虫
words.example: Put that back, you little pest!  把它放回去，你这个小讨厌鬼！

words.meaning: n.资格,合格;限定,条件;合格证
words.example:
You'll never get a good job if you don't have any qualifications.  你要是没有任何资格证明就永远得不到一份好工作。
Do you have any teaching/legal/medical/secretarial/academic qualifications?  你有没有教师/法律/医学/秘书/学术的资格证明？
Some nursing experience is a necessary qualification for this job.  这份工作的必要条件是必须具备一定的护理经验。

words.meaning: a.中间的,暂时的,临时的 n.过渡时期,暂定
words.example:
An interim government was set up for the period before the country's first free election.  该国在首次自由选举之前的过度时期成立了临时政府。UK noun
The new secretary starts in June, but in the interim we're having to type our own letters.  新秘书六月份开始工作，在此之前我们必须自己打印信件。

words.meaning: ad.完全地,全部,一概
words.example: That's a wholly different matter.  那完全是另一回事。

words.meaning: v.临时住宿,寄宿,寄存,容纳n.传达室,小旅馆
words.example:
She lodged with Mrs Higgins when she first came to Cambridge.  她第一次来剑桥时借宿在希金斯太太家里。UK verb
The US lodged a formal protest against the arrest of the foreign reporters.  美国就外国记者被捕一事提出正式抗议。
Lee's solicitor said last night that they would be lodging an appeal against the sentence.  昨晚李的律师说他们将对此项判决提起上诉。UK verb

words.meaning: v.剌穿,刺破
words.example:
The needle pierces the fabric four times a second.  针穿过布料的速度是每秒钟四次。
The gun fires a shell capable of piercing the armour of an enemy tank.  这种炮所发射的炮弹能打穿敌人坦克的装甲。
The hole they drilled pierces 6 km into the Earth's crust.  他们钻的孔深入地壳六公里。

words.meaning: v.放任,纵容,沉溺;使(自己)纵情享受
words.example:
The soccer fans indulged their patriotism, waving flags and singing songs.  足球迷摇着旗唱着歌，纵情抒发他们的爱国热情。
We took a deliberate decision to indulge in a little nostalgia.  我们特意决定好好追忆一下往事。
My aunt indulges the children dreadfully.  我婶婶太纵容孩子了。

words.meaning: n.梨子,梨树
words.example: This pear is ripe and sweet.  这个梨熟透了，很甜。

words.meaning: n.连载小说,连续剧;连载刊物 a.连续的
words.example:
She wrote a thriller about a brutal serial killer.  她写了部有关一名冷血连环杀手的惊悚小说。
Most of her novels have been made into television serials at some time.  她的大多数小说都已在某个时候被拍成了电视连续剧。

words.meaning: vt.超过,胜过
words.example:
His time for the 100 metres surpassed the previous world record by one hundredth of a second.  他以0.01秒的优势打破了100米短跑的前世界纪录。
The book's success has surpassed everyone's expectations.  这本书获得出乎所有人意料的成功。

words.meaning: a.无限的,无穷的 n.无限
words.example:
The universe is theoretically infinite.  从理论上来讲，宇宙是无边无际的。
With infinite patience , she explained the complex procedure to us.  她以极大的耐心向我们解释这个复杂的程式。adjective
The authorities, in their infinite wisdom, decided to close the advice centre.  当局以其无比的智慧决定关闭咨询中心。noun

words.meaning: v.乘公交车上下班,乘车(船等)往返于两地
words.example:
It's exhausting commuting from Brighton to London every day.  每天上下班要往返于布莱顿与伦敦之间，令人疲惫不堪。verb
People used to believe that you could commute base metals into gold.  人们过去曾认为能将贱金属变成黄金。
Her sentence was commuted from death to life imprisonment.  对她的判决由死刑减为无期徒刑。noun countable informal

words.meaning: n./v.(说)闲话,闲聊
words.example:
Her letter was full of gossip.  她信里讲的都是些闲言闲语。
Jane and Lyn sat in the kitchen having a good gossip about their friends.  简和琳恩坐在厨房里大聊特聊自己的那班朋友。
I've got some juicy gossip for you.  我有些特别有趣的小道传闻告诉你。

words.meaning: a.肌肉的;肌肉发达的;强健的
words.example:
He wished he was more muscular.  他希望自己更强壮些。UK adjective
It was a muscular, hard-hitting documentary.  那是一部震撼人心的纪录片。

words.meaning: v.反驳;同…矛盾,同…抵触
words.example:
If you're both going to lie, at least stick to the same story and don't contradict each other!  如果你们俩都要撒谎，至少也要口径一致，不要互相矛盾！
How dare you contradict (me)!  你怎么敢顶撞我！
Recent evidence has tended to contradict established theories on this subject.  关于这一问题，最近发现的证据与即存理论有相抵触的倾向。

words.meaning: n.相差;差异;矛盾;
words.example:
There is some discrepancy between the two accounts.  这两份帐单之间有一些出入。
The committee is reportedly unhappy about the discrepancy in numbers.  据说委员会对数字不一致很不满。

words.meaning: a.中间的,居间的;中级的 n.中间体,媒介物
words.example:
There are three levels of difficulty in this game: low, intermediate and high.  这个游戏有三个难度级别
This novel is too difficult for intermediate students of English.  这本小说对于中等程度的英语学习者来说太难了。

words.meaning: a.月亮的
words.example: the lunar surface  月球的表面

words.meaning: a.诚挚的,真实的,诚恳的
words.example: He seems so sincere.  他看起来很诚恳。    Opposite insincere

words.meaning: v.使富足;使肥沃;装饰;加料于;浓缩
words.example:
Fertilizer helps to enrich the soil.  化肥可以提高土壤肥沃度。
My life was greatly enriched by knowing her.  认识了她，让我的生活变得非常充实。verb
He claimed that the large stores were enriching themselves at the expense of their customers.  他声称大型商店藉由剥削顾客而获利。

words.meaning: n.潜水艇 a.水底的,海底的
words.example: a nuclear submarine  核潜艇

words.meaning: n.沟,沟渠,水沟
words.example:
The getaway car had been ditched a couple of kilometres away from the scene of the robbery.  逃离现场用的车辆被丢弃在距抢劫地几公里以外的地方。
Did you know that Sarah has ditched (= ended her relationship with) her boyfriend?  莎拉把男朋友给甩了，你知道吗？verb

words.meaning: n.一个面包
words.example: Stop loafing (about/around) and get on with cleaning the windows!  别偷懒了，赶快把窗户擦干净！

words.meaning: v.(of)处理,处置;(for)布置,安排
words.example:
His rudeness when we first met didn't dispose me very kindly to/towards him.  我们首次会面时，他那粗暴的态度使我对他没产生甚么好感。UK US  formal
How did they dispose of the body?  他们是如何处理尸体的？
