It took a mere five minutes for the world champion to dispose of (= defeat) his opponent.  世界冠军只用五分钟就击败了对手。

words.meaning: n.垫子,软垫 vt.装垫子;缓和,减轻;
words.example:
She sank back against/into the cushions.  她向后靠在垫子上。
The soft grass cushioned his fall.  柔软的草地减缓了他摔落时的冲力。verb transitive
He's lost his job, but the redundancy money will cushion the blow.  他丢了工作，不过遣散费会减轻对他的打击。

words.meaning: n.公主,王妃
words.example: Lady Diana Spencer became Princess Diana when she married Prince Charles.  戴安娜•斯宾塞女士在与查理斯王子结婚后成为戴安娜王妃。

words.meaning: vt.理解,领会;包含,包括
words.example: He doesn't seem to comprehend the scale of the problem  他似乎没意识到问题的严重性。

words.meaning: n.松鼠
words.example: As soon as I get paid, I squirrel some money away so I won't be tempted to spend it.  我一发薪水，就把一部分存起来，以免忍不住想花。

words.meaning: n.皇家,皇族
words.example: She believes she's related to royalty.  她认为她和王室有血缘关系。UK noun

words.meaning: a.极好的,杰出的;华丽的;
words.example:
He is a superb dancer.  他是一个杰出的舞蹈家。
Taylor scored a superb goal at the end of the first half.  泰勒在上半场要结束的时候攻入了一个极为精彩的进球。

words.meaning: vt.撤离,疏散,排泄,剥夺
words.example:
The police evacuated the village shortly before the explosion.  在爆炸前不久，员警将这个村庄里的人全都疏散了。
When toxic fumes began to drift toward our homes, we were told to evacuate.  当毒雾开始朝我们住宅区方向飘移时，我们被通知撤离。

words.meaning: n.明信片
words.example: I sent a postcard from the seaside.  我从海边寄了张明信片。

words.meaning: n.艰难,困苦
words.example: economic hardship  经济困难

words.meaning: v.使隶属(或附属)于 n.附属机构,分公司
words.example:
The school is affiliated with a national association of driving schools.  这所学校隶属于一个全国驾驶学校协会。noun countable /əˈfɪl.i.ət/
Our college is an affiliate of the university.  我们学院隶属于这所大学。

words.meaning: n.爪,脚爪
words.example:
Our cat likes to sharpen her claws on the legs of the dining table.  我们的猫喜欢在餐桌腿上磨爪子。
Keep your fingers away from the crab's claws when you pick it up.  抓螃蟹时，别用手指触碰它的钳子。UK noun countable
If the loan company gets its claws into you, you'll still be paying off this debt when you're 50.  要是落入了贷款公司的魔掌，那你到50岁的时候还在还债。

words.meaning: v.(觉得)可怜,惋惜 n.憾事,怜悯
words.example:
The girl stood gazing in/with pity at the old lion in the cage.  女孩站在那里，同情地盯着笼里的老狮子。
We took pity on (= felt sorry for and therefore helped) a couple of people waiting in the rain for a bus and gave them a lift.  我们同情几个在雨中等公共汽车的人，就载了他们一程。
We'll have to leave early, more's the pity (= and I am unhappy about it).  我们必须早早离开，太遗憾了。

words.meaning: a.(marvellous)惊人的,奇迹般的,妙极的
words.example: The view from the peak was marvelous.  山顶的景色美极了。

words.meaning: vi.(for/to)满足,迎合;(for)提供饮食及服务
words.example:
I'm catering for twelve on Sunday, all the family are coming.  星期天我要招待12个人，全家都要来。
Which firm will be catering at the wedding reception?  将由哪家公司承办婚宴？
The club caters for children between the ages of 4 and 12.  该俱乐部适合4至12岁的儿童。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.信任,信心,依靠,依靠的人或物
words.example:
The region's reliance on tourism is unwise.  这一地区依赖旅游业谋发展是不明智的。
You place too much reliance on her ideas and expertise.  你过于信赖她的想法和专业知识了。

words.meaning: n.棋,国际象棋
words.example: Chess requires patience and logic.  下国际象棋需要耐心和逻辑。

words.meaning: n.骆驼
words.example: The caravan of camels crossed the desert.  骆驼商队穿越了沙漠。

words.meaning: n.(pl.nuclei)核,核心,原子核
words.example: These three players will form the nucleus of a revised and stronger team.  这三名运动员将成为一支调整后实力更强的队伍的核心。

words.meaning: vi.(to)遵守,适应;相似,一致,符合
words.example:
At our school, you were required to conform, and there was no place for originality.  我们学校要求每个人循规蹈矩，容不得创新求变。UK verb intransitive
Before buying a pram, make sure that it conforms to the official safety standards.  购买婴儿车之前，要确保它符合官方的安全标准。
Members must conform to a strict dress code.  成员们必须遵守严格的衣着规定。

words.meaning: a.值得(做)的
words.example:
She considers teaching a worthwhile career.  她把教书看成是一项值得从事的事业。
The time and expense involved in keeping up to date with all the changes has been worthwhile.  为跟上所有这些变动而花费的时间和费用是值得的。
If you need him on this project, you've got to make it financially worthwhile for him (= you will have to pay him a suitable amount of money for the amount of work involved).  如果你需要他参与这个专案计划，你就要适当给他付钱，令他觉得值得一做。

words.meaning: n.装船,装运;装载的货物,装货量
words.example: The shipment was delayed by the storm.  货物因暴风雨延误了。

words.meaning: n.芽,花苞 v.发芽,含苞欲放
words.example:
It was springtime and the fruit trees were in bud.  春天到了，果树发芽了。noun countable
The unusually cold winter has caused many plants to bud late this year.  今年冬天异常寒冷，许多植物抽芽都晚了。

words.meaning: n.器械,器具,仪器;机构,组织
words.example:
The divers checked their breathing apparatus.  潜水员检查了一下呼吸器。UK US  (plural apparatus or apparatuses)
The whole apparatus of communism was already falling apart.  整个国家行政机构已经土崩瓦解。

words.meaning: vt.抵抗,经受住
words.example:
Our toys are designed to withstand the rough treatment of the average five-year-old.  我们的玩具设计要能经得住一般五岁儿童粗野的摆弄。
The aircraft base is protected with specially designed shelters which are built to withstand ground and air attacks.  空军基地有特殊设计的掩体保护，能够抵挡地面和空中袭击。
She is an artist whose work will undoubtedly withstand the test of time (= it will still be popular in the future).  她这样一位元艺术家的作品毫无疑问能经受得起时间的考验。

words.meaning: v.把…开除;驱逐;排出;发射
words.example:
The new government has expelled all foreign diplomats.  新政府驱逐了所有外国外交官。
My brother was expelled from school for bad behaviour.  我弟弟因为行为不当被学校开除了。 (-ll-)
She took a deep breath, then expelled the air in short blasts.  她深深吸了一口气，然后一下子把空气呼出来。

words.meaning: a.流行的,普遍的
words.example:
These diseases are more prevalent among young children.  这些疾病在幼儿中更普遍。
Trees are dying in areas where acid rain is most prevalent.  树木在酸雨非常严重的地区正面临枯死。

words.meaning: ad.几乎不,简直没有,勉强
words.example:
I'd scarcely have done it if I didn't think it was absolutely necessary!  要是当时我认为并非绝对必要的话，我决不会这么做的。
He's only two - you can scarcely blame him for behaving badly.  他只有两岁——不听话你也不能怪他。

words.meaning: a.(病)良性的,(气候)良好的,仁慈的,和蔼的
words.example: The tumor turned out to be benign.  肿瘤结果是良性的。

words.meaning: n.木材,木料
words.example: In the distance, we could see a herd of elephants lumbering across the plain.  我们可以看见远处有一群大象缓缓穿过平原。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n.洋白菜,卷心菜
words.example: a savoy cabbage  皱叶甘蓝

words.meaning: a.懈怠的,松驰的;萧条的 n.淡季;(pl.)便裤
words.example:
These tent ropes are too slack - they need tightening.  这些帐篷绳太松了——需要把它们拉紧。adjective
Business is always slack at this time of year.  每年的这个时候生意都很清淡。
disapproving Discipline in Mr Brown's class has become very slack recently.  布朗先生班上的纪律最近变得十分松懈。

words.meaning: a.一致的,协调的;(话语等)条理清楚的
words.example: When she calmed down, she was more coherent (= able to speak clearly and be understood).  她冷静下来后，讲话有条理多了。

words.meaning: vt.诱拐;绑架,劫持
words.example: The wife of a businessman has been kidnapped from her home in Surrey.  一个商人的妻子在她萨里郡的家中遭绑架。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.热心的,诚挚的 n.热心;真挚;定金;认真
words.example:
He was a very earnest young man.  他是个非常认真的年轻人。
These fanatics are in deadly earnest when they say they want to destroy all forms of government.  这些狂热分子声称要摧毁所有政府的形式时，他们可不是说着玩，而是完全当真的。
The election campaign has begun in earnest.  竞选宣传活动正式开始了。

words.meaning: a.恰当的,适当的;易于…的,有…倾向的
words.example:
The kitchen roof is apt to (= likely to) leak when it rains.  一下雨厨房屋顶就容易漏水。
She's in her eighties now and apt to be a bit forgetful.  她已经80多岁了，有些健忘。adjective
We have some particularly apt students in the class this year.  这学年班里有几个特别聪明的学生。

words.meaning: n.简单,简易;朴素;直率,单纯
words.example:
The advantage of the plan is its simplicity.  这项计划的优点是简单易行。
The examination was simplicity itself (= very easy).  考试非常简单。UK noun uncountable
The old people led a life of great simplicity (= with few possessions and little money).  这些老人过着十分简朴的生活，拥有的财产及金钱都不多。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.主要产品;名产;纤维;主要成分,主食
words.example:
Would you mind stapling the reports together ?  你能把报告用订书机订好吗？noun countable
Shortages mean that even staples (= basic foods) like bread are difficult to find.  物资短缺意味着连面包之类的主食都难觅踪影。
Phosphate has been a staple of this area for many years.  磷酸盐多年来一直是这一地区的主要产品。

words.meaning: a.秘(机)密的;表示信任的;担任机密工作的
words.example: All information will be treated as strictly confidential.  所有的情报都将被视作绝密。

words.meaning: a.能和睦相处的,合得来的;兼容的
words.example:
It was when we started living together that we found we just weren't compatible.  等到开始生活在一起时，才发现我们根本合不来。
This software may not be compatible with older operating systems.  该软体可能与较早期的作业系统不相容。
Such policies are not compatible with democratic government.  此类政策与民主政体格格不入。

words.meaning: a.易受影响的;易受感动的;易受感染的
words.example:
She isn't very susceptible to flattery.  她不太听信别人的奉承。
These plants are particularly susceptible to frost.  这些植物很容易受霜冻影响。
Among particularly susceptible children, the disease can develop very fast.  在特别易受感染的儿童中，这种疾病会扩展得非常迅速。

words.meaning: n.(stairway)楼梯
words.example: She descended the sweeping (= long and wide) staircase into the crowd of photographers and journalists.  她走下又长又宽的楼梯，来到摄影师和记者中间。

words.meaning: n.固定设备;预定日期;比赛时间;定期存款
words.example:
All fixtures and fittings are included in the house price.  所有固定装置和可拆除设备都包括在房价里。
figurative They've been together so long he's become a permanent fixture in her life.  他们在一起太久了，他已经成为她生活中不可缺少的一部分。    Compare fittingUK noun countable
Next season's fixtures will be published early next month.  下赛季的赛事日程将在下月初公布。

words.meaning: vt.证明,证实;发证书(或执照)给
words.example:
The meat has been certified (as) fit for human consumption.  已证实该肉品适合人食用。
As a young man, he had been certified and sent to a hospital for the mentally ill.  他年轻时证实患有精神病，并被送到了精神病院。

words.meaning: n.商品,货物
words.example:
Shoppers complained about poor quality merchandise and high prices.  顾客抱怨商品品质差、价格高。
Japan exported $117 billion in merchandise to the US in 1999.  1999年日本向美国出口了价值1170亿美元的商品。verb transitive UK US     US specialized
She had to merchandise the new product line.  她不得不推销这条新产品线。

words.meaning: vi.胜过其他;擅长 vt.胜过,优于
words.example:
Rebecca always excelled in languages at school.  瑞贝卡上学时学语言一直都出类拔萃的。
The British team have excelled themselves this year to reach the finals.  英国队今年超水准发挥，打入了决赛。

words.meaning: a.率直的;钝的 v.(使)钝;(使)迟钝
words.example:
I'll be blunt - that last piece of work you did was terrible.  我就直说了——你创作的最后一件作品糟糕透了。verb transitive
My recent bad experience has rather blunted my enthusiasm for travel.  最近的倒楣经历已经使我对旅游的热情减弱了不少。

words.meaning: n.感激,感谢
words.example:
She sent them a present to show/express her gratitude.  她送了他们一件礼物，以表达她的感激之情。
Take this as a token of my gratitude for all your help.  你帮了我那么多忙，这个就当是我的一点心意吧。

words.meaning: n.皇帝
words.example: The emperor ruled for forty years.  这位皇帝在位四十年。

words.meaning: n.三倍数 a.三倍的;三部分构成的v.使成三倍
words.example:
Her trainer is a triple Olympic champion.  她的教练是三届奥运会冠军。
There's a triple bill of Hitchcock films (= three films) on at the cinema next Sunday.  下周日将有三部希区考克的影片在这家电影院上映。
The number of one-parent U.S. households reached 10.1 million in 1991, nearly triple that of 1971.  1991年美国单亲家庭的数量达到1010万，几乎是1971年的三倍。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.圆筒,圆锥体;汽缸
words.example: Deep-sea divers carry cylinders (= containers) of oxygen on their backs.  深海潜水员背上背有氧气筒。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.自助食堂
words.example: Students eat in the cafeteria.  学生们在自助餐厅吃饭。

words.meaning: a.引起歧义的,模棱两可的,含糊不清的
words.example:
His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.  他对我的提问回答得有些含糊不清。
The wording of the agreement is ambiguous.  该协议的措辞模棱两可。
The government has been ambiguous on this issue.  在此问题上政府立场一直不明确。

words.meaning: a.(honourable)可敬的;荣誉的,光荣的
words.example: He made an honorable decision.  他做了个光明磊落的决定。

words.meaning: n.(一)堆,大量,许多 v.(up)堆,堆起
words.example:
The woman staggered and collapsed in a heap.  那个女人踉跄倒地，蜷曲成一团。noun countable
I've got a whole heap of work to do.  我有很多工作要做。verb transitive + adverb or preposition
He heaped more food onto his plate.  他在他的盘子里堆了更多的食物。verb transitive + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n./v.溜,滑行;(时间)消逝
words.example:
She came gliding gracefully into the ballroom in a long flowing gown.  她身穿一袭飘逸的礼服，优雅轻盈地快步走进舞厅。
Some people glide effortlessly through life with no real worries.  有些人一生过得轻松自在，无忧无虑。verb
We saw a condor gliding high above the mountains.  我们看到一只秃鹫在群山上空翱翔。

words.meaning: v.铺砌,铺(路)
words.example:
The area from the shops to the beach is paved with bricks set in patterns.  商店到海滩的这个区域是用拼花砖铺成的。verb transitive
Scientists hope that data from the probe will pave the way for a more detailed exploration of Mars.  科学家希望探测船传回的数据会为更深入的火星探索提供条件。verb transitive
Unemployed youngsters still come to London in their hundreds thinking that the streets are paved with gold.  失业的年轻人继续成百上千地来到伦敦，认为这里遍地都是黄金。

words.meaning: a.传染的,传染性的,有感染力的
words.example: an infectious disease/patient  传染病／传染病病人

words.meaning: n.共产主义
words.example: They studied the history of communism.  他们研究共产主义历史。

words.meaning: a.在前的,在先的
words.example:
The paintings are a development of ideas she explored in the preceding decade.  这些画是她十年以来探索思想的成果。
In conclusion, I hope the preceding arguments have convinced you of the need for action.  总之，我希望前面的论证已使你相信采取行动是必要的。

words.meaning: n.预防,谨慎,警惕
words.example:
Many people have been stockpiling food as a precaution against shortages.  为了预防食物短缺，很多人一直在大量储备食品。
They failed to take the necessary precautions to avoid infection.  他们未能采取必要的预防措施来避免感染。
If you're going to have sex, make sure you take precautions.  发生性行为一定要采取避孕措施。

words.meaning: v.油煎,油炸
words.example:
Fry the mushrooms in a little butter.  用少许牛油煎一下蘑菇。
informal figurative You'll fry (= burn) if you lie in the sun all day.  你如果整天躺在阳光下会晒伤的。plural noun

words.meaning: a.性质上的,定性的
words.example:
Is there any qualitative difference between these two video recorders?  这两台录影机在品质上有差别吗？UK US  formal
There has been a qualitative change in the relationship between the public and the government.  民众和政府之间的关系有了性质上的改变。    Compare quantitative

words.meaning: a./n.红外线(的)
words.example: Their pilots are guided by an infrared optical system that shows images clearly even at night.  他们的飞行员使用红外线光学系统导航，即使在晚上也能清楚地显示影像。

words.meaning: n.敬畏,惊惧vt.使敬畏,使惊惧
words.example:
I've always held musicians in awe.  我对音乐家们总是肃然起敬。
As children we were rather in awe of our grandfather.  小时候，我们对祖父非常敬畏。
You can't help but stand in awe of (= respect greatly and fear slightly) powerful people.  在权势人物面前，你不由自主会毕恭毕敬。UK verb transitive ( UK aweing or US awing)

words.meaning: ad.不变地,永恒地,总是
words.example: The train is invariably late.  火车总是延误。

words.meaning: n.侦察员,侦察机(舰) v.搜索,侦察
words.example:
Manchester United's chief scout spotted him when he was playing for his school football team.  他在校足球队踢球时，曼联队的首席球探就看上了他。
He's scouting about/around for somewhere better to live.  他到处寻找更好的住处。
She's opened an office in Connecticut to scout out (= discover information about) the east coast housing market.  她在康乃狄克州开了一家办事处，搜集东海岸房产市场的资讯。

words.meaning: n.(无线电或电视的)天线
words.example: Her finely-tuned political antennae helped her to sense problems that less-experienced politicians might not detect.  她敏锐的政治嗅觉使她可以意识到一些问题，而经验不足的从政者却可能觉察不到。noun

words.meaning: a.似是而非的,似乎合理的,似乎可信的
words.example: a plausible explanation/excuse  貌似有理的解释／借口

words.meaning: a.精力旺盛的;积极的;有力的
words.example: an energetic young woman  精力充沛的年轻女子

words.meaning: v.商讨;授予,颁给(勋衔,学位等)
words.example: An honorary doctorate was conferred on him by Edinburgh University.  爱丁堡大学授予他荣誉博士学位。

words.meaning: v.(paralyse)使瘫痪(麻痹);使丧失作用
words.example: Fear can paralyze your thinking.  恐惧会让你无法思考。

words.meaning: vt.使困窘,使局促不安;阻碍,麻烦
words.example: You're embarrassing him with your compliments!  你的赞美之词使他很不好意思。

words.meaning: a.热的,热力的;(小规模的)上升气流
words.example: It was the Romans who first recognised the medicinal benefits of Hungary's thermal springs (= ones which produce hot water).  是罗马人首先认识到匈牙利温泉的医疗效用。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.白天,日间
words.example: a regular daytime job  有规律的在白天上班的工作

words.meaning: v.使加固,使加强;(把...)联为一体,合并
words.example:
The success of their major product consolidated the firm's position in the market.  公司主打产品取得的成功巩固了该公司在市场上的地位。
She hoped that marriage would consolidate their relationship.  她希望婚姻能巩固他们的关系。
The party consolidated its hold on power during its term of office.  该党在执政期间加强了对政权的控制。

words.meaning: vt.唤醒,叫醒;唤起,激起
words.example:
It's a subject which has aroused a lot of interest.  这个话题引起了很多人的兴趣。
Our suspicions were first aroused when we heard a muffled scream.  我们听到一声闷声尖叫，就开始起了疑心。

words.meaning: a.牙齿的;牙科(用)的
words.example: dental decay/treatment  牙齿腐蚀／牙科治疗

words.meaning: n.餐巾,餐巾纸,<英>尿布
words.example: Wipe your hands with the napkin.  用餐巾擦擦手。

words.meaning: vi.卸货;退子弹 vt.摆脱...之负担;倾销
words.example:
We watched a ship unloading (sacks of flour).  我们观看了一艘货轮卸货（我们看着一袋袋面粉从货轮上卸下来）。UK verb
I'm afraid I've been unloading my worries on poor Ann here.  恐怕我是把自己的担忧都一股脑儿倾倒给可怜的安了。

words.meaning: a.富裕的,富有的,丰富的,富饶的
words.example: affluent nations/neighbourhoods  富有国家／富人区

words.meaning: v./n.呻吟
words.example:
We could hear the groans of the wounded soldiers.  我们能听到伤兵们的呻吟声。
He looked at the piles of dirty dishes and gave a groan of dismay.  他看着成堆的脏碟子，发出一声沮丧的叹息。UK verb intransitive
He collapsed, groaning with pain.  他痛苦地呻吟着倒了下去

words.meaning: v.住,居留
words.example:
She dwelt in remote parts of Asia for many years.  她在亚洲偏远地区居住了很多年。 (dwelt or dwelled, dwelt or dwelled)    formal
In his speech, he dwelt on the plight of the sick and the hungry.  演讲时他一直在说遭受疾病和饥饿折磨的人们所处的困境。

words.meaning: n.功绩,伟业,技艺
words.example:
The Eiffel Tower is a remarkable feat of engineering.  艾菲尔铁塔是工程技术上的一大非凡杰作。
She's performed remarkable feats of organization for the office.  她为办事处所做的组织工作成绩斐然。noun countable
Getting the job finished in under a week was no mean feat.  一周内就把这项任务完成了，真了不起。

words.meaning: a.好战的,富于战斗性的 n.斗士
words.example: The group has taken a militant position on the abortion issue and is refusing to compromise.  这个团体在堕胎问题上采取强硬立场，不肯妥协。

words.meaning: n.手电筒;火炬,火把
words.example:
She flashed/shone the torch into the dark room.  她用手电筒照了照黑暗的房间。
literary Many buildings were put to the torch (= burned intentionally) during the riots.  暴乱中，许多建筑物被付之一炬。
We must not let the burning torch of socialism go out.  我们不能让熊熊燃烧的社会主义火炬熄灭。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.干草
words.example: The hay was left to dry in the sun.  干草摊开在太阳下晒。

words.meaning: n.矮子,侏儒,矮小的动植物 vt.使…矮小
words.example:
You can grow dwarf conifers in pots on the patio.  你可以在阳台上种些矮小的针叶树盆栽。UK verb transitive
The new skyscraper will dwarf all those near it.  新建的摩天大楼跟周围的建筑相比鹤立鸡群。
This new crisis may well dwarf most that have gone before.  这场新的危机可能比以往的大多数危机都严重得多。

words.meaning: vi.(使)结束,(使)停止
words.example:
They terminated my contract in October.  他们在十月终止了我的合约。
This train will terminate at the next stop - passengers who wish to continue should change trains.  下一站就是本次列车的终点，想继续行程的乘客请换车。UK US  formal

words.meaning: n.女主人;主妇;情妇,情人
words.example:
I'll inform the mistress (of the house) of your arrival, madam.  夫人，我去告诉女主人您来了。
She intends to remain mistress of (= in charge of) her own life when she gets married.  她想在结婚后仍做自己生活的主人。
She got a good report from her German mistress.  她的德语女教师给了她很好的成绩。

words.meaning: n.(manoeuvre)机动;运用,操作; v.机动
words.example: The driver made a skillful maneuver.  司机做了一个熟练的闪避动作。

words.meaning: n./v.拥挤;聚集v.(因寒冷、害怕而)缩成一团
words.example:
Everyone huddled round the fire to keep warm.  所有人都挤在炉火旁取暖。
It was so cold that we huddled together for warmth.  太冷了，我们只好挤在一起取暖。
Sophie was so frightened by the noise of the fireworks that she huddled (up) in a corner of the room.  苏菲被烟火爆竹的声音吓坏了，在屋角缩成一团。noun countable

words.meaning: n./v.海盗,盗版(者)
words.example: software pirates  软体侵权者

words.meaning: n.失事船(或飞机)v.(船等)失事,遇难;破坏
words.example:
The explosion shattered nearby windows and wrecked two cars.  爆炸震碎了附近的窗子，并毁坏了两辆汽车。
Our greenhouse was wrecked in last night's storm.  我们的温室在昨晚的暴风雨中遭到破坏。
He has been warned that his behaviour might wreck his chances of promotion.  有人警告他说，他的行为可能会毁掉自己晋升的机会。noun countable

words.meaning: a.男性的,似男性的;[语法]阳性的
words.example: The French word for 'sun' is masculine - 'le soleil', but the German word is feminine - 'die Sonne'.  法语中“太阳”一词le soleil是阳性的，但德语中的对应词die Sonne却是阴性的。

words.meaning: n.珍珠
words.example:
He gave her pearls for her birthday.  他送珍珠首饰给她作为生日礼物。
There were pearls of dew on the grass.  草地上有点点露珠。
Inexhaustible patience is a pearl of great price.  无尽的耐心是难能可贵的。

words.meaning: n.薄暮,黄昏
words.example: As dusk fell , bats began to fly between the trees.  黄昏降临的时候蝙蝠开始在树木间飞来飞去。

words.meaning: n.排列,部署;性格倾向;倾向,意向
words.example: She is of a nervous/cheerful/sunny disposition.  她神经质／性情开朗／性格阳光。

words.meaning: n.蜡,蜂蜡 v.打蜡
words.example:
She watched the wax as it dripped down the side of the candle.  她注视着蜡从蜡烛边缘滴落下来。
I've waxed the floor so I'm afraid it's a bit slippery.  我刚给地板打了蜡，所以恐怕会有点滑。verb
My mother, a Spaniard, always used to wax lyrical about the lemon trees in the family garden.  我母亲是西班牙人，过去总是会深情地谈起她家中花园里的那些柠檬树。verb

words.meaning: v./n.哭泣,呜咽
words.example: You're not going to help matters by lying there sobbing!  你躺在那里哭并不能解决问题！UK US  (-bb-)

words.meaning: n.裤子
words.example: Why aren't you wearing any trousers, David?  戴维，你为甚么不穿长裤呢？

words.meaning: n.社会主义
words.example: He lectured on socialism.  他讲授社会主义。

words.meaning: a.优美的,文雅的,大方的
words.example: She finally apologized, but she wasn't very graceful about it.  她最后道了歉，但是态度有些勉强。

words.meaning: n.木偶,傀儡
words.example:
We took the children to a puppet show/theatre.  我们带孩子去看了木偶剧。
Western powers have been accused of trying to establish a puppet government/regime in the divided country.  西方列强被指责企图在这个分裂国家建立傀儡政府。

words.meaning: a.灾难性的
words.example:
Such a war would be disastrous for the country.  这样一场战争会给国家带来灾难性的后果。
This decision will have a disastrous impact on foreign policy.  这个决定将对外交政策产生极为不利的影响。
His first attempt was disastrous.  他第一次尝试败得很惨。

words.meaning: a.复杂的,错综的,难以理解的
words.example:
The watch mechanism is extremely intricate and very difficult to repair.  手表的机械结构非常复杂精密，很难修理。
Police officers uncovered an intricate web of deceit.  警官揭开了一个错综复杂的网路骗局。

words.meaning: n.御座,宝座;王位,王权
words.example:
Elizabeth II ascended/came to the throne (= became queen of Britain) when her father died.  伊丽莎白二世在她父亲逝世后登上王位。
Queen Victoria was on the throne (= was queen) at that time.  那时维多利亚女王在位。
Charles is next in line to the throne (= will become king next).  查理斯将继承王位。

words.meaning: n.果园,果园里的全部果树,<美俚>棒球场
words.example: an apple/cherry orchard  苹果／樱桃园

words.meaning: n.胶,胶水 v.胶合,粘贴
words.example:
Is it worth trying to glue this plate back together?  还值得把这个碟子重新黏好吗？
I've nearly finished making my model aeroplane - I just have to glue the wings on.  我快把飞机模型做好了——只需把机翼黏上就行。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition (glueing or gluing, glued, glued)
We were glued to the television watching the election results come in.  我们目不转睛地盯着电视，等待大选结果揭晓。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition (glueing or gluing, glued, glued)

words.meaning: n.人类
words.example: Mankind has always been obsessed by power.  人类总是迷恋权力。    Compare womankind

words.meaning: n.汽轮机,涡轮机
words.example: a steam turbine  汽轮机

words.meaning: n.行李
words.example:
How many pieces of baggage do you have?  你有多少件行李？
We had to pay extra for our excess baggage (= our bags and cases which weighed more than was allowed).  我们必须为超重的行李额外付款。noun uncountable
We all carry a lot of emotional baggage around with us.  我们每个人都有许多感情的负担。

words.meaning: a.荒凉的;冷酷的;没有希望的
words.example:
The house stands on a bleak, windswept moor.  这座房子坐落在一片饱受风雨侵袭的荒野上。
The economic outlook is bleak.  经济前景暗淡。

words.meaning: n.挫折;失效;复发;倒退
words.example:
Sally had been recovering well from her operation, but yesterday she experienced/suffered a setback.  莎莉手术后一直恢复良好，但昨天她的病情再度复发。
There has been a slight/temporary setback in our plans.  我们的计划遭到了一点／暂时的挫败。

words.meaning: a.得不到休息的;不平静的;坐立不安的
words.example:
He's a restless type - he never stays in one country for long.  他是那种呆不住的人——他从来不在一个国家呆太长的时间。
She spent a restless night (= She did not sleep well) , tossing and turning.  她在床上辗转反侧，一夜无眠。

words.meaning: n.日出,拂晓;朝霞
words.example:
They went out at sunrise to go bird-watching.  他们日出的时候就出去赏鸟了。
We have to leave before sun-up tomorrow.  我们明天得在日出之前离开。
There was a beautiful sunrise this morning.  今天早上的朝霞很美。

words.meaning: n.图表;图解
words.example: The teacher drew a diagram showing how the blood flows through the heart.  老师画了一张示意图来说明血液如何进出心脏。

words.meaning: n.梳子 v.梳(理)
words.example:
She combed her hair and put on some lipstick.  她梳好头发，涂了点口红。
I've been trying to comb out (= remove using a comb) the knots in her hair.  我一直想把她头发上的结梳开。UK verb transitive
The police combed the whole area for evidence.  警方为了寻找证据搜遍了整个地区。

words.meaning: n.行李,皮箱
words.example: Never leave your luggage unattended.  决不要把行李放在没人看管的地方。

words.meaning: vt.猛投,力掷;大声叫骂
words.example:
In a fit of temper he hurled the book across the room.  他一怒之下把书本扔到房间的另一边。
Youths hurled stones at the soldiers.  年轻人向士兵们投掷石头。

words.meaning: n.磨擦,摩擦力
words.example:
When you rub your hands together the friction produces heat.  揉搓双手时，摩擦会产生热量。noun uncountable
There's a lot of friction between my wife and my mother.  我妻子和我母亲之间有很多龃龉。
Politics is a source of considerable friction in our family.  政治问题在我们家是矛盾的一大根源。

words.meaning: v.供应,提供;装备,布置
words.example:
They've furnished the room very simply.  他们把房间布置得很简单。UK verb transitive
Furnished with a compass and sandwiches, they set off for a day's hiking.  他们带着罗盘和三明治开始了一天的徒步旅行。

words.meaning: a.(在或来自)空中的,航空的 n.天线
words.example: Meanwhile, the massive aerial bombardment/bombing of military targets continued unabated.  同时，对于军事目标的大规模空袭仍进行得如火如荼。

words.meaning: a.繁荣的,兴旺的,茂盛的,顺利的
words.example: In a prosperous country like this, no one should go hungry.  在这样一个繁荣的国家里，不应该有人挨饿。

words.meaning: vi./n.痴笑;咯咯地笑 vt.咯咯地笑着说
words.example:
Stop that giggling at the back!  别在后面傻笑！noun
There were a few nervous giggles from people in the audience.  观众中有人发出几声紧张的笑声。
Just for a giggle, we hid his trousers while he was in the water.  他在水里的时候，我们把他的裤子藏了起来，这纯粹为了好玩。

words.meaning: n.家族,亲属,血缘关系 a.亲属关系的,同类的
words.example: We can't release his name until we have informed his next of kin.  在通知他的直系亲属前，我们不能透露他的名字。

words.meaning: n.关税,税率;(旅馆,饭店等)价目表,收费表
words.example: The tariff on cars was cut.  汽车关税下调了。

words.meaning: a.无知的,愚昧的;不知道的
words.example:
Many teenagers are surprisingly ignorant about current politics.  许多青少年对时事政治无知得让人吃惊。
We remained blissfully ignorant of the troubles that lay ahead.  我们对将要出现的麻烦一无所知，这或许是一种幸运。
Ignorant lout!  没礼貌的混蛋！

words.meaning: n./v.假装,伪装
words.example:
Minor skin imperfections can usually be disguised with a spot of make-up.  微小的皮肤瑕疵通常可以用化妆品来掩盖。
We tried to disguise the fact that it was just a school hall by putting up coloured lights and balloons.  我们不想让人看出这里实际上只是挂着彩灯和气球的学校礼堂。
He put on a large hat and glasses as a disguise and hoped no one would recognise him.  他戴上大帽子和眼镜来伪装自己，希望没人会认出他来。

words.meaning: n.滴答声;勾号 v.滴答响;打勾号于
words.example:
Put a tick by/against the names of the people who have accepted the invitation.  在接受邀请的人的姓名上打钩。noun
Hold on/Hang on a tick - I'm not quite ready.  稍等一会儿——我还没准备好。
I'll be with you in a tick /in two ticks.  我马上就到。noun

words.meaning: v.孵,孵出;策划,图谋 n.舱口,小门
words.example: It was in August of 1978 that the Bolton brothers hatched their plot to kill their parents.  那是在1978年的8月，博尔顿兄弟策划了杀害他们父母的计划。noun countable (also hatchway)

words.meaning: v.吃饭,进餐
words.example:
We dined by candlelight.  我们在烛光下吃晚餐。
He once dined with the President of France.  他曾经跟法国总统共进晚餐。 formal
We dined on salmon and strawberries.  我们那顿饭吃的是鲑鱼和草莓。 formal

words.meaning: vt.修改,修订,改进
words.example:
MPs were urged to amend the law to prevent another oil tanker disaster.  下院议员被敦促修订该法律，以防止油轮泄漏灾难再次发生。
In line 20, 'men' should be amended (= changed) to 'people'.  第20行中的 men 应改为 people。
Until the constitution is amended, the power to appoint ministers will remain with the president.  在宪法修正之前，总统仍然有权任命部长。

words.meaning: ad./a.向旁边(的),侧身,横着(的),斜着(的)
words.example:
The fence is leaning sideways.  栅栏向一边倾斜。
If you would move sideways to the left, I can get everyone in the picture.  如果你能向左移一点，我就可以把所有人都拍进照片里。

words.meaning: n.模仿,仿效;仿制;仿造品
words.example:
It's not real silk - it's just imitation.  这不是真丝——不过是仿制的。noun
Ten-year-olds have started wearing lipstick and make-up in imitation of the older girls.  十岁的女孩子已经开始模仿年长的女孩涂抹口红和化妆了。
She can do a wonderful imitation of a blackbird's song.  她能唯妙唯肖地模仿乌鸫的鸣啭。

words.meaning: n.大教堂
words.example: Salisbury Cathedral  索尔斯堡主教堂

words.meaning: adj.自私的,利己的
words.example: The judge told him: "Your attitude shows a selfish disregard for others."  法官告诉他：“你的态度表明你只顾自己而不顾他人。”

words.meaning: a.交替的,轮流的 v.(使)交替,(使)轮流
words.example:
She alternated between cheerfulness and deep despair.  她时而情绪亢奋，时而又深陷绝望之中。
He alternated working in the office with long tours overseas.  他在办公室工作一段时间后就会安排一次海外长途旅行。adjective [before noun] UK US [ɑːlˈtɜ˞ː-/
Private cars are banned from the city on alternate days.  该市私家车限隔日出行。

words.meaning: v.点火,引燃
words.example:
The fuel spontaneously ignites because of the high temperature and pressure.  燃料因高温和高压而自燃。
The proposed restrictions have ignited a storm of protest.  拟议中的限制规定激起了抗议的浪潮。

words.meaning: n.恃强欺弱者,小流氓 vt.威胁,欺侮
words.example:
Our survey indicates that one in four children is bullied at school.  我们的调查表明，有四分之一的孩子在学校受到欺凌。
Don't let anyone bully you into doing something you don't want to do.  别让任何人胁迫你做你不愿做的事情。noun countable
You're just a big bully!  你欺负人！

words.meaning: v.(使)旋转;考虑;【天】公转,循环
words.example:
The Earth revolves around the sun.  地球围绕太阳转。
The gun turret revolved until the gun was aimed at the advancing soldiers.  炮塔旋转着，最后炮口瞄准了正在前进的士兵。UK verb intransitive or transitive
The conversation revolved around childcare problems.  这次会谈的中心议题是儿童保育方面的问题。

words.meaning: v.弄污,弄脏,毒害,传染,染污
words.example:
Much of the coast has been contaminated by nuclear waste.  大部分海岸已受到核废料污染。
The food which had been contaminated was destroyed.  受污染的食物已被销毁了。

words.meaning: vt.抑制,约束
words.example:
Some workers were inhibited (from speaking) by the presence of their managers.  一些工人在他们的经理面前不敢讲话。
This drug inhibits the growth of tumours.  这种药可以抑制肿瘤的生长。

words.meaning: n.情况,状态,困境,盟誓(婚姻) v.保证,约定
words.example: Few of us can be unmoved by the plight of the Romanian orphans.  我们几乎无一不为罗马尼亚孤儿的困难处境而心有所感。verb old use or humorous

words.meaning: v.(使)分散;(使)散开;疏散
words.example:
When the rain came down the crowds started to disperse.  雨下来时人群开始四处散开。
Police dispersed the crowd that had gathered.  员警驱散了聚在一起的人群。

words.meaning: a.空的,中空的;空洞的,空虚的 v.挖空,凿空
words.example:
Hollow blocks are used because they are lighter.  使用空心砖是因为它们更轻。
It was something of a hollow victory - she won the case but lost all her savings in legal fees.  这是一个毫无价值的胜利——她赢了诉讼，却也为此花光了所有积蓄。
Even sex had become a hollow pleasure.  甚至连性都变得无聊乏味，失去了原有的乐趣。

words.meaning: a.清醒的;认真的,冷静的,适度的
words.example:
Are you sober enough to drive, Jim?  吉姆，你够不够清醒，可以开车吗？
I'd had no wine all evening so I was stone cold (= completely) sober.  我一晚上没有喝酒，所以我非常清醒。UK adjective
In fact the whole wedding was a sober affair - no dancing, just people standing around in groups chatting politely.  事实上，整场婚礼气氛很严肃——没有人跳舞，人们只是聚在一起礼貌地交谈。

words.meaning: n.锯子,锯床 v.锯,锯开
words.example: a hand/power/chain/circular saw  手锯／电锯／链锯／圆锯

words.meaning: n.(英国)小酒店;小旅馆
words.example:
Do you want to go to / informalgo down the pub after work?  你下班后想去酒吧吗？
a pub lunch.  酒吧午餐

words.meaning: n.同志,同事,同伴,朋友
words.example:
Many of his comrades were killed in the battle.  他的许多战友死在战场上。UK noun countable
[as form of address] Welcome to the conference, comrades.  各位同志，欢迎你们参加本次大会。

words.meaning: n.虹
words.example: The tropical butterfly's wings were shimmering with all the colours of the rainbow.  热带蝴蝶的翅膀像彩虹一样闪烁着五彩缤纷的色彩。

words.meaning: n.(madam)夫人,太太,女士
words.example: Madame Curie won two Nobel Prizes.  居里夫人得了两次诺贝尔奖。

words.meaning: a.欢乐的,愉快的
words.example:
She's a merry little soul.  她是个快乐的小家伙。adjective
You got a bit merry last night, didn't you Cath?  你昨晚有点醉了，是吧，卡瑟？adjective
Hello, Phoebe. Merry Christmas!  你好，菲比。圣诞快乐！

words.meaning: a.(指价值、性质)固有的,本质的,内在的
words.example: Maths is an intrinsic part of the school curriculum.  数学是中小学的基础课。

words.meaning: a.符合的,相应的,对应的
words.example:
Company losses were 50 per cent worse than in the corresponding period last year.  与去年同期相比，公司亏损增加了50%。
As the course becomes more difficult, there's usually a corresponding drop in attendance.  随着课程逐渐变难，来上课的人也越来越少了。

words.meaning: n.小睡,打盹
words.example:
Grandpa usually has/takes a nap after lunch.  爷爷通常在午饭后小睡片刻。noun
He likes to nap for an hour when he gets home from work.  他喜欢下班回家后小睡一个小时。

words.meaning: a.不耐烦的,急躁的
words.example:
He's a good teacher, but inclined to be a bit impatient with slow learners.  他是个好老师，但对学得慢的学生却总有些不耐烦。
You'd be hopeless looking after children - you're far too impatient!  照顾孩子你是不行的——你太没有耐心了！
He's got a lot of exciting ideas and he's impatient to get started.  他有许多好主意，迫不及待地想动手做。

words.meaning: ad.一会儿,不久;现在,目前
words.example:
Of 200 boats, only 20 are presently operational.  200艘船中，目前只有20艘可用。
Three sites are presently under consideration for the new hotel.  目前这家新饭店的选址有三个地点在考虑中。adverb
The room was hot and presently her eyes grew heavy and she began to feel sleepy.  屋子里很热，一会儿她就觉得眼皮沉重，昏昏欲睡。

words.meaning: v.(使)饿死,饿得慌,挨饿
words.example:
Whole communities starved to death during the long drought.  在这场漫长的大旱中，整个村落的人都饿死了。
From talking to former prisoners in the camps, an obvious conclusion is that they have been starved.  透过和从集中营出来的囚犯谈话，一个很明显的感觉就是他们一直在挨饿。
People starved of sleep start to lose their concentration and may hallucinate.  睡眠严重不足的人开始注意力不集中，而且可能会产生幻觉。

words.meaning: v.损害,损伤;削弱,减少
words.example: Noise impairs concentration.  噪音损害注意力。

words.meaning: n.剃刀
words.example:
Do you use an electric razor or the kind that you have to put a razor blade in?  你用的是电动刮须刀还是那种要装刀片的刮胡刀？UK noun countable
Allegations of fraud have put the minister's career on a razor edge.  由于被指控有欺诈行为，这位部长的职业生涯岌岌可危。UK verb transitive
My hairdresser always razors my fringe to give a soft effect.  我的理发师总是把我的浏海用剃刀刮一下，使它变得轻柔一些。

words.meaning: a.肥沃的,富饶的;能繁殖的
words.example:
People get less fertile as they get older.  随着年龄增长，人的生育能力逐渐下降。    Opposite infertile
British politics remains very fertile ground for comedy.  英国政治依然为喜剧提供丰富的素材。

words.meaning: v.要求归还,收回;开垦
words.example: You'll be able to reclaim the tax on all equipment that you buy.  你们采购所有设备所付的税款以后都可以退回。

words.meaning: n.散文 a.散文的
words.example: I've always preferred reading prose to poetry.  我一直偏好读散文而不是诗歌。    Compare verse

words.meaning: n.厌恶,恶心 v.使厌恶
words.example:
She walked out in disgust.  她厌恶地走了出去。
We are demonstrating to show our anger and disgust at the treatment of refugees.  我们示威是对难民受到的待遇表示愤怒和憎恶。
He resigned from the committee in disgust at the corruption.  出于对腐败的憎恶，他辞去了在该委员会的职务。

words.meaning: a.及时的,适时的
words.example: The change in the exchange rate provided a timely boost to the company's falling profits.  汇率的变动及时缓解了公司利润下滑的局面。

words.meaning: n.狐狸
words.example:
He's a cunning/sly/wily old fox.  他是一个狡猾／阴险／诡计多端的老狐狸。UK noun
This puzzle has well and truly foxed me!  这个谜真把我给难住了！UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.厄运,劫数 v.注定,命定
words.example:
The newspapers are always full of doom and gloom (= bad news and unhappiness) these days.  如今报纸上总是报道一些不幸的新闻消息。verb transitive usually passive
Mounting debts doomed the factory to closure.  债台高筑使工厂无法逃脱关闭的命运。

words.meaning: n.侄女,甥女
words.example: My niece starts school this year.  我侄女今年上学。

words.meaning: n.安排,布局,设计;规划图,布局图
words.example: Application forms vary greatly in layout and length.  申请表在格式和篇幅上差别很大。

words.meaning: num./a.八十 pron.八十(个,只...)
words.example: They've invited eighty (guests) to the wedding.  他们邀请了80个（客）人参加他们的婚礼。

words.meaning: n.汉堡包,牛肉饼
words.example: He ordered a hamburger and fries.  他点了汉堡和薯条。

words.meaning: vt.废除(法律、习惯等);取消
words.example: National Service was abolished in Britain in 1962.  英国的国民兵役制度于1962年废止。

words.meaning: a.偶然的;意外的;无意中的
words.example:
Reports suggest that 11 soldiers were killed by accidental fire from their own side.  报导暗示11名士兵被己方炮火误射而丧生。
The site was located after the accidental discovery of bones in a field.  有人在田地里意外地发现遗骨后，这个遗址才被发现。

words.meaning: n.胶囊;太空舱
words.example: The capsule landed in the ocean.  太空舱降落在海里。

words.meaning: n.杆,杠杆,手段,途径,工具
words.example: Push the lever forward to start.  把操纵杆往前推启动。

words.meaning: n.班机,定期轮船,邮船
words.example: The liner docked at noon.  客轮中午靠了岸。

words.meaning: n.图书管理员
words.example: The librarian helped me find the book.  图书管理员帮我找到了书。

words.meaning: vt.解放,释放
words.example:
They said they sent troops in to liberate the people/the country from a dictator.  他们称他们向该国派出军队是要把那里的人民／那个国家从独裁者手中解放出来。
She liberated those spoons from a restaurant last week.  上周她从一家餐厅偷了那些汤匙。

words.meaning: n.预言家;先知;提倡者
words.example:
Let us hear the words of the prophet Isaiah on the coming of the Prince of Peace.  让我们聆听先知以赛亚关于和平之王来临的预言。
The prophets of doom have been predicting the end of European cinema for the last ten years.  那些悲观的预言者过去十年里一直在预言欧洲电影的末日。

words.meaning: n.转向,转移;牵制;解闷;娱乐
words.example:
Traffic diversions will be kept to a minimum throughout the festival.  在节日期间，尽量不实行交通禁行措施。
Shoplifters often work in pairs, with one creating a diversion (= an action that takes someone's attention away from something) to distract the shop assistants while the other steals the goods.  商店窃贼通常结伙作案，一人转移店员的注意力，另一人则偷盗货物。
Reading is a pleasant diversion.  阅读是一种愉快的消遣。

words.meaning: vi.吃青草 vt.放牧;擦伤;掠过 .n.擦伤(处)
words.example:
He fell down and grazed his knee.  他摔倒时擦伤了膝盖。
He was lucky, the bullet just grazed his leg.  他很幸运，子弹只是擦伤了他的腿。
The aircraft's landing gear grazed the treetops as it landed.  飞机在降落时，起落架掠过树梢。verb

words.meaning: a.下等的,下级的;劣等的,差的 n.下级,晚辈
words.example:
These products are inferior to those we bought last year.  这些产品比我们去年买的差些。
She cited cases in which women had received inferior health care.  她引用了一些妇女得到低劣保健服务的事例。
It was clear the group were regarded as intellectually/morally/socially inferior.  很明显的是，这个群体被认为在智力／道德水准／社会地位上很低下。    Compare superior    specialized

words.meaning: n.孤儿
words.example:
The civil war is making orphans of many children.  内战正使许多孩子沦为孤儿。UK verb transitive usually passive
He was orphaned as a baby (= His parents died when he was a baby).  他尚在繦褓中时，就成了孤儿。
The children were orphaned by the war (= their parents were killed in the war).  战争使这些孩子成为孤儿。

words.meaning: v.减轻,缓和,缓解(痛苦等)
words.example: The drugs did nothing to alleviate her pain/suffering.  这些药物对减轻她的病痛／痛苦没有丝毫作用。

words.meaning: n.小旅馆,客栈
words.example: the Holiday Inn, Harrogate  哈罗盖特假日酒店

words.meaning: n.(陆军)上校
words.example: Colonel is the military rank between lieutenant-colonel and brigadier.  上校是介于中校和准将之间的军衔。

words.meaning: n.卷筒,线轴 v.卷,绕
words.example:
At closing time he reeled out of the pub and fell down on the pavement.  酒吧关门时，他踉踉跄跄走了出来，一跤摔在人行道上。
She hit him so hard that he reeled backwards.  她出手太重，打得他朝后打了个趔趄。
We were reeling (in amazement/shock/delight, etc.) from/with the news that we had won all that money.  得知赢了那么多钱，我们都（惊愕得／震惊得／高兴得）发蒙了。verb intransitive

words.meaning: vt.扩大,放大,增大
words.example:
They've enlarged the kitchen by building over part of the garden.  他们占用一部分花园扩建了厨房。
Would you care to enlarge on what you've just said?  您能否再进一步阐述一下您刚才讲过的内容？

words.meaning: v.(使)逐步增长(或发展),(使)逐步升级
words.example:
The decision to escalate UN involvement has been taken in the hopes of a swift end to the hostilities.  已决定加大联合国介入的程度，以期尽快结束战争。
His financial problems escalated after he became unemployed.  他失业后，经济问题更是雪上加霜。
The escalating rate of inflation will almost certainly bring escalating prices.  通货膨胀率的不断上升几乎肯定会导致物价攀升。

words.meaning: a.顽固的,倔强的;难对付的,难以克服的
words.example:
They have massive rows because they're both so stubborn.  他们俩吵得很凶，因为他们两个人都很固执。
He was famed for his stubborn resistance and his refusal to accept defeat.  他以顽强抵抗、不甘失败著称。
Stubborn stains can be removed using a small amount of detergent.  使用少量清洁剂即可去除顽渍。UK US  mainly disapproving

words.meaning: v.嘲笑 a.假的,模拟的 n.(常pl.)模拟考试
words.example:
They were mocking him because he kept falling off his bike.  他们不断嘲笑他，因为他老是从脚踏车上摔下来。
She made fun of him by mocking his limp.  她模仿他一瘸一拐地走路来取笑他。
The wind mocked their attempts to reach the shore by pushing the boat further and further out to sea.  风把船往海里刮得越来越远，使他们靠岸的努力落空。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.游泳,洗澡,浸,弄湿
words.example:
Children suffering from the illness had bathed in sea water contaminated by sewage.  患上这个病的孩子都在遭污水污染的海水里游过泳。verb
In the afternoon the sun bathes the city in shades of pink and gold.  午后，城市沐浴在粉红色和金黄色的阳光里。verb

words.meaning: v.防止,避免 ;转移(目光、注意力等)
words.example: We tried to avert our thoughts from our massive financial problems.  我们尽量不去想我们面临的严重财政问题。

words.meaning: v.耽搁;扣押,拘留
words.example:
Several of the injured were detained overnight in hospital.  伤者中有几个人被留院观察了一晚。
I'm sorry I'm late - I was unavoidably detained.  对不起我来晚了——没办法我被耽搁了一会儿。

words.meaning: a.任意的,任性的,主观的;专断的,武断的
words.example:
What guided your choice of destination or was it arbitrary?  你根据甚么选择目的地？还是随意选定的？UK adjective
The company has been the subject of an arbitrary take-over.  这家公司被强行接管。

words.meaning: n.相似,相似性[点,物]
words.example:
There was a clear family resemblance between all the brothers.  所有兄弟都长得很像，一眼就看得出是一家人。
These prices bear no resemblance to (= are completely different from) the ones I saw printed in the newspaper.  这些价格和我在报纸上看到的大相径庭。

words.meaning: n.接合,连接,联合;连(接)词
words.example:
An unfortunate conjunction of circumstances led to his downfall.  一连串不幸事件同时发生，导致了他的下台。
There is a team of writers working in conjunction (with each other) on the book.  有一个作家小组在合作撰写这部书。
Mars and Venus will be in exact conjunction on the first of September.  火星和金星在9月1日会正好相合。

words.meaning: n.蓝图,设计图,计划 vt.制成蓝图,计划
words.example: their blueprint for economic reform  他们的经济改革计划

words.meaning: n.(pl.)问候,致意 n./v.称赞,恭维
words.example:
She complained that her husband never paid her any compliments any more.  她抱怨说丈夫再也不赞美她了。
Are you fishing for (= trying to get) compliments?  你在沽名钓誉吗？
You should take it as a compliment when I fall asleep in your company - it means I'm relaxed.  我在你面前睡着了你应该感到荣幸——这意味着我很放心。

words.meaning: n.步行者 a.徒步的,呆板的,通俗的
words.example:
The death rate for pedestrians hit by cars is unacceptably high.  行人遭遇车祸的死亡率高得令人无法接受。adjective formal disapproving
Her books, with few exceptions, are workmanlike but pedestrian.  除了寥寥几本以外，她的书全都写得精确细腻但缺乏想像力。
His speech was long and pedestrian.  他的演讲冗长乏味。

words.meaning: n.(精神或肉体的)极大痛苦,创伤
words.example:
She lay there screaming in agony.  她躺在那里痛苦地大声尖叫。
We've both suffered agonies of guilt over what happened.  所发生的事情使我们两个都饱受内疚的煎熬。

words.meaning: v.(使)恶化,(使)变坏
words.example:
She was taken into hospital last week when her condition suddenly deteriorated.  她是在上周病情突然恶化时被送进医院的。
The political situation in the region has deteriorated rapidly.  该地区的政治形势已急剧恶化。

words.meaning: vi.[with]互撞,碰撞;冲突,抵触
words.example:
The two vans collided at the crossroads.  两辆货车在十字路口相撞。
It was predicted that a comet would collide with one of the planets.  预计一颗彗星将与某行星相撞。

words.meaning: a.可行的;切实可行的;行得通的;可用的
words.example:
With the extra resources, the scheme now seems feasible.  有了额外的资源，这个计划现在看来是可行的。
It 's quite feasible (that) we'll get the money.  我们很有可能拿到这笔钱。

words.meaning: a.可应用(实施)的;适当的,合适的
words.example:
This part of the law is only applicable to companies employing more than five people.  该法律这一部分条款仅适用于有五名以上雇员的公司。
The new qualifications are applicable to all European countries.  新的限定条件适用于所有欧洲国家。

words.meaning: n.(by-pass)旁道;vt.绕过
words.example:
We were in a hurry so we decided to bypass Canterbury because we knew there'd be a lot of traffic.  我们得赶时间，于是决定绕过坎特伯雷，因为我们知道那里交通会很挤塞。
They bypassed the committee and went straight to senior management.  他们越过委员会，直接找高级管理层。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.收割,收获
words.example:
She studied every evening and reaped the benefit at exam time.  她每天晚上都坚持学习，考试时受益匪浅。
We sold them most of their modern weapons and now we are reaping the bitter harvest.  他们大部分的现代化武器都是我们卖给他们的，现在轮到我们自食其果了。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: vt.位于...之下, 成为...的基础
words.example: Psychological problems very often underlie apparently physical disorders.  心理问题常常是明显生理疾病的深层原因。

words.meaning: a.傲慢的,自大的
words.example: His arrogant tone offended people.  他傲慢的语气冒犯了别人。

words.meaning: a.怀疑的,无把握的;有问题的,靠不住的
words.example:
These claims are dubious and not scientifically proven.  这些说法未经科学证实，有些可疑。
He has been associated with some dubious characters.  他曾经与一些可疑人物有交往。
Ruth Ellis has the dubious (= bad) distinction of being the last woman to be hanged in Britain.  露丝‧艾理斯背负着英国最后一个被绞死的女人这样一个恶名。

words.meaning: v.预见,预知
words.example: Few could foresee the outcome.  几乎没人能预见结果。

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]自己;亲自,本人
words.example: One has to learn to control oneself.  人要学会控制自己。

words.meaning: n.(方)括号
words.example:
Biographical information is included in brackets.  括号里包含了作者的个人资料。
Grammar patterns in this dictionary are shown in UK square brackets] USbrackets. For example, a countable noun is marked countable.  本词典文法模式在方括号内注明，如可数名词用countable表示。noun
They were both surgeons in a high income bracket.  他俩都属于高收入阶层的外科医生。

words.meaning: n.糊,浆糊 v.粘,贴
words.example:
Are these real diamonds or paste?  这些是真钻石还是人造宝石？verb
You can make your own distorting mirror by pasting a sheet of kitchen foil to a piece of thin cardboard.  你可以将一张厨房用铝箔纸贴在一块薄纸板上自己做一个哈哈镜。verb
Cut that paragraph and then paste it at the end of the page.  将那一段剪下来，贴到页尾上。

words.meaning: n.首相,总理
words.example: He's one of the nation's premier scientists.  他是该国最重要的科学家之一。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.日食,月食
words.example:
On Wednesday there will be a total/partial eclipse of the sun.  周三将有一次日全／偏蚀。noun
The eclipse of the ruling political party was inevitable.  执政党大势已去，无可挽回。
His remarkable contribution to literature has been too long in eclipse.  他对文学的杰出贡献已被人们遗忘太久了。verb

words.meaning: n./v.统治,支配,盛行 n.统治时期 v.占优势
words.example:
Queen Victoria reigned over Britain from 1837 to 1901.  维多利亚女王自1837年到1901年间在位统治英国。
The bomb attacks produced a panic which reigned over the city.  炸弹袭击引起的恐慌笼罩全城。
Love reigned supreme in her heart.  爱情完全占据了她的心。noun countable

words.meaning: a.爱国的
words.example: Many Americans felt it was their patriotic duty to buy bonds to support the war effort.  许多美国人认为购买债券支持战备是他们的爱国职责。

words.meaning: n.青肿,挫伤;伤痕vt.打青;挫伤
words.example:
His arms and back were covered in bruises.  他手臂和背部到处是瘀伤。
She had a few cuts and bruises but nothing serious.  她有几处伤口和瘀痕，但不严重。
One or two of the peaches had bruises on them.  有一两个桃子上有碰伤的痕迹。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.家禽
words.example: Some poultry farmers keep turkeys and ducks as well as chickens.  一些饲养家禽的农民不仅养鸡，还养火鸡和鸭子。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.呻吟声,悲叹声 v.呻吟,抱怨,悲叹
words.example:
He moaned with pain before losing consciousness.  他痛苦地呻吟，随后就失去了知觉。
"Let me die," he moaned.  “让我死吧。”他呻吟道。UK verb intransitive
Thelma's always moaning (about something), and forgets how lucky she actually is.  特尔玛总爱抱怨，忘记了实际上她是多么幸运。

words.meaning: n.队伍,行列
words.example:
The festival will open with a procession led by the mayor.  艺术节将由市长带领的一支队伍揭开序幕。
My day has just been a never-ending procession of visitors.  我今天一整天来访的客人络绎不绝。

words.meaning: n.征服,征服地,掠取物
words.example: The conquest of the peak took years.  攻下这座山峰花了数年。

words.meaning: a.流行的,时髦的
words.example: It's not fashionable to wear short skirts at the moment.  现在不流行穿短裙了。

words.meaning: a.数量的,定量的
words.example: quantitative analysis  定量分析    Compare qualitative

words.meaning: n.地窑,地下室
words.example: The cellar stays cool in summer.  地窖夏天也很凉。

words.meaning: n.手提箱,公事皮包
words.example: He carried a leather briefcase.  他提着一个皮质公文包。

words.meaning: v.退回,后退;收回,撤回;跌落,缩减,贬值
words.example:
As the boat picked up speed, the coastline receded into the distance until finally it became invisible.  船越开越快，海岸线渐渐远去，直至最后从视线中消失。
The painful memories gradually receded in her mind.  痛苦的记忆逐渐在她脑海中变得淡漠了。

words.meaning: vi.大量存在;(~in,~with)充满,富于
words.example:
Theories abound about how the Earth began.  地球的起源怎样，众说纷纭。verb intransitive
The coast here abounds with rare plants.  这儿的海岸生长着大量稀有植物。

words.meaning: n.压抑,压制,镇压
words.example: The political repression in this country is enforced by terror.  这个国家透过恐怖统治来实行政治高压。

words.meaning: n.补贴,津贴;零用钱;减价,折扣;允许
words.example:
The perks of the job include a company pension scheme and a generous travel allowance.  这份工作的特殊待遇包括公司退休金计划和丰厚的差旅补助。
The baggage/luggage allowance for most flights is 20 kilos.  大多数班机允许乘客携带的行李重量限额是20公斤。
We should make allowance for bad weather and have plenty of umbrellas available.  我们应该考虑到有可能会遇上恶劣天气，所以应该备足雨伞。noun

words.meaning: n.杰作,名著
words.example:
'The Last Supper' is widely regarded as Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece.  《最后的晚餐》被广泛认为是李奥纳多‧达文西的杰作。
Her press conference was a masterpiece of media manipulation.  她的记者招待会是媒体操控的一个范例。

words.meaning: v.烤,炙,烘
words.example:
Just roast the chicken in the oven and baste it in oil and lemon.  直接把鸡放在烤箱里烤，烤时涂上油和柠檬汁。
figurative We lay on the beach and roasted (= got very hot) in the Mediterranean sun.  我们躺在地中海的沙滩上晒日光浴。

words.meaning: n.仁慈,亲切;好意;友好行为
words.example: love and kindness  爱和仁慈

words.meaning: a.壮丽的,辉煌的;极好的
words.example:
We had splendid food/a splendid holiday/splendid weather.  我们的食物／我们的假期／我们碰到的天气简直太棒了。
You look splendid in that outfit.  你穿那一身衣服简直棒极了。

words.meaning: v.认出,发现;辨别,识别
words.example: It is difficult to discern any pattern in these figures.  在这些数字中很难找出规律。

words.meaning: vt.崇拜,敬慕,爱慕;非常喜欢
words.example:
She has one son and she adores him.  她只有一个儿子，是她的掌上明珠。
Let us adore God for all his works.  让我们崇拜上帝所创造的一切。

words.meaning: n.鸽子
words.example: A dove sat on the windowsill.  一只鸽子停在窗台上。

words.meaning: a.滑的,滑溜的
words.example:
The road was wet and slippery.  道路又湿又滑。
He's as slippery as an eel - you can never get a straight answer out of him.  他非常狡猾——你永远无法从他嘴里得到直率的回答。
He's a slippery customer (= person) , that Tim, I've never felt comfortable with him.  那个蒂姆是个狡猾的家伙，和他在一起我总是感到不舒服。

words.meaning: a.污秽的;邪恶的 v.弄脏;妨害;犯规 n.犯规
words.example:
Those toilets smell foul!  那些卫生间太难闻了！
I've had a foul day at work.  我今天工作上很不顺利。
Why are you in such a foul mood this morning?  你今天早晨的情绪怎么这么糟糕？

words.meaning: n.外出,旅行,散步
words.example:
Rosie's going on a class/school outing to the Museum of Modern Art.  罗西要跟全班／全校去参观现代艺术博物馆。UK noun
There have been several outings of well-known film stars recently.  最近曝出好几宗著名电影明星是同性恋者的事。

words.meaning: n.交流,交往,交际,性交
words.example: Our survey reveals that most couples have intercourse once a week.  我们的调查显示大多数夫妻每周有一次性行为。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.试探性的,暂时的;犹豫不决的
words.example: We made a tentative plan.  我们拟了个暂定计划。

words.meaning: vi.痛;哀怜 n.(指连续)疼痛、酸痛
words.example:
As you get older, you have all sorts of aches and pains.  人老了，就会有各种各样的病痛。
I've got a dull (= slight) ache in my lower back.  我背部靠近腰的地方隐隐作痛。
I've had a stomach ache all morning.  我胃痛了一个上午。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.坏的;邪恶的;不道德的;恶劣的;淘气的
words.example:
It was a wicked thing to do.  那是件缺德的事。
Of course, in the end, the wicked witch gets killed.  当然，最后邪恶的巫婆被杀掉了。    Compare evil ; naughty    old-fashioned
He's got some wicked trainers.  他有几双非常不错的球鞋。noun

words.meaning: vi.摇晃着移动;蹒跚 n.摇晃不稳的动作;蹒跚
words.example:
After he was attacked, he managed to stagger to the phone and call for help.  他遇袭后，跌跌撞撞地走到电话旁打电话求救。
figurative The company is staggering under a $15 million debt and will almost certainly collapse by the end of the year.  公司背负着1500万美元的债务，举步维艰，年底前几乎肯定要倒闭。UK verb
He staggered all his colleagues by suddenly announcing that he was leaving the company at the end of the month.  他突然宣布月底要离开公司，把所有同事都吓了一跳。UK verb

words.meaning: n.包裹,邮包,部分 v.打包,捆扎,分配
words.example:
The parcel was wrapped in plain brown paper.  那个包裹是用普通牛皮纸包着的。UK noun countable
The bigger farms were parcelled out after the revolution in 1973.  1973年革命后，较大的农场都被划成小块分了出去。
She parcelled out the gifts to the other children.  她把礼物分给其他孩子。UK verb (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)

words.meaning: n.忍耐(力),持久(力),耐久(性)
words.example:
Running a marathon is a test of human endurance.  马拉松长跑是对人耐力的考验。
The pain was bad beyond endurance.  疼痛剧烈，令人难以忍受。

words.meaning: a.加很多香料的;(口味)浓郁的
words.example: Do you like spicy food?  你喜欢味道辛辣的食物吗？adjective

words.meaning: vt.限制,约束;克制,抑制
words.example: Time constraints force shortcuts.  时间限制逼得人走捷径。

words.meaning: v.装饰,美化 n.装饰,装饰物
words.example:
The building relies on clever design rather than on ornament for its impressive effect.  这幢大楼给人留下深刻印象，是依靠它巧妙的设计而非装饰。verb transitive UK US     slightly formal
She ornamented her letters with little drawings in the margin.  她在信的页边空白处画上小图案来作装饰。

words.meaning: a.整齐的,有秩序的,有条理的 n.勤务兵
words.example:
He has a part-time job as a hospital orderly.  他兼职在医院做勤务员。UK noun countable
She put the letters in three orderly piles.  她把信整理成整齐的三叠。
Form an orderly queue.  排好队。

words.meaning: v.捏,掐,拧;收缩;紧急关头;匮乏;压力
words.example:
Ouch! Stop pinching (me)!  哎哟，别掐我！
These shoes are too tight, they pinch (my feet).  这双鞋太紧了，夹我的脚。
Right, who's pinched my chair?  好嘛，谁把我的椅子偷走了？verb

words.meaning: n.国籍,民族
words.example:
She has British nationality.  她拥有英国国籍。
What nationality are you?  你是哪个国家的人？
At the International School they have pupils of 46 different nationalities.  这所国际学校有来自46个不同民族的学生。

words.meaning: n.对...作出的评价;评价,鉴定,评估
words.example:
The newspaper gave an editorial appraisal of the government's achievements of the past year.  这家报纸发表社论，对政府在过去一年的功绩作出评价。
Many companies operate regular job appraisals, often on an annual basis.  许多公司定期对雇员进行工作鉴定，通常是每年一次。

words.meaning: n.日光,日照;晴天;
words.example:
The children were out playing in the sunshine.  孩子们正在外面太阳下玩耍。noun uncountable
Their grandchildren have brought sunshine into their lives.  他们的孙儿为他们的生活带来快乐。
Hello, sunshine!  你好，亲爱的！

words.meaning: n.优越(性),优势,优等;高傲,傲慢
words.example:
The Australian team soon demonstrated their superiority over the opposition.  澳大利亚队很快在对手面前显示出他们的优势。    Compare inferiority
Her sense of superiority makes her very unpopular.  她的优越感让她非常不受欢迎。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.巨大的,庞大的
words.example: The cost has been gigantic.  费用非常庞大。

words.meaning: n.节目,全部剧目,保留剧目,全部技能
words.example:
The Royal Shakespeare Company also have many modern plays in their repertoire.  皇家莎士比亚剧团的演出剧目中也包括很多现代戏剧。
There is an extensive repertoire of music written for the flute.  为长笛演奏而谱写的曲目林林总总，丰富多彩。

words.meaning: n.踏板 v.踩踏板,骑自行车
words.example:
This sewing machine is operated by a foot pedal.  这台缝纫机是用脚踏板来操作的。
He stood up on the pedals of his bike to get extra power as he cycled up the hill.  他骑车上山时站在踏板上踩车以增加力量。adjective [before noun]
She emptied the ashtray into the pedal bin.  她把烟灰缸里的东西倒入脚踏式垃圾桶里。verb intransitive or transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)

words.meaning: v.举例证明;示范;作...的范例[榜样]
words.example: This painting perfectly exemplifies the naturalistic style which was so popular at the time.  这幅油画是那个时期风靡一时的自然主义风格的完美典范。

words.meaning: n.裁缝 v.缝制,剪裁
words.example: The tailor took my measurements.  裁缝量了我的尺寸。

words.meaning: n.临时解雇,操作停止,活动停止期间,失业期
words.example:
The recent economic crisis has led to massive layoffs.  近来的经济危机导致大批人员被解雇。
Foster is playing again after a six-week layoff due to injury.  福斯特因伤休息六周后又重新回到了赛场。

words.meaning: num./a.十九 pron.十九(个,只...)
words.example: Simson, aged nineteen, was convicted on two charges of burglary.  19岁的西姆森被判两项盗窃罪罪成。

words.meaning: a.理解(力),领悟;包含,包含力
words.example:
He has no comprehension of the size of the problem.  他不明白问题有多严重。
How she manages to fit so much into a working day is beyond my comprehension (= I cannot understand it).  我搞不明白她如何能在一个工作天里做那么多事情。

words.meaning: v./n.计算,估计
words.example: Compute the ratio of the object's height to its weight.  计算一下该物体的高度和重量之比。

words.meaning: n.皱纹 v.起皱,皱眉
words.example:
There are still a few wrinkles to iron out (= solve) before the agreement can be signed.  在协议签订之前还有一些小问题需要解决。verb intransitive or transitive
Sunbathing can prematurely age and wrinkle the skin.  日光浴会使皮肤提早老化、产生皱纹。
She wrinkled up her nose at the strange smell coming from the kitchen.  闻到厨房飘来的怪味，她皱起了鼻子。

words.meaning: vi.(to,after)渴望,追求,有志于
words.example: Few people who aspire to fame ever achieve it.  追求显赫名声的人很少能如愿以偿。

words.meaning: n.详述;(常pl.)规格,说明书,规范
words.example:
All products are made exactly to the customer's specifications.  所有产品完全按照客户的具体要求制造。
The cars have been built to a high specification (= a high standard).  汽车是按照高标准制造的。

words.meaning: n.原谅,宽恕;请再说一遍 v.原谅,饶恕,赦免
words.example:
Pardon my ignorance, but what exactly is ergonomics?  请恕我无知，不过人体工程学究竟是甚么一回事？
Large numbers of political prisoners have been pardoned and released by the new president.  新总统赦免并释放了一大批政治犯。UK verb transitive
The man doesn't know his arse from his elbow, if you'll pardon the expression.  这个男人是个浆糊脑袋，请原谅我这么说。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.几何(学)
words.example: the laws of geometry  几何定律

words.meaning: n.门把,(球形)把手,旋纽
words.example:
Turn/Twiddle the little knob to adjust the volume.  转动小旋钮来调节音量。
Put a knob of butter in the frying pan.  在煎锅里放一小块奶油。UK noun countable
Disney World was like an ordinary amusement park with knobs on.  迪士尼乐园简直就是个超级娱乐公园。

words.meaning: n.镍;镍币;五美分
words.example: a nickel alloy  镍合金noun

words.meaning: n.违反,不履行;破裂 vt.冲破,攻破
words.example:
They felt that our discussions with other companies constituted a breach of/in our agreement.  他们认为我们与别的公司谈判违反了我们之间的协定。
He was sued for breach of contract.  他因为违约而被起诉。
There have been serious security breaches (= breaks in our security system).  保安系统出了大问题。

words.meaning: n.药片;碑,匾
words.example: The poem was engraved on a tablet of stone.  这首诗刻在一块石匾上。

words.meaning: v.蒸发,挥发;沉淀;发射;消失
words.example:
The high concentration of sugars forms a syrup when the sap evaporates.  当树汁中的水分蒸发时，糖分就浓缩成糖浆。
Plants keep cool during the summer by evaporating water from their leaves.  夏天植物透过叶子蒸发水分保持清凉。UK verb
Halfway through the film reality evaporates and we enter a world of pure fantasy.  电影看到一半，我们就离开现实世界，完全进入了幻境中。

words.meaning: v.(使)眨眼;眨眼示意 n.眨眼;小睡,打盹
words.example:
She winked at me as he turned his back.  他转过身去的时候，她向我眨了眨眼。
For a moment I thought he was being serious, but then he winked at me.  有一阵我以为他是认真的，但是没多久他就向我眨了眨眼，暗示我他在开玩笑。
Reflected in the water, the lights winked at us from the other side of the lake.  湖对岸的灯光映在水中，向我们一闪一闪的。

words.meaning: v.模仿,模拟;假装,冒充
words.example:
In cheap furniture, plastic is often used to simulate wood.  廉价家俱经常用塑胶冒充木材。
formal Ruth simulated pleasure at seeing Simon, but really she wished he hadn't come.  看见西蒙，露丝假装很高兴，可是实际上她希望他没来。
Some driving teachers use computers to simulate (= represent) different road conditions for learners to practise on.  有些驾驶教练用电脑类比不同的路况供学员练习。

words.meaning: n.阴谋v.密谋,私通;激起…的兴趣;诡计取得
words.example: Throughout history, people have been intrigued by the question of whether there is intelligent life elsewhere in the universe.  纵观历史，人们一直被这样一个问题吸引着：宇宙的其他地方是否也存在著有智力的生物？noun countable or uncountable /ˈɪn.triːg/

words.meaning: n.排球
words.example: We play volleyball on the beach.  我们在沙滩上打排球。

words.meaning: a.粗糙的,粗劣的;粗鲁的,粗俗的
words.example: Linen is a coarse -grained fabric.  亚麻布是一种质地粗糙的布料。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.放射性,放射引起的
words.example: Uranium is a radioactive material.  铀是一种放射性物质。

words.meaning: n.图表,曲线图
words.example: This graph shows how crime has varied in relationship to unemployment over the last 20 years.  这幅图显示出在过去20年里犯罪率与失业率的变化关系。

words.meaning: n.拼法,拼写法
words.example:
He's hopeless at spelling.  他的拼写简直糟透了。
My computer has a program which corrects my spelling.  我的电脑有纠正拼写错误的程式。
Your essay is full of spelling mistakes/errors.  你的文章里通篇都是拼写错误。

words.meaning: n.衣柜,衣厨;衣服;行头;剧装
words.example:
She was showing me her new built-in / UKfitted wardrobes.  她正在带我看她新做的嵌入式衣柜。
He's in charge of wardrobe at the local amateur theatre.  他是当地业余剧院戏服部的负责人。

words.meaning: n.海湾
words.example:
The Gulf states include Iran, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates.  海湾国家包括伊朗、伊拉克、沙乌地阿拉伯、科威特、巴林、阿曼、卡塔尔以及阿拉伯联合酋长国。
There is a widening gulf between the middle classes and the poorest sections of society.  中产阶级和社会最贫困阶层之间的贫富差距在日益加大。
It is hoped that the peace plan will bridge the gulf (= reduce the very large difference) between the government and the rebels.  人们希望和平计划能够缩小政府和叛乱分子之间的分歧。

words.meaning: n.动物脂,油脂,润滑脂 v.抹油,润滑
words.example:
The dinner plates were thick with grease.  餐盘上厚厚一层油
You'll have to put some grease on those ball bearings.  你要往滚珠轴承上涂些油。verb transitive
Grease the tins well before adding the cake mixture.  在烤盘里面涂好油脂，然后再把蛋糕混合料加进去。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.鹰,隼
words.example: On every street corner there were traders hawking their wares.  每个街角都有商贩在兜售商品。

words.meaning: a.富有想象力的,爱想象的
words.example: The architects have made imaginative use of glass and transparent plastic.  建筑师别出心裁地使用了玻璃和透明塑胶。

words.meaning: n.航空,航空学;飞机制造业
words.example: the British Civil Aviation Authority  英国民航局

words.meaning: a.可怜的, 悲惨的

The refugees were a pathetic sight - starving, frightened and cold.  难民看起来实在可怜——饥寒交迫，担心受怕。
After the accident he became a pathetic figure , a shadow of his former self.  意外后他成了一个可怜人，与之前判若两人。
Are you telling me you're frightened to speak to her? Don't be so pathetic!  你是说你不敢跟她说话吗？别太窝囊了！

words.meaning: n.水银,汞
words.example:
Mercury is used in batteries, pesticides and thermometers.  水银用于电池、杀虫剂与温度计中。UK noun uncountable
With the mercury climbing to 40 degrees, beaches and pools will be crowded this afternoon.  随着气温攀升到40度，今天下午海滩和游泳池都会人满为患。

words.meaning: v./n.腐朽,腐烂;衰减,衰退
words.example:
Sugar makes your teeth decay.  糖能引起蛀牙。
The role of the extended family has been decaying for some time.  大家庭的作用开始减弱已经有一段时间了。
Pollution has decayed the surface of the stonework on the front of the cathedral.  大教堂前部的石刻表面已经因为污染受到了侵蚀。

words.meaning: n.母鸡
words.example: "Are you not feeling too good, hen?"  ｢你不舒服吗，小姑娘？｣

words.meaning: v.扎牢,使固定
words.example:
Make sure your seat belt is securely fastened.  请务必将您的安全带系好。
This shirt fastens at the back.  这件衬衫是在后面系扣的。
The tabloid newspapers have fastened on popular psychology.  这些小报处处捉摸大众心理。

words.meaning: n.(常用复数)面条
words.example: egg/rice noodles  鸡蛋面／米粉

words.meaning: a.持久的,耐久的
words.example:
The machines have to be made of durable materials.  这种机器必须使用耐用的材料来制造。
The resolution calls for a durable peace settlement.  该决议呼吁得出一个持久的和平解决方案。

words.meaning: n.罗盘,指南针;(pl.)圆规
words.example:
It's a musical instrument made of brass, somewhat like a cornet and with a similar compass.  这是一件黄铜乐器，跟短号有些类似，音域也与之相近。
The discussion went beyond the compass of my brain.  讨论超出了我的理解能力。

words.meaning: n.保龄球运动
words.example: The England captain opened the bowling (= bowled first).  英格兰队队长首先投球。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.新奇,新颖,新奇的事物
words.example:
The novelty of these toys soon wore off and the children became bored with them.  孩子们对这些玩具的新鲜感很快就消失了，开始厌倦起来。
In Britain in the 1950s, television had a novelty value.  在20世纪50年代的英国，电视机曾经是一种新奇的事物。
Tourists are still a novelty on this remote island.  鲜有游客造访这偏僻的岛屿。

words.meaning: n.开始,开端
words.example: The project failed from the outset.  项目从一开始就失败了。

words.meaning: v.偿还,报答
words.example:
He had to sell his car to repay the bank loan.  他不得不卖了车还银行贷款。

How can I ever repay you for all your kindness?  你对我这么好，我怎么才能报答你呢？ (repaid, repaid)

words.meaning: vi.(to)订阅,订购;同意vt.捐助,赞助
words.example:
She subscribes to several women's magazines.  她订阅了几本女性杂志。
Existing shareholders subscribed to only 49% of the new share issue.  现有股东只认购了新股的49%。verb intransitive or transitive
Frank subscribed firmly to the belief that human kindness would overcome evil.  法兰克坚信人类的善良能够战胜邪恶。

words.meaning: vi.发芽,抽条 vt.使发芽 n.新芽,嫩苗
words.example:
It takes about three days for the seeds to sprout.  这些种子大概要三天时间才会发芽。
Your hair is sticking up - it looks like you're sprouting horns!  你的头发竖起来了——看起来跟长了角一样！
New factories have sprouted up everywhere.  新工厂如雨后春笋般地四处涌现。noun countable

words.meaning: n.鸽
words.example: Transport? That's not my pigeon - ask Danny.  运输？这不归我管——去问丹尼。

words.meaning: v.提高,升高
words.example: The strong police presence only heightened the tension among the crowd.  大批员警出现只会使人群更加紧张。

words.meaning: n.(节日等的)前夜,前夕
words.example: Mr Hurd was speaking to Arab journalists in London on the eve of his visit to Jordan and Saudi Arabia.  赫德先生在出访约旦及沙地阿拉伯前夕将在伦敦向阿拉伯记者发表讲话。

words.meaning: n.社会学

She has a degree in sociology and politics.  她拥有社会学和政治学学位。
He specializes in the sociology of education/law/the family.  他专门研究教育／法律／家庭社会学。

words.meaning: v./n.跳(跃) a.被束缚的,一定的;n.界限
words.example:

They are bound and determined to build their own house someday.  他们坚信总有一天他们会盖起自己的房子。

words.meaning: n.纬度,行动或言论的自由(范围),(pl.)地区
words.example:
At these latitudes the sun does not rise at all on winter days.  处于这些纬度的地区冬天根本就见不到太阳。UK noun
Courts can show a considerable degree of latitude when it comes to applying the law.  法庭在依法量刑断案方面有较大的自由度。

words.meaning: v.使联合,统一;使相同,使一致
words.example: If the new leader does manage to unify his warring party it will be quite an achievement.  如果新领导人能将党内互相争斗的各派力量整合起来，那将是个了不起的成就。

words.meaning: n.药房,药剂学,制药业,配药业,一批备用药品
words.example: The pharmacy closes at ten.  药房十点关门。

words.meaning: v.(使)旋转,打转 n.旋转;-连串快速的活动
words.example:

He stepped out into the night and the whirling snow.  他走出来，融入夜色与飞旋的雪花之中。
He whirled her round until she felt quite sick.  他带着她旋转，直到她觉得非常恶心。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: a.螺旋形的 n.螺旋,螺线 v.螺旋上升;盘旋
words.example:
This year's downward spiral of house prices has depressed the market.  今年房价的持续下跌造成了市场的疲软。
We must avoid the downward spiral in which unemployment leads to homelessness and then to crime.  我们必须避免失业导致无家可归，进而导致犯罪的恶性循环。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
With one wing damaged, the model airplane spiralled downwards.  模型飞机的一个机翼坏了，盘旋下坠。

words.meaning: n.爪
words.example:
Take your filthy paws off my nice clean washing!  把你的脏手从我洗得干干净净的衣服上拿开！UK verb
When their dog heard them it began pawing (at) the ground in excitement.  他们的狗听见他们的声音就开始兴奋地用爪子抓地。

words.meaning: a.独立的,有主权的 n.君主,国王,统治者
words.example:
Sovereign power is said to lie with the people in some countries, and with a ruler in others.  据说，在某些国家中最高统治权归于人民，而在其他国家则掌握在统治者手中。
We must respect the rights of sovereign states/nations to conduct their own affairs.  我们必须尊重主权独立国家处理本国事务的权利。UK adjective
Love is a sovereign remedy for unhappiness.  爱是治疗悲伤的万灵丹。

words.meaning: vt.删除
words.example:
They insisted that all expletives be deleted from the article.  他们坚持要删除文中所有的诅咒性词语。
Here is a list of possible answers. Please delete (= draw a line through them) as appropriate.  这里列出了各种备选答案，请酌情删除。

words.meaning: v.招致,惹起,遭受
words.example:
The play has incurred the wrath/anger of both audiences and critics.  这部剧引起了观众和评论家的愤怒。
Please detail any costs/expenses incurred by you in attending the interview.  请详细列出你参加这次面试所需承担的一切费用。

words.meaning: a.接连的,连续的
words.example:
It was the team's fourth successive defeat.  那是球队接连第四次失利。
He won the World Championship for the third successive year.  他连续第三次赢得世界锦标赛冠军。

words.meaning: n.木工,木匠
words.example: The carpenter built shelves for us.  木匠给我们做了架子。

words.meaning: n.火焰;火光;闪光,光辉 v.燃烧,冒火焰
words.example:
The sun was blazing down that afternoon.  那天下午烈日炎炎。
Isaac's eyes suddenly blazed with anger.  艾萨克的眼里突然冒出怒火。verb intransitive
Elvis Presley blazed a trail in pop music.  猫王普里斯莱在流行音乐领域开创了新潮流。noun countable

words.meaning: n.饼干,点心
words.example:
We had tea and biscuits at 3.30 p.m.  我们在下午三点半享用茶点。noun countable
And you say she's opening your letters now? Oh, that really takes the biscuit!  你说她在拆你的信？啊，这可真令人难以置信！

words.meaning: ad.相反地
words.example: Cheap inputs raise profits; conversely, high costs cut them.  低成本提高利润，反之高成本则压低利润。

words.meaning: a.生理学的, 生理学上的
words.example: Sleep has physiological benefits.  睡眠有生理上的益处。

words.meaning: n.雷(声);轰隆声 v.打雷;大声说,吼叫
words.example:
The sky grew dark and it started to thunder.  天色变暗，开始打雷了。
The train thundered past, shaking the whole house.  火车轰隆隆驶过，整座房子都晃动起来。

words.meaning: v.排除,阻止,妨碍
words.example:
His contract precludes him from discussing his work with anyone outside the company.  合约中禁止他与公司外的人谈论工作。
The fact that your application was not successful this time does not preclude the possibility of you applying again next time.  这次应征失败并不妨碍你下次再来应征。

words.meaning: n.垃圾,(杂乱的)废物 v.使杂乱,乱丢
words.example:
About 2% of fast-food packaging ends up as litter.  约有2%的速食包装会被人当作垃圾随手扔掉。UK noun
The park was littered with bottles and cans after the concert.  音乐会结束后，公园里到处都是被人丢弃的瓶瓶罐罐。
Dirty clothes littered the floor of her bedroom.  她的睡房地板上到处都是脏衣服。

words.meaning: a.优美的,高雅的,精致的;剧烈的,异常的
words.example:
She has exquisite taste.  她品味高雅。adjective
The pain was quite exquisite.  疼痛得剧烈难忍。

words.meaning: n.瀑布
words.example: The waterfall feeds the river below.  瀑布汇入下方的河流。

words.meaning: n.一致,和谐,符合
words.example: In accordance with her wishes, she was buried in France.  按照她的遗愿，人们把她安葬在法国。

words.meaning: v.使沉浸在;使浸没
words.example:
She got some books out of the library and immersed her self in Jewish history and culture.  她从图书馆借了一些书，然后沉浸于犹太历史和文化之中。
The shells should be immersed in boiling water for two minutes.  贝类应在沸水中浸上两分钟。

words.meaning: n.石油
words.example: Petroleum powers much of the world.  石油驱动着世界大部分动力。

words.meaning: n.垂下物,帽沿,袋盖 n./v.拍打,拍动
words.example:
Flags flapped in the breeze above their tents.  微风中，旗子在他们帐篷上方飘动。verb (-pp-)
Don't flap - there's plenty of time to cook before they arrive.  别慌，在他们到来之前还有充裕的时间准备饭菜。
Stop flapping about/around !  别慌里慌张的！noun

words.meaning: a.激烈的,严厉的;(药性等)猛烈的
words.example: Many employees have had to take drastic cuts in pay.  许多员工不得不接受大幅降薪。

words.meaning: int.再会,别了 n.告别
words.example:
We said our sad farewells and got on the bus.  我们悲伤地道别后，上了公车。
He bid us both a fond (= affectionate) farewell.  他向我们两人深情道别。

words.meaning: n.(重要事件等的)到来,来临
words.example: Life in Britain was transformed by the advent of the steam engine.  蒸汽机的出现使英国人的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。

words.meaning: n.短处,缺点
words.example:
Whatever his shortcomings as a husband, he was a good father to his children.  不管作为一个丈夫他有何缺点，他却是孩子们的好父亲。
Like any political system, it has its shortcomings.  和任何政治体制一样，它也有不足之处。

words.meaning: n.缝,接缝;缝合,接合;vi.裂开,产生裂缝
words.example:
The bags we sell have very strong seams, so they will last for years.  我们卖的袋子缝线处非常牢固，所以经久耐用。
My old coat is coming/falling apart at the seams (= the stitches are coming out).  我的旧外套已经多处脱线。
figurative Their marriage is coming/falling apart at the seams (= likely to fail).  他们的婚姻已濒临破裂。noun countable

words.meaning: v./n.刺,刺痛,剧痛;刺,叮
words.example:
Do all types of bee sting?  所有种类的蜜蜂都蜇人吗？
The soap/smoke/sweat stung my eyes.  肥皂／烟雾／汗水刺痛了我的双眼。
This type of disinfectant doesn't sting, even if you put it on a fresh cut.  这种消毒药水即使涂在新伤口上也不会有灼痛感。

words.meaning: a.空闲的,闲置的;懒散的 v.空费,虚度
words.example:
Half these factories now stand idle.  这些工厂如今有半数闲置。
It's crazy to have £7000 sitting idle in the bank.  把7000英镑闲置在银行里简直是疯了。
If you have an idle moment, call me.  如果你有空，给我打电话。

words.meaning: n.电影院;电影,影片
words.example:
The town no longer has a cinema.  小镇已不再有电影院了。
He was well-known for his work in the cinema.  他因在电影业的成就而闻名。

words.meaning: n.风景,舞台布景
words.example: They stopped at the top of the hill to admire the scenery.  他们在山顶上停了下来，欣赏起风景来。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.英寸
words.example:
Twelve inches are equal to one foot.  12英寸等于1英尺。
He had a cut an inch long above his left eye.  他左眼上方有一道一英寸长的伤口。
The snow was six inches deep in some places.  有些地方积雪有六英寸深。

words.meaning: a.琐碎的;无足轻重的
words.example:
Sexual harassment in the workplace is not a trivial matter.  工作场所的性骚扰可不是件小事。
Getting computers to understand human language is not a trivial problem.  令电脑懂得人类语言可不是一个容易解决的问题。

words.meaning: n.瓷器 a.精制的,瓷器的
words.example:
The tea cups are (made of) porcelain.  茶杯是瓷制的。
He had a fine collection of Meissen porcelain.  他收藏了很多精美的迈森瓷器。

words.meaning: n.饥荒,饥馑
words.example:
Another crop failure could result in widespread famine.  庄稼再歉收就可能导致大规模饥荒。
There were reports of refugees dying of famine.  有关于难民饿死的报告。
Thousands of people emigrated during the Irish potato famine of 1845-46.  在1845年到1846年间的爱尔兰马铃薯饥荒时期，成千上万的人移居国外。

words.meaning: vt.失望;(希望等)破灭,挫败(计划等)
words.example:
I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I'm afraid I can't come after all.  很抱歉让你失望，但恐怕我真的来不了。
We don't want to disappoint the fans.  我们不想让球迷们失望。

words.meaning: n.人名地址录,(电话)号码簿
words.example: Look up their number in the telephone directory.  在电话簿里查查他们的号码。

words.meaning: n.盒子;盒式磁带
words.example: a video cassette  录影带

words.meaning: n.住宅,寓所
words.example: There is an estimated shortfall of some five million dwellings across the country.  据估计全国缺少约500万套房屋。

words.meaning: v.(使)变硬
words.example:
The mixture hardens as it cools.  混合物冷却时变硬了。
It is thought that high cholesterol levels in the blood can harden the arteries (= make them thicker and stiffer, causing disease).  据信血液中的胆固醇含量高会导致动脉硬化。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Living rough in the desert hardened the recruits a lot (= made them stronger).  沙漠的艰苦生活把新兵锻炼得更加坚强。

words.meaning: v.(from)阻止,妨碍 a.后面的
words.example:
High winds have hindered firefighters in their efforts to put out the blaze.  强风妨碍了消防队员扑灭大火。
Her progress certainly hasn't been hindered by her lack of experience.  经验不足当然没有妨碍她的进步。

words.meaning: a.坦白的,直率的
words.example:
There followed a frank exchange of views.  接下来大家坦诚地交换了意见。
The magazine, which gives frank advice about sex and romance, is aimed at the teenage market.  这本杂志面向青少年市场，对性和恋爱问题作出坦率的忠告。
To be perfectly frank with you, I don't think she's the woman for the job.  十分坦诚地告诉你，我认为她不适合做那份工作。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.平装本,简装本
words.example:
I'll buy some paperbacks at the airport.  我要在机场买几本平装书。
It will be published in paperback (= as a paperback) in March.  这本书将于三月份以平装本形式出版。    Compare hardback ; softback

words.meaning: a.反常的,不正常的,不规则的
words.example: Tests revealed some abnormal skin cells.  检验结果显示一些皮肤细胞异常。

words.meaning: n.航海,航空;导航,领航
words.example:
In the past, navigation depended on a knowledge of the positions of the stars.  过去，导航在很大程度上依靠对星星位置的认识。
Mechanics discovered problems with the plane's navigation system.  机械师发现了飞机导航系统所出的问题。

words.meaning: n.灰泥;熟石膏;膏药
words.example:
The plaster on the walls was cracked and flaking.  墙上的灰泥出现了裂缝，正在剥落。
My leg was in plaster for about six weeks.  我的腿打了六周左右的石膏。UK noun
Put a plaster on it so that it doesn't get infected.  在上面贴上创可贴，这样就不会感染了。UK verb

words.meaning: v.成功,兴隆,昌盛,使成功,使昌隆,繁荣
words.example: The business prospered after the reform.  改革后生意兴旺起来。

words.meaning: a.向下的 ad.(also downwards)向下,往下
words.example: The country's economy is on a downward spiral.  该国的经济正日渐衰退。    Compare upward

words.meaning: n.(pl.syntheses)综合,合成
words.example: He describes his latest record as 'a synthesis of African and Latin rhythms'.  他说他最新的唱片融合了“非洲和拉丁音乐”的旋律。

words.meaning: a.(of)包括的,包含的;范围广的
words.example:
My rent is $700 a month inclusive (of bills).  我的租金是每月700美元全包。
I'll be away from the 20th to the 31st of May inclusive.  我将于5月20日至31日外出。
Our aim is to create a fairer, more inclusive society.  我们的目标是建立一个更公平、更具包容性的社会。

words.meaning: num.九十,九十个
words.example:
Ninety percent of the people surveyed were in favour.  90%的被访者表示赞成。UK number
Ninety-nine times out of a hundred everything's fine, but now and then there's a problem.  大多数时候一切顺利，但偶尔也会出现问题。

words.meaning: a.表面的;肤浅的,浅薄的
words.example:
He's fun to be with, but he's very superficial.  和他在一起很有趣，但是他见识很肤浅。UK adjective
The documentary's treatment/analysis of the issues was very superficial.  这部纪录片对这个问题的处理／分析非常肤浅。
There are superficial similarities between the two cars, but actually they're quite different in terms of performance.  这两辆汽车表面上虽然相似，但事实上它们的性能相差甚远。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.短途旅行,游览;离题;[物理]偏移,漂移
words.example:
This year's annual excursion will be to Lincoln.  今年的年度短途旅行的目的地是林肯。
Next week we're going on an excursion.  下星期我们要去远足。

words.meaning: n.一阵,一股(气味等);喘息;吹嘘v.喘息,鼓吹
words.example:
He came puffing up the stairs.  他气喘吁吁地上了楼。
She was puffing on a cigarette at the time.  她当时正在吸烟。
He sat there, puffing away at a cigarette.  他坐在那里，抽着烟。verb

words.meaning: v.误解,误会
words.example: If you think that these transport problems can be solved by building more roads, you completely misunderstand the nature of the problem.  如果你认为这些交通问题可以藉修筑新路来解决的话，那你就完全误解了问题的本质。

words.meaning: n.显微镜
words.example: They looked at the blood samples under the microscope.  他们在显微镜下观察血液样本。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.矛,枪
words.example:
They catch the fish by spearing them.  他们用鱼镖刺鱼。
He speared a meatball with his fork.  他用叉子叉起一个肉丸。

words.meaning: a.令人满意的,圆满的,良好的,符合要求的
words.example:
The teachers seem to think his work is satisfactory.  老师们似乎认为他的作品挺不错。
We hope very much to find a satisfactory solution to the problem.  我们非常希望找到圆满解决这个问题的方案。
The result of the match was highly satisfactory (= very pleasing).  比赛结果令人非常满意。

words.meaning: a.有...倾向的;可能遭受...的;有责任的
words.example:
The law holds parents liable if a child does not attend school.  这项法律规定孩子不上学父母要负法律责任。
If we lose the case we may be liable for (= have to pay) the costs of the whole trial.  如果我们输掉了这场官司，就要承担官司的全部费用。adjective [after verb]
The areas of town near the river are liable to flooding (= are often flooded).  这个城镇靠近河边的地区很容易遭到水淹。

words.meaning: n.黄瓜
words.example: Put cucumber slices on your eyes.  把黄瓜片敷在眼睛上。

words.meaning: v.中继,转播,接力 n.接替人员,替班
words.example:
Relays of workers kept the machines going through the night.  工人们轮班工作，机器彻夜运转。
After the landslide, volunteers worked in relays to rescue people buried under the rubble.  山泥倾泻发生后，志愿者们轮班上阵解救被碎石埋困的人。

words.meaning: n.烟囱
words.example: Factory chimneys belched dense white smoke into the sky.  工厂的烟囱向空中喷出浓浓的白烟。noun countable

words.meaning: n.灯,灯笼
words.example: Red lanterns hung along the street.  街上挂着红灯笼。

words.meaning: a.超时的,加班的 ad.加班
words.example:
They're doing/working overtime to get the job finished on time.  他们加班以准时完成这项工作。
Everyone is on overtime (= being paid extra for working after the usual time) this weekend.  这个周末大家都有加班费。
You can earn some overtime by working after 6.00 p.m.  你可以工作到六点以后，赚点加班费。

words.meaning: n.(dormitory)[美][口]宿舍
words.example: My dorm is on the third floor.  我的宿舍在三楼。

words.meaning: n.女英雄;女主角
words.example: The heroine of the novel is a nurse.  小说的女主角是位护士。

words.meaning: v.慢跑
words.example:
He was walking at a very quick pace and I had to jog to keep up with him.  他走得很快，我要慢跑才能跟上他。UK US  (-gg-)
The horse and cart jogged down the rough track towards the farm.  马车在崎岖的路上颠簸着驶向农场。
We were getting more and more uncomfortable as we jogged along in the back of the truck.  卡车一路颠簸前行，坐在后面的我们越来越感到不舒服。UK US  (-gg-)

words.meaning: n.平常日,工作日
words.example: On weekdays I'm usually in bed by ten o'clock.  工作日期间我通常十时前上床睡觉。

words.meaning: n.高原,平稳状态[时期]
words.example:
The US death rate reached a plateau in the 1960s, before declining suddenly.  美国的死亡率在20世纪60年代进入平稳阶段后突然下降。UK verb intransitive
I'd been losing about a pound a week on my diet, but recently I've plateaued and haven't lost an ounce.  我藉节食减肥，体重每周减轻一磅左右，但最近体重稳定下来，一磅也没少。
The economic slowdown has caused our sales to plateau.  经济发展减缓，导致我们的产品销量停滞不前。

words.meaning: n.自助餐
words.example:
Are you having a sit-down meal or a buffet at the wedding?  你办婚礼想摆桌宴还是搞自助餐？
The little boat was buffeted mercilessly by the waves.  海浪无情地拍打着小船。

words.meaning: n.屠杀,屠宰 vt.屠杀,宰杀
words.example: The pigs were sent to slaughter.  猪被送去了屠宰场。

words.meaning: n.侧面的,旁边的
words.example: Trim the lateral shoots of the flower (= the ones which grow sideways from the main stem of a plant).  修剪花的旁枝。

words.meaning: v./n.回顾,回想,追溯[反]foresee
words.example:
In retrospect, I think my marriage was doomed from the beginning.  现在回头看，我觉得我的婚姻从一开始就注定要破裂。
I'm sure my university days seem happier in retrospect than they really were.  我敢说，回顾我的大学时光，看起来肯定要比当时实际生活幸福。

words.meaning: n.长(统)袜
words.example:
nylon/silk stockings.  长筒尼龙袜／丝袜    Compare nylons ; tightsUK noun countable
Jerome stands 1m 75 in his stocking feet.  杰尔姆不穿鞋时身高是1米75。

words.meaning: v.(on)祝贺,向…致贺词
words.example: Congratulate her on the award.  祝贺她获奖。

words.meaning: v.(使)混合
words.example:
The excitement of starting a new job is always mingled with a certain apprehension.  刚开始一份新工作时，兴奋中总是掺杂着一点担忧。
The two flavours mingle well.  两种味道混合在一起十分搭配。verb
You've been talking to Roger all evening - you really ought to be mingling with the other guests.  你整晚都和罗杰说话——你真的该和其他客人聊聊。

words.meaning: n.好客,殷勤,款待
words.example:
The local people showed me great hospitality.  当地人对我非常地热情友好。
