The company's guests at Ascot are entertained in the corporate hospitality area.  在阿斯科赛马会上，该公司的客人在团体招待区内受到了款待。

words.meaning: n.命令;需要;规则;祈使语气a.强制的;紧急的
words.example:
In the phrase 'Leave him alone!', the verb 'leave' is in the imperative form.  在句子 Leave him alone! 中，动词 leave 是祈使语气动词／用的是祈使语气。UK noun
In the phrase 'Leave him alone!', the verb 'leave' is an imperative/is in the imperative.  在句子 Leave him alone! 中，动词 leave 是祈使语气动词／用的是祈使语气。UK noun
Getting the unemployed back to work, said the minister, is a moral imperative.  部长说，让失业者重返工作岗位是一件道义上必须做的事。

words.meaning: n.语法,语法书
words.example: a German grammar  一本德语文法书

words.meaning: n.(modernisation)现代化
words.example: Modernization transformed the city.  现代化改变了这座城。

words.meaning: n.怒吼,嗥叫 vi.(风等)怒吼,咆哮
words.example:
In the silence of the night, a lone wolf howled.  在寂静的夜里，一只孤独的狼在嚎叫。
An injured dog lay in the middle of the road, howling with/in pain.  一只受伤的狗躺在路中间，痛苦地嚎叫着。
We were howling with laughter.  我们放声大笑。

words.meaning: a.冷漠的,不关心的,不积极的
words.example:
Why don't you vote - how can you be so indifferent (to what is going on)!  你为甚么不投票？你怎能（对正在发生的事情）如此漠不关心！
He found it very hard teaching a class full of indifferent teenagers.  他发觉教一班无动于衷的十几岁的孩子真是头痛。UK adjective
We didn't like the restaurant much - the food was indifferent and the service rather slow.  我们不怎么喜欢这家餐馆——饭菜一般，上菜也相当慢。

words.meaning: n.板球;蟋蟀
words.example: It's simply not cricket to flirt with another man's wife.  跟别人的妻子调情真不道德。

words.meaning: a.腐烂的,腐朽的
words.example:
The room smelled of rotten vegetables.  房间里一股蔬菜腐烂的味道。
old-fashioned It was rotten of you to leave without saying goodbye.  你竟然不辞而别，也太不像话了。UK adjective
The whole legal system is rotten to the core.  整个司法系统简直就是“头顶生疮脚底流脓”－－烂透了。

words.meaning: n.湿气,湿度
words.example: The temperature is almost eighty degrees, the humidity in the low thirties.  温度已经接近80度，湿度为30多一点。

words.meaning: v.欺骗,蒙蔽
words.example:
The company deceived customers by selling old computers as new ones.  该公司用旧电脑冒充新机器欺骗顾客。
The sound of the door closing deceived me into thinking they had gone out.  关门声让我以为他们己经出门了。
She thinks he'll come back, but she's deceiving herself.  她认为他会回来，实际上她是在自欺欺人。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.起重机,鹤
words.example:
The crane lifted the container off the ship.  起重机吊起了船上的集装箱。noun countable
He craned forward to see the procession.  他伸长脖子看游行队伍。
Mike was craning his neck to get the first glimpse of the car.  麦克伸长脖子，想抢先一睹那辆汽车的风采。

words.meaning: n.(尤指心灵上的)极度痛苦,烦恼
words.example:
His anguish at the outcome of the court case was very clear.  得知案件的庭审结果，他痛苦欲绝，这是显而易见的。
In her anguish she forgot to leave a message.  万分悲痛之中，她忘了留个口信。

words.meaning: n.乌鸦 v./n.鸡啼,鸣叫
words.example:
We were woken at dawn by a cock crowing repeatedly.  黎明时，我们被一阵阵的鸡啼声吵醒。
He's always crowing about his latest triumph.  他老是吹嘘他最近取得的成功。

words.meaning: n.大炮,火炮
words.example: An old cannon guards the fort.  一座旧大炮守卫着堡垒。

words.meaning: n.众多,大量
words.example:
The city has a multitude of problems, from homelessness to drugs and murder.  这个城市存在着很多问题，从无家可归到吸毒和谋杀，不胜枚举。
This case has raised a multitude of questions.  这个案例引出了许多问题。
He stepped out onto the balcony to address the multitude below.  他走上讲台，向台下的人群发表演讲。

words.meaning: n.斗蓬,披风;掩饰,幌子vt.掩盖,掩饰
words.example:
The restaurant he owned was just a cloak for (= hid) his drug-dealing activities.  他开那家餐馆不过是为他从事毒品交易作掩护。
They left the house under cloak of darkness.  他们趁着天黑离开了那所房子。UK verb transitive
He has always kept his love affairs cloaked in secrecy (= kept them secret).  他总是隐瞒他的风流韵事。

words.meaning: v.编织,编结;接合,粘合
words.example:
She's forever knitting.  她总是在织东西。
She's busy knitting baby clothes.  她忙着编织婴儿衣服。
Knit one, purl one.  正一针，反一针。verb

words.meaning: n.气质,性格,性情;资质
words.example: a fiery temperament  暴躁的性情

words.meaning: v./n.落后,滞后 vt.用隔热材料覆盖(锅炉等)
words.example:
He's lagging behind a bit - I think we'd better wait for him to catch us up.  他有点脱队了——我看我们最好等他赶上来。
Sales are lagging at the moment.  目前的销售很不景气。verb (-gg-)
You have to allow for a time lag between order and delivery.  订货和送货之间要有一段时间间隔。noun countable

words.meaning: n.尼龙
words.example: These covers are 100% nylon.  这些套子是百分之百尼龙的。

words.meaning: vi.(abode,abided)(by)遵守;坚持;vt.忍受,容忍
words.example:
He couldn't abide laziness.  他无法容忍懒惰。 old use
He abided in the wilderness for forty days.  他在荒野中渡过了40天。 old use
Competitors must abide by the judge's decision.  参赛者必须服从裁判的裁决。

words.meaning: n.毕业文凭,学位证书
words.example: a diploma in business studies  商学文凭

words.meaning: v.鞭打,摆动,捆扎 n.鞭子,鞭打,睫毛,讽刺
words.example:
The prisoners were regularly lashed with electric cable.  犯人经常被人用电缆抽打。
The sound of the rain lashing against the windows was deafening.  雨点敲打窗户发出巨大的声响。
I've lashed your case to the roof rack.  我把你的箱子系在车顶的行李架上了。

words.meaning: v.围住,圈起,封入
words.example:
The park that encloses the monument has recently been enlarged.  环绕着纪念碑的那个公园最近扩建了。UK verb transitive
Please enclose a curriculum vitae with your letter of application.  请在求职信中附上一份简历。

words.meaning: v./n.闪耀,闪烁
words.example:
The flame above the oil well flared (up) into the dark sky.  油井上的火焰一下子旺烧起来，直冲向漆黑的夜空。UK verb
Violence flared up again last night.  昨晚再次爆发暴力事件。
Tempers flared after a three-hour delay at Gatwick Airport yesterday.  昨天格域机场三小时的航班延误使得群情激愤。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.激怒,恼火,使急躁
words.example:
After a while her behaviour really began to irritate me.  过了一会儿儿，她的行为真让我恼火了。verb transitive
At first my contact lenses irritated my eyes.  起初一戴上隐形眼镜，我的眼睛就痛。

words.meaning: n.寄生虫,食客
words.example:
The older drugs didn't deal effectively with the malaria parasite.  以前的药物不能有效对付引起疟疾的寄生虫。
Financial speculators are parasites upon the national economy.  金融投机者是国民经济的寄生虫。

words.meaning: n.郊区
words.example: We live on the outskirts of town.  我们住在市郊。

words.meaning: v.简化,使单纯
words.example: He tried to simplify the story for the younger audience.  在讲给年龄较小的听众听时，他尽可能地简化这个故事。

words.meaning: v./n.羡慕,忌妒
words.example: Her hair is the envy of the office.  她的一头秀发令同办公室的人好生羡慕。

words.meaning: a.显而易见的,值得注意的,重要的
words.example: There has been a noticeable improvement in Tim's cooking.  提姆的烹饪水准显著提高。

words.meaning: n.公鸡,雄鸡;龙头,开关
words.example:
The cock started to crow.  公鸡开始叫了。
Wotcher, cock! How's things?  嘿，伙计！怎么样？UK verb
He cocked his head on one side with a slight frown.  他把头歪向一边，皱了皱眉。

words.meaning: n.词典,字典
words.example: To check how a word is spelt, look it up in a dictionary.  要确定单词的拼法就查词典。

words.meaning: n.手帕
words.example: She took out her handkerchief and blew her nose loudly.  她掏出手帕大声地擤鼻涕。    Compare tissue

words.meaning: v.放射,辐射;散布,传播
words.example:
The planet Jupiter radiates twice as much heat from inside as it receives from the Sun.  木星内部散发出的热量是它吸收太阳热量的两倍。
He was radiating joy and happiness.  他显得快乐而又幸福。
Enthusiasm was radiating from her.  她热情洋溢。verb

words.meaning: n./v.(联合)抵制,拒绝参与
words.example:
People were urged to boycott the country's products.  人们被鼓动起来杯葛那个国家的产品。
The union called on its members to boycott the meeting.  工会号召其成员拒绝参加会议。

words.meaning: a.习惯的,惯例的
words.example: She's not her customary cheerful self today.  她今天不像往常那样乐呵呵的。UK adjective

words.meaning: vt.撇去(液体表面)之漂浮物 vi.轻轻掠过
words.example:
The birds skimmed (across/along/over) the tops of the waves.  鸟儿从浪头上飞过。
We watched a child skimming stones across the lake.  我们看着一个孩子在湖上打水漂。 (-mm-)
I've only skimmed (through/over) his letter; I haven't read it carefully yet.  我只是大致看了一遍他的来信，还没有细读。

words.meaning: n.直觉,直观;凭直觉而知的事物
words.example: Often there's no clear evidence one way or the other and you just have to base your judgment on intuition.  很多时候，往往没有这样或那样的确凿证据，你只好凭直觉进行判断。

words.meaning: a.惯常的;习惯的,适应的(一般作表语)
words.example:
She quickly became accustomed to his messy ways.  她很快就习惯了他的邋遢作风。
I'm not accustomed to being treated like this.  我不习惯别人这样待我。
She performed the task with her accustomed ease.  她以一贯的轻松自如完成了任务。

words.meaning: v.计算,总计,估计,猜想,依赖
words.example:
She was widely reckoned (to be) the best actress of her generation.  人们普遍认为她是她那一代最优秀的演员。verb
Angela quickly reckoned the amount on her fingers.  安吉拉掰着手指头快速计算了一下数量。
The inflation rate is now reckoned to be 10%.  据计算，现在的通货膨胀率是10%。verb

words.meaning: a.古怪的,怪癖的,异乎寻常的n.古怪的人
words.example: My mother's a bit of an eccentric.  我妈妈有点古怪。

words.meaning: v.偶然听到,从旁听到
words.example: I'm sorry, I couldn't help overhearing.  很抱歉，我是碰巧听到的。

words.meaning: a.亲切的,客气的;宽厚的,仁慈的
words.example:
He was gracious enough to thank me.  他很有礼貌地向我道谢。
The losing team were gracious in defeat.  失利的球队豁达地面对失败。adjective
We can't afford gracious living.  我们过不起安逸的生活。exclamation old-fashioned

words.meaning: v./n.推翻,颠覆
words.example: the overthrow of the monarchy  君主制的推翻noun UK THROW  扔

words.meaning: n.博士学位;博士头衔
words.example: She has a doctorate in physics from Norwich.  她获得了诺里奇大学的物理学博士学位元。

words.meaning: n.欠缺,缺点;退还的关税
words.example: One of the drawbacks of living with someone is having to share a bathroom.  和别人合住的缺点之一就是不得不合用洗手间。

words.meaning: n.货物,货运,运费
words.example:
The ship carries both freight and passengers.  这艘船既载货又载客。
Will the goods be sent by air or sea freight?  这些货物要空运还是海运？
Grapes from this region are freighted all over the world.  这个地区生产的葡萄被运到世界各地。adverb

words.meaning: a.不注意的,大意的,卤莽的,不顾后果的
words.example: He was found guilty of reckless driving.  他被判鲁莽驾驶罪名成立。

words.meaning: n.家庭主妇
words.example: Being a housewife is a full-time job.  当家庭主妇是份全职工作。

words.meaning: a.外面的,公开的,向外的ad.向外,在外n.外表
words.example:
The outward appearance of the building has not changed at all in 200 years.  这幢大楼的外观200年里丝毫未变。
If he is suffering, he certainly shows no outward sign of it.  即使他很痛苦，他也肯定不会表露一点出来。
To all outward appearances everything was fine, but under the surface the marriage was very shaky.  表面看来，一切都很好，但实际上这段婚姻很不稳固。    Compare inwardUK adjective

words.meaning: n.半球
words.example: the northern hemisphere  北半球

words.meaning: v.妨碍 n.(身体或智力方面的)缺陷;不利条件
words.example:
In cases of severe mental handicap, constant supervision is recommended.  对于严重的智障病人，建议进行不间断的监护。noun
Handicaps give people with different abilities an equal chance of winning.  让步赛给具有不同能力的人同等的获胜机会。
My current golf handicap is nine.  我现在的高尔夫让分是九杆。verb transitive (-pp-)

words.meaning: vt.使惊奇,使惊愕;使困惑 vi.表现出惊奇
words.example:
You've done all your homework in an hour? You amaze me.  你在一小时内就把作业全做完了？太不简单了。
It amazes me how you can put up with living in such a dirty house.  住在这种肮脏的房子里你也受得了，真有你的。
It never ceases to amaze me how he can talk for so long without ever saying anything interesting.  他滔滔不绝那么久竟然说不出半点有趣的事，这本事真够让我惊奇一辈子的。

words.meaning: v.更新,修复
words.example: He renovates old houses and sells them at a profit.  他靠翻修老房子再出售赚钱。

words.meaning: vi.(飞机)陡升 n.陡升;嗡嗡声
words.example:
They got into the car and zoomed off.  他们钻进汽车一溜烟地开走了。
In the last few metres of the race, she suddenly zoomed ahead.  到了比赛的最后几米，她突然冲到前面。
House prices suddenly zoomed last year.  去年房价飙升。 informal

words.meaning: n.缰绳,统治,支配 v.驾驭,控制,统治
words.example:
You pull on both reins to stop or slow a horse, but only the left rein to turn left.  拉两边的缰绳来让马停住或放慢速度，但是要想左转时，只需拉左边的缰绳。
The young film-makers were given free rein to experiment with new themes and techniques.  年轻的电影制片者们对新主题和新技巧可以自由尝试。
He deliberately gave his emotions free rein as he played the sonata.  演奏这首奏鸣曲时，他刻意使自己的感情尽情奔放。noun countable usually plural

words.meaning: a.负的,减的 prep.减去 n.负号,减号
words.example:
What is 57 minus 39?  57减39是多少？
That will be £1500, minus the deposit of £150 that you have already paid.  减去你已付的150英镑的订金，那就是1500英镑。    Compare plus    informal
We're minus a chair for Ian - could you get one from the other room?  我们没有椅子给伊恩坐了——你能从另一个房间拿一张过来吗？noun countable (plural minuses)

words.meaning: n.肺炎
words.example:
People who are bedridden can easily get pneumonia.  长期卧床的人易患肺炎。
She'll catch pneumonia going out without a coat in this weather!  她这种天气不穿大衣出去会得肺炎的！

words.meaning: a.成长的,成熟的,成人的 n.成年人
words.example:
Ask a grown-up to cut the shape out for you.  请大人来替你剪出这个形状。adjective UK  ADVANCED
She has two grown-up children who work in the family business.  她有两个孩子，都已长大成人，在他们的家族企业工作。
He seems very grown-up for a ten-year-old.  做为一个十岁的小朋友，他看上去很成熟。

words.meaning: n.帝王,君主,最高统治者
words.example: Britain's head of state is a constitutional monarch (= only has very limited powers).  英国的国家元首是君主立宪的女王。

words.meaning: n.摇篮;发源地
words.example:
The nurse rocked the cradle.  保姆摇动摇篮。noun countable
Fossil records indicate that Africa was the cradle of early human evolution.  化石记载表明非洲是早期人类进化的摇篮。
She lived in the same village from the cradle to the grave.  她一辈子都住在同一个村庄里。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.抱有,怀有(希望等);爱护,抚育;珍爱
words.example:
Although I cherish my children, I do allow them their independence.  尽管我爱护自己的孩子，但我也的确允许他们独立。
Her most cherished possession is a 1926 letter from F. Scott Fitzgerald.  她最珍爱之物是佛兰西斯‧史考特‧费兹杰罗在1926年写给她的一封信。
Freedom of speech is a cherished (= carefully protected) right in this country.  在这个国家，言论自由是备受保护的权利。

words.meaning: n.美味,味道,调味品,食欲,乐趣 v.喜欢,品味
words.example:
She's relishing the prospect of studying in Bologna for six months.  她憧憬着在博洛尼亚学习6个月的美好时光。noun
Would you like relish on your burger?  你的汉堡包要涂调味汁吗？noun
She ate her cake slowly and with relish.  她津津有味地慢慢品尝着蛋糕。

words.meaning: adj.广阔的,宽敞的
words.example: a spacious house/living room  宽敞的房子／起居室

words.meaning: v.走私;偷运
words.example:
She was caught trying to smuggle 26 kilos of heroin out of/into the country.  她在企图把两万六千克的海洛因走私出境／入境时被抓获。
They managed to smuggle a videotape of the captive journalists out of the prison.  他们设法把被俘记者的录影带偷偷带出监狱。

words.meaning: a.普通的,平庸的n.寻常的事物,平庸的东西
words.example:
Home computers are increasingly commonplace.  家用电脑越来越普及了。UK noun countable formal
We exchanged commonplaces about the weather over cups of tea.  我们喝了几杯茶，就天气方面的话题寒暄了几句。

words.meaning: v.把…带错路,使误入岐途
words.example: He has admitted misleading the police about his movements on the night of the murder.  他承认误导了警方，使他们对他在谋杀案发生当晚的行踪产生了错误的判断。

words.meaning: ad.附带地,顺便提及
words.example:
We had a marvellous meal at that restaurant you recommended - incidentally, I must give you the number of a similar one I know.  我们在你推荐的那家餐馆大快朵颐了一顿——对了，我一定要把我知道的类似的一家餐馆的电话号码给你。
Incidentally, I wanted to have a word with you about your expenses claim.  顺便说一句，我原来打算和你谈一下你的开支报销问题。

words.meaning: vt.纪念,庆祝
words.example: Gathered all together in this church, we commemorate those who lost their lives in the great war.  我们聚集在这座教堂里，缅怀那些在大战中丧生的人。

words.meaning: a.突然的,出其不意的;(行为等)粗鲁无礼的
words.example:
Our conversation came to an abrupt end when George burst into the room.  乔治突然冲进房间里，我们的谈话戛然而止。
The road ended in an abrupt (= sudden and very steep) slope down to the sea.  道路沿一个险峭陡坡俯冲到海边，就到了尽头。adjective
He is sometimes very abrupt with clients.  他有时对待客户非常粗鲁。

words.meaning: a.同时的,同时存在的
words.example: There were several simultaneous explosions in different cities.  几起爆炸同时在不同的城市发生。

words.meaning: n.讨厌的人(或东西);麻烦事
words.example:
I've forgotten my umbrella - what a nuisance!  我忘了带伞——真讨厌！
Local residents claimed that the noise was causing a public nuisance.  当地居民称这种噪音妨害了公共利益。

words.meaning: a.头晕目眩的,眩晕的;(可能)使人头晕的
words.example:
Going without sleep for a long time makes me feel dizzy and light-headed.  长时间不睡觉让我觉得头晕目眩。
Who could have predicted the dizzy pace of change in the country?  谁能料到这个国家会发生日新月异的变化？
In the film, she played the part of a dizzy blonde.  在那部电影里，她扮演了一位傻乎乎的金发女郎。adjective

words.meaning: n.半导体
words.example: Semiconductors are used for making integrated circuits and computers.  半导体用于制造积体电路和电脑。

words.meaning: n.交响乐,交响曲
words.example: Mahler's 9th symphony  马勒的《第九交响曲》

words.meaning: a.外部的,外面的 n.外部
words.example:
In some of the villages the exterior walls of the houses are painted pink.  在一些村子里，房屋外墙被漆成粉红色。
Exterior to the main house there is a small building that could be used as an office or studio.  房屋的主要单位外有一个小屋，可以用作办公室或工作间。
The Palace of Fontainebleau has a very grand exterior.  枫丹白露宫殿的外观雄伟壮丽。

words.meaning: a.永久的,永恒的,长期的
words.example:
They lived in perpetual fear of being discovered and arrested.  他们长期生活在恐惧中，担心被发现并遭到拘捕。
He has hard, cold eyes and his mouth is set in a perpetual sneer.  他双眼又凶又冷，嘴角总是挂着一丝蔑笑。

words.meaning: n.便鞋,拖鞋
words.example: a pair of slippers  一双拖鞋

words.meaning: n.小型考试,测验,问答比赛
words.example:
There are so many inane television quiz shows.  电视上有那么多愚蠢的智力竞赛节目。
There was a pop (= surprise) quiz in history at school today.  今天的历史课上进行了突击测验。verb transitive (-zz-)
She spent an hour being quizzed by journalists.  她花了一小时时间回答记者的提问。

words.meaning: a.贫瘠的;不育的;(植物)不结果的;无用的
words.example:
We drove through a barren, rocky landscape.  我们驾车时，经过一个到处都是岩石的不毛之地。
She became very depressed during the barren years when she was unable to paint.  她在作品匮乏的那几年间，变得非常消沉。    Compare fertile

words.meaning: n.合页,铰链 vi.依…而定
words.example:
We had to take the front door off its hinges to get our new sofa into the house.  我们不得不把前门从铰炼上卸下来，这样我们的新沙发才能搬进屋子里。verb
The prosecution's case hinged on the evidence of a witness who died before the trial.  控方的案子取决于一位证人的证词，而该证人已在审判前死去。
The film's plot hinges on a case of mistaken identity.  该电影的情节围绕着一宗身份误认案件展开。

words.meaning: a.谨慎的,智慧的,稳健的,节俭的
words.example: It's prudent to save for emergencies.  存钱应急是明智的。

words.meaning: conj.惟恐,免得
words.example: They were afraid to complain about the noise lest they annoyed the neighbours.  他们不敢对噪音有任何抱怨，唯恐惹恼了邻居。

words.meaning: a.全体一致的,一致同意的
words.example:
The jury returned a unanimous verdict of guilty after a short deliberation.  陪审团经过短时间商讨后一致裁决有罪。
After a lengthy discussion we reached a unanimous decision on the proposal.  经过长时间讨论，我们对这一提案作出了一致决定。
The new format has unanimous support and could be introduced next season.  新的设计获得了一致支持，将会在下个季度推广使用。

words.meaning: n.耙子,耙机 v.耙;搜索,探索
words.example:
He raked about in the drawer looking for his passport.  他在抽屉中翻来翻去找他的护照。
I've raked through the cupboard but I can't find my tennis racket.  我把橱柜翻了个遍，可就是找不到我的网球拍。verb
In the autumn I rake (up) the dead leaves.  秋天，我用耙子将落叶耙集成堆。

words.meaning: vt.暗杀,行刺;中伤
words.example: a plot to assassinate the Queen  暗杀女王的阴谋

words.meaning: v.重叠,与…交叠 n.重叠
words.example:
The fence is made of panels which overlap (each other).  这个围栏是由交叠的板条搭成的。
My musical tastes don't overlap with my brother's at all.  我对音乐的喜好和我弟弟完全不一样。noun countable or uncountable UK US [ˈoʊ.və˞-/
The roof tiles will need an overlap of several centimetres.  屋顶的瓦片需要互相重叠几公分。

words.meaning: a.已废弃的,过时的
words.example: Gas lamps became obsolete when electric lighting was invented.  电灯发明以后煤气灯就被淘汰了。

words.meaning: v.(用拉链或像拉链那样)合上或打开
words.example:
The new engine has given the car a lot more zip.  新引擎使这辆汽车加速不少。noun
The Dolphins are leading the Giants fourteen to zip (= by fourteen points to nothing).  海豚队以14比0领先巨人队。verb (-pp-)
This bag's too full, I can't zip it shut.  这袋子装得太满，拉链都拉不上了。

words.meaning: a.破产的;彻底缺乏的 vt.使破产n.破产者
words.example:
He went bankrupt after only a year in business.  他仅仅做了一年的生意就破产了。
The recession has led to many small businesses going bankrupt.  经济不景气导致许多小企业破产。
He believes that modern society is morally bankrupt.  他认为现代社会道德沦亡。noun countable legal

words.meaning: v.追上,超过,突然降临,压倒
words.example:
Our US sales have now overtaken our sales in Europe.  我们在美国的销售额现已超过了我们在欧洲的销售额。
We'd planned to hold a meeting tomorrow, but events have overtaken us (= things have changed).  我们本打算明天召开一个会议，但情况发生了变化。
Always check your rear view mirror before you overtake (another car).  超车前一定要先看一下倒后镜。UK US (overtook, overtaken)

words.meaning: a.贪吃的,贪婪的,渴望的
words.example: He's greedy for power/success.  他贪恋权力／极度渴望成功。

words.meaning: a.每年的,一年一度的 ad.每年,一年一次地
words.example:
We get a yearly pay increase.  我们每年加薪一次。
Interest is paid yearly.  利息按年支付。

words.meaning: n.牧民,牧羊人
words.example:
He shepherded the old people towards the dining room.  他把老人们带到餐厅。UK verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition
The dogs shepherded the sheep into the pens.  狗把羊赶进了羊圈。

words.meaning: n.剪子
words.example: Could you pass me the/those scissors, please.  请你把那把剪刀递给我，好吗？UK plural noun

words.meaning: n.轶事,趣闻,短故事
words.example: He told one or two amusing anecdotes about his years as a policeman.  他讲了一两件他当员警时发生的趣事。

words.meaning: n.表示;标志;记号;代用硬币 a.象征性的
words.example:
As a token of our gratitude for all that you have done, we would like you to accept this small gift.  为了表示我们对你们所做的一切的感谢，希望你们接受我们这份小小的礼物。
It doesn't have to be a big present - it's just a token.  礼物不必大——只是为了表示一下。UK noun countable
The troops in front of us either surrendered or offered only token (= not much) resistance.  我们前面的军队要么投降，要么只作象征性的抵抗。

words.meaning: n.喇叭,小号
words.example:
We could hear the elephants trumpeting in the distance.  我们可以听见远处大象的吼声。verb
The museum has been loudly trumpeting its reputation as one of the finest in the world.  该博物馆一直在大肆吹嘘自己是世界上最好的博物馆之一。
Their much- trumpeted price cuts affect only 5% of the goods that they sell.  他们极力吹嘘的降价只涉及到所卖商品的5%。

words.meaning: a.轻率的,鲁莽的 n.皮疹
words.example:
I've got an itchy rash all over my chest.  我胸部出满了疹子，痒得要命。
He came out/up in a rash after he fell in a patch of nettles.  他摔倒在一片荨麻地里，结果身上就起了疹子。
If you stay in the sun too long you'll get (a) heat rash.  如果你在阳光下呆得太久，就会生痱子。noun

words.meaning: a.(to,for)必不可少的,必需的
words.example:
This book is an indispensable resource for researchers.  这本书是研究人员必不可少的资料。
His long experience at the United Nations makes him indispensable to the talks.  在联合国长期的工作经验使他成为谈判中不可或缺的人物。

words.meaning: n.染料 v.染,染色
words.example:
For a change, why not dye your T-shirts?  为什么不变一变把T恤染成别的颜色？
She dipped the material into the dye.  她把布料浸在染料中。
There are dozens of different dyes to choose from.  可供选择的染料有数十种之多。

words.meaning: v./n.反抗,起义
words.example:
The people revolted against foreign rule and established their own government.  人们奋起反抗外来统治，并成立了自己的政府。UK verb
We were revolted by the dirt and mess in her house.  她家里又脏又乱，我们看着心里生厌。
It revolts me to know that the world spends so much money on arms when millions are dying of hunger.  这个世界有数以百万计的人因饥饿挣扎在死亡线上，但却有那么多的钱花在军备上，这真让我感到震惊。

words.meaning: n.小册子
words.example: The pamphlet explains the tax rules.  小册子讲解了税法。

words.meaning: v./n.敬礼,鸣礼炮;迎接,欢迎
words.example:
Whenever you see an officer, you must salute.  只要见到军官就必须敬礼。
The soldiers saluted the colonel.  士兵们向上校敬礼。verb
On this memorable occasion we salute the wonderful work done by the association.  在这个难忘的时刻，我们对协会出色的成就表示赞扬。

words.meaning: a.东方的,东方诸国的 n.东方人
words.example: The palace has oriental carpets.  宫殿里铺着东方地毯。

words.meaning: n.扣子,钩子;握手 v.扣住,钩住;紧握,紧抱
words.example:
He was clasping the vase tightly, terrified of dropping it.  他紧紧抱住花瓶，生怕把它摔了。
Lie on your back, clasp your knees and pull them down towards your chest.  仰卧，抱紧双膝，并拉向胸前。
She clasped her son in her arms.  她把儿子紧紧抱在怀里。UK noun

words.meaning: n.蜂群;一大群 vi.涌往;挤满;云集;成群移动
words.example:
The dead sheep was covered with swarms of flies.  这头死羊身上爬满一群群的苍蝇。
After the game, thousands of football fans swarmed onto the pitch.  比赛后，成千上万的足球迷涌进球场。UK verb intransitive
The garden is swarming with wasps.  花园里到处都是黄蜂。

words.meaning: vt.(用绳、链等)拖(车、船等) n.拖,牵引
words.example:
You shouldn't drive fast when your car is towing a caravan.  汽车在拖动活动住房时不能开快车。
The road was closed while the vehicles that had been involved in the accident were towed away/off.  在发生交通事故的车辆被拖走时，这条道路被封闭。
The damaged boat was towed to safety.  受损船只被拖至安全区。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.妨碍,障碍物
words.example:
There's some sort of obstruction on the railway tracks.  铁轨上有障碍物。
They were charged with obstruction of the police/of justice (= preventing the police/law courts from doing their jobs).  他们被指控妨碍警方执行公务／法庭审判。
The referee said it was obstruction.  裁判判定这是阻挡犯规。

words.meaning: n.半岛
words.example: the Korean/Arabian/Florida Peninsula  朝鲜／阿拉伯／佛罗里达半岛

words.meaning: v./n.脸红
words.example: She blushes when praised.  一被夸她就脸红。

words.meaning: v.轻视,蔑视
words.example:
The two groups despise each other.  这两个团体互相鄙视。
She despised him for the way he treated her sister.  他那样对待她姐姐，让她感到很厌恶。

words.meaning: n./v.(使)沮丧;(使)惊慌;(使)失望,(使)绝望
words.example:
Aid workers were said to have been filled with dismay by the appalling conditions that the refugees were living in.  据说援助人员看到难民所处的恶劣生活环境时都感到非常沮丧。
The supporters watched in/with dismay as their team lost 6-0.  球队的支持者们郁闷地看着自己的球队以０比６的比分输掉了比赛。
She discovered, to her dismay, that her exam was a whole month earlier than she'd expected.  她郁闷地发现考试比她预料的早了整整一个月。

words.meaning: n.(在国外)旅游者;朝圣者,最初的移民
words.example: Pilgrims visit the temple every spring.  朝圣者每年春天来寺庙。

words.meaning: n.百叶窗;(照相机)快门;关闭装置
words.example: Shutters usually come in pairs and are hung like doors on hinges.  护窗板通常是成对的，像门一样挂在铰链上。

words.meaning: v.节制,避免,制止 n.(诗的)叠句
words.example:
We refrained from talking until we knew that it was safe.  我们缄默不语，直到确定安全了才开始说话。
'Every vote counts' is a familiar refrain in politics.  “每一票都重要”是政治上的老生常谈。

words.meaning: n.无性繁殖,克隆;复制品v.克隆
words.example:
Most people saw her as just another blond-haired, red-lipped Marilyn Monroe clone.  很多人把她看作金发红唇的玛丽莲‧梦露的翻版。
Scientists have already cloned a sheep.  科学家已经复制出一只羊。
Experiments to try to clone human embryos have met with hostility from some sections of the public.  尝试复制人类胚胎的实验遭到了部分公众人士的强烈反对。

words.meaning: v.妨碍,阻碍,牵制
words.example: Fierce storms have been hampering rescue efforts and there is now little chance of finding more survivors.  猛烈的暴风雨妨碍了救援工作的进行，现在找到更多生还者的希望已经很渺茫了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(正式的)宴会 vi.参加宴会 vt.宴情
words.example: Medieval banquets are held in the castle once a month.  每个月在城堡里举行一次中世纪风格的宴会。

words.meaning: n.霜,霜冻,严寒
words.example:
There was a frost last night.  昨天晚上下霜了。
When I woke up this morning the ground was covered with frost.  我今天早晨醒来的时候地面上覆盖了一层霜。
There were a lot of hard/heavy (= severe) frosts that winter.  那年冬天多次出现严重的霜冻。UK verb

words.meaning: n.瓷器
words.example: china plates  瓷碟

words.meaning: a.香的;芬芳的
words.example: The sauce itself was light, fragrant and slightly sweet.  酱料本身味道清淡、芳香，而且稍微有点甜味。

words.meaning: n.消防队员
words.example: The fireman broke down the door.  消防员破门而入。

words.meaning: n.粉笔,白垩
words.example:
My brother and I are like chalk and cheese.  我哥哥和我截然不同。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Today's victory is the fifth that the Irish team has chalked up this year.  今天的胜利是爱尔兰队今年获得的第五次胜利。
It was doubtful whether the Conservatives could chalk up a fourth successive election victory, but they did.  保守党能否连续四次在选举中获胜令人怀疑，但是他们做到了。

words.meaning: n.导师;家庭教师 v.辅导;当导师;当家庭教师
words.example:
His tutor encouraged him to read widely in philosophy.  他的导师鼓励他广泛阅读哲学著作。
During my illness I was taught by a series of home tutors.  我生病期间由一些家庭教师教我。

words.meaning: n.炉子,熔炉
words.example:
People who work with furnaces in a steel factory need to wear protective clothing.  钢厂里在熔炉边工作的人都需要穿防护服。
This room's like a furnace (= is very hot) !  这个房间热得像熔炉！
It's cold in here - should I turn on the furnace?  这里很冷——要不要我把暖气炉打开？

words.meaning: vt.(使)增大,增加,增长,扩张
words.example: He would have to find work to augment his income.  他可能不得不找一些工作来增加收入。

words.meaning: v.维护,保护,捍卫 n.安全装置,安全措施
words.example: The union safeguards the interests of all its members.  工会捍卫每位成员的利益。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.理发师 vt.为…理发修整 vi.当理发师
words.example: The barber gave me a haircut.  理发师给我理了发。

words.meaning: n./v.投机,冒险;赌博
words.example:
Her publishers knew they were taking a gamble when they agreed to publish such an unusual novel.  她的出版商知道，同意出版这样一部标新立异的小说是一种冒险。
It was a gamble using such an inexperienced director, but it paid off (= was successful).  任用这样一位没有经验的导演确实是一种赌博，但结果大获成功。verb
Anyone who gambles on the stock exchange has to be prepared to lose money.  任何进行股票投机的人都必须要做好赔钱的准备。

words.meaning: n.控制台,仪表板;落地柜 vt.安慰,慰问
words.example: a computer console  电脑控制台

words.meaning: a.轻快的;生气勃勃的;兴隆的
words.example:
He set a brisk pace and we struggled to keep up.  他步伐矫健，我们在后面拼命跟着。
Her tone on the telephone was brisk (= she spoke quickly and used few words) and businesslike.  电话里她的语气简洁干练。

words.meaning: v.(用力)举,提,拉;扔;拖;呕吐n.举起
words.example:
He cleared a space, heaving boxes out of the way.  他搬开箱子挪出一处空间。
She picked up a great book and heaved it at him.  她拿起一本大书就朝他扔过去。
As the wind increased, the deck of the ship began to heave beneath his feet.  随着风力增大，轮船甲板开始在他脚下颠簸起来。verb

words.meaning: a.庄严的,隆重的;严肃的
words.example: Everyone looked very solemn.  大家看起来都很严肃。

words.meaning: a.容忍的,宽容的;有耐药力的
words.example:
The present government is even less tolerant of dissent.  当权政府甚至更不能容忍异议。
On the continent people are more tolerant of children in public places.  在欧洲大陆，人们在公共场所对孩子更为宽容。UK adjective
Compared to other plants, rye is more tolerant of drought.  黑麦比其他植物更耐旱。

words.meaning: n.猎狗;卑鄙的人 vt.用猎狗追,追逐
words.example:
The reporters wouldn't stop hounding her.  记者不停地烦扰她。verb transitive
He claims he was hounded out of his job by a group of students who disapproved of his views.  他声称自己是被一群与他观点不合的学生逼迫离职的。

words.meaning: n.化学家;药剂师
words.example: The chemist formulated a new drug.  药剂师配制了一种新药。

words.meaning: v./n.恐惧,担心
words.example:
He's dreading his driving test - he's sure he's going to fail.  他在为驾照考试而担心——他觉得自己肯定过不了。
The prospect of working full-time fills me with dread.  可能要实行全日工作制，这让我很担忧。

words.meaning: vt.不理会;忽视;漠视 n.忽视;漠视
words.example:
What amazes me is her complete disregard for anyone else's opinion.  让我吃惊的是，她完全无视他人的意见。UK verb transitive
He told us to disregard everything we'd learned so far and start again.  他告诉我们不要考虑所学过的东西，一切要重新开始。

words.meaning: n.桨 v.用桨划
words.example:
Shall we go for a paddle?  我们去玩水好吗？verb
We rolled up our trousers and paddled along the seashore.  我们卷起裤管沿海边涉水而行。verb

words.meaning: a.笨拙的,愚笨的
words.example:
The first mobile phones were heavy and clumsy to use, but nowadays they are much easier to handle.  第一代手机用起来很笨重，而现在的手机就轻便多了。
My attempts to apologize were very clumsy (= not said well).  我想道歉，却拙嘴笨舌的。
That's the third glass you've smashed this week - you're so clumsy!  这已经是你这个星期打破的第三只杯子了——真是太笨了！

words.meaning: n.字母表;初步,入门
words.example: the Cyrillic alphabet  西里尔字母表

words.meaning: v.弄脏,污染
words.example:
The fertilizers and pesticides used on many farms are polluting the water supply.  农场里使用的化肥和杀虫剂正在污染供水。
We won't invest in any company that pollutes the environment.  我们不会投资任何污染环境的公司。
figurative Many Americans complain that broadcasters pollute the airwaves with violence, sensationalism and sleaze.  许多美国人抱怨说广播公司用暴力、耸人听闻的题材和低级庸俗的内容污染了无线电波。

words.meaning: n.笔迹,手迹,书法
words.example:
We need to ensure that handwriting is properly taught in our primary schools.  我们要确保小学里有正规的习字课。
His handwriting is illegible.  他的笔迹很难认。

words.meaning: a.非凡的,卓越的;单数的
words.example:
The word 'woman' is singular.  Woman 这个单词是单数形式。UK adjective
It was a building of singular grace and beauty.  这栋建筑物非常雅致、漂亮。
He showed a singular lack of skill in painting.  他非常欠缺绘画技巧。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.伪善,虚伪
words.example: There's one rule for her and another rule for everyone else and it's sheer hypocrisy.  对她是一种标准，而对所有其他人却是另一种标准，这是彻头彻尾的虚伪。

words.meaning: n.俘虏 a.被俘虏的,被监禁的
words.example:
When the town was recaptured, we found soldiers who had been captives for several years.  夺回该镇后，我们找到了被俘数年的士兵。
The terrorists were holding several British diplomats captive.  恐怖分子扣押了数名英国外交官。

words.meaning: n.复制品 v.复写,使加倍 a.复制的,二重的
words.example: Keep a duplicate of the key.  留一把备用钥匙。

words.meaning: v.卷,盘绕 n.(一)卷,(一)圈;线圈,绕组
words.example:
She coiled her hair into a neat bun on top of her head.  她把头发在头顶挽成一个俐落的发髻。
figurative A coil of thick blue smoke rose up from his pipe.  一圈蓝色的浓烟从他的烟斗里冒了出来。

words.meaning: v.推论,推断
words.example: What do you infer from her refusal?  你从她的拒绝中能推断出甚么？

words.meaning: a.情绪异常激动的,歇斯底里的
words.example:
Calm down, you're getting hysterical.  冷静下来，你太激动了。
The police were accused of hysterical over-reaction.  警方被指责有些歇斯底里、反应过敏。
His last film was hysterical.  他最新的电影非常滑稽。

words.meaning: n.微生物,细菌
words.example:
Wash your hands so you don't get germs on the food.  洗洗手，你就不会把细菌弄到食物上了。
Rats and flies spread germs.  老鼠和苍蝇传播病菌。UK noun
He found the germ of an idea in an old newspaper.  他的想法萌生于一份旧报纸。

words.meaning: n.屠夫,卖肉者
words.example: Let's have a butcher's at your present, then.  那么，让我们看一看你的礼物。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.油船
words.example: an oil tanker  油轮

words.meaning: n.伙伴关系;联谊会,团体
words.example:
He enjoyed the fellowship of other actors in the company.  他和剧团里其他演员的交情不错。
He's been elected to a fellowship at Merton College.  他当选默顿学院的研究员。
She's applied for a research fellowship.  她已申请了研究生奖学金。

words.meaning: v.(使)外溢,(使)溢出;溢出,流出,漫出
words.example:
The milk overflowed when I poured it into the jug.  我往壶里倒牛奶的时候，牛奶溢了出来。
Because of heavy rain, the river may overflow its banks.  因为下大雨，河水可能会氾滥，漫过河岸。
Oh no, the bath is overflowing all over the floor.  啊呀，糟糕，浴缸满了，水流得满地都是。

words.meaning: v.充足,足够;vt.(食物等)使(某人)满足
words.example:
I'm taking four hundred pounds' worth of travellers' cheques - I think that should suffice.  我带了400英镑的旅行支票——我觉得应该够了。 formal
Suffice (it) to say, Mike won't be going to Tina's birthday party after what he said about her to her boss.  不用多说，麦克对蒂娜的老板那样说她之后，他是不会去参加她的生日聚会的。

words.meaning: n.海绵
words.example:
Give it a sponge with a damp cloth - that will remove the blood stains.  用湿布擦一下——能把血迹擦掉。noun
Most food stains will come off if you sponge the material with a little detergent.  用一点去污剂能去除布料上的大部分食物污渍。
The doctor told me to sponge Erik down with cold water in order to lower his temperature.  医生告诉我用冷水给埃里克擦身，以帮他降低体温。

words.meaning: n.(refrigerator的略语)冰箱
words.example: Don't forget to put the milk back in the fridge.  别忘了把牛奶放回冰箱里。

words.meaning: vt./n.有危险性的人(或物);威胁,威吓
words.example:
Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone.  醉酒驾驶者对所有人都构成威胁。
Dogs running loose are a public menace.  没有拴起来到处乱跑的犬只对公众安全构成威胁。
He had a slight air of menace which I found unsettling.  他略带威胁的神情使我感到不安。

words.meaning: a.不透明(光)的;难理解的,晦涩的
words.example: opaque glass/tights  不透明的玻璃／连裤袜

words.meaning: n./v.忙乱,大惊小怪
words.example:
She made such a fuss when Richard spilt a drop of wine on her blouse!  理查将一滴酒溅在她的衬衫上，她好一阵大惊小怪。
It's all a fuss about nothing.  这完全是无谓的大惊小怪。
We tried to arrange a ceremony with as little fuss as possible.  我们试图安排一个尽可能低调的仪式。

words.meaning: v.使羞辱,使丢脸[同]disgrace
words.example:
How could you humiliate me by questioning my judgment in front of everyone like that?  你怎么能那样当众质疑我的判断，令我丢脸？
England were humiliated (= completely defeated) in last night's match.  昨晚的比赛中英格兰队遭遇惨败。

words.meaning: a.麻木的,失去感觉的 v.使麻木
words.example:
My fingers were numb with cold.  我的手指冻僵了。
When she first heard the news, she was numb with disbelief.  她最初听到这条消息的时候，简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
Ever since his girlfriend left him he has felt numb.  自从女朋友离开他之后，他就变得麻木了。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.碗柜,小橱
words.example:
Is there plenty of cupboard space (= Are there many cupboards) in your new house?  你的新居有很多壁柜吗？UK noun countable
I'd like to help you out with your expenses, Paul, but I'm afraid the cupboard is bare.  保罗，我倒是想帮助你分担费用，不过恐怕我也是两手空空。

words.meaning: n.宽度,幅
words.example:
The length of this box is twice its breadth.  这个箱子的长度是其宽度的两倍。
The breadth of her knowledge is amazing.  她知识渊博，令人惊讶。
He showed an astonishing breadth of learning for one so young.  他年纪轻轻就显示出知识的渊博，很令人吃惊。

words.meaning: a.灭绝的;熄灭了的
words.example:
There is concern that the giant panda will soon become extinct.  有人担心大熊猫很快就会绝种。
Many tribes became extinct when they came into contact with Western illnesses.  很多部落由于感染西方人的疾病而受到灭顶之灾。

words.meaning: n.推动(力),促进
words.example: The recent publicity surrounding homelessness has given (a) fresh impetus to the cause.  最近围绕无家可归者的宣传对这项事业是一股新的推动力。

words.meaning: n.男孩,小伙子
words.example:
He's a nice lad.  他是个很不错的小伙子。
The Prime Minister's a local lad (= he was born and lived in this area).  首相是当地人。
[as form of address] Come on, lads, let's get this job finished, shall we!  来吧，小伙子们，我们把这个工作做完！noun countable

words.meaning: a.无效的,无用的,无希望的
words.example:
Attempts to get supplies to the region are futile because troops will not allow the aid convoy to enter the city.  往该地区运送物资的努力失败了，因为军方不允许救援物资护送队进城。
It 's quite futile trying to reason with him - he just won't listen.  跟他讲道理一点用都没有——他就是不听。
All my attempts to cheer her up proved futile.  我想让她快活起来，但所有的努力都白费了。

words.meaning: a.显眼的,明显的
words.example:
In China, her blonde hair was conspicuous.  在中国，她的金发十分显眼。
He tried not to look conspicuous and moved slowly along the back of the room.  他尽量不使自己显眼，沿着房间后部慢慢移动。    Opposite inconspicuousadjective
Why wasn't Stephen at the meeting, then? He was conspicuous by his absence.  那么，史蒂芬怎么没参加会议？他本应在场却不在，非常惹人注意。

words.meaning: n.肠;[pl.]内部,深处
words.example:
He has trouble with his bowels.  他的肠胃有问题。
The fire started deep in the bowels of the ship.  大火是从船的最底部烧起来的。

words.meaning: a.成荫的,多荫的;可疑的,靠不住的
words.example:
We sat on the shady grass for our picnic.  我们坐在阴凉的草地上野餐。adjective
They know some very shady characters.  他们认识一些行为非常可疑的人物。
He was involved in shady deals in the past.  过去他参与了一些不可告人的勾当。

words.meaning: a.残酷的,无情的
words.example: Some people believe that to succeed in this world you have to be ruthless.  有些人认为，在这个世界上要想成功必须冷酷无情。

words.meaning: n.跛子,残疾人 v.使跛,使残疾
words.example: a country crippled by war  因战争而元气大伤的国家

words.meaning: n.半径,半径范围,有效航程,范围,界限
words.example:
The radius of this wheel is 30 cm.  这个轮子的半径是30厘米。
This wheel has a radius of 30 cm.  这个轮子的半径是30厘米。
The station, shopping centre and school lie within a one-mile radius of the house.  车站、购物中心和学校都在距这所房子一英里的范围之内。 (plural radii)

words.meaning: n.扫帚
words.example: Sweep the porch with the broom.  用扫帚扫门廊。

words.meaning: v.举起,升起,吊起
words.example: With some difficulty he hoisted her onto his shoulders.  他费了些力气才把她扛到自己肩上。

words.meaning: n.绷带 v.用绷带扎缚
words.example: You ought to bandage (up) that cut.  你应该用绷带把伤口包扎起来。

words.meaning: vt.吸收,消化;使同化 vi.被吸收;被同化
words.example:
The European Union should remain flexible enough to assimilate more countries quickly.  欧盟应该保持足够的灵活性，以加快步伐吸收更多的国家为其成员。
You shouldn't expect immigrants to assimilate into an alien culture immediately.  你不应该指望移民能够马上融入一种外国文化中。
It's hard to assimilate (= learn and understand) so much information.  很难吸收这么多的资讯。

words.meaning: n.纠缠;缠结;混乱 v.(使)缠绕;变乱
words.example: He was a self-opinionated, overbearing tyrant, and he was the last man she should want to tangle with.  他这个人固执己见、盛气凌人、专横跋扈，她绝不要与他有甚么瓜葛。

words.meaning: v.拉长,延长,拖延
words.example:
We were having such a good time that we decided to prolong our stay by another week.  我们过得非常愉快，决定再多待一个星期。
She chewed each delicious mouthful as slowly as she could, prolonging the pleasure.  她细嚼慢咽，尽情地享受每一口美食。

words.meaning: vt.消化;领会,融会贯通 n.文摘,摘要
words.example:
Sit still and allow your meal to digest.  静静地坐着，让胃里的食物消化消化。verb[daɪˈdʒest/
This chapter is so difficult to digest, I shall have to read it again later.  这一章不容易理解消化，稍后我还得再看一遍。noun countable /ˈdaɪ.dʒest/
The company publishes a monthly digest of its activities.  该公司每月出一份活动简报。

words.meaning: vt.开始 vi.获得学位
words.example:
We will commence building work in August of next year.  我们将于明年八月开始破土动工。
Shall we let the meeting commence, gentlemen?  各位先生，我们开始会议，好吗？

words.meaning: v.丧生;凋谢;毁灭,消亡
words.example:
Three hundred people perished in the earthquake.  有300人在此次地震中丧生。
He believes that Europe must create closer ties or it will perish.  他认为整个欧洲必须建立更紧密的联系，否则就会灭亡。verb intransitive
Sunlight has caused the rubber to perish.  橡胶因暴露于阳光下而老化。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.驴子;蠢人;顽固的人
words.example:
Why should I do all the donkey work while you sit around doing nothing?  为甚么你在那里闲坐着甚么也不干，而我却要干所有这些枯燥乏味的工作？UK noun countable
She's been in the same job for donkey's years.  她这份工作做了很久了。

words.meaning: a.柔软的,易曲的 v./n.蹒跚,跛行
words.example:
Three minutes into the match, Jackson limped off the pitch with a serious ankle injury.  比赛刚刚开始三分钟，杰克逊就因脚踝严重受伤而下场。verb
The little boat limped slowly towards the shore.  那艘小船缓慢地向岸边靠近。
After limping along for almost two years, the economy is starting to show signs of recovery.  经过差不多两年的徘徊，经济开始出现了复苏的迹象。adjective

words.meaning: vt.稀释,冲淡 a.稀释的,冲淡的
words.example:
Dilute the juice (with water) before you drink it.  果汁先（用水）稀释一下再喝。
These measures are designed to dilute public fears about the product's safety.  采取这些措施是为了减轻公众对该产品安全的恐慌。adjective (US usually diluted)

words.meaning: n.风筝
words.example: to fly a kite  放风筝noun countable

words.meaning: a./n.紫外线(的)
words.example: Ultraviolet rays can burn your skin.  紫外线会晒伤皮肤。

words.meaning: vi.渐渐上升,升高vt.攀登,登上
words.example:
They slowly ascended the steep path up the mountain.  他们沿着陡峭的山路，缓缓地向上攀登。
There's a long flight of steps ascending (= leading up) to the cathedral doors.  要往上走很长一段楼梯，才能到达大教堂的门前。 formal
He eventually ascended to the position of chief executive.  他最终登上了总裁的宝座。 formal

words.meaning: a.免除的 v.免除 n.免税者;被免除义务者
words.example:
Small businesses have been exempted from the tax increase.  小公司可免增税。adjective
Goods exempt from this tax include books and children's clothes.  免征这项税收的商品包括书籍和童装。
Pregnant women are exempt from dental charges under the current health system.  在现行的医疗制度下，孕妇看牙医是免费的。

words.meaning: vt.压紧,压缩;(把思想、文字等)浓缩
words.example:
Firmly compress the soil in the pot so that the plant is secure.  把盆里的泥土压实以固定植物。
The course compresses two year's training into six intensive months.  这个课程把两年的培训内容压缩成六个月的强化训练。

words.meaning: a.致命的;终有一死的;人世间的 n.凡人
words.example:
For all men are mortal.  人终有一死。    Compare immortal
figurative New computing technology dealt a mortal blow to the power of the old printing unions.  新的电脑技术向传统印刷联合会的权威送上致命一击。    Compare lethal
We live in mortal dread of further attacks.  我们生活在极度恐惧中，担心会再受袭击。

words.meaning: ad.上岸;在岸上,向岸上
words.example:
We swam ashore.  我们向岸上游去。
Strong winds blew the ship ashore.  大风把船吹向陆地。

words.meaning: n.芦苇,苇丛;芦笛,牧笛
words.example: Reeds bend in the wind.  芦苇在风中弯曲。

words.meaning: n.(sulphur)硫
words.example: Volcanoes emit sulfur dioxide.  火山排放二氧化硫。

words.meaning: vt.逃避,回避;避开,躲避
words.example:
The police have assured the public that the escaped prisoners will not evade recapture for long.  警方向大众保证，逃犯很快就会再次落网。
She leant forward to kiss him but he evaded her by pretending to sneeze.  她身子前倾想要吻他，可是他假装打喷嚏躲开了。
An Olympic gold medal is the only thing that has evaded her in her remarkable career.  在其辉煌的运动生涯中，唯一没有得到的荣誉就是奥运金牌。

words.meaning: n.说服,说服力
words.example:
It took a lot of persuasion to convince the committee of the advantages of the new scheme.  让委员会相信新计划的种种好处要费尽许多唇舌。
She will help you - she just needs a bit of gentle persuasion.  她会帮你的——只是须要稍微劝劝她。
The occasion will be a test of the senator's powers of persuasion (= his ability to persuade people).  这是考验参议员说服力的时候了。UK noun

words.meaning: a.心智健全的,神志清醒的,明智的,稳健的
words.example:
In the doctor's opinion he was sane at the time of the murder.  按照医生的看法，他在谋杀时是神志清醒的。
humorous The only thing which keeps me sane after a hard day in the office is jogging!  在办公室辛苦工作一天后，唯一能使我保持头脑清醒的方法就是慢跑。
It was a sane (= sensible) decision and one we all respected.  这是一个明智的决定，也是我们都尊重的决定。

words.meaning: vt.放大,扩大,夸大,夸张
words.example:
Although our skin looks smooth, when magnified it is full of bumps and holes.  我们的皮肤看上去很光滑，但放大后却满是坑坑洼洼。
The hot summer magnified the racial tensions in the community.  炎热的夏日加深了社区的种族矛盾。

words.meaning: vt.确定,查明,弄清
words.example: The police have so far been unable to ascertain the cause of the explosion.  警方到目前为止尚未查明爆炸原因。

words.meaning: n.观众席,听众席;会堂,礼堂
words.example: No smoking in the auditorium.  观众席中禁止吸烟。

words.meaning: a.富裕的,丰富的
words.example: Strawberries are plentiful in the summer.  夏天草莓很多。

words.meaning: a.崇高的,高尚的;高傲的;极高的
words.example: a lofty ceiling/mountain/wall  高顶／山／墙UK adjective

words.meaning: vt.放大,增强;详述,详加解说
words.example: amplified music/guitar  经过放大的音乐／带有扩音设备的电吉他

words.meaning: n.(浓烈或难闻的)烟,气,汽
words.example: The whole episode left me fuming at the injustice of it all.  整个事件毫无正义可言，我感到非常愤怒。

words.meaning: v.剪,修剪
words.example:
The farmer taught her how to shear sheep.  那个农夫教了她如何剪羊毛。
He recalled the humiliation of having his hair shorn and exchanging his clothes for the prison uniform.  他记起了曾被剃光头、被迫换上囚服的耻辱。
The ex-President, although shorn of his official powers, still has influence.  前总统虽然被剥夺了权力，但是仍有影响力。UK US  (sheared, sheared or shorn)

words.meaning: v.(使)腐烂,(使)腐败,腐朽
words.example:
The fruit had been left to rot on the trees.  水果无人采摘，就烂在树上。
Rain has got in and rotted (away) the woodwork.  雨水漏了进来，使屋中的木建部分都朽烂了。
Ruben Carter was left to rot in jail for most of his life.  鲁宾．卡特的大半生都是在牢狱中度过的。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.弥漫,遍布,散布;渗入,渗透
words.example:
Dissatisfaction with the government seems to have permeated every section of society.  社会的每一个角落似乎都弥漫着对政府的不满。
The table has a plastic coating which prevents liquids from permeating into the wood beneath.  桌子上铺了一层塑胶，防止液体渗到下面的木材里。

words.meaning: n.(有柄,小口,可盛水等的)大壶,罐,盂
words.example: a glass/plastic jug  玻璃／塑胶壶

words.meaning: vt.(with)使认识,使了解,使熟悉
words.example: The Broadcasting Museum also offers Saturday workshops to acquaint children with the world of radio.  广播博物馆还举办周六讲习班让孩子了解无线电世界。

words.meaning: n.贫民窟,贫民区,陋巷
words.example:
She was brought up in the slums of Lima.  她在利马的贫民区长大。
This flat would be an absolute slum if I wasn't here to clean it.  如果不是我在这里打扫，这套公寓会脏乱得完全不像样。verb informal
We ran out of money on holiday and had to slum it in cheap hostels.  我们假期里把钱都花光了，所以不得不降低标准住进了廉价旅馆。

words.meaning: vi.随意翻阅,浏览;(牛、羊等)吃草
words.example:
Deer were browsing (on grass) under the trees.  鹿正在树下吃草。noun only singular mainly UK
We went for a browse around an antique shop.  我们去一家古董店随便看了看。

words.meaning: n./a.(皮肤因日晒而成)棕褐色(的) vt.晒黑
words.example:
Her skin tans very quickly in the summer.  她的皮肤在夏天很容易晒黑。
Tanned workmen were sitting around the dock.  皮肤晒得黑黝黝的工人在码头围坐。verb (-nn-)
I'll tan his hide if I catch him.  如果我抓到他，一定会把他揍扁。abbreviation    written abbreviation for

words.meaning: n.温度计
words.example: The thermometer shows 38 degrees.  温度计显示 38 度。

words.meaning: a.有限的;[数]有穷的,限定的
words.example:
The funds available for the health service are finite and we cannot afford to waste money.  用于公共医疗服务的资金是有限的，我们浪费不起。
We only have a finite amount of time to complete this task - we can't continue indefinitely.  我们须在有限的时间内完成这项任务，不能无限期地做下去。adjective

words.meaning: n.海角,岬;披肩,短披风
words.example: the Cape of Good Hope  好望角noun countable

words.meaning: vt.传授,给予;告知,通知
words.example: Preservatives can impart colour and flavour to a product.  防腐剂能保持产品的色泽和味道。

words.meaning: n.降落伞 v.跳伞
words.example:
The plan is to parachute into the town.  计划是要跳伞进入该城。
[often passive] Thousands of leaflets were parachuted behind enemy lines.  数千份传单被空投至敌后。

words.meaning: vt.向…提供娱乐,使…消遣;引人发笑
words.example:
I've brought with me an article from yesterday's paper that I thought might amuse you.  我带来了昨天报上的一篇文章，或许可以让你开怀一笑。
Apparently these stories are meant to amuse.  显然这些故事的目的就在于搞笑。
Shall I put on a video to amuse the kids while we're packing?  我们收拾行李时，要不要给孩子放段影片，逗他们开心？

words.meaning: vt.在…下划线;强调
words.example:
All the technical words have been underlined in red.  所有术语的下面都画了红线。
She put the figures up on the board to underline the seriousness of the situation.  她把资料写在黑板上，以强调形势的严峻。
To underline their disgust, the crowd started throwing bottles at the stage.  为了宣泄他们的厌恶，观众们开始朝舞台上扔瓶子。

words.meaning: n.腹,下腹(胸部到腿部的部分)
words.example: The pain is in my lower abdomen.  疼痛在下腹部。

words.meaning: a.狡猾的,偷偷摸摸的
words.example:
He's a sly old devil - I wouldn't trust him with my money.  他是个老滑头——我不会把钱交付给他的。
"You'll find out eventually," said Mary with a sly smile.  “你最后就知道了，”玛丽诡秘地笑着说。noun
He drives his mother's car on the sly while she's at work.  他趁母亲上班的时候偷开她的汽车。

words.meaning: v.确定数量
words.example: It's difficult to quantify how many people will be affected by the change.  很难确定将有多少人受到该变化的影响。

words.meaning: n.硅
words.example: Silicon is the basis of computer chips.  硅是电脑芯片的基础。

words.meaning: vt.表示,意味着
words.example: The colour red is used to denote passion or danger.  红色用于表示激情或危险。

words.meaning: a.发光的,辐射的,容光焕发的
words.example: He gave a radiant smile when he heard her news.  当他听到她的消息时，脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容。adjective

words.meaning: n.一针;(因跑步引起的)肋部剧痛 v.缝(合)
words.example:
Secure the two pieces together with a couple of stitches.  缝上几针，把两块布缝在一起。
He cast on/off a stitch (= added/removed a length of thread from the needle).  他加了／拆了一针。
I've dropped a stitch (= lost a length of thread from the needle).  我漏了一针。

words.meaning: v.使悲伤,使伤心
words.example: He is still grieving for/over his wife.  他仍沉浸在丧妻之痛中。

words.meaning: n.电压
words.example: high/low voltages  高／低电压

words.meaning: n.标题
words.example: Every chapter needs a clear heading.  每章都需要清晰的标题。

words.meaning: v.治理,利用 n.马具,挽具
words.example: There is a great deal of interest in harnessing wind and waves as new sources of power.  人们对开发利用风和波浪这些新能源非常感兴趣。

words.meaning: v.驱散;(使云、雾、疑虑等)消散;挥霍
words.example:
The heat gradually dissipates into the atmosphere.  热量逐渐消失在大气中。
His anger dissipated as the situation became clear.  随着局势的明朗，他渐渐消了气。

words.meaning: n.[化]氧化物
words.example: iron oxide  氧化铁

words.meaning: a.(to)次要的,从属的;下级的
words.example: Her personal life has been subordinated to her career.  她将个人生活置于事业之下。

words.meaning: a.悲观(主义)的
words.example:
The tone of the meeting was very pessimistic.  会议的气氛非常悲观。
The doctors are pessimistic (= not hopeful) about his chances of recovery.  医生们对他康复的可能性都表示悲观。

words.meaning: a.狂暴的,无秩序的
words.example:
This has been a turbulent week for the government.  对政府来讲，这是动荡多事的一周。UK adjective
The sea was too turbulent for us to be able to take the boat out.  大海波涛汹涌，我们无法驾船出海。

words.meaning: vt.加重(剧),使恶化;激怒,使恼火
words.example:
Attempts to restrict parking in the city centre have further aggravated the problem of traffic congestion.  在市中心限制停车的试验方案使交通挤塞的问题更加严重。
The treatment only aggravated the condition.  这种疗法反而使病情恶化。verb transitive
Stop aggravating me, will you!  别再气我了，好不好！

words.meaning: n.花环,花圈
words.example:
The bride wore a veil with a wreath of silk flowers.  新娘戴着一块饰有丝绸花环的面纱。
There were two large wreaths on the coffin.  棺材上摆放着两个巨大花圈。
The President ended his visit by laying a wreath at the war memorial.  总统向战争纪念碑敬献花圈，以此结束他的访问。

words.meaning: a.令人烦恼的,讨厌的
words.example:
Her hip has been troublesome for quite a while, and she'll probably need surgery on it.  她的髋部有很长一段时间都不舒服，可能需要动手术。
The negotiations have proven more troublesome than any of us expected.  谈判比我们所有人事先想像的都要棘手。

words.meaning: n.围住,圈起,封入,附件
words.example: An early example of privatization was the enclosure of public land for use by wealthy landlords.  早期私有化的一个例子是，富有的地主圈占公共土地据为己有。UK noun

words.meaning: a.阴暗的,阴沉的,令人沮丧的,阴郁的
words.example:
The cemetery is a gloomy place.  墓地是个让人感到压抑的地方。
The vet is rather gloomy about my cat's chances of recovery.  兽医对我的猫儿康复表示很不乐观。
What gloomy weather we're having!  今天天气太阴沉了！

words.meaning: n.打字机
words.example: He still uses an old typewriter.  他还在用一部旧打字机。

words.meaning: vt.使恼怒,使生气;打扰 vi.招人讨厌
words.example:
Tim really annoyed me in the meeting this morning.  在今天上午的会上，蒂姆真是把我气坏了。
I'm sorry - is my cough annoying you?  对不起，我咳嗽打扰你了吧？
It really annoys me when people expect me to tip as well as pay a service charge in a restaurant.  在饭店里，付了服务费后他们还想要小费，这很让我恼火。

words.meaning: a.(of)指示的,暗示的
words.example: Resumption of the talks is indicative of an improving relationship between the countries.  恢复会谈表明两国关系在改善。

words.meaning: a.整洁的,整齐的 v.整理,收拾
words.example:
The house was clean and tidy.  房子干净整洁。
My flatmate isn't very tidy.  我的室友不怎么爱整洁。
His business deals make him a tidy sum.  他做生意赚了一大笔钱。noun

words.meaning: a.富于幽默感的,幽默的;滑稽的
words.example: Her latest book is a humorous look at teenage life.  她的新书是对青少年生活的一种幽默审视。

words.meaning: n.甜瓜
words.example: This melon is ripe and sweet.  这个瓜又熟又甜。

words.meaning: v.当心,谨防
words.example:
Beware salespeople who promise offers that seem too good to be true.  要提防那些满口承诺的推销员，他们说得越天花乱坠，便越不可信。
You should beware of undercooked food when staying in hot countries.  留在气候炎热的国家里，小心别吃未煮熟的食物。
Beware of falling asleep while sunbathing.  晒日光浴时当心睡着。

words.meaning: n.职业;召唤;天命;天职;才能
words.example:
"We need teachers who regard their profession as a vocation, not just a job," said the Minister.  部长说：“我们需要的老师要把他们的工作当成职业，而不仅仅是一份工作。”
To work in medicine, you should have a vocation for it.  要从事医务工作，你就要有一种使命感。

words.meaning: n.服从,顺从
words.example: He demands unquestioning obedience from his soldiers.  他要求士兵们绝对服从。

words.meaning: vt.资助,捐赠;(with)给予,赋予
words.example:
The state of Michigan has endowed three institutes to do research for industry.  密西根州已经向三所研究所提供资助进行产业研究。
This hospital was endowed by the citizens of Strasbourg in the 16th century.  这所医院是16世纪斯特拉斯堡市民捐建的。verb transitive
Some lucky people are endowed with both brains and beauty.  一些幸运之人生来就智慧和美貌并存。

words.meaning: n.球拍
words.example:
They were making such a racket outside that I couldn't get to sleep.  他们一直在外面大吵大闹，弄得我根本睡不着。noun
They were jailed for running a protection/prostitution racket.  他们因为勒索保护费／做拉皮条的勾当而被监禁。
Telephone chat lines are a real racket.  电话聊天热线纯属暴利行为。

words.meaning: ad.不管怎么说,无论如何;不论用何种方法
words.example: He looked a complete mess - dressed anyhow with hair sticking up on end.  他那样子邋遢透顶，衣衫不整，头发翘着。

words.meaning: n.苔,藓,地衣
words.example: The rocks near the river were covered with moss.  河边的岩石长满了苔藓。

words.meaning: vt.奉承;使高兴;使满意;胜过
words.example:
She was flattered by his attention.  他的关注使她格外高兴。
They were flattered to be invited to dinner by the mayor.  市长邀请他们共进晚餐，他们深感荣幸。
We felt flattered that so many people came to our party.  这么多人来参加我们的派对，我们感到十分荣幸。

words.meaning: n.变质的,不新鲜的;陈旧的,陈腐的
words.example:
The bread/biscuits/cake had gone stale.  面包／饼干／蛋糕已经不新鲜了。
The morning after the party, their apartment smelled of stale cigarette smoke.  派对后的次日早上，他们的公寓里有一股污浊的烟味。
They had been working together for over five years and they had both become a little stale.  他们两个已经在一起共事五年多了，彼此都有一点厌倦。

words.meaning: n.失误,流逝,丧失,下降 v.失效,偏离,流逝
words.example:
The management's decision to ignore the safety warnings demonstrated a remarkable lapse of judgment.  管理层作出的对安全警告不予理会的决定是决策上的明显失误。
He turned up again after a lapse of two years.  两年后他又露面了。verb intransitive
The association needs to win back former members who have allowed their subscriptions to lapse.  该协会需要重新把那些已经期满退出的会员吸引回来。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.叛徒,卖国贼
words.example:
The leaders of the rebellion were hanged as traitors.  叛乱的首领被作为叛国者，绞死了。
The Chinese Communist Party branded (= called) Mr Gorbachev 'a traitor to socialism'.  中国共产党给戈巴契夫先生打上了社会主义叛徒的烙印。（即称他为社会主义叛徒）

words.meaning: n.精神病学,精神病疗法
words.example: She specializes in psychiatry.  她专攻精神病学。

words.meaning: a.跛的,(辩解、论据等)无说服力的
words.example: a lame excuse  站不住脚的借口

words.meaning: n.节奏,行进速度;(音乐的)速度
words.example: We're going to have to up the tempo (= work faster) if we're to finish on time.  如果我们想如期完成的话，我们必须加快工作进度。

words.meaning: a.有错误的,有缺点的,不完善的
words.example: faulty wiring/brakes  有毛病的电线线路／煞车

words.meaning: a.野蛮的;凶恶的,残暴的 n.野人,未开化的人
words.example:
The child was savaged by a dog.  那个孩子被狗咬伤了。noun countable offensive
Twelve thousand years ago, our ancestors were primitive savages living in caves.  12000年以前，我们的祖先生活在洞穴里，是原始野蛮人。

words.meaning: a.静止的,固定的
words.example:
The traffic got slower and slower until it was stationary.  车流移动得越来越慢，最后完全不动了。
The rate of inflation has been stationary for several months.  通货膨胀率已经几个月保持不变。

words.meaning: a.不断的,连续的,频繁的
words.example:
I've had continual problems with this car ever since I bought it.  自从我买回这车，它就常常出毛病。
I'm sorry - I can't work with these continual interruptions.  对不起——干扰不断，我无法工作。

words.meaning: n.[数]矩形, 长方形
words.example: Draw a rectangle on the paper.  在纸上画一个长方形。

words.meaning: a.严厉的;坚决的,坚定的 n.船尾,舟尾
words.example:
She is her own sternest critic.  她对自己非常苛刻。
Journalists received a stern warning not to go anywhere near the battleship.  记者受到严厉警告，不得靠近军舰。
The President is facing the sternest test of his authority since he came to power five years ago.  总统的威严正面临着上任五年以来最严峻的考验。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.政治家,国务活动家
words.example: He was known as a careful statesman.  他以审慎的政治家著称。

words.meaning: a.马克思主义的 n.马克思主义者
words.example: They studied Marxist economics.  他们学习马克思主义经济学。

words.meaning: a.非常宝贵的,无价的
words.example:
The new job will provide you with invaluable experience.  这份新工作将使你获得宝贵的经验。
Such data will prove invaluable to/for researchers.  这些资料对于研究人员来说将是非常宝贵的。

words.meaning: a.适当的,恰当的 n.(常pl.)配件,附件;装配
words.example:
I'm having the final fitting of my wedding dress on Thursday.  周四我要最后试穿一次结婚礼服。UK noun
The house price, including fixtures and fittings, is £200 000.  包括固定装置和附加设备在内，房屋价格是20万英镑。

words.meaning: a.有毒的,恶意的,恶毒的,道德败坏的
words.example:
Can you tell the difference between poisonous mushrooms and edible varieties?  你能说出有毒蘑菇和食用蘑菇之间的区别吗？
He said some poisonous things to me.  他对我说了些恶毒的话。

words.meaning: a.数字的,用数字表示的,数值的
words.example:
Keep your files in numerical order.  把你的档按照数字顺序排列。
The UN forces have a numerical superiority over the rebels (= There are more of the UN forces).  联合国部队跟叛乱分子相比，人数占优势。

words.meaning: n.洗发膏,香波;洗发,洗头 v.洗发,洗头
words.example:
Directions: wet hair, apply shampoo and massage into a rich lather.  使用说明：润湿头发，涂上洗发精并轻揉头发至产生大量的泡沫。
My hair/The rug/The dog needs a shampoo.  我的头发／地毯／这只狗需要洗一洗。
She went to the hairdressers for a shampoo and set.  她去美容院洗头并做头发。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.马赛克;镶嵌体
words.example: figurative The country is now a cultural and social mosaic (= mixture) due to the influx of different ethnic groups.  因有不同种族融入，现在这个国家呈现出文化与社会的多元化景象。

words.meaning: n.证明持券人有某种权利的卡片,票证,赠券
words.example:
If you collect ten coupons from the newspaper, you can get a free beach towel.  从报纸上收集十张礼券你就可以免费得到一条沙滩浴巾。
To find out more about our products, fill in the coupon and send it to us at the address given below.  如果想更多了解我们的产品，请填写本资料索取单，并按以下位址寄给我们。

words.meaning: n./v.摸索,探索
words.example:
She groped for her glasses on the bedside table.  她在床头柜上摸索着找眼镜。
He groped me as I was going to the bar.  我走向吧台时，他暗中摸了我一下。UK verb
I'm groping for the right words here.  我正在绞尽脑汁寻找此处合适的措词。UK noun countable informal

words.meaning: vi.闯入,侵入vt.把(思想等)强加于人;强挤入
words.example: Newspaper editors are being urged not to intrude on/into the grief of the families of missing servicemen.  人们强烈要求报纸编辑不要烦扰失踪军人悲痛的家属。

words.meaning: a.米制的,公制的
words.example:
The recipe is given in both metric and imperial measures.  食谱中材料的份量均以公制和英制两种计量方法标出。
Most high-tech industry has been metric for decades.  大多数高科技工业采用公制已达数十年了。

words.meaning: n.对称(性);匀称,整齐
words.example: The design of the house had a pleasing symmetry, its oblong shape being picked up in its elongated windows.  房子的设计透出一种赏心悦目的对称美，狭长的窗户使长方形的结构显得更加和谐。    Compare asymmetry    specialized

words.meaning: n.热心,热忱,热情
words.example: reforming/missionary/religious zeal  改革／传教士般的／宗教热情

words.meaning: n.(in)熟练,精通
words.example: Proficiency comes with practice.  熟能生巧。

words.meaning: a.易碎的;脆弱的;冷淡的;(声音)尖利的
words.example:
As you get older your bones become increasingly brittle.  随着年龄增长，人的骨头变得越来越脆。
The pond was covered in a brittle layer of ice.  池塘上结了薄薄的一层冰。UK adjective
She gave a brittle laugh and turned away.  她冷笑了一声，转身走了。

words.meaning: a.多云的,阴(天)的;混浊的,模糊的
words.example:
Scotland will be cloudy with wintry showers.  苏格兰将会转阴，且有寒冷的阵雨。
The beer was cloudy and dark.  啤酒混浊发黑。

words.meaning: v.责骂,训斥
words.example: His mother scolded him for breaking her favourite vase.  母亲因为他打碎了她最心爱的花瓶而责骂他。

words.meaning: n.(instalment)分期付款;(连载的)一期
words.example: Pay in three interest-free installments.  分三期免息付款。

words.meaning: v.使成为必要,需要
words.example: Reduction in government spending will necessitate further cuts in public services.  削减政府开支必定会使民众服务进一步减少。

words.meaning: v. (from)减(去),扣掉
words.example: Four subtracted from ten equals six.  10减4等于6。    Compare add ; divide ; multiply

words.meaning: v.提供养分,养育,怀有(希望,仇恨等)
words.example:
Children need plenty of good fresh food to nourish them.  孩子们需要大量的新鲜食物来提供营养。
She looks happy and well nourished.  她看起来很快乐，且营养良好。
This cream is supposed to help nourish your skin.  这种润肤霜可以滋养肌肤。

words.meaning: a.节约,节俭
words.example: Thrift made him rich.  节俭让他致富。

words.meaning: n.铁锈 v.(使)生锈
words.example:
Older cars will begin to rust.  旧车将会开始生锈。
Years of being left out in the rain had rusted the metal chairs.  这些铁椅子由于长年在室外淋雨已经生锈了。
The floor of the car had rusted away/through (= been destroyed by rust) , so I was careful where I put my feet.  车的底板都锈坏／烂了，所以我放脚时很小心，不能乱踩。

words.meaning: vt.隔离,孤立;使绝缘,使绝热
words.example:
You can insulate a house against heat loss by having the windows double-glazed.  你可以给窗户装上双层玻璃来防止热量散失。verb transitive
Children should be insulated from the horrors of war.  应该让孩子远离战争的恐怖。
Until recently the country's economy has been insulated from recession by its reserves of raw materials.  该国由于原材料储备充足，直到最近其经济也没有受到衰退的影响。

words.meaning: a.雄辩的,有说服力的;善辩的,口才流利的
words.example:
She made an eloquent appeal for action.  她发表了富有说服力的演讲，呼吁采取行动。
The pictures were an eloquent reminder of the power of the volcano.  这些图片清楚有力地展现了火山的巨大威力。

words.meaning: n.放映机,幻灯机,投影仪
words.example: The projector won't focus.  投影仪对不上焦。

words.meaning: n.同盟;联邦;联合;联盟;联合会
words.example:
The United States is a federation of 50 individual states.  美国是50个州的联邦。
The federation of the six original Australian states took place in 1901.  1901年澳大利亚最初的六个州结成联邦。
He's against European federation.  他反对欧洲联盟。

words.meaning: a.口渴的;(for)渴望的,热望的
words.example: After the hike we were all thirsty.  徒步后大家都渴了。

words.meaning: n.不幸,灾祸,灾难
words.example:
She's suffered a good deal of misfortune over the years.  多年来她遭受了巨大的不幸。
It's unfair to take advantage of other people's misfortunes.  乘人之危是不公平的。

words.meaning: n.女主人,女主持人
words.example: The hostess seated us near the window.  女主人安排我们坐窗边。

words.meaning: n.形容词 a.形容词的,用作形容词的
words.example: 'Big', 'boring', 'purple', 'quick' and 'obvious' are all adjectives.  “大的”、“无聊的”、“紫色的”、“快的”以及“明显的”这些词都是形容词。

words.meaning: n.失宠,耻辱 v.使失宠;玷辱,使蒙羞
words.example:
They were sent home in disgrace.  他们蒙着羞被送回了家里。
He brought disgrace on the whole team by falsifying the results.  他篡改比分的行为让全队丢了脸。
Three families living in one room - it's a disgrace!  三家人住在一间房里——太糟糕了！

words.meaning: n.保险丝,导火线,引信 v.熔化,熔合
words.example:
My hairdrier's stopped working - I think the fuse has blown/ UK also gone (= broken).  我的吹风机坏了——我想可能是保险丝断了。
Have you tried changing the fuse?  你有没试过换根保险丝？noun countable
He lit the fuse and ran.  他点燃了导火索后就跑了。noun countable

words.meaning: v.捏造,编造(谎言,借口等);建造,制造
words.example:
He was late, so he fabricated an excuse to avoid trouble.  他迟到了，就编了个理由以免惹上麻烦。
He claims that the police fabricated evidence against him.  他声称警方伪造了对他不利的证据。

words.meaning: v.播种
words.example:
Sow the seeds in pots.  把这些种子种在花盆里。
We'll sow this field with barley.  我们将在这块田里播种大麦。verb UK US
Now that you've sown doubts in my mind, I'll never be sure I can trust him.  既然你已经使我心存疑虑，我想我很难再信任他了。verb UK US

words.meaning: v.弯腰,俯身 n.弯腰,曲背
words.example:
The doorway was so low that we had to stoop to go through it.  门道太低，我们不得不弯下腰进去。
Something fell out of her coat pocket and she stooped down and picked it up.  有个东西从她大衣口袋里掉了出来，她俯下身捡起来。
He's over six feet tall, but the way he stoops makes him look shorter.  他身高超过六英尺，但他弓着背，显得矮了一些。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.白兰地酒
words.example: He warmed himself with brandy.  他靠白兰地暖身。

words.meaning: prep./ad./conj.尽管
words.example:
Notwithstanding some members' objections, I think we must go ahead with the plan.  尽管遭到一些成员反对，我还是认为我们应该实施该计划。
Injuries notwithstanding, he won the semi-final match.  尽管身上有伤，他还是在半决赛中获胜。

words.meaning: v.猛拧;挣脱;使扭伤 n.扳手;痛苦,难受
words.example:
The photographer tripped over a lead, wrenching a microphone from its stand.  摄影师被一根电线绊了一下，将一支麦克风从底座上猛扯了下来。
The phone had been wrenched from/off the wall.  电话从墙上被猛地扯了下来。
The ball was wrenched out of his grasp by another player.  球被另一名球员从他手中猛地抢了过去。

words.meaning: vt.分开, 分离, 分遣, 派遣(军队)
words.example:
You can detach the hood if you prefer the coat without it.  如果不想要大衣上的帽兜，可以拆掉。
Detach the lower part of the form from this letter and return it to the above address.  请将表格的下半部分从信中剪下来，并寄到上述位址。    Compare attach

words.meaning: a.奢侈的;过分的;(言行等)放肆的
words.example:
That was very extravagant of you to buy strawberries out of season.  在不适当的时令买草莓，你真是太奢侈了。
He rarely used taxis, which he regarded as extravagant.  他很少坐计程车，他认为这是一种奢侈的行为。
The product does not live up to the extravagant claims of the advertisers.  这种产品根本就没有广告商讲的那样好。

words.meaning: n.锌
words.example: Zinc supplements boost immunity.  补锌能增强免疫力。

words.meaning: n.(encyclopaedia)百科全书
words.example: The Cambridge Encyclopedia of Language  剑桥语言百科全书

words.meaning: n.讽刺,讽刺文学,讽刺作品
words.example: Her play was a biting/cruel satire on life in the 80s.  她的剧作是对80年代生活的辛辣讽刺。

words.meaning: ad.预先,事先
words.example: Please book the tickets beforehand.  请提前订票。

words.meaning: a.乏味的,单调的,冗长的
words.example: The trouble is I find most forms of exercise so tedious.  问题是我觉得大多数形式的锻炼都很乏味。

words.meaning: n.爬行动物
words.example: A reptile sunbathed on the rock.  一只爬行动物在岩石上晒太阳。

words.meaning: v.称赞,表扬：委托保管;推荐
words.example:
The judge commended her for/on her bravery.  法官称赞了她的勇敢。
For a low-budget film, it has much to commend it (= it deserves praise).  作为一部低预算影片，它有不少值得称道之处。
It says on the back cover of the book ' highly commended'.  书的封底上写著「极力推荐”。

words.meaning: n.王朝,朝代
words.example: The Mogul dynasty ruled over India for centuries.  蒙兀儿王朝统治印度数世纪。

words.meaning: a.(to)更可取的,更好的
words.example: Surely a diplomatic solution is preferable to war.  外交途径当然要比战争好。

words.meaning: n.乘务员,服务员;看管人;膳食管理员
words.example:
Stewards will be inspecting the race track at 9.00.  执事将在九点钟检查跑道。
If you need help at any time during the conference, one of the stewards will be pleased to help you.  会议期间，您任何时候需要帮助，服务人员都会很乐意为您效劳。
He's the steward of the City of Wakefield's Working Men's Club.  他是韦克菲尔德市工人俱乐部的餐饮主管。

words.meaning: a.相互的,往复的,互利的
words.example: Friendship should be reciprocal.  友谊应当是相互的。

words.meaning: v.发火花,闪耀
words.example:
The snow/sea sparkled in the sunlight.  雪／大海在阳光下闪烁。
Alice is shy and quiet at parties, but her sister really sparkles!  爱丽斯在派对上安静腼腆，而她妹妹却活力四射。UK noun uncountable
The radiant smile and the sparkle in her blue eyes were the clear signs of a woman still deeply in love.  她灿烂的笑容和蓝色眼睛里那飞扬的神采都是热恋中女子的明显标记。

words.meaning: a.可食用的
words.example: Only the leaves of the plant are edible.  这种植物仅叶子可食。    Compare eatable     Opposite inedible

words.meaning: n.摩天大楼
words.example: A skyscraper rose downtown.  市中心立起一座摩天楼。

words.meaning: v.消费,花费
words.example:
You expend so much effort for so little return.  你费了那么大功夫，回报却这么微不足道。
Governments expend a lot of resources on war.  各国政府在战争上消耗了大量资源。

words.meaning: v.(反)immigrate;(to,from)自本国移居他
words.example:
Millions of Germans emigrated from Europe to America in the nineteenth century.  在19世纪，数百万的德国人从欧洲移民到了美国。
Thousands of Britons emigrate every year.  每年有数以千计的英国人移居国外。

words.meaning: n.贿赂 v.向…行贿,买通
words.example:
He bribed immigration officials and entered the country illegally.  他贿赂移民官员非法入境。
He was accused of accepting/taking bribes from wealthy businessmen.  他被指控收受富商们的贿赂。

words.meaning: pron./a.无论哪个,无论哪些
words.example:
We can go to the seven o'clock performance or the eight - whichever suits you best.  我们可以去看七点或八点的演出——选一个你最方便的时间。
Either Thursday or Friday - choose whichever day is best for you.  星期四或星期五都行——选一个你最方便的日子。UK determiner
It's going to be expensive whichever way you do it.  无论你采用甚么方法，代价都会非常高昂。

words.meaning: v.打呵欠 n.呵欠
words.example:
Her eyes watered as she tried to stifle (= stop) a yawn.  她强忍着不打哈欠，眼泪都出来了。
We have to go to dinner with Simon's boss on Saturday which is a bit of a yawn.  我们星期六得跟赛门的老板一起去吃晚餐，真是有点乏味。

words.meaning: v.阻隔,阻塞(道路、通道等)n.阻碍物,障碍物
words.example:
After the earthquake many roads were obstructed by collapsed buildings.  地震过后，许多道路都被倒塌的建筑物堵住了。
Her view of the stage was obstructed by a pillar.  一根柱子挡住了她的视线，她看不见舞台。
An accident is obstructing traffic on the M11.  一场事故堵塞了11号高速公路上的交通。

words.meaning: n.顶点,高潮
words.example:
The climax of the air show was a daring flying display.  航空展的高潮是惊险刺激的飞行表演。
The election campaign reaches its climax next week.  下周竞选活动将进入白热化阶段。
The show climaxed with all the performers singing on stage together.  所有演员同台高歌把演出推向了高潮。

words.meaning: a.湿的,湿气重的
words.example: New York is very hot and humid in the summer.  纽约的夏天炎热潮湿。

words.meaning: v.(使)欣喜,(使)高兴
words.example:
Everyone rejoiced at the news of his safe return.  听到他安全返回的消息，大家都欣喜万分。
She rejoiced in her good fortune.  她为自己的好运高兴不已。

words.meaning: n.方言
words.example: The poem is written in northern dialect.  这首诗是用北方方言写成的。

words.meaning: n.水壶
words.example: Having knowledge is one thing but being able to communicate it to others is another kettle of fish.  拥有知识是一回事，但能够传授给别人完全是另一回事了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.茶托,碟子
words.example: She gave the cat a saucer of milk (= a small amount of milk on a saucer).  她给猫一小碟牛奶。

words.meaning: v.(generalise)归纳,概括;推广,普及
words.example: You can't generalize about a continent as varied as Europe.  对于欧洲这样一个异彩纷呈的大陆，你无法一言以蔽之。

words.meaning: a.短暂的,转瞬即逝的;临时的,暂住的
words.example:
The city has a large transient population (= many people who are living in it only temporarily).  这个城市有大量暂住人口。UK noun countable mainly US formal
It's an organization set up to provide money and help for transients.  这个组织建立的目的就是给暂住者提供金钱和帮助。

words.meaning: v.(给…)穿衣,供给…衣服
words.example: It costs a lot to feed and clothe five children.  解决五个孩子的吃穿问题花费很大。

words.meaning: a.名义上的;(金额,租金)微不足道的
words.example:
She's the nominal head of our college - the real work is done by her deputy.  她名义上是我们学院的校长——实际工作都是由她的副手来完成的。UK adjective
For a nominal fee, they will deliver orders to customers' homes.  他们只象征式收点费用，就会送货上门。

words.meaning: ad.极端地,非常
words.example: He was clever, handsome and exceedingly rich.  他聪明、英俊，且非常富有。

words.meaning: a.驯服的,温顺的;沉闷的,乏味的 vt.驯服
words.example:
After a few months' contact the monkeys become very tame.  经过几个月的接触，那些猴子变得非常温顺了。adjective
It was a tame film in comparison to some that she's made.  较她之前拍摄的其他一些影片，这一部显得平淡乏味。verb transitive
He'll need to tame his temper if he wants to succeed.  如果他想取得成功，就得改改自己的脾气。

words.meaning: n.渴,口渴;(for)渴望,热望
words.example:
Hundreds of refugees collapsed from hunger and thirst.  成百上千的难民饥渴得瘫倒在地上。
I've got a terrible thirst after all that running.  跑了那么长的路，我渴得要命。
He's always had a thirst for adventure.  他总是渴望冒险。UK verb

words.meaning: v.修理,缝补;改正,改进
words.example:
Could you mend this hole in my shirt?  你能把我衬衫上的这个洞补一下吗？
I've left my watch at the jeweller's to be mended.  我把手表留在钟表店那里修理了。
The plumber came to mend the burst pipe.  水管工来修理爆裂的水管。

words.meaning: a.博学的,有学问的
words.example: This sort of aggression is learned behaviour - people aren't born that way.  人类的这种攻击行为是后天习得的——并非天生如此。

words.meaning: n.争吵;冲突,斗争;竞争
words.example:
What are the prospects for overcoming the strife between the Christian minority and Muslim majority?  解决基督教少数派和回教多数派之间冲突的前景如何？
Twenty years of civil strife have left the country's economy in ruins.  20年的内战使该国经济满目疮痍。

words.meaning: n.归还,偿还额,退款 v.退还,偿还,偿付
words.example: When I went on business to Peru, the office refunded my expenses.  我到秘鲁出差，费用由事务所报销。

words.meaning: a.哑的,缄默的n.哑巴;弱音器v.减弱…的声音
words.example:
The president has remained mute about plans to curtail the number of immigrants.  总统对于减少外来移民人数的方案保持沉默。
Double glazing muted the noise of the traffic.  双层玻璃减低了交通噪音。

words.meaning: vt./vi.唤醒,唤起;激励;激起
words.example:
He roused himself (from a pleasant daydream) and got back to work.  他不再沉迷（于甜蜜的白日梦中），开始重新投入工作。
The speaker attempted to rouse the crowd with a cry for action.  演讲者高声呼吁大家行动起来，试图激发群众的热情。

words.meaning: v.喷射,排出;驱逐
words.example:
How do you eject the tape?  怎样才能把磁带弹出来？
The coffee machine suddenly ejected a handful of coins.  咖啡自动售卖机里突然弹出一把硬币。

words.meaning: a.简陋的,破旧的,卑鄙的,不公平的
words.example:
He wore a shabby old overcoat.  他穿着一件破旧的大衣。
Her home is a rented one-bedroom flat in a shabby part of town.  她的住所是一套租来的雅房公寓，位于城里很差的地段。
The refugees were shabby (= wore old clothes in bad condition) and hungry.  难民们衣衫褴褛，饥肠辘辘。adjective

words.meaning: vt.使残废;使失去能力;丧失能力
words.example:
She was disabled in the accident.  她在那次事故中致残。verb
These guns will destroy or disable any incoming missile.  这些大炮能摧毁任何来犯的导弹或使其失灵。
Disable the alarm system and then enter the building.  破坏警报系统然后进入大楼。

words.meaning: a.最适宜的 n.最适宜(条件)
words.example: Find the optimum speed for the machine.  找到机器的最佳转速。

words.meaning: n.(入室行窃的)盗贼
words.example: The burglar set off the alarm.  盗贼触发了警报。

words.meaning: a.机灵的,敏锐的;精明的
words.example:
She is a shrewd politician who wants to avoid offending the electorate unnecessarily.  她是一个精明的政治家，想避免不必要地得罪选民。
It was a shrewd move to buy your house just before property prices started to rise.  在房地产价格开始攀升之前购买房子是个明智之举。

words.meaning: n.地方行政官,地方法官,治安官
words.example:
He will appear before the magistrates tomorrow.  明天他要在地方法院出庭。
Greenway appeared at Bow Street Magistrates' Court to face seven charges of accepting bribes.  格林韦在博街治安法庭出庭，面临七项受贿指控。

words.meaning: n.位置,地点
words.example: In 19th-century Britain, industries became concentrated in particular localities.  在19世纪的英国，工业都被集中到了某些特定地区。

words.meaning: v.反驳,驳斥
words.example: to refute a person/theory/argument/claim  驳斥一个人／理论／论点／说法

words.meaning: v.(sympathise)(with)同情;共鸣,同感;赞成
words.example: We sympathize with your situation.  我们同情你的处境。

words.meaning: a.显赫的;杰出的;有名的;优良的
words.example: an eminent historian  声名显赫的历史学家

words.meaning: v.沉没,淹没;潜入
words.example:
The submarine submerged when enemy planes were sighted.  潜艇发现敌机后马上下潜。
She was taken to hospital after being submerged in an icy river for 45 minutes.  她在冰冷的河水中浸了45分钟后被送进了医院。
She has submerged her identity in the role of photographer's wife and muse.  她完全湮没了自我，全心全意地做摄影师的妻子，并为他提供艺术灵感。UK verb

words.meaning: n.消遣,娱乐
words.example:
Do-it-yourself is the nation's most popular pastime.  自己动手是该国最流行的消遣活动。
figurative Suing people, especially doctors, is a national pastime (= common activity) in America.  在美国，提出诉讼——尤其是控告医生——是一种全民热衷的寻常事。

words.meaning: n.卵石
words.example: This part of the coast has pebble beaches.  海岸的这一部分有几处砾石海滩。

words.meaning: vt.使湿透,浸透;使充满,使饱和
words.example:
The grass had been saturated by overnight rain.  一夜的雨把草地淋透了。
He had cut his leg badly, and his trousers were saturated with/in blood.  他划破了腿，伤势严重，裤子都被血浸透了。verb UK FILL  充满
The police saturated (= A large number of police officers were sent into) the area in an attempt to find the missing child.  大批员警被派往该地区寻找失踪的孩童。

words.meaning: a.(言行)谨慎的;慎重的;有判断力的
words.example:
The family made discreet enquiries about his background.  那家人小心翼翼地打听他的背景。
They are very good assistants, very discreet - they wouldn't go shouting to the press.  他们都是很好的助手，非常谨慎——不会向新闻界嚷嚷甚么的。

words.meaning: n.刺,荆棘
words.example: A thorn pricked the gardener's hand.  园丁的手被刺扎了。

words.meaning: ad.向内,在内 a.向内的,在内的,里面的
words.example:
After the accident, her thoughts began to turn inward (= to her own interests or problems).  意外发生后，她开始反省自己。
Fold the outside edges inward.  将外部边缘部分向内折。

words.meaning: v.争吵,争论 n.争吵,争吵的原因
words.example:
They had a bitter quarrel about/over some money three years ago and they haven't spoken to each other since.  他们三年前因为钱的问题有过一次激烈的争吵，从此以后就互不理睬了。
We have no quarrel with the people of your country (= We have no reason to disagree with or dislike them).  我们没有理由对贵国的人民感到不满。
They seem to have patched up their quarrel (= finished their disagreement and started to be friendly).  他们似乎在争吵后言归于好了。UK verb intransitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)

words.meaning: v.击退,抵制,使厌恶,使不愉快
words.example:
This coat has a special surface that repels moisture.  这件外套的面是特殊料子做的，可以防潮。
formal The defenders repelled the attack without losing any men.  守军击退了敌人的进攻，自己没有损失一个人。
Similar poles of magnets repel each other, and opposite poles attract.  磁铁同极相斥，异极相吸。 (-ll-)

words.meaning: a.同种类的,同性质的,有相同特征的
words.example: The population of the village has remained remarkably homogeneous.  这个村庄的人口保持着显著的同族特征。    Compare heterogeneous

words.meaning: a./ad.国内,内地,内陆
words.example:
The Black Sea is a large inland sea.  黑海是一个很大的内海。adverb
Seabirds often come inland to find food.  海鸟经常到内陆觅食。

words.meaning: n.收银员,出纳员
words.example: The cashier counted the change.  收银员数着零钱。

words.meaning: a.节约的,经济的
words.example:
There's increasing demand for cars which are more economical on fuel.  对低油耗汽车的需求与日俱增。
What's the most economical way of heating this building?  给这栋大楼供应暖气，怎样做才是最经济的方法？UK adjective

words.meaning: ad./a.更远,更往前;进一步 v.促进,增进
words.example:
I'm afraid I never got further than the first five pages of 'Ulysses'.  恐怕我看《尤利西斯》从未超过开头的五页，之后就看不下去了。
We discussed the problem but we didn't get much further in actually solving it.  我们讨论了这个问题，但在实际解决方面没有取得多大进展。
The whole matter is further complicated by the fact that Amanda and Jo refuse to speak to each other.  阿曼达和乔彼此拒绝说话，使得整个事件更加复杂了。

words.meaning: n.尊敬,尊重 vt.尊重,敬重;把…看作
words.example:
There has been a drop in public esteem for teachers.  大众对教师的尊重程度有所下降。
Because of their achievements they were held in (= given) (high) esteem.  他们的成就使他们备受尊重。verb transitive not continuous
Her work is highly esteemed by all her colleagues.  她所有的同事对她的工作都十分推崇。

words.meaning: a.胆怯的,怯懦的
words.example:
Lucy is a rather timid child.  露西是个非常羞怯的孩子。
My horse is a bit timid and is easily frightened by traffic.  我的马有点胆小，容易受到来往车辆的惊吓。

words.meaning: vt.扣除;演绎(推理)
words.example: The player had points deducted (from his score) for arguing with the referee.  那名运动员因与裁判争辩而被扣分。

words.meaning: v./n.瞌睡;假寐
words.example:
My cat likes dozing in front of the fire.  我的猫喜欢在火炉前打盹。UK verb intransitive
