words.meaning: n.恐怖
words.example:
You gave her such a fright turning the lights out like that.  你那样把灯给关了，吓了她一大跳。
You gave me the fright of my life (= a very severe fright) , jumping out of the shadows like that!  你那样从暗处跳出来，把我吓死了！
Our dog took fright at the noise of the fireworks and ran indoors.  我们的狗听到爆竹声吓得跑进屋来。noun [S or U]

words.meaning: a.顽皮的,淘气的
words.example:
Now that's naughty - you mustn't throw food on the floor!  真淘气——你不能把食物扔在地上！
Our boss treats us all like naughty schoolchildren.  我们的老板把我们当成调皮的小学生来对待。
The film was shown on television but they'd cut out all the naughty scenes/ UKbits.  电视上播放这部电影，但他们把所有涉及性的镜头都剪掉了。

words.meaning: a.费力的,艰辛的;奋发的,努力的
words.example:
He rarely does anything more strenuous than changing the channels on the television.  他很少做比切换电视频道更费神的事。
His doctor advised him not to take any strenuous exercise.  他的医生建议他不要做任何剧烈运动。
Strenuous efforts were made throughout the war to disguise the scale of civilian casualties.  整个战争期间，政府都在煞费苦心掩饰人民的伤亡程度。

words.meaning: n.(millimetre)毫米
words.example: The gap is less than a millimeter.  间隙不到一毫米。

words.meaning: n.胸,胸部,乳房,胸怀;内心;a.亲密的,知心的
words.example: She held him tightly to her bosom.  她把他紧紧地拥在胸前。

words.meaning: v.(使)波动;(使)起伏
words.example:
Vegetable prices fluctuate according to the season.  蔬菜价格随着季节变化而涨落。
Her wages fluctuate between £150 and £200 a week.  她的周薪在150英镑到200英镑之间浮动。
Her weight fluctuates wildly.  她的体重起伏很大。

words.meaning: a.匆忙的,仓促的;草率的
words.example:
He warned against making hasty decisions.  他警告过不要仓促作出决定。
Now let's not leap to any hasty conclusions.  现在我们不要仓促得出结论。
We saw the rain and made a hasty retreat into the bar.  我们看见下雨了，于是就匆忙躲进酒吧里。

words.meaning: v.(使)倾斜;(使)倾向于 n.斜坡,斜面
words.example:
The Prime Minister is believed to be inclining towards an April election.  据信首相倾向于在四月举行大选。formal
The ground inclined steeply towards the ridge in the distance.  地势陡峭，陡坡一直延绵至远处的山脊。
He inclined his head and said nothing.  他点了点头，但甚么也没说。formal

words.meaning: n.外衣,大衣
words.example: He put on his overcoat against the wind.  他穿上大衣挡风。

words.meaning: n.习语;成语方言;(艺术等的)风格,特色
words.example:
To "have bitten off more than you can chew" is an idiom that means you have tried to do something which is too difficult for you.  have bitten off more than you can chew 是一句成语，意思是试图承担力所不及的事。
Both operas are very much in the modern idiom.  两部歌剧都很有现代风格。

words.meaning: vi.打喷嚏,发喷嚏声n.喷嚏
words.example:
Cats make him sneeze - I think he's allergic to the fur.  猫会使他打喷嚏——我想他对猫毛过敏。verb intransitive
Well, a 5% pay increase means an extra £700 a year which is not to be sneezed at!  嗯，加薪5％意味着每年多出700英镑的收入，这可不是笔小数目啊！noun countable
He's got all the classic symptoms of a cold - the coughs and sneezes and the sore throat.  他具备感冒的所有典型症状——咳嗽、打喷嚏和喉咙痛。

words.meaning: n.赤道
words.example: Singapore is/lies on the Equator.  新加坡位于赤道之上。

words.meaning: n.店主,老板
words.example: The shopkeeper knows every regular.  店主认识每位熟客。

words.meaning: vt.(analyze)分析,分解
words.example:
Researchers analysed the purchases of 6300 households.  研究人员对6300个家庭的购物消费作了分析。
Water samples taken from streams were analysed for contamination by chemicals.  对水质样本进行分析，来测定溪流是否已受到化学品的污染。

words.meaning: a.必须做的,强制性的,(课程)必修的
words.example:
Swimming was compulsory at my school.  在我们学校，游泳是必修课。
Wearing seat belts in cars is compulsory by law.  坐车系安全带是法律强制规定的。

words.meaning: vi.(星等)闪烁,(眼情)发亮 n.闪烁,闪光
words.example:
The lights of the town twinkled in the distance.  城镇的灯火在远处闪烁。
The stars twinkled in the clear sky.  星星在晴朗的夜空中闪烁。
His brown eyes twinkled behind the gold-rimmed glasses.  他棕色的眼睛在金框眼镜后面闪闪发光。noun only singular

words.meaning: n.新纪元;时代;时期;【地质】世,纪,期
words.example: The president said that his country was moving into a new epoch which would be one of lasting peace.  总统说他的国家正在步入一个长治久安的新时代。

words.meaning: a./n.狡猾(的),狡诈(的)
words.example:
He's a very cunning man.  他为人十分狡猾。adjective
We need to show a bit of cunning if we want to trick the enemy.  要想骗过敌人，我们得想点计策。

words.meaning: n./v.(皮肤)变粗糙;发痛;n.小伙子
words.example: He's a friendly sort of a chap.  他是个挺友善的家伙。

words.meaning: n.扬声器,扩音器
words.example: Music blared from loudspeakers.  广播喇叭里响起音乐声。

words.meaning: a.卫生的;有益的;健康的,有益健康的
words.example: He looks like a nice, wholesome, young man.  他看起来是个善良而又健康向上的年轻人。

words.meaning: v.迫害
words.example:
Religious minorities were persecuted and massacred during the ten-year regime.  在长达十年的独裁统治期间，宗教信仰上的少数派遭到了迫害和屠杀。
His latest film is about the experience of being persecuted for being gay.  他最新的一部影片以同性恋者受迫害的经历为题。
Ever since the news broke about her divorce, she has been persecuted by the tabloid press.  自从她离婚的消息传出后，她一直被八卦小报紧咬不放。

words.meaning: n.谋反,通敌,叛国
words.example: Guy Fawkes was executed for treason after he took part in a plot to blow up the British Parliament building.  盖伊‧福克斯因参与炸毁英国议会大厦的阴谋活动而被以叛国罪处决。

words.meaning: a.无数的,数不清的
words.example: The project has been delayed by innumerable problems.  由于问题太多，计划已延迟。

words.meaning: a.粘合性的,有结合力的
words.example: a cohesive group  有凝聚力的团体

words.meaning: n.烟雾
words.example:
Smog is a major problem in Athens.  烟雾是雅典的一个主要问题。
As we flew into the airport, we could see a murky yellow smog hovering over the city.  我们飞进机场时，可以看到灰蒙蒙的黄色烟雾笼罩在城市上空。

words.meaning: a.多余的,过剩的;(食物)丰富的;被解雇的
words.example:
To keep the company alive, half the workforce is being made redundant.  为了使公司生存下去，一半的员工要被裁掉。
figurative New technology often makes old skills and even whole communities redundant.  新技术常常会使古老的技艺甚至是某个行业完全消失。adjective
In the sentence, "She is a single unmarried woman", the word "unmarried" is redundant.  在句子 She is a single unmarried woman 中，unmarried 一词是多余的。

words.meaning: n.不活动,惰性;惯性
words.example: The organization is stifled by bureaucratic inertia.  官僚主义的惰性扼杀了这个组织。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.手册,指南
words.example: The student handbook gives details of all courses.  学生手册中有所有课程的详细介绍。

words.meaning: n.守门人,门房,行李搬运工,服务员
words.example:
There aren't any porters, so we'll have to find a trolley for the luggage.  因为没有搬运工，所以我们得找个小车来推行李。
The hotel porter opened the door for me and then called a taxi.  旅馆门厅服务员为我开了门，并帮我叫了一辆计程车。

words.meaning: v.压迫,压制
words.example:
For years now, the people have been oppressed by a ruthless dictator.  多年来，人们一直身处残暴独裁者的压迫之下。verb
Strange dreams and nightmares oppressed him.  怪梦和噩梦使他感到焦虑不安。

words.meaning: v.(尤指不好的事)一再发生;重现
words.example:
The theme of freedom recurs throughout her writing.  自由这一主题在她的写作中反复出现。
If the pain/problem/trouble, etc. recurs, come and see me.  如果疼痛复发／问题再出现／再感不适等，就来找我。

words.meaning: n.晶体管;晶体管收音机
words.example: The transistor replaced the vacuum tube.  晶体管取代了真空管。

words.meaning: n.期刊,杂志 a.周期的,定期的
words.example: She has written for several legal periodicals.  她为几本法律期刊撰稿。

words.meaning: a.讽刺的
words.example: Are you being sarcastic?  你这是在挖苦吗？

words.meaning: n.(gym)体育馆,健身房
words.example: The school gymnasium doubles as a hall.  学校体育馆也当礼堂用。

words.meaning: n.全景,全景画,全景摄影,全景照片[装置]
words.example:
From the hotel roof you can enjoy a panorama of the whole city.  从饭店楼顶上你可以欣赏到城市的全景。
The investigation revealed a panorama of corruption and illegal dealings.  调查揭露了腐败和非法交易的全貌。

words.meaning: v.使惊骇,使恐怖
words.example: The state of the kitchen appalled her.  厨房的脏乱让她目瞪口呆。

words.meaning: a.欢乐的,高兴的
words.example:
She's a very jolly, upbeat sort of a person.  她是个非常乐观向上的人。UK adjective
We spent a very jolly evening together, chatting and drinking.  我们一起聊天、喝酒，渡过了一个惬意的晚上。UK adjective
That's a jolly nice scarf you're wearing.  你戴的围巾很漂亮。UK adverb UK old-fashioned informal

words.meaning: v.(因无知等而)犯大错;踉踉跄跄地走 n.大错
words.example:
He said that the tax was a major political blunder.  他称这项税收政策是一大政治错误。
Police blundered by not releasing more details about the case to focus public interest.  警方因没有提供更多的详细案情以引起公众关注而酿成了大错。

words.meaning: n.连接,接合,交叉点,枢纽站,接头,中继线
words.example: You should slow down as you approach the junction.  接近交叉口时你应该减速。

words.meaning: n.电学家,电工
words.example: The electrician fixed the fuse.  电工修好了保险丝。

words.meaning: vt.(from)演绎,推断,推论
words.example: We cannot deduce very much from these figures.  我们无法从这些数字中推断出太多东西。

words.meaning: n./v.刺伤,刺痛,刺孔
words.example:
Prick the skin of the potatoes with a fork before baking them.  烤马铃薯前先用叉子在上面扎几个小孔。
She pricked the balloon with a pin and it burst with a loud bang.  她用别针在气球上扎了一下，气球砰的一声爆掉了。verb transitive
Dan's mentioning Julia pricked my conscience and I gave her a call.  丹提起茱莉亚，让我感到良心不安，我就打了个电话给她。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.征收,征税,征兵 v.征收,征集,征用
words.example: They imposed a 5% levy on alcohol.  他们对酒品征收5%的税。

words.meaning: n.邮费,邮资
words.example: Please enclose £15.99, plus £2 for postage.  请附上15.99英镑，外加2英镑邮资。

words.meaning: n.黑板
words.example: Write the date on the blackboard.  在黑板上写上日期。

words.meaning: n.汽船,轮船
words.example: a rice steamer  米饭蒸锅

words.meaning: n.序言,引言,前言 v.作序,写前言
words.example:
In his preface, the author says that he took eight years to write the book.  在前言中，作者说他写这本书花了八年。
We're hoping these talks could be a preface to peace.  我们希望这些会谈能拉开和平的序幕。verb transitive formal
Each work is prefaced by a descriptive note and concludes with an author's note.  每一篇作品都以说明性文字作开端，以作者自己的批注为结尾。

words.meaning: n.匆忙,急速;草率 v.赶快;匆忙
words.example:
Unfortunately the report was prepared in haste and contained several inaccuracies.  遗憾的是，这份报告准备得有些仓促，里面有几处不准确的地方。
His father had just died and he didn't want to marry with indecent haste.  父亲刚刚去世，他不想太过匆忙地结婚——那样做有悖情理。noun uncountable disapproving
Make haste!  快一点！noun uncountable disapproving

words.meaning: n.铁锹,铲子
words.example: The kids took their buckets and spades to the beach.  孩子们带着他们的桶子和铲子到海边去了。noun

words.meaning: ad.在前面 a.先前的;在前部的 n.前部
words.example:
Various ecological issues have come to the fore since the discovery of the hole in the Earth's ozone layer.  自从发现地球臭氧层空洞以来，各种生态问题成为公众关注的热点。
The prime minister has deliberately brought to the fore those ministers with a more caring image.  首相故意突出那些形象更为亲民的大臣。

words.meaning: n.暴风雪
words.example: The snowstorm buried the roads.  暴雪掩埋了道路。

words.meaning: v.使纯净,提纯
words.example:
Plants help to purify the air.  植物有助于净化空气。
One of the functions of the kidneys is to purify the blood.  肾脏的功能之一是净化血液。
One of the main teachings of Buddhism is that you should try to purify your mind.  佛教的主要教义之一是人应该努力净化自己的思想。

words.meaning: n.借口,托词
words.example:
The border dispute was used as a pretext for military intervention.  边界纠纷被用作军事入侵的借口。
He came round to see her on some flimsy (= obviously false) pretext.  他找了个明显站不住脚的借口来看她。

words.meaning: n.元音,元音字母
words.example: The vowels in English are a, e, i, o and u.  英语中的母音字母是 a， e， i， o， u。

words.meaning: n.自动,自动化,自动操作
words.example: Automation reduced manual work.  自动化减少了体力劳动。

words.meaning: n.小叶,嫩叶;传单,活页
words.example:
Demonstrators handed out leaflets to passers-by.  示威者向路人派发传单。
They leafleted the area two weeks before the event.  活动开始前两周他们就在该地区散发了广告。

words.meaning: n.水湾,小湾;进口,入口
words.example: an inlet pipe/manifold/valve  进气管／歧管／阀

words.meaning: a.符合的;一致的;欣然同意的;令人愉快的
words.example:
We spent a most agreeable evening by the river.  我们在河边渡过了一个极为愉快的夜晚。adjective
The talks are aimed at finding a mutually agreeable solution.  会谈旨在找出一个双方都能接受的解决办法。
We must find a compromise that is agreeable to both sides of the party.  我们必须找出一个党内双方都能接受的折衷方案。

words.meaning: v.(使)冷凝,(使)凝结;浓缩,压缩,简缩
words.example: Water vapour in the air condenses into fog.  空气中的水汽凝结形成雾。

words.meaning: n.名词
words.example: 'Doctor', 'tree', 'party', 'coal' and 'beauty' are all nouns.  Doctor，tree，party，coal 和 beauty 都是名词。

words.meaning: v.坚持,坚忍,不屈不挠
words.example:
It looks as if the policy will be a success, providing that the government perseveres and does not give in to its critics.  看来如果政府锲而不舍，不向批评家屈服，这项政策就有可能成功。
The education director is persevering in his attempt to obtain additional funding for the school.  教育局长正坚持不懈地为该校争取更多资金补助。
Despite receiving little support, the women are persevering with their crusade to fight crime.  尽管得不到甚么支持，这些妇女仍然坚持与犯罪搏斗。

words.meaning: v.(from)背离,偏离
words.example:
The recent pattern of weather deviates from the norm for this time of year.  近来的天气状况与往年同期相比有些异常。verb intransitive
The path follows the river closely, occasionally deviating round a clump of trees.  这条小路紧挨着河，只是在遇到树林时才偶尔分开。

words.meaning: n./v.报复,反击,反驳
words.example: "I'm going to tell him," said Max. "Just you try!" came the retort.  “我要去告诉他，”马克斯说。“你倒试试！”有人回嘴道。

words.meaning: n.附录,附属物;阑尾,盲肠
words.example:
She had her appendix out (= medically removed) last summer.  去年夏天她做了盲肠切除手术。noun countable
There's an appendix at the end of the book with a list of dates.  书后有一个附录，列有年代日期。

words.meaning: n.斑马
words.example: A zebra crossed the road.  一匹斑马横穿了马路。

words.meaning: n.焦炭;可口可乐(COCA-COLA)的缩写
words.example: He drank a coke with ice.  他喝了杯加冰可乐。

words.meaning: a.辅助的,支援的 n.辅助者,辅助设备
words.example: The first verb in each of the following sentences is an auxiliary - I would love a drink, When did you arrive?, She has finished her book.  下面这些句子中的第一个动词都是助动词—— I would love a drink, When did you arrive?, She has finished her book。

words.meaning: n.红宝石
words.example: The ring has a ruby in it.  这枚戒指镶着红宝石。

words.meaning: a.作为结果而发生的;合成的
words.example: The resultant force pushes upward.  合力向上推。

words.meaning: n.(有关某一专题的)书目;参考书目
words.example: Other sources of information are found in the bibliography at the end of this article.  其他资料来源见文末的文献目录。

words.meaning: a.勤奋的,用功的
words.example:
Leo is very diligent in/about his work.  利奥工作非常勤奋。
Their lawyer was extremely diligent in preparing their case.  律师为他们这个案子做了认真扎实的准备。
The discovery was made after years of diligent research.  这一发现是数年潜心研究的成果。

words.meaning: a.瞬间的,即刻的
words.example: an instantaneous response/reply/reaction  即时的回应／回答／反应

words.meaning: n.桶, 提桶; 一桶的量
words.example:
Fill the pail with sand.  把这个桶子装满沙。
It took several pails of water (= the amount a pail contains) to put out the fire.  这把火用了好几桶水才扑灭。

words.meaning: n.雄伟,壮丽,庄严,威严;最高权威,王权
words.example:
[as form of address] The performance begins at 8.30, (Your) Majesty.  演出八点半开始，陛下。
This music has majesty, power and passion.  这首乐曲富有气势、力量和激情。
The photograph captures the sunset in all its majesty.  照片尽显落日的壮丽。

words.meaning: n.[一般用于否定句或疑问句中]效用,利益
words.example:
We tried to persuade her not to resign, but to no avail (= did not succeed).  我们力劝她不要辞职，可她不听。
My attempts to improve the situation were of little/no avail.  我竭力扭转局面，但是收效甚微／徒劳无功。verb transitive old use
Our efforts availed us nothing (= did not help).  我们的努力全是白费。verb transitive old use

words.meaning: n.少女,处女 a.未婚的,纯洁的,无经验的
words.example:
In the story, the prince woos and wins the fair maiden.  在故事里，王子向那位美丽的姑娘求婚，赢得了她的芳心。noun countable
The Titanic sank on her maiden voyage.  “铁达尼”号在处女航时沉没了。

words.meaning: v.纠正,整顿, [化]精馏
words.example: Every effort is made to rectify any errors/mistakes before the book is printed.  在书付印前会尽力去审校修改书中的错误。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.食品商,杂货商
words.example: The grocer weighed the vegetables.  杂货商称了蔬菜。

words.meaning: n.速记
words.example: Their conversations were taken down in shorthand by a secretary.  他们谈话的内容由一位秘书速记了下来。UK US  (also stenography)

words.meaning: a.诚恳的,亲切的,热诚的
words.example:
Relations between the two leaders are said to be cordial.  据说两位领导人关系友好。UK adjective
The two statesmen are known to have a cordial dislike for each other.  众所周知，这两位政治家是死对头。UK noun uncountable    UK

words.meaning: n.桨,橹 v.划,划动,划行
words.example:
She dipped her oars into the water and pulled.  她把桨放到水中划起来。    Compare paddleUK noun countable
No-one asked him to help - he's always sticking his oar in.  没人请他帮忙——他总爱多管闲事。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)点心,饮料;精力恢复,爽快

words.meaning: n.十二月

words.meaning: n.(defense)防御,保卫;防务工事;辩护

words.meaning: vt.蒸馏,用蒸馏法提取;吸取,提炼

words.meaning: v.(inquire)询问,打听;调查;查问

words.meaning: n.(glamour)魅力;魔法 vt.迷惑
